tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 gsung 'bum/_ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/

tei:publicationStmt.tei:distributor: This OCR'd text was generated using UCB's Namsel-OCR application on Jul 23, 2014 at the request of the Tibetan Buddhist Resource Center. Please note this document has not been finalized and is subject to additional changes and corrections.

tei:div.tei:p: dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib la jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur nyi dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bu pa bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis le/gas spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad skar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang ma/ban gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung 'i bod rig pa dpe sbun khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha spel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dang spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul /bams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam nga/ ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgya pa lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi/ che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las dar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ga khug nang bstan dbe rnying 'chos ba phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdi/sgrig gsal sand/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / g.yin yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang ngo/ tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gcug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags (ka) khe) rtoganakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) 'a) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la ( ja she (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags (nya) ste rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags (ta)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags 9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags rton)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags 9)ste bstod tsho gos dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) (mi 64ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza)ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma ltar)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su la lja mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la lja'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang /tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la bra slong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor zhabrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad kur ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /raka ga nang ba na dpe rnying 'tshor ba phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hong gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sbrul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'brungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu de'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung 'o1 theg gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung mtho so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung mtho nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ g.yin yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sdo khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhig mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa g.yin don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ras gdang gas dpe rnying 'a por bas phyog ga khang nas/10

dkar chagazab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (1)mchod par brjod pa'i sgo/ (2)dngos po nges bstan gyi sgo/ (4)dang po/ bstan par 'jug pa'i sgo so so thar pa'i sdom rgyun/ 510)gnyis pa/ zhugs nas thos bsam bya ba gnas lnga rig pa bshad pa/1 thun mong ba'i rig pa'i gnas bshad pa/lo)log smra tshar gcod pa sgra dang gtan tshigs rig pa/ (16)(she gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa bzo dang gso ba rig pa sogs lung brgyud sna tshogs/ (26)2 thun mong ma yin pa nang rig pa'i lung brgyud las/6)rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i skor/ (28)'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i rtsa 'grel gyi lung brgyud/ (28)mngon pa mdzod rang 'grel dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud/ 431)sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud/ 433)dbu ma 'jug pa rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud/ 435)byams chos sde lnga sogs kyi lung brgyud/ (37)blo sbyong don bdun ma sogs blo sbyong khag gi lung brgyud/ (40)blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral sogs dpal sa skya'i chos skor gyi lung brgyud/ (51)1

dpe chos rin cen spungs pa sogs kyi lung brgyud/ (53)lam sgron sogs kyi lung brgyud/ (55)byang sa dang mdo sde rgyan sogs kyi lung brgyud/ (57)chos chung brgya rtsa'i lung gi lung brgyud/ (62)(na/'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'i skor/ (71)de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang gi lung brgyud/ (74)gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang ngam rig gtad legs par nos pa'i lung brgyud/ (83)rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i lung brgyud/ (87)khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang sogs kyi lung brgyud/ (90)dze ta ri'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang sogs kyi lung brgyud/ (94)lus srung ba'i man ngag ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung brgyud/ (99)thugs rje chen po'i rigs gtad dang rjes gnang thob pa'i lung brgyud/ (101)sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang legs par nos pa'i lung brgyud/ (104)sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo bka' babs dgu dang ldan pa'i rjes gnang gi lung brgyud/ (110)gong dkar lugs kyi sgrol dkar gyi tshe 'khrid rgyun khyer nyams khrid sogs kyi lung brgyud/ (115)ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang gi lung brgyud/ (119)

sum pa lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang dang sgrub skor gyi lung brgyud/ (120)mi 'khrugs pa lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nos pa'i lung brgyud/ (123)rdo rje rnam 'joms dkar po lha bcu dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang nos pa'i lung brgyud/ (124)dpal phyag na rdo rje lha bcu bdun gyi dbang legs par nos pa'i lung brgyud/ (126)khro bo sme brtsegs dud kha'i rjes gnang sogs kyi lung brgyud/ (130)dzam lha dkar po 'brug gzhen lha lnga ma'i rjes gnang sogs rdzogs par nos pa'i lung brgyud/ (133)rnam sras kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa zhi ba bde byed ser po lha dgu'i rjes su gnang ba'i lung brgyud/ (135)bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par thob pa'i lung brgyud/ (158)thub pa'i dbang po la gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i rjes gnang legs par thob pa'i lung brgyud/ (162)spyod rgyud kyi lung brgyud/ (163)rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lung brgyud/ (165)kun rig rtsa ba'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du chos rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi yig cha'i steng nas dbang legs par nos pa'i stod lugs kyi lung brgyud/ (/69)rnal 'byor bla med kyi lung brgyud/ (173)3

gshin rje gshed kyi skor/ (193)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ro langs brgyad skor lha dgu pa rwa lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i lung brgyud / (196)dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa'i smin byed dang lha'i rtags sogs rtags can mi 'dra ba 'ga'i lung brgyud/ (217)dge lugs kyi 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khen ra gyi dbang bzhi sogs 'jigs byed chos skor sna tshogs kyi lung brgyud/ (224)'pho ba 'jag rnags ma'i nyams khrid kyi brgyud sdo/gas khag bas)ga (262)kye rdor skor gyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i lung brgyud/ (275)rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos dbang gi sgrol ma dmar po'i rjes gnang gi lung brgyud/ (286)slob bshad gser chos kyi skor gyi lung brgyud/ (309)rten 'brel byin rlabs kyi brgyud lugs/ (359)zur gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud/ (362)sa skya pa'i gdams pa dmar po skor gsum du grags pa'i sgrub thabs gsan pa'i lung brgyud/ (391)rjes gnang thun mong ba dang / tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ga tho'i chu rgyun gyi lung brgyud/ (397)kye rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa sogs kye rdor gyi chos skor gyi lung brgyud/ (413)dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i skor gyi lung brgyud/ (424)ngor nas brgyud pa'i lung brgyud/ (429)

mkhas grub phal cher gyi rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur ba'i snying khrag gi gzungs lta bu snyan rgyud po ti'i skor/ (478)las sbyor thor bu'i skor las sgrub thabs sna tshogs kyi brgyud lugs/ (509)rgya gzhud lugs sogs dbang brgyud lugs khag gi skor/ (519)mgon po gsang sgrub lha dgu sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig gi brgyud lugs/ 4529)gong dkar lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa sogs lung brgyud 'ga' zhig (533)rtags sna tshogs las sa'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud skor/ (579)tshar lugs rdzong pod kyi lung sogs legs par nos pa'i lung brgyud skor/ (584)rjes gnang dang lung gdams skor rags rim gyi brgyud lugs khag (599)

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ra༅༅/ /zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po bzhugs/༄tsho/ /shis pa brjod pa'i sgo dang po/ phun tshogs rang bzhin rnam dag 'dus ma byas shing 'bad rtsol mtshan ma nyer zhi'i lhun grub yon tan sgra rtog tsam gyis 'jal min mkhyen brtse nus mnga' don gnyis can/ /(2na shog ge'i yul bral las nyon tshul min yid byed rnam rtog nyer spangs 'dzin stangs sgrib pas bslad pa ma zhugs de nyid legs gsal mi mthun phyogs gnyen 'gog lam ldan/ /(2bldan dam kun rdzob chos lugs rig cing nang gi ye shes yongs gzigs spang bya chags thogs dman pa'i sgrib las yongs grol phyir mi ldog ste yon tan bdun mnga' ba/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun zhes mtshan grags pa'i gdugs dkar srid rtser 'khor ba'i grib tu bsil bar 'gro kun ngal gsor spyod pa'i bkra shis dpal gyis deng 'dir skyongs/shis pa brjod pa'i sgo gnyis pa/ gang gi mtshan snyan dzam+bha'i ljon pa snod ldan rgya mtshor lhungs pa'i mod la 'chi med chu po'i gser du sgyur mdzad tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon/ /thugs rje'i ka pu ra yi gzegs mas dus kyi pho lha'i tsha reg yongs bcil bskal brgya'i yun 'tsho bsil ba'i bde ster yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /yid 'phrog thabs kyi nyag phran gzhen nu shes rab rgyud las nye bar 'phos pas(3na)srid zhi'i brtan pa kun 'phrog bcom ldan rig byed dbang gi rgyal/ /lha mchog rnam gsum snying gi ze'u 'brur rtag tu bzhugs la mkhyen brtse nus pa'i chu 'dzin las 'ongs dngos grub char du 'bebs pa'i dge legs stsol/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonashis pa brjod pa'i sgo gsum pa/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i phra rab rdul gyi grangs bzhin pha mtha' mi mngon rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu gyur kyang gzhen nu'i tshul/ /'dzin mdzad 'tshams sprin gsar pa'i lang tsho rab rgyas mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar ci yang ngoms pa'i zur phud lnga ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gang dang gnyis med mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' bzhi'i bde chen 'dren mdzad rgyud mangs glu las dam chos sgra 'khrol dbyangs can lha/ /yab yum zung 'jug thugs rje'i nyi mas bdag yid mi shes smag rum legs bsal ngag la ngag gi dngos grub ma lus stsol/mchod par brjod pa'i sgo/mar par brjod pa'i sgo dang po/sgrib gnyis lcags khams bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen dngul chus nyer bzas dbyings rig gser bsgyur bde ba chen po chos kyi sku/ /'og min zhing khams zhing gi gtso bor nges pa lnga ldan snang stong sgyu dra'i gar mkhan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zla ba gcig las stong phrag rdzing bur gzugs brnyan ji bzhin grangs med zhing du sna tshogs rnam rol sprul pa'i sku/ khyab bdag kun bzang rdor sems shākya'i rgyal sogs dus gsum sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas rnams phyag gi sdo/95/mar par brjod pa'i sgo gnyis pa/ 'phags bod skye rgu'i legs byas na ma mkhar phan bde'i nyi ma gung nas 'char ba'i bka' drin zla (3ba)bral ba/ /gnas brtan dgra bcom rig 'dzin grub chen shing rta che sogs lung dang rtogs pa'i rin cen bang mdzod can/ /mkhan slob pad+ma'i ngang tshul chos rgyal mes dbon rim par byon dang snga phyi'i sgra bsgyur 'jig rten mig /thub bstan rin cen do shal bshad sgrub srad bur rgyud mdzad rnams ni dngos po kun gyis gas bya'i gnas/mar par brjod pa'i sgo gsum pa/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga so zur gnubs nyang bka' gter gdung gsob —2

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)sngags 'chang rgyal po he ru gaḥ /jo 'brom sku mched rnam gsum glang shar bya 'chad brgyud 'dzin bka' gdams pa zhes rgyal ba'i sras/ /rigs gsum gar mkhan 'khon rigs sa skya'i bla chen rjes 'brangs bcas dang shong dpang bu ston zhabs/ /gangs can bstan pa yun du srog 'tsho'i bdud rtsi'i bum bzang tshogs la snying nas dang bas bsngags/mar par brjod pa'i sgo bzhi pa/ 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo gzhom pa'i byed por bshad sgrub dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi'i mgon por/ /'jam mgon mkhyen dpyod gser 'khor nam mkhar 'phags pas rmongs pa'i dgra tshogs las rgyal ba/ /thub bstan gling bzhi yongs la dbang sgyur blo bzang grags 'bar kun mkhyen btsong kha pa/ /gang gi bzhed gzhung 'khrul med 'dzin bcas deng nas byang chub bar du gtsug na mdzes/ma rdzo par brjod pa'i sgo lnga pa/ rang skal cha phra'i rnyog mar skyabs mchog de kun gzugs brnyan 'char min yang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan dkon cog chos tshul rab 'phel smon 'gro paṇa chen sogs/ /gnasalnga'i gtsug (4na tshe pag tshigs bcad tsam gyis mtha' rten ston mdzad yongs 'dzin tshogs/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul gar du nges rnyed dang ba'i yid kyis 'dud/mar par brjod pa'i sgo drug pa/ khyad par tsho gos gnyis sa bon yongs su smin pa'i bla med chos gzugs gzod ma nyid nas dar drag kyang / /dman blor tha mal zol can dpal 'byor lhun grub chos dbyings rang grol 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan sde/ /rin cen bsod nams mchog tu lhun grub nyang ston rig pa'i rdo rje chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i zhabs/ /bshes gnyen yongs 'du'i 'khri shing 'bras bzang ro bdas bdag yid myos las dga' spro'i bstod bsngags dbyangs su len/mar par brjod pa'i sgo bon pa/ grangs ring bgrod dka' srid pa'i lam du nye bar dub pa'i gdung skyob phyir du rgyal kun ye shes phung po'i gzugs/ /bskal bzang 'di la rnam 'dren stong gi sgyu 'phrul bsdoms pa mi lus zol can rigs brgya'i bdag po yongs 'dzin rje/ /de yang sems nyid kho na'i —3—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ma nor rang tshul 'di la (5na 'khog tu mgu/ /gal chung chos su byed pa bdag 'dra la/ /gang thob rgyud la longs pa'i nyams len mthu/ /ches cher phra yang mang thos phan yon tshogs/ /thub gsung dgongs 'grel bcas par bgrang yas gsung / /thos dang bsam pa'i me tog bcud kyi ro/ /blo gsal rkang pa drug pa'i khyus myangs pa'i/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi thub bstan gzhen nu yis/ /btungs pas phan bde'i lang tsho gcig tu rgyas/ /de lta'i ngo mtshar mu tig 'phreng / /mgrin par 'chang bas dal 'byor rten/ /don ldan dkyus ring mig zur mdas/ /'di phyi gtan mdun 'gugs pa bzhin/ ma pham mgon gyi gsung rab rab brgyan las bsngags gnas lnga rig /rig pas tshig don ma lus lus pa med spyod blo gros gsal/ /gsal mdzad mkhas las deng dus dus kyis rmongs pa phrin pa'i tshul/ /tshul ldan rnams kyis brtags tshe tshe 'di'i sto rgyab shugs kyis nongs/ /sems kyi khye'u dug gsum rjes rgyug thob thob mang dang gsan rgya can/ /phra zhib lta shog grangs tsam med kyang nges nges lta bur dpe kun bklag /rnam dag rgyun dang brgyud pa dang bral rang rang rigs mthun mgo bo bskor/ /mi gtsang dri la sbrang bu ji bzhin thibs thibs skal med tshogs rnams 'khor/ /yang yang bsams kyin sngon byon mkhas grub rtogs brjod brjod pa don dang ldan pas yid phrogs te/ /ngal ngal thos bsam sgom par byas pa mngon mtho mtho ris rtsa bar nges nas brtson pa yis/ /dka' dka'i gnas la 'jigs pa spangs te (5bang nga blo blo gros spobs mthor bteg nas legs dpyad de/ /mang mang tshig don brgyud par bcas kun phra zhib zhib mos gtan la phab 'di skal bzang dpyid/ /de phyir nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro kun phan dang bde ba'i lam po cher sbyor rtsi sman ljon pa che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis snying stobs mchogo la phul du byung bsngags zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa dri ma med/ /lhar bcas skye rgu'i legs byas rgya mtsho'i mchod sdong dam par srid mthar gnas rgyur 'gyur snyam lhag bsam gyis/ /phongs pas nor bzhin 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun deng 'dir 'bab/ /phyi nang grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs rtogs par dka' ba sgra tshad bzo —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonagaso nang don rig pa'i khog 'bub pa/ /legs bshad bye ba'i gter gyi bang mdzod sngon med nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'dzin pa snang ba dam pa'i dpal 'bar ba/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i legs bris lam du 'char nub spangs pa'i dam bca' can de nam yang mi 'gog nyer shar bas/ /gzur gnas blo ldan snying gi 'dab brgya rnam par bzhad do dpyod ldan tsho gis rnams rna ba'i dbang po blags te nyon/ /ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te/ ji skad du slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis/ bde gshegs lam brten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing / /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa/ /lam de lha dang klu yis rnyed min lha min dang / /mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar theg pa chen po'i lam la (6nang rten nas mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba rnams bla na med pa byang chub kyi sar 'dren par nus pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag gis drangs pa'i smon pa dang 'jug pa 'i sems khyad par can dal 'byor gyi rten la bskyed pa de tsam 'gro ba gzhan dag gis mi rnyed cing der ma zad 'khor ba 'dir bcings pa las rnam par grol ba'i zhi ba'i go 'phang bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gtso bo'ang dal 'byor gyi lus yin pas na/ zhi ba lhas/ 'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas/ bdag gis dge goms ma byas pa/ /'di las bslus pa gzhan med de/ /'di las rmongs pa gzhan med do/ /zhes pa ltar shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can thob pa'i dus don du gnyer bya ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang yin zhing / /de yang bshes springs las/ mgo'am gos la slo bur me shor na/ /de dag phyir zlog bgyi ba btang nas kyang / yang srid med par bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal te/ /'di bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes 'di dang phyi ma'i bde 'brasatsam sgrub pa'i zhan byung du mi byed par ma zad zhi ba bsgrub pa'i gegs su gyur pa'i gnas skabs kyi bde ba'i thabs kyang yal bar dor nas brtson pa chen pos bsgrub dgos par gsungs shing / de ltar bsgrub pa'i thabs ni/ tshul khrims dag dang shes rab bsam gtan gyis/ /mya ngan 'das zhi dul ba dri med pa'i/ /go 'phang mi rga mi 'chi zad mi 'tshal/ /sa chu me rlung nyi zla bral thob mdzod/ /ces lam —6

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bslab 4ba)pa gsum la brten nas sgrub dgos shing / de sgrub pa la'ang / mgon po byams pas/'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / /tshul bzhin yid la byed lasayang dag don yul ye shes khrung / /zhes thos bsam sgom gsum gcig la gcig brten gyi go rim ma nor ba rgyu 'bras kyi tshul du gsungs pas/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i/ /lam dang sgom pa'i lam gnyis la/ /yang dang yang du sems pa dang / /'jal dang nges rtogasasgom pa'i lam/ /zhes mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgom byung gi lam rnams rgyud la skye ba la don yang nas yang du 'jal ba'i bsam byung gi dpyad sgom sngon du 'gro dgos shing / tshul bzhin bsam par byed pa la de'i don ston pa'i bka' bstan bcos sogs gtsug lag rnams mang po thos dgos pas/ mkhasamachog dpa' bos/ gang zhig thos pas yid ni dad gyur nas/ /legs par dga' la brten pa nyid du 'gyur/ khres rab skye zhing gti mug med par 'gyur/ /rang gis shes kyang de ni nyo bar rigs/ /thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /rkun po la sogs mi 'byer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtsho ni cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pas grogs kyi mchog /phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin/ /gnod pa med pa mya ga nad kyi sman/ /nyes pa r+sā po'i dpung 'joms dpung gi mchog /grags dang dpal gyi gter gyi mchog kyang yin/ /ya rabs(7na snams dang 'phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tsho gos kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar dang por thos dgos shing /de yang thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /gsung rab ma lus gdams par shar ba dang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang / /nyesaspyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang bsrung / /zhes thub pas gsungs pa'i gsung rab thams cad 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi gtso bo dang yan lag tu 'gyur ba sha stag yin pas theg pa 'di dag blang bya dang 'di dag dor bya zhes ris su ma bcad par byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs su shes dgos shing / chos la brten nas bsags pa'i sdig pa ni sdig pa gzhan las ches khyad par 'phags pas/ ting 'dzin rgyal po —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)las/ gang gi 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir ni/ /mchod rten thams cad bshig byed la/ /gang gis mdo sde spong byed pa'i/ /sdig pa de ni ches khyad 'phags/ /zhes dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po ye bzang rtse pas sgrol ma pa sangs rgyas rin cen la chos gsan tshul gyi mthug tu chos spong ba'i sgrib pas ma sbags pa tsam mo/ /zhes drin du bzo bar mdzad pa'ang tshul de 'dra la dgongs par snang ngo/ /der ma zad byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyi don bsgrub par rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom pa'i phyir/ /thabs rnams la ni mngon sbyor mdzad/ /thabs byung de rgyu lkog gyur pas/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ /zhes rang la lkog tu gyur na gzhan la ston par mi (7ba) nus pa'i phyir/ rgyal tshab ma pham pas rigs can gsum rjes su 'dzin par theg pa gsum gyi lam shes dgos par gsungs pa ltar yin la/ theg pa gsum gyi lam shes pa tsam gyis chog gam snyam na/ spyod 'jug las/rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob nga 'i/ /dngos de 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /de ltar gnas pa'i mkhas pa la/ /bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med/ ces dang / 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring / /de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang de sras kyis/ ti shes bya'i gnas kun sbyangs zhes legs par gsungs/ /che khas pa ltar shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la bslab par gsungs pa'i mtha' dang tshad gzhal ba'i spyod yul du gyur dka' na'ang / mgon po byams pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog ci sems thams cad mkhyen nyid thob mi 'gyur/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar gcad rjes gzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya/ /zhes rig pa'i gnas lngar gsungs pa rgya bod kyi mkhas grub kun la rlung ltar grags shing / blo dang ldan pa kun gyis thos bsam du bya ba'i gnas yin kyang bdag 'dra'i blo dang brtson pa zhan pa rnams kyis tshul bzhin bsgrub par nus pa'i yul ma yin mod/ 'on kyang rig pa nang par 'chi yang slob/ /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / /nor la rang nyid dbang ba yin/ /phyi ma bcol po len dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin rgyal ba'i (8na gsung rab —8

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)la bag chags kyi sa bon bzang po bskrun pa'i ched dang sngon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phu chung pa gzhen nu rgyal mtshan/ mi la bshad pa rdo rje/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la sogs kyis mtsho ni pa'i skyes chen 'di snang chos brgyad kyi zlos gar mtha' dag sgyu ma mkhan la rdel shing rta glang du snang ba ltar gzigs nas sgrub pa snying por mdzad pas tshe gcig la rdo rje'i sku mngon du gyur pa lta bu'i rnam par thar pa ni dus dbang gis mkhyen dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis kyang 'dzin pa'i skal ba ches cher phra na bdag 'drar de lta bu'i re ba tsam yang ma mchis rung / cung zad rang gi nyams su len pa dang gzhan la phan gdags pa'i go yul tsam la'ang thos bsam zhig ma byas tshe/ deng sang la la dag che ge mo dag gi skye ba dang sprul pa yin pas bslab sbyang bya mi dgos pa/ ma bslabs par rang shugs kyis mkhyen pa/bla mas slob ma'i snying gar mdzub mo btsugs te da lta slob mi dgos ma 'ongs pa na chos thams cad rang rdol du 'byung bar lung bstan pa la brten nas byung ba/ slob dpon sogs ma bsten par rang nyid kyis dpe tsam la brten nas don khong du chud pa/ tshe 'dir ma thob kyang skye ba gzhan du thob pas 'chad nyan bya rung ba sogs mtha' klas pa zhig snang ba/ ma bslab bang pa la mkhas gyur na/ khri tā 'bras bden pa ga la srid/ /ces pa ltar ma bslabs par shes pa ni rgyu 'bras kha mi bslu bas bden par mi semasashing / dpe tsam la brten nas khong du chud pa 'byung du srid kyang bstan (8ba)pa 'di la 'o skol gyi ston pa nyid ma gtogs bla ma dang slob dpon sogs med par rang byung gi sangs rgyas 'byung bar ma bshad cing brgyud pa med pas rang gzhan gang la'ang phan par mi 'gyur la/ so thar gyi sdom rgyun ma gtogs pa'i chos rnams tshe rabs sngon mar thob pa skye ba 'di'i tshe stod la byas pa tshe smad la dran pa bzhin gsal bar yod na nyes pa mi 'byung drang / shes bya lkog tu gyur pa de 'dra slob ma dad pa can gyis bla ma zog por gtong ba'i lo rgyus su 'dug pas tshul de dag rnams la rjes su yi rang bar ma gyur pas/bshes springs las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa tshangs par spyod/ /yongs su rdzogs par thub pas gsungs de'i phyir/ /skyes bu dam pa bsten bgyi rgyal ba la/ /brten nas rab tu mang pos zhi ba —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()thob/ /ces pa ltar bshes gnyen bsten pa legs byas kyi rtsa bar mthong ste rang nyid la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal ring du dor/ 'jig rten blun po'i ngor stobs 'byor dang go sa sogs la brten nas 'phrin las chen por grags pa'i ri bong cal rgyug kho na'i rjes su ma 'brangs par rig pa'i gnas gang dang gang la goms 'dris dang khungs btsun mi btsun sogs dpyad pa gsum gyis gtan la phab nas/ yid ches kyi gnas su gyur pa'i slob dpon 'ga' zhig mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas legs par bsten te tshe 'dir thos bsam cung zad bgyis pa rang nyid brjed ngas kyi 'jigs pa spang zhing dpyod ldan rnams kyi mig rkyen dang bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun la bsams pa'i yi ge'i (9na po phreng bar bkod pa la/dang po/ bstan par 'jug pa'i sgo so so thar pa'i sdom rgyun/bstan par 'jug pa'i sgo so so thar pa'i sdom rgyun/ zhugs nas thos bsam bya ba gnas lnga rig pa'i skor dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang lo dgur slebs pa bstod 'grel ba'i lugs ltar 'phags yul ba'i skad du ke na dha ste khro bor 'bod cing rgya nag po'i skad du yi tshe'u zhes pa shing mo glang gi lo nyin mor byed pa nya'i khyim du spyod pa dbo zla ba'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i nyin 'phags yul gyi dha mya ka ṭa ka gnyis par gangs kyi rwa bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir yongs su grags pa'i chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling bka' 'gyur ro cog gi tshal chen po'i gzims khang dga' ldan pho brang gi gzims chung mngon dgar/ bod dang bod chen po byang phyogs hor gyi yul gru sogs kyi dregs ldan rnams kyi ral par zhabs sen zla ba gsar du tshes shing / sde snod gsum 'dzin pa mkhabang pa gsal ba rig pa dang lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum gyi thugs rgyud yongs su gang ba mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje chen po'i mnga' bdag gnas brtan —10

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mkhan po/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pas sa'i steng na mkhas pa thams cad kyis 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu ngur smig gi gar gyis brtsen pa rje btsun dkon cog chos 'phel gyis las kyi slob dpon/ rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen gnas brtan 'dul ba (9ba)'dzin pa sgo mang slob dpon sangs rgyas bkra shis pas grib tshod pa mdzad de bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par nos/ rang lo nyer gnyis pa 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag gi lo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i dbang pos chos kyi rgyal po zla ba bzang por dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i dus chen chu shel gyi dbang po nag pa'i dga' ma dang rtse ba'i dkar cha'i tshes lnga dbyangs o/ /res gza' nyi ma zla skar snar ma 'dzom pa'i mtshan mo'i cha rgyu skar shar ba'i dus su bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por ston pa nyi ma'i gnyen dang dbyer ma mchis pa lta bu'i zhal skyin shākya mu ni'i drung du/ tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi mkhan po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon sbrags/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon cog cho me 'phel gyis las kyi slob dpon/ byes pa zhal snga nas byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa/ chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi gra tshang bdun dang se ra theg chen gling gi grwa tshang gsum gyi slob dpon lung sde snod gsum la rab tu sbyangs shing mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud yongs su gtams pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa bcu phrag gcig gis las kyi kha stong mdzad de bstan pa la zhugs la yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs (10na)pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i seng ge /'phags mchog shā ri'i bu/sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed/ dpal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/ sba rat+na/ dmar shākya mu ni/ g.yor — 11 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dge 'byung / bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ spa gong ye shes g.yung drung / grub pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sne po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ bya brtson 'grus 'bar/mkhan po gzhon nu seng ge /gro bdud rtsi grags/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ mkhan po grags pa shes rab/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/dpang ston grub pa shes rab/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ gnas rnying chos rje kun dga' bde legs/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ dga' ldan khri rin po che bde ba can pa dge legs dpal bzang / thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen dam chos yar 'phel/mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ des bdag ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho la bka' drin du stsal to/ /bla chen brgyud dang paṇa chen brgyud gnyis gar sras sgra gcan 'dzin dang bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin gyi bar du bla ma gzhan mi 'dug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu na mi rung ba'i gzhi bcu sun dbyung ba'i bka' bsdu bar pa'i tshe thams cad 'dod dang nor can sogs kun dga' (10ba)bo'i slob ma sha stag gi dgra bcom pa bdun brgya 'dus pa las sras sgra gcan 'dzin sogs dngos su bzhugs par ma bshad/ bka' bsdu bar pa nas lo nyis brgya skor na rab tu byung ba'i mtshan bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin spyod pa la gshegs nas sa ra har grags pa byon par chos 'byung mang po las bshad pas dus mi mtshungs pa'i dbang gis bar der mkhan po gcig gnyis shig chad pa 'dra/ theg pa chen po'i skabs sprul pa bstan pa dang 'ja' lus rnyed nas rjes su bzung ba sogs bshad kyang 'dul ba'i lugs la lus tha mal du gnas pa sogs nges par dgos pas dag snang dang ye shes kyi sku mjal ba skad du byas na so thar gyi rang skad la chu bun gyis tshos rgyag par 'dug pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis dpyod cig /ga rma pa rang byung rdo rje'i do ha'i lo rgyus su sras sgra gcan 'dzin la theg chen dpal gyi grags pas bsnyen par rdzogs/ de la sar has bsnyen par — 12

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rdzogs par gsung ba rang byung zhabs mkhas grub chen po yin pas khungs dang 'brel ba zhig yin nam snyam gang ltar dpyad par bya'o/ /paṇa chen dam chos yar 'phel gyis thog mar shangs ston blo grosalegs bzang la bsnyen par rdzogs/ des spos khang tshogs su bsnyen par rdzogs pa paṇa chen brgyud yin zhing slar thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sog yul du thegs khar bskyar nas bsgrubs par brten so so'i blo dang mthun pa'i brgyud pa gnyis ka 'dren pa snang yang bskyar sgrub kyi dus sdom gsum rim gyis nos na dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob pa dang lhan du sngon ma (11na gtong bas paṇa chen brgyud kyi dogs pa'ang med/ la la skal ba bzang bzang yin zer bsnyen rdzogs khe rkyang las mi sgrub pa'i rigs yong gi 'dug pa sdom pa sngon ma ma btang bar phyi ma mi skye bas bla chen brgyud 'ong don med cing / 'di skor gyi mdzad tshul lo rgyus zhib pa mi 'dug pas brgyud pa gang yin the tshom gyi gzhir snang yang 'dir phyi ma btsan pa'i dbang du byas nas bgrangs kyi gang ltar byang sems dang sngags sdom ltar brgyud pa mang po chu bo gnyis 'dres su byed pa dpe 'dir bkab na so thar gzugs can gyi sdom pa yin pas 'dul ba'i chos skad 'jig pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po 'phags pa dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma dgra bcom pa sa ga lhas mdzad pa'i 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa me tog 'phreng rgyud kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī dang khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang / 'od srungs chen po/kun dga' bo/ sha na'i gos can/ nyer sbas/ dhi dhi ka /nag po la/ legs mthong / dge 'dun 'bangs/ 'phags pa sa ga lha/ slob dpon ma ti rat+na/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ seng ge zil gnon/ rin cen bsod nams seng ge /tham phug gnas rnying pa kun dga' dbang phyug /mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ dka' bzhi pa shes rab seng ge /dka' bzhi pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon dge ba dpal/ mkhas btsun skal bzang pa/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ chos(11ba)rje kun dga' dbang phyug /slob dpon sangs rgyas—13—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dpal grub/ngor chen lha mchog seng ge/rje sangs rgyas seng ge/thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang /sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/mkhan chen zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//slob dpon yon to 'od kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba mdo rtsa klu'i rgyal mas gyis bsgyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/thub pa'i dbang po/nye ba 'khor/'od srungs/kun dga' bo/sha na'i gos can/nyer sbas/dhi dhi ka/nag po pa/legs mthong /phyir 'ong blos mi 'bebs/slob dpon yon to 'od/chos kyi bshes gnyen/shākya 'od/seng ge'i gdong can/kha che dzi na mi tra/dwa na shī la/g.yo dge 'byung /bla chen mu thur ba dgongs pa rab gsal/klu mes tshul khrims byang chub/gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/sog tshul khrims bla ma/ko khyim pa ye shes bla ma/nyang 'tshams pa rin cen bla ma/de gsum ga la rgya 'dul ba dbang phyug tshul khrims de nas me tsho byang chub rdo rje/bya 'dul brtson 'grus 'bar/chos kyi dbang phyug/chos kyi byang chub/chos kyi brtson 'grus/chos grags/rin cen dpal bzang /rin po che bsod nams grags pa/kun mkhyen bu ston rin cen grub/dmar ston rgya mtsho rin cen/chos rje gzhan nu rgyal mchog/'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/slob dpon don grub shes rab/bla ma lha mchog seng ge shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/paṇa chen thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang man gong dang 'dra/12naslob dpon shākya 'od kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba sum brgya pa dang /de'i 'grel pa 'od ldan gyi brgyud pa ni/slob dpon yon to 'od/chos kyi gos g.ya/shākya 'od/seng gdong can/sto pha la/zhang zhung pa rgyal ba'i shes rab/rab 'byor shes rab/byang chub shes rab/byang chub seng ge rdo rje seng ge smad g.yung drung /rtsi 'dul thugs rje byang chub/bde ba can pa shākya byang chub/zul phu ba yon tan grags/ slob dpon bsod blo/ slob dpon dka' bcu pa/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/'jam dbyaXs shes rab rgya mtsho man 'dra/

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i rab tu byung ba dang zhar byung khyim pa la phan gdags pa'i 'dul ba'i lag len gyi cho ga dri ma med pa'i 'phreng ba'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ slob dpon bsod nams dpal grub/ mkhas pa nor bzang rin cen/ dka' bzhi pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu zha lu lo tsā ba rin cen chos skyong bzang po/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang /sgrub khang pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po rin cen bsod shen mas ma chag grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /des mdzad pa'i dus go blo gsal (12bdag 'a ba'i mdzes rgyan dang yar 'phrog mtsho mo che'i gru nang du mdzad pa gnyis kyi lung brgyud ni/ dka' bzhi pa rin cen rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar la/ de nas rje btsun mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje/ drung pa kun dga' bkra shis/ ri lding slob dpon dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i lung mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa ra zhus/ brgyud pa ma byung / 'dul 'dzin pas mdzad pa'i dge slong dang dge tshul gyi bslab bya'i lung khri rin po che dkon cog chos 'phel la zhus/ grub chen phag spyon la gsan gsung / de yan gyi brgyud pa ma byung /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonaganyis pa/ zhugs nas thos bsam bya ba gnas lnga rig pa bshad pa/1 thun mong ba'i rig pa'i gnas bshad pa/6) log smra tshar gcod pa sgra dang gtan tshigs rig pa/gnyis pa zhugs nas thos bsam bya ba gnas lnga rig pa la/ thun mong ba'i rig pa'i gnas dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas te gnyis/ dang po la/ log smra tshar gcod pa sgra dang gtan tshigs rig pa/ gzhan dag rjes su 'dzin pa bzo dang gso ba rig pa gnyis/ dang po la sgra tshad gnyis/dang po la dngos dang zhar byung rig gnas chung ba dang gnyis/ dang po sgra la/ slob dpon dbang phyug go cha la lha gzhen nu gdong drug gis gsungs pa'i legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos ka lā pa byā ka ra ṇa'i 'grel ba 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo tsā ba rin cen chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i bshad sbyar gzhung don gsal ba la/ bsdus don/ mtha' dpyod/ gzhung 'bebs/bka' ba'i gnas de bzhis brgyan pa'i (13na skor grel ba lnga sbrags kyi lugs su legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pa/ lha thams cad mkhyen pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin/ drang srong phur bu/ ga sto nu gdong drug /slob dpon dbang phyug go cha/ rgyal po bde spyod bzang po/ jo bo grags 'byar/mkhas pa chen po tsan+d+ra go mi/ slob dpon dharma dwa sa/ mkhas pa rat+na ma ti/ paṇa chen pu rna tsan+d+ra/ slob dpon 'chi med seng ge /paṇa chen la: kā ra/ 'jig rten mig gcig shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/shong lo blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros dpung rgyan mdzes pa'i tog /dpang lo thams cad mkhyen pa blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ sgra bsgyur nam mkha' bzang po/skad gnyis smra ba thugs rje dpal zhabs/ lo chen legs pa rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos skyong bzang po/ skyogs ston rkarma lo tsā ba rin cen bkra shis blo gros ngo mtshar bye ba'i gter mdzod/— 16

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/ sgang ra lo tsā ba 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ smon 'gro paṇa chen rig gnas rgya mtsho pa tshe dbang don grub/ de sras gnas lnga rig pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal to/ /yang na lo chen thugs rje dpal nas/ dpal sdings skad gnyis smra ba grags pa'i mtshan can/ zha lu lo chen man 'dra/ yang na thugs rje dpal nas/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin cen/ zha lu lo chen man 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub nas/ngam ring mkhan po mang yul lo chen tshe brtan rgyal mtshan/ des bdag (13bsno5'o/ /'di bsdus don dang gzhung 'bebs gtso bor sbyar ba'i brgyud pa yin la mtha' dpyod gtso por sbyar ba'i brgyud pa ni/zha lu lo chen nas/ dbon pad dkar chos skyong / 'brug pa lo tsā ba spung mo ngag dbang grags pa/ lo chen dbang phyug zhabs/ shong ston sprul pa'i zlos gar sangs rgyas dpal bzang / smon 'gro paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub man 'dra/ sgra mdo 'di'i rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs ni in+d+ra byuka ra ṇa gtso che bas/ kun shes las/ brgya byin gyis byas in+d+ra byā ka ra/ /de la drang srong phur bus legs sbyangs pas/ ta shin tu sbyangs pa'i nga rgyal mchog tu gyur/ /ces 'byung bas so/ /rgya gar shar phyogs bhe ga lar zhabrungs pa'i slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mi zhes gnas lnga rig pa mkhyen pa des mdzad pa'i legs par sbyar ba'i bstan bcos tsan+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa'i 'grel pa lo chen chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i brda sprod rgya mtsho'i gru gzings kyi steng nas legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ lha phyag na pad+ma/ lha thams cad mkhyen pa/ bram zer pā ṇi jo bo grags 'byor/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra go mi/ 'grel byed dharma dwa sa/ mkhas pa rin cen blo gros/ paṇa chen pā rje tsan+d+ra/ slob dpon 'chi med seng ge slob dpon rab 'byor zla ba/ paṇa chen la: kā ra/ shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ 'phags yul blo brtan gnyis pa shong blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen mchog ldan pa/ dpang lo chen po/ lo chen byang rtse/ sgra bsgyur nam mkha' bzang po/ skad gnyis smra ba thugs rje dpal/ dpal sdings lo chen grags pa'i mtshan can/ lo chen rin cen chos stong bzang po/ dpon lo tsā (14nang pad dkar chos skyong / spyang mo lo tsā ba ngag dbang —17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()grags pa/ lo chen dbang phyug /lo chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rig gnas rgya mtsho ba smon 'gro tshe dbang don grub/ mkhan chen lo tsā ba tshe brtan rgyal mtshan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal to/ /yang na lo chen dbang phyug pa nas/ byar po lo chen shes rab dpal bzang / khro phu dus zhabs pa dpal rgyas dbang po/ smon 'gro paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /sgra mdo 'di'i rtsa ba pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa yin pas/ kun shes las/ de las tsan+d+ra go mis bsdus pa yi/ /gzhung la tsan+d+ra par grags chos 'bangs kyis/ /byas pa'i 'grel pa dang bcas bod du 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /yi ge'i skor rnams rnam pa gcig tu bzo rig pa'i khongs su bsdu rung ba zhig 'dug na'ang 'grel pa rnams bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos yin pas chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa thu mi saṃ bho ṭa rgya gar du brdzangs te paṇ+ḍi ta lha rig pa dang bram ze li byin sogs bsten nas legs sbyar gyi brda sprod la mkhas par gyur pas rgya yig lnga bcu bod yig sum cu'i gtan la phab ste bstan bcos chen po brgyad mdzad pa'i nang tshan sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug gnyis kyi 'grel ba thams cad mkhyen pa chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i steng nas legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bram ze li byin/ thu mi saṃ bho ṭa nas rim par/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos stong bzang po skyogs ston dzin lo tsā/ dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/ sgang ra lo tsā ba 'od (14ba)zer rgyal mtshan/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po smon 'gro tshe dbang don grub/ de sras 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/des bdag la'o/ /yang na paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub nas/ mang yul lo tsā ba tshe brtan rgyal mtshan/des bdag la'o/ /gnyis pa zhar byung rig gnas chung ba la 'phags yul gyi snyan ngag mkhan kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu slob dpon daṇ+ḍi'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i snyan dngags me long lam rnam dbye sgra rgyan don rgyan dang bcas pa'i dka' gnad kyi bshad pa rtsom rgyugs dang bcas shin tu zhib par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ngag gi dbang phyug lha mo dbyangs can ma/ paṇa chen kirti bhū ti/ paṇ+ḍita chen po dbyug pa can/ paṇa chen bu rna tsan+d+ra/ dpal ldan 'chi med seng ge /slob dpon rab 'byor zla ba/ paṇa chen phun —18—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)tshogs byed pa/ shong stong wo po rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ yis blo gros brtan pa/ lo ོ mchag ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ 'jig rten mig gcig dpang lo chen po/ smra ba'i nyi ma byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/ mkhas pa shes rab dpal/ lo chen thugs rje dpal/ mkhas mchoge sangasargyas mtshan can/ mang thos legs pa rgyal mtshan/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ lo chen pad dkar chos skyong / grangs chen lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rje/ smon 'gro paṇa chen rig gnas rgya mtsho pa tshe dbang don grub/ mkhas pa'i dbang po 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal to//yang na zha lu lo tsā ba nas/ ga rma lo tsā ba rin cen bkra shis/ dpal khang lo tsā ba mang thos chos kyi rgya mtsho/ sgang ra lo tsā ba 'od zer rgyal (15nasgo tshan/ smon 'gro paṇa chen man 'dra/ le'u gnyis pa don rgyan gyi bshad pa rags bsdus dang rtsom rgyugs kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ pad dkar chos skyong nas/spyang mo lo tsā ba lo chen dbang phyug lo chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang / shad khar paṇa chen 'jam dpal rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /mkhas rlom la la mkhas mchog dpa' bos na len+da'i kun dga' ra ba'i sgo 'gram du dbyug pa thogs te dge 'dun rnams re re nas bgrangs pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan la brten nas slob dpon dbyug pa can dang gcig par 'dod pa ni mi rigs te/ lam rnam dbyer/ de dag dbye ba snyan ngag mkhan/so so la gnas brjod mi nus/ zhes pa'i 'grel pa rnams su nag mo'i khol po dpa' bo sogs bgrangs pa mang zhing / snang thang lo chen khu gha sgris/ /dan+ḍi'i bstan bcos dri ma med/ /ji bzhin 'byed la dpa' bo dang / /skal mnyam blo gros mig thob pa/ /ma nor lam 'di bdag gis bshad/ ces pas kyang shes nus so/ snyan ngag mkhan kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu chos gyi rgyal po dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing yal 'dab brgya dang bdun/ de'i kha skong le'u gcig /sras zla ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa dang bcas pa'i yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung rkyang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos rgyal dge pa'i dbang po/ sras zla ba'i dbang po/ paṇ+ḍita —19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)la sgri kā ra/ shong ston rdo rje rgyal mas/ gcung blo gros brtan pa/ dbon po chos stong dpal/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan (15ba)pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa/ 'di dbyangs༅ mas rjes su bzung bar grags/ kun spangs rnam rgyal grags pa/ 'bum rab 'byams pa rin cen chos dbang / rab 'byams chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug /dpal khang lo tsā ba mang thos chos kyi rgya mtsho/ mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i rtse mo/ mkhyen bu ོ 'a dbon po yin tshe dbang kun mkhyen yang zer/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ gong dkar drung yig ri grong pa/g.yu lo bkod pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ zur lan pa/dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ chung ru thod dkar ba/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chosadabyengs rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ yang na dpal khang lo tsā ba nas/rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i rtse mo man gong ltar ro/ /'di'i dga' ba'i gnas rnams zhib bshad du nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gcung blo gros brtan pa nas/ lo mchog pa/thams cad mkhyen pa dpang lo/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/ lo chen shes rab dpal/ lo chen thugs rje dpal/ mkhas mchog budha'i mtshan can/ gnas brtan legs pa rgyal mas/ lo wo chos skyong bzang po/ dbon pad dkar chos skyong / grangs ོ lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rje/ smon 'gro paṇa chen rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa tshe dbang don grub (16na)rigs chos kyi sras mkhas mchog 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ des bdag la stsal to/ /slob dpon chen po 'chi med seng shes mdzad pa'i mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos a ma ra ko ṣa dang de'i rgya cher 'grel paṇ+ḍita rab 'byor zla bas mdzad pa'i 'dod pa 'jo ba/ gzhan yang ma ro zhe brjod kyi bstan bcos sna tshogs gsal ba/ sa paṇa gyi tshig gter sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi yi ge la brten nas dka' ba'i gnas rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen 'chi med —20

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)seng ge /slob dpon rab 'byor zla ba/mkhas pa phun tshogs byed pa/ shong lo mched gnyis/ lo mchog pa/ dpang lo chen po/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/ sgra bsgyur thugs rje dpal/ mang thos legs pa rgyal mtshan/ zha lu lo tsā ba chen po/ skyogs ston dme lo tsā ba/ dpal khang pa dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/ de la sgang ra ba 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang grangs chen 'jam dpal rdo rje gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub/ de nas sras 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rin cen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin cen 'byung gnas kyi brit+ta dzā ti ngo mtshar rtogs byed dang bcas pa nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇ+ḍita chen po rin cen 'byung gnas/ paṇa chen sa dbang bzang po/ shong lo mched gnyis/ mchog ldan pa/ dpang lo chen po/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/ /skad gnyis smra (16ba〉ba thugs rje dpal/ dpal sdings lo chen grags pa'i mtshan can/ 'gos lo gsum pa chos skyong bzang po/ skyogs ston ga me lo tsā ba/ dpal khang lo tsā ba/ sgang lo 'od zer rgyal mtshan/shes bya kun rig smon 'gro tshe dbang don grub/ de sras paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/des bdag la'o/ /yang na zha lu lo chen nas/ lo chen pad dkar chos skyong / grangs chen 'jam dpal rdo rje/ smon 'gro paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na smon 'gro paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub nas/ stag lung dbu ma lo tsā ba su brdzi/ des bdag la'o/ /zlos gar gyi bstan bcos skad rigs kyi dbang gis bod du 'jug chung bas grags chung zhing phyogs tsam mtshon pa ni/ gzugs kyi nyi ma'i bstan bcos sogs dang cha 'dra ba snyan ngag mkhan po rnams kyis mdzad srol la don gyis thon pa las zur du nos pa med do/ /dus kyi 'khor lo phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs ba'i phyi rol shes pa'i yan lag tu rtsis skor rnams dgos pas dus 'khor gyi cha lag tu bgrangs kyang mi 'thad pa ma yin mod/mkhas pa la la'i bzhed pa sgra rig pa the ba'i rig gnas chung ba lngar mdzad kyang legs sbyar rig gnas che ba lnga'i khrod du 'dren dgos pas/ dkar rtsis rig gnas chung ba'i ya gyal gcig tu mdzad —21 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yonapa khungs dang 'brel ba nas/ pad+ma dkar po'i zhal lung gi dgongs don gtso bor bzung / phug pa man ngag lugs kyi phyag len gyis rnam par spras pa'i lnga bsdus/ sgra gcan lo 'pho zla 'pho/ gza' 'dzin/ gza' lnga tshes dang nyin zhag la spyod pa de (17na bog gi myur rtsis/ bdun brgya nyi shur 'khor ba'i nyi ldog 'khor lo/ dus sbyor tat+pal dang dum bu drug pa/ zhag gsum gyi rnam par dbye ba/ g.yul rgyal gshin rje dpung gnon dang bcas pa nos pa las/ lnga bsdus sgra gcan/ myur rtsis gshin rje dpung gnon rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa/ de la mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho dang phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa chos legs rin cen/ de nas phug nas chos rje dpal mgon 'phrin las/ bde legs gar dbang phun tshogs/rigs 'dzin 'a po ga smo nu don grub/ kun mkhyen wo po chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor brte la'o/ /gza' lnga dus sbyor zhag gsum rnam dbye bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bde legs gar dbang phun tshogs nas/ mkhar grong bsod nams dar rgyas/ mkhar grong chos mdzad/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /phug lugs kyi gza' lnga nyin zhag ma myur rtsis ri mig rgya mtsho/ le'u tho nang ma bzo tshul sogs phug lugs kyi phyag len che phra rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje 'phrin las pa nas/mkhas grub dpal gyi seng ge /mkhas dbang bkra shis mtshan can/ rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang phyug /sdum bu don grub dbang rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /yang lnga bsdus sgra gcan/ mkhas grub nor bzang pa'i gza' lnga nyin zhag sogs kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ phug pa dpal seng pa nas/ sngags 'chang g.yu lo pa/ ga lhags ban nang ra ba bla mkhyen ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo gros/ des bdag la'o/ /gza' lnga (17bsko'i sna spyod la brten pa'i ri mig rgya mtsho'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje 'phrin las pa nas/ chos rje 'chi med bde ba/ mkhas pa rdo rje'i mtshan can/ dus 'khor rab 'byams pa/ smon 'gro paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub/ de sras mkhasadabang 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ des bdag la stsal to/ yang tshes spyod mgyogs rtsis kyi brgyud —22

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lugs gcig dang rgyu mtshan rtsis kyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub nas/ mang thos gzug po ba gzhen nu skal bzang / des bdag la'o/ /dpal gtsug na zla bas gsungs pa'i dbyangs char gyi rgyud le'u bcu pa'i dgongs 'grel mchog tu dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i lag len 'od zer brgya pa'am rin po che'i 'phreng ba/ lha chen dgongs rgyan/ de dag gi yig phran sna tshogs/ dom nag lte mdung / shin tu sbas pa nag po'i 'khor lo'i skor sogs kyi phyag len man ngag rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po/ dpal rta mgrin mgon po/ de'i sras dpal ldan tshangs lha nā tha/dpal zla ba kun dga' mgon po/ dpal ut+pal bzang po/ dpal gsang ba'i mtshan can/ dpal yid dam bzang po/ dpal a bhi rna gu rton/ dpal shaṅka ra bha dra/ dpal phun tshogs 'dzin bzang po/dpal seng ge go cha/ dpal 'jam dpal dga' byed/ dpal 'od mdzad/ dpal dza ya ā nan+da/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin cen/ bla ma chos rje/ slob dpon rin cen rgyal po/ slob dpon rin cen dbang phyug /bla ma gzhen nu rin cen/ sngags 'chang lhun grub dpal/ mkhas(18naXpyob chos rje/ mkhasamachog ār+ya de wa/ mkhas dbang sangs rgyas blo gros/ dus zhabs pa chen po dpal mgon 'phrin las/dus ram pa 'chi med bde ba/ mkhas pa rdo rje'i mtshan can/ dus 'khor rab stims pa/ smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta rig gnas rgya mtsho pa tshe dbang don grub/ de sras shes bya kun rig 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ des bdag la stsal to/ /'grel pa mchog tu dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs kyi steng nas dbyangs 'char gyi phyag len yongs su rdzogs pa/ rje 'phrin las pas mdzad pa'i gshin rje dpung gnon gyi thog nas g.yul rgyal gyi skor rnams nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal mgon 'phrin las yan bshad ma thag pa ltar la/ de nas mkhas pa dpal gyi seng ge /bla mkhyen g.yu lo ba/ gnyags ban ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo gros/ desabadag la'o/ /'phags pa'i yul du nag rtsis kyi tha snyad ma grags kyang bod yul du rtsis skar nag ces —23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()grags pa'i zhar byung mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar gsungs pa'i skor la rtsa ba'i rde'u drug /gcod dral gyi rde'u nyi shu rtsa gcig /zhe bdun ma/ bcu bzhi ma/ brgyad ma/ thang shing rtsis/ tshe rtsis/ bag rtsis/ gshin rtsis/ zang khyam sogs nib tu nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ lo tsā ba khams pa phra mo sogs nas rim par/ khyung nag shāka dar/ phug pa ba mkhas mchog ārla de wa/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas blo gros/ rtsis rig smra ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal mgon 'phrin las/ chos rje bde legs gar (18ba)dbang phun tshogs/ rigs 'dzin gzhen nu don grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la stsal to/yang na dpal mgon 'phrin las nas/ mkhas mchog dpal gyi seng ge /bla mkhyen g.yu lo ba/ gnyags ban nang ra ba ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo gros/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /gnyis pa tshad ma rig pa ni/ mdun legs ma las/ khyad par tshur rol mthong bas dngos po kun/ /de nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i sgo gcig pu/ /yang dag rig pa'i gzhung gi dka' gnad la/ /'bad pa du mas yang nas yang du sbyang / /zhes dang / tshad ma'i stobs kyis the tshom ma chod na/ /'dam la btab pa'i phur ba ji bzhin du/ /yang dag bag chags brtan po 'jog mi nus/ /zhes pa ltar rig pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma sde bdun du grags pa'i nang nas rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dgongs pa thal 'phreng gi 'grel pa paṇa chen mchog lha ba dang drung chen legs pa bzang po'i gsung rgyun gyi yig cha/ ṭī skas 'grel pa rnam bshad thar lam gsal byed dang / gra chung ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i yi ge rnams kyi steng nas gnang bar thog mar sgo 'byed du cha gtsang sogs kyi dus nas dar srol bzhin mtshan mtshon/ rdzas ldog /dgag gzhi/ drug sgra/ thal 'gyur/rgyu 'bras sogs bsdus gra'i brtsi tshul rnams 'ol ci tsam min pa'i zhib mor gtan la phab nas rtags skor blo skor thal 'phreng ṭīka 'grel dang bcas legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa (19na)tshad ma'i skyes bu/ mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ dgra bcom pa chos skyobs/ mkhas pa me waṃ ga /—24

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rje bas btsong kha pa'i gas yig na me wa ga zhes snang / kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gnyen/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po/ slob dpon dbang phyug sde/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi gsan yig na 'di mi 'dug pa go dam snyam/rig pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa/ slob dpon lha dbang blo gros/ slob dpon shākya blo gros/ 'di man nas waṃ gu paṇ+ḍita'i bar grol mchog gi gsan yig tu gong 'og 'khrugs pa dang mang nyung phran tshegs byung ba bu ston dang ngag chos pa'i gsan yig sogs dang ma mthun pas nor 'brul byung ba 'dra'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rgyan mkhan por yang grags/ slob dpon dza mā ri/ kun mkhyen bu dang rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis go ldog tu 'dug pas dpyad/paṇ+ḍita chos mchog sa rnga bdun pa'ang zer/ slob dpon dul ba'i lha/ bram ze shaṅka ra nan+da/ mkha ngag chos pa'i gsan yig na bde byed dga' bar bsgyur 'dug /waṃ gu paṇ+ḍi ta/ bu ston rin po che'i gsan yig na waṃ gi paṇ+ḍita dang ngag chos pa'i gzha yig na wa yu zhes snang / paṇa chen shākya shrī/ paṇ+ḍita su ga ta shrī/ paṇa chen dwa na shi la/ bal po /gha shrī/de bzhi ga la chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa gsan/ de nas 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge /zhang mdo sde dpal/'jam skya nam mkha' dpal/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod namasargyal mtshan/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ re mda' ba ga 'ozhe nu blo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa dar ma rin cen/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags pa (19ba tha zang po/ dmar khams pa grag bzang yang zer/ gra chung pa kun mkhyen yon tan rgya mtsho/ shangs ston dri med bshes gnyen/ paṇa chen mchog lha 'od zer/ 'jam dbyangs legasapa bzang po/ mkhas pa chos kyi grags pa/ khri rin po che rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i dbang phyug stag lung brag pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'jams dbyangs mi'i gzugs can dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag za hor brje la stsal to/ yang na 'jam dbyangs mchog lha ba nas/gling smad lha dbang dpal 'byor/ rgyal khang rtse pa man 'dra/ yang na rje re mda' pa nas/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa/ gra chung ba yon tan rgya mtsho man 'dra/ yang na nya dpon kun dga' dpal nas/g.yag mi pham sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston pa shes bya kun rig /mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags pa —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bzang po man 'dra/ yang na chos rje bla ma dam pa nas/ mkhas pa brtson 'grus dpal/ kun mkhyen g.yag pa man 'dra/(she gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa bzo dang gso ba rig pa sogs lung brgyud sna tshogs/gnyis pa gzhan dag rjes su 'dzin pa la bzo dang gso ba gnyis/ dang po bzo rig pa ni kun shes las/ bzo la lus bzo ngag bzo yid bzo gsum/ /zhes sgra yangs pa'i dbang du byas na/ rig pa'i gnas phal cher bzo rig pa'i khongs su 'du zhing / bye brag pa shā ri'i bus zhus pa dang bde mchog sdom 'byung las gsung pas mtshon mdo rgyud las nye bar byung ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo sogs kyi sku'i thig rtsa thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang / de'i gsal byed du gyur pa dbyangs can mas (20na)rjes su bzung ba rta nag ri mkhar ba dpal ldan blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas thig rtsa'i rim pa zhib mor nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sman bla don grub pa/sku mdun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ sdom brtson blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mkhas mchog yon tan rgya mtsho/ dpyod ldan chu bzang sprul sku/ rigs 'dzin chen po gzhen nu don grub/ shes bya kun mkhyen chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /rgya dkar nag gi bzo pos bskrun pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan/ rol mo/ dkar yol/ gos dar/ go mtshon/ rta sogs dngos spyad kyi rigs rnams brtag thabs kyi bstan bcos sngon gyi yi ge rnying pa'i rigs dang khyad par grum stod lha sa paṇa chen dang bya bkra shis dar rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i yi ge dang dngos po rnams ngo 'phros par zhib tu bstar ba'i brgyud pa ni/ sde pa lha sa rdzong pa paṇa chen/ mtsho sgo ba grags pa rdo rje/ paṇ+ḍita chen po smon 'gro ba tshe dbang don grub/ sprul sku mdo sngags—26

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gling pa/ dpyod ldan gzug po ba gzhen nu skal bzang des bdag la'o/ /yang rgya dkar nag gi rten brtag pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ kun mkhyen tshe dbang don grub nas/ paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /gnyis pa gso ba rig pa'i skor la/ mkhas mchog dpa' bos mdzad pa'i yan lag brgyad pa dang so ma ra tsa sogs rgya dkar nag gi gtsug lag mang du snang ba ni kho bos spyod yul du ma gyur zhing /deng sang lag len phal cher dpal ldan rgyud bzhi dang bdud rtsi bum pa sogs rnying ma bka' gter nas byung ba (20ba tshegs che bas yig cha'i grangs dang lung rgyun sogs gsang sngags sngags 'gyur gyi so so'i skabs gang babs su bris shing rtsa bshad phyi gsum gyi bshad pa sa ga khod/ rdel 'grem/ phyag len ngo sprod thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa sman gyi bla/ drang srong rig pa'i ye shes/ drang srong yid lasaskyes/ 'tsho byed gzhen nu/ mgon po klu sgrub/ dpal ldan dpa' bo/ paṇa chen zla ba mngon dga'/ lo chen be+e ro tsa na/ rje khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston gra pa mngon shes/ dge bshes dbus pa dar grags/ rog ston dkon cog skyabs/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po/ /sum ston ye shes zung 'tsho byed gzhen nu ye shes/ mkhas pa 'bum seng / gtsang ston sangs rin/ mkhas pa don grub rin cen/bstan 'dzin don grub rgyal mtshan brang ti dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed/ dge slong tshal pa dbang grags/ mkhas mchog phun tshogs bzang po/ zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje/ lag len mthar phyin tshe 'bum/ byar po paṇa chen/ mkhas pa zla ba'i dbang po/ sems dpa' chen po blo bzang rgya mtsho/ drang srong bstan 'dzin rgyal po/ de sras drang srong dar rgyas/ gcung mkhas mchog gzhan phan dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed nas/ zul phu sman mo che pa sman ston dbang
