phyug bzang po/ rje zur mkhar ba man 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen mnyam nyid rdo rje nas/ kong ston mkhas pa'i dbang po/ sman bla shākya dbang phyug /mkhas pa bsod nams rgyal po/ rin cen sdings sems dpa' chen po man (21na skor dra/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()2 thun mong ma yin pa nang rig pa'i lung brgyud las/6) rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i skor/gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa nang rig pa la/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa/ de dag kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa thub pa chen po'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang gsum/ dang po ni/mdun legs ma las/ blang dor gnas la kun nas 'thoms pa'i mun/ /yang dag thos pa'i sgron mes ma bsal bar/ /lam mi shes na thar pa'i grong mchog tu/ /'jug par 'gyur ba smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /de nyid phyir na mi pham chos rje dang / /'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes grags pa'i/ /gzhung la phyogs re ba dang rags pa res/ /tshim par ma byas kun la zhib tu sbyangs/ /tshul 'di bsam zhing mdun ma legs nas gda'/ /bka' drin che'o rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung lugs kyang rje btsun re mda' pa chen pos/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan mchog dka' chen bzhi/ /rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum theg chen rgyud bla dang / /chos mngon mdzod dang dpal ldan 'dus pa sogs/ /rnam bshad byas pa'i gzhung lugs bcu phrag gcig /ces pa'i mtha' dag khong du chud par dka' na'ang ji ltar thos pa las ṣ+ka ma ni gong du song zin/ /'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i rtsa 'grel gyi lung brgyud/bstan pa'i rtsa ba dam pa'i chos 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i dgongs pa'i don snying por bsdus na ston pa 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i mchog rnam pa gnyis las slob dpon yon to 'od kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba rgya cher 'grel dang bcas pa'i gzhung don gsal bar byed pa thams —28

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun 21bskra1ba kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ṭīka rin cen 'phreng ba/skyed tshal ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang /paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/pha bong kha pa bde legs nyi ma gsum gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas spyi don dang thal 'phrong legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/thams cad mkhyen pa zas gtsang sras po/dgra bcom pa nye ba 'khor/'phags pa 'od srungs/rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig dang rdo rje gdan pas stag tshang lo tsā bar gsan pa'i thor 'di mi 'dug/'phags pa kun dga' bo/dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/rje bas btsong kha pa'i gas yig na 'di mi snyug pa ho dam dpyad/dgra bcom pa nyer sbas/dgra bcom pa dhi dhi ka/dgra bcom pa nag po pa/dgra bcom pa legs mthong /phyir mi 'ong bu ston dang grol mchog gi gsan yig na 'di gnyis so sor phral 'dug pa dpyad cing grol mchog gi der dgra bcom phyir mi 'ong zhes snang ba phyir mi 'ong rnams slar dgra bcom gyi go 'phang mngon du byed dgos pas dar 'brug tsho btsun pa thams cad la dge slong zer ba'i dpe zla yin pa 'dra'o/blos mi 'bebs/kha che 'dus bzang /'di gnyis gsan yig gas tshor migs la yang rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig dang stag tshang lo tsā bar rdo rje gdan pas gsan pa'i brgyud par 'dug pas khungs btsun par mngon/slob dpon dbyig gnyen/slob dpon yon to 'od/slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen/rje gzha btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na mi sig /slob dpon shākya 'od/dgra bcom pa seng ge'i gdong can/kha che dzi na mi tra/gsan yig la lar 'di gnyis go ldog tu 'dug pa rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na des ba na shī la dang dzi na mi tra 22naganyis la zhes dang /gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na gang rung gcig gis cho go par mdzad cing /grol mchog gi gsan yig na lhan mi tra las mi 'dug pas gnyis ka bgrangs phyin go rim gyi nges pa mi dgos pa 'dra'o//paṇa chen dā na shī la/cog gru klu'i rgyal mtshan/stag tshang par gong dkar bsags na pa'i brgyud yig na 'dug pas yid ches su mngon/g.yo dge 'byung /bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/klu mes tshul khrims 'di gnyis kyi bar du gru mer tshul khrims 'byung gnas dang skyogs shes rab 'byung gnas gnyis sa skya'i las chen ye shes lhun grub la grol mchog gis gsan pa'i brgyud par 'dug pa dus kyi snga phyi'i dbang du byas na 'thad par mthong yang bu ston/gong dkar ba/ngag chos dwags po paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal rnams kyi gsan yig na mi 'dug pas lo rgyus chos 'byung dang bas nas dpyad dgos yod /༷ /kun mkhyen bu dang mkhan ngag chos pa'i gsan yig na gzungs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhes pa snang bas brtag/byang chub/gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/sogs tshul khrims bla ma/ko khyim pa ye shes bla ma/nyang mtshams pa rin cen bla ma/de gsum ga la rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa dbang phyug tshul khrims/de nas rma tsho byang chub rdo rje/bya 'dul ba brtson tsos 'bar/bla ma chos kyi dbang phyug/chos kyi byang chub/na bza' phred ga i bar yang grags/rje chos kyi brtson 'grus/chos grags rin cen dpal bzang /mkhan chen dka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhen nu/rin po che bsod nams grags pa/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/dmar ston rgya mtsho rin cen/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa/kun mkhyen mus srad pa blo gros rin cen seng ge/se ra gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/rje bas don yod dpal ldan/paṇa 22bstob bsod nams grags pa/rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/'jam dpal dbyangs stag lung brag pa/gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dkon cog chos 'phel/des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to//yang na rma tsho byang chub rdo rje nas/skyid shod pa tshul khrims 'phags/'dar tshul khrims rgyal po/nyi steng pa tshul khrims grags/'dul 'dzin blo gros grags/ne'u paṇa chen/'dul 'dzin rgyal mtshan dpal/slob dpon rin cen byang chub/dmar ston dpal ldan rin cen/dmar ston rgya mtsho rin cen/khu dbon gnyis ka la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis gsan pa man 'dra/yang na bya 'dul brtson 'grus 'bar nas/thag ma'i ka pa chen po/g.yor po'i sbas ti dgra bcom pa/mkhan chen shes rab seng ge bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyug/se ba can pa yon tan tshul khrims/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/mkhan chen dka' bzhi pa blo gsal/dmar ston dpal ldan rin cen man 'dra/yang na dmar ston rgya mtsho rin cen nas/kun mkhyen g.yag pa/rong ston dmar khams grags bzang /gra chung pa/shangs ston pa/chos grags pa/dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/blo gros rgya mtsho/rje dkon cog choX 'phel/des bdag la'o//

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mngon pa mdzod rang 'grel dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud/sangs rgyas gnyis pa dbyig gnyen kyis mdzad pa'i shes bya gzhi lnga gtso bor brjod pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod rang 'grel dang bcas pa'i don gsal bar ston pa paṇa chen gzhung lugs brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gyis mdzad pa'i ṭīk+ka/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang las chen dngos grub rgya (23na7tsho gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i spyi don gyi steng nas spyi ṭika legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ gnas brtan 'od srung chen po/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa dbyangs sgrog /kha che 'dus bzang / kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gnyen/ mngon pa rang lasamakhas pa blo gros brtan pa/ gang ba spel/ dwa na shī la/ 'di gnyis go rim mi mas pa 'ga' zhig byung yang hrū tso gsan res ma byung 'dra bas gang bdes thus sam snyam gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu bsdu na dā dzi gnyis dang ska cog shad gsum gang rung res ga par ma' gsung bar yid do/dzi na mi tra/ ska ba dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta/ cog gru klu'i rgyal mtshan/kun mkhyen pa'i gas yig na nam nang zla ba'i rdo rje zhes snang / zhang sna nam ye shes sde/ sna nam zla ba'i rdo rje/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ sbas rgyal ba ye shes/ bu'i gsan yig na dbas zhes pa snang / gsum ga la cog gru rgyal ba'i ye shes kyis gsan/ de nas cog gru mchog gi ye shes/ se btsun dbang phyug gzhen nu/ 'gar mi yon tan g.yung drung / khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung / ra khri bzang 'bar/ bu'i gas yig na ra ston khri bzang zhes snang zhing 'di dang phyi ma gnyis go ldog tu 'dug pa brtag /rgya tshul li/ li ston chos grags/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ ko ye 'byung / 'ban dkon cog rdo rje/ tho kun dga' rdo rje/ 'jad pa ston skyabs/'jad pa gas byang / zhang 'bring mtshams pa/ bo dong pa rin cen rtse mo/ brtson grus rdo rje yin nam dpyad/stag sde pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ lor byang chub rtse mo/ rje btsun re mda' ba gak+ṣ-i na nu blo gros/ rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags(23brdza/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa —31 —

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dbyig gnyen 'khas sa paṇa/ 'phags pa man 'dra/sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud/sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i don phyin ci ma log par gsal bar ston pa rgyal tshab mi pham mgon pos mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i don gsal rtsa 'grel gnyis kyi ṭīk+ka rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rnam bshad snying po rgyan/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i spyi don thal 'phreng /dwags nyag blo gros 'phel gyi spyi don/ se ra rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi thal 'phreng rnams kyi steng nas spyi ṭīka thal 'phreng dang bcas pa legs par nos pa'i rngog lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang zas gtsang sras po/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen (24bskor phags pa rnam grol sde/ btsun pa rnam grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ mkhan po rnam snang mdzad/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ slob dpon yon tan bshes gnyen/ lo chen rin cen bzang po/ shar phyogs pa zla ba bzang po/ slob dpon bstan skyong / 'bum phrag gsum pa'ang zer/lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ ar byang chub ye shes/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa dkar mo/ dkar chung ring mo/ zhang ye ba/ gnyal zhig 'jam dpal rdo rje/gzang ring dar ma tshul khrims/ bo dong pa brtson 'grus rdo rje/ stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun re mda' pa gzhon nu blo gros/ chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po/ thams cad mkhyen pa dar ma rin cen/ gnyal rgod rin cen bsam grub/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ mus srad pa blo gros rin cen seng ge /se ra chos rje gnyal ston dpal lhun pa/ se ra don yod dpal ldan/ dwags nyag rig —33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)pa'i ral gri blo gros 'phel/ gtsang ston dge legs bshes gnyen/ te'u ra pa dge 'dun bsam grub/grom mda' ba blo bzang chos 'phel/ 'jam mgon smra ba'i dbang phyug dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /yang phar phyin rnying ma 'brom lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po nas/ ku su li che ba/ ku su li chung ba/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo chen po dpal mar me mdzad/'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung (25na gnas/ 'brom ston tsan nam mgo bla ma/ 'bre chen shes rab 'bar man 'dra/ yang khu lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje nas/ khu chen po lha sdings pa/ rgya rgyal ba tshul khrims seng ge /li ston chos grags/ 'bre chen po man 'dra/ yang na dge legs bshes gnyen nas/ sems dpa' chen po skal bzang rgya mtsho/ rtses dang pa sangs rgyas blo gros/ 'phyong rgyas pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na dge 'dun bsam grub nas/ 'ol kha ba blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rje byams pa brtan pa/ rje dkon cog chos 'phel/ yang na rje don yod dpal ldan nas/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho man 'dra/ yang na bo dong pa brtson 'grus rdo rje nas/ khro phu ba bsod nams seng ge /lha ston grub pa seng ge /tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ thugs sras rin cen rnam rgyal/ g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma/ rong ston shes bya kun rig /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ kun mkhyen blo gros rin cen seng ge man gong bzhin no/ /yang na bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa la mkhas pa lung mang po dang dharma shrī gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la kun mkhyen g.yag pas gsan pa man 'dra/—34

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dbu ma 'jug pa rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud/mdun legs ma las/ mdo sngags gzhung la ngal ba mang byas kyang / /zab don nyams su len dang smra ba la/ /gang yang ma bslab ci yang mi shes pa'i/ /lta ba'i tshul la ring du ma song bar mthong nas (25ba〉snag par klu sgrub gzhung lugs kyi/ /zab mo 'byed pa'i phra ba'i rig lam nas/ /yang dag lta ba 'dren pa'i gnad kun la/ legs par sbyangs nas the tshom mchod par byas/ /zhes pa ltar slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa tha pa 'gyur ba'i lugs srol thun mong ma yin pa zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba 'di nyid ma rtogs par 'khor ba las rnam par grol ba'i zhi ba nam yang rnyed pa'i skabs med pa la dgongs nas mnyam med re mda' ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen po sogs dam pa du mas phyogs 'di la rtsal du bton te 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pa yin pas/ 'phags pa yab sras gnyis kyi bzhed pa 'brul med du ston pa slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma 'jug pa rang 'grel dang bcas pa'i ṭīk+ka rje btsun btsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje rje btsun pa/ khyung phrug byams pa bkra shis rnams kyi yig cha'i steng nas thal 'phreng spyi don/ ṭīk+ka rnams legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon ārla de wa/ slob dpon sangasargyas bskyangs/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa/ paṇa chen de wa tsan+d+ra/bram ze rin cen rdo rje/ slob dpon ba ra ha ta/ paṇa chen ha su ma ti/ pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags/ rma bya byang ye/ rma bya byang brtson/ mtshur gak+ṣ-i na nu seng ge /rma bya shākya seng ge /shad chos kyi bla ma/ mchimasanam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral gri/ de gnyis ka la lo tsā ba (26nasgo chog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ de nas dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ slob dpon byang seng pa/ re mda' ba chen po gzhon nu —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonablo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ kun mkhyen dar ma rin cen/ slob dpon rin cen bsam grub/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan/ mus sad pa blo gros rin cen seng ge /chos rje dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rje don yod dpal ldan/ dwags nyag rig pa'i ral gri/ rje dge legs bshes gnyen/ zhal snga nas dge 'dun bsam grub/ sgrom mda' mkhan chen blo bzang chos 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag la stsal to/ /yang na pa tshab lo tsā ba nas/zhang thang sag pa ye shes 'byung gnas/'brom dbang phyug grags/ bla ma pra dz+nya badz+ra slob dpon ston tshul ba/ bla ma bde ba'i lha/ jo btsun pa/ dbu ra ba/ pra dz+nyā shrī/ dharma shes rab/ bag ston shes rab rin cen/ rje pu blo sirnya/ bag ston bsam bzang / bag ston gzhen nu bsam gtan/ byang chub seng ge re mda' ba man 'dra/ yang na mchims nam mkha' grags nas/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ slob dpon dge 'bar ba/ dbu tshad pa 'od zer grub/ mkhas pa mi g.yo bzang po/ rin po che kun rgyal ba/rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po man gong bzhin no/ /yang na lo tsā ba mchog ldan nas/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /kun mkhyen bu ston/ sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/ g.yag sangs rgyas 'phel/ rong ston rje/mkhyen rab dbang phyug /gra chung pa/ shangs stan pa/ 'jam da byangs mchoge lha ba/ legs bzang pa/ chosagrags pa/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho (26ba lhag lung brag pa rje dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na bag ston gzhon nu bsam gto nas/ dmar ston gzhen rgyan/ rong ston man gong dang 'dra/ yang na gtsang ston dge legs pa nas/ rje skal bzang pa/ zhal snga nas sangs rgyas blo gros/ rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ rje dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na zhal snga nas dge 'dun bsam grub nas/ mkhan chen blo bzang rgya mtsho/ zhal snga nas byams pa brtan pa/ rje dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gnyal ston dpal lhun nas/ ser don yod pa/ se ra rje btsun pa/zhal snga nas sgom sde/ rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho man 'dra/ nye brgyud ni/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos skyid shod dga' ba gdong du mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs dang mjal/ bla ma dbu ma pas lo tsā mdzad —36

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nas zab mo rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i skor yongs su rdzogs par gsan pas/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ bla ma dbu ma pa/ kun mkhyen btsong kha pa/ rgyal tshab rje man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na zla ba grags pa nas/ ku su li che chung / kha che gzhon nu 'bum/ ha su ma ti man 'dra/byams chos sde lnga sogs kyi lung brgyud/byams pa'i chos sde lnga'i bklags lung legs par nos pa'i thog mar mngon rtogs rgyan ni/ṭīk+ka rdzogs par song bas bshad ma thag pa'i brgyud pa ltar ram/ yang na thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin cen grub yan gong ltar la/ de nas nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ re mda' ba gzhen nu blo gros/rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa/ gung ru rin cen byang chub/ chos rje dpal 'byor lhun grub/ slob dpon ba tso ba chos (27na bo pa la rgyal mtshan/ drung chen nyi ma grags pa/drung chen chos kyi bshes gar+sā/ ra tshag pa blo bzang e waṃ/ rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ kun mkhyen dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas/ rje chosadabyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rgyal khang rtse ba nas/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/bla mas yang ra/ rje pha bong kha ba man 'dra/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan dang dbus mtha' rnam 'byed gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal ba byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ mkhas pa dbyig gnyen/ kha che'i paṇa chen blo gros brtan pa/ paṇa chen rig pa'i khu byug /slob dpon mche ba'i sde/ bha dra pā da/ mar me mdzad/ gaṅgā dha ra/ pu tho shrī/ kha che dgon pa ba/ bram ze sa pa/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/rngog lo chen po/ ba reg lotsā ba rgyal mtshan/ ba reg stone skyabs/ skyes bu yon tan dga'/ bla ma bkra shis rdo rje/ bla ma 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ nyang ro kun dga' rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs dar ma 'od zer/ khro phu tshad ma'i skyes bu/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lung rkyang gi brgyud pa ltar —37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonaro/ /yang mdo sde rgyan gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo gros brtan pa/ gang ba spel/ gaṅgā dha ra/ ngor chen gyi gsan yig na 'di gnyis ka mi 'dug pa dpyad/gaṅgā dza na rat+na/ kha che rin cen rdo rje/ kha che sa tho na/ pa ra he ta/ ci kha po tshe yin min brtag /blo gros grags/mar pa jo phan/ mchims don grub/ mchims brtson seng / mchims(27bsgom mkha' grags/ skyi ston shākya 'bum/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen sher rgyan/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang gzhon blo/ngor chen/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ rat+na shī la/ thar lam gsal sgron/ 'di bla ma'i ma' mi 'dra ba brtag /rin cen 'byung gnas/ ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang / ngag dbang chos grags/ rin po che bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ drung chen byang ma khang gsar ba/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa man 'dra/ chos nyid rnam 'byed dang rgyud bla ma gnyis kyi brgyud pa byams chos gzhan gsum dang mthun par mdzad pa ngor pa rdo rje 'chang dang chos rje dpa' bo sogs rang gzhan gyi bla ma mang po'i gsan yig tu snang yang ha cang ma dpyad pa'i rtsing skyon du sems te/ rgyu mtshan thogs med kyi dga' ldan nas byams chos spyan drangs pa dus ring zhig nas chos nyid rnam 'byed dang rgyud bla ma'i dpe tsam yang nub pas brgyad stong 'grel chen du de nyid nas lung 'dren sogs med pas kyang slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i dus nub zin pa rjes su dpag pa'i tshad mas kyang gzhal nus la/ rje mi tri pa chen pos mchod rten zhig gi ser kha nas 'od yang yang 'phro ba gzigs pas/ de la zhig gso dang bcas ci 'dug btsal bas tā la'i 'dab mar bris pa'i bstan bcos gnyis kyi dpe rnyed kyang rgyun ma rnyed par brten rje btsun byams pa la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas sprin gyi gseb nas zhal dngos su bstan nas gnang ba'i lung rgyun 'phel ba yin pas/ de gnyis kyi rgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ /ma pham mgon po/ /mnga' bdag mai tri ba (28na bā na po/ paṇ+ḍita dga' ba'i grags pa/paṇ+ḍita sadz+dza na/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ khyung rin cen grags/ rgya dmar ba byang chub grags/gro lung ba blo gros 'byung gnas/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge /'dul dkar ba/ gtsang pa 'bre skur/ sdong khrod —38

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'dul 'dzin/ slob dpon dar ma 'od zer/ lho pa gru pa seng ge /slob dpon rig thigs pa/ thamasacad mkhyen pa bu ston man mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lung rkyang ltar ro/ /de'ang kha che'i grong khyer dpe med du paṇ+ḍi ta sa tho na la rngog lo chen pos gsan pa'i tshe dpe shog re la'ang 'di me la sbyangs na rgyal ba byams pa gshegs pa dang mnyam zer nas g.yar bar dka' tshegs shin tu che ba'i ngang nas bsgyur zhus mdzad pa yin no/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems rin po che skyed par byed pa'i thabs dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ārla de wa/zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ paṇ+ḍita puṭu shrī/ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa paṇ+ḍita 'phags pa rin po che/ e pa 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston/ byang sems rin cen mgon/ 'jig rten dbang phyug bzang po dpal/ chos rje tshul khrims dpal/ sems dpa' chen po gzhen nu rgyal mchog /ri pa dpal ldan grags/ mkhan chen grags pa rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen (28ba)rin cen grags pa/ mkhan sangs rgyas bkra shis/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang / paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ lo pa spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ dpal ldan sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dpal rdo rje ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug/bka' drin mnyam med mkhan chen zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ sgron mon can pa rin cen dpal bzang / byang sems rin cen mgon po man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje/ khro phu bsod nams seng ge /kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ rgyal sras thogs med pa man 'dra/sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje ge mi ba tshong kha pa'i gsan yig na 'jugatso—39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ye a la tshe peXng /bcom ldan 'das/rje btsun ma pham pa/'phags pa thogs med/dbyig gnyen/'phags pa grol sde/btsun pa grol sde/mchog gi sde/dul ba'i sde/seng ge bzang po/ku swā li che chung gnyis/gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/dpal mar me mdzad/rgyal ba 'brom/spyan snga pa/bya yulab/rgyal sras char ོ pa/mugs 4 4 zer/gro ston bdud rtsi grags/sangs rgyas sgom pa/mchims ston/mkhan seng ge skyabs/mkhas btsun bsod nams ye shes/byang sems bsod nams grags pa/thogs med bzang po dpal/grub ོ ga shrī/ngor r+sā rdo rje lang /mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/mkhan chen rat+na shī la/rdo rje 'chang sgo 29na ngos pa/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/'khor lo'i mgon po dbang phyug rab brtan/'jam dpal dbyangs ngag dbang chos grags/byu kun dga' bsod nams/de sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug/mkhan wo rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag la'o//yang na rgyal sras thogs med pa nas/lo wo byang chub rtse mo/lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/bo dong paṇa chen dbyangs can dga' ba/mkhan chen bsod rgyal/paṇa wo shāka mchog/paṇa ོ don yod pa/rje kun dga' grol mchog/mkhan ོ na rma bzang po/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man gong bzhi no//blo sbyong don bdun ma sogs blo spyong khag gi lung brgyud/'jig rten dbang phyug bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'khrid yig gi steng nas theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong nyams 'khrid du legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/thub pa'i dbang po/rgyal tshab byams pa/'phags pa thogs med/slob dpon dbyig gnyen/'phags pa rnam grol sde/btsun pa rnam grol sde/gu ṇa mi tra/slob dpon seng ge bzang po/bshes gnyen gang ba spel/ku swā li che chung gnyis/gser gling pa chos kyi gragaX ༷/dpal ldan a ti sha/rgyal ba 'brom/po to ba

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rin cen gsal/sha ra ba yon tan grags/'chad ka ye shes rdo rje/ se lo pa spyan snga'i gas yig dang yar klungs jo bo chos 'gus mthun par 'di bzhin 'dug/rje mkhyen brtse/thar rtse pa/mkhan ngag chos pa gsum gyi gsan yig na 'od zer gzhen nu zer ba 'dug pa brtag/la lar dharma shes rab ces pa snang zhing rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na 'di nas tshogis pa'i dbu mdzad kyi bar la rong lha ring pa khu dbon gnyis zhes pa las 29ba7 byung ba yig skyon zhig zhugs pa 'dra'o//spyil bu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan/lha ston 'od zer bla ma/jo bo cha thung na byang tso 'od zer dang lo pa spyan snga'i gas yig na skyes mchog lha chen zer ba snang /lha sdings pa byang chub 'bum/lo pa spyan snga pa'i gsan yig na shes rab 'bum zhes 'dug kyang mkhyen brtse thar rtse ngag chos gsum gyi gas yig na 'di ltar snang /lha sdings dbon po kun dga' rgya mtsho/thar rtse ba dang /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse ngag chos gsum gyi gsan yig na 'di gnyis lha sdings pa yon tan dpal zhes gcig tu bgrangasa'adug kyang ngor chen lo pa spyan snga dang sgrub khang pa gsum gyi gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung bas bla ma gnyis kyi mtshan gcig tu 'dusapa'i bris nor byung smo snyam/tshogs pa'i dbu mdzad yon tan dpal/mkhan chen bde ba dpal/mkhan chen dka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhen nu/byang sems bsod nams grags pa/rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal/rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/'phags pa blo 'phel ba/spyan snga tshul khrims dar ma/spyan snga ba bsod nams lha'i dbang po/rgyal sras bsod nams legs mchog/paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang / gos la paṇa — /spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/rdo rje lang pha bong kha pa/zur thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na slob dpon dbyig gnyen nas/kha che blo gros brtan pa/ku su li che chung gnyis man 'dra/yang na rgyal sras thogs med pa nas/gnyag dbon bsod nams bzang po/mtshan ldan zhig mo rang grol/kun dga' dpal mo/rje ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/yang na rgyal sras rin po che nas/mkhan chen 30na / grags pa rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen grags pa bshes gnyen/'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/mkhan chen kun blo pa/gnyug la paṇa chen ngag gi /bang po/ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/yang na

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)rgyal sras rin po che nas/ mang mkhar tshul khrims dpal/ sems dpa' ga 'ozhe nu rgyal mchog /musachen sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ chos rje shes rab bzang po/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ yang na sems dpa' chen po gzhen nu rgyal mchog /rje mi g.yo gru bzhi/ de la paṇa chen don grub rgyal mtshan dang mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka nas rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ yang na gzhen nu rgyal mchog nas/ byams chen sku skye/ chen po kun dga' bkra shis/ 'phags mchog yon tan rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ /yang na lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags nas/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ /des bdag la'o/ /yang na mkhan chen kun blo ba nas/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen kun dga' legs pa/ mkhan chen dkon cog rin cen/ mkhan chen rnam sras bzang po/ mkhan chen shes rab rin cen/ spyan (30bsnga kun dga' don grub man 'dra/yang na sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan nas/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ 'jam dbyangasakun dga' chos bzang / mkhas pa lha dbang blo gros/ rje byams pa phun tshogs/ ras chen dpal 'byor shes rab/ ngor sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ bka' drin mnyam med gnas gsar ba rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/ des bdag la'o/ yang na sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog nas/ ri pa dpal ldan grags/ mkhan chen grags pa rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen rin grags pa/ mkhan sangs rgyas bkra shis/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang /paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bzang po dpal gyi dngos slob rje dpal ldan ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo'am 'khrid yig gsung sgros mar grags pa'i lo rgyus gdams pa dngos dang —42

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bcas pa'i lung brgyud ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i dpal ldan chos 'byor la lo pa spyan sngas gsan pa dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags brgyud par bzhugs pa sor gnas la spyan snga rin po che dang mkhan chen gnyis ka la khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ de la rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa rin cen bsod snang nams mchag grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gzhen nu rgyal mchog nas/ mus chen semasadapa' chen po/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas 'phel/ rje btsun kun dga' chos bzang / lha dbang blo gros/byams pa phun tshogs/ dpal 'byor shes (31na)rab/ sgrub pa khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /brgyud pa 'di skor la rtsom pa po dngos su mi gsal ba rgyal sras rin po che'i gsung ji lta ba zin bris su mdzad pa'i dbang gis rgyal sras pas rgya ma ba dang mang mkhar ba sogs la gnang ba yin 'dug /yang na rgyal sras rin po che nas 'gro mgon dpal ldan ye shes/ mkhas pa gzhen nu rgyal mchog man 'dra/ mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la'ang nos pa slar gyi rten 'brel du mjug nas shog bu sum cu tsam zhig 'jog pa gnang song ba 'phro can du lus/ rje de nyid kyis dben sa bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes la gsan/ de yan gyi brgyud pa ma rnyed/sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog gis mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi lus yan lag dang bcas pa'i don cung zad bshad pa blo sbyong don gsal shes rab gsal sgron nam legs bshad kun 'dus su grags pa'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sems dpa' chen po gzhen nu rgyal mchog yan don bdun ma ltar la/ de nas byams chen sku skye/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ 'phags mchog yon tan rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/bka' drin mnyam med zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /sum pa lo tsā ba dpal (31bsgo chog dang po'i rdo rjes rgya gar du byon dus mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rje'i tshig bzhi pa rje btsun sgrol mas gsungs pa la brten nas thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i sum pa lo tsā ba'i blo sbyong snyan brgyud du grags pa thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi zin bris kyi steng nas nyams 'khrid du legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ sum pa lo tsā ba/chos rje sa paṇa/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs chosarje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun spangs chos rje/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab bstan/ bka' drin mnyam med sems dpa' chen po gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal to/ yang na bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan nas/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / rje bsod nams sangs rgyas/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po man 'dra/ yang na rje rdo rje ring pa nas/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ grub thob mtsho 'phreng ba rin cen bzang po/ 'dar phyar yin/mkhas grub chosarje/ ri khrod ras chen/ pra dz+nya bo dhi/ don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin cen/ 'khrul zhig grags pa tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ mkhan chen bsod nams rin cen/ (32na93ga rje gzhen nu rgyal mchog /mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ drin can mkhyen rab chos rje/ drin can rdo rje ring man 'dra/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig gi lung yang thob/mkhas pa chen po gzhen nu rgyal mchog dang mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan dpon slob gnyis kyis theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi rgya gzhung bod gzhung shin tu gces pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i skor la/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i glegs bam(ka)dkar chag /jo bo chen po lha gcig gis rgyal srid spangs nas thar par byon pa'i rnam par (ka)thar pa bla ma'i yon tan chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad —44—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa/ jo bo rjes mnyam med gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa'i drung du byang chub kyi sems 'tshol ba'i slad du dka' ba spyad nas byon pa'i rnam (ka)thar jo bo chen po nyid kyis gsungs pa/ jo bo chen po a ti shas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i (ka)gzhung rgyas pa mchan bcas/ rtsab 'di ga spyi sa la mang co yod pas lung so sor gnang ba de ka dngos gtsang / de las btus ba'i rtsa (ka)ba mchan med gcig /'gor bde legs kun 'byung rin thang med pa'i sku zhes yod pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel ba bka' gdams (ka)yang snying po mtshar che'o'i mtha' can/ 'jigs pa'i gcan gzan sna tshogs rgyu ba'i nags khrod du lung rigs dang rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po dharma rak+ṣi tas bla ma dam pa'i gsung ltar bsdebs nas jo bo a ti sha la gnang ba'i dgra bo gnad la dbab (32ba)pa'i blo sbyong mtshon cha (kha)'khor lo/ /ri nag po'i khong gseng na gnas pa'i bla ma dam pa bshad ma thag pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong rma bya dug (kha)'joms/ bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i gyer sgom rdo rje'i glu rtog)blangs pas chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du byams pa lha'i rgyal po'i cha byad kyis gsungs pa jo bo chen pos bod du lkog khrid du mdzad pa/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa lugs kyi blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las nyon mongs (ga)pa gtan la dbab pa'i chos/ blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las bzlog phyogs ltag)gnyen po'i chos/ blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las rang rgyud ngan sma dbab rtog)pa'i chos/ blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las zag bcas dge ba'i stobs bskyed (ga)pa'i chos/ gser gling pas jo bo la mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i ched du gnang pa'i (nga)blo sbyong gi rtsa ba/ 'di dang 'og gi 'grel ba'i nang gi rtsa ba gnyis zhus dag mi 'pher ba khrug /nyon mongs lam du blang ba'i man (skang ga nyon mongs pa thams cad la sbyar bar shes par bya ba/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos mjug (ca)gsum gyis bstan pa spyil bu ba'i zhal nas nga'i snying phyung nas bstan kyang sha dmar lho lhog pa kham gcig las mi gda' zhes bsngags par mdzad pa/yi ge gsum la (6)brten nas sems can thams cad kyi sdig grib sbyong ba/ 'di la lung rgyun snang bsadakar chag dang gsan yig na migs la ba ho dam snyam/rdo rje sems dpa' la brten nas sha 'khon sbyong ba'i man —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)(ca)ngag /rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs nas rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyi dri ba dris lan gyi tshul gyis jo bo chen po la sems (33na)sbyong (cha)bar bskul nas gnang ba'i blo sbyong / 'di la lo rgyus las blo sbyong dngosagazhi ma byung ba gsang sngags lugs 'di gsungs zhes pa ltar na 'di kha'i gong 'og gnyis po su rigs shig yin nam snyam/ 11 21 chen pos gsungs pa'i phan yon brgyad dang ldan pa'i ku su lu'i tshogs (cha)gsog kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrīs khro phu lo tsā bar gnang ba'i blo sbyong skyid/ (ji/sdug lam 'byer gyi man ngag go'i mtha' can/ 'jam dbyangs sa los zur chag tu 'di ltar grags kyang dge ba can te ku su lir bzhed la lo chen byang rtses ma bcos pal ma lhug pa zhes pa'i skad dod yin gsungs/grub thob sum pa lo tsā ba la mkha' 'gro ma dmar sngo gnyis kyi dri ba dris lan gyi tshul gyis gnang ba'i snyan brgyud (nyi)blo sbyong 'chi rgyu med pa lags so'i mtha' can/rigs gsum mgon po las byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mdzad pa rlabs che bar bstan pa'i kun tu bzang po'i blo sbyong (ta)'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'byung gsung ba'i mtha' can/ jo bo chen po la byang chub kyi sems ston pa'i bla ma gsum gyi nang nas gser gling pa lhag pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i blo sbyong thun brgyad (rte)ma zho sha mi bsri bar phan 'dogs gsung ba'i mtha' can/ thun brgyad ma lag len du byed tshul dge bshes ston pa'i (tha)man ngag la zas la brten pa'i blo sbyong le'u dang po/ dbugs la brten pa'i blo sbyong le'u gnyis pa/ lus gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du sprul nas rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i blo sbyong le'u gsum pa/ sha khrag gtang ba'i blo sbyong le'u bzhi pa/ gtor ma la brten pa'i blo sbyong le'u lnga pa/ 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong le'u drug pa/ lus yid (33ba)bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher sprul pa'i blo sbyong le'u bdun pa/ 'chi kha ma'i blo sbyong gi man ngag le'u brgyad pa rnams/ ltas ngan g.yang du len pa sogs man ngag bzhi la brten pa'i blo sbyong gegs sel (tha)'dod thog tu byed pa yin gyi mtha' can/ brjed pa'i gnas bzhi dang 'chor ba'i gnas bzhi la brten pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'gal rkyen spong ba'i blo sbyong (tha)dpal mar me mdzad nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa/ 'gor dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi lam gyi mchog ces yod pa'i jo bo'i —46

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)blo sbyong 9)don bdun ma mdo dang bstan bcos rnams la legs par blta'o'i mtha' can/ blo sbyong yid bzhi nor bu dang lhan thab bzhi pa che bar yang grags/ blo sbyong thun gcig rton)ma zhes pa dpal snar thang gi mkhan po mchims nam mkha' grags pas mdzad pa/ mnyam med jo bo chen po bod du 'byon khar rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu la spyi chos su (pa)gdams pa/ dpal ldan bir wa pa'i blo sbyong dar paṇa gyi gsung glo bo lo tsā ba'i 'khrid yig mnyam med snying rje'i (pha)man ngag /dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang thang pa chen pos mdzad pa'i blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad ma'i rtsa (ba)ba la 'chad ka bas 'grel ba mdzad pa smon lam yang yang gdab par bya'o'i mtha' can/ de'i zhan byung du a tsa ra gzugs ngan gyi gtam rgyud yod pa/ mgon po a ti sha la gser gling pa chos kyi grags pas gsungs pa'i gong gi mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i (di)rtsa ba/ 'dra min la 'grel ba dang bcas pa gsung bar gda' 'o'i mtha' can/'gor byams pa thogs med la sogs dang zhes pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma sde snod thams cad kyi bcud tig pa'i (34na snyang (di)khu 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor kun mkhyen thugs ni brtse ba'i dbang sgyur cing zhes yod pa'i snar thang pa sangs rgyas sgom pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong tshogs (cha)bshad chen mo/ ༷ rat+na gu ru'i sa chos kyang ra/'dus byas la rtag pa med kyi zhes sogs rgyal ba yang dgon pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong yis len gnad thog 6)tu skyong ngo'i mtha' can/ jo bo rje lha rtag gi blo sbyong byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas na rten 'brel (6)snying po zhes bya'o'i mtha' can rnams/ rten 'dzesnying yi lo'i kyang zer/dkar chag tu mi gsal ba blo sbyong (ka)gsung sgros ma'i kha skong du mus chen semasadapa' chen pos sangs rgyas sgom pa'i tshogs bshad nas btus te mdzad pa rnams legs par thob pa'i/ ga'i rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang / byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ grol sde rnam gnyis/ gu ṇa mi tra/ seng ge bzang po/ gang spel/ dge ba can gnyis/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo chen po/ 'brom/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ lha ston pa/ lha sdingasapa/ de dbon kun rgyam/ dbu mdzad yon tan dpal/ mkhan bde ba dpal/ dga' bzhi pa grags gzhon/—47—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()byang sems bso de nams grags pa/rgyal sras thogs med pa/mang mkhar tshul khrims dpal/semasadapa' gzhen nu rgyal mchog/mus chen sems dpa' chen po/rje btsun sangs rgyas rin cen/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/rje dkon cog rgya mtsho/mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/mus pa grub pa'i dbang phyug/'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod 34bar mas/de sras 'khon ston bsod nams dbang phyug/zha lu mkhan chen khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/desabadag za hor ban+de la'o//rnam thar chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/mus chen sems dpa' chen po nas/rgyal ba byams chen rab 'byams pa/rje kun dga' chos bzang mnga' ris pa lha dbang blo gros/bla ma byams pa phun tshogs/rje dpal 'byor shes rab/mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//kha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/thub dbang /byams pa/byams pa'i rnal 'byor ba/bla ma dharma rak+ṣi ta/jo bo r+ṣa po/'brom/po to ba/sha ra ba/lar ka ba/se spyil bu ba/skyes mchog lha ོ/lha 'gro ba'i mgon po/'od 'jo ba/lo pa spyan snga'i gas yig na 'di gnyis ga tu byas nas smra ston zhes snang bas dpyad/mkhan po dmar ston/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin cen/bla ma grags pa tshul khrims/chos rje rgyal ba bzang po/gnubs chos lung pa bsod nams rin cen/mkhan chen gzhen nu rgyal mchog man 'dra/yang na don zhags pa nas/'chad ka ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/mkhan rin cen rgyal mtshan/mkhan rgyal ba phyag na/mkhan kun dga' blo gros/gnyug la paṇa chen/spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/lo gzims 'og pa byams pa chos lhor dpal bzang /yangs can spyan snga rnam rgyal dpal bzang /stag lung pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/'ol ba pa ngag dbang chos grags/khyab bdag sman lung blo gros mchog gi rdo 35na ) rje/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//ga'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas/byams pa/byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa/jo bo 0 po man mar cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/nga'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/sangs ༷sa/byams pa/thogs med sku mched/blo gros

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)brtan pa/ ku su li che chung gnyis/ bla ma gser gling pa/ jo 'brom yab sras/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ mal dro ba/ brag dmar ba/ shad brag dkar ba/ bla ma dkon cog byang chub/ gzhen nu grags pa/ slob dpon zhang / shes rab bsod nams/ slob dpon brtson 'grus/ slob dpon chos mchog /don zhags pa man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ ca'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogasamed sku mched/ ku su li gnyis/ gser gling pa/ jo 'brom/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ spyil bu ba/ slob dpon lha/ lha sdings dbon po/ /chos kyi seng ge /rgya ston byang rgyal/ mkhan pa gzhen byang /rin cen 'byung gnas dpal/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ cha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo mo sgrol ma/ khro gnyer can/ jo 'brom gnyis/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ gtsang pa rin po che/ glang lung pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ zam se rin sangs pa/ lo pa spyan lnga'i gsan yig na zim rtse ring po zer pa dag gam snyam/ gom pa byang skyabs ye shes 'khas/ lo pa spyan snga'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis gcig tu brtsis pa'i shī la pradz+nyā zer ba 'dug 6) la badz+ra/don zhags pa man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang gcig /ja'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kha che paṇa chen/khro phu lo tsā (35bsgo/ lho brag pa byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen grags pa bshes gnyen/ gnubs chos lung pa bsod nams rin cen man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ yang na mkhan chen bde ba dpal nas bka' bzhi pa grags gzhen/byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ rje tshul khrims dpal/ gzhen nu rgyal mchog man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ nya'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje phag mo/ sgrol ma/sum pa lo sto ba dar ma yon tan/ rje sa paṇa/ grub thob 'dar phyar/ mkhas grub chos rje/ ri khrod ras chen shes rab byang chub/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa man skyid sdug lam khyer dang 'dra/ ta'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo chen po/ lo pa'i gas yig na bar 'dir 'brom ston bog /'dzeng dgon pa ba dbang rgyal/sne'u zur pa/ skyer sgom pa/ sangs rgyas dbon ston gzhen nu 'byung gnas/ zangs dgon —49—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonapa/ lo pa'i gas yig na zong dgon zer wo 'di ga rdzis sbrel/mkhan po chos ldan pa/ slob dpon shākya bkra shis/rgya ma ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan/don zhags pa man 'dra/ tha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ grol sde gnyis/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ rnam snang mdzad/ seng bzang / rin po che'i mdo/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ sku mched gsum/ gsum gas glang thang pa rdo rje seng (36na sko dang sha bo sgang pa gnyis la gnang / de gnyis kyis slob dpon zhang zhung pa dang tam tang bu khur gnyis la gnang / de gnyis kyis sangs rgyas jo bo la gnang lung nang mkhan po/ lo pa'i gas yig na lung sgom pa dang mkhan po rin cen zhes so sor phral 'dug /'brom ston sher rin/slob dpon gzhen nu bsam gtan/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ glang ri thang pa'i tshig rkang brgya pa'i rtsa ba khyab bdag zha lu pas sgye chu mkhan chen byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang la gsan zhing de yan slar dpyad do/ /da'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'cha / tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ḍom+bhi pa/ jo bo rje/'dzes dbang rgyal/ po to ba/ glang thang pa/ rgya lcags ri ba/ lha ri rtsa brgyad pa/ dwags po lha rje/ phag mo gru pa/ rgya sgom zhig po/ rgya mkhar ri pa/ brag dmar ba man mtha' 'khob 'dul ba dang 'dra/ na'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo 'brom gnyis/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ lha dbon po/ gnas brtan 'dul 'dzin/ mchims chen mo/ mchims yon tan bla ma/ 'gro mgon bshesaganyen/ don zhags pa man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ pa'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo 'phrom yab sras/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ lha spyil bu ba/ lha 'gro mgon/ 'od 'jo ba/mkhan po dmar ston/ jo gdan rlung shod pa/ bshes gar+sā shes rab bzang po/ don zhags pa man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/ pha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bil ba pa/ ḍo snyi pa/dpal 'dzin/ ma ti ba/ ni ska lo ka /re len+d+ra/ chag chos rje dpal gzhen nu rgyal mtshan/ blo (36ba)gros dpal/ ye shes zhabs bzang po/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ ba'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ grol sde gnyis/ seng bzang / dge ba can che chung / gser —50—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gling pa/ jo 'brom gnyis/ po to ba/ glang ri thang pa/ glang thang zhang zhung pa/ sangs rgyas jo bo/ lung sgom pa/ mkhan po rin cen/ 'brog ston sher rin/ slob dpon gzhon bsam/ don zhags pa man 'dra/ma'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa nas bla ma gnyis tsam zhig ma rnyed/ de nas byang sems gshone nu rgyal mchog man 'dra/ tsa'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/gser gling pa/ jo 'brom gnyis/ po to ba/ lcags ri ba/ chos kyi g.yung drung / snye phu rgya sgom/ brag ram pa/ nyen chen pa/ shes rab 'bum/ thogs med bzang po dpal/ mang mkhar tshul khrims dpal/sems dpa' gzhen nu rgyal mchog man mtshon cha 'khor lo dang 'dra/byang sems rwa bsgreng pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyi brgyud pa ni/ lha ston pa yan blo sbyong don bdun ma dang 'dra ba la/ de nas lha brag kha pa/ lha zur khang pa/ lha chos sku blo gros 'od/ de la byang sems seng ge rgyal mtshan/ lha shākya bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gsan/gnyis ka la byang sems rwa bsgreng ba/ bar 'dir bla ma gsum tsam zhig ma rnyed/ rim bzhin lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang / brag dgon spyan snga/rdo rje 44 pha bong kha pa/ kun mkhyen chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral sogs dpal sa skya'i chos skor gyi lung brgyud/rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos zla ba drug (37na8 bar du 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe 'jam dbyangs gtso 'khor gsum pa zhal gzigs pa'i gtso bos dngos su gsungs pa'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral/ de'i 'grel ba rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍitas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ 'gor rje btsun chen po sa skya pa'i zhal nas zhes yod pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral —51—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gyi gdams pa nub pa rig 'dzin grags kyis mdzad pa/ chen pa bzhi bral gyi dmigs 'khrid byang chub sems dpa' ra lod rdo rjes bskul ba la brten nas kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa/'khrid yig bla ma kun dga' legs pa'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas dge slong kun dga' legs pa'i rin cen gyis zin bris su bkod de chos rje rdo rje 'chang la gzigs su phul nas dag par byas pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/slob dpon rin po che/ rje gas rin po che/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon cog dpal/rgyal ba brag phug pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge /'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug /rje bkra shis brtan pa/ spyan snga dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mus pa grub pa'i dbang po/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam (37ba bo byangs bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang zha lu mkhan chen/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na kun mkhyen go bo nas/ paṇa chen kong ston/ rje bkra shis brtan pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /rje dkane cog 'phel/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/mus pa dkon cog rgya mtsho man 'dra/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun dga' mchog ldan/ dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang / glo bo mkhan chen/ dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ sa chen la gnang ba'i rtsa tshig gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bla ma dam pa nas/ ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen sa rgyal/ lung rig rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal bzang / brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa nas rim par nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /—52—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dpe chos rin cen spungs pa sogs kyi brgyud pa/po to ba chen po'i dpe chos rin cen spungs pa dang de'i 'grel ba bas pa shes rab rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ po to ba/ dge bshes gra pa ba/ 'di gnyis gcig mi gcig brtag /dge bshes brag dkar ba/ lce sgom 'dul ba rdo rje/ shes rab rdo rje'ang zer/ rje smon lam mgon po/ bla ma rin cen ye shes/rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med pa/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/hor dka' bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rje dpal ldan bzang po/ byang sems sbyin pa ba/ bla ma nam mkha'i mtshan can/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang /mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge gar khang pa shes rab rgyal (38na)mtshan/ paṇa chen thar rtse pa/ sgrub khang ba dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/sems dpa' chen po zha lu pa/ de bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rgyal sras thogs med pa nas/dpal ldan ye shes/ hor dka' bzhi pa man 'dra/ /dpe chos la nye bar mkho ba'i gtam rgyud rin cen 'phreng mdzes rje dpal yes mdzad pa dang /lce sgom shes rab rdo rjes mdzad pa'i man ngag rin cen spungs pa le'u bcu gsum ma gnyis kyi lung brgyud ni/ dpal ldan ye shes bzhugs pa'i dpe chos kyi brgyud pa dang gcig go /gtam rgyud rin cen 'phreng mdzes kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od nas/ 'phags pa blo 'phel/tshul khrims dang / bsod nams lha dbang / ngag dbang chos grags/ brag dgon spyan snga/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /ji skad du/'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro na lhang nge ba/ /klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin du/ /legs brgyud byang chub lam gyi rim pa ni/ /skye rgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na/ /gdams pa rin cen dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()phyir//dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/zhes shing rta chen po rnam pa gnyis kyi bzhed gzhung dpal mar me mdzad nas chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i dgongs pa bka' gdams rin po che bstan rim rnams su bkral ba 38ba7khan chen phyag rdor ba dang /mkhan chen chos skyong bzang po gnyis la thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa wo pos legs par gsan te byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i bstan bcos che chung gnyis mdzad pa nyams 'khrid du nos pa la rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud dang zab mo lta brgyud gnyis las/dang po ni/sangs rgyas zas gtsang sras po/rgyal ba mi pham pa/shing rta chen po thogs med/mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen/'phags pa rnam grol sde/btsun pa rnam grol sde/slob dpon mchog gi sde/rgyal sras dul ba'i sde/mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/rnam snang mdzad/slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ku su li che chung gnyis/gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/paṇ+ḍita chen po mar me mdzad/'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/'dzeng dgon pa ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar/thag ma pa ka ba dar seng /shud bun nam mkha' seng ge/slob dpon nam mkha' rgyal po/rgyal sras seng ge bzang po/slob dpon rgyal sras bzang po/gsang bdag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/mkhas grub shes rab seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa/nges par zung 'jug brnyes pa'i mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/khri rin po che bde ba can pa dge legs dpal bzang /lha'i btsun pa mkhas grub bsod nams dpal bzang /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/brag dgon spyan snga pa gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/rdo rje 'chang pha bong 39na ) kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/bka' drin mnyam med kun mkhyen dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas/des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to//yang na rgyal ba 'brom nas/spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od/skyer sgom pa gcan nu grags/sangs rgyas dbon ston gzhon nu 'byung gnas/shud bu ba nam mkha' rgyal po man gong bzhin no//yang na zhe chos kyi rgyal po/po to ba rin cen gsal/

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)sha ra ba yon tan grags/ 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rje/ spyil bu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ lha lung gi dbang phyug byang chub rin cen/ 'gro mgon dbang phyug 'od/ zangs chen pa dar ma bsod nams/ mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po/ mon grab pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ gnyal mkhan chen chos skyong bzang po rje btsun btsong kha pa man gong bzhin no/ /zab mo lta brgyud ni/ thub dbang nyi ma'i gnyen/ mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug /khu byug gnyis pa/ rdzo bo chen po a ti sha /'brom chos kyi rgyal po/ dgon pa ba man rgya chen spyod brgyud bzhin no/ / yang na 'brom nas/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar man 'dra/ yang na 'brom nas/ po to ba man 'dra/ deng sang rang phyogs kyi brgyud 'dzin phal cher lam rim gsol 'debs su tshig nyung ba gtsor bton gyi sbugs 'dren mdzad pa ma dgongs par rgya ོ spyod pa dgon pa ba dang / zab mo lta ba po to ba nas brgyud pa lta bu mdzad pa ni zhib mor ma dpyad pa'i rtsing chos kho nar snang ste de ltar (39ba)na brgyud pa gnyis ka la lam gye rim pa phyogs re ba las lus yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i skyon 'dug pa dgongs 'tshal lo/ /lam sgron sogs kyi lung brgyud/lam sgron gyi brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje nas/ mtsho sna pa shes rab bzang po yan gong ltar la/ de nas slob dpon dga' ba bzang po/ mkhan chen chos skyong bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa man 'dra/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i byang chub lam rim gyi 'khrid yig bdud rtsi gser gyi yang zhun gyi lung gi brgyud pa'ang bshad ma thag pa ltar ro/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo'i dka' ba'i gnad mtha' dag zhib mor 'grol ba'i rgyas bshad dang rtogs sla ba ltar snang ba la tshig gi lo mas don bsgribs nas dpyad dka' ba rnams snying por —33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bsgril nas don 'bru mdzad pa'i bshad lung yongs su rdzogs pa lan gnyis kyi bar nan to du nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po yan bshad ma thag pa ltar la/de nas rgyal tshab thamasacad mkhyen pa dar ma rin cen/bla chen nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan/se ra mkhas btsun don yod dpal ldan/se ra rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan/khri rin po che dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/gsung rab rgya mtsho'i ded dpon stag lung brag pa blo gros rgya mtsho/'jam dbyangs smra ba'i nyi ma dkon cog chos 'phel/des bdag la bka' drin du stsal to//lam rim chung ba'i lhag mthong gi dka' gnad kyi zhib bshad nos pa'i brgyud pa'ang brjod ma thag pa bzhin no//bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros sems 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor mdzad pa 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig 40na chu lcer sgom gyis bsdoms pa da lta bka' gdams thor bur grags pa'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/grub thob lcer sgom pa/'jam ston rnal 'byor zhig po brtson 'grus seng ge/mkhas pa brtson 'grus shes rab/'brom ston/'di 'brom 0 ba'i yang gnas dang mi tsog/lha rin pa/'dul ba rdo rje/'jad pa jo sras/mkhas btsun bsod nams rgyal mas/bla ma dpal ldan pa/bla ma dkon cog rdo rje/bla ma byang chub pa/bla ma shāka 'od pa/chos rje blo gros bzang po/chos rje bka' 'gyur pa/lo pa spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po//rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/zur thams cad mkhyen pa dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags nas/mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug/chos rje kun dga' legs grub/rje byams pa phun tshogs/rab 'byams pa dpal 'byor shes rab/mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/mkhan chen dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag zha lu ba chen po/des bdag la'o// 6

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)byang sa dang mdo sde rgyan sogs kyi lung brgyud/dpal mar me mdzad la shing rta chen po gnyis kyi gdams pa ma lus pa mnga' ba'i bstan bcos mtha' klas na'ang de'i nang nas thogs med sku mched kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'i lta spyod ston pa sa rgyan gnyis/ klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'i lta spyod rdzogs par ston pa bslab spyod gnyis/ de thams cad kyi yan lag 'chad pa skyes rabs dang (40ba brjod bya sna tshogs pa ston pas nye bar mkho ba ched du brjod pa'i tshoms gnyis te bka' gdams gzhung drug tu grags pa las byang sa dang mdo sde rgyan gyi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/rgyal tshab byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ mkhas pa blo gros brtan pa/puṭu shrīdha/ gang ba spel/ gaṅgā dha ra/ lo pa'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis 'dug kyang rje mkhyen brtse'i der mi snang ba brtag /gaṅgā dzi na rat+na/ kha che rin cen rdo rje/ kha che sa rdzo na/ paṇ+ḍita pa ra he ta/ 'di lo pa spyan snga'i gas yig na wo kha po che dang tshwag par mdzad bog pa dpyad/ bla ma blo gros grags pa/ mar pa jo pan/ mchims ston don grub/mchims brtson 'grus seng ge /mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyi ston shākya 'bum/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ ma dbyangs kyang ra/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang gzhen nu blo gros/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mkhan chen dkon cog tshul khrims/thar lam gsal sgron/ lo pa'i gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung ba tsho mes sogs gzhan gyi skabs dkon cog tshul khrims dang rat+na ā kwa ra'i bar du bla ma'i rigs mi 'dug cing mi'i ming mi 'dra 'dug pas dpyad/ mkhan chen rat+na ā kā ra/ rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang / sku gal paṇa 'a yang zer/ spyan snga ngag dbang cho me grags rgyal mtshan rin po che bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rtsed thang drung chen dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub/ shes bya kun mkhyen pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/—57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)zur r+ṣa chos kyi rgyal po (41na jos dbyings rang grol/ de bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na brgyud pa 'di mdo sde rgyan khe rkyang du mdzad kyang lo phyogs kyi gsan yig la sa rgyan gnyis ga'i brgyud par mdzad 'dug pa bka' gdams kyi 'byung khungs yin pas khungs dang 'brel ba yod dam snyam/ yang mdo sde rgyan gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ kha che blo brtan nas/ rig pa'i khu byug /mche ba'i sde/ bzang po'i zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ gaṅgā dha ra/ bsod nams dpal/ kha che dgon pa ba/ bram ze /gha/ kha che ye shes dpal/ rngog lo/ ba reg lo tsā ba rgyal mtshan/ ba reg ston skyabs/ skyes bu yon to dga'/ bkra shis rdo rje/ bol 'dzin pa/ kho ro ༅ rdor/ dar ma 'od zer/ tshad ma'i skyes bu/ kun mkhyen bu ston/ nya dpon/ re mda' ba/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa/ rgyal tshab rje/ gung ru rin byang / slob dpon gnyal ston pa/ rje chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma grags pa/chos kyi bshes gnyen/ blo bzangs waṃ/ rgyal khang rtse pa/ rje pha bong kha pa man 'dra/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyi mdzad pa'i byang sa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ mgon po byams pa/ slob dpon thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ kha che blo gros brtan pa/ slob dpon gang ba spel/ de la dzi na mi tra/ dwa na shī la/ in+d+ra bhū (41ba)ti gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum la ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog gru klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum la lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ nam nang zla ba'i rdo rje/ dbus rgyal ba ye shes gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum la grusargyal ba ye shes kyis gsan/ kun mkhyen bu dang mkhan ngag cho ba sog kyi gsan yig na 'di rnam kyi rig pa bzhin du gnang ba la sdeb su gsan pa'i gsal kha ma byung yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang ba nye brgyud ring brgyud kyi khyad yin nam yig skyon bzhi yin sog dpyad par bya'o/ /de nas gru mchog gi ye shes/ se btsun dbang phyug gzhen nu/ 'brom kyi bla ma de yin nam snyam/ 'gar mi yon tan g.yung drung / khu ston brtson tsos g.yung drung / ra khri bzang 'od/ rgya rgyal tshul/ li ston chos grags/ de gnyis la brang ti dar ma snying po dang ko ye 'byung gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis la rog chos brtson/ de nas mchims—58—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)brtson seng/ mchims don ba/ mchims blo brtan/ spyo ston bsod nams rin cen/ bo dong rin rtse/brtson 'grus rdo rje dang gcig 'dra ba dpyad/ stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan drang lung pa thugs rje shes rab/ rin cen ye shes/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ rgya ma yon to 'od/ chos rje bsod nams blo gros/dka' bcu pa dar ma bzang / mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje man gong ltar ro/ /slob dpon shan+ta de was mdzad pa'i bslab pa kun las btus kyi lung brgyud ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs ā tsarla shan+ti de wa pā da/ slob dpon e la dha ri/ slob dpon shu raṃ ga se na/da pa 'ar+sā rje ra/slob dpon sto ki rti/ gser gling pa/ (42na jo bo di baṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā na/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po/ po to ba rin cen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ chos lung ba shes rab grags/ gtum ston blo gro bang grags/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig tu 'di ltar snang la lo ba spyan snga'i gsan yig na 'di dang gong ma gcig tu mdzad 'dug bas brtag /gro mo che ba bdud rtsi grags/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na gro'i rjes su mchimasabyas pa'ang snang zer ba'i mas bu smo bog /zhang btsun pa/ zhang ston pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral gri/ skyi ston shākya 'bum/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ grags pa rgyal mas yang zer/ kun mkhyen dol po ba/ mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje grags don pa/ chos rje bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje dkon cog tshul khrims/ mkhan chen ran+ta ā kā ra man sa rgyan thun mong gi brgyud pa dang 'dra/ yang na zhi ba lha/ dze tā ri/ shes rab blo gros 'byung gnas/ dha na shrī/ su ma ti kirti/ rngog lo blo ldan shes rab/ khyung rin cen grags/ zhang tshe spong ba chos kyi bla ma/ nyang brang chos seng / gtsang nag pa/ rma bya shāka seng / mkhan chen bde ldan grub pa/ mkhan wo rngog ye/ bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ rje grags don pa man 'dra/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i lung brgyud ni/ ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po/ lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs/ slob dpon —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)zhi ba lha/ paṇ+ḍita mi brjed gzungs thob/ grub chen dze tā ri/ paṇa chen tsan+d+ra (42ba tha rti gi tsu/ slob grags pa wo ba zer/ paṇa chen pu rtso shrī/ bal po ka na ka pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirti/ blo gros legs grags/ rngog lo blo ldan shes rab/ zhang tshe spong ba chos kyi bla ma/ nyang bran ba chos kyi seng ge /gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge /dpal ldan gro/ mchims chen po/ skyi ston shāka 'bum/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ kun mkhyen dol bo ba/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge /rgyal sras sangs rgyas rin cen/ gnyug la ngag dbang grags pa man sa rgyan thun mong gi brgyud pa dang gcig /yang na rngog lo nas/ khyung rin cen grags/ stod lung rgya dmar ba/ cha ba chos kyi seng ge /'jad pa ston skyabs/ mus srad pa chen po/gtsang po ba bsod nams mdzes/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ dka' bzhi pa grags ga then/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ yang na rngog lo nas/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge man gong ltar ro/ /yang na cha pa chos kyi seng ge nas/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal man 'dra/ yang na rgyal sras zhi ba lha nas/ thams cad brtsegs/ shākya ma ti/ gu ṇa pu rkyu/ su ma ti kirti/ rngog lo man 'dra/slob dpon chen (43na)po dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i lung brgyud ni/rgyal ba zas gtsang sras po/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mkhas mchog dpa' bo/'jam dpal grags pa/ shan+ti pa/ se'u ri pa/ 'jigs med grags pa/ dge 'byung sbas pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che 'bring chung gsum/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ pu rgya shrī/ steng pa lo tsā ba/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/lho pa kun mkhyen/ bla ma rgya/ ga rma ba rang byung rdo rje/ sngags 'chang g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ rje rol ba'i rdo rje/ lho rin po che grags pa yon tan/ chos rje grags pa 'byung gnas/ mi pham gnyis pa tshul —60

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)khrims dar/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan man sargyan thun mong gi brgyud pa dang gcig /yang na slob dpon dpa' bo nas legs ldan 'byed/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug /ku mā ra lak+ṣa/ ha su ma ti/ dzol ā nan+da/ khu lotsā ba/ legs ldan pa/gtsang nag pa/ gshen chu skor ba/ g.yo pa jo nag ba/ 'od zer mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhon nu/ rje rang byung rdo rje man 'dra/ slob dpon 'di thog ma stag mo lus sbyin gyi rtogs brjod mdzad pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'khrungs rabs so bzhi song mtshams stag gis skyon nas rtsom 'phror lus pa dang la la dag brgya rtsa rdzogs par mdzes kyang slob dpon stag gis zos nas yun ring po'i bar ma tshor bas 'khrungs rabs so lnga man thigs pas chud zos pas so bzhi yan las ma byung ba'i lo rgyus snang bas gang ltar kyang slob dpon 'di dngos su (43ba gzhan la bklag lung ma gnang ba 'dra zhig 'dug mod/'on kyang mkhas grub thams cad kyi gsan yig na lung rgyun yod par mdzad pas med pa ni ci la srid/yang lo tsā ba'i 'gyur lung tsam la ngos bzung ba yin na ni brgyud pa gong ma rnams 'dren don mi 'dug pa rnam dpyod kyi khur dang ldan pa rnams kyis ljags ring du rkyong bar rigs so/ /dgra bcom pa chos skyob kyis bsdus pa'i ched du brjod pa'i tshoms gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa rak+ṣi ta/ dgra bcom pa chos skyob/ dgra bcom pa gro lha'i gos can/dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa/ rgyal rigs thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ārla de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ rat+na ā ka ra shan+ti/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dpyal chos bzang / dpyal pad+mo can/ mkhan po gzhon nu ye shes/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ spus ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ slob dpon bsod nams seng ge /rin po che grags pa don grub/ dgra bcom pa rin cen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje dkon cog tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rat+na ā kā ra man sa rgyan thun mong gi —61—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()brgyud pa dang gcig go /'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa'i bshad lung rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho yan khungs ma chod/ de nas zhal snga (44na gis bde ba can pa/ khri rin po che rgyal khang rtse pa/ 'jam dbyangs stag lung brag pa/ rje btsun bla ma dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag la bka' drin du stsal to/ /chos chung brgya rtsa'i lung gi lung brgyud/dpal mnyam med dī paṃ kwa ra shrī dz+nyā na'i thugs dam du mdzad pa'i chos chung brgya rtsar grags pa/byang chub lam gyi sgron ma rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta di baṃ kā ra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/1 spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma jo bos ne pā la'i yul du grogs po'i don du mdzad pa paṇ+ḍita de nyid dang nag tsho lo tswa'i 'gyur/ 2 bden pa gnyis la 'jug pa gser gling rgyal pos dge slong de wa ma ti bto ba'i ngor jo bos mdzad pa paṇ+ḍita de nyid dang lo tsā ba rgya brtson sgo gi 'gyur/ 3 dbu ma'i man ngag jo bo dang nag tsho lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ 4 snying po bsdu ba jo bo dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas de brtsa'i 'gyur/ 5 snying po nges par bsdu ba jo bos ste thang du mdzad pa paṇ+ḍita de nyid dang nag tsho lo tswa'i 'gyur/ 6 byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba jo bo nyid kyis sgra rang bsgyur du mdzad pa/ chos rje dpa' bo'i gsan yig na 'di bka' gdams kyi rtsab yin pa 'brom gyis gsung pa'i phyogs mdzad pa ni cung zad ma dgongs par mngon te pha 'brom ston gyis zhus nas jo bos gsungs pa la pha chos dang bu khu rngog gis zhus nas gsungs par bu chosazhes grags pas so/ / 7 byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam ga dmasang ga tu byas pa 'gyur byang ma gsal ba/ 8 'khor ba las yid nges par 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i glu jo bo dang lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng gis bsgyur ba la slar yang nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas 'gyur bcos mdzad pa/ 9(44ba)tshul khrims kyi spyod pa'i glu paṇ+ḍita badz+ra pā ṇi dang chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 10 chos kyi dbyings su —62

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)blta ba'i glu jo bo dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/11dran pa gcig pa'i man ngag jo bosalo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i ngor mdzad pa lo paṇa de gnyis kyi 'gyur/12byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i lam la 'jug par bstan pa jo bos lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi don du mdzad pa paṇ+ḍita de nyid dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/12skyabs su 'gro ba bstan pa 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/14theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs yi ge bsdus pa jo bo dang lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/15theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa 'gyur byang gong 'dra/16rang gi bya ba'i rim pa bskur ba dang bcas pa yi ger bris pa 'gyur byang gong dang 'dra ba/17mdo sde'i don kun las btus pa'i man ngag jo bo dang nag tsho lo tswa'i 'gyur/18mi dge ba bcu'i lasalam bstan pa 'gyur gong 'dra/19las rnam par 'byed pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra/20ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u jo bo dang dge slong shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/21'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga/22kha tan dang glegs bam bklag pa'i sngon du bya ba'i cho ga/rdo rje gdan pa'i ga yig kha ton dang glegs bam gnyis chos tshan so sor phral 'dug cing thar rtse sgrub khang shar pa gsum gyi gsan yig na gcig tu mdzad//23pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i sāts+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga/24bla ma'i bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa gong gsal bzhi po de la 'gyur byang mi gsal/25sems bskyed 45nasgo dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim pa rdzo bo dang dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur slar yang paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos shing gto la phab pa/26chos tsha zho nyer drug po 'di rnams dpal di baṃ kā ra nyid kyis mdzad pa yin/slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga paṇ+ḍita pu rgya shrī mi tra dang lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/27dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga paṇ+ḍita su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/28slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang yid dam blang ba'i cho ga mkhan po chen po su ma ti kirti dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/6

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na sems bskyed dang yid dam blang ba kha bral te a rmi yang sgo sor snang ngo / 29slob dpon mkhas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rnam rgyal gsang ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i las dang po ba'i sa sbyang ba slob dpon spos pa dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/30 des mdzad pa'i sems rin po che rnam par sbyang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i springs yig ā ma du lo ba dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dpe rnying pa 'dra na dgra las rgyal zhes pa las rnam mi 'dug pa rgya skad sor bzhag bsgyur ba 'dra ste slob dpon dze tā ri yin par mjug tu/ 'jam dpal rdo rjes byin brlabs pa'i/ /dze tā ris mdzad gzhung 'di la/ brten nas rang sems sbyang ba la/ /mkhasapa rnams kyis brtson par rigs/ /(45bsko skes snang bas bod skad la rnams bsnan pa legs par mngon no/ /31 slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bshes pa'i springs yig slob dpon sarba dz+nya de wa dang lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 32 mkhas pa tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i slob ma la springs pa'i yi ge lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/ 33 slob dpon maX tsi tras ma khol/mdzad pa'i rgyal po ka ni ka la springs pa'i yi ge paṇ+ḍita bi du kā ra pra bha dang lo tsā ba rin cen mchog gis bsgyur ba slar yang ā tsa sgro dpal brtsegs kyis bcos pa/ 34 slob dpon don yod 'char gyis rgyal po snyan ngag mkhan la gdams pa'i dri ma med pa'i dris lan rin cen 'phreng ba zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la gup+ta dang lo chen rin cen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 35 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu la springs pa sarba dz+nya de wa dang lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 35 slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/ 37 slob dpon btsun pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyi mdzad pa'i dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon dha rma kā ra dang lo tsā ba gtsang de be ji rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur/ 38 slob dpon mkhas mchog rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa slob dpon a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 39—64—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)btsun pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa paṇa chen burnya kā ra warma dang lo tsā ba chos kyi (46na)shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 40 slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i mya ngan bsal ba zhes bya slob dpon a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 41slob dpon gsang ba byin gyis mdzad pa'i gzhen nu ma bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa 'gyur byang med pa/42 slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i yon tan bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam paṇ+ḍita gaṅgā dha ra dang lo chen rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 43 des mdzad pa'i tshul khrims kyi gtam slob dpon dza lan dha ra dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 44 des mdzad pa'i tsho gos kyi gtam paṇ+ḍita gaṅgā dha ra dang lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 45 slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam slob dpon a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 45 slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i legs par bshad pa rin po che za ma tog lta bu'i gtam le'u brgyad pa slob dpon ru tra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ la las 'di'i nang gi maṇ+ḍal zur du phyung nas dpa' bos mdzad pa'i ma rdzas zhes josa'adzin pa'ang snang ngo / /47 slob dpon maX tsi tras mdzad pa'i phyin ci log bzhi spong ba'i gtam paṇ+ḍi bu bha dra dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 48 des mdzad pa'i rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam slob dpon a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 49 slob dpon sa 'tsho byin gyis mdzad pa'i dben pa'i gtam paṇ+ḍita di paṃ kā ra dang lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ thar rtse pa khang shar pa gsum gyi ga yig na chos sbyin zer ba 'dug kyang dpe rnying pa 'ga' dang /rdo rje gdan pa'i (46bskos na yig na 'di ltar snang / 50 slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rin cen 'phreng ba las byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu pa/ 51 des ba tshwa can gyi chu klung gi mdo las byung ba'i sems can mgu bar bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu gcig pa slob dpon burnya kā ra warma dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 52 slob dpon btsun pa gzhan la phan pa'i dbyangs dgon pa bas mdzad pa'i smon lam bdun cu pa zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa paṇ+ḍi ta dharma shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba dpal gyi lhun po'i sde'i —63—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'gyur/mkhas mchog dpa' po stag gis ma' par gcos te nags khrod du snying rje 'a po ca nas blangs te smon lam 'di mdzad do/53slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i don dam byang chub sems sgom pa'i rim pa rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta pad+mā ka ra warma dang lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po'i 'gyur/54des mdzad pa'i kun rdzob byang chub sems sgom pa'i man ngag pad+ma spungs pa zhes bya ba lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/sems ni ra yug dkar po 'dra zhes sogs sho lon bzhi pa zhig 'dug pa bstan bcos rtsom pa po dang lo paṇa gang gi gsung bi tho tshogs pa/55slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi mdo las phyung ba'i 'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa/56chos rjes su dran pa/57dge 'dun rjes su dran pa/58'dod pa'i yon to rnam pa lnga'i nyesadamigs shad pa dang bcas pa'i bzhi slob dpon sto shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po'i 'gyur/59'phags pa rtog pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo sde las byung ba'i sdig pa bshagasapa'i 47na ) cho ga/60'di gnyis gyi bar na sgrub pa'i cho ga logs shin tu phyung ba zhes pa'i chos 'a gcig gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'dug kyang bshags pa sgrub pa zhes gcig tu bya ba las dpe sgo sor med/bslab pa kun las btus las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya ba'i bsrung ba dang sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/thar rtse ba khang shar pa gsum gyigs yig tu bsrung ba dang sdig pa bshags pa a rmi sgo sor brgyab pa'i skyon gyis chos tshan brgya dang gsum yin khul la rtsi rgyu a rmi brgya dang bzhi yong gi 'dug cing gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'a nga so sor phral snyug wo mi 'gago yin/61slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i mdo sngags gnyisathun mong ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/62slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal gsang bas mdzad pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul pa'i cho ga a du lo pa dang chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/63dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa wo po rin cen 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/mas bong grag slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa zer/64slob dpon rnyog pa med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i ma rdza gyi cho ga slob dpon a du lo pa dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/65slob dpo/ kai ma las mdzad pa'i sngags kyi maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'gyur rnying / dpe la lar ka mal shrī las mdzod zer pa snang ba mtshan la 'khrul gzhi byung ba 'dra yang ka ma la ni chu skye gyi rigasadang /ma la ni zla bar chag go/ 7 slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa'i (47ba)ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u zhes bya ba slob dpon bi na ya tsan+d+ra dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 67 slob dpon nag po'i zhabs kyi mdzad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 68 slob dpon a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa'i bsam gtan gyi chosadrug rnam par gzhag pa slob dpon dharma shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 69 de'i 'grel ba slob dpon bā na shī las mdzad pa 'gyur byang gong dang 'dra ba/ 70 sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las byung ba'i gnas dang spyad par mi bya ba ste ting nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnam par gzhag pa rgya nag gi mkhan po hā shang zab mo dang lo tsā ba rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/ 71 dngosagrub brnyes pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor rtog pa'i gegs sel zhes bya ba 'gyur rnying yin zhing 'di gsang sngags yo ga'i rgyud la brten nas bshad pa 'dra zer ba snang ngo / /72 mkhas pa chen po byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/73slob dpon kā ma la shi las mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la 'jug pa slob dpon pra dz+nyā warma dang lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 74 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhabs kyi pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru spyi bos len pa'i sde snod gsum pa slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i lam 'gyur byang migs la ba/ 75 slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa slob dpon dharma (4ni tha dang lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 7 slob dpon dge ba'i go mas mdzad pa'i mi sdug pa sgom pa'i rim pa 'gyur rnying / migatsang ba sgom pa'i thab gad pa'ang ra/ 77 slob dpon nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i lus yongs su dpyad pa'i sgom pa'i rim pa slob dpon de nyid dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gsan yig rnam su sa mgo can bris 'dug kyang brjod don lus gyi phyi nang rnams la dpyad byed pa snang / 78 slob dpon chen po dpal ye shes grags pas mdzad pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i —67
