rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()theg pa sgom pa'i rim pa'i man ngag slob dpon pad+ma ka ra warma dang lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po'i 'gyur/79dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon ma hā ma tis mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bla na med par sgom pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'gro ba zhes pa ā tsan+d+ra bi na ya tsan+d+ra dang lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/'di'i mthug tu mi mchog gang zhig gis ni zhes sogs tshig 'bru bcu gcig snang ba sus mdzad ma nges/80slob dpon chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag slob dpon dza la na dha ra dang lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po'i 'gyur/phyogs glang gis mdzad pa dang 'di gnyis na los rgya 'a po ni thos na kyang zhes pa na bzung ste mang po rnam ni yang dag rdzogs par 'gyur zhes pa'i bar zhus dag phar yang 'go mjug mi gcig/81slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rin cen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom pa'i man ngag slob dpon shan+ti bha dra dang lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 44'gyur/82slob dpon ye shes zla bas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor dpyod pa'i sgom pa'i don mdor bsdus te bstan pa slob dpon pradzha warma dang lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/'di'i rtsab slob da' klu'i gsag sto gyi mdzad/83mkhasapa chen po dze tā ris mdzad pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon sharnyi bha dra dang dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/84slob dpon dbyig ga 'a gyis mdzad pa'i yon tan bdun bstan pa'i gtam paṇ+ḍita ka ma la gup+ta dang lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po'i 'gyur/85mkhan po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i bslab pa kun las btus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/86de'i mngon par rtogs pa dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍita de nyid dang nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/87gser gling rgyal po dpal ldan cho cha gis/ba chos sa sa mo dpal rdo rje mnyes bya pas/bslab pa kun la ba yis ba'i mngon par rtogs/nam la dang mar tshe mdzad lagasungs/zhes gser gling pa mar me mdzad la bshad ba jo bo bla ma'i bka' bsdus na mdzad pa mdzad pa po jo bo min nam snyam pa'i som nyi mi dgo so//'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po nyi shu pa kha che ā nan+da dang lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/88des mdzad pa'i 'phags pa sa lu ljang pa'i // le'ur byas pa paṇ+ḍita dharma shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)legs pa'i blo gros dang dz+nyā na ku mā ra'i 'gyur slad kyi dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bcos pa/ yo desamadzad pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ 90 des (49nasgo dzad pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i rnam par bshad pa/ 91 de gnyis la 'gyur byang mi gsal/des mdzad pa'i rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam zhes pa kha che shrī rā tha dang lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 92 des mdzad pa'i byang chub sems kyi rnam par bshad pa chos 'di'i mdzad pa po'i che ba dang brjod bya bzang ba dang rjod byed dbyings su gyur pa'i stobs kyis rtsal phyung zhing bsgyur ba mang du snang ba las lo tsā ba rab zhi chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis bsgyur ba la gzhi byas gu ru ba chos kyi shes rab/seng dkar shākya 'od/ shes rab grags pa/ mar pa chos dbang / pa tshab nyi ma grags/ mang nad grags 'byor shes rab bdun gyi 'gyur las don gang bzang phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa/ 93des mdzad pa'i bla na med par bstod pa paṇ+ḍita lo tra dang lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 94 des mdzad pa'i srid pa las 'das par bstod pa kha che shrī rā tha dang lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 95 slob dpon dkon cog 'bangs kyi mdzad pa'i yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa paṇ+ḍita sarba dz+nya de wa dang lo tsā ba rin cen mchog gi 'gyur la bzhed pa la brtsegs kyis bcos pa/ 96 de'i 'grel ba slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/ 97 yang desamadzad pa'i yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa lo paṇa bshad ma thag pa'i 'gyur/ 98 slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa'i khyad par du 'phags par bstod pa sgyur byed gong dang (49ba)'dra ba/ 99 slob dpon bde byed bdag pos mdzad pa'i lha las phul du byung bar bstod pa sgyur byed gong dang 'dra ba/ 100 slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba bdun cu pa jo bo rje dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi 'gyur/ 101 slob dpon bi mā las mdzad pa'i skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa 'gyur byang mi gsal ba/ 102 jo bo chen po a ti shas rgyal po ner ya pha la la brdzangs pa'i dri ma med pa rin po che'i 'di dang byang tso sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba gnyis phal cher gcig —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pas dpe sna zur du mi 'dren zhes chos rje dpa' bo gsung yang sho lo na gsum bzhi tsam gyi bar zhus dag pher ba la bar bar du mi pher ba/rang ston rtog la mig bca bya/gas skyon rtog la long nga//zhes dang /rtse 'di thu' zhin dran pa dang //gas la dad gawo ba dang //ldan gsum 'das par gnas mi bya//zhes dang /mar pa bdun du rab grags pa'i phung po gsum pa gdon par mdzod/ces pas mtsho ni pa'i nor bu'i 'phreng bar med pa'i tshig shin tu mang bas dbe lung gnyis ga zur du nges par dgos phyogs 'dra tsam gyi sto na sher phyogs kyi mdo sde yang la la dor rung bar sgo so/'phrin yig/de nyid dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams/102de ltar chos 'a brgya dang gsum gyi lung legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa ོ di paṃ kā ra/'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po/po to ba rin cen gsal/sha ra ba yon tan grags/chu mig pa shes rab grags/gro ston bdud rtsi grags/sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/mchims nam mkha' grags/rgyang ro byang chub 50na po bum/thar rtse pa'i gas yig na gar gags du 'di gnyis go ldog tu 'dug kyang mchims kyi rnam thar ltar dang de ltar yin gsung ba khungs ga mi par mthi no//mchims blo bzang grags pa/yol ston bsod nams lhun grub/slob dpon grags pa rgya mtsho/mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/rgya ston tsan+d+ra de wa/ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/'gar ston shes rab rgya mtsho/mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/yongs 'dzin dkon cog chos 'phel/ngor r+sā dkon cog lhun grub/rje dkon cog dpal ldan/shar pa byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/sgrub khang pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/rgyal kun ngo bo bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/rdo rje las pa dngos zur chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to//khyad par 'phags bstod dang lha las phul byung gi bstod pa gnyis kyi lung mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la'ang thos/brgyud pa ma byung /bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po rtses dang las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa'i byang chub lam gyi sgron me'i 'grel pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/las chen kun rgyal ba/paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa bar 'dir bla tshigacig gnyis shig ma rnyed/de nas sgom shar 0pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/zhal snga nas nam mkha'

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i dbang phyug dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /(2) 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'i skor/gnyis pa/(50bskor bras bu sngags kyi theg pa la/ gsang sngags phyi 'gyur/ snga 'gyur gnyis/dang po la zur bka'/ spyi bka'/ zhan byung bla ma'i gsung 'bum sogs mdo sngags tha snyad so sor dbye dka' ba'i skor dang gsum/ dang po la/ bya ba/ spyod pa rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla med dang bzhi/dang po bya rgyud ni/ mdun legs ma las/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam gyi tshul/ /mi shes de yis rnal 'byor bla med rgyud/ khyud sde kun gyi mchoge tu thag bcad kyang / /dam bca' tsam du zad par legasamathong nas/ /gsang ba spyi rgyud legs par grub pa dang / /dpung bzang gis zhus bsam gtan phyi ma sogs/ /bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud sde rnams la ring du 'dris par byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya ba'i rgyud la mtha' klas pa'i nang nas nyung zad tsam nos pa'i rim pa la/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pas mdzod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga phan bde'i 'byung gnas kyi steng nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bor gtogos pa'i sman gyi bla ma lha bzhi bcu rtsa bdun gyi dbang legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs/mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bo dhi satwa/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ sad na legs mjing yon/mnga' bdag khri ral/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ mnga' bdag 'od srungs/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsun/ khri skyi lde nyi ma mgon/ mnga' bdag bkra shis lde/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od/ mnga' bdag lha lde/(51na sgong 'a bdag 'od lde/ mnga' bdag rtse lde/ mnga' ris dgra bcom/ blo ldan shes rab grags/brtse ldan dar ma rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan gro/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ dgra bcom gzhen nu'i mtshan can/ rje 'dul mdzad pa/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ dpang —71—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ston rgyal mtshan dpal/'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang po/'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel/rgyud chen bkra shis 'phags/rgyud chen brtson 'grus 'phags/sras khang sngags ram pa bzang po rnam rgyal/rdo rje lasang 'bon rigs grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal 'byor lhun grub/rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to//bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bde bar gshegs pa brgyad mtho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i rjes gnang legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/mnga' ris dgra bcom yan gong ltar la/sgrub kha ba'i gas yig na 'di tshab snar byang chub tshul khrim zer ba zhig 'dug pa mtshan gyi rnam grang yin nam mi gcig pa yan brtag/de nas dge bshes zhu ldan pa shes rab grags/ra sa mkha pa sgos gas yig na chu lhad pa zer ba'ang snang /chu las pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/sgrub khang pa'i gag yig na zar ba dar ma rgyal ma' zer ba yo 2ga pa dpyad/dpal ldan gro mo che/sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/gnyag snying po rgyal mas/spro lung pa kun smon/spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/51ba'i jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/mkhan chen tshul khrims dpal 'byor/chos lung shar gling pa 'khrul zhig kun bzang mthu stobs dpal 'bar/'jam da byang tshomakhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/desabadag la'o//yang na mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho nas/bo dhi satwa chung ba/rgyal po dge ba'i dpal/jo bo rje/lha btsun byang chub 'od/te se ba chen po/byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/kong po lo tsā ba/ngag chosapa'i gag mig na dbang po lo tsā ba zer ba 2ga pa brtag/dgra bcom rgyal mtshan/gya ba dbang mdzes/gya ba dpal mdzes/yon tan dbang phyug shangs pa 'dul 'dzin/'di gong du bla mjo r+sā zer ba wo mag ngag cho pa'i gag mig na 2ga pa lhag ho gang yin brtag/mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa man 'dra/'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thaXs kyi yi ge dang gong ma'i phyag len ltar sangs

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg bam dang po/ (ka)rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga pa'i rjes gnang dang /de'i sgrub skor klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa la sgrub thabs dbul ba dang bral ba/sad ser dang lte 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa zhi ba/phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral ba/klu'i gnod pa dang bral ba/skyes pa bud med thams cad 'phel ba/char dbab gcod/sa'i gter 'byin pa rnams/bcom ldan ral gris mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/rong ston 52nashākya rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa thabs mkhas thugs rje ma dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po/'phags pa klu sgrub/jo bo a ti sha/'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/bshes gnyen po to ba/dge bzhes sha ra ba/gas ston blo gros grags/zhang ston rdo rje 'od zer/gro ston shes rab grags/mchims nam mkha' grags/bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri/dpal sdings pa/shar pa'i gsan yig na dkyus ltar byung la sngags 'chang dkon leg pa'i gsan mig na 'di gnyis go ldog tu snang ba brtag/'dul 'dzin grags pa dpal/mnga' ris byang chub bla ma/shar pa'i gag yig na 'di ba 2ga cing lo pa sbyan snga'i gas yig na 'di gnyis sbrel2ga pa dpyad/rgya gar rgyal mtshan/bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/rong r+sā shes bya tso rig/thams go ༷ pa dge 'dun grub/paṇa wo bzang po bkra shis/rje stobasaldan pa/paṇa chen na bza' pa/gan pa paṇa chen/rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/slob dpon brnya ba/rdo rje lang pha bong kha pa/bka' drin mnyam med chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/rong ston nas/paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/brag dkar ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang dkon cog legasapa/mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/khyab bdag zha lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/52ba8sa bdag la'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang gi lung brgyud sogs/sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang dang /yig cha gnyis kyi lung thob pa las rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ba ri lo tsā ba rin r+ṣa grags/sa skya pa — po/slob dpon rin po che/rje gzha rin po che/chos rje sa paṇa/rgya lo rnam tso rdo rje/sras a ka ra skye med grub pa/rdo rje gdan pa'i gas yig tu a kā ra sirnyi zhes snang /brag kha ba grags pa seng ge/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/cho ge rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/chosarje kun dga' bzang po/gu ge paṇ+ḍita grags pa rgyal mtshan/glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/bka' drin mnyam med rigs brgya'i bdag po mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/desabadag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na sa paṇa nas/chos rgyal 'phags pa/rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje man 'dra/yang na sa paṇa nas/tsho gis sgom kun dga' dpal/nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/bla ma bsod nams skyabs/sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/rje dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/yang na glo bo mkhan chen nas/sa lo 'jam dpal rdo 53na ) rje/rdo rje 'chang sgo rus pa/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse nas/mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/yang na sangs rgyas phyag na rdo rje/dze twa ri man gong bzhin no//yig cha gnyis kyi lung brgyud 4

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ni/'jam dbyangs ma brtse'i dbang phyug nas/mchod dpon dkon cog pa/rdo rje lang dbang rab man gong dang 'dra/gang blo ma'i rgya gzhung la brten nas 'jam dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i rjes su gnang ba bya rgyud rang skad kyi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin dang /rtsa ba rgya gzhung gang blo ma/de la brten pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa rnams thob pa las rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/paṇa chen dhi ra pā la/ngor r+ṣa thar rtse ra pa mar ngag chos pa bzhi'i gas yig na paṇa r+pā 'bum ldog gsum pa zer ba snang ba mas gyi rnam grang yin min brtag/rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/khyung rin cen grags/rgya dmar ba byang chub grags/cha pa chos kyi seng ge/gtsang nag pa thugs rje seng ge/dan 'bag pa dar ma seng ge/gnyal zhig 'jam dpal rdo rje/gzang ring nam mkha' dpal/ngor wo thar rtse shar pa ngag chos bzhi'i gsan yig na dar ma tshul khrim zer ba 'dug pa dpyad/brag steng pa bsod nams rgyal ba/gsan yig gzhan bzhi por 'di'i gong du gra thang ba zer ba zhig 'dug pa brag steng pa dang nor ba'i mig skyon gyis zur du bya pa yin na mo brtag/yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge/53ba ) thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/rje bkra shis rin cen/rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams legs yang /sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/bka' 'gyur ba chen po 'jam mgon bsod shen mas ma chag ldan/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//lung gi brgyud pa ni/sgo rum pa nas/tshar chen rje mkhyen brtse/rdo rje 'chang dbang rab/khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i bzhed srol gyi 'jam dkar kha che paṇa chen gyi thugs dam bzhi'i nang tshan gyi ya rgyal gcig tu brtsi ba'i rjes gnang /khro phu lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i yig cha ltar dang lung la/slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs zab pa las kyang ches

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zab pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍita shākya shrī dang khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs bskyed rim dang mthun par bstod pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ma tis mdzad pa gnyan los bsgyur ba/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i phyag len ltar lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bsdebs pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge /rgya ston pasamadzad pa'i sgrub skor la/ rtsa ba'i (54na ba pa/ nyes byas 'joms pa/ yon tan sgrub pa/ rtsod pa bya thabs/ ma sha la brten pa'i las sbyor/ mkhas pa chen po bsod snyoms pa rin cen rgyal mtshan gyisamadzad pa'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab bsgrub pa/ ral gri'i dngos grub/ mig sman/ rgad nad las grol ba/ tshe'i rig pa 'dzin pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i yi ge /'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs stag tshang lo tsā ba'i gsung bzhin ā nan+da ra smis mdzad pa rnams legs par thob pa las bsod sgoms pa rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa ma gtogs pa'i rjes gnang dang lung yongs rdzogs gyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ paṇ+ḍita sgeg pa'i rdo rje ma ti/ slob dpon nor bu gling pa chung ba/ bu ston dang sa lug kyigs yig phal cher na 'di gnyis mi bong snyug pa nye bas yin nam snyam/ paṇ+ḍita 'byung gnas sbas pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ mkhan chen grags pa gzhen nu/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ lo chen skyabs mchogo dpal/ sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer/ bcom ldan grags 'phel ba/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin cen/ gnas brtan 'od 'gro ba/ 'jam dbyangs sku skye shes rab rin cen/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang (54ba bo bang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu ba rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /brgyud pa 'di zhal gzigs brgyud pa ngo mtshar can no/ /yang na stag tshang pa'i gsung rgyun ā nan+da sa mdzad pa ma gtogs pa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ kha che paṇa chen yan gong ltar la/ de nas khro phu lo tsā ba byams —76

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa'i dpal/mkhan po dbang phyug grags/rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/mkhan chen dngas ma ba/rin po che shes rab grags/lung pa dkon cog rdo rje/mkhan chen seng ge dpal/chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/byang sems 'phags pa blo 'phel/spyan snga tshul khrims dang /lo pa spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/gur rdzong chos 'byor dpal bzang /rig 'dzin chen po gzhon nu don grub/drin can bla ma 'jam dbyangs chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//yang na mkhan chen bde ba dpal nas/ rje sangs rgyas gzhen nu/ mkhan chen bsod nams shes rab/mkhan chen shes rab mgon po/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ngor chen rdo rje 'chang /chos rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang man 'gre/yang rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ngor chen nas/gu ge paṇ+ḍita grags pa rgyal mtshan/glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams legasa'abyung sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan man 'dra/yang na 55naspyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan nas/rin po che bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/zur chen gzhen nu don grub man 'dra/yang na tshar chen nas/rin po che bod mkhar ba man 'dra/yang na ngor chen nas/kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/chos rje sangs rgyas lhun grub/mkhan chen ga shī la/rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/yang na gu ge paṇa r+pā nas/glo bo mkhan chen legs yang /sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/rje dkon cog dpal ldan/shar r+ṣa kun dga' bkra shis/de dbon shes rab 'byung gnas/khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//yang na rgya ston kun dga' brtson grus nas/mkhan chen brtson 'grus byang chub/chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/'jam dbyangs grags pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/'jam dbyangs tshe dbang kun mkhyen/kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/rab 'byams chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()yang na mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa nas/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/grub chen dpal bzang pa/bka' bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/mtshams 'dir bla ma gnyis tsam zhig ma rnyed/de 55bar sa sku shad bkra shisargyal mtshan/lha bo bla ma rin cen rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa chen po//des bdag la'o//yang na 'jam dbyangs/rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/pa ri lo tsā ba/bu ston dang sa lug kyi gas yig phal ṭ+wā na brgyud pa 'di go skeyang rdo rje gdan pa'i gag yig dang yis/brtse ba r+ṣa po/slob dpon rin po che/rje btsun grags pa/sa paṇ+ḍita/'phags pa rin po che/brag kha ba grags pa seng ge/bla ma mang mkhar ba/bla ma byang seng ba/chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/gnas rnying 'jam dbyangs si cen rgyal mtshan/gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/rtser rje btsun pa/pha bong kha pa bde legs nyi ma/brag dgon spyan snga gas nu chos dpal bzang po/rdo rje 'amang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/des bdag la'o//yang na kha che paṇa chen nas/paṇ+ḍita dwa na shī la/g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams seng ge/mkhan chen bde ba dpal man 'dra/ā nan+da sa mdzad pa ma ga rta gos pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ngor r+sā yan 'dra ba la/de nas rgyal k+ṣe kun dbang /yongs won dkon cog 'phel/ngor ོ dkon cog lhun grub/spyan snga dkon cog rgya mtsho/mus 'a sangs rgyas rgyal mas/sa' kun dga' bsod nams/de sras 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug/rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan chen zha lu pa rin cen bsod na mas mchogo grub/des bdag la'o//yang gas lo lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ma ti nas/gnyan 56na kho tho tsā ba dar ma grags/gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mas/sgang ston grub pa/jo sras rgyal mas/'bre sgur dme/'jam dbyangs gsar ma/byang chub 'od/mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang man sngar bzhin no//paṇ+ḍita gser gdugs can gyi bar srol / bas 'jam dbyangs dkar po shes rab 'khor

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lo'i rjes gnang gong ma'i phyag len bzhin dang / khro phu lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gsal byed me long gi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ paṇ+ḍi gser gdugs can/ 4zha zla ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rwa hu la shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na bi na ya shrī zer/ bik+ṣa ta de wa/gong dkar ba'i ga ga na bi khya〉zer bsnang / kha che'i paṇ+ḍita shākya shrī bha dra/ khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal/ chos rje bsod nams dbang phyug /khro phu rin cen dbang phyug /mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang / kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang / khro phu rin cen 'bum/ gnyag dbon bsod namasabazang po/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ mkhan chen rin cen bzang po/ mkhan chen chos grub seng ge /lo chen rat+na bha dra/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ chos gter dkon cog legs pa/ e waṃ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ khyab bdag zha lu ba chen po rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /ngor mkhan chen sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyi yig cha'i steng nas rgya gar mkhas grub dam pa sangs rgyas lugs kyi 'jam (56ba bo byangs smra ba'i seng ge yum dbyangs can ma sngon mo bya rgyud kyi lugs ltar mdun du bskyed pa'i lha gnyis kyi rjes su gnang ba nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/'phags pa 'jam dpal dmar po'i gsung gi sgrub thabs mkhas pa kā ma shrī las mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal dmar po'i sgrub pa'i rim pa dam pa rgya gar gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa chos dbyings rnam dag ma/ dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa dus gsum bde gshegs ma/ shes rab 'phel ba'i gdams pa 'jam dpal dmar po gsung gi rdzogs rim/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal mthong ba'i thabs/ril sgrub kyi tshogs bcad blo 'phel sgron me/ rdzas dang 'khor lo la brten nas shes rab 'phel ba/rgyal po dbang du bsdu ba blon po sogs la'ang de dang 'dra ba/ mu dra dbang du bya ba mdzes ma rgyan 'khor/gzhan gyi ngag rku ba/ pha rol gyi shes rab ga pa/ mngon par shes pa sgrub pa/ rkang mgyogs/ mig rno ba/ sman gyi thun tshad/ ral gri'i rgyu/ 'khor lo/ ril bu'i dbyibs dang kha dog gza' skar dang bcas —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bstan pa/ ril bu'i gdan gyi 'khor lo'i bskyed chog /rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi maṇ+ḍal bstan pa/ sgrub pa'i tshad dang blang dor bstan pa/ swā ts+tsha dkar nag gi spyor ba la brten nas gnod byed gnon zhing bar gcod bsrung ba/dbang sdud 'khor lo 'dri tshul gyi gsal byed dang bcas pa/ 'di yan phal cher yig rnying dam pa'i gsung / gdams pa'i byung tshul khyab bdag sman lung pa ma ti'i mtshan can gyi zin bris/ (57na gyi khor lo/ gtor ma/ sbyin sreg /spogs cho go /rdzas kyi bya ba dang bcas pa 'jam dbyangs smra seng sgrub pa'i man ngag zab pa las kyang ches zab pa rigs 'dzin ga rma gu rus kong po rtse lha sgang du mdzad pa/ de'i gsung rgyun gyi sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi gegs sel gnad kyi man ngag /sgab 'dre dkyil 'khor nyal 'og sgo them zhabs su gnon thabs/ dpe ris las/ ril bu'i gdan dang khebs kyi 'khor lo/ yum gyi 'khor lo/ mdzes ma rgyan 'khor/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nyin byed mi shes smag rus sel ba/ des mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga bklags pas don grub/ des mdzad pa'i ril sgrub kyi gdams pa rgya gzhung gi gsal byed nyin byed snang ba dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob pa las ril sgrub blo 'phel sgron me dang / sgrub khang pas mdzad pa'i yig cha gsum ma gtogs rjes gnang dang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta/ bram ze rig byed gzhon nu/ dbyangs li bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar 'dug kyang lo rgyus su dam pas rig byed gzhen nu la gsan par bshad pas dpyad/ rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas/ dar pan ā tsarla/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ dbus pa gzhon nu byang chub/ shing stod pa tshul khrims gzungs/ mkhas btsun don grub rin cen/ de wa rā dza/ slob dpon gnyan/ mkhan po tshul khrims dga'/ bla ma bkra shis dpal/ bla brang pa bzang po dpal/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ rong ston (57ba'i kya rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen bkra shisarnam rgyal/ sems dpa' chen po bsod nams lha dbang / mthu stobs dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis/—80

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ kurma 'phrin las che ba'ang zer/ gyer gyi sngags 'chang bsod nams dge legs/ rig 'dzin chen po bsod nams rnam rgyal/ dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin chos kyi sgron me/rig 'dzin chen po mdze gu sa chos brgyad rang grol nam mkha' chos dbang khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje lang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ pha dam pa nas/ kha che gu phya pa/ glan sgom yab sras/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'di'i sngon du lo bas chung ra ba zhig 'dug pa ro dam dpyad/ bla ma 'od zer shākya/ shar pa sher 'byung ba'i gsan yig na shāka 'od zer ba bdug pa phal cher dang ma mthun pas nor ba 'dra/ slob dpon 'od zer mgon po/ slob dpon shākya gzhen nu/ spyan snga bkra shis rnam rgyal man 'dra/ yang na spyan snga bkra shis rnam rgyal nas/ mkhan po bzod pa dpal/ mkhan po bsod nams 'od zer/ mkhan po shes rab mgon po/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen gragasapa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams legs 'byung / rje lha mchog seng ge gar khang pa shesarab rgyal mtshan/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa mkhas mchog dpal ldan don grub/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang (58nasgo gon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na bla ma 'od zer shākya nas/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen dol po ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen man 'dra/yang na pha dam pa nas/ dam pa so/ lkugs ring / lde ston dge ba/ glo chen sangs rgyas/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ sa bzang 'phags pa man 'dra/ yang nye brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ pha dam pa man 'dra/ ril sgrub blo 'phel sgron me dang sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyisamadzad pa'i yig cha le tshan gsum gyi lung ni/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ brang ti nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyud la brten nas 'khor los thog bsrung ba'i lag —81 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rtsamatsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()len kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/thugs sras lo tsā ba/rje nam mkha'i mtshan can/bla ma don grub legs pa/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/mkhyen rab rje/byang gling rin cen rgyal po/bla ma don grubargyal mtshan/rje ba po shis rgyal mtshan/bla mas dga' ba po shis/rje dpon cog rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//thugs sras lo tsā ba rin cen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bde dga' rgya mtsho'i steng nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum du gtogs pa bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi ras 58ba ) brisakyi dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/gtso mo lnga/phyogs skyong ༄/gza' dgu/rgyu skar nyer brgyad/rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas lha lnga bas rtsa drug byung bas gtso mo lnga po gcig tu 'brang na ma gtog ma 'grig pas dpyad/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/dpal phyag na rdo rje/dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba/rdo rje gdan pa che ba/chung ba/ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/rje btsun sa skya pa wo po/slob dpon rin po che/rje bas grags pa rgyal mtshan/chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na kun bsod 'dug pas brtag/kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/lte chos rgyal nam mkha' mchog grub/zha lu dka' bzhi pa wo po/sku spyo mkhyen rab chos rje rin cen mchog grub/rje bas rdo ring pa ོ po/ḍā r+ṣa chos kyi rgyal po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'cha dbang phyug rab brtan/mkhan chen 'jam dpal ngag dbang chos grags/rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams ma ba ldan/zur rdo rje lang chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na ba ri lo tsā ba nas/gto ston grags pa/gto rin cen grags/lha sa'i gnas brtan dkon cog/mkha ngag 6pa' gas na yig na dkon sto zer ba bog pas brtag/de'i sras rngog ston kha'u rgyal/rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug/rong pa shes rab seng ge/'phags 'od yon to rgya mtsho/kun mkhyen bu ston man 'dra/yang na bu /na rin po che nas/mkhan wo shes rab rdo rje/bla

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ma a mo gha/'jam dbyangs bsod nams 59na ) rin cen/chos lung mkhan chen don yod rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan/chos rje bshes gnyen bkra shis/grub mchog ngag dbang rnam rgyal/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na mkhyen rab cho me rje nas/mkhan chen dkon cog tshul khrims/gung pa mgon po rgyal mtshan/dge slong ngag dbang rnam rgyal man 'dra/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dang lung gsum gyi chings phyag len ltar 'od zer can ma gtso rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba dang /des mdzad pa'i 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs dgra bo 'dul ba'i las tshogos thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 44 /phyag na rdo rje/dze tu ri/rdo rje gdan pa che chung /ba ri lo tsā ba/rje btsun sa chen/slob dpon rin po che/rje btsun rin po che/sa paṇa/tshogs sgom pa/nyan chen pa/bla ma bsod nams skyabs/rje gzungs kyi dpal ba/dpal ldan tshul khrims/shar wo pa/ngor r+sā kun dga' bzang po/rje dpal ldan rdo rje/rje dkon cog tshul khrims/rje btsun sgo rum pa/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag zha lu pa/de bdag la'o//gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang ngam rig gtad legs par nos pa'i lung brgyud sogs/so'i sngags 'chang chen po snye mdo ba shākya dpal gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtsug gtor gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang ngam rig gtad legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo/gsang bdag phyag na 59brdo rje/slob dpon bsam gtan bstopa/mkhas pa tsan+d+ra go mi/slob dpon gi ra wa ti//ba dpon rdo rje rnon po/slob dpon pad+ma lcags kyu/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bram ze rin cen rdo rje/slob dpon dze tā ri pa/rdo rje gdan pa che wo ga snya/ba ri lo tsā ba/ldan ma kyu ra a skyabs/rje btsun brtse ba chen po/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/de la stod lung gad ser ba dang pho rog mdo sde mgon gnyis kyis gsan/gnyis ka nas khams pa rgan mo lhas pa byang chub dpal/bla ma ye shes rin cen/rje rin cen rgyal mtshan/bla ma cha rgan pa/bla ma grags chen pa/kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/sngags 'chang shākya dpal ba/rje dkon cog rgyal mtshan/cho so rje rgyal mtshan bkra shis/slob dpon dbang chen rgyal po/bla ma byang chub bzang po/mkhan chen rin cen kun ldan/rig 'dzin kun dga' don grub/dge steng bla ma byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas/rig 'dzin — po khra sgo pa blo mchog rdo rje/rdo rje la'i mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur rtsa ba'i bla ma kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na khams pa rgan lhas pa nas/'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/rong pa a snar/slob dpon dkon cog tshul khrims/bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/bla ma tshul rgyal ba/kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang /rje sangs rgyas rin cen/paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/mar ston sems dpa' chen po/rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun kun dga' bkra shis/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/brag dgon spyan snga gzhen 40na chos dpal bzang po/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//de yang snye mdo shākya dpal ba'i 'og tu mkhan chen bkra shis pa dang mkhan chen nam chos pa gnyis dge steng pa tshos mos gus brgyud par bgrangs pa las chos brgyud du med 'dug pas 'dir dkyus su ma bris/chos rje rgyal mtshan bkra shis shin tu mkhas pas bskul gyi zhing der dkyil 'khor re bris kyang 'theb pa 'dug gsung /kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pas chos gsan par bzhed de gdan drangs pas glang po che'i mche ba byi ba'i khar mi shong gsung ba sogs thugs nga rgyal ches skyon tsam byung bar grags/mkhas grub grags pa rin cen gyis mdza/zhe pa'i dkyil chog 'jug bde rab gsal gyi steng

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gnas 'phags pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri med pa lha lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rig gtad thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/thub pa'i dbang po/jo bo chen po a ti sha/nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/rong pa phyag sor ba/bshes gnyen bya yul pa/skar chung sbyin pa/gze pa don grub ye shes/khams pa shākya rdo rje/dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/thog ston shes rab rdo rje/meg ston grags pa 'od zer/bla chen grags pa rin cen/kun mkhyen nam mkha' 'od zer/chos rje nam mkha' tshul khrims/sku shad mkhyen rab chos rje/rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/rdo 40brje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/'jam dpal dbyangs chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//khyab bdag zha lu ba rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i gtsug tor dri med lha lnga'i chog khrigs rin cen bsam 'phel gyi lung ni mkhan chen nyid la bdag gis nos so//thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i dkyil chog 'chi med grub pa lhan thabs dang bcas pa'i steng nas 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i gzungs las gsungs pa'i thub pa'i dbang po lha bdun gyi rig gtad thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rje gzha sgo'i kha ba'i gas yig na bo: sa lhas mdzad pa'i ma rten brgya rtsabs las thag dab pa'i rjes sang dang lung zhes pa snang /thub pa'i dbang po/'jam dbyangs/mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/lha sras mu ba btsan po/sad na legs mjing yon/lha sras gtsang ma/ lha sras 'od srungs/mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/skyi lde nyi ma mgon/ khri bkra shis mgon/lha bla ma me shes 'od/lha btsun byang chub 'od/lha bla ma zhi ba 'od/mnga' bdag 'od sde/rtse lde/mnga' ris dgra bcom pa tshul khrims byang chub/zhu lhan pa/ra sa chu las pa/gro mo che pa/sangs rgyas sgom pa skyabs/mchims nam mkha' grags/tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/thug sra/sems dpa' chen po/sku zhang nam mkha' mchog

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()grub/bla ma rin cen don grub legs pa/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/drin can mkhyen rab chos rje/byang gling rin po che rin cen rgyal po/zha 41na ) lu ba rin cen bkra shis/gnubs sgom sbas pa'i rnal 'byor smon lam rgyal mtshan/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to//yang na mchims nas/mkhan zi/grags chen pa/'phags 'od/bu ston man 'dra/yang na jo bo rje/nag tsho lo tsā ba/rong pa phyag sor ba/'phan yul gu kha ba/shangs kyi rgya phug pa can/g.yag sde'i zhang ye shes rgyal mas/slob dpon dbang phyug rin cen/dbus pa sangs rgyas la bum/kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/'phags 'od yon to rgya mtsho/chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na dbang rgyun 'di chad par nye ba'i tshe byang gling rje la dbang thob cing lag len kyang bslabs nas chog dpon yun ring mdzad pa'i bsres por gyur pa'i zha lu pa rin cen bkra shis zer ba khungs chod nas/de la gnubs sgom gsan du bcug nas dbang rgyun 'phel bar byas gsung ba 'dug pa bstan pa rin po che kho na thugs la gcags pa'i rnam par thar pa la rjes su yi rang zhing dad pa'i gsos su gyur pa'o//dri med kyi dkyil chog kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i 'chi med grub pa dang thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs bklag cing mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad dam lnga gdab pa'i cho ga mdo sde las btus pa mchod 'bum gyi lung brgyud ni bu rin po che/thugs sras lo tsā ba/lce bzhi chos kyi rgyal po/bla ma don grub legs 91bsgo/mchod 'bum rgya skab 'di tshab tu mkhas pa 'a shrī 'jug pa ma gtogos gzhan wa'o//kun mkhyen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/mkhyen rab chos rje/chos rje dpon rgyal ba/rin cen 0 po yang zer/chos rje don grub rgyal mtshan/byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan drung kun dga' bkra shis/bla ma dkon cog rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//dbang gi skabs 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs kyi lung gnang ༷la 'dug pa ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang dbang dang

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gcig cing brgyud srol gzhan ni bka' 'gyur gyi skabs su gsal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'phags pa 'od zer dri med kyi gzungs nas gsungs pa'i srog shing 'thunas pa'i cho ga lag len bklags chog ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi bzhed pa ltar bkod pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nas/ 'dar chos 'khor yang rtse ba dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ dge slong 'a mo wo zer/ dge slong mkhas grub pa/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /mkhan chen zha lu pas mdzad pa'i 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil chog gi lhan thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa mun sel nyin byed snang ba/ des mdzad pa'i 'phags pa gtsug tor dri med kyi dkyil 'khor mchod rten du gzhug pa'i cho ga 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dpal ster zhes bya ba dang de'i cha mthun gyi rgyud 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil 'khor mchod rten du bzhugs su gsol nas srog shing 'dzugs pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa'i 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba thams 42na༄da mkhyen pa bu'i bzhed pa ltar gsal bar bkod pa gnyis yig cha gcig tu dril ba'i lung yang rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub la bdag gis nos so/ /rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i lung brgyud/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bstod mchod rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi steng nas gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ grub chen dze tu ri/ paṇa dar/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ga med/che chung gnyis/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ rgyal ba —87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()brag phug pa/ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/mtshudas med kun dga' bzang po/rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug/yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge/'jam dbyangs dan na cog lhun grub/shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/rje btsun brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang /sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/gnasagasar rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/desabadag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na lha mchog seng ge nas/sangs rgyas seng ge/thar rtse pa man 'dra/yang na ngor chen nas/mus chen sems dpa' chen po/kun mkhyen go bo/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/yang na sangs rgyas rin cen 42bshos/sa lo/dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/yang na mus chen nas/grub chen dkon cog blo gros/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/sa lo man 'dra/yang na ngor chen nas/mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/rje sangs rgyas rin cen man wa/yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/rje sangs rgyas seng ge/thar rtse pa man 'dra/yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/thar rtse pa man 'dra/yang na chos rje sa paṇa nas/shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/rin cen ye shes/glo chen sangs rgyas sras/brag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/bsam gtan lhun grub/glo bo lo tsā ba shrī māṃ bo dhi/'bri khung lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/sa bzang 'phags pa/ngor pa rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/yang na sa paṇa nas/shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/bla ma bkra shis 'od/'khon ston thugs rje rin cen/'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/spang khang pa grags pa dpal/spro lung pa kun smon/na bza' brag phug pa/chos rje bla ma dam pa/dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/yang na rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis nas/jo bo a ti sha/ba ri lotsā ba/gong ma lnga/snur ye shes rgyal mtshan/snur chos 'phags/gar thig pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/thel grag pa rdo rje/drung byang chub rdo rje/'jam dbyangs rin cen/mkhan chen zla ba blo gros/maX/ chen nyi ma ba/mkhan chen kun blo ba/paṇa chen

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ mar ston tshul khrims rin cen/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra 93na)shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ brag dgon spyan snga ba gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'cha pha bong kha pa/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /ring brgyud ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ 'di gsan yig gzhan na mi 'dug yo rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na snang ngo / /byams pa/thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ skal ldan grags pa/ shī la kā ra ma ti/ paṇ+ḍita be ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ ba ri lo tsā ba man 'dra/ dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi lung brgyud ni/ rje dkon cog lhun grub/ dbon dkon cog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rnam par rgyal ma'i bstod pa 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs kyi lung brgyud ni/ kun mkhyen bu ston/ sgra tshad pa rin rnam/lce nam mkha'i mtshan can/ bla ma don grub legs pa/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab rje/ dpon po rgyal po/ rje don grub rgyal po/ rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling bkra shis rgyalamatshan/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ rin po che dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'chi med dpal sbyin gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ 43brdo rje 'am pa kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge /mtshungs med sangs rgyas seng ge /brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang / mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /—89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang sogs kyi lung brgyud/slob dpon chen po a bha ā ka ra'i bzhed srol chag lo gsum pas mdzad pa'i sreg byed me'i mtshon cha'i yi ge'i steng nas dam pa'i phyag len ltar khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang dang /lung la lo rgyus/sgrub thabs dngos/spyir bzlog pa'i man ngag/byad chu bor bskyur ba dang bcas pa man ngag tu bsdebs pa'i sreg byed me'i mtshon cha chag lo gsum pa rin cen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/des mdzad pa'i bstod pa dpal mgon sangs rgyas ma dang bcas thob pa lasarjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/de bzhin gshegs pa swā la'i dbang po/sangs rgyas shākya seng ge/paṇa grub a bha wā ka ra/nga ga la'i paṇa chen sha rwa ka ra gu sa/de la kha che'i paṇ+ḍita brnya shrī dz+nyā na dang grub chen ā nan+da gu rtoganyis kyis zhus/gnyis ka la chag lo dgra bcom/de nas chag lo chos rje dpal/gtsang nag spug pa mkhan chen dbang phyug shes rab/chos rje dpal ba'i gdan sa pa yin/chags dbon bstan 'dzin dpal bzang /'dzag mon mkhas pa grub chen maṅga la shrī/ri ra'i ra rdzo du btsor gung lo brgya bsto/rje bas dpal ོ bzang po/chos rje ye shes dpal bzang /de la rgyal sras blo bzang dpal6ga'abyor dang rdo rje 'dzin pa chos skyong bzang po gnyis kyis gsan/yab sras gsum ga nas chag lo gsum pa rin cen chos rgyal/bla ma rin cen rgyal mchog/chos rdzong pa dge slong ngag dbang rnam rgyal/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag zha lu ba mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/lung gi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/des bdag la'o// 90

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma/rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/sgo rus pa man 'dra/yang na khro bo'i dbang po/grub r+ṣa 'od byed 'byung gnas/paṇa byu shākya shri bha dra/paṇ+ḍi ta dwa na shrī la man 'dra/nye brgyud ni/khro bo'i dbang po/paṇ+ḍita dwa na shrī la/de la sa paṇa dang 45na〉khyom ral gnyis kyis ga pa man 'dra/yang rjes gnang nye brgyud ni/khro bo'i dbang po/mkhas pa yon tan khri/mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/yar klungs pa mkhas grub seng ge rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen rgyal ba mchog/bdag wo 'jam dbyangs zhi po/bdag r+sā rdo rje lang /rje bsno rdo ring pa wo po/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/lung rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/mkhyen brtse'i zhabs nas/mchod dpon drung pa dkon cog/rje dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/yang lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/kun mkhyen g.yag pa yan gong ltar la/de nas slob dpon dpal ldan bzang po/paṇa chen shāka mchog man yang 'dra ba las rje mkhyen brtse'i rjes su drung pa dkon cog pa yod do//yang na kun mkhyen g.yag pa nas/rong ston shes bya kun rig khyu 'gul paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/glo bo mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/rje dkon cog rgya mtsho/mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/de sras bsod nams dbang phyug/rtsa ba'i bla ma zha lu mkhan chen/des bdag la'o//yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/shrī ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/sdom brtson sbyin pa grags pa/khri chen kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/shin tu nye brgyud ni/mi g.yo ba/g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma man 'dra/mi g.yo pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i zhag bdun thog zhal dkar nang du mo g.yo ba'i sku mtheb sor tsam pa mang po byung ba bgegs kyi sprul 65ba khor mkhyen na lhag med gsol bas thul zhing bcom ldan 'ad zhal gzig pa'i lo rgyus snang ngo //mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang dam pa'i phyag len 'khrul med ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/de bzhin gshegs pa/phyag na rdo rje/grub chen dze tā ri pa/rdo rje gdan pa mya ga med pa'i dpal/paṇ+ḍita don yod rdo rje/ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/mi/ gzha bu ba r+ṣa po/slob dpon bsod nams

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor cher kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ grub chen bsod nams seng ge /rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ bka' drin mnyam med zur rdo rje 'chang / des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga'i lung brgyud ni/ rtsom pa po/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ mkhan dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs sam chu bsrung gi rjes su gnang ba dam pa'i phyag len 'khrul pa med pa bzhin dang / de'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rtse mos mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri dgra 96na sgos rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ paṇ+ḍita a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'tsho / gu ge paṇ+ḍita/ glo bo mkhan ོ bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ gong dkar paṇa chen kun bzang rtse pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod na mas mchoge grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge /ngor pa sangs rgyas seng ge /rje kun dga' lung rig /sdom brtson sbyin pa grags pa/ sa skya khri chen man 'dra/ /—93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)dze ta ri'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang sogs kyi lung brgyud/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang gi steng nas dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba lugs kyi pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang / de'i sgrub thabs dbang chog bstod pa dze tā ris mdzad pa/ rje dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil gyi lung dang bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ grub wo dze tā slob)ri/ slob dpon byang tso bzang po/ slob dpon khi 'an bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ chung ba a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/ brtse chen snying po'i zhabs/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma bkra shis 'od/ e pa 'khon ston thugs rje rin ā+o/ 'jam dbyangs 'a po rin cen rgyal mtshan/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ spang khang pa grags pa dpal/ shas phogs nas gan don rigrags pa dpal zhes 'dug /spro lung pa kun dga' smon lam/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ de la bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang brag phug pa chung ba blo gros brtan pa gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka nas chosarje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtsen ma mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ rigs dang dkyila'akhor kun gyi khyab bdag gnas gsar pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bstsal to/ /—94

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg ba yodang po/ (ka)yang na ngor chen nas/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rgyal tsha ba kun dga' dbang phyug /dkon cog 'phel man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ rje dkon cog 'phel man 'dra/ yang na yongs 'dzin dkon 97na jog 'phel nas/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo/ rje kun dga' dpal ldan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na mus chen nas/ grub chen dkon cog blo gros/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ sa lo man gong bawo no/ /yang na lha mchog seng ge nas/ rkyang ngur rab 'byams pa dge legs bshes gnyen/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na ba ri lo tsā ba nas/ mjims brtson 'grus seng ge /rgya shad phug pa/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ gzhen nu 'bum/'di gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'dug kyang gas tshor mi snang ba pha 'dra/ bla ma cha gan pa/ grags pa dpal man 'dra/ yang na rgya zhang phug pa nas/ 'jang pa rin cen ye shes/ rje gzha btsong kha pa dang gong dkar ba'i gag yig na sher si zer spus ga /ye pa 'khon ston man 'dra/ yang na grags pa dpal nas/ chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin cen seng ge /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mo/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no/ /yang na gzhen nu 'bum nas/ gsal la ba/ grags chen pa/'phags 'od/ kun mkhyen bu ston man 'dra/ yang na mchims brtson khrus seng ge nas/ spug thamasacad mkhyen pa/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /kun mkhyen bu ston man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dpal ldan seng ge nas/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams 495 mtshan man 'dra/thugs sras sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog tshe dpal ye shes bsam grub kyi steng nas47bsgo gon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa 'chi med rnga sgra lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang 'chi glu dang bcas pa zha lu pa'i phyag len ltar legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ bo dhi bha dra/—95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonasam ti bha dra/rdo rje gdan pa/ba ri lo r+ṣa/mtshims brtson khrus seng ge/rgya zhang phug pa/'jad pa shes rab rin cen/e pa 'khon ston/shar pa 'jam dbyangs pa/bzhi thog pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/bla ma grags pa dpal/snar chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/yab sras gnyis ka la sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can/de nas chos rje rin cen dpal grub/thar rtse ba khang shar pa gsum gyi gsan mig na 'di mi 'dug kyang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig brgyud lugs gnyis kar 'dug pa chad 'dra/sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rgyal mtshan/bla ma rin cen rgya mtsho/zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na rje rin cen rgya mtsho nas/bla ma bkra shis rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag zha lu ba/des bdag la'o//yang na mkhyen rab rje/de la 'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mas dang sgog lung pa bkra shis dpal 'byor gnyis kyi gsan/gnyis ka la byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi gsan pa man 'dra/'chi blu ma sbyar ba'i dbang rkyang gi brgyud lugs gcig 98na8/byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan nas/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje las pa dbang phyug rab brtan/'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/rab mas chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/khyab bdag zha lu ba/des bdag la'o//yang na sku shad nam mkha'i mtshan can nas/mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/dka' bzhi pa rin cen mchog grub dpal 'bar/rgyal yum grub pa'i dbang po tshul khrimasabazang mo/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/yang na thugs sras nas/'ang ma dbyangasagrags pa rgyal mtshan/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan man 'dra/yang na ba ri lo tsā ba nas/brtse ba chen po/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mas/sa paṇa 'phags pa rin po che/lo tsā ba mchog ldan/lo 'a byang chub rtse mo/mkhan po bkra shis rin ceX6/mkhan r+ṣa seng ge dpal/brag thog pa bsod

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg bam dang po/ (ka)nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ mkhas grub rnam rgyal rin cen/ 'jam dbyangs dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ kun bzang rtse pa paṇa chen bsod nams mchog ldan/ khyab bdag zha lu ba/ desabadag la'o/ /yang na dbang phyug rgyal mtshan nas/ mkhas grub tshul khrims bkra shis/ rab 'byamasachos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag zha lu ba/ des bdag la'o/ /'chi med rnga sgra'i mngon dkyil dze tā ri'i rgya gzhung gi brgyud pa ni/ byang gling rje nas/ brang ti khu dbon/ mkhan chen zha lu ba/ des bdag la'o/ /dze tā ris mdzad pa'i bstod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ brgyud pa gong 447 rnams slar 'tshol/ saskya khri chen yab sras/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /dkyil chog tshe dpal ye shes bsam grub kyi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin cen dpal grub/ mkhyen rab rin cen mchog grub/ dbon rgyal ba/ 'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ drung pa kun dga' bkra shis/ bla ma dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gzungs las gsungs pa'i tshe dpag med dkar po grub chen mi tra dzo gi'i bzhed srol ltar chag lo gsum pas mdzad pa'i las dang po pa'i bya ba las byung ba'i yi ge'i steng nas rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ grub chen mi tra dzo gi /burnya shrī/ chag lo tsā ba dar ma dgra bcom/ grum ston dar ma shes rab/ sgrag phug pa shes rab dpal/ grub thob legs ldan 'od/ chos rje dpal chen bzang po/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug ye shes dpal bzang po/rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/ chag lo gsum pa rin cen chos rgyal/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /grub brnyes dbang phyug rab brtan/rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi bcangs pa tsam gyis skye ba dran pa'i gzungs sngags yig 'bru lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa byang sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe'i rang gzugs su grags pa thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo tsā 49na)ba chen —97—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pos bslab pa kun las btus pa'i lus bsrung ba'i sngags su bshad pa nyid/ drug cu rtsa bdun yin nam brtag /de'i rgya dpe las dngos su phyung ste dag par mdzad cing / lo rgyus yongs grags su lha'i dge bsnyen zhig gis sgra mi snyan nas dngos su blangs te dgra bcom pa blo gros dpal la gtad pa'i sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe gzungs la yig cha mi mthun pa sna tshogs 'dug pa las tshe dpag med lhung bzed bsnams pa'i mngon rtogs dang 'brel ba'i tshe dbang la bsdus pa paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa dang rgyas pa o rgyan chen pos 'bri khung dbus smyon la rmi lam du stsal pa gnyis las/ phyi ma ni rnying ma'i sdebs su yod la/ bsdus pa'i dbang dang sgrub thabs zab mo'i yang snying gi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/mgon po tshe dpag med/ dgra bcom pa blo gros 'phel/ paṇa chen nag rin/ 'brug pa rgyal dbang rje/bla ma sangs rgyas dpal ba/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / 'bri khung pa chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs/ de sras chos rgyal phun tshogs/ de sras chos kyi grags pa/ rig 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub/khyab bdag blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /paṇa ོ nags rin la tshe dbang shin tu zab pa zhig yod ces khrims khang lo tsā ba sogs kyi rnam thar du snang ba 'di nyid yin par mngon la/ 'di'i sku sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe dpag med ces kha byang btab cing / ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub dang shar pa kun dga' bkra shis yod pa'i bris thang mthong bas ngor phyogs la'ang rgyun zhig byung ba 'dra/ sgra mi 49bsnyan pa'i tshe sgrub de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i sgom bzlas dang bcas yod pa'i sgom lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ lha'i dge bsnyen/ dgra bcom pa blo gros dpal/ lo stong bzhugs/ bal po ha du tsan+d+ra/ lo lnga brgya btsos/ slob dpon dar ma grags/ lo nyis brgya tso/ mnga' ris pa dpal chen rgyal bgrub/ lo brgyad yi slebs nas kyang lus stobs sa du ma sgo ra/ slob dpon ye shes rgyal po/ lo sum brgya thub nyis brgya lon nas lha sal na gsum bskor/ slob dpon shes rab grags/ bsod nams mgon po/ kun mkhyen bu ston/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ bar 'dir bla ma 'ga' zhig ma rnyed/ de nas dge steng pa kun dga' dpal bzang / nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims ba po shis/ khyab bdag —98

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bka' 'gyur ba chen po/zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//lus srung ba'i man ngag ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung brgyud sogs/lus bsrung ba'i man ngag ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/thugs sras rin po che yan gong ltar la/de nas rje bkra shis rin cen/ngor pa rdo rje 'chang /mus chen sems dpa' chen po/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/'jam dbyangs sa lo/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/rje sangs rgyas seng ge/paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang /mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/de dpon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/rtsa ba'i bla ma zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//yang na dkon cog lhun grub la thar rtse pas gsan pa man 'dra/mngon rtogs kyi dmigs skor dang sngags kyi dag bya sogs shin tu zhib pa'i brgyud pa ni/slob dpon shes70nang ba grags nas/dz+nyā na sirnyi/slob dpon 3 ma'i bu'i gago yin/bla ma sangs rgyas grags/rdo rje rin cen/dka' bzhi pa dpal ldan grags pa/spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/paṇa chen shāka mchog/spyang lung gzhen nu chos grub/rje btsun grol mchog/rje kun dga' dpal bzang /paṇa chen tshe dbang don grub/'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje/des bdag la'o//phyi sgrub shākya thub pa/nang sgrub tshe dpag med dmar po/gsang sgrub dkar po yum bcas la brten pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa/sngags kyang 'dra min gnyis tsam yod pa zhig mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan las nos/brgyud pa bu ston rin po tshe yan wa/de man ma rnyed/la la dag gsang sgrub yumabacas sogs bla med lta bu nas bskangs pa'i lhad can yin nam zhes dpyad ga'i na mdzad/rang lus lcags kyi rdo rjer sgom pa gzuX sngags dang bcas pa'i gdams pa dpe lag tu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonagatad pa'i gtad lung zhig rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha par thob/ dkar chen lan bu a mir gsan gsung pa las brgyud pa gong ma byung / sgra mi snyan nas lha'i dge bsnyen gyi blangs te dgra bcom par gtad pa las ngag thog nas lung ma mdzad pas gtad lung las 'chad nyan gyi rgyun med 'dra gnang ba rnam pa gcig tu 'thad par mthong ngo / /ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyi grub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag po dpal mo lugs kyi 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes su gnang ba dang de'i yig cha rje dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad (70ba)pa'i lung dang bcas thob pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/'phags pa thugs rje chen po/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ ma paṇ+ḍita tsan+d+ra ku mā ra/ paṇ+ḍita shrī dz+nyā na bha dra/bal po paṇ+ḍita pe nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub thob nyi phug pa chos grags/ spru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ ngor 'a dang rdo rje gdan pa'i gas ga na sru pa tsherang /zhang ston dgra 'jigs mkhan chen/ rtse 'dul ba thugs rje byang chub/ mkhan chen bde ba can pa/ byang sems chu bzang ba byang chub 'bar/ rin po che shes rab 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal/ grub chen burnya shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge nas/ bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ lung brgyud ni/ dkon cog lhun grub/ thar rtsen ma mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen/ des bdag la'o/ /yig rnying gi steng nas bcu gcig zhal mkha' 'gro lnga dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spun ras gzigs/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ (71na)paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes bzang po/— 100

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)paṇ+ḍita zla ba gzhen nu/ rdzo bo a ti sha /lha btsun byang chub 'od/ bal po pe nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub thob nyi phug pa/ bshes gnyen grags pa ba/ klu sgrub mtshan can/ dka' bzhi pa shes rab/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin cen/ bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/ rje rin cen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin cen grub/ rje rgyal mtshan rin cen/ gnas rnying pa kun dga' bde legs rin cen rgyal mtshan/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ ra tsheg pa blo bzang e waṃ/ sras khang sngags rams pa bzang po rnam rgyal/ rdo rje lang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje bas chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ yang na spyan ras gzigs/ bi ku ṇi la sgyi ka ra/ tsan+d+ra kumā ra/ su dz+nya na/ bal po pe nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ nyin phug pa/ sru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ zhang ston dgra 'jigs/ 'jad pa rtse 'dul ba chen po/ mkhan chen ldog lhod pa/ mkhan chen chu bzang pa/bla ma shes rab 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ rin po che bsod nams bzang po/ rje bsod dar ba/dmar ston pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ gnas rnying chos rje kun dga' bde legs man 'dra/ tshal min mkhan chen gnyag dbon bsod nams bzang pos smyung gnas la nan tan du byed pa 'phags pa bsod nams dar gyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga'i lung brgyud ni/ gnyag dbon pa bzhugs pa'i brgyud pa bshad ma thag pa bzhin no/ /thugs rje chen po'i rigs gtad dang rjes gnang thob pa'i lung brgyud sogs/thugs rje chen (71ba)po skyer sgang lugs lha gsum ma'i rigs gtad thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ grub chen rā hu la gu lta badz+ra/ jo bo chen po di paṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā na/ nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba shes rab 'bar/ wa yu ba shes rab tshul khrims/—101

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lce sgom shes rab rdo rje/dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge/gto ston chos kyi shes rab/sbasapa'i go lor yang ra/chos rje ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge/mkhas ba shangs tshe yang ra/'gro mgon shangasaston tshul khrims 'bum/gnyan ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang mus chen sa mas dpal bzang yang ra/sngags 'chang rdo rje gzhen nu/mus mu nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/sems dpa' r+sā po dkon cog rgyal mas/kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/rdo rje 'amang tshar pa chos rje/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/paṇa chen ngag dbang chosagrags/yangs can mkhan po ngag dbang rnam rgyal/dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug/rdo rje 44 rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na shangasaston nas/mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/'jag chen byams pa dpal bzang /'jag pa blo grosadapal bzang /'jag chen kun dga'/rje chos rgyal dpal bzang /phrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/rdo ring rin po che man 'dra/yang na mus chen dkon cog rgyal mtshan nas/chos rje zur khang pa dpal ldan rin cen/rje btsun sgo dras pa kun dga' legs pa/kun 72namakhyen mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na mus chen dkon cog rgyal mtshan nas/yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/rje lha mchog seng ge/rje sangs rgyas seng ge khus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang /ngor sgrub khang pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don gru gamakhan chen zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//yang na mus chen nas/kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/dkon cog 'phel man 'dra/yang na mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang nas/bla ma nam mkha' dbang phyug khus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor man 'dra/spyan ras gzigs kyi mus chen sems dpa' chen po la dngos su gnang ba'i nye brgyud ltar na/'phags pa thugs rje chen po/sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no//yang na grub thob skyer sgang pa nas/mkhan po gsang ba shes rab/bkra shi bsod nams/mkhan chen bde ba dpal/dka' bzhi pa grags gzhen/mkhan chen bsod 0/ma grags pa/rgyal sras thog med pa/mo

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bzang 'phags pa/ngor wo kun dga' bzang po/rgyal sgo kun dga' dbang phyug/rje dkon cog 'phel man gong ltar ro//yang na shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum nas/khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ras chen sangs rgyas seng gegangs dkar ba rin cen/rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang /grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rgya sgom legs rgyal/rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog/rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang dkon cog legs pa/sgrub khang pa man 'dra//thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya 72bsgo tsho la chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos dngos su gnang ba'i thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas longs sku thugs rje wo po/sprul sku srong bzhi sgam po/yang sprul bsod nams rgya mtsho/rdo rje 44 pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/rigs kun khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//pad+ma'i rigs kyi yum seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang lung gsum gyis 'ong ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/sang rgyas/rje btsun sgrol ma/dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ga med pa'i dpal/chung ba don yod rdo rje/ba ri lo tsā ba/sa skya pa chen po/slob dpon rin po che/rje btsun rin po che/sa paṇ+ḍita/tsho gis sgom pa/nyan chen pa/bla ma bsod namasaskyabs/sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/shar chen me shes rgyal mas/ngor pa rdo rje lang /mus mu smos dpa' r+sā po/chos rje dpal ldan rin cen/rje gzha sgo dras pa r+sā po/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan chen zha lu ba chen po/des bdag hor ban+de la'o/yang na rje bas ma sgrol ma/jo bo wo po dpal mar me mdzad/'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/bshes gnyen po to ba/dge bshes sha ra ba/bya 'chad ka pa/skyer sgang pa/sa spras rgyas sgom pa/mchims nam mkha' grags/ze'u sku mched/mchims blo bzang grags pa/gro ston kun dga' 73na ) rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen /ba ba shes rab/kun mkhyen rong ston wo po//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ brag dkar ba sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor/ gnubs sgoms sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ smon lam rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man gong bzhin no/ /sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang legs par nos pa'i lung brgyud sogs/mnyam med jo bo chen po bod du 'byor pa'i dus phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi zhal 'don dang bcas rdo rje gdan du skor ba mdzad pa'i tshe rje btsun sgrol ma dngos su zhal mjal te bod du bzhud cig par lung bstan/ 'di la yi dam byas na bar chad mi 'byung zhes sho lo ka re dang las tshogs re sbyar nas gnang pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig la thog mar thams cad kyi gzhi seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma/1 dgra bgegs log 'dren gyi 'tshe ba zhi bar byed pa myur zhing dpa' ba'i sgrol ma/ 2 nad gdon bgegs sdig pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi bar byed pa ston ga'i zla ltar dkar ba'i sgrol ma/ 3 tshe dang longs spyod 'phel bar byed pa gser mdog can gyi sgrol ma/ 4 tshe lo bcu yang brgyar 'phel bar byed pa tshe 'phel sgrol ma ser mo/ 5 bud med sogs dmigs bya dbang du bya ba hūṃ sgra sgrog pa'i sgrol ma/ 6 dbang phyug lha dang sa bdag sogs dbang chen thams cad bran du byas nas 'byung po 'dul ba 'jig rten gsum rgyal sgrol ma/ 7 rig sngags kyi gnod pa dang rbod zor zlog par byed pa gzhan gyi 'brul 'khor 'joms pa'i sgrol ma/ 8 bdud dang dgra bgegs sgrol bar byed pa bdud dgra rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrol ma/ 9 (73ba'i di phyi'i gnod pa dang 'jigs pa thams cad srung ba phyag rgya dkon cog gsum mtshon sgrol ma/ 10 bdud dang mu stegs log lta can rnams dbang du bsdus nasabar gcod 'dul bar byed pa 'jig rten dbang mdzad sgrol ma/ 11 mkho dgu'i 'byor pa thams cad —104—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)spel te phongs pa las rnam par skyob pa 'gugs shing phongs pa sel ba'i sgrol ma/ 12 bkra shis shing dngos grub thams cad 'grub par byed pa bkra shis thams cad 'byin pa'i sgrol ma/ 13 bar gcod dgra bgegs rnams 'joms shing bsrung ba dang rengs par byed pa me ltar 'bar ba'i sgrol ma/ 14bgegs la rnam par bsnun pas bar gcod sel bar byed pa sgrol ma khro gnyer can ma/ 15 sdig sgrib bag chags mi gtsang ba rnams zhi bar byed pa sgrol ma zhi ba chen mo/ 16 gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi nus pa 'joms shing rang gi shes rab 'phel bar byed pa rig pa hūṃ las sgrol ma/ 17 gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gnon cing dgra dang chom rkun zhi bar byed pa 'jig rten gsum g.yo'i sgrol ma/ 18klu'i dug dang gnod pa thams cad las grol bar byed pa dug rnams rab tu zhi byed sgrol ma/ 19'thab rtsod dang btson du chud pa dang rmi lam ngan pa sogs duḥkha las thar bar byed pa sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i sgrol ma/ 20 rims nad dang yams thams cad zhi bar byed pa rims nad sel ba'i sgrol ma/ 21 zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dngos grub thams cad sbyin par byed pa 'phrin las yongs rdzogs sgrol ma rnams kyi rjes gnang legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma (74nasto|lam/jo bo chen po a ti sha /'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rgyal sras po to ba/ bshes gnyen sha ra ba/gtum ston dbang phyug grags/ bang ston shākya gzhen nu/ zla grags gsar ma ba/ chos rje shes rab dpal/ rong ston blo bzang grags pa/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ slob dpon skal bzang rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ drin can bla ma 'jam dbyangs chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na sha ra ba nas/bya 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rje/ skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas dgon pa ba/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ze'u sku mched/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ gnas rnying chos rje kun dga' bde legs/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho man gong bzhin no/ /yang na 'brom ston nas/ spyan snga tshul khrims — 105

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)mang (75na)po brtson khrus grags pa nas rim par brgyud de/ rigs 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje/ mnyam med rab 'byams chos rje/ sa skyong yug nor bu dbang rgyal/ chos rje dam pa bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ yug rab brtan dbang po/ gung ru dbyangs dpon po mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /sgrol ma'i sgo nas btson las thon pa'i man ngag nyi ma sbas pa'i gzhung la brten nas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i lung brgyud ni/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa nas rim par/ mkhyen rab rje/ dbon rgyal ba/ 'brog khang pa/ byang gling rje/ rje kun bkras pa/ rin po che dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /'jigs chen bcu drug las skyob pa'i ched du sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung brgyud ni/mdzad pa po/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa dang rjes gnang gi yi ge kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i steng nas rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma dkar mo spyan bdun yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma'i 'od zer drug sbrags kyi rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo/ paṇa grub ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa/ rje btsun ba ri lo tsā ba/ grub chen sle nag pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgre pa/ mnyam med sgam (75ba)po pa/ dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po/ sgom chung shes rab byang chub/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin pa/ rje 'bri khung gling pa/ rje dam chos gling pa/ bla ma chosakyi tshul khrims/ mnyam med lha lung pa/ thog gnas pa chen po/ lo pa spyan snga'i gsan yig tu yon gnas pa zer ba snang / bla ma chos kyi dbang phyug /'dren mchog byang chub bzang po/ kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ lo pa spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang / spang gzhongs ha ri kha pa dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ dwags po paṇa chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ paṇa bkras rnam pa'i sna tsha 'bras yul gyi dge bshes yin zhing gnyug la legs—107—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)bshad gling gi bla mar bskos nas karma 'phrin las su grags/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal to/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ de bdag la'o/ /yang na mkhyen brtse'i zhabs la/ mkhan chen bslab gsum pa/ dgon gsar pa bsod nams mchog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje gsum gyis gsan/ yab sras bzhi ka la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyisagasan no/ /yang na tshar chen nas/ bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen thar pa rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag (76na)la'o/ /yang yig cha de ga'i steng nas thun mong ba'i rjes gnang thob pa'ang bshad ma thag pa bzhin no/ /tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa'i steng nas nyams khrid zab mo smin rgyas dang de nyid kyi yig cha'i lung dang bcas nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan nas/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ rigs kun bdag po chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge /des mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi chog khrigs ngag 'don bklags/ (ka)chog tu bkod pa tshe dang bsod nams kyi nyi ma bdun 'bar/des mdzad pa'i tshe khrid skyabs (ka)yul zhing khams ma/ rje dbang rab kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i dpal ster/ bla ma(gi)brgyud pa'i lo rgyus sha dum 'thor gyi song yang 'gal ba med gsung pa'i mtha' can/ paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i sgrol dkar (ka)gyi sgo nas 'chi ba blu ba'i rtogs pa bsdus pa/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub (gi)thabs paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang lo tsā ba ba ris bsgyur ba/ yang sgrub thabs/ bum chog /gtor chog /sgom pa'i (sko)bsrung 'khor rnams chos— /08

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)tshan gcig tu byas pa/ bris pa'i bsrung (gi)'khor gyi gdams ngag yon tan dpag tu med pa/ bar chad zhi byed ltas (gi)ngan g.yang du len pa/ slob dpon pad+ma nag pos mdzad pa'i byad (gi)'grol ba ri'i 'gyur/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i (gi)gnas dang chom rkun bsrung (76ba)ba/ ce spyang sngon (gi)mo'i lam bsrung las rtags med pa rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ bslab gsum rje/ khyab bdag dbang rab/ rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /ga'i rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ mchod dpon drung pa dkon cog /rje dbang rab man 'dra/ zhi'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje dbang rab nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ mkhan dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /ltas ngan g.yang len lugs gcig la/dbang rab nas/ bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ zha lu pa/ des bdag go /sgrol ma'i man ngag lha mo shra ma ṇa'i sgrub thabs kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ shar pa ye 'byung / shar pa kun dga' seng ge /seng ge rgyal mtshan/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ shes rab rdo rje/ grags pa rdo rje/ grags pa don grub/ grub chen ri khrod pa shar dwags po'i paṇa chen bkra shisarnam rgyal/ yongs 'dzin bde legs bzang po/ chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rje bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'changs sangs rgyas rin cen/bco brgyad chos rje mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhas grub byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/mkhas dbang 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ khyab bdag zha lu ba/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /— 109—
