rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo bka' babs dgu dang ldan pa'i rjes gnang gi lung brgyud/sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo bka' (77na thabs dgu dang ldan pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa la bka' babs dang po jo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ ngag gi dbang phyugamagon po gser gling pa/ jo bo rje a ti sha /'brom ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od/ dwagasapo lha rje/ bsod nams rin cen/ shad gsum thog pa/ zhang bka' stsal pa/ bla ma lha/ slob dpon rin cen bzang po/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo rin cen chos kyi rgyal po/ khra ri ba rin cen rgyal mchog /kun mkhyen rdzong dkar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ bka' drin mnyam med mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan/ desabadag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na mkhan chen bde ba dpal nas/ dka' bzhi ba grags pa gzhen nu/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na spyan snga pa chen po nas/ dge bshes sgre pa/ sgam po bsod nams rin cen/ phag mo gru pa/ nye gnas stag lung thang pa/ bla ma ba lam pa/ slob dpon tshal pa/ slob dpon shākya gzhen nu/ don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin cen/ rtsegs pa bsod nams rdo rje/ma ti pha la/ gtsang pa blo bzang zer yang skad dod la dpags na blo gros bzang po thob pa 'dra/ bla ma rang grol lhun grub/ mtshungs (77ba thad nam mkha' blo gros/ chag lo rin cen chos rgyal man 'dra/yang na sgam po pa nas/ lho la yag pa/ slob dpon brtan pa/ slob dpon tshal pa ba/ slob dpon shākya —110

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gzhen nu man 'dra/yang na slob dpon shākya gzhen nas shangs pa grags pa seng ge/bla ma mgon rgyal ba/mkha' spyod dbang po/'khrul zhig bsod nams 'bum/bla ma rgyal mtshan/zhwa dmar bzhi pa spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa/chag lo man 'dra/yang na spyan snga ba nas/bya yul ba gzhen nu 'od/dge bshes sle nag pa/bshes gar+sā sgre pa/dwags po zla 'od ga smo nu man tsā/yang na zla 'od ga smo nu nas/dus gsum mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa/khams pa dbu se/khams pa dbang phyug rdo rje/bla ma dbang phyug seng ge/khams pa bya bral ba/bla ma shes rab gzhen nu/spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po/de gnyis ka la ri khrod pa gzhen nu rgyal mas/de nas ras wo gzhen nu dpal/grub chen sangs rgyas rin cen/de la sgo rum pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang kun dga' rgya mtsho gnyis kyis gsan/gnyis ka nas rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/yang na chos rje bla ma dam pa yan gong ltar la/de nas ri khrod pa ga smo nu rgyal mas man gong bzhi no//yang na bla ma dam pa nas/bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/bdag r+ṣa rdo rje 44 blo gros rgyal mas/chos rje sangs rgyas dpal/rje bas sgo wo pa man 'dra/yang na bdag r+ṣa rdo rje lang nas/rje gzha 78na rdo ring pa 'a po/'a wo chos kyi rgyal po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas/lo chen byang chub rtse mo/lo wo grags pa rgyal tsho/bo dong paṇa ོ phyogs las rnam rgyal/stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/chos rje 'chi med dpal bzang /mkhas mchogo sangs rgyas lhun grub/bo dong sngags ram pa yon tan rgya mtsho/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na chag lo rin cen chos rgyal nas/rje bshes gnyen bkra shis/grub pa'i khyu mchog dge slong ngag dbang rnam rgyal/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na bla ma dam pa nas/rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/shar ba ye shes rgyal mtshan/rje kun dga' bzang po/rgyal tshab kun dbang /glo bo mkhan chen legs 'byung /rje kun dga' grol mchog/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man gong bzhin no//yang na ngor chen nas/mus chen sems dpa'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()wo po/paṇa wo chos rin dpal ba/rje blo gros rgya mtsho thugs rje can rin cen bzang po/sngagasa'achang kun dga' bsod nams/sngags 'chang dkon cog legs 'dzin/sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag la'o//yang na bya yul ba gzhen nu 'od nas/dge bshes 'chad ka ba/skyer sgang ba chos kyi seng ge/sangs rgyas sgom pa/mchims nam mkha' grags/skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/rgyang ro byang chub 'bum/mchims 78ba ) blo bzang grags pa/gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/dbang ston grub pa shes rab/spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/spyang lung pa gzhon nu mchog grub/rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog/rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang dkon cog legs 'dzin man 'dra/yang na bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal nas/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/de nas bla ma gsum tsam zhig ma rnyed/de nas mkhan chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel/de gnyis ka la bdag gis zhus/nye brgyud ni/rje btsun sgrol mas mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho la dngos su gnang zhing bstod pa sho lo ka gang mang rtsoms shig de'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshe'i dngos grub ster bar zhal gyis 'ches pa bzhin rje btsun mar bstod pa brtsams pas dgung lo brgyar nye ba bzhugs/de la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos gsan no//bka' babs gnyis pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/rje btsun sgrol ma/paṇa chen grub wā gi shwa ra/rdo rje gdan pa/ba ri lo tsā ba/rje bas brtse ba r+sā po/slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita/'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che/zhang dkon cog dpal/rgyal ba brag phug pa/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/rje btsun dpal chen bzang po/chos rje ye shes dpal bzang /chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/khra ri ba rin wo rgyal79na ) mchog/rdzong dkar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man sngar ltar ro//

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gzhan yang jo bo lugs kyi skabs smos pa'i bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan brgyud par bzhugs phyin de man chad 'dir yang bgrangs chog go /bka' babs gsum pa paṇa chen lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan wo kun dga' blo gros/ chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba man gong bzhi no/ /yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/mtshungs med nam mkha' blo gros/ chag lo khra ri ba man 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen shākya shrī nas/ paṇa chen dā na shī la/ tsang thang pa/ bla ma ka pa ba/ rtogs ldan grags seng / g.ya' bzang pa bsod nams 'od/bsod nams rdo rje/ gtsang pa blo bzang pa/ rang grol lhun grub/ nam mkha' blo gros/ chag lo/ khra ri ba man 'dra/ 'dir ma zad mkhan chen byang chub dpal brgyud par bzhugs phyin de man chad 'dir yang bgrangs chog go /bka' babs bzhi pa a bha yā ka ra lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra/ shu : ka ru gup+ta/ legs spyod 'byung gnas/ ran+ta ra sti ta/ go snya shrī/ gī (79brta tsan+d+ra/lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rong pa shes rab seng ge /bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen rin cen 'phel/ bla ma ye shes 'phel/ rje kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma byang seng pa/ rgya ma ba yon to 'od/ shang dkar ba rin cen rgyal mtshan/ skungs lung pa sangasargyas dpal/ rje 'phags pa rin cen/ chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba man 'dra/ /bka' babs lnga pa gnyan lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇ+ḍita ma ti/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sa chen man 'dra/ sa chen brgyud par bzhugs phyin de man gyi brgyud pa rnams tshang ma ded chog /— 1/3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bka' babs drug pa dpyal gyi brgyud pa ni/rje btsun sgrol ma/rdo rje gdan pa ni ska lo ka/dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/dpyal a mo gha/mkhan ོ gzhon nu dpal ye shes/thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/rje btsun da pa la r+sā bzang po/rje ye shes dpal bzang /chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/khrag ri ba rin cen rgyal mchog man 'dra/bu ston rin po che brgyud par bzhugs phyin de man gyi brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyang bgrangs chog/bka' babs bdun pa rngog lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/rje btsun sgrol ma/ngag dbang grags pa/mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros/rngog chos sku rdo rje/rngog mdo sde/rngog kun dga'/rngog gzi brjed grags pa/rngog rin la bzang po/rngog chos kyi rgyal mas/gnag ra ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/80narngog byang chub dpal/byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba/lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/zhwa dmar bzhi pa spyan snga chos kyi grags pa/chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/khra ri ba man 'dra//bka' babs brgyad pa sgar lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/rje btsun sgrol ma/rkadze pa rol pa'i rdo rje/rje mkha' spyod dbang po/skadze pa de bzhin gshegs pa/mkhas grub bsod nams 'bum/slob dpon rin po che bla ma rgyal mtshan/zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/khra ri ba man 'dra/bka' babs dgu pa nags rin lugs ni/rje btsun sgrol ma/paṇ+ḍita ngag dbang grags pa/paṇa chen nags kyi rin cen//chos rje kun dga' mchog grub/rje btsun kun dga' grol mchogachos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang dkon cog legs 'dzin/mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/shar r+ṣa shes rab 'byung gnas/rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod na mas mchoge grub/des bdag za sto brnye la'o// 4

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gong dkar lugs kyi sgrol dkar gyi tshe 'khrid rgyun khyer nyams khrid sogs kyi lung brgyud/gong dkar lugs kyi sgrol dkar gyi tshe 'khrid rgyun khyer nyams khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgron ma/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ rgyal ba 'brom/ spyan snga ba/ dge bshes sle nag pa/ dge bshes sgre pa/ sgam po pa bsod nams rin cen/ dbu se dus mkhyen/ khams pa dbang rdor/ dbang phyug seng ge /khams pa bya bral ba/bla ma shes rab (80ba gzhon nu/ spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po/ de gnyis la ri khrod gawo nu rgyal mtshan dang ras chen gzhen nu dpal ldan gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka nas rje grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje rnam rgyal mgon po/ mkhas grub rnam rgya wa rin cen/ bla ma shākya kun dga'/ rje dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/mkhas grub nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ rab stims chas rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ rigs kun khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /'phan yul lan pa'i spyil bur dpal mar me mdzad la dran kha dpal yon gyis mtho 'tshams pa'i tshe pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bor gtogs pa rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi sgo nas btul ba sogs byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che bar grags pa'i rjes su gnang ba gzhan ma'i rgyas bkab ma yin pa'i gong ma'i yig rnying steng nas phyag len 'khrul med du nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rta mgrin/ yum gsang ba ye shes shā gi ma/ slob dpon sangs rgyas zhi ba/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku swā li che chung gnyis/ jo bo chen po di paṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā na/ yol grub thob chos dbang / mtha' bzhi grub thob/ rin cen smon lam pa/ rin po che lam pa/ bla ma ye shes 'od/ slob dpon legs pa shes rab/ bla ma byang chub rin cen/ slob dpon byang chub/ gzhen nu 'od/ mkhan chen byams pa rin cen/ mkhas btsun byang —115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/ spyan snga ba bsod nams lha dbang / rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ lo (81na)pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ bdag chen ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ de bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /yang na dang po'i sangs rgyas/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ dge slong ma dpal gyi bzang mo/ slob dpon ye shes bzang po/ jo bo r+ṣa po man 'dra/ /byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi zhal gzigs ma'i dpal rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can zla rgyal lugs su grags pa'i yig rnying dang phyag len la brten nas rjes gnang dang / lung la/ sgrub thabs/ nad pa gso ba/ steng gdon gzir ba/ lus bsrung ba/ ser ba bsrung ba/ phyir bzlog pa rjes gnang gi yi ge dang bcas pa legs par thob pa las rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ dpal rta mgrin/byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ zhang skyi tsha 'od chen/ zhang dbu dkar ba/ zhang lo tsā ba/ zhang byang chub rin cen/ dpal rgyal ba grub/ 'dzims pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ sgrub pa po bla ma rin cen brtson tsos chen po/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge /sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor pa rdo rje la4 / kho phyar mkhan wo bsod nams rgyal mas/ kun ma' go bo rab 'byams pa/ mkhan chen rat+na shī la/ rje btsun sgo dras pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod namasamachog ldan/ bka' drin mnyam med 'jam dbyangs chos dbyings rang (81ba)grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na shad byang chub rin cen nas/ lce ston sangs rgyas dpal/ brag ston tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ byang sems shes rab rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge legs dpal bzang / ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas/ rje chos grags bzang po/brag dgon spyan snga ba gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/—116

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rje chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /lung gi brgyud pa ni/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan yan rjes gnang ltar las/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen yan gong ltar la/ de nas rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas dpal jo bo di paṃ kā ras yol chos dbang la gnang ba'i rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa gshog pa can jo lugs su grags pa'i rjes gnang nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo chen po a ti sha /yol grub thob chos dbang / mtha' bzhi grub thob/ rin cen smon lam/ rin cen lam pa/ lha ye shes 'od/ slob dpon legs pa shes rab/ byang chub rin cen/ byang chub gzhen nu/ mkhan byams pa rin cen/ (82na7khas btsun byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa ga 'an nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇ+ḍita grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen legs 'byung / rje lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyasaseng ge thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rje lha mchog seng ge nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse pa man 'dra/thar rtse pas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i lung ni/ thar rtse khu dbon/ mkhan dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro mo ri khrod lo ma gyon pa'i rjes gnang lung gsum gyi chings ldan thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ grub chen dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i —117—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)dpal/ chung ba a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/ rje btsun brtseb chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje paṇa chen/ shar ba shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/rin cen ye shes/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/ bla ma bsam gtan lhun grub/ lo tsā ba dpal ldan byang chub/ 'bri gung lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shri dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur pa bsod nams seng ge/rdo rje (82ba'i chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod na mas mchogo grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ e waṃ pa dkon cog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen legs 'byung / 'jam dbyangs sa lo/ rje dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel man 'dra/ yang na yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel nas/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang /sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa sher 'byung man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ /—118—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang gi lung brgyud sogs/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba rnams phyi rol pa'i lha'i gzugs dang rtags dang mtshan mas 'dul bar dgongs nas lha thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dbang phyug sogs phyi rol pa'i lha rnams sku'i cha shas nas byung ba'i skabs dbyangs can ma mche ba las phyung bar bshad cing nges pa'i don du dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum (83na 'khog ma yin la/ de yang rigs mang du yod pa'i nang nas shesarab bskyed pa'i lhag pa'i lha pad+ma'i rigs kyi pho nya mo ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes su gnang ba slob dpon dpe med rgya mtsho chen po dang sum pa lo tsā ba'i bzhed srol dam pa'i phyag len 'khrul med bzhin legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma/ bram ze phur bu/ bram ze tsaṇ+ḍa ka /thar rtse bdang shar pa'i ga3 yig na gtso po bde r+ṣa zhes 'di gnyis gcig tu mdzad khrug kyang ngor 'dang mkho bu'i ga yin so sor snang ro / /bram ze bde chen/ bram ze mchod sdong / thar mu dang shar ba'i ga yig na 'di ga gis gi tu 2ga kyang ngor r+sā dang di bu'i gas yig na 'di ltar snang ngo / /slob dpon seng ge /nye ba'i seng ge /ngor mu gyi gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung zhing 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na lku ba ji zhes rgya skad sor bzhag bris 'dug thar rtse dang shar pa sog gsan yig mang por nyi ma seng ge zer ba 'dug pa yig skyon shor ram snyam/ dpe med 'tsho chen po/ ngor r+sā gyi gas yig 'di ba ca wo mkhyen bu'i gas yig na dpe med rgya mtsho mu po zhes snang ba don gcig pa cu/ thar rtse pa dang shar pa'i gsan yig na dpe med rgya mtsho mu po so sor phral 'dug pa yig nor byung smo snyam/ sum pa lo tsā ba dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje/ kun dga' bla ma/ spyi bo lha thar mu dang shar pheg ga gan byang tso bde zer ba 2ga kyang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gas thor 'di bzhi snang ba lo rgyu sogs dang mas pa/ byang chub 'od/— 119

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dam pa shes rab/gru rdo rje seng ge/bu ston seng ge 'od/lha ga smo nu 'bum/lo tsā ba rin cen rnam rgyal/bla ma 83bajol pa'i rdo rje/tso pa dang char+sāg/mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī/sku zhab mkhyen rab chos rje/thams cad mkhyen pa lo ོ chos skyong bzang po/sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ngor r+ṣa dkon cog lhun grub/shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang /shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/drin can bla ma rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag la bka' drin du stsal to//rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍita sa man+ta shrīs thugs sras lo tsā ba la gnang ba'i rgya gar paṇa chen gyi phyag len 'khrul pa med pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ngag dbang dbyangs can ma/des rjes su bzung ba'i rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī dz+nyā na bha dra mu ni spro/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man ta shrī/sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/bla ma rol pa'i rdo rje man gong dang 'dra//thugs sras lo tsā bas paṇ+ḍi 'a gsung bzhi bkod pa'i rjesaganang gi yig cha'i lung ni/thugs sras lotsā ba/lce nam mkha' chos kyi rgyal po/gang4ne rol rna rje/mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/byang gling pa rin r+ṣa rgyal po/chos rje don grub rgyal mas/byang gling ma la dbyangs ba po shis rgyal ma/rje kun dga' bkra shis/rje dkon cog rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag zha lu ba/des bdag la'o//sum pa lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang dang sgrub skor gyi lung brgyud sogs/yang sum pa lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang dang /sgrub skor la/sgrub thabs dngos/zhan byung rmi ltas/gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa/84na ) thun mong ba'i gegs sel la/'phrin las 'chol ba/grib sel ba/ting nge 'dzin 0 'dod chags sel ba/smyo 'bog sel ba/'di

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)las zab pa med pa'i gegs sel/ rtags med na spogs cho go /rdzas kyi chags gegs sel ba/ nor rgyun ma'i phrag dog sel ba rigs gsum/ lha mo dpal mo'i phrag dog sel ba rigs gsum dang bcas pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gegs sel la/ ting nge 'dzin la brten na shes rab 'phel zhing mi 'grib pa/ phongs pa sel ba/ chags pa sel ba/ snying rlung sel ba rnams sbyin sreg gi cho ga /rtsod pa las rgyal ba/ bsgrub bya dbang du bya ba/ byis pa blo rno bar byed pa/ ril bu'i sbyor ba/ dam tshig me long la brten pa'i zhal shes dang bcas pa bram ze phur bus mdzad pa'i yi ge sogs gzhung man ngag las 'jam dbyangs smon lam dpal ba dang paṇ+ḍi ta phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gsung bzhin bkod pa'i lung dang bcas legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ lo tsā ba rin cen rnam rgyal yan ring brgyud ltar la/ de nas bla ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rje tshul khrims dpal bzang / rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ chos rje dpal ldan seng ge /'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'byor/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rje thub bstan pa/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang / brag dgon spyan snga gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha (84ba)bong kha pa snang mdzad rdo rje/ rtsa ba'i bla ma zur 'jam dbyangs chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /sgrub thabs/ spogs chog /rtags/ rtsod pa rgyal ba/ dbang sdud/ dug sel/ byis pa blo rno bar byed pa/ khams 'dus sel ba rnams man ngag tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa bo dong pa bi dza yas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs lhug /man ngag bying ba/ rgod pa/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / mi dga' ba/ sdug bsngal sogs gegs sel sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ des mdzad pa'i tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pa rgyan gyi 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od yan sngar ltar la/ de nas 'dzim pa mgon po zla ba'i 'od/ lho pa rin cen grags/—121—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'dzims mkhan chen bde gshegs/'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal/kun spangs chos grags dpal/sabazang ma ti paṇa chen/lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/glang thang spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//yang na dbyangs can ma/paṇ+ḍi ta shī la ā kwa ra/tsan+d+ra shī/go snya shwe/thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/lo chen byang chub rtse mo/lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan man 'dra//thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i 85ri thabs rjes gnang gi kha skong dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud ni/shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar la/de nas paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang /shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/sgrub khang dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//bram ze phur bus mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ngag gi 'od zer/drang srong mngon shes can gyis mdzad pa'i las sbyor gyi rtsa ba/dpal ldan bsam yas pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs gegs sel las sbyor dang bcas pa le'u bzhi pa 'od kyi dra ba/bstod pa gzhen nu rol dga' dang bcas pa rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/sum pa lo tsā ba yan gong ltar la/de nas bla brang pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/kun mkhyen klong chen pa/mkhas grub chos rje/sangs rgyas dbon po/kun spangs sems dpa' chen po/bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/dzo mig pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/rtsen bsod nams rnam rgyal/rtse le o rgyan bstan 'dzin/rigs 'dzin mthu stobasarnam rgyal/rje pad+ma dbang chen/sdom brtson rin cen dar rgyas/rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/sprul pa'i sku mchog gter bdag gling pa/des ba// la'o//

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mi 'khrugs pa lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nos pa'i lung brgyud/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog las sgrib rnam sbyong gi steng nas rdo rje'i rigs kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs(85ba)pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ dz+nyā na gar+bha/ dz+nyā na shān+ta/ burnya shān+ta ngor r+ṣa gong dkar mkhyen brtsegasum gyi gsan mig na 'dug rung thar rtse pa dang shar pa'i gsan yig tu mi snang ba chad pa 'dra/ burnya gu ༅ / ku su li che chung gnyis/ su war+ṇa dī ba dharma kirti/ dpal di paṃ kā ra/ go mi sgom chen/ kyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyag sdom bu ba/ spug thams cad mkhyen pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na chos kyi tog zer ba 'dug ba tog gi skad dod ke tu rgyal mtshan la'ang 'jug par dgongs sam snyam/ bya rin cen 'od/ bla ma bya nag r+ṣa po/ slo chen sangs rgyas sras/ mnga' ri slo bo pa yin/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dbang yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/ zur rigs kun bdag po chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan nas/ rje lha mchog seng ge /sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog 'phel nas/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse pa man gong bzhin no/ /yang na jo bo chen po nas/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun —123

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)sa chen/ slob dpon rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ snur ye shes rgyal mtshan/ snur chos 'phags/ gar thig pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen (86na〉ges rab rdo rje/ thel chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ thel mkhan po grags rdor ba/ drung byang chub rdo rje/'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba/ mkhan chen zla blo pa/ mkhan chen nyi ma/ mkhan chen kun blo ba/ paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ mar ston sems dpa' chen po/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za sto ban+de la'o/ /yang na rdo rje 44 / phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che wo / jo bo rje man 'dra/rdo rje rnam 'joms dkar po lha bcu dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang nos pa'i lung brgyud sogs/rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil gyi steng nas rdo rje rigs kyi bdag po grub chen sa wa ri pa lugs kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dkar po lha bcu dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can/ grub chen sa wa ri pa/ dza wa ri pa/ de wa pu rna ma ti/ 'gar lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ gshen ston rin cen dngos grub/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sgang ston shes rab bla ma/ sgang ston shes rab 'bum/ gragasapa rdo rje/ dar ma byang chub/ yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin cen/ thugasasras sems dpa' chen po/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhas pa bsod nams 'phel/—124

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)byang sems rin cen chos dpal/mkhan chen rin cen rgyal po/bla chen chos rig rgyal mtshan/slob dpon bsod nams dpal 86ba7khyor/'jam dbyangs byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan/mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang /bco brgyad chos rje mchog legs rdo rje/rje mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/bco brgyad pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug lhun grub/dge slong 'phrin las rnam rgyal/khyab bdag zha lu ba chen po/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas ba ri lugs kyi rnam 'joms ljang sngon lha gcig pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas/phyag na rdo rje/slob dpon dze tā ri/rdo rje gdan pa che chung /ba ri lo tsā ba/brtse ba chen po/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/rje sapaṇa/'phags pa rin po che/bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug/bla ma rin cen dpal/bla ma byang chub gzhen nu/mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/rje btsun ngor chen/mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge/rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/drin can bla ma zur thams cad mkhyen pa/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang bkru byab bsrung gsum dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba nas/mkhan chen zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//yang rjes gnang rkyang pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/'phags pa rin po che nas/'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge/ba ri phug pa shākya seng ge/bla ma sdings pa dbang rgyal/sa bzang paṇa chen 87na ) rin po che rgyal dbang pa/bla ma yon to dpal/rong ston blo bzang grags pa/sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/bar 'dir bla ma gcig gnyis shig hor khongs su lus/go pa don grub rtsa44na li na nas ༅ ga/de nasasku zhang rin cen bkra shis/rje rin cen rgya mtsho/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/snur ye shes rgyal mtshan/snar chos 'phags/gar thig pa seng ge rgyal

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonams/mkha shes tha rdo rje/thel chos sgo ba/thel grags rdor ba/byang rdor ba/wom dbyangs gi cen/mkhan chen zla blo/mkhan chen nyi ma/mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/mar ston tshul khrims rin cen/rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun bkra shis/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod namasargya mtsho/brag dgon spyan snga ga smo nu chos dpal bzang po/'bon ston rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o/yang rjes gnang dang rje dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bum chog rjes gnang bcas tshang ba'i yi ge'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ lung 'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang lag༅ dag kyang /des dkon lhun grub la gas nam gas la gas khungs ma ra/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//dpal phyag na rdo rje lha bcu bdun gyi dbang legs par nos pa'i lung brgyud/zha lu pa shar chen ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gsang ba nor bu'i gter mdzod kyi steng nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs kyi dpal phyag na rdo rje 87ba po bcu bdun gyi dbang legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /phyag na rdo rje/spyod mdzad chog kyi rdo rje/dpal ldan kun tu bzang po/slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/kha che rin cen rdo rje/bram ze sadz+dza na/jo bo te dza de wa/zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/g.yor po jo r+sā/bur bsod nams rin cen/gra dol gyi mtshams nas ba zer ba zhig 'dug pa de na yin pa chog khrigs dngos grub 'dod 'jor gsal/'byed phu ba pad+ma bkra shis/lha rje stag pa jo bzang /gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug/khro phu rin cen bsod nams seng ge/yang rtseb rin cen seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos rje/thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/chos rgyal nam

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin cen dpal grub/ sku shad mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ bka' drin mnyam med khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na mkhyen rab rje/ de la lcags sgos lung ba bkra shis dpal sgo r+sā gyi lam yig kusu lu rigs bla ma lam du mjal gsungs pa de yin/ 'byor dang 'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka nas 'jam dbyangs byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang kha che rin chen rdo rje nas/ kha che'i dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/zhu don sa skya pa/ rje btsun grags pa seng ge rgya (88na skon sgrub pa po/ rgya ston grub mchog /bla ma rje dpal/ khro bu ba sems dpa' chen po man 'dra/ yang na khro bu ba nas/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ kun mkhyen bu man 'dra/ yang na grub mchog pa nas/ dpal sang pa/ sprul sku rgyal tsha/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan seng ge man gong ltar ro/ yang na rdo rje dpal nas/ gzhen nu seng ge /brag ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de sras kun mkhyen bu ston man 'dra/ spyir chu yi dbang bskur dbu rgyan dag /bya ba'i rgyu la rab tu grags/ zhes gsungs kyang dmigs kyis bsal ba bya rgyud kyi cho ga chung ba rgya gar nas bsgyur ba 'ga' dang 'di nyid kyi dkyil chog bzhir slob ma'i dbang lnga phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang dang bcas pa mdzad mod rnal 'byor rgyud du 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi rnam sras rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas gong gnon phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang dang / lung la/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po te dza de wa dang lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyi bsgyur ba/ thun 'tshams su gtor ma btang nas thog ma dang mtha' mar mchod par bya ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ sreg pa'i sgo nas tshar gcod pa slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa mkhan po te dza de wa dang lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'khrul 'khor bcing ba zhes pa rdzas dang — 127

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sngags dang sman gyi 'khrul 'khor rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ chu po'i gzhung la gtong ba bskrad pa'i 'khrul 'khor/ bgegs (88bsgo bsnun pa'i 'khrul 'khor/ bum pa la brten nas khro bo'i rgyal po'i khrus kyi cho ga rnams/ sgrub thabs dang sbyin sreg ma gtogs par 'gyur byang mi 'dug rung thams cad 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa yin la/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na ba thabs kyi spyi don/ sgrub thabs/ bum chog/'khrula'akhor/ gtor chog /sbyin sreg rnams kyi ṭīk+ka 'dug kyang dpe ma 'byor bas lung ma thob/ rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje yan bshad ma thag pa ltar la/ de la rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po dang sgos lung pa bkra shis dpal 'byor gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la tshar chen rdo rje 'chang / de nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/ de dbon sku zhang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub dpal bzang / byang gling 'jam dpal rin cen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / de la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ de nas zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ yab sras gnyis ka la khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ de la rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs chos dbyings rang grol gyis gsan/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ dhu tī pa/ jo bo rje/ lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge /rong ba 'gar dge /'dzad gyang phu ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇ+ḍita/ rgyal tsha chos kyi dbang phyug /rong pa shes rab seng ge /bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bram nam mkha' (89na)rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyan mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ grub wo dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje tsho man 'dra/ lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje nas/ rje bcun bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang — 128

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dbang phyug rab brtan/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /rje sgo rum pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dang brgyud pa'i phyag len la brten nas phyag na rdo rje u tsarla'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'jam dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra go mi/ rgyal po dharma pa la/ bla ma zangs gling pa/ khams pa a sing / jo sras gnyal pa rin cen 'od/ bla ma bya nag yin pa 'dra/ bla chen dkon cog rgya mtsho/ jo sras me 'bar/ bla ma don zhags pa/ rje mkhyen brtses sgo sum par gsan pa'i thor ston grags zhor ba zhes 'dug pa 'di dang gcig mi gcig brtag /bla ma lha rje/ byams pa che ba/ mkhan po rin cen rdo rje/ zur phug pa rin cen dpal bzang / ri khrod pa gzhen nu rgyal mtshan/ ras chen gzhen nu (yob bo pa la ldan/ grub chen sangs rgyas rin cen/ de la sgo rum pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' rgya mtsho/ zur khang pa dpal ldan rin cen gsum gyis zhus/ gsum ga nas rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ kun mkhyen mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ bka' drin mnyam med zur chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na bla ma lha rje nas/ slob dpon chos grags/ e ba 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ bya ster ba byang chub seng ge /sabazang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje bsod nams dbang phyug /rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po nas/ rje btsun sgo rum pa/ tshar chen man 'dra/ yang na khams pa a seng nas/ zhang ston dkon cog /ru smon mkhar ba/ skyi ston ru zhang / rje dkon cog blo gros/ rje chos grags pa man 'dra/ yang na lo tsā ba mchog ldan nas/ bla ma rgyal bod/ slob dpon smra ba'i seng ge /bya sder ba byang chub seng ge man —129

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sprul pa'i sku mchog mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje/ gcung mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dkon cog rgya mtsho nas/ bla ma chos ldan rgya mtsho/ bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma (90na)gzhon nu bkra shis/ chos rje gzi brjid pa/ bla ma shākya shrī/ bla ma dka' bzhi pa/ bla ma ras pa chen po/ be bug pa bde legs rgyal mtshan/ glo bo thar pa rigs 'dzin chos rgyal bsod nams/ gos sngon zhal gzigs sngags 'chang chos skyong bsod nams/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man gong bzhin no/ /yang na ngor chen dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ rje dkon cog lhun grub/ rje dkon cog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ de dbon shes rab 'byung gnas/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ dkon cog rgya mtsho/ shar chen man 'dra/rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pas mdzad pa'i u tsarla'i sgrub thabs kyi lung ni/ rje sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ rje dbang rab/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /khro bo sme brtsegs dud kha'i rjes gnang sogs kyi lung brgyud/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zin bris kyi steng nas rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa dud kha'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri rin cen grags/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ bla ma gra thang pa/ bla ma kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma blo gros dpal/ dge bshes seng ge /mkhan po bsod nams shes rab/ mkhan po shes rab mgon/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ rje (90ba tha sod nams seng ge /rje btsun sgo dras pa —130

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)chen po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /glo bo mkhan chen legs 'byung / bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na mkhas btsun dge stag par khro bo'i dbang po zhal dngos su gzigs pa'i zhal gzigs brgyud pa ni/ mkhas btsun dge stag pa/ dran bu rin cen grub/ mkhan chen shes rab gzhon nu/ slob dpon dkon cog mkhar/ ri lung sbug pa chos kyi mgon po/ lte blo ldan seng ge /lce btsun bsod nams dpal/ sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje/ dka' bzhi ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang yon tan dpal/ bla ma blo bzang dpal/ mkhyen rab rin po che mchog grub/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legasapa man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/ rje dkon cog tshul khrims/ 'gos ston rdo rje seng ge /mnga' ris ru thog pa rdo rje gzi brjid/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ /rje btsun sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i sme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs/ smyo 'bog 'don pa/ ser ba bzlog pa/ rims gso ba/ phyugs kyi god ka gcod pa/ phyugs nad gsob/ mi nad bsrung ba/ ra lug la spyang ki bsrung ba/ 'bras phol lhog pa gsob/ nad pa'i sngas bsrung / zhing gi 'bu bsrung / sris rme ba/ 'gong po sreg pa dang (91na yo cas pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje bsod nams seng ge yan gong ltar las/ rje sgo dras pa/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o/ /yang na chos rje khu dbon/ zhang ston khu dbon/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin pa/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ shar chen/ngor chen/ mus chen/ sangs dpal ba/bdag wo rdo rje 44 / 'gos ston rdo rje seng ge /ru thog pa rdo rje gzi brjid rje mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / yongs 'dzin dkon 'phel/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog lhun grub/ shar khang pa sher rgyan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang /—131—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nas/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ bdag chen 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des (92na)bdag la'o/ /khro mo sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang dang / de'i sgrub thabs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas nos pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ ḍā ki seng ge gdong can/ gru spang rtsa ba rdo rje seng ge /chos rje brag nag pa/byang sems chen po/ bla ma dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dar/ be bug bde legs rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams mchog ldan/ bka' drin mnyam med zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rje dbang rab nas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rje sgo dras pa yan gyi brgyud pa ma rnyed/ de la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses gsan no/ /lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /'phags mchogo byams pa skal bzang rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na rje dbang rab nas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /dzam lha dkar po 'brug gzhon lha lnga ma'i rjes gnang sogs rdzogs par nos pa'i lung brgyud pa/she'u lo sto ba'i yi ge'i steng nas nor can gyi rigs jo bo lugs kyi dzam lha dkar po 'brug gzhen lha lnga ma'i rjes gnang / lung la/ phyi chu sbyin la brten nas bsgrub pa/ nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa/ gsang ba ga'u la brten nas bsgrub pa/ thugs rje chen pos spyan nas dzam la sprul te jo bo la gnang ba'i (92ba tshe tho rgyus/ rjes gnang gi yi ge /bstod pa spyan ras gzigs dbang ma/ she'u —133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lo tsā ba kun dga' chos dbang gis mdzad pa'i sgom bzlas rjes gnang byed tshul bcas rdzogs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/jo bo chen po a ti sha/rgya brtson tsos seng ge/nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po/bshes gnyen po to ba/dge bshesasha ra ba/skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/spyan lnga bsod nams 'phel/dka' bcu pa gzhen nu seng ge/sribs ri ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/lha phug pa rin cen 'od zer/bla ma dpal ldan grub pa/rin po che sangs rgyas 'od zer/sa skya'i gsan yig na mi gsal yang lo pa spyan lnga'i gsan yig tu bar 'dir bla ma kha shas ma rnyed tso 2ga/spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/chos kyi spyan ldan lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/'jam dpal rdo rje bsod namasadabang phyug/khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang she'u pa'i yig cha ma gam gtags pa'i rjes gnang dang lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po yan gong ltar la/de nas bla ma blo ldan pa/gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/gdan sa pa gru mi/bla ma bsod nams 'byung gnas/rje zangs chen pa/bla ma chos sgang pa/grub chen ri khrod pa/dwags po paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/rje sangs rgyas93na sgos ma grub/chos rje phyogs lasarnam rgyal/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/rje chosang/pal bzang /sngags 'chang nga/kon cog legs pa/sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/thar rtse pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas/rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//'phags pa za la ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang dam pa'i phyag bzhes/ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas/badz+ra pāṇi/so tā ri/rdza shwa /shrī/a mok+ta badz+ra/ba ri lotsā ba rin cen grags/rje brtse ba chen po/slob dpon rin po che/rje bzhi rin po che/chos rje paṇ+ḍita/chos kyi 4

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)rgyal po 'phags pa/ tsho gis sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shesargyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ go ram pa bsod nams seng ge /rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag za hor brjel 'o/ /yang na 'phags pa nas/ bla ma bso de nams dbang phyug /bla ma rin cen dpal/ bla ma gzhon nu/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan man 'dra/sa la nag po zhal gcig (93ba)phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang bshad ma thag pa bzhin no/ /rnam sras kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa zhi ba bde byed ser po lha dgu'i rjes su gnang ba'i lung brgyud sogs/'dul ba lung las/ rgyal chen sde bzhi po mkha' lding sgra snyan dang sgra chung / klu dbugs dang dbug chen du gyur pa na bzhi gas sangs rgyas 'od srungs la yon tan shes nas dad de bslab pa'i gzhi bzung nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la 'jig rten skyong bar smon lam btab pa'i mthu btsan pos bstan pa rin po che skyong ba la 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir yongs su grags shing mkhas grub mang pos chos skyong gi gtso bor mdzad pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam mang thos pa'i sras 'di nyid kyi gzi brdzid ma bzod par lha min gyi dpung phyir log par brten lha rnams ngal bsos pas ngal bsos po dang / lha min gyis g.yul bshams pa'i tshe seng ge khros pa la zhen nas bsrungs pas gnas srung po dang / dug sbrul chen por sprul na lha min dbang po ra rgod kyi —133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dmag rnams myos par byas pas lus ngan po zhes sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang por grags shing /mu stegs kyi sprang po nyi ma'i dngos grub sogs bsgral bar dka' ba mang po tshar bcad pas mthu rtsal che ba/ tshe dang dpal 'byor sogs 'dod dgu'i char chen po 'bad med du stsol ba'i lha mchog 'di nyid kyi chos skor bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gyi lo paṇa rnams las brgyud pa mtha' klas na'ang dus dbang gis chos par rlom pa phal cher mi chos kyi zhar la lha chos 'grub tu re ba'i le lo dang rnam par g.yeng ba'i dbang gis nub tu nye ba na rdo rje 'chang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal (94na)pos byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rnam par thar pa bzhin rnam thos sras bka' mi 'dra ba bco lnga tsam gyi chos skor gsan zhing phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i rgyun ma nyams pa legs par thob pa la/ 'di nyid kyi gong gnon du phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang mdzad pa'i srol ltar mnos pa ni gong du smos zin cing / slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos rgyud dang man ngag la brten nas rgyal po ngal bsos po zhi ba nor du bsgrub pa dang drag byed mthu ru bsgrub pa'i cho ga sogs mdzad pa las thog mar zhi ba bde byed ser po lha dgu zangs dkar nas brgyud pa stod lugs smad lugs kyi brgyud pa chu bo gnyis 'dres las/ phyag len gyi rim pa smad lugs chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i bzhed srol gtso che bar mdzad la/ der ma zad rjes gnang lnga phrag gsum gyi cho ga so so'i lugs srol nyams pa med pa rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi phyag len bzhin mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi chog khrigs su mdzad pa'i nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyan 'phreng gi steng nas thos pa yin zhing / bsgrig rim mkhan chen pa'i 'dir rten 'brel gyi dbang gis rnam sras dkar po thog mar mdzad la/ kho bos rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po la gsol ba btab par brten phyag len phra mo rnams kyang gab sbas med pa'i chog sgrigs dngos grub 'dod 'jo phyogs sdebs skabs su gang babs la rnam sras dkar po rten 'brel gyis rjes su gnang ba sogs go rim mi mthun tsam snang ba'i lugs gnyis gang byas kyang 'gal ba cher mi 'dug (94bcung / rjes gnang sogs kyi dus gang bde byas chog na'ang / 136

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'dir dbang lung gnyis po ngo 'phrod sla ba'i khyad dang bcas thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gsan yig gi go rim ltar bkod pa la/ rnam sras kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa zhi ba bde byed ser po lha dgu'i rjes su gnang ba/ 1 'di dang 'brel bar shin tu gnyan pa slob ma dam ldan bsnyen song re re tsam las mang por mi gnang ba'i drag po'i rjes gnang shin tu gnyan cing bka' rgya dam pa/zangs dkar ba'i gong khug sro ma can las byung ba'i gsang sgrub ljang ser be con can yum pad+ma gtsug phud ma ste yab yum gnyis kyi rjes gnang stod lugs las 'ongs pa/ 2 slob dpon klu sgrub kyis sprang po nyi ma'i dngos grub bsgral ba'i drag byed rta sngon bdud mo bzhi skor lha lnga'i rjes gnang / rnam srasadamar po'i skor dang rnying ma bka' gter nas bshad pa rnam bla med du gtogs kyang 'dir sde tshan gyi dbang gi phyogs gcig tu bkod do/ /3 de nyid la cung zad kha bsgyur zhing rgyal chen bzhi bsnan pa'i nang ma mo lhar bsgrub pa lha dgu'i rjes gnang gnubs kyis bsgyur ba'i be+e shra wa ṇa kha rag khram thogs nag po'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i drag po mthu ru bsgrub pa'i nang nas drag byed seng zhen klu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i rjes gnang / 5 de nyid la cung zad kha bsgyur ba bzhon pa med pa'i drag byed rkang thang lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na migs la yang / chog sgrigs gnyis ga na 'dug cing phyag len la'ang mdzad/6gsang ba gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa mdung dmar can lha bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang / kha rags sa thog kyi sa na mu steg nyi ma ba (9577 dang lha ri 'a grong khyer gzhom pa'i ṣ+ka du slob nga pon nā gā cana'i snyegs nas rgyud bton par bshad pas sbrang po nyi ma'i dngos grub bsgral ba'i chos spyong yang 'di yin nam snyam/ 7bram ze su pa rta me zhag gsum la mu stegs pa bco lnga bsgral ba'i yang gsang drag po srin po bzhi skor gtso 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang / /shu raṃ ka warma'i lugasakyi rnam sras mthing kha zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum gyis 'khril ba gtso 'khor bco lnga pa'i rjes gnang / 9 rnam sras dmar ser las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor gnyis kyi rjes gnang / 10 gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud nas sras gar mkhan mchog gur kum gcan nu'i mdangasacan zhal bzhi phyag bcu drug pa bstan pa'i shugs la slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po dang kha che rin cen —137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rdo rje sogs kyis bkral ba'i gar mkhan mchog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / 11 'di la rjes gnang ṣ+ka/ de la cung zad kha bsgyur ba gar mkhan mchog dmar smug zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa yum bcas kyi rjes gnang / 12 rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel lha dgu'i rjes gnang /13 lha sras mu tig btsan po dang blon po zhang lha bzang klu dpal gnyis bha da hor gyi sgom gra bcom pa'i dmag la 'byon skabs dpal o rgyan chen pos gnang ba'i rnam sras zhi drag gnyis las zhi ba ljang yum ma'am sprin gseb mar grags pa ser chen lha dgu'i rjes gnang / 14 drag po yang gsang mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa las mkhan dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor gnyis kyi rjes gnang /15 rnams (95ba tshe rdos nas rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ mkhan r+ṣa ngag chos pa'i chog sgrigs na las mkhan ma byung yang mkhan 'a bslab gsum rgyal mas dang khyab bdag bkar 'gyur ba'i mig cha mas par ca ngo / /gnod sbyin sde dpon chen po gar mkhan mchog gi rtog pa (dbang/brtag pa gnyis pa le'u bcu drug pa kha che'i mkhas pa chen po dha na gup+ta dang rab zhi lo tsā bas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang mtho gling 'dzam gling rgyan du bsgyur ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di'i gong du gar mkhan mchog gi brtag pa phyi ma las byung ba'i gtam rgyud/ skya rgyud bla ma gtu sa gyi gsung sgros/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar o po zha nang pa nas brgyud pa gsum 'dug kyang dpe ma 'byor ba lung mo byung /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las sna tshogs sgrub pa le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thosasras kyi rgyud rin chen 'byung ba le'u bcu dgu pa rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍita kha che dgon pa ba dang lo tsā ba mnga' ris pa ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ sna tshogs dag pa'i rgyud le'u sum cu pa slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa zangs dkar lo tsā bas bsgyur ba / 'di gleng gzhi'i skabs slob dpon gang gis mdzad na 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad ces dang rgyud kyi rdzogs mtshams su mdzad pa po bshad pa mthun par byung yang skye rgyud kyi le'u'i skabs slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la zhus par bshad pa cung zad 'gal ba ltar snang yang gsung pa po phyag na rdo rje dang 'gro bzang snying pos de'i bka' bsdus par mdzad pa'i sgra bshad pa 'dra'o/ /rje ma' bu'i gar yig na 'di gnyis kyi bar du sna rdzas—138

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dag pa'i rgyud le'u nyer dgu pa dang 'gro bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gser 'od 'bar (96na)pa gnyis 'dug kyang dpe ma lor ba ma thob/'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa'i zhi ba bde byed lha dgu'i sgrub thabs gser 'od 'bar ba'i ṭik+ka sems can dbul ba rnams kyi don du zhi ba nor sgrub las sbyor dang bcas pa bshad zin to'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras drag byed seng zhen khros pa'i 'phrin las sgrub tshul bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po byung bar gyur cig gi mtha' can/ 'khor klu brgyad kyis ma bskor bar sgrol byed nag po/ khyab 'jug /lha mo dpal tshul gnod sbyin gyi dmag dpung dang bcas pa snang ngo / /des mdzad pa'i rnam thos sras bde byed kyi rtog pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can paṇ+ḍita te tsa de wa dang lo tsā ba dge slong 'phags pa shes rab kyis zhus shing bsgyur ba/ rnam sras ser za phyag 4zha si po tsho be sngo dang ne'u lewon pa ṣ+ka snang / 'gor bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas zhes yod pa shu raṃ ka warmas mdzad pa'i zhi ba bde byed ser po lha dgu'i man ngag yid bzhin (dbang/nor bu'i sgrub thabs zhes pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ de'i ṭīk+ka slob dpon shu raṃ ka warmas mdzad pa'i sgrub yig 'di la gnyis te zhes pa 'gor yod pa la zab mo yin pas gsang bar zhu'i mtha' can/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis kyi bar du bde byed kyi cho ga sna tshogasapa'i mdzod dang dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lusang na po'i sgrub thab thar lo'i 'gyur gnyis 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/shog dril drug pa zhes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgrub thabs la nang gses kyi sku gdung (|nge)sa pa mas gyi sgrub thabs te bsnyen pa'i cho ga /gsung chos(96bcu dung sgrub (ni go pa'i cho ga /tsit+ta rin po che thugs (ba pe smreb pa'i cho ga /'chi med yon to (go pe'i ba pa'i cho ga /spu gri gsang (|kān pa 'phrin las sgrub pa'i cho ga /bum pa bzang po'i dngos grub mthar thug bang mdzod sgrub (kon pa'i cho ga rnams rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta te tsa de was mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ de'i gsal byed zangs dkar lo tsā bas mdzad pa la sku gzugs kyi rgyal mtshan (ko nge spyo brten nas rgyal po zhal dngos su blta ba'i shog dril/ gsung dbyangs chos kyi dung la — 139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()brten (gong )nas snyan grags kyi rgyun sgrub pa'i shog dril/ tsit+ta rin po che thugs kyi sgrub pa la brten nas (ko nge/rgyal po dang tshangs pa'i bu mo'ang 'gugs pa'i shog dril/ yon tan shel gyi bum par brten nas 'chi med (|nge/kyi tshe sgrub pa'i shog dril/ 'phrin las drag po gnam lcags kyi spu gri la brten nas(|rngo/dgra srog myur du gcod pa'i shog dril/ te tsa de wa'i pha ngag 5tshod du snang bas ga yig na ho pa 'dra/ mthar thug gter gyi bum pa la brten nas dgos (ko re/'dod kun 'byung nam mkha' mdzod sgrub pa'i shog dril/ mjug tu gang las brgyud (|rngo/kyi lo rgyus nyung ngu dang 'khor lo bri tshul gyi yig chung dang bcas pa/ 'di gnyis kyi bar du khro po kong bu ri ba la zhus pa'i shog dril drug gi yi ge zur ba zhig rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig tu thabs kyang dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/ bsnyen pa'i gnad snying du dril ba/ sgrub pa'i gnad snying du dril ba/ srog gnad la dbab pa ste don gsum gyi man ngag rnam sras snying dril lam snying dang 'dra ba'i gnad kyi yi ge khra rgya gar du gtsigs po cher (97na)byas te rin po che sna lnga'i khu bas bris pas khra bo zhes pa'i ming thogs skad/bo/ /'di gnyis kyi bar na rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na gnod sbyin brel phongs kyis mnan thabs gur ga de was mdzad pa 'dug kyang dpe ma 'byor pas ma thob/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i mgul mgul khug sro mo can gyi kha gsal ma byung yang dpe dang gsan yig zhus dag pher bas yid ches su byas so/ /khug sro ma can la rnam sras gser chen gyi gsang sgrub rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa zhes bya ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ rnam sras ljang ser be con ma'i thugs (dbang)yib gsang sgrub rdzogs so'i mtha' can rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi gsang ba'i man ngag ces par nang gses kyi dngos grub kyi gzhi bzung ba/ rten gzug pa/ gsham bu bdun gyis dngos grub bsdu ba/ tshe sgrub pa/ bse rag kha 'ching ba dang / bcas pa 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa yin gyi mtha' can/ sna tshogs dag pa'i rgyud las gang la dmigs pa'i liṅga yi zhes sogs mnan pa/ rmi ltas/'khor lo'i kha chings/ sngags kyi kha chings dang bcas pa'i bse rag 'ching ba shin tu rgyas pa 'gro bzang snying po de skad gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ rgyun du 'grogs par 'dod na rten gsum gzug pa'i man ngag thams cad 'grub par the tshom med do'i mtha' can/ rten gsum gzug pa'i man ngag 'khor — 140—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lo 'dri tshul khyi dmar po'i snying la brten pa'i man ngag gsham bu'i tshul du bzlas so'i mtha' can/mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na tshar gnyis ma byung yang phyi ma 'di gsal byed du 'dug pas kha phral nas bris pa yin/ bsnyen sgrub labasagasum gyi rtags ma byung na spogs pa'i cho ga sku gsung thugs kyi byin (97ba)gyis brlab pa'i bskyod rdo rjes zhus pa/ yang de dang stod 'dra ba la smad cung zad nyung ba 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad po zhi'i mtha' can/ yang de dang cung zad 'dra min rgyas pa 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na stag mda'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba bzhi zer ba las kha ma phral ba bog /'gor de bzhin gshegs pa rin cen mang la phyag 'tshal lo zhes yod pa'i gnod sbyin zhing ka ra la brten nas mi nor zas gsum bsgrub pa zang zang g.yur rtse'i gter ma zangs dkar gyi khyad chos/ byang phyogs rgyal po'i bka' nyan a pa ra tsit+ta rin cen bzang po'am nor bu bzang po dred zhen gyi sgrub thabs in+d+ra bhū nyis mdzad pa rdzogs (103ba tha'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs chung ba lag len gyi rim pa rin cen bzang po'i nang du sgrub pa yin gyi mtha' can/ 'gor phyag na rdo rje'i sku la 'dud ces yod pa'i nor bu bzang po a pa ra dkar po dred zhon gyi sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma gsang sgrub gnad kyi zhal gdams rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ las tshogs bcu gsum zhes pa rang don du gzhan las rgyal ba/ bsam pa 'grub pa stobs rgyas pa/ mnan gtad bcings pa dgrol ba/ dbang du bya ba/ bzlums pa/ gzhan don du pham pa/ 'phung ba/ mnan pa/ bcings pa/ bskrad pa/dbye ba/ gsad pa rnams/ a pa ra tsit+ta'i dngos grub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gnod sbyin lag spun mnan pa/ mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di'i rje su 'khor lo sogs kyi zhal gdam a pa ra gsum gyi dbye ba/ sgrub thabs mtshal min ngag dbang dgyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa gsum 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor bas lung ma thob/ cho ga phyag len gyi skor la/ 'gor bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes yod pa'i zhi drag spel ba'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrīs mdzad pa mjug tu thugs sras lo tsā ba'i ka bstod le tshan gnyis btags pa/ 'di rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig gsham gyi bstod pa'i mdzad byang la brten nas thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad gsungs pa 'dug kyang 'di — 149

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'debs pa dang rgyun med pa 'ga' re'ang chud pa bcas byud 'dug kyang mgo mjug gi tshigs bcad sogs mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legasagad du snang ngo /des mdzad pa'i rnam sras dbang drag gi yi ge'i skor gtso bor ston pa'i dkar chag snyan brgyud gser gyi za ma rtag/mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i dpal chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnam thos rigs mi 'dra ba lnga phrag gsum gyi rjes gnang gi cho ga nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyan 'phreng /rigs kun khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa'i rnam sras lnga phrag gsum gyi rjes gnang gi chog khrigs dngos grub 'dod 'jo dang bcas pa rnams legs par nos pa las zangs dkar lo tsā bas stod kyi phyogs su thog mar gnang zhing gtum ston blo gros grags nas brgyud pa'i rnam sras stod lugs sam bya sder lugs su grags pa'i zhi ba bde byed ser wo lha dgu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje la4 phyag na rdo rje/spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/kun tu bzang po/slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/kha che rin cen rdo rje/kha che dgon pa ba/zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/gtum ston blo gros grags/gtum mgon po yon tan/lung khu dgon 105na rdza/mkhan po lung ston/slob dpon legs pa'i shes rab/bya sder ba byang chub rin cen/bya sder ba byang chub gzhen nu/mang mkhar ba blo bzang dkar po/mang mkhar ba blo bzang grags pa/bzang ldan mkhan chen shākya blo gros/'bul dpon rdo rje rgyal po/rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod namasamachog ldan/rigs kun khyab bdag zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du bstsal to//yang na tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po nas/rin po che bod mkhar ba me tri don grub rgyal mtshan/spyan snga rin po che mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/yang na rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po/rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()man 'dra/zangs dkar lo tsā bas smad kyi char g.yor po jo ston la gnang bas smad lugs su grags pa'i rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po zhi ba bde byed ser chen lha dgu dang drag byed bzhon pa med pa klu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i rjes gnang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag len ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/zangs dkar lo tsā ba yan gong ltar la/de nas g.yor po jo ston/bas bsod nams rin cen/rje ga mi ba'i kha pa'i gzha yig na mi 'dug pa ho pa tsā/'byed phu ba pad+ma bkra shis/rtag pa lha rje jo bzang khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal/bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug/khro phu 105ba(7sa dpa' chen po/yang rtse pa rin cen seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin cen grub/thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub dpal bzang /chos rje rin cen dpal grub/sku zhang rin po che mkhyen rab rin cen mchog grub dpal bzang /de la rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po dang chos rje bkra shis dpal 'byor gnyis kyis gsan/gnyis ka la tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/de nas brgyud tshul le tshan rnams gong dang 'dra/yang na mkhyen rab rin po che nas/sku zhang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/'jam dbyangs byang gling chos rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na byang gling rje nas/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/yang na sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje nas/bco brgyad pa 'jam dbyangs chos rje/gnas brtan bstan pa bzang po/'jam dbyangs byang gling rje man 'dra/yang na thugs sras rin cen rnam rgyal nas/mkhas grub rin cen bsod nams 'phel/stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin cen/rje btsun yab chos rgyal rin cen dpal bzang po/tshar chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/yang na khro phu lo tsā ba nas/mkhan chen byang chub dpal/mkhan chen bde ba dpal/mkhan chen dka' bzhi pa/mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen rin cen rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/rje btsun rdo ring pa wo po man 'dra/yang na rdo rje 'cha /phyag na rdo rje/slob dpon ka ma ru pa/slob dpon dmi pa/rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di 106na2ltar snang la rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyi

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)gas yig dang chog khrigs dngos grub 'dod 'jo na sa zhes pa bog /slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin cen rdo rje/ kha che sa dz+dza na/ kha che te dza de wa/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ zhu sa skya pa/ jo btsun grags pa seng ge /rgya ston grub pa po/ sngags ram pa'i gsan yig na rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus zhes snang / rgya ston grub mchog /bla ma rdo rje dpal/ khro phu sems dpa' chen po man 'dra/ yang skyor mo lung pa'i phyag len ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po nas/ grub chen bri ka ra wa ti/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangasadakar lo tsā ba/ g.yor po jo ston rdo rje rtse mo/ sbas ti dgra bcom pa sems dpa' rgyal mas/ mkhan chen shes rab seng ge /bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyug /se ba can pa yon tan tshul khrims/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen dka' bzhi pa/ dga' ldan phug pa blo bzang grags pa/ de gnyis ka la mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de nas paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ brag dmar ba kun dga' tshe 'phel/ spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ rnam sras kyi rjesaganang lnga phrag gsum pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo ma gtogs pa'i rtags med pa'i lung yongs rdzogs dang dbang gi rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yan gong du smos pa'i smad lugs kyi brgyud pa'i rnam grangs ltar la/ de nas mkhan btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ bstan pa'i srog shing spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan (106bston thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dpal rdo rje kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /dbang gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /chog sgrigs dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba nas/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /kong gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/kha che te dza de wa nas/ kai po dzi/ su ma ti kirti/ kong bu ri pa/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal man —153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'dra//ra'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros yan gong ltar la/de nasapaṇa wo bsod nams blo gros/sham+bha ra rin po che kun dga' sangs rgyas/rdo rje lang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/'brom gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/gsang ba'i bdag po/slob dpon sangs rgyasagasang ba/lo tsā ba dbas mnyu shrī/la gsum rgyal ba byang chub/de la paṇ+ḍita kha che dkar pos bod du zhus/de nas zangs dkar lo tsā ba/mchims yul smad kyi 'brom sde nyi ma/dge bshes lo tsā ba/sle'u mtshur ston/sle'u ston pa/dge bshes dbu gru ston smon lam/'phrin las jo sras nas rim par brgyud de/sham+bha ra rin po che kun dga' sangs rgyas/rdo rje 'amang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/zhi ba bde byed ser po 'di dang 'brel ba'i drag po'i rjes gnang shin tu bka' gnyan pa'i brgyud pa ni/mkhyen rab chos rje nas/sku zhang rin cen 107na7chog grub/'jam dbyangs byang gling rje/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/'di thob pa'i gang zag de rnam sras la mchod gtor mi gcig cing rjes gnang zhu dus ting nge 'dzin gsal ba dang mjug tu rnam sras kyi tshe sgrub nyams su len dgos tshul snang ngo //yang drag po dang ma 'brel ba'i rnam sras ser chen smad lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros yan gong ltar la/de nas mkhan chen ngag dbang lhun grub bkra shis/mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/chos lung mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun grub rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na thugs sras rin cen rnam rgyal yan gong ltar la/de nas rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/paṇa chen ye shesartse mo/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/se ra rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan/pha bong kha pa bde legs nyi ma/shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/zur kun mkhyen chosadabyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//yang na thugs sras lo tsā ba nas/rje grags pa rgyal mtshan/chosarje ye shes rgya mtsho/bla ma grags pa bsam grub/mar ston tshul khrims rin cen/rdo rje 'chang sngagasaram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/thams cad mkhyen ༷ bsod nams rgya mtsho/sngags ram pa bzang po

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa man 'dra/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i gong khug sro ma can gyi zab chos gsang sgrub ljang ser be con gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal yan rnam sras (107ba thar chen ltar la/ de nas mkhan chen gtsang pa dbang phyug grags/ mkhas pa byang chub grags/ mkhan chen dang ma ba brtson 'grus byang chub/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma rin cen rgya mtsho/ bla ma rin cen dpal/ bla ma rin po che chos grags pa/ bla ma shākya ye shes/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ chos rje kun dga' tshe 'phel/ glang thang spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ de la rje mkhyen brtse dang rin po che bod mkhar bsags na pa'i lugs gnyis ka ser chen ltar la rje dbang rab khu dbon gyi bar du mkhan chen zha lu pa nges par dgos so/ /be'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ spyan snga chos kyi rgya mtsho nas/ rje dbang rab/ mkhan ngag chos pa man gong gi lung brgyud bzhin no/ /klu sgrub kyi rgyal chen rta sngon bdud mo bzhi skor dang nang ma mo ltar sgrub pa lha dgu drag byed seng zhen klu brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gsang ba gshin rje ltar sgrub pa mdung dmar can lha bcu gsum/ yang gsang srin po bzhi skor/ shu raṃ ga warma lugs kyi rnam sras mthing kha lha bco lnga/ rnam sras dmar ser las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa/ gar mkhan mchog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa/ dmar smug zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa/ rnam sras dkar po lha dgu'i tshe dbang dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ dpal kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon gro bzang snying po/ grub wo brim ka ra wa ti/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ g.yor po jo ston rdo rje rtse mo/ 'digs yig na migs la (108na〉nga chog khrigs gnyis ka na byung zhing sbas tis zangs dkar pa la cung ma thug pa 'dra'o//sbas ti dgra bcom pa sems dpa' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dang ma ba brtson 'grus dbang phyug /mkhan ngag dbang chos grags dang rje bka' 'gyur ba gnyis kyi yig char mi 'dug kyang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'dug pas chad pa 'dra'o/ /mkhan chen zhig po shes rab seng ge /bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyug /se ba can pa yon tan tshul khrims/— 155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonamakhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chog khrigs gnyis ka na 'di la mkhan chen dka' bzhi pa dang dga' ldan phug pa blo bzang gnyisakyis gsan de gnyis ka la chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gsan zer ba 'dug kyang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig sor gnas byas pa yin slar yang brtag go /bla ma blo gros bzang po/ bla ma chos skyong bzang po/ dga' ldan phug pa blo bzang grags pa/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ brag dmar ba kun dga' tshe 'phel/spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na tshar chen nas/ rin po che bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga rin po che chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/ rnam sras dmar ser las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa/ rnam sras dkar po gnyis kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni rdo rje 'chang dbang rab la 'jam mgon bsod (108bzhims mchog ldan gyis gsan pa man 'dra/ /klu kha shā gsum gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ spyan snga chos kyi rgyal mtsho yan bshad ma thag pa'i rjes gnang rnams kyi brgyud pa ltar la/ de nas rje dbang rab/ mkhan ngag chos pa man lung brgyud spyi 'gro bzhin no/ /yang shā'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab nas/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ desabadag la'o/ /rnam sras sprin gseb ma ser chen lha dgur grags pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/phyag na rdo rje dpal o rgyan chen po/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ lha sras mu tig btsan po/ zhang lha bzang klu dpal nas rim par/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/sham+bha ra rin po che kun dga' sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin cen mchog grub/ rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na tshar chen nas/ rin po che mai tri/ spyan snga chos rgyal/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ ljang gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ spyan snga rin po che yan sprin — 156

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gseb ma'i rjes gnang ltar la/ de nas rje dbang rab/ mkhan ngag chos pa man lung brgyud spyi ltar ro//yang na rje dbang rab nas/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang gsang mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ mkhas pa be+e ro tsa na/ rgyal po g.yu sgra snying po/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ (109na gyi kha lha bzang klu dpal/ gter ston gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi ma/ dbus pa dmar ston/ slob dpon bcur ston/ 'od zer bla ma/ dz+nyā na lak+ṣa/ slob dpon thabs kyi blo gros/ mkhan po dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon nam mkha' grags pa/ bla ma bsod nams rin cen/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ gnyag phu ba mkhas grub bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen pad+ma bzang po/ mkhan chen chos kyi dbang phyug /mkhan chen chos grub seng ge /thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/mkhan chen zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na tshar chen nas/ rin po che bod mkhar ba/ spyan snga ge chas rgyal ma/ khyab bdag dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na gnyan phu ba nas/ mkhas chen seng ge dpal/ mkhas chen rab 'byor seng ge /mkhan chen chos kyi dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang bka' ma'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ mi pham sgra'i la ba can/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ thugs sras mang ston/ sogs byang chub yon tan/ dpal rgya lo/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/ gnyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po man gong bzhin no/ /sprin gseb ma dang phyag mtshan bzhi pa gnyis snga gyur bka' gter gyi thob yig tu lam tsam yod kyang 'dir tshar lugs rjes gnang bka' bco lnga zhes grags(109bto'i rjes su 'brangs te bris pa yin no/ /bzhi'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ spyan snga cho'/kyi rgya mtsho yan phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ltar la/ de nas rje dbang phyug rab brtan/mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags man sngar bzhin no//bo'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ mkhan chen — 157

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonabaslab gsum pa/rdo rje 'chang dbang rab/mkhan chen zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//gsabs kyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/rgyal po kun skyong /bal po ba su dha ra/gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/gnubs rdo rje 'bar/gnubs byang chub snying po/ga chubs spyi bo dong ring /gnubs ga spyon tor 'gying ba/gnubs bya pho brtsegs pa/gnubs 'jol po dbang phyug/gnubs ser po dpa' sras/gnubs klus 'byin/gnubs ra thung /gnubs gtso bo lha pa/gnubs dkon cog grags/gnubs nag po jo phan/gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal nas pho par brgyud de/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/spyan snga chos kyi rgya mtsho/rje btsun dbang phyug rab brtan/paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags man lung brgyud spyi 'gro bzhin no//bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par thob pa'i lung brgyud sogs/mnga' ris rab 'byams pa tshul khrims 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog 'phrin las lhun grub kyi steng nas bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/badz+ra dha ra/badz+ra pā ṇi/ma hā in+d+ra bhū ti/mjum/phri'i/nā ga rdzu na/nā ga bo dhi/kha che ye shes rdo rje/lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/rje btsun 10na tha rtse ba chen po/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/chos rje sa paṇa/de gnyis ka la ngo pa dkar ston shākya grags kyis gsan/de nas brnye lung pa kun bzang dpal/gung pa dar ma ye shes/bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/bla ma tshul rgyal/bla ma ngag dbang /gnyag ston byang chub seng ge/sa bzang 'phags pa gshon nu blo gros/ngor r+ṣa rdo rje 44 /rgyal tshab kun dbang /yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/rje lha mchog seng ge/rje sangasargyas seng ge/brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang /8ye waṃ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/rdo rje

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (kana'achang bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i rigs gsum spyi'i dbang gi tho chung gi brgyud pa ni/ rje dpal ldan don grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ drin can zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i rigs gsum mgon po'i mchod rten bzhedas thabs kyi yig cha'i lung brgyud ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ gas gsum mgon po/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi nas rim par brgyud de sngags 'chang dpal ldan bkra shis/ se ston legs grub tshe ring / khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge go bde bklags chog gi steng nas ston pa thub pa'i dbang po gtso 'khor gsum/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs gtso (110bgyi khor gsum/ rje btsun mi g.yo mgon po/ rje btsun sgrol ma ljang gu gtso 'khor gsum dang bcas te bka' gdams lha bzhin grags pa'i rjes gnang dang / sa skya khri chen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams lha bzhi'i 'khrid yig bka' gdams bstan pa'i sgron me/
