mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i lha bzhi'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi yi ge go bde bklags chog dang bcas pa'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo chen po a ti sha /nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ bya 'dul 'dzin pa/ mkhan po chos kyi byang chub/ mkhan po zul phu ba/ slob dpon dkon cog seng ge /de gnyis ka la mkhas btsun tshul khrims rin cen/ de nas bla ma dar ma bzang po chos rje gzhen nu rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan don grub/ chos rje gtsang pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ bya btang bo dhi satwa/ 'jam dbyangs rin cen grags pa/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lcags thang rab 'byams pa bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/de sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog — 159—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi thub pa'i dbang po'i lha khrid nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa mgon po/ thogs (111na thad/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ mkhan po rnam snang mdzad/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ ku swā li che chung gnyis/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ dpal ldan a ti sha /'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/po to ba rin cen gsal/ glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge /rgya ston lcags ri ba/ dwags po lha rje/ rnal 'byor pa chos kyi skyang gnas/ gyer sgom ོ po/ rgya sgom ri pa/ bo dong rin po che brtson 'grus rdo rje/nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ rin po che shes rab 'bum/ 'jig rten dbang phyug thogs med bzang po dpal/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grags pa bshes gnyen/ 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug /mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du bstsal to/ /thub pa'i rjes gnang dang lha 'khrid kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan yan bshad ma thag pa ltar la/ de nas mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug /chos rje kun dga' legs grub/ rje byams pa phun tshogs/ rab 'byams pa dpal 'byor shes rab/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab (110ba༄byung gnas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i lha 'khrid dmar 'khrid skyer sgang lugs su grags pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po/ rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra/ jo bo chen po lha gcig /nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ba yu ba shes rab tshul khrims/ de la mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dang lce sgom shes rab rdo rje —160

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg bam dang po/ (ka)gnyis kyis gsan/de gnyis la grub thob skyer sgang pa/de nas sangs rgyas gnyen ston/sangs rgyasaston pa/mkhas grub shangs ston/mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/'jag chen byams pa dpal/gser gling byams pa smon lam dbang phyug grub chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/rin po che shes rab bzang po/gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa man thub pa'i lha 'khrid bzhin no//yang rjesaganang dang 'khrid kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig la gzham nas 'byung ba'i sgrol ma'i 'khrid brgyud ji lta ba mdzad srol yang yod do//rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i lha 'khrid bka' gdams rjes dran lnga'i 'khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rje bzhi sgrol ma/jo bo 'a po a ti sha/'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/rngog legs pa'i shes rab/mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/phu chung ba gzhen nu rgyal mtshan/ka ma ba rin cen rgyal mtshan/shad ston dar ma rgyal mtshan/'brom byang chub bzang po/stabs ka ba nam mkha' rin cen/'brom gzhen nu blo gros/lho pa zug/bla ma brab phu ba/mkhan chen 2nadaga' lung pa dbon po bsod nams 'od/bla ma bsod nams bzang po/bla ma dpal ldan pa/chosarje gtsang ba blo bzang grags pa/chos rje bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/rin po che bsod nams lha dbang /spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug man 'dra/yang na 'brom gzhen nu blo gros nas/snar thang mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/gling kha ba rin cen byang chub/rigs kyi bdag po'i dpal/sgang lung pa byang chub dpal/bsod nams 'od zer/sangs rgyas bzang po/sgrub khang pa'i gas yig na sang rgyas rgya mtsho ra ba bog pa brtag/bsod nams bzang po/bla ma dpal ldan pa/stag tshang nam mkha' 'od zer/gnas brtan ye shes tshul khrims/mkhan chen rat+na a ka ra/gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/rje btsun mi g.yo ba sngon po'i lha 'khrid mi g.yo chos drug tu grags pa'i shin tu zab pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti/klu'i rnal 'byor ma/bi su da lnga/bram ze sar ha/'phags pa klu sgrub/tsan+d+ra kirti/birla mi tra/rol pa'i rdo rje/sgeg pa'i khas/shān+ti pa/jo bo r+pā po a ti sha/sgom pa ba 6

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonadabang phyug 'bar/ sne'u zur pa/ gyer sgom wo po/ sangs rgyas dbon ston/ rtogs ldan bzang mob/lha 'phrang po ba/ slob dpon lcags ri ba/ sangs rgyas gzhen nu 'od/ rgya ma bkra shis rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen sangs rgyas rin cen/ mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ bya bral ba (112bang sod nams rin cen/ bla ma chos grags bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ ti'u ra pa rin cen chos kyi rgyal po/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa man gong bzhin no/ /yang na rtogs ldan bzang mo ba nas/mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ mkhan chen grags pa gzhen nu/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims man 'dra/thub pa'i dbang po la gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i rjes gnang legs par thob pa'i lung brgyud/btsun pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gnas brtan phyag mchod dang rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas thub pa'i dbang po 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i rjes gnang legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo chen po di paṃ ka ra/sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i paṇ+ḍita/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/ bshes gto po to ba/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ dge bshes 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ rgan mo lhas pa chen po/ dpal ldan gro mo che ba/mchims nam mkha' grags/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ slob dpon sbas pa ston gzhen/ chos sku blo gros 'od/ mkhan r+pā seng ge rgyal mtshan/ byang sems chen po shākya bsod nams/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ gzims 'og pa dpal ldan chos—162—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)'byor/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ gnas gsar rdo rje la tsho mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ bka' drin mnyam (113na thad zur chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /mchims nam mkha' grags kyis mdzad pa'i 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi sgrub yig rgyas pa'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo ོ po/ dha na shrī/rngog byang tso khrung gnas/ po to ba/ sha ra pa/ 'chad ka pa/ spyil bu ba gnyis/ 'bre lhas pa rdo rje dpal/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ slob dpon bsod ye/ bsod grags pa/ bar 'dir bla ma gsum bzhi zhig ma rnyed/spyan snga lha bsod nams lha dbang / spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhon nu chosadapal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /spyod rgyud kyi lung brgyud/gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud ni/ mdun legs ma las/ rgyud sde gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud rnams kyi//gtso bor gyur pa rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud la sbyangs pas spyod pa'i rgyud kyi phyogs/ /gang yin de yang legs par nges par byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'phags pa'i yul du rnam grangs mang na'ang ljongs 'dir mkhas pa thams cad zhal mthun pa rnam snang mngon byang ste/ de yang zha lu pa ye shes rgya mtsho'i khrigs bzhin rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi bkod pa'i dkyil chog rab gsal nor bu'i phreng ba'i steng nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo (113ba tshe so pa ldan 'das/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa snying rje chen po ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangasargyas/ 'jam dpal/ grub chen dze tā ri pa/ a shwa ka shrī rdo rje gdan pa rtseb/la li ta thar bskus khang pa'i —163—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gsan yig na mi 'dug kyang bu ston ngor chen gong dkar ba mkhyen brtse bzhi'i gsan yig na 'dug/badz+ra rdo rje gdan pa 'bring ba/a mo gha badz+ra rdo rje gdan pa chung ba gsum gyi mas yin/ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/mchims brtson seng /mjims don grub rgyal ba/bu ston rje gzha btsong kha pa ngor r+ṣa gong dkar ba thar rtse sgrub khang pa drug gi gas mig na 77sa don yi zer ba snang /mchims chos seng /mchims blo brtan/'di bu ngor gong dkar ba ma' 0bsto gas yig na snang bas thar rtse sgrub khang pa'i gsha yig na pha pa wa/mchims nam mkha' grags/slob dpon dar ma rgyal mtshan/byang chen pa bsod nams 'phel/rje bas btsong kha ba'i gas kho na mi dag pa pha dam brtagalo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/thar rtsedang sgrub khang pa'i gas yig na 'di gnyis mi 2ga cing gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na mkhan chen grags gzhon pas bu ston la thug 'dug pa dpyad/mkhan chen grags pa ga cho zhe nu/zha lu mkhan po grags pa rgyal mas/dbur stod pa yon to dpal/'bras spungs mkhan ོ rong po blo bzang /rdo rje 'chang ri rab rin cen mchog grub/slob dpon sa ṅga shrī/slob dpon tshul khrimasa'od zer/slob dpon bsod nams dpal 'byor/'jam dpal 114na bo byangs byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/bla ma rdo rje bzang po/bla ma rin cen rgya mtsho/zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/rigs kun khyab bdag mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/thams cad mkhyen pa zur chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rin cen dbang rgyal gyi steng nas grub chen ma ṇi ka badz+ra lugs su grags pa'i rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo rnam par 'joms pa lha bcu dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob ba'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /dpal phyag na rdo rje/ngor 'a dang thar rtse pa'i gas mig na mi 'dug kyang rje mkhyen brtse dang mkha ngag chos pa'i gas mig na snang ngo //rje btsun byams pa/skal ldan gang gā dha ra/bram ze'i slob dpon ma ṇi badz+ra/paṇ+ḍita dza ya warma/paṇ+ḍita dz+nya na shrī/lo tsā ba cog gru ra bzhi/bla ༷ yon to legs pa/rje bsam gto dbang phyug/

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bla ma don grub ye shes/ rje chos kyi blo gros/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mas/ rje dkon cog rdo rje/ bla ma shesarab 'bum/ rong pa chos kyi mgon po/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ ngor 'a dang thar rtse'i gas yig tu khrug pas rje mkhyen brtse dang ngag chos pa'i gsan yig na chad dam snyam/spur bsod nams dbang phyug /ngag chos pa'i gsan yig na 'di ra/ /bya sder ba byang chub rin cen/ bya sder ba byang chub gzhen nu/ bya sder ba byams pa rin cen/ bya sder ba byang chub seng ge /sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' (114ba)bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ mkhan chen dkon cog tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lung brgyud/gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud ni/ mdun legs ma las/ rgyud sde gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyi/ /gtso bo dpal ldan de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud/ /bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo la sogs la/ /sbyangs pasarnal 'byor rgyud gyi dga' ston myong / /zhes pa ltar rnal 'byor rgyud la thabs gtso bor ston pa dang shes rab gtso bor ston pa gnyis las dum bu dang po rdor dbyings dang gnyis pa khams gsum rnam rgyal/ de las 'phros pa'i rim pa sogs rnam grangs mang na'ang yul dus kyi bskal bas chu thigs tsam nos pa la kun mkhyen bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rin cen bsam 'phel la byang gling pa rin cen rgyal po'i lhan thabs dang rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje'i dbang chog sbyar ba'i steng nas dum bu dang po 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul ba rtsa rgyud rdo rje dbyings kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dkyil chog lugs kyi dbang legs par nos pa'i yo ga smad lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ brgyud —165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tshul 'di la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dang sgrub khang pa'i gsan yig na rgya gar dbus na brgyud pa'i lug zhe ngos 'dzin mdzad/khyab bdag rnam snang chen po/ 'khor (115na〉sgos sgyur ba rdo rje sems dpa'/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ paṇa ser/ dpa' bo rta pa la/ paṇa ra/ dz+nyā na badz+ra/ paṇa ser/ pradzha sirnyi/ paṇa ser/ de bzhi la slob dpon kun dka' snying pos gsan/ paṇa ser/ de nas pradz+nyā wa li ta/ paṇa ser/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ paṇa ser/shārnya ka ra warma/ paṇa ser/ sangs rgyas/ paṇa ser/zhi ba/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di mi bog /lo chen rin cen bzang po/ phyar phu ba/lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ bod rna/ de gnyis la rgyang ro spel dmar gyi rkyang po chos blo/ sngagago kar lcang rdzog/lo chung dang rkyang po gnyis/ka la sum ston ye shes 'bar dang lce ston 'dir rtsa ba'i bla ma zha lu mkha rin po che'i gsan yig sor gnas bris pa yin rdo rje gdan pa sgrub khang pa mkhyen brtsegasum gyi gsan yi na gla mo 'di rnams ris par brgyud pa lta bu zhig 'dug/chos grags gnyis kyi gsan/ lce zhan ba'ang ra sngags dkar co bre can/ de gnyis ka la stag tshal gdong sngon gyi spu ston 'bar thog /sngags dkar co brig mā/de nas rong lha steng gi /gtsang pa yang dag rdo rje/ sngags dkar lcang lo ༅/ gtsang ston smra ba'i seng ge/lce ston mdo sde seng ge /sngags dkar lcang lo mā/ mag dge sdings pa kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ lce blo ldan seng ge /lce mdo seng ge sras dkon cog seng ge'i gra sngags dkar lcang lowo/ de gnyis ka la 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ de nas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin cen grub/ sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/ lce btsun nam mkha' mchog grub/ cho so rje rin cen dpal grub/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab mchog grub dpal bzang (115bsgo khan chen rig 'dzin rgyal po/ byang gling pa rin cen rgyal po/ /de gsum ga la sku shad bsod ston mas ma chag grub/ de nas byang gling pa rin cen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po rin cen bsod namasamachog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na byang gling rje nas/ rje bsod nams dpal 'byor/ rje rin cen rgya mtshom na 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/chos rje bkra shis dpal 'byor/ byang gling rje man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas —166

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rje don grub rgyal mas/byang gling rje man 'dra/yang na byang gling rin cen rgyal po nas/chos rje bkra shis dpal 'byor/byang gling rje man 'dra/yang na thugs sras lo tsā ba nas/'jam dbyangs gragasapa rgyal mtshan/slob dpon ye shes rgya mtsho/thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/bla ma yon tan rgya mtsho/ rje lo rgyan rgyal po/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal po/ nyi ma gling pa mkhas grub tshul khrims bkra shis/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//yang na bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad/brgyud pa 'di la kun mkhyen bu/rje btsun btsong kha pa/rje mkhyen brtse gsum gyi gsan yig na zang dgan lugs kyi brgyud par ngos lon mdzad bog cing ba khang pa'i gas yig smad lugs su bca do//phyag na rdo rje/rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/bar pa/chung ba/slob dpon klu sgrub/klu'i byang chub/dz+nyā na badz+ra/au ḍi ā na'i smra ba'i gtsug gi nor bu kun dga' snying po/rje gzha btsong kha pa'i gas yig na 'di zur du snang /rab dbyings bshes gnyen/rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na 'di la nar/pad+ma /ra/dharma nar gsum gyis gsan 116na ngor ba la lo chen gyisags ge snang /pad+ma ka ra warma/lo chen rin cen bzang po/lo chung legs she/zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/phyar tsa/klog skya seng ge rgyal ba/de la spyang tshang ston pa rtse mo dang jo she gnyisakyis gas/de gnyis nas gtsang yang dag rdo rje/sngag pos lcang log/gtsang smra seng man gong ltar ro//kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/kun mkhyen bu/rje btsun btsong kha pa/sgrub khang pa gsum gyigs yig na'ang kha che'i brgyud par mdzad bog/pra dz+nya wa li ta nas/pradzha dzo/muk+ta ko kha shārnya ka ra/lo chen rin bzang /rkyang po chos blo/sum ston ye 'bar/lte zhar ba/spu ston man gong dang 'dra/dbus 'gyur 'chang ba'i lugasakyi brgyud pa ni/'di gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na smad lugs dang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na kha che'i lugs kyi brgyud par bar cing rje gzha btsong kha pa'i gas yig tsong dbu brgyud du bar do/usti ko ṣa yan gong ltar la/de nasasangs rgyas zhi ba/lo chen/lo chung /gnyis ka la rkyang po chos blo man gong bzhin no//yo ga stod lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na'ang stod lug su bgrangs 'dug cing rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na smad lugasazer ba 'dug pa phyag bris nor ram snyam pa dpyad/thar rtse pa'i gaX/ yig na rdor dbying rtsa lugs kyi brgyud par ngos bzung /rab

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'byor bskyangs yan gong ltar la/ de nas kha che sto pā la/ lo chen rin cen bzang po/ gung shing pa brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ lo 'a gyi bla wo che ba bzhi'i ya gyal snyag yin zhing bod gzha mas/ gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ sngags pa gos dkar lcang lo༅/snar nyi ma 'od zer/ rtsa skya (116bston pa dkon cog grags/sngags pa gos dkar lcang lo can/rtsa skya shākya 'i ngo krum/ 'di yab chos grags pa chos lung thob pa tsam byas nas glan la gtugasasngags pa gos dkar co breg ༅/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ bod gzha/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer/ bod gzha/chos rje 'phags 'od man gong dang 'dra/ yang na snar nyi ma 'od zer nas/ 'di thar rtse pa'i gas yig rdor dbying tshol lug kyi brgyud par ngos tshong bog /snar rdo rje seng ge /sngags dkar lcang lo mā/ glan chos 'byung rtsa skya ston pa shāka 'bum/ sngags dkar lcang lo can/ rtsa skya khri brtan/ /snar ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bod gzha/snur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho man gong bzhin no/ /chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i lag len rin cen bsam 'phel/ de mdzad pa'i yo ga'i mchod 'phreng bla med mchod sprin/ des mdzad pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rgyas byin rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin cen grub/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ lce ston nam mkha'i mtshan can/mkhas mchog tsan+d+ra shrī/ kun mkhyen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ byang gling pa rin cen rgyal po/ 'phrog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kun dga' bkra shis/ byang gling pa rin cen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /rab gnas bkra shis rgyas byed kyi lhan thabs rdo rje 'chang rin (117na)cen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas phun tshogs dpal 'bar/ des mdzad pa'i rab gnas rgyas pa'i yon bdag bsgo ba'i bshad pa/ des mdzad pa'i rdul tshon spyan drang ba'i cho ga rdo rje dbyings la sbyar ba dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel rnams kyi lung yang rtsom pa po nyid la legs par nos so/ /—168—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)kun rig rtsa ba'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du chos rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi yig cha'i steng nas dbang legs par nos pa'i stod lugs kyi lung brgyud/zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba dpal khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdig pa bral ba'i skabs las 'phros pas 'phros pa'i rgyud ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjed kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa las gsungs pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du chos rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi yig cha'i steng nas dbang legs par nos pa'i stod lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad/phyag na rdo rje/rab gsal zla ba/sgra gcan 'dzin/slob dpon kun dga' snying po/pradzha wa li ta/pradzha bo dhi/musti ko ga sto pā la/jo bo a ti sha/do pa sgom chen/skyi nor dz+nya na/gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/snur nyi 'od/de sras snar rdo rje seng ge/snur byang chub 'od/snar nyi ma rgyal mtshan/rin cen shes rab/bla ma yang rtseb rin cen seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin cen grub/thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/'brong rtse lha ras rje/grub chen ngag dbang blo gros/mar ston tshul khrims rin cen/rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/thams cad 17bsgo khyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/shar pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/chos rje rin cen bshes gnyen/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na snur nyi 'od nas gshen rdor seng /glan chos 'byung /gtum ston shāka 'bum/bla ma mdzims pa rin cen shes rab/yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge man ༷//yang na pra dz+nya wa li ta nas/go mi dge bsnyen/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()shākya dz+nyā na/ jo bo rje man 'dra/ yang na pradz+nyā wa li ta nas/ sto pā la/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ jo bo rje man gong ltar ro/ /yang na snur nyi 'od nas/ rtsa skya ston grags/ slob dpon ston 'bum/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ dge sdings pa chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ ye shes rdo rje/ kun dga' snying po man gong dang 'dra/ yang na rnam par snang mdzad/ dze tā ri pa/ kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ nā ya ka pa/ mai tri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ni ska lam ka /de len+d+ra/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams seng ge /lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /thamasacad mkhyen pa bu ston man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje sems dpa'/ a nu sa ma rak+ṣi ta/ rin cen 'byung gnasazhi ba/ bha ska ra de wa/rdo rje gdan pa man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje gdan pa nas/ bi khyu ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba man 'dra/ yang na rtsa skya ston grags(118na)nas/ rtsaskya shāka 'bum/ 'dzims pa rin cen shes rab/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan man 'dra/ smad lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po yan gong ltar la/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje/ shārnya ka ra warma/ lo chen rin cen bzang po/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ sum ston ye 'bar/ gnyal ston tshul 'bar/ thod pa dben mgrags/ thod pa 'od zer/ ri lung phug pa chos mgon/ bla ma blo ldan seng ge /bla ma 'phags 'od/ kun mkhyen bu ston man sngar bzhin no/ /chos rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i kun rig ṭīka chen gyi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ bar 'dir bla ma 'ga' zhig gi gsan yig bde gzar dus 'thor ba'i khrod du song nas ma rnyed/ rim bzhin rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rin cen bshes gnyen khyab bdag dpal 'byor lhun grub/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ desabadag la'o/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba —170

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/bcom ldan 'das kun rig/phyag na rdo rje/rab gsal zla/sgra gcan 'dzin/grub wo ca snying /pradzha wali ta/lo chu/multi ko sto pā la/rdzo bo rje/do po sgom sto/skyi nor dz+nyā na/gnyal pa nyi she/snur nyi ma/snur badz+ra sidha/snur byang chub 'od/snar nyi ma rgyal mtshan/snar ye shes rgyal mtshan/snur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/'phags 'od yon tan rgya 14mtsho/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/chos rgyal nam mkha'i mtshan can/chos rje rin cen dpalagrub/rdo rje la yo mkhyen sa chos rje/dge slong chos legs pa/gnas brtan bstan pa bzang po womadabyangs byang gling rje/lha bod bu mdzad si la rgya mtsho/rdo rje lang si byu bgo nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na thugs sras nas/'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/shar wo ye shes rgya mtsho/gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa/'di nas bla ma gcig gnyis tsho le/kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/rtsa ba'i bla ma zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'brugs pa lha bcu gsum ma'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bskul nas thams cad mkhyen pa bus phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i gtso bo 'pho bar mdzad pa khung shin tu che/bya rgyud yin khul gyi lha ༄ gsum ma 'dra 'ong bog pa ni rgya nag mdo rtsom pa dang bod sa rtsom pa dang tsā 'o//thub pa'i dbang po/kun dga' bo/klu sgrub/ār+ya de wa/a ba lha ti pa/a ṣ+ṭha snar gup+ta/gser gling pa/jo bo rje/'brom ston pa/po to ba/sha ra ba/rgya ye sgom/grub thob hūṃ wor/spyo dge slong /dge slong dkon cog ye shes/bla ma ga kun ston/rong pa dkon cog 'bar/mkhan po dbang phyug rin cen/ khams pa sa phug pa/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ kun mkhyen chos 'od/'phags 'od yon to rgya mtsho/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/thugs sras sems dpa' r+sā po/chos rgyal nam 119na7kha'i mtshan can/chos rje rin cen dpal grub/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/chu mig kha pa dkon cog dpal bzang /'brog sgang pa don grub rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs byang gling chos rje/de la rje sangs rgyas tshe dpal dang bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor gnyis kyis zhus/gnyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ka la rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na dge slong dkon ye nas/ mkhan po 'brom/ g.ya' lung dgon gsar pa rin bla/ 'od chung ba gzhen nu 'od/ grags chen pa/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na kha che ye shes rdo rje/lo chung grags wor shes rab/ rje btsun sa chen/ rje btsun rin po che/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/bo dong ra lung pa/ shab lung phu ba nam mkha' bsod nams/ nub gog pa/ dge bshes dar gshon/mdo stod pa ston pa don yod/ slob dpon rin rgyan/ bla ma grags chen pa/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od man gong bzhin no/ /yang na sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ lo chen rin bzang /rkyang po chos blo/ rkyang po zhang khri/ gnyal pa sgog ston/ 'khur ston gzhon/ rong pa dkon cog 'bar/mkhan po dbang rin/ sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ 'od chung pa/ gzhen 'od/ grags chen pa man 'dra'o/ /kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen bu ston/ rje dpal mchog pa/ mkhas pa zla ba dpal rin/'khrul zhig (119ba)rin po che/ mkhyen rab rje/ rje rin cen rgyal po/ rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje/ bla ma kun dga' bkra shis/ rje dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang des mdzad pa'i mi zhabrugs pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga las sgrib rnam sbyong dang / ro'i sbyin sreg gi cho gas sdig pa sbyong ba gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ bu ston rje/ thugs sras rin po che/ sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can/ zla ba dpal rin man gong bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi cho ga byed pa'i skabs su gtor ma cha gsum mdor bsdus te gtong tshul ngor chen gyis slob dpon dad byed go cha'i gzhung dang mthun par mdzad pa'i lung brgyud ni/ ngor chen/ sems dpa' chen po/ mkhyen rab rin po che/ rje shākya don grub/ dbon kun dga' legs grub/ bla ma kun dga' chos grags/ bco brgyad pa bstan 'dzin bzang po/ dbon —172

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po las kyang thos pa yin rung brgyud pa zhu ba ma byung /rnal 'byor bla med kyi lung brgyud/bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa ni/ mdun legs ma las/ bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa la/ /'phags yul mkhas pa rnams la nyi zla ltar/ /yongs su grags pa'i pha rgyud 'dus pa dang / /rnal 'byor ma rgyud kye rdor bde mchog gi /rtsa rgyud bshad pa'i rgyud la sogs pa dang / /bsdus rgyud gzhan yang bshad srol mi 'dra ba'i/ mang rta'i srol 'byed dus kyi (120na7khor lo'i rgyud/ /gsal byed dri ma med pa'i 'od la sbyangs/ /zhes pa ltar rnal 'byor bla na med pa rgya mtsho chen po bzhin bzhugs pa las cung zad nos par/ de yang pha bla na med pa/ ma bla na med pa/ gnyis su med pa bla na med pa gsum du grags pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi kye rdo rje gnyis med du bzhed cing / thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston dus kyi 'khor lo gnyis med du bzhed/ rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po bla med kyi rgyud thams cad gnyis med du bzhed pa sogs rnam grangs mang ba gang gi rjes su 'brangs kyang tshad ldan mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i gsung las ma 'das na'ang thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen po'i dgongs pa ltar pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ de dag dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba'i rgyud dang gsum/ dang po la/ rigs drug yod pa'i mi bskyod pa'i rigs su gtogs pa 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul bar byed pa 'dus pa'i skor la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsungs shing rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis legs par bkral ba'i bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por zha lu pa ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dngos grub char 'bebs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i dkyil chog ye shes —173

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)glan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam/sngags pa gos dkar co breg/de gnyis ka la rdog ārla de wa/rdog mu ni rab tu ma byung gong gi sras/sngag dkar/de'i zhan chos pa skyi mkhar 'jug/bres kha dben tsha'i stag pa rin cen grags/rab mi /kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/thugs sras lo tsā ba rin cen rnam rgyal/mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/mkhan chen rig 'dzin rgyal po/mas nyid kyi thugs gnyer skyid shod 'bras skrungs su mdzad tso rigs dgon pa skyid lung pa'i zhal ngo /bla chen chos rig rgyal mtshan/lha 'o grwa tshang gi slob dpon bsod nams dpal 'byor/mtshungs med byang gling rje/grong gsar lo tsā ba blo gros dpal bzang /chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod gam nams mchag grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du bstsal to//yang na thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston nas/khyung po lhas pa gzhen nu bsod nams/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ngor chen rdo rje 'amang kun dga' bzang po/mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/rje sangs rgyas seng ge/thar rtse ba paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang /shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//yang na khyung po lhas pa gzhen nu bsod nams nas/zha lu'i ri phug gi byang nags phug gong gi dgon pa chosaphug pa de yang tshong 'dus kyi nub dgon pa khyung po lhas kyi gdan sa thog gcig mdzad pas khyung lhas par grags/gdung rus skyo/thams cad mkhyen pa btsong rnam thar che chung tshor 'di nyid kyi dbang bka' yongs grags su ma gnang ba'i phyogs yod pas dbu ma pa dang bzang skyong pa brgyud par mi bzhugs par rje bla ma 'dren pa ni khungs ma dpyad pa'i skyon te/de rigs kyi brgyud pa phal cher la bu ston nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/lo chen skyabs mchog dpal/de la rje'i dngo slob phal cher gyis gsan pas brgyud pa de ltar du 'dren dgos shing /mkhas grub rjer 'jigs byed dpa' bo rdo rje dang bzang skyong bar gsang 'dus ni byings la ma grags par gsang ba'i tshul du gnang bar 'dug cing rang phyog kyi dbang lung gi phya/ len dang brgyud pa rnam par dag pa sngags ram pa yin pas de'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gsan yig na'ang bzang stong pas rje la gsan par mdzad snang ngo / kha pa chen po/ rgyal sras bzang skyong ba/ shar pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ /mkhas grub sher 'byung blo gros/mkhas grub dpal ldan seng ge /mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ thon pa dge legs dpal (122na tha zang / chos rje 'od zer bzang po/ rje chosagrags 'od zer/ mtshungs med nam mkha' bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal byor lhun grub/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bstsal to/ /yang na rdog ye shes seng ge dang glan rtsad tsha ba gnyis la snye mo'i phug ka ba 'bum skyabs/ sngags dkar/ de nas rong lha steng gi gtsang ston smra seng / nyang stod srebs chung gi lce mdo sde seng ge /sngags dkar/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer man gong ltar ro/ /yang na brag ltag pa ye shes seng ge la/ bod gas/ cha gar mon brag gi mi nyag rdo rje grags/ sngags pa gos dkar co breg can/ de nas lce mdo sde seng ge /gos dkar co breg can/ dge sdings pa chos sku 'od zer man 'dra/ yang na glan rtsad tsha nas/ thang spe ba/ grub thob se sdings pa/kun mkhyen 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na dge sdings pa chos sku 'od zer nas/ lce blo ldan seng ge /bla ma 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na 'gos lo tsā ba nas/ dbus pa dge ser/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa chen/ kha'u pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen burnya shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ 'jig rten mig gcig shong blo gros brtan pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/(122ba)brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub rig pa'i glog 'phreng / 'od gsal rtse pa bla ma ma ṇi badz+ra/ dam chos gling pa bla chen ye shes dbang po/ nyi ma gling pa mkhas grub tshul khrims bkra shis/rab 'byams chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /bka' babs gnyis pa mar lugs kyi brgyud par nang gses kyi sgro 'dogs nang nas chod pa — 176

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)grub thob nyams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje bzhi btsong kha pa chen po'i gsan yig na 'di 'phag lugs min gsung / rdo rje 'chang / in+d+ra bhū ti/ ḍā ki bde ba'i zhabs/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka /rdo rje dril bu pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/gas la pa/ nag po spyod pa/ tai lo pa/ me tog dkar po'i thod can/ nā ro pa/ nag po mi lngags gsol ba rgyan drug phyag ḍa thod/ mar lo chos kyi blo gros/ gos dkar lcang lo mā/ mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje/ sngags dkar/ 'khon gad pa kirti/ bod gzha/'khon bya khang pa bsod nams rin cen/ 'khon thur lha kun tu bzang po/nam mkha'i snying po/ye shes dngos grub/rtsa bshad pa/ snyan grags bzang po rnams mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ ba tshul khrims skyabs/ bod btsun/ thang spel ba 'phags pa skyabs/ se sdings pa gzhen nu 'od/ bod bas/ dge sdings pa chos sku gsang ma' mibaskyod rdo rje zer/ 'od zer man 'gos lugs dang 'dra/ yang na 'khon gad pa kirti nas/ 'gar ston shes rab rgya mtsho/ yar klungs zur ri dgon pa sngags dkar/ grang po khra bo la rtsang a byu pa rin cen seng ge /la stod pa bod gzha/ rong pa shes/ (123na)rab seng ge /rab byung / ston mo lung pa ye shes 'bar/ bod bas/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang / rje bas btsong kha pa'i gag yig na grub thob dang paṇ+ḍita gnyis ka'i brgyud par ma phye ba'i mar lugs spyi tsam pa zhig tu mdzad 'dug pa dbyad/ byang sems blo gros rin cen/ lha bu ser po chos 'pha kyi phyag rgya/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ gsang mtshan ma tadhi pa/ grub thob dmar smug ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya me tog gi thod can/tai lo pa man 'dra/bka' babs gsum pa mar lugs mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub yan 'gos lugs ltar la/ rje btsun brtsang kha pa'i gsan yig na mi 'dren pa 'dra zhig 'dug kyang chu bo gnyis 'dres yin pas skyon du mi 'gyur/ de nas 'jam dpal zhal mthong shākya mi tra/ sgrol ma zhal gzigs nā ga bornyi/ sa brgyad non pa ārla de wa/ spyan ras gzigs zhal mthong ma ta lha pa ste klu sgrub kyi thugs sras bzhi/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ legs ldan 'byed/ mkhas mchogo dpa' bo ste nye ba'i sras gsum/ bdun po de'i nang nas ma ta rmi pa nas/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ yang na ma ta rmi pa nas/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug /a wa dh+wa ti pa/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ nag po'i zhabs/ dri med blo gros/ nub la snye tra'i gtsug lag — 177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)khang na bzhugs pa'i dpal ye shes snying po lho brag mar pa lo tsā/ spyir rgya gar na 'grel pa dang rgyud rkyang bshad rgyud lnga gzhung phran dang bcas pa dang ye shes zhabs lugs sogs 'grel pa nyer gsum/ jo bo nyer lnga tsam yang gsan par grags/bod na (123ba 'grel pa bdun zer yang mang du snang / mar pa la/ dza ya na/ tha ga na/ snyim rtag gsum yod/lotsā ba 'di rgyagar du gsum/ bal por bzhi ste lan bdun byon/shar nub lho byang kha che bal po'i paṇ+ḍita dang ku su lir grags tshad la bla ma brgya rtsa/brgyud pa 'dzin nges lnga bas rtsa brgyad/ snang ba 'gyur nges bcagasum/ 'dus pa la mkhas pa'i bla ma bdun dang bcas bod pa'i nang gi ye shes snying po 'di dbang brgyud man ngag gdams pa'i bka' thams cad babs pa'i gtso bor 'dzin no/ /bu bzhi'i nang tshan mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ g.yi gi rngog ston chos rdor/dol gyi gas ston dbang nge / gtsang rong gi mo ston r+sā po/ gung thang gi mi lar pa/ 'khon ston gad pa kirti/ de la mi nyag thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ dbus pa gar dge /grub thob zhang zhung pa ste thugs sras gsum gyis gsan/ gsum ga la gang bar sar kha'i rin cen gling pa tshul khrims mdzes rje btsun btsong kha pa/ mkhyen brtse thar rtse/ sgrub khang pa bzhi'i gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung yang kun mkhyen bu'i gsan yig na gling pa tshul khrims mdzes zur du mdzad 'dug pa brtag /bla ma rgya rnal 'byor pho ba lung pa/dge slong chos grags bzang po/ bla ma shākya gar+sha zhe nu/ bla ma blo ldan pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od man sngar ltar ro/ /yang na 'khon gad pa kirti nas/ 'gar ston pa/ gnyan rtse ba/ go lung pa ye rgyal/ rong ston mkhan po/ phug ri pa byang chub gzungs/ shong blo brtan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na lo mchog ba nas/ bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/rje thog ston pa/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab man 'dra/bka' babs bzhi pa jo bo lugs kyi brgyud (124na tha ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ slob dpon nā ga dzo gi /bram ze sar ha/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ zla ba grags pa/ rdo rje lang sngags4kho'i gas yig na bar 'dir rig pa'i khu byug bog pa gdam dpyad/ ku su li che chung / jo bo chen po di paṃ kā ra/rong pa 'gar dge/lha rje stod pa tshul khrims dpal/ sngags pa gos dkar lcang lo ༅/ de sras che ba shes rab rgyal po/ sras chung ba shes rab gtsug tor/ lha rje wo po sto tsakra /thang stong chos kyi 'od/ bla r+sā — 178

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)glog skya grags pa bzang po/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bu dang sngags ram pa'i gas yig na 'di ltar snang ba thar rtse sgrub khang pa'i gas yig na shes rab rgyal ma' zer ba 'dug pa nor ram dpyad/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtshos gsan pa man 'dra/ bu thar rtse sgrub khang shar pa bzhi'i gsan yig na bla ma sgom ye zer ba zhig 'dug kyang de'i brgyud pa gong ma tshigs bcad kyi stabs nas mi gsal zhing / sngags ram pa'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pas slar zhib dpyod/bka' babs lnga pa chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub yan sngar ltar la/ de la slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen/ slob dpon ārla de wa/ klu byang / zla ba grags pa ste sras kyi thu bo bzhi sogs na/ārla de wa nas/ 'phags pa rta dbyangs/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ dril bu pa/ dza las ri pa/ dpe med dpal/ga snyir ma ti pa/ ni ska laṅga pa de wa/ paṇa das/re len+d+ra ba de wa/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ phodakadakar po phyar bu dang zhwa rtse ring ser po/'u yug kung ra ba bla (124bsgo dpal/ phyar bu ba se bo/ bla ma grags chen/don mo ri ba/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na slob dpon klu'i byang chub nas/ 4 ze pa/ bī ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ rdo rje gdan pa/ paṇa dkar/re len+d+ra/ chag lo tsā ba man 'dra/ yang na slob dpon zla ba grags pa nas/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rnam par grags pa'i lha/ rnyog med lha/ paṇa dkar/ gong gi ni ska la pa de wa/rdo rje gdan pa/ 'di gtso don gcig ming gi rnam grangs/ re wa spro/ chag lo man 'dra/bka' babs drug pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sngag rmas pa'i ga yig na klu byang dkyil chog dang mthun pa'i brgyud par ngo tshong / rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ — de wa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bi khyu ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita/ 'od zer shākya/ kha'u pa dar ma shes rab/ se mo ra pa rin cen dpal/ bla ma ra gnyis pa rgyal mtshan rin cen/ sngag sgo pa'i gsan mig na ba ri gnyis pa zer ba 'dug /spro lung nags phug pa kun smon/ bla ma grags—179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()chen pa/ chos rje 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang / sngags ram pa'i gsan yig na sgra khan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen dang mthun pa'i brgyud par mdzad/shar pa'i gsan mig na dbang bka' gsar ma'i nye brgyud du ngos 'dzin/ phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ ma ta lha pa/ sgra gcan (125na 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen/ bi khyu ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen/ sa paṇ+ḍita man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/ shong blo grosabartan pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal seng / mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chosadapal shes rab man sngar bzhin no/ /bka' babs bdun pa dpyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ kha che paṇa chen yan sa lugs dang 'dra ba la/ de nas dpyal chos kyi bzang po/ rje btsun rgya lo/ bla ma dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma don ri grags chen/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na 'gos lo tsā ba nas/ mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mgo pa dharma tsa kra/ stag pa rdzo bzang / dpyal chos bzang man 'dra/ yang na dpyal chos bzang nas/ bod bas/klog skya ba grags pa dpal/ klog skya bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang / sngags ram pa'i gas yig na 'di klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i brgyud par bzhed gsan yig gzhan rnams na rgyud kyi brgyud pa las dbang brgyud mi gsal bas dpyad/ phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje chos/ in+d+ra sgru ti/ pad+ma zhabs/ rta mchog /sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ klu byang / bal po phyag rdor/ rat+na ā ka ra shārnyi pa shrī gī rti/ shrī legs smin/ shrī ku mā ra sha na/ binā ya ka /rat+na badz+ra/ zha lu lo tsā ba chos kyi brtson 'grus/ she ston mar lan/ jo ston dkon seng / kun mkhyen chos 'od/ sre chung pa lte blo ldan/ 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang (125bar she ston nas/ la stod tshul bzang / dpyal nyi ma/ chos sku 'od zer man 'dra/rang lo dgu pa'i steng mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la tshar gcig nos kyang na tshod phra bas/ dbang rdzas sogs la rtsed mo'i 'du shes las brda 'phrod pa zhig ma byung bas brgyud yig gi ce sna la ba ma byas/—180

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i za ma rtag dang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i yid bzhin nor bu'i za ma tog kha 'byed pa'i lde mig ma bu sbyar ba'i steng nas bla na med pa'i snying po las kyang snying por gyur pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud bshad rgyud thun mong ma yin pa bzhis gsal bar byas pa'i don sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis thugs nyams su bzhes nas tai lo nā ro sogs paṇa grub las nye bar 'ongs pa'i gdams pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim rim pa lnga'i dmar khrid zab mo nyams 'khrid du legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin cen/ lha'i bu/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mtshan gsang ba ma ski pa/ tai lo pa shes rab bzang po/ paṇa wo nā ro ta pa/ mnga' bdag mar ba lo tsā chos kyi blo gros/mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kirti/ bya khang pa bsod nams rin cen/ mi nyag thur lha ba tshul khrims skyabs/ rgya mkhar thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ rtse sdings pa gzhen nu 'od/ mag dge (126na)sdings pa kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ chos rje 'phags 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin cen tshul khrims/ mkhas grub tshul khrims rgya kha mtshan/ drin can mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/rigs kun bdag po bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /rje mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig gi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa'ang bshad ma thag pa bzhin no/ /kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig gi lung ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ zha lu pa mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ rje bka' 'gyur ba chen po man 'dra/ kun —181 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonamakhyen bus mdzad pa'i sgron me gsal bar byed pa'i bshad sbyar mtha' drug rab gsal/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mdor byas kyi rgya cher bshad pa skyed rim gsal byed/ des mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi mngon par rtogs pa dngos grub char 'bebs/ 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la bstod pa byin rlabs char 'bebs rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen yab sras/ dpal (126bsgo choge don grub/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra/ zhakhrul zhig rje/ mkhyen rab rje/ byang gling rin rgyal/ 'brog sgar pa/ rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/gro bo lung pa/ rin lding dkon rgyan/ drin can zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /kun mkhyen busamadzad pa'i gsang 'dus chos 'byung mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan las thos/ bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes la gsan gsung / brgyud pa gong ma rnams ma rnyed/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim yang gsal sgron me'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ drung pa lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang / shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ byang ma khang gsar ba dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs/ rgyud sde spyi rnam gsum gyi steng nas 'dzin chos/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa yan gyi ṭīk+ka /rtsa rgyud dang 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba gnyis kyi thog /rje btsun btsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i sa gcad/ mchan bu/mtha' dpyod rin po che'i myu gu rnams sbyar te 'grel ba bzhi sbrags su legs par thob pa'i 'gos lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ mnga' bdag bi su spu lpa/ sa ra ha/(127na kho ga rdzun/ des slob ma'i mchog bzhi la gnang / 'phag pa lha/shākya bshes gar+sā/klu byang /zla grags/bzhi ga la slob pa'i rdo rje/ nag po spyod pa/ sa 'dres pa/ de la di spre kā ra/ de wa ā ka ra/ birla bha dra gsum gyis gsan/ gsum ka la 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ de nas —182

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rdog ye shes seng ge /rdog mu yi/ glan rtsad tsha/ de gnyis ka la rdog ārla de wa/ de nas brtag pa rin cen grags/ lce mdo sde seng ge /dge sdings pa chos sku 'od zer/lce blo ldan seng ge /kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sgra bsgyur nam mkha' bzang po/ rje btsun re mda' ba chen po gzhen nu blo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen po/ mkhas grub shes rab seng ge /rje sbyin pa dpal ba/rje kun dga' don grub/ zhal snga nas lha rin cen/ chos rje chos ldan blo gros/ paṇa chen bsod namasagrags pa/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dge legs dpal bzang / khri rin po che rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ khri rin po che 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i nyi ma dkon cog chos 'phel/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bstsal to/ /yang na glan rtsad tsha nas/ thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ se sdings pa gzhen nu 'od/ dge sdings pa chos sku 'od zer man gong bzhin no/ /yang na glan rtsad tsha nas/ phug pa 'bum skyabs/ gtsang pa smra seng / lce mdo sde seng ge man 'dra/ yang na stag pa rin grags nas (127ba)dge sdings pa/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston man 'dra/ /mar lugs grub thob nyams brgyud ni/rdo rje 'a zang /in+d+ra bhū ti/ ḍā kyi bde ba'i zhabs/ sa pa/ dril bu pa/ a na ṅga badz+ra/ ga spa la pa/ nag po pa/tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā/ mtshur ston dbang rdor/ gad pa kirti/ des thur la ba/ dbus pa 'gar dge /grub thob gzhung pa gsum la gnang / de gsum gas rin cen gling pa tshul mdzes la gnang / de nas rgya pho ba lung pa/ dge slong chos grags/ bla ma shāka gzhen/ lce blo ldan seng ge /'phags 'od man 'dra/ /paṇ+ḍita'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / blo gros rin cen/ klu sgrub/ de la thugs kyi sras bzhi dang nye ba'i sras gsum las ma ta rmi pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ yang na ma ta rmi pa nas/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug /a wa sgyu ti pa/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ nag po'i zhabs/ dri med blo gros/ dpal ye shes snying po/ rje mar pa lo tsā man 'dra/ /chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'amang / phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ ārla de wa/ rta dbyang rol pa'i rdo rje/ dril bu ba/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza las ri/ dpe med —183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dpal/ sa ra ma ti/ ni ska lo ka pa de wa/ re len+d+ra pa de wa/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ 'u yug pa bla ma dpal/ bla ma grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na klu sgrub nas/ klu byang/ shākya bshesaganyen/ rol pa'i rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na sha lan+ta ra nas/ ḍo ma bhi he ru ka /bi ra ḍi ba/ ma snya gi man 'dra/ yang na klu byang nas/ ḍom+bhi pa/ bi ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ rdo rje gdan pa/ re len+d+ra pa/ chag lo man 'dra/ yang na zla grags/ (128na)rol ba'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od 'byung grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ rnam grags lha/ rnyog med lha/ re len+d+ra/ chag lo man 'dra/ rtsa rgyud dang rgyud phyi ma gnyis kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'khon gad pa kirti nas/ 'gar ston jo sras/ ang phug ri ston/ seng ge rdzong pa/ khyung ston zhig po/ mkhan tshul khrims snying po/ mkhan rdo rje snying po/ chos sdings 'og ma zur phug dar ma bzang po/ mkhan bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen/ 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros/ rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ byang chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shesarab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge /rje dge legs bshes gnyen/ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / brang ti nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rim lnga gsal ba'i sgron me'i lung zab bshad legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dan sgo cog chos 'phel yan gong ltar la/ de nas shar chen mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa rnam rgyal/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /gsang 'dus rim lnga'i 'khrid yig zin bris stod rgyud lugs kyi lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel yan gong ltar la/ shar pa chos rje sangs rgyas bkra shis/ stod rgyud slob dpon bzang grong rab (124)'byams pa ngag dbang chos 'phel/ shar chen byams pa rnam rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis legs par bkral ba'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam dpal rdo —184

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rje lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog nag po 'gro shes rnams la brten nas brgyud pa'i bka' babs drug dang ldan pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i lo chen lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dang gnyis su med pa'i a wa dhū ti pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ kun dga' snying po/ tha ga na/ shān+ti pa/ shārnya ka ra warma/ pad+ma ka ra warma/ sngags ram pa'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pa chad dam brtag /de gnyis ka la lo tsā ba chen po rin cen bzang po/ de nas rkyang pa chos kyi blo gros/ dge bshes skyabs seng / rje btsong kha pa'i gas yig na nga mtha' mi 'dug pas brtag /rdo rje sra brtan/ dkon cog 'bar/ dge bshes dbang rin/ khams pa sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ rong pa chos mgon/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ sku zhang chosarje nam mkha' mchog grub/ dka' bzhi pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/mkhan chen rig 'dzin rgyal po/ bla chen chos rig rgyal mtshan/ bla ma (129nasgo sod nams dpal 'byor/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na 'jam dpal/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ tha ga na/ bhu sha na pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ bhi ma shān+ti/ bhi ga ra pā da/ shārnya ka ra warma/ lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po/ rkyang po chos blo/ gcung po zhad khri/ gnyal pa skyogs ston/ khun tsi gzhen nu rin cen/ gtsang rong pa shes rab gzhen nu/ slob dpon dkon cog 'bar/ g.yag sde ba dbang phyug rin cen/ khams ston shākya rdo rje man 'dra/bka' babs gnyis pa jo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ ā nan+da gar+bha/ tha ga na/ rin cen 'byung gnas zhi ba/ jo bo rje mar me mdzad/ lcags ri gong —185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kha ba/ rdzi'u kha pa/ spen phug pa/ yid ye shes/ gze pa don grub/ bar thang pa yab sras dar ma shākya/bsod nams dbang phyug /lo mchog pa man 'dra/bka' babs gsum pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal rdo rje/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ paṇa grub mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba'i zhabs/ bi mā la gup+ta/ rat+na badz+ra/ran+ta kirti/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ mkhan ngag chos pa thar rtse pa shar pa gsum gyi gas mig na ma byung yang /'jam dbyang mkhyen brtse dang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis gnyis kyi gsan yig na 'dug pas chad dam snyam/ bla ma (129ba)pa zhe pa/ sngags ram pa'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pa ho 'dra/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun chen po/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge /sgo dras pa kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/bka' babs bzhi pa rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ sangs rgyas ye shesazhabs/ mar me mdzad/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ dpal bde ba/ dri med sbas pa/ rin cen rdo rje/rin cen grags pa/ sa man+ta pra bha/ dz+nyā na shrī me tra/ rat+na kirti/ pu rdza shrī/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/rdo rje sa brtan man lo chen lugs dang 'dra/bka' babs lnga pa ga lta r+sha ga lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bi mā la gug yan rwa lug ltar la/ de nas yi ge'i rnal 'byor pa/ ga sna pa/ badz+ra shrī/'di gsum sngag ram pa'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pa chad dam snyam/ ba li sto ā tsarla/ gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags/ gnyos rdo rje bla ma/gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pa gdam snyam/ gnyos dpal le/ gnyos grags pa dpal/ gnyos gzi brdzid/ dpal/ sang rgya ra chen rgyal ba lha snang / tsa ri ra 'a/ dpyal kha cho rje zhes pa rnams(130na〉'a gyi rnam grang so/ /ston mo lung pa ye shes mkhar/—186

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na gnyos rdo rje bla ma nas/ gnyos ston grags pa dpal/ gnyos lha snang pa/ rin cen do pa/ mdog stod ser ma/ glas pa dpon rdo rje tshul khrims/ g.yas ru ba rngos ston rin cen rgyal mtshan/ don ri ba grags pa dpal bzang / ma ti paṇa chen man sa lugs dang 'dra/bka' babs drug pa kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad nas rim par brgyud de/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍita gha ya dha ra/paṇ+ḍita bi na shrī/ de la go pa la'i pho brang du khams pa rdo rje dpal gyis zhus/ de nas kirti shrī/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa man sa lugs bzhin no/ /slob dpon chen po jo bo mar me mdzad ye shes kyis legs par bkral ba'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jig rten dbang phyug lha bcu dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du byang gling chos rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi las rim cho ga'i ngag 'don khrigs chags lhan thabs thugs rje'i 'od zer gyi steng nas dbang nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'am ri / 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ 'al pa byang chub rdo rje/rgya lcags ri gong pa/ rdzing bu kha pa shākya grags/ spen phug pa dar ma grags/ zhad ye pa shes rab rdo rje/ gze pa don (130badzo ba mgon po/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ sras chos grags/ dar ma shākya/ bsod nams dbang po/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin cen rnam rgyal/ snye mo sku zhang bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ dka' bzhi pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ mkhan chen skyo ston rig 'dzin rgyal po/ ri sbug dbu mdzad chos rig rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dpal 'byor/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shākya seng ge /chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ rigs kun khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rdzing bu kha pa nas/ thang stong pa chos 'od/ zhang ye —187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa man 'dra/ yang na gze pa don grub mgon po nas/ bar thang pa yab sras/ dar ma shākya man 'dra/yang na lo tsā ba mchog ldan nas/ gshon nu 'od/ grags pa dpal/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston man 'dra/gsang phu gling stod du kun mkhyen dpal ldan 'bras skrungs kyi mkhan thog gnyis pa/ seng ge bzhugs pa'i dus dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du byon te gnang ba'i dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i chos skor nas cung zad nos pa la/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gsang ba'i mgon po dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang / lung la/ las mgon gyi mngon rtogs/ mus srad pa blo gros rin cen gyis mdzad pa'i gtor chen gyi zhal shes/ ltas ngan gtong thabs/ mgon po gri lag ma'i sgrub thabs/ (131na)g.yab dar gyi sgo nas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ dpal mgon dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ rje chos bzang nyi mas mdzad pa'i dpal mgon dkar ser ljang nag gi gtor 'bul/ gnyan lo'i mgul khug ma'i shog dril nas bsdus pa'i man ngag /mus srad pa blo gros rin cen gyis mdzad pa'i mchod gtor 'bul tshul/ gtor chen bca' ba kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge'i zhal gdams/ gtor ma nang du bsgrubs nas nus — 'don thabs/ phyir 'phen tshul/ rnam shes spar ba/ mon pa dang dam tshig bsre tshul/ mnan pa sogs drag las kyi 'khor lo/ phyi nang gi nyams rtags 'byung tshul/ gtor ma'i bkra rtags/ chos skyong 'grub rtags/ bskang mdos/ rten mdos/ zlog mdos/ bod mdos/gsang mdos rnams kyi zhal gdams/ bshan pa'i sngags dang rbad tshul ha la nag po'i shog dril/zhing skyong brgyad kyi lha ngo sprod lugs dang sngags byang / mus srad pa blo gros rin cen gyis gtor chen dang gtor zor gyi yi ge dang bcas pa rnams nos pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang /dpal ldan sha ba ri'i dbang phyug /kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge /mus srad pa blo gros rin cen seng ge /se ba mkhan po chos bzang nyi ma/ se ba dgon pa'i dbu mdzad chos rje/ rje drung rin po che dge 'dun bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de — 188

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)la'o/ /nye brgyud ni/ dpal ldan sha ba ri/ grub chen dpal ldan rdo rje thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje drung rin po che dge 'dun bstan pa rgya mtsho man gong bzhin no/ /lung gi brgyud pa ni/ se ba mkhan po chos bzang nyi ma/ drung pa lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang / thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho man 'dra/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zin bris kyi steng nas rgya gar ka ma ru pa nas brgyud pa'i zhal bram nag bshad pa drug bskor gyi rjes gnang dang zin bris kyi lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / slob dpon klu sgrub/ rgya gar gyi grub thob ka ma ru pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ rje 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma grang mo che ba/ dpe la lar 'di gnyis sbrel ba'i grang mo che ba re gzer ba snang ba ma dag pa 'dra'o/ /rje re ta zla ba/ grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med dpa' bo/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ 'khor lo'i mgon po chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /mnyam med lha rje chen pos sgra rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'i gdong bzhi pa'i gsang sgrub nag po dom mchongs/ des mdzad pa'i gsang sgrub kyi las mtha' nor sgrub rgyal brgyad ma gnyis kyi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tsa tu rmu kha/ dz+nyā na shrī bha dra/ mgon pos mnyam med lha rje la dngos su gnang zer ba 'dug pa 'di mtshan dngos(132na skin pa 'dra zhing / rin po che kun bzang rtse pa'i phyag len du gnyan los mdzad pa'i zhal gyi bskang thung gi skabasamanyam med lha rje chen po'i thugs dam bskang / las mkhan pha rdzo chen po'i thugs dam bskang zer ba 'jug srol kyang 'dug cing / 'di dwags po lha rje dang migacig go/su ma ti shrī bhū ti/ chag lo rin cen chos kyi rgyal po/ khra ri ba rin cen chosargyal/ de la 'u yug dgon pa dkar por rje btsun grol mchog gis gsan/ de nas bstan 'dzin nyi zlabazang po/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags 'jam mgon grub —189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang gsang sgrub kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje btsun mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan nas/zur wo chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /nag po dom mchongs kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po yan rjes gnang ltar la/ de nas chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/ ljang ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan bla chen yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man lung brgyud gong ma bzhin no/ /rgyal brgyad ma'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje dbang rab nas/ rje zha lu pa/ khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag go /rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs drag po brtsegs pa dang dkyil chog dngos grub (132ba)thams cad 'byung ba'i steng nas mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi khro bo dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po lha bco brgyad kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dmar gyis ma brgyud du bshad kyang rgyud 'bum dkar ga dang rje bas tso dga' bzang tsho bca pa ltar bkod do/ /rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ gas yig gas rnams na mi gsal yang gong dkar ba'i gas yig na snang ngo / /mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ grub chen swā wa ri pa/ bu ngor ma' 'tshe thar rtse ba khang pa rnams kyi gsan yig na 'di ltar snang la/rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa'i gsan yig tu sha ba ri pa zhes 'dug /paṇa grub dz+wa wa ri pa/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta de wa pu rna ma ti/ rje ga mi btsong kha pa'i gsha yig tu yi ma ti zhes snang /'gar lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ yul pu rangs pa/ phyar bu pa sto me zhwa can phyis rgya na gtu tshogs/ gshen ston rin cen dngos grub/dmar sgang bu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa dkar/ dmar shes rab rdo rje/ dmar thub pa shes rab/ dmar brtson 'grus rdo rje/ bu dang thar rtse sgrub khang pa gsum gyi gas yig tu brtson yas seng ge zhes snang ba brtag /dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ yar klungs smon gro pa bod bas/dmar shākya grub pa/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/— 190

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang grub chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/rje ngag dbang blo gros/ mar ston tshul khrims rin cen/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dgo'adun bkra shis/ drung pa lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang / shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ (133na)byang ma khang gsar ba dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub/ bla ma zhang 'phrin las lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ desabadag za hor gyi ban+de la bstsal to/ /yang na dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas/ sgang ston rin cen bla ma/sgang ston shes rab 'bum/ gru ston shes rab 'bum/ rje bas btsong kha pa r+sā po'i gsan yig na shes rab grub cesasnang / gru rdo rje seng ge /sngags pa/ gru chos kyi mgon po/ rong ri lung phug pa/ khams ston lho tshang pa/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug /bla ma byang chub rin cen/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rje byams pa mgon po/mkhas grub dge legs pa man 'dra/ yang na dmar shākya grub nas/ yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ rje rin cen legs pa/ chos rje blo grosachos skyong / grub chen bzang po rgyal mtshan man sngar bzhin no/ /mkhyen rab rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'khor chen la brten nas gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga thar pa'i lam ston gyi brgyud pa ni/ mkhyen rab rje/ stong ra ba shākya don grub/ de dbon kun dga' legs grub/ lum pa ba kun dga' chosagrags/ bco brgyad pa mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ sdom brtson 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /'ba' ra ba rgyal (133bsgo tshan dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas gsang ba'i bdag po drag sngags kyi che ba dang ldan pa u tsarla'i rjes gnang med dbang phyag mtshan gyi dbang dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang bdag phyag rdor/ 'phagasapa klu sgrub/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ gong dkar ba/ thar rtse/shar pa gsum gyi gsan yig na 'di gnyis go ldog tu 'dug kyang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig ltar bris pa yin pad+ma badz+ra 'od slob dpon mtsho skyes dang gcig gam snyam o rgyan chen po ni —191 —

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gshin rje gshed kyi skor/rnam snang gi rigs su gtogs pa zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba gshed skor la rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs khro bo rnam rol dang dkyil chog gzhen nu rnam rol gyi steng nas rwa lugs kyi dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag lha bcu gsum ma ras bris kyi dkyil 'bor r+ṣa por dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pra dz+nya rak+ṣi ta/ bal po me lha gling pa thugs rje chen po/ sa dge'i mkhas grub mang po bal bo bha ro dang gcig par mdzad kyang 'di ye rang pa dang bha ro yam bu ba (134bskin zhing thugs rje chen po ni dus 'khor phag mo sogs la shin tu mkhas/ bha ro ni gshin rje gshed kyi grub pa thob pa tsam las mkhas par ma grags pas so sor ma 'dres par dgosapar mdzo no/ /rwa chen lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rab byung / rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /sngags pa dkar masalcang lo pa/ rwa 'bum seng / rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ thar rtse sgrub khang pa shar pa gsum gyi gas yig tu don yod rdo rje yin tshul 'dug pa gsang mtshan dang zhabyu thal ma dpyad/ de sras rong pa shes rab seng ge /'di man rab byung / bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ sngags dkar co bregatso/ thugs sras lo tsā ba ren cen rnam rgyal/ sku shad nam mkha'i mtshan can/ bla ma rin cen dpal grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ mkhan chen rig 'dzin rgyal po/ bla chen chos rig rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor/ rje byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i gshin rje dgra nag po'i mngon par rtogs pa gsod byed rngams pa 'jigs rungs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/ rje sku zhang nam mkha'/ zla ba — 193

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dpal rin/ 'khrul zhig tshul rgyan/ rin cen mchog grub/ rin cen rgyal po/ 'brog sgang pa/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje/ gro bo lung pa/ slob dpon dkon rgyan/ khyab (135na thad ga rin cen bsod namasamachog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i sa la'i pho nya'am dbyangs can lha mo dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba shin tu zab pa dang / lung la/ sgrub thabs/ lo rgyus/ gtor 'bul/ bstod pa gang srid ma/ rjes gnang gi yi ge dang bcas thob pa'i sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sgra dbyangs lha mo/ des yang nas yang du rjes su bzung ba'i paṇ+ḍita bik+ṣa pā ra ma/ paṇ+ḍita shrī ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya da paṇ+ḍi ta bha ska ra de wa/ 'od byed yang gnas yin sto thar rtse bshad pa gnyis kyi gsan yig na 'di dang dza ya ka go ldog tu snang la/ 'dir rdo rje gdan pa dang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig btsan par byasate bkod/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta dwa na shī la/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug /mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog /bsam gtan gling pa nam mkha' bsod nams/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ rje btsun bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na bsam (135ba btan gling pa nam mkha' bsod nams nas/ lha ri pa dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen man 'dra/ yang na yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan nas/ klu pa mkhan po bsod nams dar/ bla ma dmar ston pa/ rin po che kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen man gong dang 'dra/ /rngog lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya ka nas/ rngog lo chen po/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ la stod dkon cog mkhar/— 194

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)slob dpon blo gros khrung gnas/ don mo ri pa blo gsal/ jo btsun lcags thang pa/ dpe dmar ba chos kyi shes rab/ chos rje 'jam dpal gsar ma/ rgyal tsha lung mang po man gong ltar ro/ /yang na 'bre shes rab 'bar nas/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge /gtsang nag mi'i seng ge /lha sa'i bla ma rngog khu dbon gnyis/ rgyal tsha lung mang po man 'dra/ mar do lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ ku su lu pa/ dpal 'dzin/ rgyalapo rā dza kā ya/ de'i yig mkhan paṇ+ḍita/ paṇ+ḍita 'bum phrag gsum pa/ bal po dha ma ta la/ de gnyisaka la mar do lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis zhus/ de nas gze pa blo ldan/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/sras dharma kirti/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa man sngar (136na)bzhin no/ /gshin rje nag po'i mngon rtogs rgyud don rab gsal dang thugs sras rin po che'i gtum chen rol ba dkyil chog dgra nag dang cha mthun pa'i phyag len ltar rwa lugs kyi 'jam dpal gshin rje nag po zhal drug pa lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ nag po pa/ bha da pa/ dha ma pa/ de wa pa/ dze tā ri pa/ a rna ga badz+ra/ dharma ka ra shārnyi/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar 'dug kyang kun mkhyen bu'i gsan yig na dharma snar ma ti dang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na a ka ra ma ti zhes snang / thar rtse sgrub khang shar pa gsum gyi gsan yig na dharma ā kā sha ma ti zhesag pa brtag /bal po thugs rje chen po nas/ zha lu pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi bar dgra nag sor bzhag la/ de nas brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / de dbon thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ gnasagasar ba rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /dgra gdong gnyis thun mong gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ bu'i gsan yig na 'di mi 'dug pa brtag /dpal bde ba/ bi — 195

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yonam la gup+ta/ kuṇ+ḍa pa/ sa man+ta bha dra/ shrī dha ra/ ka ya dha pa/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na ka yas pa zer ba snang / dz+nyā na mi tra/ dz+nyā na mi tra/ rat+na kirti/ 'di gnyis kyi bar du bu dang gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu pe rnya pa zer ba 'dug pa ga dam snyam/ so na shrī/ bal po thugs rje chen po man sngar (136ba bzhin no/ /mngon rtogs gas chen rol ba'i brgyud pa ni/ gso byed rngams pa 'jigs rungs dang gcig go /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ro langs brgyad skor lha dgu pa rwa lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i lung brgyud sogs/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rab gsal zla ba'i steng nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ro langs brgyad skor lha dgu pa rwa lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rdo rje ro langs ma/ grub chen la lī ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī po ka ra rak+ṣi ta/ bal po bha ro phyag wo yang zer/ rwa chen lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /rwa 'bum seng / klog skya dbang phyug grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon cog dpal/rgyal ba brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang /shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rje lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / e waṃ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ gnas gsar ba rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na glo bo mkhan chen nas/ sa — 196

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ gnyan chen grags pa blo gros/ chos rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na rwa 'bum seng yan gong ltar la/ de nas rong (137na)pa rga lo/de sras shes rab seng ge /bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /kun mkhyen bu ston/ sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'amang kun dga' bzang po man 'dra/ yang na rong pa shes rab seng ge nas/ rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bu ston man gong ltar ro/ /yang na rwa 'bum seng nas/rwa pa'i lhar ngo bzhi po ni sngags pa gos dkar lcang log/ rwa dharma seng ge /rwa dkon cog seng ge /rwa chen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon cog dpal man 'dra/ yang na rong pa shes rab seng ge nas/ bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal/ rwa lo gnyis pa dge ba rgyal mtshan/ gra thang pa shes rab zla ba/ sngags 'chang rin cen rnam rgyal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin cen/ rje lha mchog seng ge man sngar bzhin no/ /mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rwa chen lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs yid bzhin gter mdzod dang dbang gi chu bo gnyis la rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gsal byed lhan thabs nyi gzhon gsar ba'i dga' ston dang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i ngag 'don breng chags nag po 'gro shes rnams kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i steng nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs thun mong ma yin pa lha bcu gsum gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal khros pa'i zhal lung (137bskong gi zungs khrag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can gyi steng nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi nyams 'khrid zab mo smin rgyas/grub pa'i dbang phyug la sī ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i 'khrid don gsal byed rgyal khams lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrīdz+nyā nas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams 'khrid —197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)zab mo/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i zin bris la brten nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang / phyag mtshan mda' gzhu la brten pa'i bi ṣa gsad pa'i las tshogs dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i tho yig la brten nas las gshin dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang / thar gling pa ārla de wasamadzad pa'i yi ge dang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mthong brgyud ltar phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa'i las gshin gsum gyi rjes gnang gi yi ge la brten nas 'chi bdag gshin rje'i dbang phyug lha bcu gsum gi rjes su gnang ba/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i yi ge la brten nas las kyi gshin rje dmar po bse bya bzhi bskor gyi rjes gnang / gtor chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge'i steng nas gshin rje dmar po khrag mdog yab yum gyi rjes gnang rnams nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ rwa chen shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag na gsal ba'i chos skor/ der ma 'khod pa'i rgya bod kyi yig sna'i skor/ bod kyi mkhas pa 'bri khung dpal 'dzin (138na)gyis mdzad pa'i skor dang gsum/dang po la/ rwa lugs kyi gshin rje gshed nag po skor gsum du grags pa'i dkar chag rwa chen gyis mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad dang de'i rgyas bshad rwa dbon shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ der gsal ba'i yig sna la/ rgyud 'bum pa las la lī ta badz+ra gyis phyung ba'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed khros pa'i rgyal po'am rtsa (/lo7kun/ba'i rgyud rtog pa bdun pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā kā ru ni ka dang bod kyi lo tsā ba rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba 'di'i 'gyur ye rang pa sa sa rje r+pā po dang 'og nas 'gung ba'i mo lhas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog 'gyur du bha ro'i mas smos pas kyang 'di gnyis tha dad par 3 mas grub bo/ /slob dpon chen po a mo gha badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'bor (rwa)(/ / e gyi cho ga dngos grub brnyes pa'i bla ma bha ro dang rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdzad pa po dang sgyur byed gong 'dra/ des mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs las su bya ba'i cho ga sems dpa' 'di rwas swā ra bcos mdzad pa'i gas wa kha yis yang rwa — 198

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (kanar+ṣa gyi gsung la kha cig gsar 'gyur kha cig bcos zhes pa ltar na 'gyur btsos mdzad par mdzo/bsdus pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po mnyu shrī dz+nyā na dang bod kyi lo tsā ba rong sgom chos bzang rong zom chos bzang yin min brtag/gis bsgyur cing 'gos lhas btsas dbang // / yo kyi zu/ zhus te gto la phab pa/slob dpon rat+na a skar shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi shā spu / na kyi na / tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya gar gyi mkhan po di paṃ ka ra 38bang k+ṣi ta bha ro phyag rdum/dang lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/rgyud 'bum pa nas phyung ba'i lasamakhan te'u lo pa'i rtog pa dang te'u lo pa'i cho ga'am rtog pa zhib mo di paṃ ka ra dang rwa lo rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur pa/ slob dpon shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dkar chag na rtog pa zhes pa las mi gsal pa gcig tu bsdoms pa 'dra'o//mdor bsdus pa 'gyur byang mi gsal yang rwa'i 'gyur yin nam snyam/'di'i rjes su bha ros mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gsum zhes pa dpe ma 'byor pas ma thob/rwa chen rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi (/lo| rdzi yo kyi shen ga 'grel dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshig don rnam par bshad pa/rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis dbang phyug ོ po 'dul ba'i ched du 'jigs byed sprul tshul gsungs par mkhas grub rje ma dag ces gsungs pa ni/rwa chen gyis/rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog bdun la//nag 'grel mun pa'i mda' 'phen tsam//zhes pa'i 'grel pa 'dir gsal bar gsungs pa ma gzigs pa 'a〉 spo /4gdo / ga/gas na mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis brgal bar sems so//des mdzad pa'i dkar ra tu de rje rdo kyi nan 'grel rtog pa bdun pa'i man ngag gi gnad du grags pa dpe la lar dka' gnad kyi 'grel pa'i brda dag bris yod khrug kyang dkar 'a/////ma// byim rdo gto/bcud kyi thigs pas phog par bsnun
