zhes pas shes so//des mdzad pa'i rtog bdun ra de rje kunagand kyi gdams ngag bas kyi thigs pa/de'i gsung ha la'i shog dril (/lo|bad(tho kyi shedang po'i (pe tu snus lo sdo)rtsa ba gcig las mang na khyod snying khos kyi mtha' can/'i rtsa ba smyo she //9//she rdzogs so kunakhong pa'i nang nas snying drongs shig gi mtha' can/sum pa'i rtsa ba ( shes snub kun na rdzogs so'i mtha' can/des mdzad pa'i rtog pa dang po bsnyen pa'i / ༷ dang rtog pa gnas pa sgrub pa'i cho ga gnyis la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub dgra srog dbang sdud dam bsnyen sgrub las gshin sbrel ba/ des mdzad pa'i lha bcu gsum ma'i mngon (re/9kund(mkhas par rtogs pa yid bzhin gter mdzod/ des rgyal ba bkra shis kyi ngor mdzad pa'i gtso rkyang (re/do ku ni)zhal dgu phyag so bzhi ma'i mngon rtogs dri med snang ba/ des mdzad pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug (rwa)(rdo kyin/pa'i mngon rtogs khams gsum za byed des ston pa a gro'i don du mdzad pa'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi (mi yo kyi ni)pa'i mngon rtogs dri med chu rgyun/ des mdzad pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis(spyi yo kyi ni)pa'i mngon rtogs rin cen don bsdus/des rwa chos rab kyi don du (/lo su ྂ shemadzad pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mi mthun kun sel/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ( she(rdo kyin/'dod pa kun 'phel/ dbang gi sbyin sreg (re/zhe ni/gnad kyi lcags kyu/ des sngags 'chang khro rgyal dang blo ldan gnyis kyi don du mdzad (rwa)( kyi shepa'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dgra bgegs kun 'dul zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i dug dbang lo rgyus dang (shi re/bcas pa dbang bskur zhal gdams so'i mtha' can/ dbang dang zas tshad phan (zhe re/yon gsum bstan pa/ bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel zhing nad gso ba 'as)la gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dmar (139ba)po'i mngon rtogs sngon por bsgyur yod do'i mtha' can/ gu lang (she(legs)gi mgo can la brten nas bzlas pa/ sngags kyi gnas pa/ dug brtag pa/ bsrung bya/ gso thabs rnams bstan pa'o8)1 pe ga )bhi sha bzhi skor/ bshal (re/(legs)bya ba/ sngags kyis bhi sha phyogs med (re/(legs)thub pa kha ri su/ rdzas dgus(/lo ligs/bhi sha phyogs med thub pa/ ser po (rwa)(legs/gsum sbyor/ rna ba mig sogs lus kyi cha gang la babs pa(mi(klog rme)sngags rdzas gtar kha sman la brten nas 'chos pa/ phyag mtshan mda' gzhu la brten nas bhi sha gsad pa'i las bstan pa (3)(legs)lcags rtse zlum po 'jib pa gnad yin gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ dug khyer yod pa'i mi dang nad pa'i brtags (re/9 pe gzu)thabs nag por song na bhi sha yin gyi mtha' can/ 'jigs byed glang mgo gyi bhi sha (re/(legs)gso srung badz+ra rak+ṣa kirtis ā tsarla la zhus pa badz+ra bhe ra'i rak+ṣa'i mtha' —200—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)can/ sngags thams u pa(re)9 pe gzu)ta bya thā/ bya ra bsrung bya/ khyab 'jug mtho tra'i 'jug pa la(ni lo yigs/brten nas brtag thabs/ tho rengs kyi dri chur (/yo pe gzu)brtag cing srung ba/ dug (re kyi pho pe gzu)'breng / sngags(/lo yigazu)bshal/ khyi spyon gyis rmugs (re/9 pe garme)par dug yod med blta ba/be bum /ba pa'i nang gi (she(ligs rig dril gyi gdams pa shin tu gces pa'i skor dpe la dam par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ dmar po mda' gzhu 'geng ba la brten pa'i dbang sdusaskal med rnams la sba ba shis kyi mtha' can/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dmar po phyag gnyis pa sgom thabs/(140na)rgyal po/ bas mo/ blon 'bangs/ grong khyer sde brgyad sogs dbang du bya ba/ nag po mda' gzhu 'geng ba'i dug sngags 'di las lhag pa yod ri skan gyi mtha' can/ rwa chen gyi (mkhan/mdzad pa'i dbang gi chu bo rnams/ gnyis pa dkar chag na ma 'khod pa'i rgya bod kyi yig sna'i skor la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa gsum pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po di paṃ ka ra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dngo grub kyi rtog pa dang 'gyur gcig pa zhig dang aḍa ya shrī dang rong zom gyi 'gyur yang snang /rgyud kyi rgyal po'i las dngos grub kyi rtog pa zhes pa rtog pa bzhi par grags pa a mo gha dang mar do'i 'gyur/gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa dang las mkhan te'u lo la chu byi'i rtog pa gnyis bha ros rgyud 'bum pa la gtugs te rgya dpe las bye ba/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen yon tan dpal bzang gi ngor mdzad (shar/pa'i rgya bal gyi paṇ+ḍi ta lnga'i rnam par thar pa/ des mdzad pa'i la sī ta badz+ra gyis ( sha re/nag po skor gsum gyi rgyud o rgyan nas gdan drangs tshul/ rgyud dang bla ma brgyud pa byon tshul gyi lo rgyus don gsum pa rgya ston gyi slob (shar/ma zhig gis mdzad pa/ rdzong lugasazab don bdud rtsi'i bstod (dub/kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sku bzhi'i ngo bo/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs (nub)rab tu gsal ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi ngor mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub rin po che'i snye ma/ des mdzad pa'i dpa' bo (140ba)gcig pa'i sgrub thabs (mkhan/bdud las —201 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonarnam par rgyal ba'i ba 'ad sgra/ des mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyis bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi lam rim dang sbyar ba'i smon lam gyi rab byed lam zab sgrub pa'i dga' ston/ des mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i shis brjod 'chi med sprin gyi rnga dbyangs/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad (sa/pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches shing kun tu mdzad pa'i (sdo nge/dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga /tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i bcu gsum ma'i/(mkhand(pha)sgrub dkyil gsal byed lhan thabs nyi gzhon gsar pa'i dga' ston/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis (mkhan/mdzad pa'i ngag 'don breng chags nag po 'gro shes/ mthu stobs dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i (pu)rwa lugs lha bcu gsum gyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub par bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge mthong ba don ldan/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bzlas lung bsnyen (ni lo rdo rje/pa'i man ngag bla ma snya nam pa'i gsung lhag chad med par rwa chos rab kyis gzhon nu 'od kyi ngor mdzad pa/ badz+ra bhe ra wa e ka mu kha bhū dza di pa'i rjes(dhi/gnang gi zin bris rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa'i gsung bzhin 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtsesamadzad pa/ ngor shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub (5)thabs (141na dang dug dbang bskur tshul gyi man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po rwa lugs kyi dbang gi cho ga las (sa)brtsams pa'i dri ba rtog dpyod sprin gyi rnga gsang gi rang lan dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dga' ston legs bshad khu byug gi sgra dbyangs gsar pa/ des mdzad pa'i dbang gi cho ga'i dka' gnad las ltas)brtsams te dris pa'i rang lan snying po mdzub tshugs/ rtog pa bdun gyi gnad bstan pa rwa sto (du lo3ge seng ges mdzad pa'i man ngag gnad bdun ma/ rdo rje 'bum dang rdo rje seng ge sogs kyi ngor rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis (skyi lo3gas)mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi rnam —202

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bshad rdo rje'i tshig gi mdud 'grol/ des mdzad pa'i rtog gsum kyi ḍiska rtog ge dri med snang ba/ rwa dharma seng shes mdzad pa'i te'u lo (zhar/pa'i rtog pa'i gsal byed/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rgya che ba zab pa gnyis su med pa dang bcas par sems 'dzin pa'i man ngag rwa chen gyi gsung sgros/ de'i gsung sgros mtshan ma gyen bsgreng gi man ngag /de'i gsung sgros rwa la sems 'dzin pa'i man ngag /rje btsun rdo rje be+e ta lis la lī ta badz+ra la dngos su gnang (rje/ba'i rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi rtsa ba rdo 'phung bar byed pa/ gtun shing gis rim dbab cing 'dre brdung ba/ chu gris grir 'gum pa/rdo rje rtse gcig pas gdon bsrung ba/ dgra stas dgra bo tshar gcod pa/ mdung gis cho 'phrul gtong ba/ mda' 'khor los las kun bsgrub pa/ gsal shing gi ros ro langs bsgrub pa/ me thab kyis sbyin sreg gi cho ga bsgrub pa/ thod tshal gyis dgra bo gnad la dbab pa/ sdigs mdzub kyis 'gal ba cham la dbab pa/ 'phan dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bshang lam nas snying gi dkyil lo'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i phyag len de la gshegs su gsol lo'i mtha' can/ gsad pa 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung rgyun 'di ni gshin rje mkhan po phal cher la ming tsam yang ma grags pa'i zab gnad can yin pas mjug tu/ e ma rwa lo'i thugs bcud mkha' 'gro'i gtam/ /snyan brgyud ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bal bo thugs rje chen po la gser srang lnga brgya phul (/lo|ba)(rum)bar zhal gyis bzhes nas gnang ba'i drag po bzhi'i gsang bzlog yi ger (144na 〉 mi 'dri ba'i bka' rgya can/ mgor bdag nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal zhes yod pa'i yi ge (|ba)bzhi pa'i man ngag nyi ma —206

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dang sprad do'i mtha' can/ mgor rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs la zhes yod pa'i yi ge bzhi pa'i (re/(nub)bsrung bzlog gsang gsum (shar/brten pa'i gtad rul/ ngag ( 'e re/'grol/ mgor dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed khro bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo zhes (ma)yod pa'i — dzi'i bsrung bzlog man ngag lag len dmar khrid phyogs med lo tsā bas gsal bar bkod pa/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor dpal khro bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo 'dir bdag gzhan thams cad kyi lus ltam)srung bar byed pa zhes yod pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi bri yig /des mdzad pa'i 'gor gnyis pa bzlog pa'i 'khor lo ni snga ma lta bu la ltam)ming spel gyi mthar zhes yo pa'i bzlog 'khor bri yig /des mdzad pa'i 'gor : dpal ldan khro bo chen po la phyag 'tshal lo ming dang rnam shes sba ba la zhes yod (ma)pa'i stso dzi'i bsrung 'khor rmi lam ngan pa zlog pa byad ma mkhan —207—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonagyi bsod nams nyams thabs byas pas mi tshugs pa dang bcas pa/ des mdzad pa'i zlog pa'i rnal 'byor khyad (ma)par can rngon pa nyi ma lde zhing gdos dang sha ba 'thab pa lta bu'i man ngag /des mdzad pa'i uṣ+ṭi dzi'i sgo ltam)nas dam nyams gsod pa'i mtshon cha/ des brag dkar chos sdings su bkod pa'i bsrung bzlog (ma)gnyis kyi man ngag sngags pa nang 'gras dang gsad pa gzhan du gsal ba'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i / dzi'i bskul(ma)rnam dag zhi ba ma/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa(ma)thugs rje'i dbang khros ma/ las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs la lī ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa bal bo thugs rje chen po dang rwa lo rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ ro ras dang thod pa la brten nas las gshin sgrub cing bsnyen sgrub gsang ba'i man ngag lo tsā ba (145na)phyi mas yi ger btab pa/las kyi gshin rje srid pa'i 'khor lo'i man ngag rwa chen gyis lcags sgom ras pa la gnang ba srid pa'i 'khor lo rdzogs byang gis mtha' can/ dge 'dun gtsug lag khang bsrung ba'i gshin rje srid pa'i 'khor lo bka' rgya dam po yod do:'i mtha' can/ las kyi gshin rje gnam lcags ur chung gi gdams pa zhes pa bsrung bzlog gsad pa'i sngags zlog pa yin na sngags bzla zhing gsad pa lham mthu ma dang bcas pa sus kyang mi shigs pa'i man ngag lags so'i mtha' can/ las kyi gshin rje'i yig chung drag sngags hur thum srog len dmar po snya nam pa'i man ngag yig chung zab mo rdzogs byang bi mtha' can/ dkon cog gi bstan dgra ya ma rnams kyis 'dul bar khas blangs tshul/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje gnad la phab nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i yi ge drag sngags kyi rgyan du dgos pa'i yig chung3ni'i mtha' can/ 'chi bdag sgrub (rje/thabs bshes gnyen tshul khrims bla ma bskul ba'i ngor rgya ston gyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi mchod pa'i cho ga (4)9ri)khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang gis mdzad pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos las dang po pa'i rigs 'dzin rnams la phan pa'i ched du mdzad pa'i (mkhan)las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i cho ga/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i dam can gshin rje'i rgyal —208

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)po'i mngon rtogs spyan 'dren (dbang/gtor 'bul bstod pa dang bcas pa'i chog sgrigs/ des mdo khams (145ba)pa sbyin pa dpal bzang gi ngor mdzad pa'i 'chi bdag (mkhan)gshin rje'i dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang ba mi bzad 'jam dpal ma/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad (dbang/pa'i las gshin gyi bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis bkod pa/ las gshin bcu gsum ma'i rjes gnang gi yi ge thar gling (4snyun ārla de was bkod pa/ las gshin dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang gi tho (dbang/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gshin rje dmar nag gsum gyi rjes gnang gi (sa/cho ga'i lag len shin tu gsal ba rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ gshin rje dmar po ma ru tse bzhi skor du (rje/grags pa snying la brten pa'i phyi sgrub/ spyang thod la brten pa'i nang sgrub/ nal gri'i thod par brten pa'i gsang sgrub/ ra spyang gi thod par brten pa'i gsang chen chig dril/ gtor chog bstod pa dang bcas pa rdo rje dpal ba'i don du rgya ston gyi mdzad pa/ las kyi gshin rje khrag mdog yab yum gyi bsnyen sgrub (dpal)las gsum gyi man ngag rwa dbon shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dge bas bstan pa bsrung bar shog gi mtha' can/ de'i gtor chog rjes gnang dang bcas (dpal)pa'i cho ga rnams/ gsum pa bod kyi mkhas pa 'bri gung dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i skor la/ kun dga' dbang phyug gis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i rtog pa gsum pa'i rgyas 'grel rin po che'i snye ma/rtog pa gsum pa'i tshig gis mtshams bcad cing don gyi go rim bsdu ba/ dpal rtog pa gsum pa'i (146na tshe mo rgyal 'khor gyi cho ga khams gsum gyi 'khor los sgyur ba khrag skyugs kyi lo chos dkar nam mkha'i rdzong du mdzad pa/ de las drag shul spyod pa'i cho ga zhib mo gud du bstan pa zad pa'i lo nag pa zla ba'i dkar tshes bzhi la mdzad pa/ rtog pa gsum pa'i man ngag gi zhal shes lnga pa zhes pa snyan brgyud yi ge med pa'i zin bris mdangs dkar snying rje'i rdzong du mdzad pa/ rtog pa gsum pa'i 'byul 'khor rdzong ri rtse dgu'i mgul du mdzad pa/ thar pa'i rgyal srid la gnas pa'i dge sbyong —209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonachen po'i bkas bskul ba la brten nas 'brul 'khor gyi lung sbyor rin cen 'od kyi sgron ma/ dpal rtog pa bdun pa'i 'brul 'khor gyi cho ga 'khor lo rin po che'i bang badzod chos dkar nam mkha'i rdzong du mdzad pa/ de la mkho ba'i zin bris 'gor rtog bdun gyi rgyas 'grel slob dpon mi bskyod pas mdzad ces yod pa rang bzo med par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub lag tu blang ba'i rim pa snying gtam glen pa'i tshig tu btsun pa kun dga' dbang phyug la gdams pa/ rtags kyi yi ge zhib mo khrag skyug gi lo lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzong du mdzad pa/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bzlas pa'i tshul nges pa seng ge'i nga ro me byi mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/drag po'i las kyi bzlas pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon cha me byi mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/'di sngags bsdebs yin 'dug pa gsar ma phyogs la grags chung bas dpal 'dzin rtsa ba gsang sngags rnying ma bar song gshis snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi man ngag (146ba)zab mo nas rku thabs kyi tshul du bris par mngon no/ /mdo khams tre shod pa rtogs ldan bsod nams dpal gyis bskul ba la brten nas thang skya'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa'i las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg dngos grub kyi gzi brjid rab snang / zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg nyes pa'i tshang tshing ma lus pa sreg par nus pa bsod nams kyi nyi ma bdun 'bar mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ rgyud rtog pa bdun pa'i 'byul 'khor gyi skabs su khyim du bzhag na zhi bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i man ngag zhi ba'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ de'i yan lag 'jigs pa zhi ba'i bsrung 'khor/ mtshon bsrung ba/ tshe sgrub dang bcas pa/ gtsang rong dmu lha sham+bha ra gyi gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ yang gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i rgyas pa'i las sgrub pa'i cho ga yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'bar ba yan lag dang bcas pa/dbang du bya ba'i cho ga don yod pa'i zhags pa rnam par g.yo ba/ de'i yan lag 'gugs pa'i cho ga lcags kyu 'bar ba/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa gang rung gi lam gyi grogs su rig pa'i skyes bu 'gugs pa zhu ba'i bsam gtan rig ma mi bsrun pa 'dul thabs bu mo rengs pa'i sbyor ba rnams me byi sham+bha ra —2/0

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dpal gyi yang dgon du mdzad pa/ dbang dang 'gugs pa'i cho ga 'jig rten gsum rnam par gnon pa mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ drag po'i cho ga gshin rje'i gzugs la brten nas dgra sde 'phung bar bya ba'i man ngag 'jig rten gsum gyi bshad pa chen po rnam par rol ba skal ldan sbyin pa rin cen gyi ched du mdzad pa/ 'jig rten (147na gsum gyi bshan pa chen po rnam par rol pa ma grub na spogs pa'i cho ga 'jig rten gsum za ba me pho byi ba'i lor mdzad pa/ gsad pa'i 'phrin las ga'u bsre ba'i man ngag gsum rnam par 'joms pa'i 'khrul 'khor me khyi mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ yang gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i sdig pa sbyang ba'i cho ga sbyin sreg dang zhabrul 'khor sbrags pa 'jig rten gsum 'phung bar byed pa/ mdza' ba dbye bar byed pa sham+bha ra du mdzad pa/ yang gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i sdang ba yul nas dbyung ba bskrad pa'i 'brul 'khor gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i g.yam pa la brten nas rengs pa'i cho ga 'jig rten gsum rnam par g.yo ba/ gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i te'u lo pa'i pags pa la brten nas rengs pa'i cho ga 'jig rten gsum rnam par 'ching ba/ gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i yan lag mtshon gyis 'bugs pa'i man ngag 'jig rten gsum pham par byed pa/ srin pos 'dzin pa'i cho ga las kyi srin po zhes bya ba mtshur phur mdzad pa/ yang de nyid du mdzad pa'i rims nad gtong ba'i mar ngag rims nad chen po zhakhrug pa/ yang gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i spyo bar byed pa'i cho ga drag po'i bzhad gad chen po/ drag shul spyod pa'i gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'i cho ga sdig can sgrol ba'i mtshon cha ngar ma mdangs dkar snying rje rdzong du mdzad pa/ lugs srol 'di la lcags mkhar mi rtsig pa'i phyogs su mdzad nas/ lcags mkhar zur dgu pa dang zur bcu drug pa sogs spro na byar rung gi 'on kyang rnying ma ba ltar blos btags nas byas pa yin pas rgyud rgya gzhung (147ba tshe shi khungs ni med la zhes zur za ba ni spyir kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad blos btags nas byas pa kho na yin pas gzhud lugs dang 'gal zhing rgyud rgya gzhung gi khungs med bzhin du gsar ma ba rnams spro na byar rung ba'i dam bcar song bas pha ma thob pa'i gzhu cig 'dir shor bar gda'o/ /—211—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonam 'grub na gnad la dbab pa'i cho ga sa gsum nges par 'joms pa me byi mtshur phur mdzad pa/ yang de nyid du mdzad pa'i gsad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dus kyi me lce 'bar ba chen po'i 'phreng ba/ rtsa sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor bri ba'i zin bris bris pas chog go'i mtha' can/ rtog bdun 'khrul 'khor mchog gi man ngag rdzong ri rtse dgu'i mgul du brjed byang du mdzad pa/ las kyi gshin rje yab yum sbrags te sgrub pa'i man ngag dug ha la ha la chen po zhes pa lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzong du sbyar ba rnams/'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa dag gtor ma'i cho ga'i lag len bsod nams kyi 'od zer rnam par spel ba'i nyi ma zhes bya ba gnyis kyi lung rgyun deng sang mi 'dug /gtor ma'i cho ga 'di la zhi rgyas dbang drag gi drug cu pa'i khyad par sogs legs bshad ngo mtshar ba snang / 'di nyid gshed skor la shin tu mkhas pas rgya gar gyi slob dpon dpal 'dzin dang 'dra zhes gleng bar brten mtshan de ltar thogs/ rin cen snye ma'i mthug tu/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhang ston bsod nams grags/ /mnyam med de yi gsung la brten pa'i mthus/ /rgya chen rgyud dang rgya gar mkhas pa'i lugs/ /bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin 'dir bshad (148nasgo/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dpal 'dzin bzang po la/ zhes gsungs pa rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nar mngon zhing rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi sgo nas las bzhi sgrub par 'dod na 'di nyid las lhag pa'i legs bshad bod na yod par ma mthong gsang sngags rnying ma ba rnams sngags klog sun 'byin gyi rtsod pa 'khon du bzung nas yal bar 'dor ba'i mched por paṇa chen gser mdog can pas sdom gsum la dri ba mdzad pa dang / chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas rab gnas dang bde mchog nag po'i skor la zhus dag par sa lugs rnams rje btsun gong ma la 'khrul pa med ces log par rtog /stag tshang lo tsā bas rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal sogs la rtsod pa mdzad par rang phyogs dge lugs rnams chos rje sher rin pa'i legs bshad rnams 'dor/ sdom gsum dang lhag bsam rab dkar sogs mtshang du phog pa'i dwags brgyud pa rnams rje btsun sa paṇa dang rgyal ba btsong kha par ma gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ston —212

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pas mtshon te a pha'i gsol zhal ma gtsang dogs pa'i sbubs 'thum gyi ra bar thugs blo tsab tsub tu gyur pa zhig tu thugs bden na'ang / shes bya'i mtha' la tshad gzung med pas thugs sems rang mal du phab pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jog pa zhu/ de ltar gong du smos pa'i smin grol rnams legs par thob pa las dbang brgyud dang po kha'u ba'i lugs dang / sa bcad dang po dang gnyis pa'i rwa'i rtags yod pa dang rtags gang yang med pa'i lung rnams dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs khrosapa drag (148ba)po rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po/ rje btsun rdo rje ro langs ma/ grub chen la lī ta badz+ra/ rdo rje gdan pa a mo gha badz+ra/ paṇa grub ye shes khrung gnas sbas pa/ grub chen pad+ma badz+ra/ bla ma bal bo bha ro phyag rdum/ di paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta dang gcig kyang rdzong lugs kyi gsan yig na di baṃ kā ra dang bha ro thugs rje chen po zhes so sor bgrangs shing / bha ro dang thugs rje 'a po gcig pa sogs yig nor byung bar ma'/ rwa chen lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /rwa 'bum seng / rong pa rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ khams pa rga lo'i skye bar grags pas de ltar thogs/ de sras rong pa shes rab seng ge /brag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang / rwa lo gnyis pa dag pa rgyal mtshan/ gra thang ba shes rab zla ba'i dbang po/ rje bsno rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje la'i tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /dgon gsar ba mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rgyud lnga ni mkhan chen bslab gsum pa'ang gsan/ dus dgra'i dbang po 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bstsal to/ /yang dbang khe rkyang gi brgyud lugs rnam grangs ni tshar chen/mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ yab sras de gnyis la rje dbang rab kyis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na rje mkhyen brtse la/ mkhan bslab gsum pa/ rje bsod na mas tshulu khrims gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka nas rje dbang rab man 'dra/ /dbang brgyud gnyis pa ngor lugs ni/ rong (149na)pa sher seng nas/ 'phags 'od tan rgya —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mtsho/spang khang pa grags pa dpal bzang /kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po/tshar chen man 'dra//yang kun gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/rwa 'bum seng yan gong ltar la/de nas rwa dkon cog seng ge/rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/sras shes rab seng ge/kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/grub chen kun dga' blo gros/rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/chos rje rin cen rnam rgyal/'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen/rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man gong ltar ro//dbang brgyud gsum pa gong dkar lugs dang ldong gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/rwa 'bum seng nas/klog skya dbang phyug grags/ldong ston shes rab dpal/chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/shar gling pa rgyal mtshan bzang po/sgo rum pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan/bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen seng ge dpal/brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med dpa' bo/bla ma bsod nams mchog ldan/'brasaspungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man sngar bzhin no//yang na chos rgyal 'phags pa nas/gan pa chos rgyal/gan pa chos149ba chin/gan pa rin rgyan/mkhar/ chen shes rab rdo rje/chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/brag thog pa man 'dra//yang dbang gi brgyud tshul mi 'dra ba gcig dang /sa gcad dang po yongs rdzogs dang rigs kyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/rong pa shes rab seng ge nas/mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/chos rje dge legs bzang po/bla chen chos dpal bzang po/rtsa brgyad ston bkra shis bzang po/bya btang bsam grub rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang rdo rje rgyal mtshan/rje nam mkha' dpal bzang /mang thos dpal ldan chos skyong /mchog gi sprul sku rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/yang dbaX brgyud lugs gcig ni bla chen pa nas/rje seng

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yag gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ge dbang phyug/rje 'od zer seng ge/dpal ldan chos skyong man 'dra/yang na bla chen pa nas/gragasapa rgyal mtshan/rje nor bu phun sum tshogs/chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/drung btsun rin cen rnam rgyal/rje nor bu phun tshogs/dpal ldan chos skyong man 'dra//lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/rje dge legs bzang po nas/rdzong pa ā nan+da ma ti/ bla ma shākya dpal/'khon ston byams pa dpal/rje dpal ldan chos stong man gong bzhin no//yang dbang gi brgyud tshul mi 'dra ba gcig ni/rwa 'bum seng nas rwa sto seng ge/rwa dkon cog seng ge/rwa shes rab rgyal mas/rgya ston dbang phyug rgyal mas/rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/khams pa yon to 'bum/bla ma brtson tsos bzang po/dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/grub 150na bā na bzang po rgyal mtshan/mthu stobs dbang phyug 'bom pa 'jigs byed pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/rwa chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/yang na bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims nas/bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang /dmar ston rgyal mas 'od zer man gong ltar ro//yang na rong pa sher seng nas/mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes/mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/'jag chen byams pa dpal/dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer man 'dra/yang na gu ge paṇ+ḍita grags pa rgyal mtshan nas/slo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ngor chen lha mchog seng ge/rwa chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/yang dbang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/khams ston yon tan 'bum nas/mchod rten dkar po sangs rgyas skyabs/lha rin po che bsod nams rin chen/khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang /chos rje rin cen rnam rgyal/chos rje nor bu phun tshogs/chos rje dpal ldan bkra shis/chosalung shar gling pa 'khrul zhig kun bzang mthu stobs dpal 'bar/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra//rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi nyams khrid dang rgya'i rtags yod pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/rwa 'bum seng yan dbang brgyud ltar la/de nas rwa dharma seng ge/rwa dkon cog seng ge/rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/rgya ston dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/mkhan chen dang ma ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonabartson 'grus byang chub/ nyan po ba slob dpon kun dga' rgya mtsho/ dbur (150bston pa yon to chos rin/ yer pa ba brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ mal dro ba grub chen chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ mdo khams pa bla chen yon tan rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /bo dong mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rigs kun khyab bdag gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ dus dgra'i dbang po kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rwa 'bum seng yan dbang brgyud ltar la/ de nas rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ mkhan chen dang ma ba/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ nyang stod ārla de wa/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rin cen rnam rgyal/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin cen/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor ོ dkon cog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du bstsal to/ /yang na nyams khrid de nyid dang ma'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa nas/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ paṇ+ḍita bhū mi shrī/ paṇa chen bi mā la shrī/ paṇ+ḍita bi bya ā ka ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa phywa shrī/ slo bo lo tsā ba dpal ldan byang chub/ rgyal khams lo tsā ba ma ṇi ga shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje (151na'i chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ 'gos ston rdo rje seng ge /rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mthu stobs dbang phyug dgon gsar pa bsod nams chos 'phel/ sngags 'chang dkon cog legs pa/ e waṃ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub man 'dra/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang sgo'i rtags yod pa'i lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgo dras pa chen po yan dbang brgyud gnyis pa ngor —216

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lugs ltar la/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rje sgo rum man 'dra zhing / rje dbang phyug rab brtan yan la bla ma bzhi yod pa oṃ āḥ/ ho yin gsung ngo / /sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs na gshin rje dang he ru ka gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang bshad pa dang mtshungs pa'i 'jigs byed dpa' gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang rwa pa'i rgyun la yod pa yang bskyar zhal gzigs kyi tshul du byung ba dang bcas pa'i nye brgyud ring brgyud tshang ba yin gyi gsang 'dus dus 'khor bde dgyes gshed skor gyis mtshon pa'i rgyud sde chen po tshor dbang go rjes gnang gis gcod pa stong 'khor ba sogs khams phyogs su byung zer ba sde pa snang rtse ba'i dam rdzas la rin spungs zhabs drung ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyis/ bag phye btsag gis gyil ba'i ril bu dang / /a ru (151ba tshe ka ser mdog brdungs pa'i phye ma gnyis/ /sa phyogs 'di na phrin sgo mi 'dug pas/ /mon dang kong po'i yul la gshegs pa zhu/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par dpyod ldan rnams la mi brin yang dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi mgo bo mgal me ltar bskor bar mngon/ /dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa'i smin byed dang lha'i rtags sogs rtags can mi 'dra ba 'ga'i lung brgyud/dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa'i smin byed dang ā'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la lī ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ dz+nyā na ā ka ra gup+ta/ pad+ma badz+ra/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /rwa 'bum seng / rga lo yab sras gnyis/ mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ bla ma seng ge dpal/ mkhas grub dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje rin cen rnam rgyal/ mtshungs —217—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)med sangs rgyas rin cen/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyas seng ge /brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / de dbon mkhan chen nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /mkhan gyi rtags yod pa rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse yan dbang brgyud dang po kha'u pa'i lugs ltar la/ de nas bo dong mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur kun mkhyen rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /mkhan g.yung drung can gyi lung ni/ rje dbang rab yan bshad ma thag pa ltar nas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag (152na tshe pa'o/ zhar gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ gu ge paṇa chen yan dbang brgyud gnyis pa ngor lugs ltar la/ de nas mkhan chen legs 'byung / rje lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o//legs kyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sngags 'chang gzungs pa yan gong ltar la/de nas gon jo jo bzang / mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ mthu chen rgyal mtshan/ rje rin cen rnam rgyal/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ rje sangs rgyas dpal/ rje sgo rum pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse man dbang brgyud dang po bzhin no/ /yang na rwa 'bum seng nas/ phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ rje rin cen bzang po/bla ma tshul khrims shes rab/ rin po che bsod nams seng ge /dpal ri ba blo gros mchogo ldan/ rje sangs rgyas dbon/ gnyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po/ rin po che bsod nams dpal ba/ slob dpon grags pa dpal mgon/ chos rje nam mkha'i mtshan can/ rje rin cen rnam rgyal man 'dra/ rdo rje'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rwa shar pa ltar na rwa chos rab nas/ rdzong sa pa'i gsan yig na dharma seng ge /rwa dkon cog seng ge mas rab rgyal mtshan gsum la rwa nub pa/ rwa cho shar pa na ra bo 'dug srasadharma seng ge/rwa dkon cog seng ge /rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ bla ma khams pa yon tan 'bum/ bsam yas mchod (152brten dkar po —218

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ba sangs rgyas skyabs/lha rin po che bsod nams rin cen/mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang /mnyam med dpal 'dzin bzang po/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/bla ma bsod nams mchog ldan/rje tshe dbang bkra shis/rdo rje la'i tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/rwa nub pa ltar na rwa chos rab nas/rdzong pa'i gas yig na ye shes seng ge dang 'bum seng gnyis la rwa shar pa rwa tsho nub pa zer ba 'dug/sras ye shes seng ge/rwa 'bum seng /rje btsun rga lo/mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/zhang ston rgya bo bsod nams grags/ 'bri gung dpal 'dzin gyi bla ma cha lung mkhan 'a yin/ gnyan ston rdo rje grags/khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang man sngar dang 'dra//nub kyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/rwa chos rab nas/rwa ye shes seng ge/rong pa rgya lo/bla ma shes rab seng ge/rje grags pa rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang gzungs pa/rje dge legs dpal bzang /rdzong pa ā nan+da ma ti/grub chen byams pa chos rin/rje sangs rgyas mgon po/rje byams pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/bla ma sangs rgyas 'od zer/byams pa ye shes 'byung gnas/'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas bkra shis/skye chu mkhan po byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang /khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o/shar gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/rwa chos rab nas/rwa sto seng ge/rwa dkon cog seng ge/rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/rgya ston dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/mkhan chen dang ma ba brtson 'grus byang chub/rje bsod nams yon tan/rje dge legs dpal bzang 153na / ma na bshad ma thag pa ltar ro//yang na byams pa chos rin nas/rje shākya ye shes/'bum chen blo gros dpal ldan/byams pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/yang na byams pa chos rin nas/dbon chen brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/'bum chen blo gros dpal ldan man 'dra//bu'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos rje/thugs sras rin cen rnam rgyal/lce ston chos rgyal nam mkha'i mtshan can/mkhas mchog zla ba dpal rin/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/mkhyen rab rin cen mchog grub/byang gling pa rin cen rgyal po/'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan//nga /nga 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rgyal mtshan/bla ma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonakun dga' bkra shis/ chos rje dkon cog rgyal mtshan rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag la'o/ /gzungs kyi rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas/ rje gzungs pa/ dge legs bzang po/ ā nan+da pa/ chos kyi rin cen/ sangs rgyas mgon po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas 'od zer/ ye shes 'byung gnas/ sangs rgyas bkra shis/ byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang / mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /kha'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kun spang rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po man 'dra/ rum gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rwa 'bum seng nas/ rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sngags dkar ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ khro che ba gzhen (153ba ji kyi skyabs/ sprul sku shes rab bzang po/ bla ma rgyal ba dpal/ khams pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang /rje sangs rgyas dpal/ rje btsun sgo rum pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man dbang brgyud dang po sor bzhag go /gub kyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse yan dbang brgyud dang po ltar la/ de nas drin can sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /bu'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sachen kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /dbang gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sa'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya khri chen yab sras nas/ rje zha lu pa/ desabadag la'o/ /las gshin dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yan dbang brgyud dang po kha'u pa'i lugs ji lta ba la/ de la mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal —220

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mtshan dang dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka nas rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /las gshin lha bcu gsum ma'i rjesaganang (154na dang pi ku'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ gshin rje gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon gzhon nu zla ba/ nā ga bo dhi/ la lī ta badz+ra/ dz+nyā na kirti/ mi nyag ston sgom/ lo sgom zhig po/ zhang ston bsod nams rin cen/ thang stod shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rdo rje bzang po thar gling pa ārla de wa/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ slob dpon don ri ba/ de gnyis ka la mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / de nas drung btsun rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje bshes gnyen bkra shis/ grub mchog ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man las gshin dpa' gcig dang 'dra/ yang na thar gling pa ārla de wa nas/ gnas rnying mkhan chen lo tsā ba chos bzang / bla ma rin cen dpal/ chos rje chos grags pa/ rong ri lung sbug pa rgyal ba thugs rje/ bshes gnyen bkra shisaman 'dra/ yang na drung btsun rin cen rnam rgyal nas/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge /rwa chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na rong pa shes rab seng ge yan dbang brgyud kha'u pa'i lugs ltar la/ de nas rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gung ru rig pa'i ral gri/ chos rje rin cen dpal/ ras chen zla ba rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ sku zhang bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ rje rin cen rgyal mtshan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang (154bsho rong pa rgya lo yan dbang brgyud kha'u pa'i lugasaltar la/ de nas lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ zhang ston bsod nams grags pa/ gnyan ston rdo rje grags pa/ jo ston nam mkha' lhun bzang / sngags 'chang rin cen rnam rgyal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin cen/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyas seng ge /brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab —221 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)'byung gnas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rtse'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/mkhan chen dang ma pa yan rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud ltar la/ de nas mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma ārla de wa/ rtse chen grub chen kun blo/ khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang / rje dpal 'dzin bzang po/ mthu chen 'jigs med dpa' bo/ bla ma bsod nams pa mchog ldan/ sngags 'chang tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen man 'dra/ las gshin dmar po bse bya bzhi skor gyi rjes gnang dang dz+nyā'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus yan rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud dang 'dra ba la mkhan chen dang ma pa nas rim par brgyud de rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ sngags 'chang bsod namasachos 'phel/ grub dbang shākya seng ge /khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel nas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba/ rig (155na)'dzin chen po blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /lasagashin dmar po phrag mdog yab yum gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ mkhan chen dang ma yan bse bya bzhi skor ltar la/ de nas thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ rin po che shes rab grags/ lung pa dkon cog rdo rje/ khrom yon nam mkha' lhun bzang / brag thog dpal 'dzin bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal sa skya pa bsod nams dbang phyug /rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan chen zha lu pa/ desabadag la'o/ /dpal gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rje dbang rab yan bshad ma thag pa ltar la/de nas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /sa bcad gsum pa dpal 'dzin nyi 'od bzang pos mdzad pa'i glegs bam gyi lung brgyud ni/ gra lo—222

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)rnam rgyal rdo rje yan dbang brgyud dang po ltar la/de nas mang mkhar lo sto ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/thams cad mkhyen pa zhang ston bsod nams grags pa/gangs ri'i khrod kyi dpa' 'dzin nyi 'od bzang po/rgya45'i gyi las sgron gi web༅ yang ra/bla ma stag lung ba/zha lu ba chen po/stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/mi nyag paṇa 155bar+pā grags pa rdo rje/mkhan wo dkon cog tso khrims/'gos ston rdo rje seng ge/rdo rje la yo sgo pa chos rje/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/mthu r+ṣa bsod nams chos 'phel/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/rje bas bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur thamasacad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du bstsal to//bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dgra nag zhang lugs lha bcu gsum gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs/grub wo sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/paṇa grub di paṃ ka ra bha dra/grub chen la lī ta badz+ra/so su ra pa/she na pa/a wa li na pa/gu ṇa bha dra/wa gī shwa ra kirti/de wa ā ka ra tsan+d+ra/slob dpon a mo gha badz+ra/lto lo tsā ba shes rab bla ma/'di man gyi bla ma bzhi dmag zor ma'i bla brgyud kyi shad gi zhal ngo bzhi po sngag pa gos dkar lcang lo༅/sras saṃ gha bha dra/gcen rin cen gtsang 'od/sras 'od po che yang zer/gcung rdo rje rtse mo/dpal gti mug rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje/kho nyi ma 'od yin min brtag/dpal rdo rje gsang ba'i ye shes/bstan bzang pa rin cen rnam a yin min brtag/bsam brling pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba/kun mkhyen 'dzims pa rin cen shes rab/shar pa kun dga' seng ge/'dzims pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /kun spangs chos grags dpal/ma ti paṇa chen/sa bzang 'phags pa/rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/sngags 'chang chos dar dpal/mkhan wo dkon cog tshul khrims/rje btsun sgo rum pa chen 156na po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/des bdag za sto gyi ban+de la'o// 22

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dge lugs kyi 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bzhi sogs 'jigs byed chos skor sna tshogs kyi lung brgyud/sgrub thabs za ma tog dang bcu gsum ma gsum gyi dkyil chog rin cen 'phreng ba la brten nas dge lugs kyi dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la lī ta badz+ra/a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes tshang gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra ra khri ta/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/rab byung / rwa lo chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /sngags pa gos dkar lcang lo can/ rwa 'bum seng / rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ gos dkar co breg can/ de sras rong pa shes rab seng ge /bod tshon/sman dge ba ye shes dpal/chos rje don grub rin cen/ chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / mkhas grub shes rab seng zha khyud pa sbyin pa dpal ba/ rtse pa shes rab bzang po/ rje chosaskyong rgya mtsho/ dwags po nam mkha' grags/ rje nyi ma bkra shis/ chos rje bde legs nyi ma/ shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du bstsal to/ /yang na mkhas grub rje nas/ 'phags mchog don grub rin cen/ paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje nam mkha' (156ba)bzang po/ rje pha bong kha pa man 'dra/ yang na rong pa shes seng nas/ bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/ chos rje don grub rin cen man 'dra/ yang na rong pa shes rab seng ge nas/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen lcags ri pa/—224

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mkhan chen grags pa shes rab/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho man gong bzhin no/ /rang lo drug pa'i dus na tshod kyi dbang brda 'phrod pa sogs ma byung yang brgyud pa'i rnam grangs tsam la/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba nas/ gcung chos rgyal ba/ bla ma chos rdo rje/ rje blo bzang don grub/ dben sa pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ desabadag la'o/ /rang lo brgyad pa'i dus 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel la zhus pa dbang brda sogs ni ye ma 'phrod/ rje nyid kyis rgyal ri khrod kyi dge slong khyung po la gsan/ des rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa la gsan 'dra gsung ba las nges 'drong ma byung ngo / /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sman dge ba ye shes dpal yan gong ltar la/ de nas chos rje don grub rin cen/ thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen po/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang /lha btsun rin cen blo gros rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ mar ston tshul khrims rin cen/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ slob dpon chos grags 'od zer/ chos rje nam mkha' bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ kun mkhyen chos (157na bo byings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i nyi 'od/ de la mdo smad pa tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pas thog drangs dge slong bzhi sdes gser gyi maṇ+ḍal bla gos dang bcas nas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor drang srong srin po ri'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa'i 'brul 'khor gyi sbas don yig chung gi 'phreng ba ha la'i lo 'dab/ tsha kho dbon po dang bon po thug pa'i dus phyag len mdzad pa rnams nyams su myong ba'i man ngag yang chung zin bris su bkod pa/ des sngags 'chang rdo rje dbang phyug gi ngor mdzad pa'i gshin rje nag po'i 'khor lo blta ba tshul gyi man ngag zin bris dang bcas pa rnams kyi lung phyag len zhi rgyas dmar khrid du legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni sman dge ba ye shes dpal yan —2256

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sngar ltar la/de nas rje don grub rin cen/rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po/mkhas grub dge legasadapal bzang /rje don grub rin cen/paṇa wo ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ba so sprul sku lha dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho/gung ru dbyangs dpon po mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'am pa pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/des bdag la bka' drin du stsal to//zha lu pa legs pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i drug cu pa'i rtsa tshig la brten nas paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i drug cu pa'i rnam gzhag dam nyams kyi srog 157ba7khod mtshon cha 'bar ba'i ga gil 'khor/bka' sdod dam can rnam gsum gyi phrin las bskul ba myur mgyogs drag po'i pho lha'i yig cha'i lung dang sa 'khor 'dri lugs dang gnam 'khor rtsigs lugs kyi phyag 'khrid dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/zha lu pa legs pa rgyal mtshan nas/bla ma gnyis gsum zhig ma rnyed/de nas dben sa rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas ye shes/mkhan chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/des bdag la'o//las gshin phyi nang gsang gsum ni 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi chos tshan du bzhugs shing brgyud pa'ang rwa pa sogs nas mi 'dren 'dug pas 'dir ma smos/gong gi dbang brgyud deng sang rwa lugs nas 'dren pa kun la grags shing 'jigs byed rwa lugs yin par zhal gyis kyang 'tshes/rwa lugs min par byas na 'jigs byed de ngan par song dogs pa'i ngan rtog mdzad mkhan yang mang mod/za ma tog dang bcu gsum ma gsum gyi dkyil chog rwa los mdzad pa'i mtho rtogs rim pa lnga dbang gi chu bo rnams dang mi mthun pas rwa lugs su gtan tshigs lung rig gang gis kyang mi 'grub pas kho bo ni de ltar yin zhes khas blang bar mi nus/gong du dbang brgyud de ltar 'dren pa ni kun dang mthun na mi chos rtsa ba yin zhes pa ltar smos la/kho bo'i blo gros kyi mig chung ngu zhig gis brtags tshe rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis mdzad par rje bas ṣ+ka kyi zhal gyis kyang 'tshes shing don la'ang ༷nas pas chos rje don grub rin tso yan 15zha

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las sgrogs bam dang po/ (ka)brgyud mi dgos par bla ma 'jam dbyangs kyis rjes su gnang ba thob pa la brten nas mngon dkyil mdzad pa las rwa skyo zhang ma la gnyos sogs bod kyi 'jigs byed mkhan po'i rjes su 'brangs pa min par sems/ lcags mkhar zur bcu drug pa'i drug cu pa 'di rwa lo'i thugs la gab pa'i mtshon cha sngon chad gzhan la ma grags pa'i phyogs shig 'dug kyang bod snga rabs pa'i rwa lugs pa rnams la grags shing rgya sdong sogs zur drug pa dang phyi'i zur la brten nas zur drug par ngos 'dzin pa'ang yod mod don phyi nang gnyis ka dril ba'i zur dgu pa 'di rā lugs kyi phyag len thun mong ma yin pa'o/ dgu pa las 'di la thugs gtsigs kyang mi mdzad/ mkhas pa dpal 'dzin zur dgu pa dang bcu drug pa gnyis ka rgyud rgya gzhung gi zin so med par mdzad cing gong dkar rdo rje gdan pas dpe'u ris na'ang brir mdzad pas snyan brgyud min 'dra zhing / 'di la phyag len kyang rigs mi gcig pa 'ga' zhig 'dug pa dang / deng sang gtsang phyogs su dar ba'i lugs dang rab 'byams pa bsod nams gragasapa'i lag len thun mong ma yin par grags pa'i zin bris 'dra yod 'dug pa rnams kyang mi mthun pa mang zhing spyir rā hu la'i pha srin por bshad pa sogs rnam pa srin po la ngo bo sde brgyad du gtogs pa yod na'ang laṅka mgrin bcu chos mngon pa nas gcig na srin po dag gnas so zhes 'dzam bu gling gi gling phran gcig srin po yin par bshad pa'i rgyal po yin pas mi dang rjes su mthun par stobs dang rdzu 'phrul cung zad yod pa las bstan pa bsrung nus pa'i sde brgyad lta bu'i mthu stobs med pa rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud kyis kyang rtogs nus/ drang nges kyi bshad (158ba)pa la mtha' gcig tu ma nges rung /rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i gsang ba'i rnam thar du khyab 'jug /klu/ sha za/ rgyal po ste nag po'i ris kyi sde bzhis mtho snyoms par mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi mthus btul bar bshad pas 'di'i bka' bsrung thun mong ma yin pa yin tshe lha bdud du babs pa lta bu'i khungs dang ma 'brel ba sogs nas dpyad dka' bar snang ngo / / ridapal rdo rje 'jigs byed skyo lugs lha zhe dgu ma'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'jigs byed/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/la lī ta badz+ra/a mo gha badz+ra che chung gnyis/skyo 'od kyi 'byung gnas/gtsang pa yang dag 'bar/gtsang pa yang dag rdo rje/rngog rdo rje rgyal po/gze pa don grub seng ge/khams pa shākya rdo rje/dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/zhang ston rin cen dpal/bla ma bsod nams 'bum/bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/sa bzang paṇa chen/'dan ston pu rgya dz+nyā na/bla ma dpal ldan legs dbang /brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/sngags 'chang yon tan rgya mtsho/bla ma dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal to//yang skyo 'od 'byung nas/skyo 'jam dpal/skyo pad+ma/skyo khams lung pa/gnyan rin cen brtan pa/gnyan 'od srungs/gnyan chos rgyal/'phags pa rin po che man 'dra/yang na 159na 'phags pa rin po che nas/glo chen sangs rgyas sras bag ston gzhen tshul man gong bzhin no//bla ma skyo yab sras nas brgyud pa'i zab cing rgya che ba'i rwa rtsa sems 'di'i na byed lha bas bdun ma yin yang deng 4dbang rgyun bod du ma rnyed/'dzin gyi 'khrid glo bo mkhan chen legs 'byung ba'i gsung rgyun bzhin la ngor r+sā dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas nyams 'khrid dang /yig cha de nyid kyi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/la lī ta badz+ra/slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/a mo gha badz+ra/don yod rdo rje/skyo ston 'od yang /skyo ston sku ma ho/skyo khams pa gto ston rin cen brtan/de srasa'od srungs/gnyan ston chos rgyal/'dzims pa rin cen shes rab/'jam dbyangs 'khon ston thugs rje rin cen/'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/bla ma cha gan dbang rgyal/bla ma klog skya pa/bla ma grags 'jam dbyang mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na klog skya grags chen pa zhes gcig tu bris 'dun pa yig skyon byung ngam brtag cing thar rtse sgrub khang shar pa gsum gyi gsan yig bla ma grags chen pa'i tshab tu spang khang pa grag pa dpal zer ba 'dug pa dpyad/chen pa/kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/saXng ma ti paṇa chen/sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)blo gros/ rdo rje 'amang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge /rje btsun brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /rgyud rtog pa bdun pa dang rtog pa gsum pa skyo lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/'jam (159ba bo pa la/ dz+nyā na ḍā gi /la lī ta badz+ra/ don yod rdo rje che chung gnyis/ skyo 'od 'byung / skyo 'jam dpal/ skyo pad+ma/ skyo khams pa/ gnyan rin cen brtan/ gnyan 'od srungs/ gnyan chos rgyal/glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ gangs khrod pa grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/sa bzang 'phags pa/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ 'dren mchog rat+na wa lha/ rje lha mchog seng ge /chos rje bde legs bshes gnyen/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / de dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag go /yang na skyo 'od 'byung nas/ gtsang yang dag 'bar/ gtsang yang dag rdo rje/rngog rdo rje rgyal po/ gze pa don grub ye shes/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ sras chos grags/ dbus pa sangasargyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ slo chen pa man 'dra/'jigs byed lha dgu ma sa lugs kyi dbang ma thob cing / zur bka'i dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang bod kyi blos byas ma yin pa khungs btsun gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha pa ri/ lha hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ 'bar 'dzin/ na rna pa/ gu ༅ pa/rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ mal lo/ rje btsun yab sras gsum/gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ byang chub —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dpal/shar wo/rdo rje la4 /mus wo/bdag wo rdo rje la'i /sangs rgyas dpal/sgo wo pa/rje mkhyen brtse khu dbon gnyis/khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//rgya gar gyi grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur pa slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis legs par bkral ba'i bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed 160na dmar po lha bcu gsum gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi steng nas dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i bka' babs dang po chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba dpal 'dzin/sngon lha dang lha min 4bas pa na lha phrug stog mgo ra pa gzigs pa na rang gi dbu bcad nas sbyar te gsos/ma he shi ba'i mgor rang la sbyar nas dge slong gi lus la ma he'i dbu can chos ma lha'i zhal nas gsung pa chang 'o mar bsgyur bsgod par blug/mgo bar pa'i gri gug phyag na bsnams pa zhin ri mor 'a mi grol snang ngo //bi ra ḍi pa/ma ti pa/ni ska lo ka/re len+d+ra pra bha wa/chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/g.yung phug pa rgyal mtshan dge ba/shong lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/thugs sras lo tsā ba rin cen rnam rgyal/mnyam med gragasapa rgyal mas/dwags po kun dga' bkra shis/paṇa r+sā bzang po bkra shis/rong ston blo bzang grags pa/thon pa mkhas bas yon to rgya mtsho/slob dpon lcang sdur ba/ra tshag pa blo bzang e waṃ/sras khang sngags ram pa bzang po rnam rgyal/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/des za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to//bka' babs gnyis pa dwa na shī la lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/gshin rje gshed/grub thob dpal 'dzin/dpe med 'tsho/rin cen 'byung gnas zhi ba/chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/'dren mdzad zhabs/rnam grags lha/paṇa chen shākya shrī/paṇa chen 160ba ) dwa na shī la/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams seng ge /mnga' ris pa rje ri btsong kha pa mu tshogs yig tu 'di gnyis sgo sor stsol 'dug pa yig skyon rtsa wa/sangs rgyas ye shes/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man gong ltar ro//bka' babs gsum pa glo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/gshin rje gshed/grub chen dpal 20

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'dzin/ ma ti pa/ da rlan ā tsarla/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin cen/ bla ma sa pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan man chag lugs bzhin no/ /gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bzhi gsal ba'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje yab sras/ lce nam mkha'i mtshan can/ tsan+d+ra pa/ 'khrul zhig rje/ mkhyen rab rje/ rin cen rgyal po/don grub rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ dkon cog rgyal mtshan mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad kyi snying po'i yang snying rgyud dang man ngag gi dgongs pa bzhin grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan chos stong gis legs par bkral ba'i gdams pa snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la dbang po yang rab kyi skal ldan rnams grol bar byed pa shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi sngon 'gro smin byed gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du mngon rtogs bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang dkyil chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ lhan thabs kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses mdzad pa gsum la brten nas dbang bzhi/ yig snying gi thog nas spros med kyi byin rlabs/ kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i 'jug bde gsal (161na tha'i steng nas 'od gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs/ theg chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i gsal byed sgron ma'i steng nas bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs/ grol byed kyi lam la shin tu spros pa med pa de kho na nyid glo bo lo tsā ba chen po'i 'khrid yig man ngag snyan brgyud kyis legs par brgyan pa'i rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses zin bris su mdzad pa'i steng nas nyams 'khrid smin rgyas rnams nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birnyas mdzad pa'i shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rgya gar gyi mkhan po da rlan ā tsarla dang glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin cen gyis bsgyur ba/ des mdzad pa'i byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po re wa ji dang chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ slojo lo9 'gyur zhin kyang yod skad/des—231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yonamadzad pa'i bdud rtsi lnga'i byin gyis bas pa'i rim pa (a)dan na ā tsarla dang lo tsā ba zhe sdang rdo rjes bsgyur ba/ shin tu spros med kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba'i rim pa sa skyong ba'i mnga' bdag jo jo dge slong gi ched du glo bo lo tsā bas mdzad pa/ /des mdzad pa'i birlu pa'i rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi lam 'khrid da rlan ā tsarla'i zhabs kyi man ngag /des mdzad pa'i sems bskyed pa'i thabs drug po 'di ni rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi man ngag slob dpon birnya pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag /des mdzad pa'i sems bskyed drug po de rim gyis sam cig car nyams su len tshul/ (161ba8sa mdzad pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom pa'i bar gcod sel thabs/des mdzad pa'i gzhan yang bdud la sogs pa'i bar gcod dngos grub tu blang thabs bla ma'i man ngag shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi gsung bzhin rgyud gsum ngor r+ṣa/ pas ngor chen sde snod 'dzin (6ri/pa chos rgyal dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i spros med mdzes rgyan/ zhal gdamasathor bu'i skor la/ birlu pas mdzad pa'i shin tu spros med de kho na nyid man ngag gi don 'grel btsun pa shes rab ming can gyis mdzad pa/ bla ma rgyal mtshan dpal gyis rang gi slob ma rnams la zhal ta mdzad pa/ shes rab ming can gyis mdzad pa'i me thabs drug 'chings/ de mdzad pa'i gegs sel/mang mkhar bas bkod pa'i tho rtse/ 'gor bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das yab yum zhes yod pa'i sngon 'gro'i man ngag /bdag byin brlab kyi lag len gud na yod gsung ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed spyor ba bla mas bstan pa de 'di yin no gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi zhal shes mkha' 'gro rnams la gsol ba btab nas lo mchog pas yi ger bkod pa/ des bkod pa'i bar du gcod pa'i gegs sel ba'i gzhung gi thems yig /rnal 'byor bzhi'i gzhung gi thems yig dbang phyug brtson 'grus kyis yi ger bkod pa/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa'i gdams ngag ces pa byin rlabs kyi yi ge /theg chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor ram byin rlabs gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma/ des mdzad pa'i bcud len gyi man ngag (162na)—232

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar po lha'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'bor kyi mngon par (shi rtogs pa gshin rje kun 'joms/de'i dkyil 'bor gyi cho ga snying i nye (shi bar bsdus nas bde blag tu 'jug pa/des mdzad pa'i 'od (ra)gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs 'jug bde gsal ba/des mdzad pa'i mchod pa'i ltar)cho ga mchod sprin bsam yas/des mdzad pa'i 9)las bzhi'i sbyin sreg/(shi des mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi gtor ma 'khyog cu rtsa (lhadargyubazhi pa'i cho ga'i lag len bya tshul/tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i spros med na gyi rnal 'byor ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me/tshar chen gyi gsung 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris su ()mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig/de'i zhal byang du/gsang chen thabs rgyud gshin rje thar byed lam//grub chen birnya'i bzhed gzhung zab mo'i don//brtse chen bla ma dam pa'i gsung gi bcud//don chen tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i zhal lung 'di//'di dang phyi ma'i don chen dran gyis la//la 'ur nyams su len la ma 'bad na//na rga 'chi skye'i sdug bsngal bzod dam ci//ji ltar song yang nyams lan gnad du thong //bden gsung gsung gi gsang ba bla na med//gang zin zin bris bgyis pa'i legs bshad 'di//brjed ngas mun pa'i smag dras dbyis won phyir//nyams rtogs pa da dkar bshad pa'i nyi ma lags//zhes pa snang ngo //tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung la kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris 162bsgo dzad (dbang/pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad 'khrul pa zab lam thun gcig gis dbyings su sbyong ba bla ma'i thugs bas/'di skor shin tu zab pa'i slob bshad yin pas ji skad du/rang gi ngo bo gang du ma grub kyang //du mar 'char ba'i sems nyid yid bzhin nor//lam byed rnam bzhis mngon du byed pa 'di//sa skya'i bla r+sā kho na'i khyad chos yin//de gsung 'dzin pa phal cher tshogs bshad sbun pas g.yengs//la la smras tshad gtam du song ba'i mu cor mkhan//slob bshad snyan brgyud lhug par stsol ba'i drin can rje//blo gsal zhabs la snying nas 'dud do ring du skyong //zhes pa ltar snying gi dpal be'ur bcang ba'i gaXs so//khyab bdag zha lu bas mdzad pa'i gshed

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dmar gyi mngon dkyil phyag len chu babs su bkod pa slob ma sta gon zur du bkol ba dang bcas pa/de ltar nos pa'i dbang brgyud bka' babs dang po dpyal lugs ni/bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/rnal 'byor dbang phyug birnya pa/grub chen ḍom+bhi he ru ga grub chen bi ra ḍi pa/dmu tha bye shamathabs༅zer/ma ti gar+bha/blo gros snying po/nga ra ma ti/rdo rje gdan pa chen po ni ska lo ka de wa/dpyal lo tsā ba chos bzang /rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/thar rtse ba'i gas yig na dpyal bas rgya lo la bum dbang yan ho las ma gnang bas rgya los 'jam gsar ba la dbang gong ma gsum gsan nas mdzad ces snang ba brtag/de sras rong pa shes rab seng ge/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 163na'achang kun dga' bzang po/mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan/bdag r+sā rdo rje lang blo gros rgyal mas/rje gzha rdo ring pa r+ṣa po/dus dgra'i dbang po sgo pa chos rje/thamasacad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drin can bla ma mgon po bsod namasamachog ldan/des bdag za hor gyi ban+de la stsal to//yang na rong pa shes rab seng ge yan gong ltar la/de nas skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/jo nang phyogs las pa/shar chen pa/ngo chen/mus chen/kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang /rje nor bu phun tshogs/chos lung shar gling pa kun bzang mthu stobs dpal 'bar/'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse man 'dra/bka' babs gnyis pa chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/gshin rje gshed/grub chen birnya pa/zu he ru ga grub chen dpal 'dzin/rje gzha btsong kha pa'i gag yig na 'di mi 2ga/bi ra ḍi ba/sa ra ma ti/ni ska lo ka de wa/paṇa grub re len+d+ra pra bha wa/chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/gro lung pa mdo sde dpal/shong lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge man gong ltar ro//yang na chag lo nas2//yung phug pa rgyal mtshan dge ba/shong blo gros

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)brtan pa man 'dra/ yang na lo tsā ba mchog ldan nas/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug /bya sder ba byang chub rin cen/ ra ga brag pa shākya (163ba thang ge /rje phyogs las rnam rgyal man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen bu ston nas/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ sku shad nam mkha' mchog grub/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po man 'dra/ yang na mus chen semasadapa' chen po nas/ kun mkhyen gung ru shes rab bzang po/ de gnyis ka la mkhyen rab chos rje/ de nas rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang na mus chen nas/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / chos rje byams pa chosalegs/ 'khrul zhig byams pa shes rab bzang po/ tshar chen man 'dra/ yang na ra ga brag pa shākya seng ge nas rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ rje sangs rgyas 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang man 'dra/ yang na mus chen sems dpa' chen po nas/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rā ston yon to dpal bzang / glo bo mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ go ram pa/ sangs rin pa/ lha mchog seng ge /grol mchog man 'dra/ rje grol mchog gi gsan yig na glo bo lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i dbang kun dga' mchog grub la gsan tshul 'dug pa/ glo bo lo tsā ba nas grol byed las smin byed kyi rgyun ma 'phel tshul mkhas pa rnams la yongs su grags pas paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i gur (164na)gyi rjes gnang ltar gzhan las khyad ma thon ma zhig mdzad bzhed pa'i sgyu ma'i rol gar yin nam snyam/yang chag lo tsā ba nas bla brang pa chen po gzhen nu rgyal mtshan/ de dbon bla brang pa shākya dpal/ rje bzhi dpal chen bzang po/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug ye shes dpal bzang po/ rgyal sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ de gnyis ka la chag lo tsā ba rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ de nas chos rje rin chen rgyal mchog /rdzong dkar ba kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man sngar ltar ro/ /yang na —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonabla brang pa gzhen nu rgyal mtshan nas/bla brang pa blo gros dpal/bla brang pa bzang po dpal/bla brang pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/bla brang pa bsod nams dpal 'byor/bla brang pa chos dpal bzang po/chag lo rin chen chos rgyal man 'dra/yang na bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa nas mkhar chen dharma shrī/rje btsun dpal chen bzang po man 'dra/bka' babs gsum pa dwa na shī la lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/gshin rje gshed/birnya pa/shar phyogs nag po pa/su li pa/shī la tsan+d+ra/paṇa chen dwa na shī la/'jam gsar shes rab 'od/rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje man 'dra/yang na rga lo yab sras gnyis nas/skyi ston gragasargyal/kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal/shar chen/ngor chen/musachen/rje sangs rgyas 'phel/rje kun dga' chos bzang man 'dra//byin rlabs gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/rje btsun btsong kha ba'i gsan yig na byin rlabs kyi lung brgyud las brgyud pa mi gcig tsam 'dren pa gnang 'dug pa rnam grangs zhig yin pa 'dra/khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams 164ba ) mchog ldan yan 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'khrid brgyud le tshan gsum po ltar la/de nas khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//'od gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ngor chen nas/rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/rje lha mchog seng ge/'jam dbyangs dkon cog lhun grub/byang gling ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan/sku drung shākya seng ge/rtse chen dus 'khor ba'i bla ma bkra shis rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//nyams stsed kyi brgyud pa dang po ni/bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/grub r+ṣa birnya pa/grub ོ ḍom+bhi he ru ga grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba dpal 'dzin grub chen nga ra ma ti/paṇa grub da rlan ā tsarla/kri ya sa mu tshi dzad pa po yin dgung lo stong dang 7brgya gsas/glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/sras bla ma sa pa/lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin cen grub/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nas rje tshar wo yan dbang /rgyud bka' babs dang po ltar la/de na rje bod

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur kun mkhyen chosadabyings rang grol//des bdag la'o//brgyud pa gnyis pa ni/bla ma dam pa yan bshad ma thag pa ltar la/de nas theg chen chos kyi rgyal po 'jam 165na bo byangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man bshad ma thag pa bzhin no//brgyud pa gsum pa ni/bu ston rin po che nas/thugs sras rin cen rnam rgyal/sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub/mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī rat+na/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/rje btsun rdo ring pa man bshad ma thag pa bzhin no//yang na thugs sras sems dpa' wo po nas/drin can bsod nams don grub/'jam dbyangasabakra shis rgyal mtshan/dka' bzhi pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/mkhyen rab rje man bshad ma thag pa ltar ro//nye brgyud du byed na shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mnal lam bzung nas so ma pu rir rnal 'byor dbang phyug birnya pa dang dngos su mjal nas gsan pa yin pas rdo rje 'chang /birnya pa/shar chen man gong ltar ro//rtags med pa'i lung rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/bla ma dam pa yan 'khrid brgyud dang po ltar la/de na/sa theg chen rin po che kun dga' bkra shis/yab 'jam dbyangs chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mas/bdag wo rdo rje 'chang /rje btsun rdo ring pa r+ṣa po/tshar wo chos kyi rgyal po/kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho/mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/de sras bsod nams dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//yang na bla ma dam pa nas/rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/shar chen/ngor chen/mus chen/bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra//a'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/bi rū pa/ma lta gi/dpal 'dzin/lī la badz+ra/165bshān+ta rak+ṣi ta/sto badz+ra/rat+na badz+ra/da rlan ā tsarla/glo bo lo tsā ba yab sras gnyis/lo mchog pa/dpal seng ba/kun mkhyen bu ston/bla ma dam pa/theg chen pa man 'dra/thar gyi rtags yod pa'i lung rgyud ni/ngor wo nas/mus 'a dkon cog shul mas/yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/'jam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dbyangs dkon cog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/de dbon mkhan chen dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na musachen nas/ kun mkhyen go bo/ yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyasaseng ge /thar rtse pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / 'dren mchog lha mchog seng ge /dkon cog lhun grub sangs rgyas seng ge man gong bzhin no/ /ra'i rtags can gyi lung ni/shes bya kun mkhyen bu ston rin cen grub/ sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/ lce nam mkha'i mtshan can/mkhas pa zla ba dpal rin/ mkhan chen zhabrul zhig chen po/ mkhyen rab rje/ byang gling pa rin cen rgyal po/ 'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kun dga' bkra shis/ chos rje dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /da'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses 'khrid kyi zin bris tshar chen la spyan 'bebs zhus pas nged kyis gang dpod de ga tshig zur ma nyams par byung 'dug /blo khogs byas pa rnams ma thebs 'dug gsung kyal ka mdzad skad/ tshar chen nas/ skyed tshal (1glan)'og mkhan chen blo gros chosa'aphags/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad rnams kyang snyan po 'dug pas klog gtang gsungs nas lung dang lhan du gnang ngo / /lha'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /sngags la4 bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'amang dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o//dbang gi rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /g.yung drung gi rtags can ni rje bla ma nyid la thos so/ /chos rje khro phu lo tsā bas dkyil chog bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig dang lnga gsum bco lnga gnyis bsres nas mdzad pa ltar thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston yab sras dang khyung po lhas pa rnams kyis mdzad —238

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa ji lta ba blo dman gyi don du brjed tho khrigs chags su bris pa'i steng nas pad+ma'i rigs bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po ral pa gcig pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang chog gnyis bsres bsdus pa'i lugs kyi dbang bzhi/ rdo rje gdan pa dang mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī sogs ma rgyud du bzhed kyang pha rgyud kyi rjesasu gongs te bkod pa yin/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses zin bris su mdzad pa'i sems kyi gdung sel gyi steng nas sems nyid ngal gso'i nyams 'khrid smin rgyas/ bar skabs (166bshos smin grol ya bral ba'i dbang lung legs ldan rje nas brgyud dgos kyang nyams 'khrid rje blo gsal rgya mtsho nas byung pas ji skad du/ mnyam rjes bral ba'i dge sbyor khor yug gi /snang srid bde chen chos skur shar ba'i ngang / /dngos dang brgyud pas drin can ma rnams la/ /phan bde rab 'byams stsol dus nam 'ong na/ /de skad rgyal ba kun dngos tshar pa rje'i/ /zhabs sen nor bu'i cod pan spyi bo'i gtsug /'bral med bcings pas chos kyi rgyal srid la/ dbang thob mkhyen brtse'i ming des yi ger bkod ces so/ /rgyab brten lung la/ thun mong du dgos pa/ smin byed/ bskyed rim/rdzogs rim/ yum gyi skor/ chos skyong dang drug /dang po la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal ral pa gcig pa'i brtag pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bla na med pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nan+da'i thugs sras rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍita shrī kha la ru tra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ gnubs lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi bsdus don bcas dang po'o/ /'di'i rjes su rje mkhyen bu'i gsan yig na khro los mdzad pa'i spyi chings nang chings gnyis 'dug pa ma thob/ gnyis pa smin byed la/ dam pa'i bkas bskul nas shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nan+da'i zhal gyi gdams pa thun mongs ma yin pa ltar khro phu lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ des mdzad pa'i rgyas par byed na zur 'debs su byed pa'i cho ga lnga gsum bco lnga'i sgo nas dpal ral pa gcig pa'i dbang cho ga mdor bsdus man ngag gi sgo nas lag len khrigs su bsgrigs pa/ (167na)grol lam gtso bor byed pa'i dbang gong ma bsdus pa ngo sprod dmar 'khrid du byas pa gsang ba dam pa yang dag rdzogs so'i —239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mtha' can/ pho lha'i lam gtso bor byed pa'i dbang gong ma rgyas pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur mi tri ba'i zhal gyi gdams pa mthar thug /rgyud dang gdams ngag rdzogs par thob pas gzhan don byed pa'i dbang bcu gnyis rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang chog /'di'i rjes su yab gtso bor byas pa'i 'pho ba'i byin gsag3 yig na 'dug kyang sa ma rma / yum gtso bor byas pa'i ye shes 'pho ba'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bsdus pa rnams/ gsum pa bskyed rim la/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍita chen po a dzi ta mi tra gugs mi pham sbasa'i bshes ga/ mdzad pa grub chen mi tra dzo gi dang lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bal yul 'phags pa shing kun tu bsgyur ba/ de'i don 'grel gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa sngags 'chang dpal gyi ming khro phu lo tsā ba mi pham bshesaganyen gyis mdzad pa'i lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs dang lus dkyil mngon rtogs gnyis gsan yig na 'dug pa rgyun ma byung / can gyis bkod pa/ slob dpon shrī badz+ra gī rtis/ mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes sgrub/ slob dpon rol ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i yum rkyang gi sgrub thabs mi tra dzo gi dang gnubs lo tsā bas bsgyur pa/ khro phu lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs jo bo e ka dza ṭi'i gdams ngag sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa/ gsan yig na mngon rtogs che chung gsum 'dug kyang gnyis kyi rgyun ma rnyed/mi tras rjes bzung bstan pa'i srog shing dam pa'i gsung (167ba)zas gos spyod lam ste ral gcig ma'i rnal 'byor gsum gyi gdams ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ tshogs mchod bla na med pa'i lag len rdo rje me dpung zhes bya ba gnubs lo tsā ba dpal gyi ming can gyis sbyar ba/ 'di'i rjes su gsan yig tu mi pham zla ba'i bsngo gnor bu'i sgron ma 'dug kyang rgyun ma rma / rwa dza ga ā nan+da sa mdzad pa'i bstod pa paṇ+ḍita burnya shrī bha dra dang lo chung gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba rnams/ bzhi pa rdzogs rim/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyis gsung pa'i semasanyid ngal gso'i skor la ngal gso'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig /khā+e)rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ba bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa/ khro bu lo tsā ba'i rnam thar dpag bsam 'khri shing /do ha rdo rje'i tshigs bcad nyer lnga pa/don 'grel gnad kyi sgron me khro los mdzad pa/ngo sprod kyi man ngag /ma yengs ma bcos rang ga'i gnas kyi zhal gdams/ sngon 'gro khro lo'i reg —240

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)thig /'khrid yig bsod nams seng shes mdzad pa rnams kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses tshar chen la gsan pa'i gsan yig na snang yang rgyun mo rnyed/ mkhyen rab chos rjes mdzad pa'i ( k+ṣi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gnas sbyar ma/ 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtses mdzad pa'i lta:)'khrid yig sems kyi gdung sel/ mkha' 'gro ma gsum gyis gsungs pa'i rdo rje sbas pa'i gsang lam la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ral gcig mas gsungs pa'i brtag pa dang po/rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje 'phreng ba can gyis gsungs pa'i brtag pa gnyis pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma thod pa'i 'phreng ba can gyis gsungs pa'i brtag pa gsum pa ste brtag pa gsum gyi rgyud rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal 'gro ba'i bshes gnyen kun dga' dang lo tsā ba gnubs mi (168na)bskyod rdo rjes dpal su ya bhu di bi hā rar bsgyur pa/ rgyud de la brten nas dbang po rab tshe 'di la 'tshang rgya ba gser bzo mkhan mkhas pas gser la rgyan bkod pa lta bu'i man ngag la gsum yod pa'i dang po rdo
