rje'i lam la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro gsum khro phu lo tsā bas mdzad pa/'di'i rjes su dngos gzhi dang dbang byang gnyis gsan yig tu 'dug kyang rgyun ma rnyed/ sbas pa'i lam zhes pa rang semasathabs ldan rang dbang rang gis bsgyur ba 'khor los sgyur ba lta bu la thabs gtso bor byed pa'i bsre ba bzhi snying byang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'di'i rjes su phyag rgya bzhi zung 'jug bzhi/ sku gsum ngo sprod thig le gsum/thig pa gsum 'bru gu zhes pa rnams gsan yig na 'dug kyang rgyun ma byung / thabs shes zung 'jug gtso bor byas pa'i rin cen 'bru gsum zhes pa gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis yi ger bkod pa/ 'di'i rjes su mchog gi gdams pa gsum zhes pa gsan mig na 'dug kyang rgyun ma rnyed/ gsang ba'i lam la rang lus thabs ldan dpa' bo'i lus la dgos dgu tshang ba lta bur thabs lam rgyas pa rdo rje sbas pa'i gsang lam zhes par byin rlabs/ lus sbyang / sa sbyang gsum gyi sngon 'gro/ rtsa thig rlung gsum yi ge dang 'brel bas dngos gzhi bstan pa/ 'di'i rjes su thabs lam 'bring po gsang rnying rdo rje'i tshig bzhi bsdus pa rgyud tshig la skyar pa/ gzhan lus shes ldan 'dod 'khro'i ba mo'i gzhan lus kyi rten rnal 'byor ma'i brtag thabs/ dngos gzhir byang sems kyi dkar 'khrid nyams myong gi dga' 'khrid lcags kyu'i dul 'khrid/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal 'khrid rnams gsan mig na 'dug kyang rgyun ma rnyed/ sgra gcan gyi gza' —241 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'khrid nyi (168ba)zla btson 'dzin rnams/ 'di'i rjes su bsrung bzaba'i rang ga /dbang po phreng waṃ khar grol ba khyung sgor rgya las grol pa lta bu'i man ngag gi gnad drug pa/ 'pho ba srid zhi'i dkyil 'khor mo rnams gsan yig na 'dug kyang rgyun ma byung / dbang po 'bring po gnad dgu'i 'pho ba dang mtha' mo bar dor grol ba'i skor rnams gsan migan 'ang rgyun med tshul 'dun pasaring mo zhig nas chad pa 'dra'o/ /lnga pa yum gyi skor la/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/byin rlabs gnad/'pho ba'i ga dmasang ga gi slobabu smin byed/ zab pa'i yig chung gi lus bskyed pa'i rim pa/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi man ngag gis sems rdzog pa'i rim pa sgrub thabs rdo rje'i tshig gis kun gyi gzhi gzung ba/ phyag mtshan gyi sgrub thabs bzhi las tshogis kyi mtha' bsdu ba rnams gsan yig na 'dug kyang sa mo r+sā/ dmigs pa me'i 'khor los bar gcod kyi bgegs bsrung ba/ 'bru bzhi sngags kyi bzlasapas snang ba 'ur bslang ba/ 'di'i rjes su 'bar ba me'i mchod pas gzhan gyi snang ba bsgul ba gsan yig na 'dug kyang rgyun ma rnyed/ rlung yi ge'i ris kyis rang bzhin gyis rtsa sbyang ba/ thugs phrad thog 'gel gyis byed rgu chos su gtang ba/ khams dngas snyigs kyi dag pa dang 'khrul pa shan dbye ba/ 'da' kha 'chi drod kyi rlung rig gnad du bsnun pa/ bar do 'od gsal kyi gdams ngag gis rlung rig ya bral ba/ sku gsum rang chas kyi man ngag gis 'bor ba ma stong gi bar du 'gro don byed pa/ rgyun yod med bsdoms pa'i bco lnga po de snye ba lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud gser chos so/ khrug pa chos skyong skor la/ gnod sbyin kā la dang bi kā la gnyis te gnod sbyin spun gnyis kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin spun gnyis kyi lung nod pa'i yi ge /(169na)phyi dud 'gro'i rdzas sdig pa dang spre'u'i gzugs la brten nas nor sgrub pa/ 'brug gzugs kyi snyan grags sgrub pa/ nang mi'i rdzas bum pa la brten nas 'chi ba blu zhing tshe sgrub pa/ gzan gyi rkun po'i gzugs brnyan la brten nas chom rkun 'ching ba/kā la'i gzuṭa la brten nas mngon shes sgrub pa/ shel la brten nas dbang phyug sgrub pa/ gser gyi mdung thung la brten nas dgra bo gsad pa ste kā la'i las lnga/ ro ras la brten nas bsdu ni 'grol ba/ lci ba'i me la brten nas stor ba btsal ba/ gri rgyud la brten nas gnod sbyin mo 'gugs pa/ rus sbal pho mo la brten nas gter 'don pa/ gnod sbyin gyi gzugs la brten nas tshe brtag pa ste bi kā la'i las lnga —242

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gsang ba lha min gyi rdzas badz+ra tri shul la brten nas las la sbyor ba rnams kha ba chus zung chag gi ye shes 'pho ba'i dbang chog/gza' tshogs gtor lung /lha bas bdun gyi ma' rtogs don gsal sgron me/khas ga ṇi'i sgrub thabs tshigs da bzhi pa/long spyod myur du 'byung ba'i thabs/gsol 'debs stong ṣ+ka sa rje ma/rgyud kyi sa gir kun sbangasaX gis mdzad pa/yum skor gyi gdams pa bco lnga'i dkar chag rnams deng sang lung mdzad 'dug kyang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pa mnga' ri rig 'dzin chen por mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis gsan pa'i zhabs phyir bla ma o rgyan rgyal bos gsan 'dug pasagasha yig na med pa smo 'ong don med 'dra snyam mo//de ltar legs par nos pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/khyab bdag rdo rje lang wo po/jo bo khas pā ṇi/byang sems blo gros rin cen/grub byu tai lo pa/grub wo ni ska lo ka shrī/grub wo mi tra dzo gi/khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal/bla ma dbon ston pa/yang rtse rin cen seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/khyung bo lhas pa gas nu bsod nams/bla ma rin cen grub legs pa/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/'khrul zhig dka' bzhi pa rin cen mchog grub dpal 'bar/rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo/mnga' ris ga kho ོ chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan rdo rje/bla ma o rgyan rgyal po/paṇa ོ kun dga' bkra shis/rab stims chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/khyab bdag khra tsha pa ོ po blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag za sto ban+de la'o//sems nyid ngal gso'i nyams 'khrid dang lha'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/'phags pa thugasarje wo po/byang sgos blo gros gi mā/tai lo shes tha bzang po/grub r+pā rol pa'i rdo rje/grub mu mi kro dzo gi/khro phu lotsā ba byams pa'i dpal/bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug/khro phu sems dpa' chen po ba nams seng ge/de la bla ma ra ma'i skyes bu ba nams mgon po dang yang rtse pa rin cen seng ge gnyis kyis gsan/gnyis ka la bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/de nas thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can/mkhas grub zla ba dpal rin/mas sgo 5pa/'khrul zhig tshul khrimasargyal mas/mkhas grub mkhyen rab chos rje/rje huXtsun rdo ring ba chen po/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des(170na thad ga la'o/ /lha'i rtags ma gtogs pa'i sa bcad bzhi pa yan gyi lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ khro phu lo tsā ba nas/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge man dbang brgyud ltar ro/ /sa bcad lnga pa'i lung brgyud ni/ khro phu lo tsā ba nas/ snye ba lo tsā ba rdo rje las rab rtsal/ bla ma dbon ston pa man dbang gi brgyud pa bzhin no/ /sa gcad drug pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ khro phu lo tsā ba nas/ bla ma dngon ston pa/ zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus/ yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge man dbang brgyud dang gcig go /grub chen mi tra dzo gi'i thugs kyi bcud 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor shin tu zab pa snying po don gsum du grags pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'khrid yig dga' ldan du bgrod pa'i them skas la zhal shes snyan brgyud kyis brgyan pa'i nyams 'khrid dang /lung la grub chen mi tra dzo gis mdzad pa'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang / 'khrid yig dga' ldan du bgrod pa'i them skas dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po/ byang sems blo gros ren cen/ grub chen te lo ba/ grub chen rol pa'i rdo rje/ grub chen mi tra dzo gi /khro phu lo tsā ba gnubasabyams pa'i dpal/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug /khro phu bsod nams seng ge /de la bla ma yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge dang tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon po gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ de nas khyung bo lhas gzhon nu bsod nams/ (170ba)thamasacad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa/ lcang ra ba mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / rje drung ba sochos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs leg pa chos 'byor/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'am pa pha bong kha ba dpal —244—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (kana'abyor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung ngag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i snying po don gsum gyi 'khrid yig gi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa yan gong ltar la/ de nas lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bo dong paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pa/ sngags rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mon rdzong ras pa zla ba rgyal mtshan/ drin can mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /'khrid yig 'di la yi dam dang 'pho ba'i skor gnyis la gzhan du ma grags pa'i zab gnad kyang 'ga' zhig snang bas de la dgongs te/ gzhan du yun ring lo slar bsgoms pa bas/ /gang gsung cha shas thob pa'ang don che ba'i/ /yab gcig thugs rje can de'i gsung rnams kyi/ /snying po yid la gang zin bris pa yin/ /zhes pa (171na khong ngo / /gnyis pa la ma rgyud dngos kyi skor/ slob bshad gser chos kyi skor te gnyis/ pha sa dang bya rgyud sogs 'dres cung da yod kyang ma rgyud sha che ba dang sde tshan gcig tu dgo pa'i dbang gi bkod do/ /dang po la/ shes rab kyi rgyud la sgo drug tu bzhugs pa las rigs drug cha mnyam par ston pa dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor pa mkha' 'gro ma sku ma bde ba mchog lha brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'phrin las mtha' yas/ dkyil chog ngag 'don rtogs par sla zhing dngos grub 'byung ba/ zha lu pa nam mkha' 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog mthong ba don ldan rnams la brten nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal kun tu bzang po/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ gsang bdag phyag na —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rdo rje/li tsa sī dri ma med pa/rgyal po dza/u pa rā dza/grub r+pā ku kurwa dza/mu ti ta nyi zla rdo rje/rdorje gdan pa'i gas yig tu mu ti ta dang nyi zla rdo rje zhes so sodang /ba hu ta dang mus to ba zhes sgo sor 2ga cing /ma' brtse thar rtseri shar pa po stogs yi0dkyus bsnang ba brtag/ba hu ta mu ti/slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/bi mā la mi tra/rma lo tsā ba rin cen mchog/gye re ma' brtse thar rtse shar pa sgrub khang pa rnams kyi gas yig tu chos skyong ra ba 'dug kyang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu dkyus la ra byung pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i gsan yig tsho dang mas/mchog skyong /rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis kas rma la thug cing 'go 'o mo gyis gnyis/la zhus tshul 'dug pa rnying yod pa mas/tsu ru rin cen gzhen nu/'go 'om tshul khrims 171ba ) byang chub/de la cog ro rgyal ba'i yon tan/stag rtse 'jam dpal/la gsum gzhen nu mchog gsum gyis zhus/gsum ga la khu byang chub 'od/de nas blo gros rgyal mas/rog ban rin cen tshul khrims/rong zom chos bzang /yam shud blo r+sā mgo zla pa 'bar/mgo zla 'thum grags/mgo dngos grub rgyal mas/mgo dge slong chos rdor/mgo dngos grub mgon/dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/rtse sdings pa chos sku 'od zer/gru mi bskyod rdo rje/byang chen mkhan po bsod nams 'phel/bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/bla ma tshul rgyal ba/lam 'brasapa bsod nams dpal/grub ོ kun dga' blo gros/chos rje nam mkha' tshul khrims/rong ston blo bzang grags pa/rdo rje 'chang cho rab chos rje/slob dpon /gha shrī/slob dpon tshul khrims 'od zer/slob dpon bsod nams dpal 'byor/'jam dbyangs byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/grub pa mchog gi ded dpon dbang phyug rab brtan/rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan/dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po khra tshang pa blo gros mchogo gi rdo rje/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na rma lo tsā ba nas/gnyag dz+nyā na kumā ra/khyung po dbyig 'od/cog ro rgyal 'bum/dam pa khu go dpal gzhon/de gsum la cog ro rgyal ba'i yon to/de nas yon to bzang po/cog ro byang chub 'byung gnas/za ring 'phags pa/rmugs byang chub rnying po/dmar sgom chen yon to tshul /༷sa/lce bsod nams bzang po/'gar 172na

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ston tshul bzang /yan shud blo chen man 'dra/rnal 'byor dbang phyug lha hi pas sbyang gzhi sgong skyed sbyong byed ltar legs par 'gal ba'i he ru ga'i rigs dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyis gsal byed khyad par bzhi ldan gsum la brten nas brgyud pa'i bka' babs dgu ldan gyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i bka' babs dang po sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ngor chen dang mkhyen brtse'i gsan mig na bka' babs bdun las mi 'dug kyang rdzo po lugs gnyis sgo sor bgrangs gnyosalugs bsnan pas dgu ca ngo //khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang /dpal phyag na rdo rje/bram ze chen po sar ha/mda' bas/'phags pa klu sgrub/grub chen sha wa ri pa/phag ro khur/slob dpon lha hi pa/dha ri ka pa/bud med phywa/rdo rje dril bu pa/rus sbal zhabs/tsog/shrīdzā la na dha ra/nag po spyod pa/gu phya pa/rnam rgyal zhabs/tai lo pa/nā ro ta pa/kun tu bzang po/nam mkha'i snying po/snyan grags bzang po/ye shes dngos grub/rtsal shad pa rnamasams gyi rnam grang su grags/pham mthing pa gzhen 'jigs med grags pa/gcung ngag gi dbang phyug/klog skya shes ros 'as/gas ḍa/ma la lotsā ba blo gros grags rje bzhi brtse bawo po/slob dpon gi po che/rje btsun rin po che/sa paṇa/'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge/dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/lo sto ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/172ba bang po lhas pa gas nu bsod nams/shar r+sā ye shes rgyal ma/rdo rje lang kun dga' bzang po/mus chen dkon cog rgyal mtshan/mus chen sangs rgyas rin cen/ngor chen sangs rgyasaseng ge/de la thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang dang mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/gnyis ka la sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/de nas khyab bdag he ru ka dpal mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to//yang na mus chen yan gong ltar la/de la kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byamaXpa dang grub chen dkon cog blo gros gnyis kyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gsan/ gnyis ka la mus chen sangs rgyas rin cen gyis gsan pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang na rje sangs rgyas rin cen nas/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse pa man 'dra/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ dmar chos rgyal/ mi nyag chos rgyal/ mi lhag rdor grags/ lce mdo sde seng ge /ston shāka /lce blo ldan/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ bo dong rin po che/ khro phu rin po che/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /kun mkhyen bu man gong bzhi no/ /yang na sa paṇa nas/ bo dong rin po che/ to r+sā bsod nams brtan pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no/ /yang na sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang (173na dkon cog dpal/rgyal ba brag phug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen man 'dra/bka' babs gnyis pa bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i bshad rgyud a bhi dha na'i le'u sum cu rtsa gsum pa nas gsungs pa'i mar do lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bde mchog gnyi pa sbyang pa'i yon tan lha gas sumama'am bde mchog lab pa4zer/rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ lha hi pa/ lha ki pa/ 'jam dbyangs ma brtse'i gsan yig tu lha hi pa dang 'di gnyis gcig par mdzad 'dug /paṇa grub dbang po la wa pa/ rgyal po in+d+ra sgru ti/ka tsa ṭa pa/ bu ston dang rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan mig na ka ca pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na ka tsa tra pa zhes snang /grub chen dril bu ba/ rus sbal zhabs/ bu rje btsong kha pa ngor gong dkar thar rtse shar pa rnam kyi gsan mig na mi gsal yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan mig na snang ba brtag /dzā la ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ ku sha la nā tha/ bu dang gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu 'di dang dge ba'i mgon po so sor 'dug pa rgya skad bod skad kyi khyad par la don gcig pa mig skyon shor ba 0 ngor ma' brtse thar rtse shar pa sog kyi gsha yig dang lta mthun/ tai lo ba/ nā ro pa/ ma na ka shrī dz+nyā na/bu'i gsan yig na ma na ka dang shrī dz+nyā na zhes 'dug pa yig skyon byung sgo snyam/ bal po bha da / su ma ti kirti dang gcig yin skad/—248

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las sgrogs bam dang po/ (ka)bu'i gsan yig na bha ran dang /ngor ོ gyi gsan yig tu bha to zhes snang ba gcig la yig skyon byung pha/ lo tsā ba mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang phyug /gze pa blo ldan seng ge /gze pa bde mchog rdo rje/ rje gzha tsho'i kha pa rdo rje gdan pa thar rtse pa gsum gyigs yig tu jo bde zhes snang / slob dpon khu (173ba tha/ khams pa lho tshad pa kun dga' rin cen/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ khyung lhas pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ rje sangs rin pa/ sangs rgyas seng ge /de la thar rtse pa dang mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la sgrub khang dpal don pa/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' 'gyur ba/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen la wa pa/ la ki mi pa/ bar ba'i gtso bo/ dge ba'i gtso bo/ ku sha la nā tha man gong ltar ro/ /yang na khyung lhas pa nas/ chos rje bkra shis rin cen/ ngor chen man 'dra/ yang na gze pa blo ldan nas/ gze pa don grub ye shes/ sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan man 'dra/ /bka' babs gsum pa jo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen lha hi pa/ slob dpon dha ri ka pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/rat+na ā ka ra shārnyi/ thar rtse pa'i gas yig na 'di jo bo'i rjes su 2ga pa yig nor mi tsā/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/ rong pa 'gar dge /dge bsnyen yin/ lha rje stod pa tshul khrims dpal/ sngags dkar/ steng pa thugs rje zla gsal/ rje bas btsong pa kha pa dang rdo rje gdan pa'i gag yig na steng shod zhal gnyis zhes snang / shod nyi ma kha dro/gcen shes rab rgyal po/ 'di gnyis kyi sgo tu rje bas btsong kha pa dang rdo rje gdan pa'i gas yig tu rje che ba dang sa ba zhe pa 'dug pa'i de zha lu tsan+d+ra ba'i gsan yig tu je ba che chung gi 'og tu sgo so'i mtshan brgyab 'dug pa don lagacig pa 'dra/ gcung shes rab gtsug tor/ lha rje chen po dharma tsakra /sngag pa rtse po/ thang stod (174nasgo chos 'ong / 4ca rtse bo/zhing chen pa grags pa dpal/ bod ge mig zer se bo/ bde gshegs dpal/ bod bas/ bla ma sgom gzha pa/pa ye shes/ gyer bug pa sgom me dang tsog pa wa/ bla ma grags chen/ btsun pa byar bu ba/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ khyung lhas pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ sems dpa' chen po/ sangs rin pa/ sangs rgyas —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)seng ge /de la thar rtse pa dang mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la sgrub khang pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /bka' babs bzhi pa kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ tsakra wa ra/ badz+ra wa ra twe/ grub chen lha hi pa/ ri khrod zhabs/ 'di gong dkar shā gas yig na mi dag gar dmo dbyad/gan+ta pa/ 'dren mdzad zhabs/ bik+ṣa ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang po/ mnga' ris ze dmar ba sangs rgyas ye shes/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa yan jo lugs dang 'dra/ yang na bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra nas/ mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes man 'dra/ yang na kha che paṇa chen nas/ spyi bo lhas pa seng ge dpal/ zhang phya ru ba/ 'bro lung pa/ rin po che khra phu ba/yang rtse pa rin cen seng ge /bu ston man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje lang /rdo rje phag mo/ slob dpon dril bu pa/ dha ri /ba/ dga' ba rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ a bha ya/ de wa stsa/ kha che paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang nye brgyud ni 'khor lo sdom pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī man gong bzhin no/ /bka' babs lnga pa pu rang lo chung lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang rdo (174ba)rje phag mo/ grub chen lha hi pa/ lha ki pa/rdo rje dril bu pa/ dza las ri pa/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa/ dge ba'i mgon po/ rus sbal zhabs/ gu tho pa/ rje bsdung kha pa dang gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na sgrub pa zhes snang / rnam rgyal zhabs/tai lo pa/nā ro ta pa/ ma na ka shrī/ pra dz+nya rak+ṣi ta/ pham thing pa gsum/ 'jigs med grags pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ bha darnya/pu rang lo chung grags mchog shes rab/ 'di lus ma sbangs par mkha' spyod du byon pa yin/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris kyi ston pa dkon cog 'bar/ thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ thang spe ba 'phagasapa skyabs/ rtse sdings ba gzhen nu 'od/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che man jo bo lugs bzhin no/ /yang na dmar chos rgyal nas/ mi nyag chos rgyal/ mi nyag rdor grags/ lce mdo seng / bla ma ston shāka /blo ldan seng ge /'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na ma na ka dang pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta gnyis la ka na la shrīs gas na/ de dang pham thing pa gnyis ka la bha dan+da/ de nas bu rang lo chung man bshad ma thag pa ltar ro/ / 250

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bka' bab bas drug pa mar lugasang kyi brgyud pa ni/ gsan yig tshor 'di bzhin 'dug kyang mar lo sogasamabyung bas dmang lugs zer rgyu yin nam dbyad/ pham thing pa yan sa lugs dang 'dra ba la/ de nas bal po bha ( /lo chung grags mchog shes rab/ dmar chen po chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dbon po shes rab rdo rje/ thub pa shes rab/ brtson 'grus rdo rje/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shākya gzhon nu/ lce blo ldan seng ge /bla ma 'phags 'od/ kun mkhyen bu ston (175na sgon jo lugs dang 'dra/bka' babs bdun pa dpyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ grub chen lha hi pa/ rgyal po dha ri ka pa/mnga' bdag mi tri pa/ n+ya ka pa/ gas pa/ bik+ṣa ta de wa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ grub thob rdo rje gdan pa/paṇ+ḍi ta skyi ti gar+bha/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos bzang / rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras shes rab seng ge /gru ma chos skyong dpal/ khyung po lhas pa man jo bo lugs bzhin no/ /bka' bab ba(brgyad pa sbal spang sna lug ba'i kyi brgyud pa ni/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'di jo lugasabargyud pa'i rnam grangs su mdzad 'dug cing thar rtse ra pa'i gsan yig na dkyus bzhin du so sor snang / sangs rgyas/ ye shebasakyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon chen po tsaṇ+ḍi ka ma/ bram ze chen po me ko pa/ slob dpon lha hi pa/ dha ri /pa/ bram ze sdom pa bzang po/ jo bo rje a ti sha /de la lo chen rin cen bzang po dang nag tsho lo tsā ba gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la 'phan yul 'al pa ston mgon dang 'al pa jo btsun gnyis kyisagasan/ de gnyis la sgom pa sngags dkar lcang lo can/ mang sgom/ 'phan yul rgyal pa/ sbal spang drang srong srin po ri pa/sna pa/ 'di gnyi sku mgo yin/ me reg dar ma byang chub/ spong zho brag nag pa/ de dbon rin cen rgyal po/bla ma don ri ba grags pa dpal/ bod gas phyar bu ba/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ kun mkhyen bu ston man jo lugs ba'i na no/ /bka' babs dgu pa gnyos lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig tu 'di'i rjes su nag po pa 'dug /gu tho pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ te lo pa/nā ro pa/ de la ra skyi ta/ nag po lha las dad pa/ pham mthing pa ste gsum kyis gsan/ gsum ka la (175bang la po bha dan+ta/ de nas nag po lha las dad pa'i slob ma/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na'ang 4skogasal—231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mi 'dug /rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na bha dan+ta dang lha las dad pa gnyis ka la gnyos lo sto bsags na tshul snang ba dag par ma'/ gnyos lo tsā ba/ gnyos bla ma/ gnyos dpal le/ phug ka ba jo bo tho 'bum dang gtsang pa lha steng pa dang lce mdo sde seng ge sngags dkar lcang log yin/ bla ma ston shāka /bod btsun/ bla ma blo ldan/sngags dkar lcang lo can/ bla ma 'phags 'od man jo lugs dang 'dra/ kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha hi pa'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bzhi ldan gyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje yab sras/nam mkha'i mtshan can/ tsan+d+ra shrī/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab rje/ byang gling rin rgyan/ don grub rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ slob dpon dkon cog rgyal mtshan/rtsa ba'i bla ma zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi zab don grub pa'i khyu mchog dpal ldan spyod pa'i rdo rje brtul zhugs pa'i zhabs kyis sbyang gzhi mngal skyes ltar sbyong byed du bkral ba'i bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge dang zha lu pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs/ rje btsun rin po che'i dkyil chog /de'i gsal byed ngor chen dkor cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rnams la brten nas dbang bzhi legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ rje gu btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na phyag rdor/sar ha/ klu sgrub/sha wa ri/ lha hi pa/dha ri ko pa/dril bu pa zhes byung ba ring brgyud yin 'dra/ grub chen dril (176na༄ pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dzā las ra/ grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rje/ nag po bar grags pa gsum byon te/nag po spyod pa ba/nag po dam rdzo rdo rje/nag po lha lasadad pa gsum gyi dang po gnyis la nag po pa che ba dang chung bar grags pa las 'di nag po pa rtseb ga sna pa ste spyod pa par grags so/ /slob dpon gu tho pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs/ tai lo pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ pham thing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung ngag gi dbang phyug /klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ sngags pa gos dkar ༅/ rje bas brtse ba wo po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje bas rin po che/ chos rje paṇa chen/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa/ zhad dkon cog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/—252

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / chos rje gshon nu seng ge /byu gyi brgyud pa 'di sto nas rtsa skad/ rje sangs rgyas dpal grub/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyas seng ge /de la brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dang mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs kun khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ khā char ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas dpal grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mus pa grub chen dkon cog blo gros/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin cen/ rje lha mchog (17ba thang ge man gong ltar ro/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/grub chen dkon cog blo gros man 'dra/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin cen nas/ chos rje dge legasabashes gnyen/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ stag ston shes rab gzhen nu/ bla ma brag dkar ba/ mkhas grub gzhen nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ bu ston rin po che'i gsan yig dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses tshar chen dang grol mchog la gsan pa tshang mar rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su grub chen dril bu pa 'dug na'ang / ngor chen rdo rje gdan pa thar rtse sgrub khang shar pa khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba rnams kyi gsan yig ltar na/ rdo rje 'amang / phyag na rdo rje/ sar ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ri pa/lha hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ dril bu pa man mthun pa 'di bzhin no/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pasalegs par bkral ba'i 'khor lo sdom pa zab don dril bu pa phyi'i dkyil ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por zha lu pa thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi steng nas dbang bzhi legs par nos pa'i bka' babs dang po sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ 'bar ba 'dzin/ ga sna pa/ gu khya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/—253

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tai lo pa/nā ro pa/pham thing pa sku mched/klog skya shes rab brtsegs/mal gyi lo tsā ba blo gros grags/rje bas sa skya pa r+ṣa po/slob dpon rin po che/rje bzhi r+pā po/sa paṇ+ḍita/177na'i phags pa rin po che/khro phu rin po che/yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/khyung lhas pa gzhen nu bsod nams/mkhas pa nor bzang rin cen/dka' bzhi pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ljil mig pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/lha bo pa kun dga' don grub/slob dpon bsod nams dpal 'byor/byang gling rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/grang r+pā pa dpal ldan chos bzang /chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na bu ston rin po che nas/thugs sras rin cen rnam rgyal/rje kun dga' rin cen/gzad rin pa/brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/bla ma yon to rgya mtsho/bla ma shākya kun dga'/kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/paṇa chen bsod na mas mchogo ldan/zha lu pa ོ po/des bdag la'o//yang na thugs sras rin cen rnam rgyal nas/shangs pa shes rab dpal bzang /rje sangs rgyas rin cen/gnas rnying pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/gnas rnying pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/mar ston tshul khrims rin cen/rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rje blo gros mtha' yas/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/zur thams cad mkhyen pa/des bdag la'o//yang na shes rab dpal bzang nas/dge legs dpal bzang /mthu chen legs rgyan/rgya ma ba rin cen rgyal mtshan/nyan shāka pa/177bar+ṣa po yon to bshes gto/wo po blo gros rnam rgyal/shar pa rin cen rgyal mas/rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/yang na sa paṇa nas/bo dong rin cen brtson 'grus/khro phu rin po che man 'dra/yang na sa paṇa nas/tshogs sgom pa/khro phu ba man 'dra/bka' babs gnyis pa mar do lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /dril bu pa/laṅka ling pa/nag po spyod pa/dge ba'i mgon po/tai lo pa/4

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nā ro pa/ ma ṇa ka shrī/ ka ṇa ka shrī/ pham thing ba 'jigs med grags pa/ bal po bha dan+ta/ su ma ti kirti yang zer/ mar do lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug /sngags pa shos da ༅/ gze pa blo ldan seng ge /gze pa bde mchog rdo rje/ shākya rdo rje/ rong pa chos mgon/ lo mchog pa/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra/ thugs sras rin po ches mdzad pa'i dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs yid kyi mun sel dang dkyil chog gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ dbang rnon/ tsan+d+ra shrī/zhabrul zhig rje/ rin cen mchog grub/ byang gling rin rgyal 'brog sgang pa/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ gro po lung pa/ slob dpon dkon rgyan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sgrub dkyil gnyis kyi lhan thabs byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ byang gling rje man gong bzhin no/ /slob dpon dril bu pa'i bzhed srol dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lus kyi dkyil 'khor du thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i dkyil chog zab don gsal ba la brten nasadabang bzhi legs par nos pa'i bka' babs gnyis ldan gyi dang po (178na)sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / yum rdo rje phag mo/ grub r+ṣa rdo rje dril bu pa/ rab rma gi mas blo gros snying po/ ku me pā da/'bar ba 'dzin pa/ kuṇ+ḍa pa/ gu ༅ pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung ngag gi dbang phyug /klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/rje ge thi kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ bla ma rje 'ar+sha ho po/ chos rje paṇ+ḍita/'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ ba phug pa bsod nams dpal/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyasarin cen/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ de la thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dang mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la —255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ de nas rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal to/ /yang na rje sangs rgyas rin cen nas/ ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ slo bo mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa la/ 'phags pa rin po che/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ bo dong rin po (174༄ gsum gyis gas/ de gsum ga la khro phu rin po che bsod nams seng ges gsan/ de la bla ma dpal ldan seng ge dang yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge gnyis kyis gsan/ de gsum la thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin cen grub/ de nas khyung po lhas pa gzhen nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na khyung lhas pa la/ mkhas grub nor bzang rin cen/ dka' bzhi pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ mkhan chen rigs 'dzin rgyal po/ lcags sgog lung pa bkra shis dpal 'byor/ sgo r+sā gyi ku su lu'i bla ma lam du mjal gsung bde na/ byang gling pa rin cen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/yang na byang gling rin cen bkra shis rgyal mtshan nas grang chen slob dpon dpal ldan chos bzang rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /bka' ba bas gnyizla/pa kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ badz+ra dha ra/ badz+ra wā ra hi/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa pa/ rje bas btsong kha pa' gas yig na bar 'dir dha ri na pa snang bsar dam brtag/dga' ba'i rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/a bha yā kā ra gup+ta/ de wa pā r+ṇa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ spyi bo lhas pa seng ge dpal/ shad phya ru ba/ byang sems 'bri lung pa/ thar rtse pa dang shar pa'i gsan yig na zhang 'bre lung pa zhes 'di dang sgong ma gnyis bla mthakhegatu mdzad 'dug kyang bu r+sādang ma' bu'i gas yig tu dkyus ltar so sor snang ngo / /khro phu rin po/ yang rtse pa rin cen seng ge/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston man 'dra/ thung brgyud ni/ rdo rje dril bu ba/ de wa bla ṇi/ kha che paṇa chen man 'dra/nye brgyud ni/ 'khor (179na tshe tho sdom pa/ kha che paṇa chen man gong bzhin no/ /—256

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i lus dkyil dbang chog gi lung ni/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal/ mkhas pa nor bzang rin cen/ dka' bzhi 'dzin pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ bla ma dbon rgyal ba/ rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ drung kun dga' bkra shis/ bla ma dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo dang mthun par bshad pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho lha stong dang lnga brgya zhe lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub rin po che'i mdzod/ des mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yon tan rin po che'i mdzod/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na lha stong phrag gcig brgya phrag dgu brgyad kyi lhag pa'i bcu phrag tshog yod par bshad chi lo pa'i gas yig na stong dang bdun brgya zhes snang ngo / /zha lu byang gling pa rin cen bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lhan thabs gsang ba'i mdzod kyi sgo 'byed lde mig /sngags 'phreng ngor chen gyis zhus dag mdzad pa rnams la brten nas dbang bzhi legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / yum rdo rje phag mo/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin cen/grub chen sha wa ri pa/ mnga' bdag mi tri gup+ta/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon ka mā la badz+ra/ paṇa grub dza ya se na/ sum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha (179ba long mang po chos kyi dbang phyug /lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug /mkhan chen byang chub seng ge /sa bzang 'phags pa gak+ṣ-i na nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub gung ru sher bzang / kun mkhyen go ram pa bsod nams seng ge /bya 'gyur pa bsod nams seng ge /mkhan chen dkon cog tshul khrims/ zha yong dpal wor cha 'a'i gdan sa pa/rje btsun sgo dras pa kun dga' legs pa/ jo nang mkhan po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang —257

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rtsamatsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()phyug /zha lu'i mkha po/ rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag zha lu pa rin cen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge man 'dra/ yang na tsho paṇa nas/ mnga' ris pa rin 'byung / tshul khrims rin cen rang byung rdo rje/ 'dzam gling paṇ+ḍita/ bla ma a mo gha pa/ gzad pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ rje rnam rgyal rin cen/ bla ma shākya kun dga'/ bla chen ye shes dbang po/nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' 'gyur pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ dha byang chub sems dpa'/ a sa ka ra/mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na a ཿ rak+ṣi ta/ zhes gcig tu bsdoms 'dun kyang gong dkar ba dang thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na dkyus ltar snang ngo / /rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ (180nasgo ṇa grub dza ya sen/ sum pa lo tsā ba man gong ltar ro/ /yang na sum pa lo tsā ba nas/ mkhas pa sa mu dra/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ ngor mu dang thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na grags pa dpal zhes pa dkyus su bris bar rdo rje yin nam 'di ma dag zer ba'i mchan 'dug kyang rdo rje gdan pa'i gas yig na 'di ltar snang ngo / /bag ston gzhen tshul man 'dra/ yang na bag ston nas/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma bde legs pa/ de la tshal min bsod nams bzang po dang gnas rnying rin cen rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ de nas brag thog pa man 'dra/yang na sum pa lo tsā ba nas/ rgya thams cad mkhyen pa/ srin po ri pa/ bsgrad ston rdo rje dpal/ gong dkar phags mig na gzhi go snang / mtshur phu ba tshul khrims rin cen/ rje rang byung rdo rje/ snye mdo kun dga' don grub/ bsod nams 'od zer/ bag ston ga smo tshul man gong bzhi no/ /yang na rang byung rdo rje nas/ yor pa ye shes dpal/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ pad+ma badz+ra che wo gnyis/ in+d+ra bha ti/ lcam la kur/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/rdo rje gdan pa/ a —258—

rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ ()'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dkar po lhan cig skyes pa'i byin rlabs/bde mchog dkar po la brten nas byang chub bsgrub pa/'jam dkar la brten nas shes rab bsgrub pa/yang dag me gcig thod gcig la brten nas ras thub pa/bye la nag po la brten nas nor bsgrub pa'o//rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig byang chub sgrub pa'i nye lam grub pa'i zhal lung la brten nas bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams 'khrid zab mo smin rgyas/zhan byung tshe sgrub kyi 'khrid dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /rdo rje phag mo/rnal 'byor dbang phyug lha hi pa/da ri ka pa/mi tri pa/na ya ka pa/gas pa/kha che'i paṇa chen shākya shrī/dpyal chos kyi bzang po/dpyal a mo gha/rje btso rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/de sras shes rab seng ge/bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/mkhan chen seng ge dpal/brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/thugs sras klu dbang gling pa/gos spungs tshe dbang bkra shis/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na kha che paṇa 181bsten nas/sa paṇ+ḍita/g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang po/grub chen ze dmar ba sangs rgyas ye shes/mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/bya sder pa byang chub seng ge/sa bzang 'phags pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/mus chen sems dpa' r+ṣa po/grub r+ṣa dkon cog blo gros/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/yang na ngor chen nas/gu ge paṇ+ḍita/glo bo mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/rje grol mchog man gong bzhin no//byang chub sgrub pa dang tshe sgrub pa'i nyams 'khrid rje dbang rab kyis mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig gi lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ngor wo nas/mug mu 'bor lo /༷ pa chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang /rje byams

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa chos legs/'khrul zhig byams pa shes rab bzang po/khrag 'thung tsho gis kyi dbang phyug tshar pa chos rje/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/bo dong mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mas/rigs kun bdag po dbang phyug rab brtan/gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la stsal to//nye brgyud ni/rdo rje phag mo/kha che paṇa chen man dbang 'khrid thams cad la 'dra//rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug byang pa ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po la gser chos gsum gyi bka' babs pa'i tshe dpag med ni o rgyan chen pos dngos su gnang bas gsang sngags rnying ma bka' mar gtogs la/'dir zho ra ras pas 182nasgo dzad pa'i dbang chog snying po bsdus pa'i steng nas bde mchog lha lnga'i byin rlabs dang /'bri gung mkhan chen rnam mgon dri med sdes mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig grub pa'i mchog sbyin gyi steng nas zab mo ni gu chos drug gi thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar gyi nyams 'khrid mjug tu rlung la dor ba dang /gser chos gsum pa 'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma dang bcas pa'i smin rgyas su nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma/mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/rmog cog pa rin cen brtson 'grus/skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge/gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab/sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge/bsam sdings pa gzhen nu grub/zhang ston pa/tshom dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gas yig na 'di mi 'dug pa brtag/mkhas btsun lho ba/nyang stod bsam sdings kyi bla ma sku mched gsum/sprul sku blo gros dpal ba/'di gong dkar lugs kyi bas yig na mi 'dug kyang mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na bla ma sku mched gsum mi 'dug pa de'i gra shig yin nam brtag/'jam dbyangs chos dpal bzang po/mus chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rgyal sras byams mgon pa/bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/'jam dbyangs byang chub dbang rgyal/paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje/bla ma lha dbang 'phrin las/mkhas grub tshul khrims bkra shis/'jam dbyangs dge ba'i daX po/rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bsod na mas mchogo grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na ras wo pa nas/'jam dbyangasabyang 182ba༄kha dbang rgyal man 'dra//nye brgyud ni/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu mas spo ba la kong lung du ras wo dpal 'byor bzang po la dngos su gnang /de man gong bzhi no//'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma'i nyams khrid kyi brgyud lugs khag gcig/'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma'i nyams 'khrid kyi brgyud pa lug/sa gcig ni/rdo rje 'chang /rdo rje phag mo/mkha' 'gro ma ni gu/ras mu dpal 'byor bzang po/mkhas grub bya bral chos rje/mtshungasamed bsam gtan gling pa/mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ras chung rnam sprul bkra shis rgya mtsho/rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog/mtshungs med ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i ga kho lung du/rdo rje rgyal mtshan gsung gi sprul pa gcig bsod nams rgyal mtshan phag gru'i nang nas yang /bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin bod 'bangs yongs kyi phaḥzhes lung gis zin pa'i spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po lha gzigs ras pas mdzad pa'i nā ro chos drug gi 'khrid yig wo mo'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan/'brog shar smad pa rat+na bha dra/mkhan chen shar smad ba bsod nams bkra shis/brag thog thams cad mkhyen pa/grub chen g.yang hril rgyal mas don grub/mkhan chen dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan/mnga' ris drung pa rin po che lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/gye re lha btsun lha dbang rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba dpal 'byor lhun grub/zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//183natshar pa chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga pad dkar bas pa'i 'phreng ba dang /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga'i steng nas dpal 'khor lo

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)sdom pa'i rgyud mngon par brjod pa 'bum pa las gsung pa'i tshe dpag med lha gcig bum gcig tshe gzan la brten pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/mgon po tshe dpag med/ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/rje ras chud rdo rje grags pa/mi la ba 'ad pa rdo rje/mnyam med zla 'od gas nu/bde gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal/'bri gung 'jig rten gsum mgon/spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po grags pa 'byung gnas/yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje/thugs srasaspyan snga rigs ldan/zur phug pa rin cen dpal bzang /'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /grub chen rin cen 'phel/zha lu mkhan chen 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/sku zhang rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab rin cen mchog grub/rje btsun rdo ring pa wo po/tshar wo chos kyi rgyal po/'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/rigs kun khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mag ldan/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/zha lu mkhan chen khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag la'o//yang na 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la/mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/sngags long bsod nams chos183ba'i phel/zha lu byang gling pa rin cen bkra shis rgyal mtshan gsum gyis gsan/tshar chen sogs yab sras lnga ga la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gas pa man 'dra/yang na tshar r+ṣa nas/gnyan ston sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros/rje dbang rab man 'dra/yang na tshar chen nas/rin po che bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/skyed tshal mkhan chen thar pa rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag zha lu pa/de bdag la'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang dbang rab nas/zha lu pa dge 'dun dpal bzang /mkhan wo zha lu pa/de bdag la'o//yang na 'ba' ra ba nas/rje sangs rgyas seng ge/'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po/shangs dkar ba rin cen rgyal mas/pha rgod bso/ nams bzang po/rje btsun rdo ring ba ོ po man

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'dra/yang na 'ba' ra ba nas/chos rje bde legs rin cen/lha do rtogs ldan yang ra/gnas rnying pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa kun dga' dpal bzang /chos rje rin cen rgyal mtshan/sku zhang ma' rab chos rje man 'dra/yang na rdo ring rin po che/rje bzhi sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/rdo rje 'chang tshar ba chos rje/yab sras gnyis ka la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses gsan pa man gong ltar ro//yang na sgo rum pa nas/de dbon sgo rum pa ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/yang na rje sgo rum pa dang tshar chen gnyis la mnga' ris ru thog 84na ) pa nam mkha' gzi brjid/de nas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na ras chung pa nas/sum pa seng ge dpal/lo ston kun dga' dar/gling ras pa pad+ma rdo rje nas rim par brgyud de/rtsis dang sman tshul khang pa slob dpon bkra shis dar/dgung lo brgya lhag ba po yin/rje btsun rdo ring pa man 'dra/yang na skyed mchog 'ba' ra ba nas/g.yag ste kha rag ri ba sangs rgyasargyal mtshan/'bri gung lo tsā ba nam mkha' grags/mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang /rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rje rin cen rnam rgyal/paṇa chen gzhung lugs 'bum phrag brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar/chos lor lhun tsho mag po/bla chen nam mkha' ga brjid man 'dra/yang na rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po nas/rje kun dga' grol mchog/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na lha do rtogs ldan bde legs rin cen nas/dbu ma chos shes bzang po/dge slong dpal mgon pa/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ngor ba lha mchog seng ge/grol mchog man 'dra/yang na 'ba' ra ba nas/gnyan ras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/dme pa chos grags rgya mtsho/tre bo cho me kyi rgya mtsho/rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog man 'dra/yang na rje btsun grol mchog nas/gser mdog can gyi mkhan po 'bum ram pa dge 'dun nyi ma/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/yang na kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa kun dga' dpal yan go/ /ra la/dbu ma pa dpal ldan bzang po/drin can

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dpal ldan mgon po/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/bdag chen 'jam 84brko pa la da byangasang ga gi dbang phyug/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/yang na 'ba' ra ba nas/mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma/rong ston shes bya kun rig/lha 'bri shes rab rdo rje/mi nyag grags pa rdo rje/bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug man gong ltar ro//yang na 'ba' ra ba nas/grub chen rin cen bzang po/lung mang po chos grags dpal bzang /mkhan chen zla ba blo gros/skyesamachog tshangs pa rgyal mtshan/mal gro grub chen blo gros dpal ldan/chos lung mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na 'ba' ra ba nas/rje sangs rgyas seng ge/klong mkhar ba kun dga' shes rab/mon rtse ba kun dga' dpal/gri byang chub sding pa kun dga' dpal/de'i gdan sa pa byang chub dpal/mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun grub man gong bzhi no//yang na ras sa pa nas/gru ston rdo rje 'od/chag drag bcom/sha lo chos rje dpal/bla brang steng pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/rje btsun dpal chen bzang po/rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug man 'dra/yang na ras chung pa nas/sum pa seng ge dpal/lo ston kun dga' dar/gling ras pad+ma rdo rje/grum ston dar ma shes rab/sbrag phug pa shes rab dpal/grub thob legs ldan 'od/rje btsun dpal chen bzang po man 'dra/yang na gangs khrod pa kun dga' dpal bzang nas/mus chen dpal ldan mgon po/chos rje nyi zla seng ge/yol mo sprul sku shākya bzang po/bkra bzang 185na sngags 'chang chos skyong bsod nams/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na chag lo gsum pa nas/thugs sras don yod dpal/rin po che bshes gnyen bkra shis/grub brnyes sdom brtson chos kyi 'byung gnas ngag dbang rnam rgyal/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra//yang nye brgyud ni/tshe dpag med/rje btsun mi la ras pa/chos rje ye shes dpal bzang man gong bzhin no//yang na ras chung pa nas/mnga' ris pa ༷nga chub rdo rje/bla ma kun dga' shes rab/bzang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()yul ba rin cen ldan/'gro mgon ston pa/mkhas grub gzhon nu grub/bla ma byang chub shes rab/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/'khrul zhig grags pa tshul khrims/mnyam med rgyal ba bzang po/rje bkra shis ye shes/bla ma tshul khrims dbang phyug/rje bshes gnyen bkra shis/bla ma ngag dbang rnam rgyal man 'dra/yang na ras chung pa nas/dgung lo gyag gyil/'gos ri khrod dbang phyug/dgung lo gya brgyad/gnyan sgom rgyal pa seng ge/dgung lo go drug/byang chub gling pa/dgung lo go gnyis/slob dpon dge'u pa/dgung lo gya drug/'don pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/dgung lo go dgu/chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa/ mkhan chen mchims/ mkhas grub gzhon nu grub man 'dra/ yang na 'gos ri khrod dbang phyug nas/yar klungs kyi gnyag dmar po/rje btsun yon tan bzang po/rig pa 'dzin pa gnyos a seng /gan pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/yang na bla ma dam pa nas/bla ma rnam rgyal dpal bzang 185ba7khan chen dpal 'byor/brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/phun tsho gos gling pa rnam rgyal rin cen/'brasaspungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/rdo rje 44 tshar pa chos rje/'jam dbyangs ma brtse ma na 'dra/yang na gan pa rin rgyal nas/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/brag thog pa man 'dra/yang na ras chung pa nas/mnga' ris pa byang chub rdo rje/grub thob rgyal tsha mgon po/bla ma bzang yul ba/sangs rgyas ston pa/rin wo seng ge/slob dpon lha gzhon/mkhan wo dang ma ba/mkhan r+sā shes rab rdo rje/chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/brag thog pa man 'dra/yang na kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa nas/rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/bla ma shākya kun dga'/kun bzang rtse ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//yang na nyi ma gling pa nas/rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/de la kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol dang khyab bdag zha lu pa gnyis kyis gsan/gnyis ka la bdag gis zhugaso//yang na 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang yan gong ltar la/des nas skye mchog ā nas ༷6/6chos rje dpal 'byor rgyal mas/yab rje rdo rje

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/chos rje yon tan mchog/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/gye re lha btsun lha dbang rgya mtsho/de gnyis ka la 'khon ston rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/de nas zur thams cad mkhyen pa/des bdag la stsal to//yang na thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho nas/ 86na ) paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho man gong ltar ro//yang na thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho nas/brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa man 'dra/yang na gangs can pa kun dga' dpal bzang yan gong ltar la/de nas 'brong rtse lha btsun rin cen rgya mtsho blo gros/grub wo ngag dbang blo gros/mar ston tshul khrims rin cen/rdo rje 'amang sngags ram pa ge 'dun bkra shis/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho man 'dra/yang na yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje nas/mkhan po rin cen rdo rje/sprul sku bsod nams rin cen/byang semasakhyung dkar ba r+sā po/ri pa dkon cog 'byung gnas/bla ma smon lam snying po/mkhas bas chosadapal mgon po/ri khrod pa seng ge dpal bzang /paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/mar ston sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims rin cen man gong ltar ro//yang na 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang nas/chos rje shes rab dpal/bla ma tshul khrims dpal bzang /rje rin cen bshes gnyen/mtshungasamed sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/rje skyabs mchoge dpal/rje blo bzang don grub/dben sa bla ma sangs rgyasaye shes/mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/des bdag la'o//yang na rje bsod nams rgya mtsho nas/khri rin po che rgyal khang rtse pa/'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel/des bdag la'o//yang na dbu ma pa dpal ldan bzang po nas/rje dpal ldan mgon po/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ngor chen 186bsto mchog seng ge/rje sangs rgyas seng ge/thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen/des bdag la'o// 6

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()yang na thar rtsen ma mkha' dpal bzang nas/de dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//yang na thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang nas/shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//yang na rje sangs rgyas seng ge nas/shar chen kun dga' bkra shis man 'dra/yang na rje sangs rgyas rin cen nas/'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ngor wo dkon cog lhun grub/rje dkon cog dpal ldan/shar r+ṣa man 'dra/yang na mi nyag grags pa rdo rje yan sngar ltar la/de nas 'jam dbyangs sa lo man 'dra/yang na sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje nas/sku zhad bsod nams mchog grub/sku zhang rin cen bkra shis bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sku spyo sgo ldan 'dis rdzogs/ri sbug dbu mdzad rin cen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o//brgyud lugs gcig la/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo 'di spyan snga zhwa dmar ba thams cad ma' pa chos kyi grags pa dang rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shi kyi gsan yig na 'dug cing /lha lcam man da ra ba la rgya gar du dus ring mo zhig nas ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mor grags zhes gsung ngo //man 'dra//byin rlabs kyi cho ga pad dkar bzhad pa'i 'phreng ba'i lung ni/tshar chen nas/mkhyen brtse'i 187na tshobs/mkhan chen bslab gsum pa/rje dbang rab man 'dra/tshar chen cho se kyi rgyal po'i gsung rgyun 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris su mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig bdud rtsi zil dngar gyi steng nas bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim la brten nas tshe bsring ba'i nyams 'khrid zab mo smin rgyas dang 'khrid yig gi lung bcas nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang yan sngar ltar la/de nas grub chen rin cen 'phel/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab rje/mkhas grub rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/rdo rje 'am ri tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i daX /ga/'phags mchog byams pa skal ldan bzang

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bdag la'o//mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje lang /rdo rje phag mo/grub thob koṅka dat+ta/a bha yā kar/su tsa ri pā da/rat+na rak+ṣi ta/mā na /shrī dz+nyā na/chag lo chos rje dpal/go lung pa mdo sdod pa la rgyalams/shong lo rdo rje rgyal mas/lo tsā ba ma rdzo ldan legs pa'i blo gros/dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/rje sangs rgyas lhun grub/mkhan chen dkon cog tshul khrims/rje sangs rgyas dpal/rje btsun sgo dras pa kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams mchog ldan/shes bya kun mkhyen zur chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na koṅka dat+ta nas/a nu sam rak+ṣi ta/kumā ra de wa/re len+d+ra pra bha wa/chag lochos rje dpal man 'dra/yang na lo sto ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros nas/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan man gong ltar ro//yang na dpang lo tsā ba nas/sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/sa bzang 1yon sgo phags pa gzhen nu blo gros/ngor chen man 'dra/yang na bla ma dam pa nas/dbang rnon rgyal ba mchog grub/dka' bzhi pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/rje bas rdo ring pa wo po/tshar wo chos kyi rgyal po/'jam dbyangs ma brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs dang byin mas kyi cho sa /nyis kyi lung brgyud ni/ngor wo yan gong ltar la/de nas gu ge paṇa r+ṣa/rwa ston yon to dang bzang /mnga' ris pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/rje grol mchog/rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang dkon cog legs pa/sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rgya gar gyi paṇa chen ā tsarla dmar pos rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la gnang ba'i rdo rje nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba 'byung po 'ur 'ded ces shin tu thugs gtsigs che ba'i zab chos kyi skor la zin bris dang phyag len la brten nas rjes gnang / gdams pa shar 'bun cu ba dpal ldan grags kyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor gyi nang gses khyad par gyi las sbyor ser ba dang char gcod pa/ mid 'byar 'chos pa/ dug bsrung / dug 'bred/ sri'u gso ba/ gdon bgegs bsgrad pa/ spyo ba 'dul ba/ bcud len/ mdze gso ba/ spyi 'gro'i las sbyor dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bla ma ā tsarla dmar po/ ga4 ba shes4kyang zer bod du lan gsum byon pa'i dang po khri srong lde'u btsun gyi dus/ bar pa bstan pa (189ba)phyi dar gyi 'go/rjes ma sa chen dang mjal ba ste sku tsho rig yon ba kho pa dam gcar ma'i bla rgyud na yod pa de dang mug go/rje btsun sa skya ba chen po/ slob dpon rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ rong mi grags pa dpal/ rong mi lnga sba ba can sangs rgyas/ rong mi dar ma grags/ rong mi sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rong mi bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shar 'bun cu ba dpal ldan grags/ sbu chu zer ba'ang snang / grags pa dpal mgon/ jo stan khro yon nam mkha' lhun bzang / bla ma dpal ldan grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog rgya mtsho/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ rgyal tshab shes rab 'byung gnas/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ ngor chen dkon cog rgya mtsho nas/ bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o/ /rje sangs rgyas rin cen gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi zin bris dang zin bris zur pa gnyis kyi steng nas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya ba'i bka' srung dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang / lung la/ dpal dur khrod bdag po'i rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo le'u brgyad pa paṇ+ḍita be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta las brgyud cing 'jim lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ dur khrod bdag po'i —272

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)sgrub thabs/ / be+e ro tsa nas mdzad pa 'jim lo'i 'gyur/'gor gang dang rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis zhes yod (sgo / nga'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma bla ma be+e ro'i man ngag/'gor dpal dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang 190na ) bya bzhes yod (5)pa'i rjes gnang gi yig rnying rdzogs so'i mtha' can/rjes gnang gi yi ge rje sangs rgyas rin cen (ni/gyis mdzad pa/des mdzad pa'i bsnyen pa (5)dang mchod gtor bsdus pa bya tshul/dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi man ngag tshogs so so'i skabs su shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/sku rten sba ba'i man ngag kun gyi (ni/gtsug gi nor bur 'gyur/'di ni rten gyi man ngag go'i mtha' can/rdzas dang sngags la brten nas smyo ba 'dul pa (3)g.yin zhig 'drir bcug pas thul lo'i mtha' can dam nyams bsgral ba'i las tshogs drag po'i las so'i mtha' can/spos khang pa rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bskang gso dang bstod bskul kyi yi ge/chos rgyal dbang po'i zhes mdzad pa'i skor la/lo rgyus dung sgra chen po srid gsum gang ba don ldan nyid du sgrog pa/bsnyen sgrub kyi rtsa ba 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bshad wo byed 'khor lo/srog kho bla rdo yong ba nyi zla skar gsum/yon tan rten gyi 'khor lo'i gnad gdams tshig brgyud la/rten bzheng rab gnas de dang 'brel ba'i zlog gsang bstan pa sna tsho gos byed po'i nyams yig/gtor ma'i yig chung 'dod yon sprin phung /'bru 'phel ma rmos lo tog/dkar 'phel dngos grub 'dod 'jo/lo legs 'byor ba'i bang mdzod/thabs gtor rin cen 'bar ba/rkun 'ching don yod zhags pa/bzlas pas 'bral med 'grogs pa ngo ma' spro pa'i rba mas/ga sto chog gsal byed 'dod yon gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/rimasabasrung dpa' bo'i sgo 190bsrung /'dzul chog yid bzhin tshe 'khor/srid spel zla ba'i chu rgyun/sde dang chos 'phel ba 'du byed chos kyi dung sgra/gcan gzan kha 'ching gser gyi 'khor lo rnams thos pa las rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /rdo rje phag mo/grub wo pad+ma badz+ra/shrī badz+ra/rā hu la badz+ra/sgeg pa'i rdo rje/dz+nyā na sirnyi/dpal dam rdzo rdo rje/waṃ med blo gros bzang po/grub wo be+e ro

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tsa na badz+ra/ khams pa rga lo tsā ba gzhen nu dpal/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun chen po/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos gyi dbang phyug /mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog /bdag chen 'jam dbyangs chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ rdo rje 'amang tshar pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /grub pa mchog gi ded dpon bsod nams chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rigs kun khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ mkhan chen dkon cog tshul khrims/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ chos rje dpal ldan rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen/ rje sgo rum pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ (191na thad ga chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ chos rje sbyin pa dpal ba/ 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis/ zhe dgon pa bsod nams rtse mo/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ sprul sku gter ston bstan 'dzin nor bu/ sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /sangs rgyasarin cen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge gnyis dang chos rgyal bkra shis rtobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams ma gtogos pa'i rtags yod med tshang ma'i lung brgyud ni/ rjes gnang gi dang po dbang rab yan sor gnas la/ de nas zha lu pa/ des bdag go /sgo'i rtags can lugs gcig ni/ rjes gnang phyi ma gnyis ltar la/ dbang rab nas/ zha lu pa'o/ /byang pa rigs 'dzin chen pos mdzad pa'i yi ge rnamasakyi lung brgyud ni/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nas/ sha gzug pa ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal/gling stod chos rje dkon cog dpal 'byor/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag —274

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)la'o/ /yang rjes gnang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen nas/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu man 'dra/ yang na zhe dgon pa bsod nams rtse mo nas/ rje rin cen chos 'phel/ mkhan chen shesarab nor bu/ sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu man 'dra/kye rdor skor gyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i lung brgyud/rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la kye rdor bka' babs bzhi bzhugs pa (191ba tshe pas rnal 'byor dbang phyug birnya pa dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i grub chen ḍom+bhi he ru gas legs par bkral ba'i kye rdor ḍom+bhi lugs su grags pa lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du theg chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa las dang po pa 'jug bde dang dkyil chog kye rdor rnam par rol pa la brten nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birlu pa/ sa he ru ka /a na la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ dza ya shrī dz+nya na/ 'di gong dkar ba'i gsan mig na mi 'dug kyang thar rtse ba'i gsan yig na snang bas chad dam snyam/ mi thub zla ba/dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi lo chen/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon skye chu ba dgra lha 'bar/sa chen/ rtse mo/ rke btsun pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ mkhas grub rin cen rnam rgyal/ yongasa'adzin shākya kun dga'/ kun spangs rin cen dbang sgrol/ bla ma ye shes dbang po/ gra thang mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal po/ mkhas grub nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ mtshungs med dge ba'i dbang po/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal to/ /—275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()slob dpon a rna ga'i rjes su gongs pa o rgyan gyi slob dpon dpal pad+ma badz+ra gyis legs par bkral ba'i kye rdor mtsho skyes lugs nas gling ma lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du theg 92nar+ṣa rin po ches mdzad pa'i ma' rtogs zung 'jug rnam rol dang rje bzhi rtse mos mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi las rim bla ma'i phyag bzhes ltar bkod pa la dbang gong ma man ngag lugs nas kha bskangasate dbang bzhi nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 44 /bi lwa sa badz+ra/yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje/in+d+ra ༷ /lcam la snar/nag po spyod pa/bram ze dpal 'dzin/gha ya dha ra/bla 'a 'brog mi/se ston kun rig/༷ ston chos 'bar/rje gzha tsho/rta stags po pa/de dbon chos kyi shes rab dang la kha ba rgyal mtshan grags pa/dpal chu bo ri pa/thar rma 'ag ligs sgos gopadakaspu'i gar yi mi bon por das snya/zhang dkon cog dpal/bla ma kun bsod pa/bla ma dpal ldan pa/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/mkhas grub rin cen rnam rgyal/sngags 'chang tshe dbang bkra shis/bla ma mkhyen rab rnam rgyal/bla ma ye shes dbang po/bla ma shākya bas mo grub/rdo rje 'dzin pa dge ba'i dbang po/bka' drin mnyam med zha lu mkhan chen/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//slob dpon nag po dam tshig rdo rje legs par bkral ba'i sku gsung thugs snying po kye rdo rje lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal gyis rdo rje gdan pa chen pos mdzad pa'i stod cha dang gsung mchan la brten nas bsgrigs pa'i mngon rtogs de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba dang /dbang gi cho ga la brten nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par 92bshos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /bdag med ma/nag po dam tshig rdo rje/bram ze nag po pa/thar rtse ba'i gas yig na nag po zhi ba bzang po ra bsnang /'gos khug pa lhas btsas/mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/'khon snye chu ba dgra lha 'bar/brtse bi 0 po/slob dpon ོ po/rje btsun rin po che/dkar shākya grags/bde lung pa kun bzang dpal/dkar gyi dbon po yin/bla ma 6dar ma ye shes/bag ston gcan nu tshul khrims/

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med dpa' bo/ mkhas grub rin cen rnam rgyal/ bla ma o rgyan rgyal po/ gra thang mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal po/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dge ba'i dbang po/ bka' drin mnyam med khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na 'gos lo tsā ba nas/rgyal tsha rta phug pa/ de'i gdan sa pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ e pa 'khon ston/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/bla ma kun dga' seng ge /bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man 'dra/ /dpal kye rdo rje lha dgu'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje la4 / sar ha/klu sgrub/ ḍā gi ma skal ba bzang mo/ lā wa pa/ de bzhi la tai lo pas nos/ nā ro pa/ mnga' bdag mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ rngog ston r+ṣa po chos sku rdo rje/ rngog mdo sde/ rngog kun dga' rdo rje/ rngog dge slong gzi brjid grags pa/ rngog rin cen bzang po/ rngog chos kyi rgyal mas/ rngog don grub dpal bzang / rngog byang chub dpal ba/ rngog rin cen dpal bzang / rngog (193na)byang chub dpal grub/rngog byang chub grags pa/ rngog blo gros dpal bzang / rngog dpal 'byor don grub/ rngog 'jam dbyangs 'od zer/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rngog lugs kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang yab bka' dang gcig go /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho dang dkyil chog bde chen rgya mtsho/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyisamadzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed rab gsal snang ba rnams la brten nas dpal kye rdo rje'i bshad rgyud thun mong ma yin pa gur rigs bsdus pa mkha' 'gro lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du man ngag lugs dang 'grel pa lugs gnyis las 'grel pa lugs(kyi dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ grub chen birnya pa/ slob dpon nga he ru ka /a la la badz+ra/ bā na pi pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa dza ya shrī dz+nyā na/ slob dpon mi thub zla ba/ grub chen —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pradzha in+d+ra ru tse/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ rje bas btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis kyi tshab tu 'khon dkon cog rgyal po snang zhing phyi ma 'di mkhyen brtse dang thar rtse'i gsan yig na dkyus ltar khrug pa dgra lha wor min nam dpyad/ 'khon skye chu ba shākya 'bar/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ ne tse sbas ston/rta stag so ba rin cen don grub/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chosarin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ thar rtse ba'i gsan yig tu mi 'dug kyang mkhyen brtse'i der snang bas(193ba 〉 da dam snyam/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal grub/ mnga' ris pa nam mkha' brtan pa/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog lhun grub/ ngor shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/de la e waṃ thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang dang mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ khā char pa/ kun mkhyen seng ge'i mtshan can/ yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge /rje sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ kye rdo rje rigs bsdus pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur lha bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rngog mdo sde yan kye rdor lha dgu ltar la/ de nas ram rdo rje grags/ bka' lung gnyan sgom/ mnga' ris pa byang chub tshul khrims/ rgya po ba lung pa/ bla ma rgyal po dga'/ rngog seng ge grags/ rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan man lha dgu bzhin no/ /bde dgyes gnyis kyi bshad rgyud thun mong ba sam+bha ṭi nas gsungs pa'i rdor dbyings lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub snye ma dang dkyil chog tshogs gnyis snye ma/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog (194na bo bang gi snye ma/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i zin bris —278

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pad ma kha 'byed rnams la brten nas dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /bdag med ma/rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong /ṇa snyi he ru ka/a la rdzogo'i rdo rje/la badz+ra dpal ldan nags khrod pa/gar+bha ri pa/bsod snyoms pa/rgyal ba dpal/ma' ga'ang thar rtse pa'i gas yig na mi2ga kyang shar ba'i der snang ba go dam snyam/slob dpon mi thub zla ba/dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje/bla chen 'brog mi/mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/'khon skye chu ba dgra lha 'bar/rje btsun sa chen/rje btsun grags pa/chos rje sa paṇa/tshogs sgom pa/gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan/'ad bkra shis dpal/spang khang pa grags pa dpal/paṇa chen ma ti/sa bzang 'phags pa/rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/mus chen sangs rgyas rin cen/ngor wo dkon cog lhun grub/thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang /shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/shar ba shes rab 'byung gnas/sgrub khang pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen zha lu ba chen po/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na sangs rgyas rin cen nas/sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/yang na sangs rgyas rin cen nas/chos rje dge legs bshes gnyen/shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/sa myu ṭi nas gsungs pa'i 'da' kha ma'i nyams len rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos legs par 194bang kral ba'i 'pho 'khrid gser gyi sgo 'byed kyi nyams 'khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rgyal ba btsong kha pa r+sā po nas rim par brgyud de/brag dgon spyan snga ga nu chos dpal bzang po/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches rwa ṭi'i rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i thog bsrung gi lung brgyud ni/thams cad mkhyen pa rin cen grub/thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/rje dngosagrub dpal/mkhas pa zla ba dpal rin/mkhan /na tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rab chos rje/byang gling pa rin cen rgyal po/rje don grub rgyal mtshan/byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan/rje kun dga' bkra shis/mtshudas med dkon cog rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen/desabadag la'o//'jam dbyangs dkon cog lhun grub kyi yi ge'i steng nas mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud nasalegs par gsungs pa'i phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes su gnang ba thob ba'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /phyag na rdo rje/ḍa ki ma dri med gzi brjid/rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ༅ med pa'i dpal/'chung ba don yod rdo rje/ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/bla ma sa skya pa chen po/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/mchims ston chos kyi seng ge/'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/rong pa rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/de sras shes rab seng ge/bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / 195na7khas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na ngor chen nas/rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug/glo bo mkhan chen legs 'byung /sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/rje btsun sgo nas pa kun dga' legs pa/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang nas/yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge/rje sangs rgyas seng ge/de la thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang dang mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/gnyis ka la sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/de nas khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o//yang rjes gnang dang /mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi yi ge rje dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rje lha mchog seng ge nas/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/thar rtse pa man 'dra/yang na ngor chen nas/rje shes rab ṭ+wāṃ /tsho/yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel man 'dra/

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)yang na dkon cog 'phel nas/ mnga' ris pa nam mkha' brtan pa/ rje dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/rjes gnang gi ba pa/ yang na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ a bha wā snar/ shu bhā ka ra gup+ta/ pā dza ti gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ go snya shrī/ kirti paṇ+ḍi ta/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dgung lo brgya dang bdun pa'i sa/ rgyal mtshan rin cen/ gar thig pa (195bsgo sod rgyal/ dka' bcu pa ga mga' na nu seng ge /bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ sgrub khang pas mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs rgyal ba kun dngos ma'i lung ni/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rab 'byams pa rin cen dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas so'i sngags 'chang snye mdo shākya dpal la gsang ba'i bdag pos dngos su gnang ba'i gur nas gsungs pa dang 'brel ba phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang me'i dbang dang bcas pa'i nye brgyud ni/ phyag na rdo rje/so'i sngags 'chang shākya dpal/ bla chen chos dpal ba/ chos rje rin cen dpal bzang / bla ma lha dbang blo gros/ rje chos grags pa/ zha lu mkhan chen bsod nams dbang po/ bla ma dam pa shākya seng ge /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rje rin cen dpal bzang nas/ mkhasagrub kun dga' dpal 'byor/ rje chos grags pa man 'dra/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa'i las rgyas pa'i lha so sor 'brang ma'i rjes gnang dang / de'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i lung dang bcas nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birlu pa/ khro ze pa/ a la la badz+ra/ bā na thi/ gar+bha ri pa/ sa n+da pa/ du rga tsan+d+ra/ bī ra badz+ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ se ston kun rig /'khon dkon cog rgyal po/ brtseb chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje (196na)btsun rin po che/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /chos rje bla ma dam pa/ rje dpal ldan tshul —281—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ dge slong chos skyong grags pa/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sgo rngam pa kun dga' legs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ bka' drin mnyam med khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rje btsun grags pa nas/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ chos rje bsod nams skyabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ yang na 'brog mi nas/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon snye chu ba/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug /rong pa shes rab seng ge /bla ma mgon po 'bum/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ yang na thub pa'i dbang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ paṇa chen mya ༅ med pa'i dpal/ paṇ+ḍita don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/ rje bas sa skya pa chen po man 'dra/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal pos 'jigs byed mun pa tshal gyi dur khrod du bram ze mchog sred la mgon po'i rgyud
