man ngag rnams gsan zhing khyad par rdo rje gur nas bshad pa'i mgon po 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang gsan pa'i tshe nam srod kyi char sprin nag (196ba)du ba'i mdog can gyi dbus na zhabs pus man chad nub pa'i sku'i snang ba gsal bar bstan pas gur mgon sprin gseb mar grags pa'i rjes gnang bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang gis mdzad pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod kyi yi ge bzhin nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ rje bas rdo ring pa r+pā po/ rje bas grol mchog /bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ rje ngag dbang nyi ma bzang po/ sprul sku bsod nams dbang phyug /gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /dbyug gu spun gsum rgyud sde phyogs gang du gtogs gsal bar ma byung yang / gong gnon 'byung 'dul gyis mdzad pa sogs dang bcas de'i sdebs su 'brel mtshungs par mjo zhe la/ 'di nyid —282

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)kyi chos skor mgon po klu sgrub dang bla ma rdo rje gdan pa sogs las nye bar brgyud de dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yab chos nor gyi lha mo thugs gtsigs can gyi chos skor la/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis sha za'i gnod sbyin mo mkha' 'gro kun nas 'khyil ba'i rtogs pa las phyung ba'i sgrub (6)thabs bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang ba ri lo tsā bas brgyur ba/ rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin mo kun nas 'khyil ba'i don (6)'dus 'grel pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba la slar pa tshab lo tsā bas 'gyur bcos mdzad pa/ de'i snying po sa chen gyis mdzad pa bla ma ba ri ba rgya gar du bzhugs dus shin tu bkren par rdo rje gdan pas gnang nas zas gos nor gsum tshegs med du 'ong gsungs pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i man ngag /lo (197na lo ba bod du 'byon dus rdo rje gdan pas skyel thung mdzad nas gnang ba'i thugs dam mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub lag bcangs/ spun gsum gyi mngon rtogs gsal byed btsal sla ba yin no'i mtha' can/ rten bca' ba dang gtor ma gtang thabs phun sum tshogs par byed do'i mtha' can/ chang bu bsngo lugs dang tshigs bcad mkha' 'gro chen mo ma/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dge tshul byams pa bzang po'i don du mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bsam don kun 'grub/ shākya'i dge slong rat+na'i mtha' can gyis bskul ba'i tsakra la brten nas dbang bsdus zab mo'i lag len gsal bar bkod pa bsam 'phel nor bu rnams thob pa las g.yung drung gi rtags kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang / 'jam dbyangs slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/brag phug pa/ bla ma blo bzang pa/ seng ge dpal/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal/ chag lo rin cen chosargyal/ bar 'di nas bla ma gnyis tsam ma rnyed/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rin po che bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ chag lo rin cen chos rgyal nas/ 'jam dbyangasas—283—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()skya lo tsā ba/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog rgya mtsho/ spun gsum bran 'khol mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa chen (197ba)ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na sa lo nas/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug /rje chos dbang pa/ rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/bla ma khang ston pa/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ jo nang kun mkhyen/ bla ma byang seng pa/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ bsod nams seng ge /de sras bya btang rje/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje chos dbang pa man 'dra/ /mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can dmar mo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ seng gdong ma/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ra sa chos grags/ bla ma don yod rdo rje/ paṇa chen nags kyi rin cen/ lo tsā ba ma dz+nyā shrī/ rje bsam grub rgyal mtshan mkhas btsun ā nan+da dh+wa dza/ rje nor bu phun tshogs/ rje lha dbang blo gros/ ngor pa sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod namasalhun grub/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang thar rtse pas mdzad pa'i lung brgyud ni/rtsom pa po/shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ sgrub khang pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ zha lu ba chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rjes gnang gi yi ge yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i steng nas me long dgon pa ba bo dong paṇa chen pad+ma gar dbang la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sidha mu khas dngos su gnang ba'i phyi sgrub seng gdong lha dgu'i rjes (198na gnang nos nas/ lung la pad+ma gar dbang gis mdzad pa'i phyi sgrub lha dgu'i mngon rtogs/ rgyun khyer gtso rkyang gi nyams len bya tshul/ gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang yid bzhin nor bu rnamasalegs par thob pa'i ring brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ḍā ki sirnya mu kha/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje gzha rin po che/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ nye gnas rong po rdo rje/ rong po sangs rgyas ye —284

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)shes/ rong po bla ma rin po che/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/ rje btsun ma tsi mu baṃ/ gnas rnying pa mkhas mchog rin cen bsam gtan dpal bzang / rtogs ldan nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ thugs sras ras chen kun dga' dar po/ thugs sras kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen byams pa chos kyi nyi ma/ paṇa chen pad+ma gar dbang / dka' bzhi tshul khrims 'gyur med/ ras chen kun dga' lha dbang / khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /snga 'gyur ltar na kun bzang yab yum/ seng ge'i gdong can/ o rgyan chen po/ mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ rtogs ldan nam mkha' sangs rgyas man 'dra/ /sangs rgyas mgon po ra ba'ang snang / nye brgyud ni/seng ge'i gdong can/ pad+ma gar dbang man gong bzhin no/ /lha dgu so so'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang gong dang 'dra/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs mi brjed pa'i dran byed dang rngog gzhung ba rin cen dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil bcas par brten nas rgyud gsar gyi char pa sogs nas bstan pa'i rnam snang gi rigs dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'am rdo rje gdan (198ba)bzhi yab bka' lha dgu bcu rtsa bdun gyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par nosapa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ bu ston rngog pa bka' 'gyur ba gsum gyi gsan yig na mi 'dug kyang rje ges btsong kha pa dang ngor chen gyi der snang ngo / /dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon ārla nge wa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ dge ba'i so cha/ 'di man gyi rgya gar ba bzhi po bu ston rje btsong kha pa ngor r+ṣa gsum gyi gsan yig na migs la yang rngog pa'i rgyun bzhin rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsan yig na snang ngo / /bde ba'i go cha/ rnam rgyal dbang po'i sde/ thang wo pa/ rje mar pa lo tsā/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ rngog mdo sde/ rngog kun dga' rdo rje/ rngog gzi brjid grags/ rngog rin cen bzang po/ rngog chos kyi rgyal po/ rngog don grub dpal bzang rngog byang chub dpal/ rngog rin cen dpal bzang po/ rngog byang chub dpal grub/ rngog byang chub grags/rngog blo gros dpal bzang / rngog dpal 'byor don grub/ rngog ston wo po 'jam dbyangs 'od zer/—283—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rtsa ba'i bla ma gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /yang na ārla de wa nas/ a su ra'i brag phug na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma mi rus kyi 'phreng ba can/ bal po rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde/ bal po zer spu yang rabs phun/ mar pa lo tsā ba man 'dra/rje ras pa badz+ra kirti nas brgyud pa'i pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs su gtogs pa rta mgrin dmar po pad dbyug can gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rta mgrin/ o rgyan rin po che/ chan brtses tshar chen (199na ngo gsan pa tshor mi gsal yang sgo rus par gsan pa der snang ngo / /ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/grub chen ti phu pa/ rje ras chung pa/ dbang phyug mi la ras pa/ sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu/ dpal phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung skyu ra rin cen dpal/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje/ thugs sras spyan snga rigs ldan/ zur phug pa rin cen bzang po/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / chos rje rin cen 'phel/ mkhan chen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chosarje/ grub mchog rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar ོ chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag ga hor bsal 'o/ /yang na 'ba' ra ba nas/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge / 'jam dbyangasachos kyi rgyal po/ sprul sku rdo rje rgyal po/ pha rgod bsod nams bzang po/ rdo ring pa chen po man 'dra/rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos dbang gi sgrol ma dmar po'i rjes gnang gi lung brgyud sogs/rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun sgrol ma/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya pha med pa'i dpal/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/—286

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ sa paṇa/ slob dpon shākya 'od zer/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ klu pa mkhan chen bsod nams dar/ dmar (199bskosgron rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ gong ma grag bas pa 'byung gnas/ sre pa lo tswab/sa skyong thamatsho cad mkhyen pa/tshes lnga rin po che rnam su'ang grags/ dpal ldan kun bzang rol pa/ sa bzang rtse pa bgo nams a43 yang zer/ chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/ bla ma don yod dpal/ grub brnyes dge slong ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bstan pa'i nyi ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /grub pa mchog gi ded dpon dbang phyug rab brtan/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ bka' drin 'khor med zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ gsol ba 'debs pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i sgra dbyangasaganyis kyi lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chag lo nas/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ mtshungs med dkon cog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge /rje btsun brang ti pa/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rta mchog gi rigs kyi sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten nas slob dpon klu sgrub kyis legs par bkra zhing lo chen dar ma grags kyis spyan drangs pa'i gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa rje bas chen pos mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa yar lag drug ldan dang rjes gnang gi cho ga ngor wo dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas rjes (200na yinang dang / de dang 'brel bar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i mde'i lung rjes gnang gi skabs nges par mdzad dgos pa'i phyag bzhes ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ba ling ta pa/ thar rtse dang shar pa'i gas yig na mi gsal yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i der snang ba chad dam snyam/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ ḍi paṃ ka ra bha dra/ dpal bde ba'i zhabs/ dri med sbas pa/ kha che rin cen rdo rje/ rin cen grags pa/ ban+de pa chen po/ thar 'ang shar—287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ba'i gsan yig na 'di'i tshab tu ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma 'dug pa zhal gyi brgyud pa dkyus shor byung gro/gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/brtse ba chen po/rje btsun grags pa/chos rje sa paṇa/mkhan chen byang chub dpal/bde ba dpal/dka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhen nu/mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/thar rtsedang shar ba'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pa chad dam snyam/thog ston shes rab rdo rje/mkhan chen rgyal bzang dpal/mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/rgyal tsha ba kun dga' dbang phyug/yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ngor ོ dkon cog lhun grub/thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang /sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/rigs kun bdag po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/yang na yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel 200bkas/rje lha mchog seng ge/dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/yang na ngor r+sā nas/mus chen sems dpa' chen po/rje sangs rgyas rin cen/dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/yang na ngor chen nas/rgyu 'gul paṇa chen/glo bo mkhan chen legasa'abyung /rnam dbyangs sa lo/dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/yang na lha mchog seng ge nas/ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge/thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub skor la/lo rgyus/bsnyen pa/sgrub pa/thun 'tshams su bya ba gtor ma/'brul 'khor/chom rkun 'ching ba/mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang gzungs kyi lung blang pa dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/kha'u pa yan gong ltar la/de nas gong ma lnga/dga' ldan pa kun bsod/bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ma ti paṇa chen/theg chen rin po che/bla ma lung rig rgya mtsho/mkhan chen seng ge dpal bzang /brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/btsun pa rnam mgon dri med sde/rje byang chub dbang rgyal/'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/bla ma rnam rgyal bkra shis/thu btsun kun dga' bsod nams/dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/rab 'byams pa chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/khyab bdag ༷ ḍi pa chen po/des bdag la'o//yang na 'phags

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa nas/ tsho gos nyan gnyis/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags(201na〉pa nas/zhang ston khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang na 'phags pa nas/ shar pa sku mched/'jam dbyangs chen po/ bla ma gzhon tshul ba/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shesarab/ brag thog pa man 'dra/ /dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i lung ni/ rje dkon cog lhun grub nas/ brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge /rje kun dga' lung rig /nagasadagon pa sbyin pa grags pa/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ des sras bso de nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston rjes the tshom gyi gzhir mdzad kyang phyag bzhi drug gi brgyud pa'i bla ma phal cher tshad mar mdzad pa'i mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu bzhi par/ mgon po kun gyi gnas 'di ni/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag drug pa/ dang po gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /spyan gsum mthing nag rngam pa yi/ /g.yas g.yon bar pa'i phreng ba dang / ḍā ma ru ni 'dzin cing brdung / /mtha' ma gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ dang / /sdigs mdzub zhags pas 'ching bar mdzad/ /ces pa dang / shangs pa rnams kyi rang skad la rgyud tshad ldan du grags shing thams cad mkhyen pa bus som nyir mdzang pa rta mgrin gyis (201ba gsungs pa'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa'i le'u gnyis par/ nag po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ /gri gug bgrang 'phreng ḍā ma sa /thod pa mdung dang zhags pa bsnams/ /zhes gsal bar bstan cing rtsod med yongs grags kyi rgyud rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba'i mgon po gsang ba mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu pa las/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa lha mo bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas zur tsam bstan pa 'di rgyud kyi zin zo che bar mngon zhing / de ltar lo paṇa mkhas grub rnams kyis legs par bkral ba'i ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i chos skor la/ mkhas grub khyung po —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gdub bu pas ko sa li bik+ṣa'i dur khrod du rje btsun mi tri pa chen po la gser srang bdun phul nas nor sgrub mthu myur ltag tshan che ba'i chos skyong zhig zhus pa la brten nas gnang ba'i yid bzhin mgon po/mgon po shing phung can/ tsan dan mgon po/ thugs rje r+ṣa po nag po/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa sogs gzhi gcig la mtshan du mar grags pa/ mi nor zas gsum dbang du sdud pa/ dgra bo brlag cing zlog pas mi tshugs pa/ bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob cing mchog thun dngos grub thams cad 'bad med du stsol ba'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba'i skor dang mkhas grub khyung po 'phan yul 'jog po'i ri la sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe grub chen rā hu las chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du gnang ba'i rjes gnang gi skor rnams bsdoms pas mgon po bcu gsum du grags pa rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun (202na thakra shis kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas nos par/ gtor dbang bar gcod kun sel/ rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ bla mgon dbyer med kyi skor la zhi ba grib sel/ rgyas pa bla ma mgon po dbyer med/mkha' 'gro dbang sdus dang gnas dbab gcig tu byas pa/ gsang sgrub mgon po mchin kha/ nang sgrub rgyan can/ mgon po dbang rgyal/ mgon po tshe bdag /sar ha'i mgon po khrag 'thung / lha bzhi dril sgrub/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu ste dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa la grags pa'i bka' bcu gsum/ de'i grangs su mi the ba'i phyag mtshan drug chas gos sis ra rnams kyi rjes gnang mgon po snying zhugs thun mong ba'i rjes gnang tshar chen dang mkhan ngag dbang chos grags pa'i yi ge'i steng nas dbang bzhi byin rlabs su bskur ba shangs pa'i phyag len gtsang ma shin tu rgyas pa rnams nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ be bum thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa shog dril gyi skor dang gnyis/dang po la/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gis mthar byed rta'i rgyal po la zhus pa'i nag po chen po'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ 'di la mkhas grub rjes rgyud 'di nyid yid ches su 'dod pa rnams kyi zhes the tshom gyi gzhir mdzad nas rang lugs kyi rtsa ba'i khungs su be bum gyi thog mar bris pa 'og nas 'byung —290

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la sgrog bas dang po/ (ka)ba'i man ngag mtha' dag som nyi'i yul du 'bad pas bsgrubs pa la dgos pa lhag po ma mthong /mgon po gsang ba dngos (202ba'i ba 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u nyer lnga pa tshad ldan du mdzad 'dug kyang thams cad mkhyen pa bu sogs tshad mar mi bzhed pa rgyud 'bum dkar chag na gsal bas dur khrod nag po'i rgyud bu ston gyis brdzus mar bzhed pa bzhin kho bo 'dod gsung ba dur khrod nag po rnam par ma dag cing dngos grub 'byung ba rnam par dag pa rang gi zhen 'dod gtso bor ston pa las rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i gsung du mi sems so/ /ye shes kyi mgon po thugs bskyed pa'i lo rgyus mi tri pas khyung po rnal 'byor la ko sal bik+ṣa'i dur khrod du gsungs pa/ 'di'i mjug tu mkhas grub rjes gsungasalas/ 'di gtso bor yid ches kyi gnas su gzung zhes bla ma dam pa dag bzhed la bdag kyang de ltar smra'o zhes snang ba'i 'di kho na'i tshig gis rgyud le brgyad mar rta mgrin gyis nag po chen po btul ba'i lo rgyus sogs tshad ma ma yin pa shugs la bstan nas sgos rgyud dmigs pa med pa'i dbyings su rgyas 'debs par nye ba'o/ /rang byin gyis brlab pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs dpal sha wa ris mdzad pa/ 'di'i mjug tu mkhas grub rjes sgrub thabs rgya gzhung 'di la yi ge rnying pa na mchan chung nyag nyog mang po btab 'dug na'ang dgos pa lhag po ci yang mi snang bsam bris so/ /zhes gsungs 'dug go /tsa la na ni zhes sogs bstod pa rgya skad ma 'di'i mthug tu mkhas grub rjes 'di la yang yi ge ma dag pa rim par brgyud pa'i 'dra min mang du snang ngo zhes gsung pa las dag ther ma gnang 'dug pa 'og gi man ngas mang por lhad zhugs bsal nas dag par na (203na)byas zhes zhal gyis 'ches pa bzhin 'dir yang zhus dag cig dgos pa 'dra yang lo tsā zhig ma rnyed pa'i rang btsan du lus pa 'dra'o/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i nag po chen po 'di nyams su len tshul dpal phyag drug pa'i sgrub yig mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa'i yi ge /lag tu len pa'i man ngag mdzo par rtogs pa sgrub pa'i thabs 'bring po'i yi ge /rnam pa gcig tu ma rā zhe par rtogs pa bsdus pa'i yi ge /sgrub thabs rgyasang bsdus gsum gyi mjug tu mkhas grub rjes sgrub yig gsum po 'di la mdzad byang med shangs pa'i yig rnying yin bla —291—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ma shangs pa'i gsung sgros zin bris su byas pa gda'o zhes dang gtor ma dang ma 'brel ba'i skabs mngon rtogs bsdus pa 'di mkho tshul dang dam tshig pa mi bskyed gsung pa zhig 'dug pa gong du dam tshig pa bskyed par bshad pa dang ma mthun pas yig nor byung 'dra ba dpyad do/ /srog sngags dang shā sa na'i sngags don bshad pa mdzad pa po'i gsal kha mi 'dug kyang bar mtshams shig tu bdag gi bla ma rje btsun nam mkha' rnal 'byor gyi zhal nas k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra zhes gsung pa la ma dag pa'i dpyad pa 'dug pas mkhas grub rje'i gsung yin 'dra/ 'gor legs ldan 'di'i lugs kyis zhes yod pa'i bla ma des kyang bdag mang du thos pa'i btsun pa dge legs dpal bzang po mchog tu dgyes pa chen pos gnang tshul dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus nyung ngu / 'gor da de la gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i bsnyen pa'i tshul du sgrub pa yin gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor (203ba)dpal mgon po'i gtor sgrub byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i gtor sgrub bya thabs so'i mtha' can/ mkhas grub rjes gtor sgrub 'di shangs pa'i yig rnying zhig yin 'dug kyang mdzad pa po bla ma rnams gsung rgyun mi snang gtor sgrub dang gtor chen 'dres pas mi mkhas pa zhig gis byas 'dra snyam pa'i rtog pa skyes gsung ba 'dug /'gor gtor chen byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i yig rnying bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pa yin rna'i mtha' can/ 'gor ye shes kyi mgon po 'di nyid nyams su len pa la bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa dang las sbyor gsum mo zhes yod pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gdams pa man ngag bzhin las la sbyor ba legs so'i mtha' can/ 'di mkhas grub rjes shangs pa'i yig rnying yin tshul mdzad 'dug /'gor sangs rgyas gnyan ston la sogs pa'i rje grub thob rnams la skyabs su mchi zhes yod pa'i rang nyid la dbang dmigs pas len pa dang gzhan la gtor dbang bya ba'i yi ge mgon po la gtang rag gi tshul du 'bul lo'i mtha' can/ mgon po'i slob ma rjes su bzung ba gzhan phan gyi blo kho nas chos rje sangs rgyas ston pas yi ger bkod pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum ma/'gor gtor ma mgon po la phul zin pa'i rjes la zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi zur 'debs dpon —292

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)slob gnyis gas bsgom par bya ba'i mtha' can/ mdun du mgon po bskyed nas rang la dbang blang ba'i gnad mchog khyad 'phags mgon pos sangs rgyas gnyan ston la dngos su gsungs nas(204na)mkha' la gshegs pa/ 'gor slob ma'i snying na chos kyi 'khor lo zhes yod pa'i mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang zur 'debs/ 'di'i gsham du mkhas grub rjes rje nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi phyag dpe na mchan bur yod pa ma gtogs gzhan la med tshul mgon po rigs lnga'i rjes gnang stod lugs par yod pa ma dag pa dang / gtor snod pad+ma ra bskyed pa mi 'thad tshul gsung ngo / phyag mtshan rjesaganang gi tshigs bcad ma/ 'gor grib phog dam tshig 'gal gyur na zhes yod pa'i grib sel khyad par can gyi man ngag /grib sel gyi dbang bka'i tho yig /bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sgrub thabasamagon pos sha wa ri pa la lan gsum gsungs nas bka' rgyas btab pa chig brgyud ma/ de'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi slob ma rjes bzung rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ mgon po mchin kha'i rjes gnang bla ma'i gsung bzhin lo tsā ba tshul khrims mgon gyis bkod pa/ mgon po mchin khar sgrub pa 'i man ngag dpral ba'i sis ra la brten nas mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i zhal gdams/ deng 4 'di la gtso btu 'dogs/ mgon po mchin kha'i 'khor gyi mngon rtogs ye shes pa bstims te gtor ma phul la gsol ba gdabs bo'i mtha' can/ sar ha'i lugs kyi ye shes mgon po zhes gcig phyag drug 'di dang 'og gi rgyan can gnyis bum gyi mchan dang phyag mtshan rnam mi 'dra ba mi tri pa dang rā hu la'i lugs kyi khyad par yi nam dpyad lo rgyus cha mi tri par zhus pa'i gro su snang / pa'i dbang chog rgya gar mkhas grub kyi gzhung bzhin khyung po bdag gis yi ger bkod pa rā hu la la gser (204ba)srang brgya phul bas zhus te rmog lcog pa la gtad pa'i chig brgyud ma/ de'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung sha wa ri pasamadzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dpal mgon po'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa mgon po rgyan can du grags pa deng 4 'di la nang bzer/ rā hu las rdo rje gong la dngos su gsan nasagrub pa brnyes pa/ de'i dbang chog 'gor rdo rje nag po chen po'i dbang gi cho ga zhes yod pa'i khyung po —293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rnal 'byor pas nyams su myong bar byas pa'i bka' rgya ma/ 'gor 'di'i byin rlabs byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i mgon po dbang rgyal gyi rjes gnang gi yi ge tshig brgyud bka' rgya ma rin cen brtson 'grus la gdams pa/ mgon po nang sgrub bam deng 4 'di pong bkyi tha snyad mi mdzad/ dbang rgyal gyi sgrub thabs mi tri pa la khyung po rnal 'byor gyis zhus pa/ mgon po dbang rgyal gyi sgo nas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsdu ba dam pa'i mgon la bshags par bgyi'i mtha' can/ mgon po tshe bdag mkha' 'gro bzhi skor yum bcas kyi sgrub thabs khyung pos rā hu la la gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhusapa/ lo rgyus 'a mi tri par lus pa'i gras su snang / de'i sgo nas tshe'i dbang byed pa chog brgyud bka' rgya ma rin cen brtson 'grus la gdams pa'i gser chos/ byin gyis brlabs pa nag po chen po zhal gsum phyag drug pa 'di snyem yod kyang a ༅ du ngos mi 'dzin/ khrag 'thung gi sgrub thabs dpal ldan sa ra has mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po a tha ya badz+ra dang lo tsā ba khyung pos bsgyur ba/ de'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang 'gor 'di'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas zhes/ (205na tshes da pa sngags gsum ga'i rjes slosabya'o'i mtha' can/ gu ṇa a ka ra dang a tha ya na badz+ra gnyis las brgyud pa'i lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi lam gyi rim pa rje btsun mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/'gor rdo rje phag mo'i byin gyis brlab pa zhes yod pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs a tha ya badz+ra gyis mdzad pa/ lha bzhi'i zhal gdams mchag dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i mtha' can/ lha bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan la dbang bskur ba snod ldan re tsam la ster na rang la dbang bskur ba ltar bya'o'i mtha' can/ lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang rgyun du blang ba'i man ngag /lha bzhi bla ma dang lnga'i bstod pa chos dbyings ma/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang gi yi ge bkra shis smon lam sogs bya'o'i mtha' can/ sgrub thabs dgos pa kun 'byung ba'i gdams ngag gi rgyal po lo rgyusasbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes bzhis bstan pa/ zhi ba nor du sgrub pa'i gdams pa phyi ma'i gnam stong gi bar du bya'o'i mtha' can/ mgon po gzi ldan gyi sgrub thabs shang pa rnams 'di rjes yang tshad par mas —294—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)grub rje mi 'thad pa'i phyog gsung yang sku'i rnam 'gyur la khyad par yod phyin rjes gnang mi rig pa'i sgrub byed yang dag med pa cu'o/ zhan tu gsang bar bya zhing dpe su la'ang mi bstan rna'i mtha' can/ dbang sdus kyi 'khor lo'i bri yig /gtor ma'i man ngag /sbyin sreg bum pa bca' thabs gzhan la mi bstan par cho ge dam par bya'o mtha' can/ mgon po dbang gi rgyal po'i sgo nas 'jig (205ba)rten pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsdu ba'i/ 'di dang gong gi 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsdus pa gnyis mi 'dra yang mgon dkar dang dbang rgyal gyi khyad yod pasamigacig go /man ngag dngos grub thams cad mod la 'grub par shog gi mtha' can/ bstod pa rgyal kun ma/ mkhas grub chos rjes phyag drug pa'i skor rtsad bcad cing dag ther mdzad pa'i thems yig kho bos yi ger bkod pa 'di la bla ma mgon po 'khor bcas bzod par mdzad nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dag ma dag gi dogs sel rgyas par yod pa'i lasagasum rnam bzhag gsal bar phye ba khrigs su bsdebs pa/ des mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag thun mong ma yin pa gsal zhing rgyas la ma sbas par thams cad tshang ba phyogs gcig tu bkod pa/ des mdzad pa'i gtor chog bskang ba dang bcas pa/ rten bzhi gnad gsum gyi man ngag thun mong ba'i skor/ spos sbyor gyi man ngag bsdus pa ril bu dbul bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ spos sbyor rgyas pa byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags snga mar ma tshang ba mang bar yod do'i mtha' can/ mdze thod dang mon gyi thod pa la brten pa'i mnan gtad ka ma la ra ga ras zla ba gcig la phyi rol pa 'bum tsho stongs su bcug pa 'i man ngag /phyi dar nag nang nal bu'i rgyal mtshan/ gsang ba nal bu'i snying la brten pa'i dpal ldan lha mo nag mo'i rten bca' thabs gnyan ston re gong pas sangs rgyas ston pa la gnang ba'i zhal gdams chig brgyud ma/ gdon gyi bu dang sha ma ma thon pa 'don thabs/ (206na)dpal ldan lha mo nag mo phyag bzhi ma'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rten bca' thabs dang bcas pa shin tu gnyan pa las la sbyar ba sa mā ya gu rgya'i mtha' can/ mi tri pa'i lugs kyi lha mo phyag gnyis ma'i srog sgrub chung ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i lugs kyi srog sgrub rgyas pa la la bla ma re gong pas mdzad zer/'ga' —295

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhig skyer sgang pas mdzad nas lcag pho ri'i brag la sbas la re gong pas bston zer ro/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa/ slob dpon dha na lha: lhas rnying ma phyogs ma gtogs gsar mar grags chung / gnod sbyin bzhi dam la brtags nas mgon po dang gtso 'khor gyi tshul du lhan cig tu bsgrubs pa'i sbrags sgrub dug lta bu'i man ngag su rung rung la ster zhing dpe cha ston na k+ṣe tra pā las de'i snying phyung zhig gi mtha' can/ bdud mgon trag shad la brten pa'i dpal ldan mgon po nag po'i ngan sngags tshig sgrub spu gri me dbal/mgon po'i sbyin sreg gsal ba gsum ldan sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyis mdzad pa/ mkhas grub khyung pos mdzad pa'i spyan 'dren bzhengs shig ma/ gtor bsngo'i dus kyi ma g.yel ma/ gtor rdzong gtsang zhing gtsang sbyar ma/ bram ze mchog srid kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa rngam pa sgra sgrog ma/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig can gyis yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas dpal ldan lha mo la bstod pa dpag dka' ma/ lha mo'i bstod pa bskal me ma/ mai tri pas lha mo zhal gzigs dus mdzad pa'i bstod pa dka' ba dang blangs ma/ bskul steng gi tshangs pa ma/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal (206ba tha zang gis mdzad pa'i mgon po'i bstod pa gang thugs ma/ des mdzad pa'i lha mo'i bstod pa dpal ldan ma mo ma/ khyung pos mdzad pa'i bkra shis bka' rgya ma rnams/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa shog dril skor la/ shog dril dang po la bsrung 'khor 'dri thabs rdo rje'i go cha bla ma shangs pa lo tsā ba la nag po chen pos bstan pa/ mkhas grub rje'i zhus dag ma yin pas mjug tu/ mang thos dge legs dpal bzang gis/ /mkhas grub gong ma'i man ngag la/ /lhad zhugs bsal nas dag par byas/ zhes pa 'dug cing shog dril phyi ma phal cher la'ang de ltar snang ngo / /phyi rten lug sogs srog chags/ nang rten mda'/ gsang rten gri snying / de kho na nyid de rten bzhi/ dpral ba'i sis ra la brten nas mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa/ spyi bo'i mi bskyod pa la brten nas rgyud 'jam du gtong ba/ gshin rje gshed la brten nas mgon po'i nus pa bskyed pa ste gnas gsum dang bcas pa rgya gar mkhas grub kyi man ngag bla ma'i gdams pa shangs ston gyis yi ger bkod pa/ gnas khang bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod —296

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ltar bya ba'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa'i rten bca' thabs rtsig brgyud ma/ mgon po'i 'phyar dar ram bris sku bzhed pa'i man ngag rnams/ shog dril gnyis pa la mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug par brten pa'i bsrung ba rdo rje'i char 'bebs/ zlog pa stobs chen shugs zlog /gsad pa gnam lcags dug mda' nag po/ yang zlog bsrung ba stobs bskyed/ slar zlog nyams (207na)pa kun gso/ /gdams pa lnga po 'di grub chen rā hu las mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la gsungs pa'i snyan brgyud bla ma'i zhal shes ma/ yang zlog gi zhal shes yig chung rnams/ shog dril gsum pa mgon po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa/ 'grub khung ling ga 'khor lo sogs bstan pa las kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba rā hu las khyung po rnal 'byor la gnang ba'i gsang ba'i nor/drag po'i ser ba 'bebs pa gnam stong la ni las la sbyor zhes gsung ba'i mtha' can/ shog dril bzhi pa la/ slob dpon mtsho la la 'di yo sa ོ por bca pa yod 'dra yang kye rdor mtsho skyes kyi skabs kyi slob dpon ོ po pad+ma 2 ṇa gnas gang yin the r+yā gyig sto snang ngo / /skyes kyis mdzad pa'i gnad lngas chos skyong bran du bskul ba'i man ngag /gdams pa 'di gur zhal sogs chos stong mang po'i be'u bum du'ang yod do/ mnan pa 'don pa/ bcings pa 'grol ba/ bsdams pa bcas pa/ ngag la bang bskur ba/ sngags kyi mthu bskyed pa/ bzlas pa'i dbal gsol ba/ so la ngar blud pa/ mchu la dug bsku ba/ lte la skru gri 'dogs pa ste gdams pa gnad dgu ma/ 'di'i mjug na gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs bla ma drug las brgyud tshul 'dug cing / bla ma dgongs 'dus su/ sngags kyi dbal gsob/ lce la skru gri gdags/ kun la ngar 'dogs gsad pa'i tha ram ste/ /'di dang ldan na yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ spra 'dod 'byung ngo lasacan thugs kyi sras/ /zhes pa'i man ngag bsres nas khyung po la khungs btsal ba (207ba)zhig 'dra'o//sri'u gso ba'i gdams pa gtor mas bsrung ba la zhal shes kyang yod do'i mtha' can/ gu gul gyi bsnyen pas bgegs skrod pa/ yungs kar gyi bsnyen pas bgegs tshar gcod pa/ lam du 'gro ba'i bar chad bsrung ba/ gnod byed sreg par bsam pa'i mtha' can/ lug nag po'i bal gyi bsrung skud —297

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dam tshig ma nyams pas bya'o'i mtha' can/ ngag gnod sel ba'i gdams pa ngag nus pa dang ldan ltar 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ rdzas sngags la brten pa'i mtshon srung mi tshugs so'i mtha' can/ mchod rten phur pa la brten pa'i shwa zlog 'phral du zlog par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ mtho phur la brten pa'i ser srung gdong zlog sogs mi dgos gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ rmi lam ngan pa zlog thabs gtor chung bsham par bya'o'i mtha' can/ de'i zhal shes mkhas grub pa'i gsung rgyun rnams/ shog dril lnga pa la rgyud kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa nas gsungs pa'i mgon po rgyan can la brten pa'i rlung sgrub shin tu zab pa mchog sgrub pa'i man ngag /'di khyung po rnal 'byor gyis gser srang brgya phul nas rā hu la la zhus pa rmog lcog par chig brgyud du gnang ba'o/ /gur zhal gyi gsang khrid phyag bzhi pa'i sku rags ma sogs dang dbyibs mtshungs pa'i dmar khrid du byed pa zhig shangs pa'i gong ma rnams la yod tshod du snang /rdor bzlas kyi shog dril gzhan du gsal zhes kha 'phangs 'dug kyang dpe zur pa ma rnyed/ dgra bo tshar gcod pa'i rlung sgrub la gtso bo dang 'khor gyi las tshogs gnyis kyi dang po la (208nag wa ri dbang phyug gis rgyud nas phyung ste gup+ta badz+ra la gnang / des 'jog po'i rir khyung po la gnang ba'i skye ragasathem khug nas phyung bar rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i mgon po'i rlung sgrub kyis lo rtag 'joms shing thog dbab pa/ mi'i rlid bu la brten pa'i mgon po'i rlung sgrub kyis sbos te gsad pa'o//'khor gyi rlung sgrub la/ mi dbang snying shun la brten pa'i lha mo rlung sgrub kyis pha rol khrag nad kyis phung ba/ dom gyi chu 'dzin la brten pa'i k+ṣe tra pā la'i rlung sgrub kyis rab zhag bdun/ 'bring brgyad/tha ma dgu la dgra bo gum pa/ lug nag gcan gzan gyis bsad pa'i rgyu mar brten pa'i dzi na mi tra'i rlung sgrub kyis nyin mtshan go ldog ste tsha grang nad kyis gsod pa/ lte khung nag po dang zangs khab kyi sbyor bar brten pa'i ṭak+ki rā dza'i rlung sgrub kyis zhag gsum na gsod pa/ nag po rta'i chu 'dzin la brten nas bdud kyi skyes bu trag shad kyi rlung sgrub zhag gsum nas gsod pa/ man ngag 'di rnamasachig brgyud las mang por bstan na snying khrag 'thung zhig pa'i bka' rgya can/ gtso 'khor yongs—298

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rdzogs kyi rlung sgrub kyi sngags gab sbas phyogs gcig tu mkhas grub chos rjes bsgrigs pa/ 'di'i sngags byang du gzer gzer zhug zhug snying khrag la rbad sogs 'dug pa rgya gar gyi skad la zha dang la sogs mi yong zhing rgya min bod min du 'dug kyang a mas bcag pa'i rdzas skam snod nyan pa'i dpe ltar skyon med dam snyam/ shog dril drug pa la grib sel gnad dbab kyi gdams pa sangs rgyasaganyan (208bston yan la chig brgyud ma gnad yig yid bzhin nor bur grags pa sangs rgyas ston pas ri gong dpal gyi ri khrod du yi ger bkod pa/ rta mgrin la brten pa'i bsrung ba rdo rje'i char 'bebs thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes/ bgegs kyi rgyal po la brten nas pra 'bebs pa'i gdams pa rnams/ shog dril bdun pa la dpal ldan lha mo'i phyag g.yon gyi thod pa la brten nas dgra bo phung du 'jug pa/ k+ṣe tra pā la'i gri gug la brten nas dgra srog 'bral ba/ dzi na mi tra'i ḍā ma ru la brten nas spyo ru 'jug pa/ ṭak+ki rā dze'i rgyu zhags la brten nas lkugs par byed pa/ trag shad kyi ba dan la brten nas skrad par byed pa ste bka' sdod kyi phyag mtshan las sbyor du grags pa'o/ khog dril brgyad pa la byin rlabs nag po chen po'i gnod sbyin bzhi gnang nas bskul ba'i zhal gdams tshig brgyud ma 'di med na 'khor bzhis las byed mi nyan gsung ba'i mtha' can/ mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud cing gnod sbyin thams cad gnad nas bskul ba/ gnad 'bebs yid bzhin nor bu dang bcas pa/ shog dril dgu pa la las byed k+ṣe tra pā la'i gdams pa k+ṣe tra pā la sprel 'khrid mar grags pa/ rū pa'i sto pa'i tsakra grong khyer dkrug pa dang lus ngag yid gsum dbab pa rnams kyi zhal shes be bum nag po'i snying po/ chags pa rnam gsum gyi man ngag /rtags kyi rim pa shog dril nag po'i man ngag rdzogasaso'i mtha' can/ 'khor lo'i sgo nas dgra bgegs gsad pa'i las sbyor mgon po (209na bo ngos kyis shangs pa lo tsā ba gnang ba ston pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar gyur cig gi mtha' can/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sha wa ri pas rgyud nas phyung ste sras kyi thu bor gnang zhing sa ra ha'i lugs kyang mi tri par gsan pa'i mgon po'i 'khor lo'i las sbyor shangs khrag gi shog dril dang po/ re ma ti'i man ngag gi —299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'khor lo'i las sbyor lha mo'i snying khrag shog dril gnyis pa/ k+ṣe tra pā la'i 'khor lo'i las sbyor snying khrag shog dril gsum pa/ dzi na mi tra'i 'khor lo'i las sbyor snying khrag shog dril bzhi pa/ ṭak+ki rā dza'i 'khor lo'i las sbyor snying khrag shog dril lnga pa/ trag shad kyi 'khor lo'i las sbyor snying khrag shog dril drug pa/ 'di'i mjug tu bcas pa'i man ngag bcu gnyis thog ser dang bcu gsum bla ma bdun gyi dgongs pa bsdus nas mkhas grub rjes 'grig par bsdebs tshul snang ngo / lkog dril bcu pa la mgon po yab yum gyi srog gi 'khor lo gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos/ k+ṣe tra pā la'i rlung sgrub zlog med ha la khong song 'dra ba/ k+ṣe tra pā la'i gtor ma'i las sbyor rā hu las khyung po la gnang ba'i mgon po zhing skyong du sgrub pa'i man ngag khog dril bcu gcig pa la shog dril rnams kyi man ngag sbas dkrugs gab pa rnams gsal byed kyi zhal shes shog dril shin tu gsang zhing sba bar bya ba/ 'di'i mjug tu be'u bum nag po'i shog dril gnyis/ gsang ba'i man ngag mchog yin pas/ /mkhas grub gong ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen re re tsam/ /de la sbyin la bka' (209ba)rgyas thob/ /snod min dag la spel gyur na/ /k+ṣe tra pā la yab yum gyis/ /de yi snying phyung srog chod cigaces pa snang ngo / shog dril bcu gnyis pa la shog dril dmar po'i man ngag skor la rigs gtad pa'i zhal shes/ nang rten gyi zhal shes/ gsang rten gyi zhal shes/ de kho na nyid kyi rten gyi zhal shes/ khyad par can gyi rten brdab dar gyi zhal shes rnams/ shog dril bcu gsum pa la mgon po'i rab gnas bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu gnyan ston gyis ri gong dpal gyi dgon par bkod pa/ rab ga myosakyi sngon du gal che ba me tog gi zhal gdams/ rab tu gnas yul gyi khyad par zhal gdams/ dus kyi zhal gdams/ ye shes pa dngos su gzhug pa'i zhal gdams/ rab gnas kyi sngon du gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor lo'i zhal gdams rnams/ dpe ris skor la/ rdo rje lang sngags ram pa lugasakyi gtor ོ gyi 'bor lo/ chos rje rje bas pa lugs kyi gtor ོ gyi ga bor lo/ grong khyer dkrug pa'i 'bor lo/ brdab dar/ mgon po rma sgrub 'khor lo/ lha mo'i 'khor lo/ k+ṣe tra pā la'i 'bor lo/—300—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)k+ṣe tra pā la yab yum gyi 'khor lo/ dzi na mi tre'i 'khor lo/ ṭak+ki rā dza'i 'khor lo/ trag shad kyi 'khor lo/gtor chen sogs man ngag gi phyag len/ dmar khrid dang bcas legs par nos pa las shangs lugs gtsang ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs/ rgyan can/ tshe bdag /khrag 'thung / lha bzhi dril sgrub/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu rnams ma ga rta gos pa'i rjes gnang bcu brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje (210nasgo chang /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen sha wa ri'i dbang phyug /rje btsun mi tri pa chen po/ shangs pa lo tsā ba khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ skyer snang pa chos kyi seng ge /gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston chen po/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / sngags 'chang rdo rje gzhen nu/ mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / mtshungs med bzang po rgyal mtshan/ grub chen ngag dbang blo gros/ mar ston tshul khrims rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rigs kun bdag po chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na mkhas grub rje nas/ 'brong rtse lha btsun rin cen rgya mtsho blo gros/ paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ mar ston tshul khrims rin cen man 'dra/ yang na 'brong rtse chos rje nas/ grub chen ngag dbang blo gros/ mar ston sems dpa' chen po man 'dra/ yang na mkhas grub shangs ston pa nas/ mkhasabatsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ 'jag pa blo gros dpal/ grub chen ngag dbang blo gros man 'dra/ yang na byams pa dpal nas/ kun dga' dpal/ ngag dbang blo gros man 'dra/ yang na mkhas grub rje nas/ rong ston blo bzang grags pa/ thon pa mkhas phan (210ba)yon tan rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ gu ge pa nyi ma bzang po/ khri rin po che rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa man 'dra/ yang rjes gnang bar chad kun sel gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal nas/ snang thang lo tsā ba don grub bzang po/ rgyal —301—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ba btsong kha pa chen po/shar pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/byang gling pa grags pa rin cen/snar thang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/rje chos grags pa/mar ston sems dpa' r+ṣa po/rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa man gong ltar ro//yang na rgyal ba btsong kha pa wo po nas/rgyal sras bzang skyong ba/rin po che chos dpal ba/chos rje blo gros rgyal tsho/rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/rdo rje 'cha sngags ram pa man 'dra/yang na 'jag chen byams pa dpal nas/kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang /sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims dpal bzang /mkhas grub rin cen bshes gnyen/chosarje legs pa'i blo gros/rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa man 'dra/dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba bar gcod kun sel gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/mkhas grub shangasaston nas/rje rgyal mtshan 'bum/'jag chen byams pa dpal/rje bsod nams blo gros/bla ma kun dga' bzang po/dran mchog don yod rgyal mtshan/yab chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/chos rje rin po che thub bstan pa/rje phyogs las rnam rgyal man gong bzhin no//211na〉nga na mtshungs med bzang po rgyal mtshan nas/rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/yang na mkhas grub rje nas/ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/gnas rnying pa kun dga' bde legs/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho man gong ltar ro//yang na mtshungs med bzang po rgyal mtshan nas/'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel/rgyud pa bkra shis 'phags/rgyud chen brtson grus 'phags/sras khang sngags ram pa bzang po rnam rgyal/rdo rje lang pha bong kha pa man 'dra/mgon po ༅ ༅/tshe bdag /lha bzhi'i dril sgrub/mgon dkar bzhi'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /slob dpon dha na lha: ta/grub 'a rwa hu la gusta/jo bo a ti sha'i bla ma ri nag tsho gtsug lag khang du btsos pa'i tshe'i rigs 'dzin brnyes pa de yon/mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor man brgyud tshul gong ma mtha' dag dang 'dra/sar ha'i mgon po khrag 'thung gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /sar ha/'phags pa klu sgrub/slob dpon r+ṣa po pad+ma thod phreng /grub wo sha ba ri ༵/mnga' bdag mi tri pa/khyung po rnal 'byor man

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bong kha pa bde les nyi ma/ lha rin po che lha dbang rgya mtsho/rdo rje lang pha bong kha pa dpal lhor lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /rgyud dang las gsum rnam gzhag gi lung ni/ chos rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang la rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pas gsan 'dug kyang khong la mtshan nyid pa'i rtags kyi gsan yig sogs med 'dug pas brgyud pa 'dri ba'i blo 'tshab 'tshub mi dgos par rang mal du gnas chog pa'o/ /gnas rnying pa lugs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo/ /trag shad kyi thal mo brdab pa'i cho ga'i lung ni mkhan chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la gsan 'dug kyang gnas rnying pa phyogs nas brgyud gsung pa las brgyud yig mi snang ngo / lkog dril bcu gsum gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig dang rten bzhi gnad gsum/ gtor chen 'khor lo sogs shog dril du gsal ba'i man ngag rnams phyag len dmar 'khrid du legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma drin can chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang phyag len dmar 'khrid chos rje dpon dar ba dpal 'byor dar rgyas rang la nos so/ /sgo mang slob dpon sangs rgyas bkra shis dang lam pa rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pa sogs(212ba)kyis gtor chen nub re bzhin sked pa nas phral te liṅga 'don 'jug byed pas mtshon phyag len rnams dpe tsam la brten nas 'ol tshod du gyur pa'i dus rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pas chos rje dpon dar ba thugs rtsol chen pos nyang po bla mar zhu ru bcug pas chos skor 'di nyid kyi bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa lta bu'o/ /mgon po phyag bzhi pa lha mang phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi yi ge thar rtse pas mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mgon po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dus zhabs pa/ rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ mi nyanartsashing gi 0 rigs/ dpal chen rgya lo/ phag mo gru pa/ 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po/ skyi shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ skyid shod pa grags pa seng ge /slob dpon sangs rgyas gzhone nu/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī/ sabazang 'phags pa ga smo nu blo gros/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang / gu ge paṇa ོ/ glo bo mkhan wo bsod —304—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nams lhun grub/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ gnyan grags pa blo gros/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge / paṇa chen thar rtse pa/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / e waṃ pa dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na ma ṇi ka shrī nas/ sprul sku nam mkha' rgyal po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' rtse mo/ gu ge paṇa chen man 'dra/ 'di mgon po rang gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i lha mang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las sngags gsar rnying gi mgon po yin no cog bsdus pa ni ma yin no/ /thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gis (213nasgo dzad pa'i gtor chog rjes gnang bya tshul bklags pa'i don grub mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gyi steng nas bdud mgon thog shad lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang thob ba'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang /phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ rnal 'byor pa ro zan de wa/ rnal 'byor ma bde ster ma/bla ma ba / ta ā tsar+ya/ kha reg gi gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags/ de sras gnyos rdo rje bla ma/ gnyosadapal 'byung / gnyos dpal gyi seng ge yab gnyos nag grags pa dpal/ sangs rgyas ras chen/ rgyal ba lha nang pal ra/ bla ma rin cen rgyal po/ bla ma byang chub dar rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs rin cen 'byung gnas/ mkhas pa ye shes rin cen/ kun spangs chos kyi rin cen/ dbu ma ba dpal ldan rin cen/byang sems bsod nams rin cen/ brag dkar ba sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong khri chen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ sa chen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/'jam dpal rdo rje ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang zha lu ba rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na sangs rgyas ras chen nas/ rgyal sras stag tshang ba/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas phyar chen/'jam dbyangs rin cen 'byung gnas/ drin can mkhas btsun sangs rgyas/ kun mkhyen saṃ gha bha dra/—305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()brgyung 'dzin sangs rgyas bzang po/ dbu ma pa dpal ldan rin (213bcun man 'dra/ yang na brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang nas/ de dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ nyang ston khyab bdag blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /thar rtse pas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i lung brgyud ni/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / de dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ ngor mkhan chen dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku pad+ma 'phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dang rtsa ba'i yig rnying gi steng nas dpal jo bo bka' gdams pa'i bka'i srung ma mgon po lho nub ma/ mi thung gsod byed/ zhal dmar ba/ mthar skyes ma zhes mtshan gyi rnam grangs bzhi dang ldan pa de'i rjes su gnang ba nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ grub chen klu'i byang chub/ grub chen dz+nyā na bo dhi/ drang srong bi bya ma ti/rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra/ 'di phyag drug pa'i bas pa'i rā hu la dang gago /jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha /'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/po to ba rin cen gsal/ 'dam shod kyi gru gu zhwa chen/ klog skya lha'i dbang phyug /zhang ston rdo rje 'bar/ dbon po blo gros rgyal mas/ rma ston pra dz+nya rat+na/ mkhan r+sā shes rab rdo rje/ 'dul 'dzin dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dkon cog dar po/ mkhan chen bsam grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin po che bi du dz+wa la/ mkhan chen 'od 'jo ba nam mkha' bsam grub/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lo pa spyan snga ngag (214na bo bang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan chosa'abyor/ lo pa spyan snga byams pa kun dga' don grub/ gling stod chos rje dkon cog dpal 'byor/rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las/ nyang ston khyab bdag blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang rab kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan beng dmar gtso 'khor gnyis pa'i rjes gnang / de'i gtor chog 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug —306

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam dang po/ (ka)gis mdzad pa/rjes gnang gi yi ge rje dbang rab kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'amang /kha sar pā ṇi/grub chen mi tra dzo gi/khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/yang rtse ba rin cen seng ge/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/sgra tshad ba rin cen rnam rgyal/sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can/sku zhang nam mkha' 'bum/mkhasapa tsan+d+ra shrī/'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/dka' bzhi pa rin cen mchog grub dpal 'bar/rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o//yang na 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse nas/sku zhang rin cen bkra shis bsod nams rgyal mtshan/grub dbang shākya seng ge/rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen 214ba po lu pa/des bdag la'o//gdugs dkar lha zhe gcig ma'i dkyil chog nas zur du bkol ba'i yi ge'i steng nas gtsug tor gdugs dkar nas gsungs pa'i mgon po legs ldan mched gsum a sto ra'i sgro chag kyang zhi byed pa'i de dang mi r+sāg/gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas/gsang ba'i bdag po/grub chen dze tā ri/rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ga med pa'i dpal/chung ba a mo gha badz+ra/ba ri lo tsā ba/skyu ra a skyabs/rje btsun sa chen/slob dpon rtse mo/rje btsun grags pa/pho rog mdo sde mgon/rgan mo lhas pa/'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/rong pa a ka ra/rje dkon cog tshul khrims/bag ston ga cho ne nu tshul khrims/chos rje tshul rgyal ba/bya bral ba bsod nams rin cen/nyug pa chos grags dpal/chos rje bsod nams rin cen/rje don yod rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/mkhasagrub bshes gnyen bkra shis/dge slong ngag dbang rnam rgyal/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/rigs kun bdag po mkhan chen zha lu pa/des bdag za hor ban+de ༷'o//yang na rdo rje 'chang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()jo bo rje/ 'byom ston pa/ po to pa/ mus sman pa/ dpal ldan gro/ zhang ston pa/ mchims chen po/ skyo ston/ byang chen pa/ bsod nams 'phel/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/mkha' 'gro ma bde ba sbyin/ bram ze rin cen rdo rje/ ma hā dza na/ gnyal pa ston pa ye shes dbang phyug /dge bshes (215na)bla ston/ gdong sngon pa/ pho rog mdo sde mgon man 'dra/ yang na pho rog mdo sde mgon nas/ thod pa jo phur/ jo bo gnyan ston/ dbang phyug rin cen/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ sras chos grags/ ston pa dar ma shākya/ bcur bsod nams dbang phyug /lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma kun bsod/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ rje chos grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rin cen/ ri lung sbug pa rgyal ba thugs rje/ rje bshes gnyen bkra shis man 'dra/ legs ldan mched gsum gyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang gi yi ge sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rtsom pa po/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /bka' ma phyi 'gyur gyi dpal mgon stag zhen nag po'i gtor ma/ bzlas lung / phyag mtshan gtod pa sogs phyag len 'khrul med du sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon bhe ha ra/ paṇ+ḍita rdo rje grags pa/ jo bo a ti sha /dge bshes 'bangs/ dbon po rig 'bar/ lce mdo sde seng ge /rong pa rgya lo/ sras shar seng /gcung a ka ra/ bag ston gzhen tshul/ kun mkhyen grags 'od/ dpyal ban rgya mtsho/ bla ma chos grags pa/ dpal ri ba chos rgyal dpal bzang / rin cen chos rje/ rin cen seng ge /rong pa bsod nams blo gros/ sham+bha ra kun dga' sangs rgyas/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mthu chen bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje (215ba tshe yang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na jo bo rje nas/ rgya lcags ri gong pa/ yol chos dbang / dpe dkar rdo rje thog 'bebs rong pa sher seng man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ kha che paṇa chen/—308

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dpyal chos bzang / dpyal pad+mo can/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin/ gnubs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma 'dzam gling pa/ kun mkhyen grags 'od man 'dra/slob bshad gser chos kyi skor gyi lung brgyud/gnyis pa slob bshad gser chos skor la/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa byon dang 'byon 'gyur 'byon bzhin pa mtha' dag gi lam po che mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba 'phags yul paṇa grub dbang po dpal ldan chos skyong ngam grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birnya pa chen po rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mas dngos su gnang ba'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa/ gcig shes pas mang po shes pa/ skyon yon tan du blang ba/bar gcod dngos grub tu blang ba/ ltas ngan g.yang du 'gugs pa/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba/ bar gcod ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba/ sde snod gsum gyi de nyid shes pa gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub kun gyi 'dod pa'i 'jo ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu gsung ngag rin po che zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug mtha' dag zung 'jug tu gshegs pa'i them skas chen po 'di nyid/ lo tsā ba rnams kyi nang nas nyi zla ltar grags pa 'brog mi shākya ye shes(216na)kyis 'phags yul paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan tu gyur pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten te zhus shing gtan la phab/ de la slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa gzhung rdzogs pa/ gdams ngag rdzogs pa/ grub pa thob pa'i slob ma gsum du byung bar grags pa'i gdams pa rdzogs pa'i slob ma'i nang nas rab tu thob pa se mkhar chung pa/ de'i slob ma shad ston chos 'bar nas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya ba yab sras la bka' babs/ de'i sgol 'dzin ngor rdzong gong dkar ba sogs tshogs bshad 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub sa chen po'i rdul ltar —309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()grangs su mi chod pa'i nang nas/yongs 'du'i ljon pa lta bur mchog tu gyur pa kha'u brag rdzong pa'am tshar lugs su grags pa zab pa las kyang chos zab pa'i gsang chen slob bshad kyi smin grol zab mo legs par nos pa la/de yang sa ṭa las/bstan bcos rgo ma slob dpon dang //lung gi rjesa'abrang de ṣ+ka rig/gsang ston de ṣ+ka dngos po yang //r+sāg nas tshwag brgyud shes par bya//bla ma rab kyi zhal las blangs/zhes dang /tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi yis spros pa bcad/ces pa ltar lugs srol 'di la tshad ma bzhi dang /snyan brgyud bzhi zhes gsungs pa'i dang po rje btsun chen pos/chos kun tshad ma bzhi yis gtan la dbab/ces gsungs pa ltar/bla ma tshad ma/nyams myong tshad ma/bstan bcos tshad ma/lung tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas gto la 'bebs par mdzad pa las/dang po bla ma 3 ma ni/tshar wo chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bla ma 216bsgo chod pa'i cho () rtsa ra ga dngos grub rin cen gter mdzod/rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs 9)bla ma rdor 'dzin ma/'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i phyag mchod (nyi)sangs rgyas kun ngo ma/theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad 9)pa'i brgyud 'debs dus gsum bde gshegs ma/ngor r+sā rdo rje 'amang gis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma/tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud (6re/'debs dngos grub char 'bebs/mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i slob bshad brgyud 'debs byin byang chub shes rab kyis gsol ba btab pa ltar rje btsun — pos mdzad pa/slob dpon rin po che'i rnam thar gsol 9)'debs 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//khyod nyid dam pa rnams kyi rigs 'khrungs nas/zhes dang /ma sdug tu/yang dag rtogs pa'i blo gros skyed dug so le zhes yod pa/de'i 'phros las yang smras pa/tshangasapar spyod pa'i dge bsnyen tshul 'dzin pa zhes sogs kyi mjug na/bde ba can du gshegs la gusaphyag 'tshal/zhes yod pa rje btsun chen pos mdzad ༷ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis dag par

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gtugs pa'i mtha' can/rje btsun chen po'i rnam (zha)thar thun mong du grags pa sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa mdzad pa/rje btsun chen po'i rnam thar mnal lam ma mjug na slob dpon rin po che dang mjal nas lan mang du chos zhus pa rmis gsungs rje btsun pa'i mnal lam bris pa'o//217na lhag pa sna ro ban+de gshin rje grags kyis mdzad pa/rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar bde ba nas bde bar gshegs pa'i dus su lung bstan pa'i rtogs brjod cha 'ga' zhig brjod pa chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i rnam thar rin po che'i 'phreng ba rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i tshogs sgom rin po che'i rnam thar me mo lug gi dpyid zla tha chung yar ngo'i tshes dgu'i snga dro gza' zla ba dang skar ma rta pa rgyu ba'i dus su sku gshegs tshul bstan to zhes pa'i mtha' can/nyan chen bsod nams bstan pa'i rnam thar dkar po brag pa rat+na sirnyas bkod pa/dkar po grags pa rin cen seng ge'i rnam thar (zha)sgro skur gyi skyon gyis dben pa dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dad ldan slob mas bskul bar brten rang nyid kyis mdzad pa/zhang dkon cog dpal pa'i rnam thar dge slong dpal ldan gyis dben gnas tsha mo rong byang chub chos rdzong du mdzad pa/rgyal ba brag phug pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan blo gro brtan pasalcags mo yos kyi lo ston zla tha chung smin drug zla ba'i tshes gcig la sbyar ba/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa dge slong dpal ldan tshul khrims kyi rang gis cung zad thos pa bris pa/ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa'i rnam thar dge slong dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis dad cing gus pa'i slob ma'i ngor tsha mo rong gi byang chub chos rdzong du mdzad pa/chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims kyi rnam thar grub chen 217ba kho sna shrīs mdzad pa'i nang nas mdor bsdus te mus chen sems dpa' chen pos gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong du mdzad pa/grub chen burnya shrī'i rnam thar rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwar mdzad pa/rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)po'i dgung lo don bzhi yan gyi rnam thar sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i slar yang de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i
