'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rje btsun sgo rum pa'i rnam thar (zur/ngo mtshar yid bzhin gyi chu gter bshad pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dgung lo so brgyad pa'i dus dbus su/ (6re/phebs pa'i rtogs brjod rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lam glu dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dga' ston/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i rnam thar (zuge rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar snye ma/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i mkhan (zha)chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad (nyid/'i)pa'i brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung rgyun 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses zin bris su btab pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu (218na dang bcas pa'i gdams pa'i byung tshul gsang chen bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba (ni / kha lu brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa ma nor ba/tshar chen gyi gsung rgyun 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses zin bris su btab pa'i khog 'bubs las byung ba'i chos la bshad sgrub bya tshul sogs kyi zin bris/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i spyi don khog 'bubs (klu/kyi legs bshad gnas kyi be bum zab mo/ /tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i bstod pa (zur/snyan brgyud pad mtsho bshad pa/ slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa (zha)chen po'i bstod pa tshangs dbang ma/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi bstod pa (ji sher ba dkar blo gros ma/ des mdzad pa'i rje btsun rdo ring pa'i bstod pa (6ra/mtha' yas ma/ des mdzad pa'i bdag bstod blo gsal mang thos ma/ de'i bstod pa thams —312

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi mdzad 'bage pa'i bkra shis mtshan bzang ma/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i bstod pa 'bager ba yangs ma/ rdo rje la yo dbang phyug rab brtan gyi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dus gsum rgyal ba ma rang nyid kyi mdzad pa/ rje btsun sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i maṇ+ḍal zhing khams rnam dag ma/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bla ma lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa (6re/dngos grub sgo 'byed/ des mdzad pa'i gsung ngag brgyud pa'i (zuge bkra shis rdo rje 'cha dbang ma rnams/gnyis pa nyams myong tshad ma rgyud la skyed par byed pa'i thabs glegs bam du bzhugs pa'i 'khrid (218ba)kyi gzhung shing chen mo bzhi las/ gzhung ji ltar ba bzhin bkri ba'i nyams 'khrid kyi dgongs pa rdo rje 'chang tshar ba chen po'i gsung thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig gsang chen bstan pa rgyas byed kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa ma nor ba la gzhi byas/ bla ma dam pa'i sbas don gsal ba dang / tshar chen gyi gsung mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtshos reg zig tu mdzad pa'i snang gsum gsal byed zla ba bdud rtsi'i thigs 'phreng dang / sngags lam gyi 'khrid yig nyi gzhon gsar pa'i thigs 'phreng skal bzang ut+pal gzhen nu'i kha 'byed nas rgyas bshad kha bskangs te nyams 'khrid zla ba phyed bzhi'i bar nos pa la/ snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i skabs dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdams pa'i sa rga ma log pa/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa ste bzhi ldan 'di tshogs slob gnyis ka la dgos shing /slob bshad par thun mong ma yin pa'i 'chad tshul yang yod la/ de yang rgyu lam 'bras gsum gyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ nyams su blangs pa myong ba byin gyis brlabs pa grub pa'i mtha' ste brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ sa rga zhes pa go rim ma 'chol pa/ bsam pa tshim pa rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pas bla ma lha dang gdams ngag la gzhan rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa'i mos gus te tshar chen gyis rje btsun rdo ring pa la gsung ngag rin po che thob nas bla ma gzhan dang gdams ngag gzhan la sangs rgyas re bsam pa med —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gsungs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnad yin zhing /de yang snyan brgyud gsum pa'i go rim ma 219na'achol ba dpon slob kyi 'grel ba ma brtags par dbang mi bskur/de ma bskur bar gdams pa mi 'chad/de ma bshad par gzhung mi 'chad/de ma bshad par sgrub pa'i lung mi sbyin/de ma byin par gsang bcu'i rgyas mi gdams pa sogs 'khrul pa'i dri ma phra mo tsam yang med pa'i phyag len rnam par dag pa yin la/spyir 'khrid tshul ni/brtag gnyis las/dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya//de nasabaslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin//de la bye brag smra ba bstan//mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no//de nas rnal 'byor dpyod pa nyid//de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan//sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas//de rjes kye'i rdo rje brtsams//zhes brgyud kyi dgongs pa dang /de dang cha 'dra ba/ljon shing las/a mong gi gdamasapas bkral ba/thun mong ma yin pa gzhung chung rdo rje'i tshig rkang nas gsung pa sogs mtha' dag la lam thun mong ba'i rgyud sbyangs sngon du song nas sngags lam la 'jug dgos pa yin zhing /de yang gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum gyi rab rnams dbang bzhi tshad ldan thob nas de bskur ba'i bla ma sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan du thag chod nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni lam zab mo kho nas grol ba/'bring po som nyi cung zad yod pa dam tshig bsrungs pas grol ba/tha ma bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pas grol ba las/deng sang phyi ma nyid gtso che ba'i phyag len du mdzad kyi/dwags brgyud pa sogs phag mo'i byin rlabs tsam gyis dbang gi go bcad/dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshul tsam yang ma thos par phyag chen du ming btags pa'i tshad lta had po dang chos drug gi 219brtsa rlung sogs la btsan thabs su 'khrid de/chos sgor zhugs ma thag pa nas grub pa'i dbang phyug tu rlom pa'i lugs dang 'di yi mi 'dra bas tshar chen gyis/ga dmasang ga mkha' 'gro yi snyan brgyud/gsung ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bu/nyams len phyogs re tsam ma yin/bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len/zhesalam thun mong ba'i rgyud sbyangs nas dbang bzhi pa'i bar gyi gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i nyams len cha tshang ba dgos pas thog mar theg chen thun mong ༷'i lam sems can la nyon mongs pa la ma dag

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa'i snang ba/ rnal 'byor pa la ting nge 'dzin la nyams kyi snang ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dag pa'i snang ba ste lam snang ba gsum gyi 'khrid/ de rjes maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga ma la brten nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa brgyud pa khyab par gnyis ldan gyi phyag len ltar nos/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'i sdom pa nyi shu pa'i lung / sems bskyed kyi cho ga rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab kyi don snying por bsdus pa ngor r+sā dkon cog lhun grub 6)(dzha/kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i lung / slob ma rjes 'dzin song nas slob dpon bsnyen pa kha gso ba dang de'i bar bsag sbyang gi 'khrid nos pa ltar nyams len thun bzhin bcad de nan tan du bstar/ tshar chen gyis/rgyal yum bdag med mkha' 'gro la/ /paṇa grub dbang po bi ru pas/ /nos pa nas bzung da lta'i bar//rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad du/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo ma nub pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan dbang bzhi'i lam/ rdo (220na)rje theg pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes pa ltar bla med rdo rje theg pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i smin grol gnyis kyi thog mar kye rdo rje lha dgu'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen por mus chen gyis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil dang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i lhan thabs zung du 'jug par zhal shes phyag len gyis brgyan te dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa brgyad tshang ba'i sgo nas rgyu dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa bshad pas mtha' dpyad de sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo 'phrod pa smin rgyas su nos/ adzi'i bzlas(༅)lung / rje btsun yum bka' rdo rje bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil gyi yi ge'i steng nas rgyu dus kyi dbang phyin ci ma log pa thob/ de ltar nos pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams mi nyams par bsrung ba gsal bar ston pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i lhung ba rgya cher bshad pa'i 'grel (nyi)pa zhakhrul pa spong las dang po pa dang i mong gi chos bdun gyi nang phywa/ ba zhes bya ba rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad pa/ rtsa ba yan lag gi lhung ba'i rnam bshad 'khrul spong rab gsal bdag chen rdo rje 'changagis mdzad pa/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i dam tshig gi tshogs rnam (ngag)par —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bshad pa'i zin bris bag yod gtam gyi bdud rtsi/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa rje btsun chen po'i yi ge'i gsal byed/ khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig gi tshogs 'khor (nyi)'bring po las dang po ba dang thun mong gi chos bon gyi nang 'a/ rje btsun (220ba)chen pos mdzad pa/ sa paṇa gyis mdo smad ling chu tser khab kyi gtsug lag khang du mdzad (brang/pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rtsod spong ma/ rgyal sras jing zhing gi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas 'phags (e)pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos mdzad pa'i tshogs mchod chog khrigs ma/ dkar shākya grags kyis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas rje btsun gyis mdzad lta'i)pa'i lam gyi yan lag dpal he ru ga'i chos drug gi yi ge /slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad ()pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes nyan pa'i kun spyod sogs ston pa/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa (nyi)slob dpon rin po che rtse mos mdzad pa/ las dang po sa mong gi chos mdun gyi nang phywa/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs 'bring po yan lag drug (a)pa tshig sna ring thung gnyis yod pa'i thung ba/ des mdzad pa'i rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i rim pa gnyis (nyi)'khor dang bcas pa'i mngon rtogs las dang po pa dang thun mong gi chos bdun gyi nang tshan rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i dbang gi chu bo chen (a)po ma nub pa'i phyag len/ des mdzad pa'i zhi ba 'ba' zhig gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga (nyi)zhib tu bstan cing rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa/ las dang po pa dang thun mong gi chos bdun gyi nang tshan/ de'i sa las las bzhi ga'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga (nyi)mdor bstan zhing rnam gzhag rgyas par bstan pa rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad pa/ des dge slong kun dga' tshul khrims kyi ngor (mig)mdzad pa'i dus mtha' ma'i cho ga g.yin phan bdud rtsi/ slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i (221na)rab gnas (sku/bzang po drug pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse sgo dras par gsan pa'i gsan yig na tsho gis 'khor gyi tshab tu 'di las dang po pa dang thun mong gi chos bdun gyi gras su 'dug pa dkar chag dang ma mthun na'ang / des mdzad pa'i khog 'bubs su dkar chag dang mthun par 'dug pa —316

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)the tshom mi bya'o/ /rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad lta'i)pa'i rab gnas don gsal rnams/ dbang gi ye shes la log par rtog pa dag cing 'og nas 'byung ba'i lam thams cad skyon med par sgrub pa'i slad du kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i 'khrid sa gzhung spel ba'i bshad yam tsam min par 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel la brten nas sems 'tshol sogs rig thog tu brdar sha dpyad/ lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lam gyi thog mar bum dbang dang 'brel ba phyi skyed pa'i rim pa slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi bzhes pa'i zab pa'i tshul dgu'i sems 'dzin gyis kha bskangs te gsal snang ma mthong bar bsgom pa'i mos blor byas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad (nyi)pa'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa bya bral mar grags pa/ des mdzad pa'i dbang chu gsal ba'i me long / tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i lhan thabs nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i kye rdor sgrub thabs (lce)kyi rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi legs(su/par bshad pa las dang po pa la phan (221ba)pa sgrub pa nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba/ tshar chen gyisamadzad pa'i bskyed rim kyi rnam (zur/bshad legs par bshad pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i bsnyen chen (re/gyi yi ge dpyid kyi dga' ston/ des mdzad pa'i bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg rnams kyis rang gzhan gyi don gang sgrub kyang phyin ci ma log par shes pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du bsgrubs nas/ phyi rol tu zhen pa'i gdon gyi gnyen por nang rdo rje slob dpon gyi don dam lus kyi dkyil 'khor du rkyang 'dur ba dkon cog dpal dang mkhan chen bsod blo sogs kyis bskul nas bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ bla ma dam pa'i lus dkyil dbang chog zhabs na tho tsam yod pa'i steng nas—317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mi tsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lus dkyil lam (6)dus kyi lam 'bring po dang bsdus pa'i dbang /yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas( )lung bcas pa stsal nas/nang bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs dpyad de dpyad don nyams su len pa bskyed rim sems 'dzin gyi nyams 'khrid lam dus kyi nyams len gyi yi ge mus wo 'khor lo sdom pas mdzad pa/lam dus kyi dbang gi cho ga bdag wo rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i lung rnams/gsang dbang gi lam bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i 'khrid kyi thog mar nang gi bdag med ma gtum mo drod bskyed pa'i slad du rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i sis ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par thob nas/bdag byin gyis brlab pa khams 'dus pa dang po rlung gtum mo drod rtags kyi 'khrid ces pa 222na7)mu mo'i dmigs rkang bco brgyad kyi rim pa/pho nya'i lam mam shes rab ye shes kyi lam zhes bya ba khams 'dus pa bar ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'dod pa'i lcags kyu dga' bzhi lungs 'byung lugs ldog tu nyams su blang ba'i 'khrid/khams 'dus pa mtha' ma skyon med gzhug ma ye shes kyi lam 'khrid dam dbang bzhi pa'i lam rba rlabs gsum gyi 'khrid dang bcas pa'i dbang bzhi re re la'ang /lam/lta ba/grub mtha'/'da' kha ma/bar do/rmi lam/sgyu lus dang bcas pa'i dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i lam cha tshang ba re re 'khrid rim du tshang bar stsal/rnal 'byor birnya bas rje btsun brtse ba chen po pa la dngos su gnang ba'i man ngag sa skya'i lcags ri'i khongs las mi 'da' ba bzhi'i nang tshan lam zab phyi nang gsang gsum las lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi phyi ma'i ( )'khrid kyi byin rlabs/de'i yi ge bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/lam zab nang ma'i 'khrid (6)kyi byin rlabs/de'i yi ge khri chen kun dga' bsod nams kyis (6)mdzad pa'i don gnyis mthar phyin/bla ma rin cen 'byung ldan gyi byin rlabs/de'i yi ge tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis brtse chen zhabs la dngos su gnang ba'i phyi'i bar gcod bsrung ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ( )ba thun mong ba'i byin mas/de'i yig rnying /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ( )ba 8

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nang ma'i byin rlabs/ de dang 'brel ba'i bir bsrung (6)gi bsrung (nyi)ba'i dmigs rim/ sngon chad zhal shes kho nar bzhugs pa'i bir bsrung (5)gi cha lag zab mo'i dmigs 'khrid/ bla ma don (222bgrub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bye brag pa mtshar gsum khug (6)pa'i byin rlabs/ de'i yi ge (zha)rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad pa/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yi ge ltar brda don (6)gsal ba'i byin rlabs/ lam sbas (༅)bshad kyi byin rlabs rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa'i zin bris ltar dbang bzhi (6)ngo sprod kyi byin rlabs/ man ngag gces bsdus kyi rten 'brel (pyad)gyi byin rlabs/ lum pa ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags kyi yi ge ltar rnam 'joms (༅)bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ man ngag rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar brda tshig ( ) rgyud kyi byin rlabs/ gsung ngag stan thog gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul ston pa lam bsdus te sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa/ lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar gsang ba (6)bcus rgyas gdab pa/ bstan pa gtad cing bka' bsgo ba'i tshul du lam 'bras pa'i mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang dang bzhi 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i reg zig la brten pa dang bcas pa rnams/gnyis pa de rnams kyi rgyab brten du bstan bcos tshad ma dang 'brel pa'i lung thob pa la/thog mar gsung ngag glegs bam du grags par/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i glegs bam gyi dkar chag rje btsun 'di glegs bam gyi dbur bzhugs kyang chos sna drug cur mi gtogs so/ /chen pos dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ gsung ngag rin po che rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'di rje gas 'a po'i lhagasabam dkar chag na mi gsal bar brten rjes 'brang mang po zhig glegs bam gyi grangs su mi 'dren pa'i log rtog gi 'khrul gtam smra'o/ /gzhung chung yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyag bzhi rab pa (223na bo bang phyug rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa'i ngor dpal ldan sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel gnyag ma/rnam 'grel bcu gcig tsam yod pa'i nang nas 'di gzhung nyung la don rgyas pa'i khyad du 'phags zhes dkar chag tu snang ngo / /dkar chag las mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa la zhal las shes so zhes smos pa dgu las med kyang —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de zhes gsal byed kyi yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis don bsdus ma dang bcas pa las kun gci'i yi ge don bsdus pa/ gdan sogs kyi yi ge /lubs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi yig chung / bum dbang gi 'da' kha ma'i skabs su 'chi ltas 'phrul 'khor 'chi blu dang bcas pa snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' kha ma ste bum dbang gi yig chung chos sde gcig tu 'dren pa/ gsang dbang gi thig le'i rnal 'byor/ shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ bzhi ba'i 'da' kha ma bum dbang dang thun mong du yi shes sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa'i yig chung 'di ni bum dbang dang thun mong yin no'i mtha' can/ bar do bzhi'i yig chung / lam dus kyi dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi yig chung /tshad ma bzhi'i yig chung / gdams ngag drug gi yig chung / rten 'brel lngar bstan pa'i lam gyi yig chung / sgrib sel dang gnas sbyong 'byams gcod kyi za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg klu sgrub pa 'i khog 'bubs su 'di su sto'i 'jug tu 'dug /gi yig chung / gdon gyi grib khru ba'i kyis sel ba'i yig chung / grib ma su tsā sa sel ba'i yig chung / thig le 'dzag pa bsrung ba'i yig chung / yi ge brgya pa gdon thabs kyi yig chung ste 'khor 'das thun mong gi skabs dgos pa bcu bdun/ rlung gi sbyor ba bdun/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi ste (223btostsor lo cham pa la gnyis/ gsang dbang gi skabs su 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa'i dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ mthar phyin pa'i sa bcu gsum phyed 'og ma'i mngon rtogs te 'das lam gyi skabs su gsum gyi gsal byed nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /byang chub sems dpa' a seng gis zhus pa'i ngor sa skya pa chen pos gnang ba'i 'grel pa thams cad kyi don bsdus kyi tshigs bcad rnam 'grel a seng mar grags pa ste nyi shu rtsa gsum glegs bam 'di wo ro mas ni dang sbyar na 'di yan gyi chos 'a nyi shu rtsa lnga po bstan yos 'a ma/ ni bstan bcos 'di nyid kyi steng du bshad par bya ba yin no/ /de dag las 'phros pa'i gud du gsung pa'i chos skor la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud las 'phros nas snying po'i don lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtsa ba tshig le'ur byas pa rin po che'i snang ba sh+lau ka nyi shu ba 'grel pa dang bcas pa/thabs rgyud gdan sogs las 'phros pa dang dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa'i man —320

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ngag gi yi ge'am rgyu dus su dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i man ngag gi gnad/ gdan sogs las 'phros pa mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten nas bskur ba'i man ngag /lam sogs nyi shu nas 'phros nas phyi thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen rtse dang rje klu sgrub pa'i khog 'bubs su gong du smos zin pa'i las dang po ba dang thun mong du dgos pa'i chos sna bdun po 'dir bgrangs 'dug cing / dkar chag na 'phrin las so gnyis kyi mthug na 'dug pa dngos gzhi dkar chag gtso che na'ang bskyed rim mdor bsdus sogs dang sde tshan bstun na khog 'bubs 'bar bar mngon zhing bdag chen rdo rje 'chang (224na)gi ba tshes pa'ang de kha yin nam snyam mo/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa'i gnad ces pa rgyas 'bring mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bstan pa'i 'jug tu bsdus pa la bsod nams tshogs gsog sogs pa gsal bar bstan pa/ dam tshig las 'phros pa bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub tshul/ gsang sngags snyan brgyud sogs ma chad pa las 'phros nas rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa'i tho yig brtse chen snying po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dkar chag tu byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa ma nyams pa ni logs su rtogs par bya'o gsung pa 'di yin la phra mo'i chos sde yang gtogs so/ /bsrung ba sum cu dang man ngag gi gnad bdun cu las 'phros nas gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi byung ba las thog mar bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun gyi gegs sel thabs klu sgrub pa'i khog 'bugs na 'di gnyis go ldog 'dug na'ang dkar chag dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i 'og 'bu bas na 'di ltar byung ngo / /byung rgyal du mi gtang ba'i gnad bzhi/ lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyis sel ba/ rnal 'byor gyi 'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis te dgu po 'di glegs bam du dngos su bzhugs shing / las dang po ba dang thun mong du dgos pa'i chos bdun po deng sang glegs bam 'dir mi bzhugs pas gong du smos zin na'ang don du de dag thams cad rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las 'phros pa'i skor yin/ dkar chag tu glegs bam 'di na gnas kyang 'gal ba med la las dang po ba dang thun mong du dgos pa'i phyir logs su 'dug kyang nyes pa med do zhes so/ /lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rgyas pa gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar dang / 'bring po rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bras 'bring du bsdus nas gang zag gcig gis lam 'bras bu dang bcas ma —321 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tshang ba med par ston pa/ rang gi gzhung cung zad yod pa sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'am 'bogs pa lam bsdus pa/ de ltar lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mtha' dag (224bzhol 'byor pas nyams su blang ba'i phyir gzhung shing chen po bzhi las thog mar gzhung ji lta bar bkri ba'i 'khrid yig jo lcags mar grags pa lho brag pa dkar ston jo sras lcags kyi rdo rjes lan mang du gsol ba btab pa la brten nas mdzad pa/ dkar chag dang rin po che klu bsgrub pa'i khog 'bubs su 'di ltar 'dug cing rje mkhyen rtse'i khog 'bu bas na gzhung shing dang rtogs pa bskyed pa bsdoms pa'i chos tshan dgu po gegs sel gyi 'gor 'dug pa tshad ma bzhi dang sbyor ba'i dbang du byas na don la gnas so/ /man ngag gi gnad drug gis bkri ba'i 'khrid yig khyad par can/ brtson 'grus can man ngag gi gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba'i 'khrid yig /gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum bkri ba'i 'khrid yig dang bzhi/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa las byung ba'i rtogs pa bogs dbyung ba'i phyir rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga la thog mar lam 'jug ldog mgyogs byed pho lha'i lam phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ 'khor 'das kyi lam thun mong du bsre ba dang /'gros bzhi bcas pa'i yi ge /phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ rtog pa gsal ba'i phyir dkar chag klu sgrub pa 'i khog 'bubs kyi dngos bstan las bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi phyag dpe'i dpe ris rnams cung zad mang bar snang ngo / /'chi ltas brtag pa rgyas pa'i dpe chung / ma nges pa'i 'chi ltas kyi dpe chung / de gnyis dang 'dra min re/ rtsa'i dpe ris rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ gsum ngag dkyus dang sras don ma'i lugs kyi bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i dpe chung so so/ yang bha ga'i dpe chung lugs gcig nyams skye tshul dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor gyi 'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis dpe ris/ gegs sel gzhan gyi dpe chung gnyis/ lam sbas (225na)bshad kyi rigs drug skye ba brtag pa'i dpe chung rnams rnam grangs gcig tu 'dren no/ /gang zag dbang po rab bla mas grol bas lam g.yin la ltos mi dgos pa de'i cha rkyen lam zab 'bring gsum las lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bla ma chen po'i dbu bsnyung ma/'di yan la rtog pa gsal ba'i skor ma gtogasadangos bstan gyi yi ge rnams kyi steng dbang chu/ sgrub thabs yan lag zhe drug /bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg rnams bsnan pa'i —322—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)chos sna sum cu po nyams myong tshad ma yin no/ /tshad ma bzhi pa bka' yang dag pa'i lung tshad ma dang sbyor bar lung tshad ma gsung ngag rin po che 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyor ba lam phyi ma gnyis kyang de bzhin du shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ gsung ngag rin po che lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba gsung ngag tshad ma lung dang sbyar ba'i gdams ngag go'i mtha' can/ rje btsun brtse ba chen pos mdzad pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba dkar chag tu lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba ni logs su shes par bya'o gsung ba 'di yin pas/ dpe la lar dmar gyis mdzad tshul 'dug pa'i mchan bu lta bu dmar gyis mdzad pa yod srid pa la 'brul lam snyam mo/ /phra mo'i chos sder yang snang ngo / /gleng gzhi dang gleng bslang ba dang rgyud kyi yan lag rgyas par dbye ba dang sbyar ba gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa lung sbyor gsum po 'di lung 3 ma/ mtshon gyis bsrung la mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol gyi mtha' can/ bla ma tshad ma sbyar ba'i skabs kyi bla ma brgyud pa rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus zhes pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rnam thar/ 'di gnyis bla ma tshad ma'o/ /bla ma brgyud pa bod kyi lo rgyus zhes pa 'brog mi lo chen nas sa skya pa chen po'i bar gyi rtogs brjod mdor (225bang sdus/ 'di yan gyis lam 'bras glegs bam chos sna drug cu zhes pa tshang ba yin la/ rjes 'brang la la dag rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang rtog gsal dor nas yi ge med pa'i lung sbyor rgyas pa dang phra mo'i dkar chag gnyis 'dren pa dang / ngor lugs pa 'ga' zhig rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi tshab tu man ngag phra mo gzhan rnams gcig tu 'dren par dkar chag tu man ngag phra mo gzhan gyi dkar chag ni bri bar ma nus zhes pa dang dngos su 'gal/ rdzong pa'i bzhed par rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi tshab tu g.yag drug cu'i grangs su rdzi'u brtsi ba ltar dkar chag 'dren pa 'dug na'ang rang re kha'u brag rdzong pa'i brgyud 'dzin gsang chen slob bshad pa rnams kyi lugs la mi bzhed cing / deng sang yongs grags la glegs bam du nges par bzhugs dgos pa bzhi bcu zhe dgu dkar chag la snga stom phyi rtsom gyi khyad nas la lar 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel med 'dug pa de'i dbang gis zhe dgur ngos bzung pas snyam/ che ltas grags na'ang dkar chag gi tshig gis9zen pa lnga bcu nga gnyig /—323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā)logs su bzhugs pa byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa dang lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba gnyis/ glegs bam 'dir bzhugs kyang rung zhing ma bzhugs kyang rung ba'i yig sna bdun dang bcas pas chos sde drug cu tham pa/ yang chos sde drug cur dngos su mi gtogs par glegs bam du bzhugs pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' (zha)yang dag pa lung gi tshad ma lung 'di nyid dang sbyar na mthar thug rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyi bka'i dbang du byas te gleng gzhi'i mdo dang gleng bslang gi mdo rgyud don rgyas pa dang sbyar ba slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa phra tsho rmis yang the/ mjug na 'di ni (226na thad ga cag spun gnyis dang bka' lung pa dang rmog ston dang bzhis zhus pa lags zhes sogs yod pa/ rnam 'grel gnyag ma'i mjug tu rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag dpe la gtugs te dag par byas so zhes bris pa'i dkar shākya grags kyi phyag dpe la dpe phyi byas pas shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas su rig par bya'o/ /'khon bya bral ba ma ti'i ming can gyi yi dam du bya ba'i chos 3zhas pa 'jug tu bris pa'i bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal ma' dpal bzang po'i phyag dpe dngos rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang / thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug khu dbon gsum dang bcasapa'i phyag dpe'i steng nas mchan rnying par ma zad bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsum mchan phyag bris ma dang bcas legs par nos/ de yang rjes 'brang gi mkhas pa mang dag 'da' kha ma yan las rmi lam man gyi 'khrid lam 'bras glegs bam tshor gsal bar med pas gsung ngag slob bshad ces bya ba rje btsun gong ma'i dus med snyam pa'i log rtog gi mun pa gtibs pa mang na'ang glegs bam dkar chag tu yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag mang tu thos mod/ yi ge la thun mong dang gang zag so so la gnang nas de dag kyang thun mong du gnang bar gsal ba 'di dag la rje bla mas gzhan su la yang ma gnang ba'i yi ge kho bo cag kho na la bye brag tu sbas nas snang ba yod na dkon cog gsum dpang ngo //zhes gsungs pas glegs bam du ma grags pa'i yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud yod pa dngos su bstan zhing / rje btsun sa paṇa gyis/ 'on kyang rten 'brel ba mo'i gnad/ /da dung kun gyis shes pa (226ba)—324

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)med/ /glegs bam tsam la brten pa yi/ /lam 'bras pas kyang 'di mi shes/ ceXzhu glegs bam la ma brten pa'i snyan nas snyan zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i slob bshad zab mo yod par gsungs shing / bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i dus nas slob ma byings la mi ston pa'i man ngag zab mo zur pa zhig yod ba phyogs tsam rig nas skur ba btab par brten rje btsun chen pos/ 'gro la bu gcig ltar brtse yang / /bye brag bu la brtse ba yis/ yi ge sbas pa snang ngo zhes/ /bla ma mchog la bskur mi bya/ zhes gsung pa sogs kyis log rtog gi mdud pa thams cad rang grol du 'gro'o/ /tshul de dag la dgongs nas/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ yab gcig snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i zil dngar can/ /thugs rje'i ge sar ba 'ad ldan zhabs pas ra/ /gus btud bung ba bdag kyang slob bshad kyi/ /sbrang rtsi gsar pa'i bde bas ci yang myos/ /zhes dang / rnam thar las/ 'khrul med chos kyi snying po 'di thos tshe/ /rab 'byams shes bya'i rang zhal tshur ston byung / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len brgyud la khel/ /zab zab phal cher ming rkyang tsam du song / /zhes dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po klu sgrub pas/ tshogs par bshad pa'i drang don za zi'i gtam/ /rnam par spangs nas slob bu mchog dag la/ /gces par gdams pa nges don snying po'i bcud/ /zab mo slob bshad 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsung pa rang bzhin brjod kyi snyan ngag kho nar yid ches pa'o/ /rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan du/ dam pa'i drin las chos 'di'i zab pa'i gnad/ /mang po'i don la kho bo blo gsal yang / /thun mong ngag tu brjod (227na〉ngung 'ga' zhig tsam/ /'chad par 'gyur gyis mkha' 'gros skabs phye zhig /ces tshogs bshad pa phal cher gyis mgrin pa bteg nas 'chad pa'i 'khrid yig 'di nyid thun mong tsam du bstan pas kyang de las zab pa zhig med ces smra ba'i lce 'chad par snang ngo / /rje sa skya pa chen pos gsung ngag 'di la zhu ba po so so'i don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel bcu gcig tsam yod pa'i nang nas shin tu zab cing rgyas pa rigs kyi sras slob dpon rin po che sku mched gnyis kyi don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel sras don mar (sa)grags pa rdo rje'i tshig rkang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i bshad pa —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i glegs bam pod nag tu grags (nyi)pa'i skor la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/ phyi dkyil gyi mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ lam dus kyi smin byed mchog gi dbang bskur ba'i tshul zab pa las kyang ches zab pa/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs lam dus dbang gi nyams len dge bshes kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi ngor mdzad pa/ bla ma la brten nas dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan dang bla ma sras pa'i don du mdzad pa/lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yan lag mdo stod pa chos rgyal 'od zer gyi ngor mdzad pa/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gzhud ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i 'khrid yig sbas don gsal ba/ gnad drug gis bkri ba'i 'khrid kyi gsal byed gnad kyi lde mig /gnad bcu gcig gis dkri ba'i 'khrid kyi gsal byed gnad kyi sgo 'byed/ (227ba bo bang po rab 'bring tha gsum bkri ba'i 'khrid kyi gsal byed nyung du rnam gsal/ lam 'bras 'bring du bsdus nas snang ba gsum du gang zag gcig la dgos pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas rjod byed kyi sgra la ma ltos par brjod bya'i don gtso bo'i dbang du byas nas ma tshang ba med par bstan pa'i snyan brgyud/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag rnam par bshad pa man ngag gi mdzod rnams/ lam 'bras skor lhag ma dang bcas pa'i tho yig man ngag phra mor grags (nyi)pa'i skor la/ rdzong chung pa rtsang rus kyi ming / byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag /de las byung ba'i gdams skor la/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pas mdzad pa/rjes 'brang gi yi ge dang drug /dang po la/ byin rlabs/ gegs sel/ spyi 'gro'i yi ge dang gsum/dang po la/ lam dus kyi dbang chog gam lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi byin rlabs mdor bsdus kyi cho ga bla ma sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa dbang tshig tsam gyis thob pa'i gdams ngag sa ma ba ta ma'i mtha' can/des mdzad pa'i bdag med ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par bskur ba'i phyag len tho yig /—326

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'di glegs bam du'ang gtogs/ pod dmar na grags pas mdzad zer/ des mdzad pa'i bir bsrung pod dmar na 'phags pas mdzad par 4kho/ 'di'i lung len par 'dod pa la birlu pa'i byin rlabs sa skya pa la gnang ste rim par brgyud pa'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i a spyil brten nas dpal kye rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa nus pa dang ldan pa 'gyur gsung ba'i mtha' can rnams/ pod (228na bo mar gyis de 'di dang 7 mi mas/gnyis pa gegs sel la/ gegs sel nyams chen mo zhes pod dmar na'ang yod/ pa dbu na birlu nā tha ya dang ri klung la sogs su cung zad bcags pas spyir gces pa yin gsung pa'i mtha' can/ 'di la yi ge 'dra min 'ga' re yod par grags na'ang deng sang glegs bam du gcig pu 'di las mi bzhugs shing yi ge tshan pa brgyad kyi bsgrigs rim tsam las tshig don la khyad med tshul dkar chag tu gsal/gegs sel nyams len chung ba bla ma chen po'i gdams pa dmar 'khrid thugs kyi nying khu yi ge'i ris su bkod pa po'i mtha' can pod dmar na'ang yod/ lho brag dkar ston la gnang ba'i gegs sel bar gcod rnam gsum sel ba/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ dpal sa skya pa chen po'i gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ 'di'i mchod brjod du/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhabs rdul gus len pa/ chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya dmar gyis zhus/ zhes pa'i tshig rigs la 'brul nas dmar gyis mdzad par bzhed pa byung na'ang de zhus dag mdzad nas tshig rigs de rnams bsnan pa ma gtogs 'jug gi mchan bur dzang dza ne/ gtsang bzher/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa khams pa lnga ste bdun la gnang bka' rgyas kyang btab bo/ /dzang gis bla chen la zhus nas rje pa sku mched gnyis sbran pas/ rje pa'i zhal nas/dzang 'di nged la drin che gsungs so/ /zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas kyang brtse ba chen po'i gsung yin par nges nus so/ /gegs sel gces bsdus zhes pa rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad g.yin gyis nges par bsrung ngo'i mtha' can/ dkar chag tu yi ge phywa pa nyi (228bsko rtsa gnyis yod gsungs kyang /thor ya yan gyi nyer bzhi 'dug pa dpyad/ gegs sel gsang bdun ma thes pa sgam la 'phra gegs byung na 'kho5 gdams gdab ces pa'i mtha' can/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ gegs sel ha dmigs ma rags pa tsam lags kyi mtha' —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()can/ lung sbyor nyi shu pa rnams/ gsum pa spyi 'gro'i yi ge la/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi tshigs bcad ma rtsa 'grel/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ lam bsdus pa ngo bo nyid gsum zhes pa lam dang 'bras bu'i chos thams cad mdor bsdus te bstan pa/ gsang bcu spyod pa'i rnal 'byor mthar bskyal ba'i spyod pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gsung ngag rin po che lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba rnams/ 'di glegasabam du'ang gtogs/ 'di tshor sbyar byang med pa 'ga' zhig 'dug cing dkar chag tu 'ga' zhig dngos kyi slob mas gsung las zin pa'i bris pa'ang 'dra'o zhes byung bas kyang shes so/ /gnyis pa slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa ni/ lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba mchan bu ma mjug tu/ 'di glegs gyi chosasder mi gtogs kyang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dang lo pa spyan snga sogs kyi phyag dpe khungs thub tshor glegs bam gyi mjug tu bris 'dug /'di ni bdag cag spun gnyis dang bka' lung pa dang rmog ston pa bzhis zhus tshul yod pa/ gsum pa rje btsun rin po che mdzad pa la/ gsol 'debs/ zhal gdams/ rnam thar dang gsum/ dang po la/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs che ba bla ma rdor 'dzin ma/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ chung ba rdo rje 'chang gtso ma/ gnyis pa zhal gdams la/ bra ston blo gros la gdams pa/ mjug na blo ka gcig thol du yod pa zhig pod dmar na'ang yod/ dga' ston rdo rje grags par springs pa/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ (229na gsum pa rnam thar la/ bla ma chen po'i ngo mtshar ba'i gtam mang du yod pa'i nang nas dang po gung thang du bzhugs pa dang gnyis pa bzang rgyud 'phrog gseng tu byon tshul skor/ bzhi pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa la/ 'khrid/ bshad pa/lam zab/ bir bsrung dang bzhi/ dang po la/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi dkar chag /'di gsung yin min la rtsod pa byung na'ang bka' sgrub bstan pa'i skabs bsgrubs zin zhes pa dkar chag tu 'dug go /lam sbas (ṇi)pod dmar na'ang yod/ bshad/ 'di la 'dra min 'ga' zhig byung bar brten/ ji skad du/ bdag ni gsang sngags zab mo'i don/ yi ger byed la cung zad skrag /'on kyang g.yin gyis sbyar ba la/ /bla ma'i gsung dang 'gal bar mthong / /des na gsung dang mthun par bkod/ /ces ched du gnyer nas mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i yan lag rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi zhal gyi —328

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gdams pa thun mong gi dngos grub chen po bcu zhes pa/ tshe sgrub/ rdo rje chu 'thung / thig le 'dzag med/lte bsgyur/ rlung gi bcud len/ 'chi blu/ dbang bsdud/ gdon 'grol/ nor sgrub/ skye ba brtag pa dang / phra mo brgyad ces pa gza' bsrung / bgegs bsrung / rkyal pa kha gcu/ mig gi rab rib/ lce dig /snying rlung rnams sel ba/ drod skye ba/ rten 'brel brtag pa'i gdams pa rtsa 'grel/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ rje btsun chen po dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhes dus brtse ba chen pos gnang ba'i brda don gsal ba'i rtsa 'grel rdo rje 'dzin thob shog gi mtha' can/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ de'i yan lag 'khrid kyi lung sbyor rgyas bsdus rnams la blta bar bya'o'i mtha' (229ba lon/ lam bsdus te sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'i yi ge rnams/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ gnyis pa bshad pa la/ rtsa sngags kyi rnam par bshad pa snying po'i don gsal/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ phyag rgya chen po'i rab tu dbye ba/ pod dmar na ma sun tu skye bskye ba med pa sogs kyi tho ka gcig thol du bod pa zhig snang / rdo rje'i tshig rkang las rten 'brel lngas lam yongs su rdzogs par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa phyogs tsam bstan pa/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ rlung ltas rten 'brel brtag pa/sa bdun pa yan chad 'khor bzhi'i rgya zhes pa'i dgongs pa ston pa/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ 'gor bla ma'i zhal nas zhes pa dang dbu ma la dbang phyug gi ming btags pa ni dbu ma'i yon tan brgyad do'i mtha' can rnams/ dkar tshan na sa paṇa:na bris zer/ gsum pa lam zab ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa ling chu rtse khab ma/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gu shrī jo 'bum la 'phrings pa nad 'don mar grags pa/ bzhi ba bir bsrung la/ bir bsrung thun mong ma yin pa chu la brten pa'i rgyun bsrung dang mi bskyod pa la brten nas nam dgos su bsrung ba/ sngags byang zhu dag ma/ rdo rje bsrung ba'i phyag rgya/ tsakra'i bsrung ba/ thabs shes kyi bsrung ba ste bsrung ba gsum/ ril bu bcud len sgrub pa rnams/lnga pa 'phags pas mdzad pa la/ phyag mchod/ 'khrid/ lus dkyil/ lam zab/ thor bu dang lnga/ dang po ni/ chu mo glang gi lo'i nag pa zla ba la mdzad pa'i las 'bras brgyud pa'i phyag mchod sangs rgyas kun ngo ma/ gnyis pa 'khrid la/ dag pa rnam gsum gyi sgo nas rnal 'byor pas nyams su blang ba'i —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 7)'khrid yig /rgyal po la phul ba'i dbang gsum pa'i lam rgyas bsdus (230na tshe ka nyis so/ /gsum pa lus kyi dkyil la/ kye rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bla ma nyis thog par gnang ba/dpal kye rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa'i thabs lcags pho rta'i lo gsar shar ba'i tshe mdzad nas jin gyim la phul ba/ lam dus kyis dbang rgyas par len pa'i lag len dpon mo go go can gyi don du shing pho khyi lor mdzad pa/ bzhi pa lam zab la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag la'u shum/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor shod dgon spyan snga ma me pho byi ba'i lo la mdzad pa rnams/ lnga pa thor bu la/ bir bsrung thun mong bar grags pa zhar byung chu bsrung / pod dmar na'ang yod/ rdo rje rtse gsum/ phyag rgya/ sngags rgya/ dmigs pa/ lam bsrung / nyal bsrung dang bcas bstan pa/ bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa bdud rtsi 'byung ba/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg /tsho gos sbyor mngon rtogs rnams/pod dmar na'ang yod/ drug pa gsal byed rjes (mi)'brang gi yi ge la/ sa chen gyi yi ge'i gsal byed/sa paṇa gyi yi ge'i gsal byed/ 'phags pa'i yi ge'i gsal byed/ gnyag ma cha lag dang bcas pa'i yi ge'i gsal byed dang bzhi/ dang po la/ lus dkyil dbang chog gi gsal byed dpal ldan blo gros brtan pas lcags yos sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la mdzad pa'i lus dkyil cho ga gsal ba'i sgron me/nyams chen mo sogs kyi gsal byed 'gor gegs sel dkar ston ma zhes yod pa'i brda 'grol chen mo ka nas ba'i bar te man ngag bco lnga yod pa/ sa rgya rkang pas chos kyis srin bu'i zhal dgag pa sogs brda 'grol chung ba gcig nas brgyad kyi bar gyi man (230na khor ga /dkar ston ma'i gsal byed nang 'byung ba phyi rol gdon gsang ba ting 'dzin sems kyi bar chad rnam gsum gsal bsgrub thabs ltar ros ma pa tha mi thi'i mtha' can/ bka' rgya ma'i gsal byed na bza' pa'i dbyug /bcos tshegs chung la don che ba gsal byed sgron me/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi gsal byed ngo sprod byin rlabs kyi lag len bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa rnams/ gnyis pa sa paṇa gyi yi ge'i gsal byed la/'khrid kyi dmigs pa'i thun gyi dkar chag gi gsal byed zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi zin —330

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bris/ chos rje gzungs pas bla ma klu pa la gnang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa sidha dh+wa dza'i dri lan/ lam sbas bshad kyi gsal byed 'gor 'di la rdza'i 'khor lo sor bzhi pa zhes yod pa'i sbas bshad lag len zin bris 'brul 'khor bdun po ston gyin gda' 'o'i mtha' can/ phra grub kyi gsal byed 'gor dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug dang zhes yod pa'i grub chen dang phra mo'i zhal shes zin bris che ba kun la ston par mi bya'o'i mtha' can/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ 'gor mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs zhes yod pa'i phra grub kyi zhal shes chung ba snying gar bcer ba 'o'i mtha' can/ che ba 'di la brda don gsal ba'i byed lho pa rin chen dpal gyi zin bris rnams/ dkar man tu 'di bu shrī byas pa'i sbyar byang bris pa snang mod yi ge rnying pa yin pas nyis su byas pa ma yin no gsungs pa 'thad pa 'dra ste 'gor lho pas nan tan gyis bzung rab tu bris zhes pas kyang shes nus so/ /pod dmar na'ang yod/ gsum pa 'phags pa'i yi ge'i gsal byed ni/ 'gor rdo rje'i tshig rkang nas bsrung ba'i 'khor (231nal zhes yod pa'i bir bsrung gi gsal byed bsrung ba gsum dang sbyar ba su ṣ+ṭha swā hā'i mtha' can/ dkar chag na 'di nges pa mi 'dug kyang 'phags pa'i der sbyar bde tshul 'dug pas gcig gi nges bzung dka' ba 'dra'o/ /pod dmar na'ang bzhugs/ bzhi pa gnyag ma cha lag dang bcas sa pa'i gsal byed yi ge la gnyag ma gsal byed kyi yi ge /'phros don gsal byed kyi yi ge /lam 'bring po gsal byed kyi yi ge /gzhung shing gsal byed kyi yi ge dang bzhi/ dang po la/ 'gor rgyud dang man ngag la sogs pa nyan pa'i dus su zhes yod pa'i gzhung bshad (bar/gsal byed bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis rang gi blo nus dang sbyar ba'i zin bris/ 'gor lus zungs skyed pa'i skabs su bcud len ni zhes yod pa'i bdud rtsi la brten pa'i gsal byed bcud len zhal shes ting nge 'dzin shugs chung du 'gro bas 'dzags par btags te 'o'i mtha' can/ gnyis pa 'phros don gsal byed kyi yi ge la/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi zin bris bar bsdings pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ 'dir kha phral ba ma gtogs lam skor gyi zin bris rnams 'di'i 'gor bris nas mdzad byang gcig gis thus pa thog ma'i rtsom gzhir yod 'dug /rlung bcu sogs kyi gegs sel la nang gses kyi srog 'dzin nas rtsa dang ba spu'i tshogs thams —331 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()cad la rgyu ba'i bar gyi rlung bcu'i gegs sel sdom dang bcas pa/ gzugs brtan bsgom pa'i sbyor ba nas er po che'i bar gyi gegs sel/ lus mtha' dag na ba nas gsang rlung sems la rengs pa'i bar gyi gegs sel/ khyab byed rengs pa nas shes rab kyi ar snod bcud yul gyi stong pa mthong yul 'gags pa'i bar gyi gegs sel/ thur sel nas shin tu (231ba)rgyu ba'i bar rlung bcu'i gegs pod dmar na gsham du rlung zas sman gyis bsal ba dang grib gtor ba sna khrag gcod pa zhu'i 'brul 'khor rnams btags pa zhig 'dug /sel zhar byung zas dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bcos pa dang thig le 'chor ba bsrung ba'i zhal shes dang bcas pa rlung bcu'i 'phrin las so gnyis kyi zhal shes zhes pa lam 'bras 'khrul 'khor gyi zhal shes bdun par grags pa rnams/ gsum pa lam 'bring po gsal byed kyi yi ge la/ 'gor lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos thams cad bsdus na lnga ste zhes yod pa'i lam 'bring po'i zin bris che ba rje'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin bris pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'gor rje yi gsung ngag rin chen 'di zhes yod pa'i lam 'bring po'i zin bris chung ba bla ma'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin bris pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ bzhi pa gzhung shing gsal byed kyi yi ge la/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i gzhud shing gsal byed gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan gyis bla ma rin po che'i gsung bzhin dben glan mkhan du bris pa/gnyag gis mdzad ces pa'i gsal kha mi 'dug kyang dkar chag tu des mdzad par ngos bzung zhing nyan chen pa'i gsung min pa'i rgyu mas dang bcas snang ngo / /gsung ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gzhung 'khrid mkhyen rab dang thugs rje phun sum tshogs pa bla ma nyan po'i gsung dang bcas pa rnams/ dkar chag sa gcad kyis ma zin yang zhar byung du gsal ba la/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dbang phyug 'od zer gyi don du gtsang kha dgon par (zha)mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar gsum khug pa/ pod dmar na'ang yod/ aṣ+ṭa la brten nas gzhan gyi byad bzlog pa gar thod thod du mi bya gsung pa'i mtha' (232na lon/ go cha lnga'i bsrung ba sa skya'i lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i zab chos/ rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pa rnal 'byor dbang (dkar/phyug birlu ba'i man ngag rten 'brel gyi bsrung ba'i byin rlabs/ rmi lam dang nad dang dgra zhi ba btsal —332

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lo zhes snang yang deng sang dpe rgyun dang chos rgyun gnyis ka med 'dra/ lam skor lhag ma brgyad kyi chos tshan kha shas bgrangs 'dug pa ni phal cher glegs bam du bzhugs pa shas che/ de thams cad la nye bar mkho ba'i gnad drug ces pa bskyed rim/ pod dmar na lam 'bras kyi chos sder bgrangs 'dug /rlung / mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs/ phyag rgya ma/ phyag rgya chen po/ rten 'brel te drug ston pa/ lam skor byung tshul zhesapa'i yig chung lam dgu po bla ma bzhi la gsan gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lo rgyus bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i gsung sgros ji ltar ba bzhin rang gi slob ma'i ngor dkar ston chos 'od kyis dbri bsnan med par bris pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byin rlabs bla chen 'brog mi la rang gis thob pa ltar brjed byang du bris pa 'di ni yab yum dbang rdzogs thob par gdams te byin pa/ 'di 'brog mi'i dngos slob gcig gi yin tshul dkar chag na 'dug /bar ston gyi lam skor zin bris la/ mchod rten drung thob/ bsam mi khyab/ pad+ma badz+ra gyi lam/ lhan cig skyes grub/ gtum mo lam rdzogs rnams kyi zin bris chos tshan gcig tu bsdebs pa/ thog mar rtsom pa'i dus 'di rnams 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi 'gor bris yod 'dug /gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa nyams su len pa'i 'khrid/ mdzad byang na hrid dh+wa dza zhes rgya skad du bris 'dug /'gor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gdams (232ba)ngag 'di la zhes yod pa'i zin bris chen mo lta ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa lngas rgyu dus su gtan la phab ste lam dus su lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs nas 'bras bu lung bstan pa'i phyag rgyas 'tshams sbyar bas gnas 'gyur gyi sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan 'grub par byed pa 'o'i mtha' can/sgo drug chos 'brel zhes pa rje 'brog mis bla ma shan+ti pa la slob gnyer tshar nas mkhas pa gzhan lnga la'ang gzhung dang man ngag re gsan pa'i shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa'i phyi rol gyi gdon bsrung ba/dz+nyā na shrī'i 'byung 'khrugs sel ba/ rin chen rdo rje'i ting 'dzin sems kyi bar chad bsrung ba dang gsum (rje/chos sde gcig tu byas pa'i yi ge /pod dmar na'ang yod/ na ro pa'i phyag rgya chen po sdug bsngal gsum sel gyi gsal (|)byed rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa zhar byung bzhi pa man chad rlung dang —333

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mdzad pa'i a spyi'i bzlas lung bla ma'i phyag len mdzad pa bzhin bris pa 'o'i mtha' can/ phra tsho de 'di dang mi gcig pa 'dug /sa paṇa gyis (233bsgo dzad pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rnam par bshad phra mo na'ang yod/pa snying po don gsal/ bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa'i phyag len bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes pa 'phags pas mdzad pa/ phra mo na'ang yod/ dbang gi rab dbye rje btsun grags pa'i gsung bzhin yid btsun gyis brisapa/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis byi lo nag zla'i tshes bcu la/ sga ston rdo rje grags la springs yig /phra mor yang yod/ skyu ra'i dbon po dpon g.yog gis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas sa paṇa gyis bsam yas su mdzad pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal/ de'i kha skong shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa'i pags pa gser gyi sa gzhi pa/ 'gor dang po lag bkru lta bu ste zhes yod pa'i lus sbyong nyi shu'i gsal byed mdud 'grol zin bris nor bzang pas mdzad pa/ lus gnad la dbab pa'i gdams pa tshigs bcad ma sa paṇa gyi 'khas la spyi bos rab tu btud pa'i dpal ldan phug pa dmar gyis zin bris kun dang thun mong ma yin pa/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs brgyud pa ma nyams pa lag len gyi tho yig rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa/ phra mor 'dun pas gyis mdzad par ba/ 'gor shangs sgor waṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes yod pa'i 'khor lo bzhi brgya pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa thugs kyi nying khu lags so'i mtha' can/ dpal yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud las byung ba'i rang byin gyis brlab pa'i dmigs pa nyi shu (6)rtsa dgu pa zhar byung rlung gi rnal 'byor gtso bor bzhed pa bla ma'i zhal shes zhes pa'i gegs sel dang bcas pa/ rje sa skya pa chen pos lho brag dkar ston la gnang ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i bar gcod (234na tshe sum sel/ phra mo na'ang yod cing gsham na sna khrag gcod pa'i gdams pa de yang bris la dug /'gor rtsa dag par bya ba ni zhes yod pa'i bla ma sa chen gyi nyams chung ba bar pa dang mtha' ma la sogs pa 'o'i mtha' can/ phra mor yang yod/ 'gor spyir srog 'dzin pa snying gar rengs pa'i tshul bzhi zhes yod pa'i bla ma sa chen kyi nyams chen mo/ phra mor kun gzhi byin rlabs dang me mnyam gyi rlung rengs tshul sogs kyang chos 'a rtag tu 4ri/ mthar dri chen rdo lta bu skam po 'byung gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ khyad par gyi rlung —333—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rengs pa lnga 'chos pa sogs kyi thabs bla ma'i zhal la ltos pa khrag de nyid bskol te spod kyis sbran nas gtang ngo'i mtha' can/ phra mor thig le bsrung nga yan las mi 'dug /lho pa dkar ston gyis zhus pa'i gzhan la med pa'i gegs sel gsang bdun ma/ phra mor yang yod/ 'gor 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bskyed pa'i sa bon zhes yod pa'i gegs sel gling bzhi ma ri bong gi ril ma 'dra ba chu dang bcas nas stan thog tu byung bas sel 'o'i mtha' can/ phra mo na nyams 'a mo dang sbrel nas 'dug cing sgom chen rdo rje 'bar lus ma bde ba pos zhus pa'i gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ phra mor yang yod/ 'di khams pa lnga dang rje btsun sku mched gnyis la gnang zhing dzang gis rje btsun sku mched sbran pas dzang 'di nged la shin tu drin chen gsung ba mjug na snang / 'gong gzhan dbang rten 'brel zhes byas ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs(234bsal ston zhes yod pa'i gegs sel bzhi'i zhal shes 'di la goms nas mtshan sum cu so gnyis thob gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor dza lan+ta ra zhes yod pa'i 'phrin las (pa)so gnyis kyi sdom tshig zhal shes burnya shrīs mdzad pa/ de'i zhal shes 'gor lag gnyis bsnol ba zhes yod pa re mos rdeg gi mtha' can/ sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i dbang bzhi ngo sprod/ phra mo na'ang yod/ de'i 'grel pa/ 'gor rje btsun thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa zhes yod pa'i brda don gsal ba'i rtsa ba sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ phra mor yang yod/ de'i rang 'grel rtsom pa dam bcar/ rdo rje'i tshig 'byed brda don gsal ba 'di/ dbus gtsang mtshams su bla ma rje la gnang zhes yod pa/ de'i gsal byed lho pas gsung bzhin zin bris su mdzad dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)brgyangs byas te yo pa'i dmar gyis mdzad pa'i lam bsdus 'dod pa'i lcags kyu lam 'bring po bya ba yin gsung ba'i mtha' can/ phyag mdzad pa/ lam bsdus te sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ phra mor yang yod/ rje sachen gyis mdzad pa'i gsang bcu'i rgyas gdab nyam nga'i 'phrang la yid bzhin nor bu ltar gsang bcud ldan gnyis phra mo na'ang yod/de'i 'grel pa 'gor dpal ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa zhes yod pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa/ de'i gsal byed snyoms las pa burnya shrīs brjed byang du bris pa/ phra mor la lar bu shrīs mdzad zer ba mi 'thad tshul dang bcas snang ngo / /'gor rdo rje'i tshig rkang las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo zhes yod pa'i bir bsrung (235ba)su khru swā hā'i mtha' can/ phra mor 'phags pa'i yi ge'i gsal byed du bgrangs 'dug go /'gor dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug ces yod pa'i bir bsrung spyan sngar dpe 'di gtugs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor ra ga pa'i lam zab nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ des mdzad pa'i rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rtogs pa bskyed pa'i rim pa/ bir bsrung gi man ngag bar chad kun sel/ des mdzad pa'i birlu ba'i sku'i rnam —338

tshongs/sa paṇ+ḍita 'a po kun dga' rgyal ma' dpal bzang po/mahā paṇ+ḍita lha myu nan+da ṅgādza shrī bha draḥdage byed ces pa chu stag la sgo wo tshogs khang phur 'khrungs/'gro 238ba ) ba'i mgon po sgru/kun ldan lcags byi la ra sa mtshal khung du 'khrungs/grub 'a brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ma hāswādhashil ko0ga pu༄shrī/dbang phyug me mo glang la ra sa mtshal khung du 'brungs/thams cad mkhyen pa tishī laḥdapal gdong zhes pa chu bya'i lo 'bras khung sgang skyar 'khrungs/grub wo sangs rgyas dpal/ma hās sa gas shrī/myos lngan zhes pa sa yos la mdog gi phur tsongs/ngor 'a rdo rje lang kun dga' bzang po/mahā ngor badz+radha nan+da bha dra:rnga wo zhes pa chu pho khyi la sa skya'i byi khrung sgor tshongs/sems dpa' 'a po dkon cog tso mas/ma hās twarat+na'i dzaḥrnam byung zhes pa sa tsog la mud stod gling skyar tsongs/bdag 'a rdo rje 'chang blo gros sto ma' dpal bzang po/ma hā pa ti badz+ra dhar ma ti'i dza shrī bha draḥ mig dmar spyo pa shing byi la shab lcam mo g.yang grong du yangs/rje bas rdo ring pa 'a po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kun dga' rgyal ma' dpal bzang po/ bha snarwa ka ma hā shel di rgyus man+ta bha dra dharmasu ru dhi ma spro dz+nyā nas dz+nyāshrī bha 'a chos kyi sto po blo gas rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal ma' dpal bzang po/'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen bu'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal ma' dpal bzang po/mas239nago ṣa dz+nyā da ye shwa ra shā sa na hwa dza shrī bha dra:nyi sgrol byed ces pa shing sprel la bo dong du stings/mkha 'a bslab gsum yi ma'/ma ho pa yaXsko de byudha dzaḥmi zad pa zhes pa me khyi la ram sdings ma dang nye ba'i gnas log ri khrod kyi mdun ngos su 'khrungs/rdo rje chung dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i a mas dpal bzang po/badz+ra dha re shā ra:dra dha shus na ṅgādza shrī bha dra dus kyi pho nya zhes pa sa rta la nyug bkra shis shin tu rgyas pa ni bla ma dam pa nas rin cen sgang sgos kyi zhal ngo 'ba' zhig la brgyud pa'i khyad par can no//thun mong ba tshogs bshad tsam gyis brgyud pa ni brgyud pa baX rda'i bla chen kun rgyal ba nas/theg chen chos rje

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 7)kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ yab 'jam dbyangs chen po man gong ltar du brgyud pa dang / brgyud pa gsum pa lugs 'di la grags che zhing / gzhan yang brgyud pa'i rnam grangs chos rje bla ma nas/ ri khrod pa blo (240na)gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims man gong bzhin no/ /yang na brag phug pa nas/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ dpal tshul pa man 'dra/ yang tshogs bshad brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ dkar po brag pa/ ri khrod pa/ chos rje dpal tshul ba man 'dra/ yang na zhang ston pa nas/dga' ldan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ 'jam skya ba/ bla ma dpal seng pa man gong ltar/ yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang la/ 'bor lo sdom pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje bzhis gsan/ bzhi ga la bya 'gyur ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug bsod nams seng ge /de nas sgo rum pa man gong ltar/ yang na bya 'gyur bas gsan pa'i bla ma bzhi'i steng du kun mkhyen go bo ste lnga la/ yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ rim bzhin sa lo/ sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog 'phel nas/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ de gnyis la sa lo man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ rje sgo sum pa man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge nas/ paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ bdag chen 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen (240ba)la/ mus chen/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / kun mkhyen go bo gsum gas gsan/ gsum ga la yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang po man gong ltar/yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / slo bo mkhan chen legs 'byung sa lo/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang po man 'dra/ yang na ngag gi dbang pos glo bo mkhan chen rang la rdzogs par gsan no/ /yang —344

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nye brgyud ni/ brtse ba chen po mnga' ris gung thang du bzhugs skabs dug byung ba'i ro ma g.yas ru'i grong chu dgon par bzhugs dus langs pa'i skyon gyis chos rnams mnyel bas 'jam dbyangs phug tu sku mtshams bsdams te gsol ba btab pas/ zhang dgon pa ba mnal lam dang dngos du byon nas gdams pa rnams gsungs/ de rjes rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chos 'khor kyi phyag rgya can sa skya'i 'bam grog mon grogs gi bar skyil dkrung gcig gis khebs pa gtso 'khor lnga pa zhig zhal gzigs nas gsungs pas rnal 'byor dbang phyug nas rje btsun brtse ba chen po man gong bzhin no/ /de rnams ni gsung ngag gi brgyud pa'i rnam grangs yin la/ rgyud dbang gi brgyud pa'i rnam grangs la/ yang na dkar po brag pa rin cen seng ge nas/ chos rje gung thang pa seng ge dpal ldan/ rje 'od mdzes bzang po/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ rtsed dang dge 'phel ba bsod nams blo gros/ rje rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang na brag phug pa nas/ lam 'bras pa ye shes dpal/ sa skya pa rin chen dpal/ cho me rje paṇ+ḍita man 'dra/yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ 'di brgyud pa 'gangs che ba gcig tu 'dug /yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal (241na 〉 pa tshan/mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog /rtsed dang pa bsod nams blo gros man 'dra/ yang na chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims la/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / grub chen burnya shrīs gsan/ de gnyis la rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ de nas rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje yab sras bzhugs pa'i bar gong bzhin no/ /yang na rje btsun kun spangs chen po nas/ rje sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ tshar chen man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun grags pa nas/ gcung dpal chen 'od po/ sa paṇa/ zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa/ 'di gnyis kyi bar na bla ma zhig dgos nges su 'dug pa dam pa kun dga' grags yin min dpyad/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ tshogs sgom pa kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge /chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims grub chen bu d+dha shrī/ rje rdo rje 'chang / mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba —345

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smonabasod nams seng ge /zha lu mkhan chen dkon cog tshul khrims/ de gnyis la rje btsun sgo rum pa/tshar chen rdo rje 'chang / gnyis ka la thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/paṇ+ḍita rdo rje shes rab/ bla ma 'phags rgyal ba/ bla ma rin cen dpal bzang / 'gro mgon bsod nams (241ba)rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na zhang dkon cog dpal nas/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ rgyal ba brag phug pa man 'dra/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ bang mo zhu pa ga cho zhe nu dpal/bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na brag phug pa nas/ ri khrod pa blo brtan bla ma dpal tshul man 'dra/ yang na rje sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan/ bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen rdo rje tshul khrims/ bla ma dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ bu ston dbang phyug dar/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ sgo rum pa rin cen bzang po/ sgo rum pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa man gong ltar/ yang na brag phug pa bsod nams dpal nas/ brag phug pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ bu ston dbang phyug dar man 'dra/ yang na dkar po brag pa nas/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/grub chen burnya shrī man 'dra/ yang na dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nas/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyis dpal ba/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med rgyal mtshan dkon cog /rdzong chung pa byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang po man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na sgo rum pa chen po nas/ mnga' ris bla chen nam mkha' gzi brjid/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na sgo rum pa nas/ de dbon ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje/ rje mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun rdo ring pa nas/ rje grol mchog /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/yang na ngor chen nas/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ sbyang lung pa gzhen nu chos grub/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na sa bzang (242nasgo ti nas/ theg chen chos rgyal spyang lung gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan man 'dra/ yang na mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa nas/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos —346

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rje/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu chos grub/ rje grol mchog man gong ltar/ yang na mus chen la bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje shes rab rgya mtsho/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang / rgyal tshab kun dbang bzhi/ bzhi ga la 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub/ grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na 'jam dbyangs bsod lhun la/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen la/ gu ge paṇ+ḍita/ rje ri ti skyog pa/ rje dpal ldan pa/ rje nam dpal pa/ rje yon tan chos rgyal/ rje legs pa'i shes rab drug gis gsan/ drug ga la slo bo mkhan pos gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje/kun dga' mchog grub man 'dra/ yang na mus chen la/ go ram pa/ dkon cog 'phel/ sangs rin pa gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum la lha mchog seng ge /grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na mus chen nas/ zha lu pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang / chos rje byams pa chos legs/ 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis/rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ de la rin po che nor bu phun tshogs dang mkhas grub bshes gnyen bkra shis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la rdzong dkar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na mus chen nas/ grub chen dkon cog blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen/ chos rje bshes (242ba gnyen bkra shis man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po nas/ rin po che bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ spos khang tshogs pa mkhan chen thar pa rgyal mtshan/ zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na tshar chen nas/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ mkhan rin po che ngag dbang chos grags/'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa chen sgyupo/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na grol mchog nas/ kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho man 'dra/ yang na spos chen sems dpa' chen po nas/ yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dpal bzang / thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na dkon cog 'phel nas/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge /dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge /brang ti pa man gong bzhin no/ /yang na sangs rgyas seng ge nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen dang sems dpa' chen po gnyis la/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ kun dga' dbang phyug /dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge bzhis gsan/ mus chen man gyi bla ma lnga ga la rat+na warnyas gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na sems dpa' chen po la/ kun mkhyen go bo/ grub chen dkon cog blo gros/ rje dkon cog 'phel gsum gas gsan/ gsum ga la rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyis gsan/ dkon (243na jog lhun grub man gong ltar ro/ /yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ rje dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mkhan ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog rgya mtsho nas/ 'phyong rgyas 'phags sde mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang / ngag chos pa man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog rgya mtsho nas/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ kun mkhyen gangs pa grags pa dpal/ spang khang pa yang zer/ /ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen chos rje nyi lde ba gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po/ dpal ldan rdo rje man gong ltar/ yang na sa paṇa nas/grub thob yo' tan dpal/ la ru ba bsod nams seng ge /kun mkhyen gangs pa man gong bzhin/yang na bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims nas/ de dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang / gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po man 'dra/ yang na glo bo mkhan po bsod nams lhun grub nas/ rje dkon cog lhun grub man sngar ltar/ yang na 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen nas/ rje dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang nas/ yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ rje dkon cog lhun grub man gong bzhin no/ /yang na rje dkon cog 'phel/ sa lo man 'dra/ yang na glo bo mkhan chen legs 'byung nas/ sa lo man gong ltar/ yang na mkhas grub —348

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dpal ldan rdo rje nas/ mi nyag paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje/ sa lo man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/mkhas pa gzhen nu seng ge /de gnyis la lha 'bri ston pa shes rab rdo rje/ mi nyag paṇa (243ba)chen man gong bzhin/ yang na ngor chen dang mus chen gnyis la/ spyan snga kun dga' rdo rje dang / mkhas grub gung ru sher bzang gis gsan/ gnyis ka la mi nyag paṇa chen gyis gsan no/ /yang na gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po nas/ rje ngag dbang grags pa/ bdag chen rgya dkar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo man 'dra/ yang na 'jam dbyangs dkon cog bzang po nas/ bdag chen rgya dkar ba man sngar bzhin/yang na sangs rgyas seng ge dang / brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis la/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de dbon rje btsun shes rab 'byung gnas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba dang rdo rje 'chang zha lu mkhan chen gnyis gas gsan/gnyis gas bdag la'o/ /yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ de dbon dkon cog dpal ldan/ shar chen pa man 'dra/yang na sangs rgyas seng ge nas/ dkon cog dpal ldan/ shar chen pa man gong ltar/ yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ shar ba kun bkras pa man 'dra/ yang na thar rtse pa nas/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ dkon cog dpa la ldan/ rtse gdong khri chen man 'dra/ yang na bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug nas/ mkhan byams pa rab brtan/ rtse gdong khri chen man 'dra/ yang na shar pa kun dga' bkra shis nas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ yang na 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan nas/ zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod (244na joms mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /gong dkar ba lugs ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ 'di nas bla ma dam pa'i bar gyi brgyud pa rnams ngor pa dang mthun pa don gyis thob kyang 'dir rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig sor gnas bzhin bris pa yin/ paṇ+ḍita rdo rje shes rab/ bla ma 'phags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin cen —349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dpal bzang / bla mi dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos sgo ba/brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang po/ mkhas grub rnam rgyal rin cen/ yongs 'dzin shākya kun dga'/ bla ma dam chos gling pa ye shes dbang po/ bla ma nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na bla ma tshul khrims bkra shis nas/ zha lu mkhan chen khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ de bdag la'o/ /yang na rdo rje gdan pa nas/ 'jam dbyangs byang chub dbang rgyal/ yongasa'adzin shākya kun dga' man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje gdan pa la/ 'bri gung mkhan chen/ mkhas grub rig pa'i glog 'phreng / chos rje lcang lo can pa gsum gas gsan/ gsum ga la rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal gyisagasan pa man gong ltar/ yang na rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal la/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje dang 'phags mchog o rgyan rgyal pos gsan de gnyis la mtshungs med lha dbang 'phrin las/ nyi ma gling pa man 'dra/yang na shākya kun dga' nas/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma gling pa man gong ltar/yang na kun bzang rtse pa dang / nyi ma gling pa gnyis la/ kun bzang rtse pa paṇa chen (244bdapal ldan tshul khrims/ de la khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na bla ma ye shes dbang po nas/byams pa shākya rdo rje/ mtshungs med dge ba'i dbang po/ zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'phags pa nas/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ drung chos rje pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ gzad pa rin rgyan/ brag thog pa man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na nyan chen pa nas/chos rje spang khang pa/ mkhan chen lha dbang pa/ bla ma dpal ldan bsod nams/ gzad pa rin rgyan pa/brag thog pa man 'dra/ yang na brag phug pa nas/ chos rje ye shes dpal/ chos rje blo gros bzang po/mtshungs med chos rje seng ge dpal bzang / brag thog pa man 'dra/ a gi'i bzlas lung gi brgyud pa ngor lugs ni/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang yan lam 'bras ltar la/ de nas mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ mus—33()

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)chen sangs rgyas rin cen/ yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ de dbon dkon cog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /rdzong lugs ni/ bla ma dam pa yan gsung ngag ltar la/ de nas sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ mkhas grub bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rje rgyal mtshan dkon cog /mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje dkon cog dpal/ bla ma byams pa chos dpal 'byor/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ rje shākya kun dga'/paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje/ bla ma lha dbang 'phrin las/ rdo rje 'dzin pa tshul khrims bkra shis (245na)rdo rje 'chang mgon bo'i mtshan can/ des bdag la'o/ /gong dkar ba'i lugs ni/ 'phags pa yan lam 'bras ltar la/ de nas zhang dkon cog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos sgo ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ mkhas grub rig pa'i glog 'phreng / yangs pa can pa byang chub dbang rgyal man 'dra/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha bco lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa gsung ngag slob bshad kyi brgyud pa lugs gsum dang 'dra zhing / yang na rje btsun sa skya pa chen po nas/ ba tse sbal ston chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bla ma shes rab grags/ gnam pa rwa chos kyi shes rab/ mngan pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ de la 'phags pa rin po che dang paṇ+ḍita rdo rje shes rab kyis gsan/ de gnyis la zhang dkon cog dpal/ de nas brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ de la bla ma dam pa dang ri khrod pa blo brtan gyis gsan/ gnyis ka la dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de la shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan dang grub chen burnya shis gsan/ de gnyis la ngor chen gyis gsan pa man gsung ngag slob bshad dang 'dra/ yang na bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ rje btsun sgo rum pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man sngar ltar/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba bsod namasaseng ge /rje sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ rje dkon cog tshul khrims/ sgo —351 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rum pa kun dga' legs pa man gong bzhin no/ /yang (245bajo 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses grol mchog la gsan pa'i brgyud pa rgyud dbang skabs bgrangs pa dang gcig /yang na ngor chen nas/'khor lo sdom pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ yab sras gnyis ka la rgyal tshab kun dbang dang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges gsan/ de gnyis la 'dren mchog dkon cog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge /gnyis ka la dkon cog lhun grub/ rim bzhin sangs rgyas seng ge /de la thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na lha mchog seng ge nas/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge /thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na 'dren mchog nas/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen gnyis ka la sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub man gong lngar/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ sgang ston shes rab 'bum/ dkar po brag pa/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ grub chen burnya shrī man sngar bzhin no/ /yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas lung gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ zhang ston rje/ na bza' pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rdzong chung pa gzungs kyi dpal ba/ rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/rje rgyal mtshan dkon cog /rdzong chung pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje dkon cog dpal/ 'jam dbyangs chosadapal 'byor/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ mkhas pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ mtshungs med lha dbang 'phrin las/ mkhas grub tshul khrims bkra shis/ khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ (246na8sa bdag la'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du lam dus kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bka' babs lugs gsum gyi rgyud dbang gi brgyud pa ltar dang / thun mong ba bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug /rje grol mchog /thar rtse pa/ shar pas dkon cog dpal ldan par zhus pa rnams bzhugs pa'i rgyud dbang gi brgyud pa bzhin yin la/ rje btsun sgo rum pa nas brgyud pa ni/ zhad dkon cog dpal nas/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla chen kun dga' blo —352

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gros/ drung chos rje pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bu d+dha shrī/ngor chen/ mus chen/ bdag wo rin po che/sgo rum pa/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man gsung ngag ltar ro/ /yang rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la zha lu mkhan chen gyis gsan/ de la bdag gis nos so/ /yang na mus chen nas/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge /paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ 'jam da byangasang ga gi dbang phyug /bdag chen kun dga' bsam grub/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ gong dkar ba'i lugs ni/ 'phags pa yan rgyud dbang ltar la/ de na zhang dkon cog dpal/ na bza' pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa man yang rgyud dbang ltar ro/ /yang na zhang dkon cog dpal nas/ slob dpon kun dga' dpal/ lo mchog pa/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /drung chos rje pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man rgyud dbang dang 'dra/ yang na bla ma dpal ldan seng ge nas/ mkhan (246ba)chen shes rab rdo rje man 'gre/ yang na rgyal ba brag phug pa nas/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man 'dra/ lam dus kyi dbang 'bring bsdus kyi brgyud pa ni/'phags pa rin po che nas/ zhad ston khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa/ snga gas 'chang gzungs pa/ dge legasadapal bzang / rje ā nan+da pa/ byams pa chos kyi rin cen/ dbon brtson khrus rgya mtsho/ rje sangs rgyasamagon po/ bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas 'od zer/ mkhan chen nam mkha' dbang phyug /de gnyis ka la brtson 'grus 'od zer/ de nas rje sangs rgyas bkra shis/ mkhas grub byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang / khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'phags pa nas/ la ru ba bsod nams seṅge/ nyan chen pa/ gnyis ka la gangs khrod pa/ de nas ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen rin po che/ rdzong kha ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje dpal ldan chos skyong / byams pa chos kyi rin cen man 'dra/yang na gzungs pa nas/ bzang po rgyal mchan/ sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan dkon cog /byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgyud gsum smra ba shes rab rin cen/ rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan nas/ byams pa dkon cog dpal bzang / sgye chu ba mkhas grub shes rab —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 7)legs/ sgye chu ba paṇa chen bzang bkras/ byams pa yon tan lhun grub/ mkhan byams pa bzang po/dge steng pa dga' ldan grub chen kun dga' dpal bzang / nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i (247na)si rgyu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kha'u brag rdzong pa'i brgyud srol lugs gsum gyi brgyud pa dang po gnyis kho na dang / thun mong ba'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ rje dkon cog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla chen kun blo/ bla ma dam pa/ chos rje dpal tshul ba/ rje burnya shrī/ ngor chen/ rje dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po man kha'u brag rdzong pa'i brgyud pa lugs gsum gyis dang po gnyis sor gnas dang / yang na sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom pa kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen pa bsod nams brtan pa/ rgyal ba brag phug pa man gsung ngag slob bshad sor gnas/ thun mong ba'i brgyud pa chos rje bla ma dam pa nas/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ mkhas grub dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen burnya shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / kun spangs chen po/ rje sgo rum pa/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man sngar ltar/ yang na ngor chen nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba puṣ+yo sirnya/ sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na dpal ldan rdo rje nas/ mkhan chen dkon cog tshul khrims sgo rum pa man 'dra/yang na brag phug pa nas/ brag phug pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ bu ston dbang phyug dar/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ glang thang pa kun dga' rgyal (247bsgo tshan/ gra thang pa shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa/ rje sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / rje bsod nams lhun grub/ bdag chen 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang po/ rje mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na mus chen sems —354

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dpa' chen po nas/ go ram pa bsod nams seng ge /paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang po man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses rje grol mchog la gsan pa rgyud dbang skabs bgrangs pa dang gcig /rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i ling chu tse gab thar chags su ston pa'i byin rlabs dang 'khrid nyis chod kyi brgyud pa rdzong lugs ni/ 'phags pa yan spyi ltar la/ de nas zhang ston pa/brag phug pa/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ tshogs nyan gnyis/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ thugs sras bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med rgyal mtshan dkon cog /mus srad pa rtsang rus ming / byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje dkon cog dpal/ 'jam dbyangs chos dpal 'byor/ rje byang chub dbang rgyal/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje/ rje lha dbang 'phrin las/ rje tshul khrims bkra shis/ zha lu mkhan chen khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'jam dbyangs chos dpal 'byor nas/ byang chub dbang rgyal/ shākya kun dga'/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen bsod nams mchog ldan/ zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ yang na brag phug pa nas/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ bla ma dpal tshul ba/(248na〉pang na nyan chen pa/ dkar po brag pa/ bla ma dpal tshul ba/ thugs sras bzang po rgyal mtshan man sngar ltar/ gong dkar ba lugs ni/ bla ma dam pa nas/ gangs khrod pa/ de la sa bzang ma ti dang sa skya bu ston dbang phyug dar gyis zhus/ de gsum la theg chen rin po che/ brag thog pa/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal man gong bzhin no/ /bla ma rin 'byung gi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa kha'u pa'i bka' bab gsum ldan gyi brgyud pa dang po ltar dang / thun mong ba bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal/ rje btsun kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man sngar ltar ro/ lam zab nang ma'i 'khrid kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan nye brgyud ltar la/ tsho gos sgom pa/ nyan chen —353

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)pa/ brag phug pa/ de la bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang ri khrod pa blo brtan gnyis kyis gsan gnyis ka la dpal tshul ba/ burnya shrī/ rje rdo rje 'chang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rdo ring rin po che/ tshar pa rdo rje 'chang / thabs cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod namasadabang phyug /drin can bla ma khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen dang mus chen gnyis la/ 'jam dbyangs sher
