rgyam/ kun dga' dbang phyug /dpal ldan rdo rje/ bsod nams seng ge bzhis gsan/ bzhi ga la dkon cog 'phel/ de nas sa lo/ dkon cog (248ba 〉 lhun grub/ de la dkon cog rgya mtsho dang dkon cog dpal ldan gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la bdag chen bsod nams dbang po/ de nas khri chen kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na spyan snga dkon cog rgya mtsho la/ mus pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan khri chen kun bsod man 'dra/ bir bsrung phyi ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birnya pa/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje sa paṇa/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ ri khrod pa blo grosabartan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen burnya shrī/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang man gsung ngag slob bshad ji lta ba'o/ /yang thun mong ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun rdo ring pa nas/ rje sgo rum pa/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ de la bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge dang / chos rje dkon cog tshul khrims kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la rje sgo rum ba man 'dra/ gong dkar lugs kyi bir bsrung phyi ma'i brgyud pa ni rdo rje gdan pa bzhugs pa'i lam dbang dang gcig go /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ba nang ma'i byin rlabs rgyas par thob pa'i brgyud pa rdzong lugs ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yan gsung ngag ltar la/ rdzong chung pa gzungs kyi dpal ba/ rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rje rgyal mtshan dkon cog /byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje dkon cog dpal —336

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ba/ 'jam dbyangs chos dpal 'byor/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ bla ma shākya kun dga'/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal (249nasgo tshan/ nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na byang chub dbang rgyal nas/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ lha dbang 'phrin las/ nyi ma gling pa man 'dra/ yang na nyi ma gling pa nas/ zha lu khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na nyan chen pa nas dkar po brag pa rin cen seng ge /bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/bzang po rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ dpal tshul ba man 'dra/yang na bla ma dam pa/ dpal tshul ba man 'dra'o/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ba'i rim pa chu gtsang gi bsrung ba/ rdo rje gsum gyi bsrung ba/ phyag rgya'i bsrung ba/ sngags rgya'i bsrung ba/ mtheb srin sbyar ba'i bsrung ba/ phyogs mtshams kyi bsrung ba/ thabs shes kyi bsrung ba/ dri chu'i bsrung ba nas/lam bsrung / phug pa dgu bsrung thog bsrung rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni zha lu mkhan chen bzhugs pa'i bshad ma thag pa'i brgyud pa ltar ro/ /sngon chad yi ger ma 'khod pa'i bir bsrung gi cha lag shin tu zab pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa nas/ dkon cog dpal/ bsod nams dpal/ drung chos rje pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chosasgo ba/ brag thog pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya ston pa/ yangs can shākya kun dga'/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rje tshul khrims bkra shis/ paṇa chen dpal ldan tshul khrims/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na dbang phyug rgyal mtshan (249bajos/ bla ma paṇa chen pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'o/ /bla ma don grub la brten pa'i mtshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang /bdag med ma/ birnya pa/ ga rje pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ gnyis spangs zhabs/ gha ya dha ra/ 'byog mi lo chen/mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgye chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po —357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)che/ rje btsun rin po che/ dbang phyug 'od zer/ mkhan po rong pa/ lung phu ba nam mkha' bsod nams/bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub gzhen nu don 'grub/ zhang ston byang chub ye shes/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bu chu shrī/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/bdag r+ṣa rdo rje lang / rdo ring rin po che/ rdo rje 'cha sgo pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ mkhan chen bslab gsum pa/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rigs kun bdag po chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mkhan chen dkon cog tshul khrims/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun grags pa nas/ chos rje sa paṇa/lung phu ba nam mkha' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ yid dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros brtan pa man 'dra/brda don gsal ba'i byin rlabs ngor lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan nye brgyud ltar la/de nas lung phu ba nam mkha' bsod nams/ (250nasgo kras lung pa/ mkhas btsun gzhen nu grub/dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ de la bla ma dam pa dang / blo gros brtan pa gnyis gas gsan/gnyis ka la dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de nas burnya shrī/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ gnyis ka la rgyal tshab kun dbang / de nas dkon cog 'phel/ sa lo/ dkon cog lhun grub/ dkon cog rgya mtsho/ sangasargyas rgyal mtshan/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang nas/ go ram pa/ rje sangs rin/ salo man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa/ zhad brag phug pa man 'dra/yang rdzong lugs brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa nas/ sngags 'chang gzungs pa/ dge legs dpal bzang / ā nan+da pa/ byams pa chos rin/ brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas mgon po/ nam mkha' rgyal ma tshan/ sangs rgyas 'od zer/ nam mkha' dbang phyug /gnyis ka la brtson 'grus 'od —358

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)zer/ sangs rgyas bkra shis/ byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang / zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gzungs pa nas/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ gab chag pa/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ la ru ba/ nyan chen pa/ gnyis ka la gangs khrod pa/ de nas ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen pa/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dpal ldan chosaskyong / byams pa chos rin man 'dra/lam sbas bshad kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan nye brgyud ltar la/ de nas tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ gnyis ka la dpal (250ba)tshul ba/ burnya shrī/ ngor chen/ rgyal tshab pa/ dkon cog 'phel/ sa lo/ dkon cog lhun grub/ dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan man brda don gsal ba'i ngor lugs bzhin no/ /rdzong lugs kyi brgyud lugs ni brda don gsal ba'i rdzong lugs bla brgyud ltar ro/ /dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa yan gsung ngag ltar la/ de nas zhad ston khu dpon/ bla ma dam pa/ chos rje gzungs pa/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ sems dpa' rgyal mtshan dkon cog /rtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sgye chu ba byams pa dkon cog dpal bzang sgye chu ba shes rab legs pa/ sgye chu ba bzang po bkra shis/ sgye chu ba byams pa yon tan lhun grub/ sgye chu ba mkhan byams pa bzang po/ gong dkar dge steng pa kun dga' dpal bzang / rje nyi ma gling pa/khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rten 'brel byin rlabs kyi brgyud lugs/ rten 'brel byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun grags pa yan gsung ngag ltar la/ de nas dkar shākya grags/ rje kun bzang dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa —359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)man brda don gsal ba'i rdzong lugs kyi brgyud pa bzhin nam/ yang na dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa sor bzhag go /rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa/ brtse ba chen po/ slob dbon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇa/ skyo ston dri med/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/gan pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' (251nasgo zang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan/gnyis ka la rje mkhyen rab chos rje/ de nas spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ gsan yig na mi 'dug kyang byin rlabs sbyar byang gi brjod don ltar na chad 'dra snyam bris so/ /rje byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ bco brgyad pa mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ de dbon mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ mang thos 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rje btsun grags pa nas/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di mi 'dug pa brtag /gan pa rin rgyan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na skyo ston dri med nas/ skyo ston dar ma rin cen/ wom dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na dharma ye shes zhes 'dug pa brtag /bag ston ga tshe zhe nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen burnya shrī/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/brda tshig brgyud kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa yan gsung ngag bka' babs thog ma gnyis ltar la/ de nas ri khrod pa blo brtan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims man kyang gsung ngag bka' babs thog ma gnyis dang 'dra/ yang na rje btsun kun spangs chen po nas/ rje sgo rum pa/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi brgyud pa ni gsum ngag gi brgyud pa dang po gnyis ltar ram/ yang na kun spangs chen po nas/ mkhas grub kun dga' legs pa/ rje mkhyen brtse —360

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)man 'dra / yang (251bzhi sa paṇa nas/ tshogs nyan gnyis/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ dkar po brag pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ yang na rje bka' 'gyur ba nas/ mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o//yang na ngor chen dang mus chen gnyis ka la rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /de nas rje dkon cog 'phel/ sa lo/ rje dkon cog lhun grub/ spyan snga dkon cog rgya mtsho/ rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o/ /yang na kun dga' dbang phyug nas/ kun mkhyen go bo/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/sa lo man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa la/ gzungs pa dang dpal tshul ba gnyis gas gsan/ gnyis ka nas bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rgyal mtshan dkon cog /rtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ dkon cog dpal/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab legs pa/ paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis/ bla chen chos dpal/ byams pa yon tan lhun grub/ gling stod lha dbang 'phrin las/ nyi ma gling pa/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan nas/ dkon cog dpal/ chos dpal 'byor/ rgya ston byang dbang / shākya kun dga'/ ye shes dbang po/ rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma gling pa man 'dra/ yang na shākya kun dga' nas/ dpal 'byor gling pa/ nyi ma gling pa man 'dra/gsang bcu'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'ad dkon cog dpal yan gsung ngag bka' babs dang bo gnyis ltar la/ de nas dga' ldan pa kun (252na tha sod/ grub chen bsod nams dpal/ drung chos rje pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan man gsung ngag gi brgyud pa thog ma gnyis ltar ro/ /yang na rje btsun kun spangs chen po nas/ sgo rum pa/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba nas/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ de bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen dang mus chen gnyis la rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug gis gsan pa'i brgyud pa sgrub pa lung sbyin na yod pa bzhin no/ /lam 'bras kyi chos skyong mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa gsung ngag bka' babs dang po gnyis —361 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)ltar dang / thun mong ba kun spangs chen po nas/ sgo rum pa/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgo rum pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa man 'dra/ rtags yod pa'i lung rnams las ra'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mchod dpon drung pa dkon cog /rdo rje 44 dbang phyug rab brtan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /zur gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud sogs/zur gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan yan gsung ngag ltar la/ de nas zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /zha'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po'i mtshan can/ khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /dbang gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rtse'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/(252ba)thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang nas/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ lcags zam sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug /mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /tha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje dkon cog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / de dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /lce'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen mus chen/ mkhyen rab rin cen mchog grub/ stong ra ba shākya don grub/ stong ra ba kun dga' legs grub/ lum pa ba kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ dbon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ bco brgyad pa byams pa ngag dbang lhun —362

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)grub/ zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /su'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/'bri gung mkhan chen/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ yangs can shākya kun dga'/ bla ma rdo rje brag pa/rje tshul khrims bkra shis/ paṇa chen bsod nams mchog ldan/ zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /sa pha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ slob dpon bkra shis rnam rgyal/ rje gu ru chos dbang / bla ma o rgyan rgyal po/ gra thang mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal po/ rje nyi ma gling pa/zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /nya'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa nas/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ mkhas grub gzungs kyi dpal pa/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan (253na dkon cog /rdzong chung pa byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med dkon cog dpal/ rje chos dpal 'byor/ yangs pa can pa byang chub dbang rgyal/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje/ mang thos lha dbang 'phrin las/ mkhas mchog tshul khrims bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /mngon rtogs lan lag bzhi pa ma gtogs pa'i nyi'i rtags can gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa man 'dra/ a'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa nas/ 'jam skya pa/ a mo gha pa/ mkhan sher rdor ba/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ ku'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa nas/ cog ro ston gzhen/ chos brtson 'grus/ sangs rgyas rin cen/ shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ sbas don gsal ba'i brgyud lugs gcig la/ bla ma dam pa nas/ de la sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen dang / bu ston dbang phyug dar gyis zhus/ de gnyis la theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ rje rig pa'i slog 'phreng /mkhas pa byang chub dbang rgyal/ yangs can pa shākya kun dga'/ bla chen ye shes dbang po/ nyi ma gling pa man 'dra/ yang na theg chen pa nas/ mkhan chen dpal 'byor ba/ brag thog pa man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ burnya shrī/ ngor chen/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ dkon cog tshul —363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)khrims/ sgo rum pa/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man gsung ngag ltar ro/ /lam 'bras chos 'byung ngo mtshar snang ba'i brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ rje nyi ma gling pa nas/ 'jam mgon bsod (250na joms mchog ldan/ mkhan chen zha lu pa man 'dra/ yang na 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma des bdag la'o/ /mi'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ 'phags pa rin po che yan lam 'bras ltar la/ de nas shad dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ rje dge legs dpal bzang / chos rje ā nan pa/ rje byams pa chos kyi rin cen/ dbon chen brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ rje sangs rgyas mgon po/ rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'od zer/ mkhan chen nam mkha' dbang phyug /gnyis ka la thugs sras brtson 'grus 'od zer/ de nas mkhas grub sangs rgyas bkra shis/ rigs 'dzin byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang / la ru ba/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na 'phagasapa rin po che la/ tshogs sgom pa dang la ru ba bsod nams seng ge gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la nyan chen pa/ la ru ba dang nyan chen pa gnyis la kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa kun dga' dpal bzang /thar rtse ba'i gsan yig na spang khang pa grags pa dpal zer/ de nas ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rdzong chung pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa'ang zer/ bdag chen dpal ldan chos skyong / byams pa chos kyi rin cen man 'dra/ yang na gzungs kyi dpal ba nas/ mnyam med bzang po rgyal mtshan/sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan dkon cog /rdzong chung pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgyud gsum smra ba shes rab rin cen/ rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no/ /yang na nyan chen (254na)pa nas/dkar po brag pa rin cen seng ge /rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bzang po rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na na bza' pa nas/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ rje dpal tshul ba/ bzang po rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ sgrub kyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ brgyud pa 'di la pod dmar gyi mas bu la'ang lung rgyun yod/ ngor chen kun dga' —364

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan leg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bzang po yan gsung ngag dang 'dra ba la/ de nas mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ yab sras gnyis ka la 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / mkhas grub dpal rdor/ go ram bsod nams seng ge bzhis gsan/ mus chen sogs lnga ga la yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ de nasa'ajam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge /de la thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang dang mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la sgrub khang pa mtshungs med dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na kun mkhyen go bo nas/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ sa lo man 'dra/ yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang nas/ glo bo mkhan chen/ sa lo man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ dkon cog dpal ldan/ bdag chen bsod nams dbang po/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug /zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na dkon cog lhun grub nas/ spyan snga dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ brgyud lugs 'di la pod dmar gyi (254bgi chan bu la lung med/ bar gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ snang ston shes rab 'bum/ dkar po brag pa rin cen seng ge /bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bzang po rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ dkar gyi rtagasayod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun grags pa yan lam 'bras ltar la/ de nas dkar shākya grags/ slob dpon kun bzang dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ na bza' pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bzang po rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ dz+nyā'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇ+ḍita dz+nyā na shrī/ shesarab 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rin cen rdo rje/ de gsum ga la rje 'phrog mi/ gshen sgom se'o/ gyer sgom rog po/ bla ma gnyos/ yer pa sgom seng / grub thob lha 'bar/ kha rag dgon pa/ lung phu pa/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas pa gzhen nu grub/ 'ad ston byang chub shes rab/ bla ma dam pa/ sngags 'chang gzungs pa man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ dpal tshul ba/ burnya shrī/ ngor chen man 'dra/ nā'i rtags can —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen nā ro'i zhabs/ 'phrog mi lo chen/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgye chu ba/ rje sa chen/ rje btsun sku mched/ sa paṇa/ lung phu ba man gong ltar ro/ /wa'i rtags yod pa'i rgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇa grub ngag dbang grags pa/ 'brog mi lo chen/ 'khon dkon cog rgyal po/ bla ma shangs pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ lung phu ba man 'dra/ sha'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen shan+ti pa/ rje 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun sku mched gnyis/ sa paṇa/ lung phu ba man 'dra/ saṃ gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birlu pa (255na/ḍom+bhi he ru ka /a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ lo chen 'brog mi/ se ston/ zhang ston/ rje btsun yab sras gsum/chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ shad ston khu dpon gnyis/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ de gnyis la dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de nas bzhi shrī/ ngor chen man 'dra/ ṇa'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa nas/ tshogasanyan gnyis/ brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis dpal tshul ba/ bzang po rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na dpal ldan tshul khrims nas/ burnya shrī/ ngor chen man 'dra/ pa'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen brgyud par bzhugs pa'i bshad ma thag pa ltar ram/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ dkar po brag pa/dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bzhi shrī man 'dra/ pa'i rtags can zhabrul 'khor so gnyis pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ nyan chen pa nas/ gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan 'bum/ bla ma dam pa/dpal tshul ba/ bud+dhā shrī man gong bzhin no/ /gu'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ sbas don gsal ba'i brgyud pa zur pa theg chen pa bzhugs pa dang gcig /bi'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun birnya pa/ rnal 'byor pa/ dza don badz+ra/ burnya shrī/ ngor chen man 'dra/ stong gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhyen rab rje/ stong rab khu dbon/ kun dga' chos grags/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rje ngag dbang lhun grub/ sdom brtson 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /sto'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje dkon cog lhun grub/ shar khang —366

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa sher rgyan (255ba)thar rtse paṇa chen/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ drin can zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /waṃ gyi rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ rje dpal don pa/ thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sa'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa yan gsung ngag brgyud pa dang po ltar la/ de nas zha lu pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang / paṇa chen nyi zla seng ge /grub chen nam mkha' shes rab/ rje zhe dgon pa bsod nams rtse mo/ mtshungs med rin cen chos 'phel/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /klu'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man gong bzhin no/ /brang gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhad dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin pa/ chos rje byang seng pa/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ shar khang shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / shar pa byams pa (256na sko/na dga' bkra shis/ thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /e'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ 'phags pa nas/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang yan gong ltar la/ de nas e waṃ dpal ldan don grub/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas man yang 'dra/ yang brang dang e'i rtags yod pa gnyis ga'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'phags pa nas/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog 'phel nas/ lha mchog seng ge /—367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ shi'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/chos rje sa paṇa/ zhad mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /mkhan sher rdor ba/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ lung rig rgya mtsho/ mkhar chen seng ge dpal bzang / brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ 'bri gung mkhan chen/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ sngags 'chang tshe dbang bkra shis/ bla ma rnam rgyal bkra shis/ thu btsun kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rab 'byams chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /pu'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa/ 'jam skya ba/ a mo gha/ mkhan sher rdor ba/bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ cog gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa nas/ cog ro ston gzhen/chos (256ba'i rtson 'grus/ sangs rgyas rin cen/ shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ ngag gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags man klu'i rtags yod pa dang gcig /khri'i rtags yod pa'i lung ni lam zab nang ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa sor bzhag go /ā'i rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /paṇa grub brgyad kyis mdzad pa lam skor brgyad dang chos kyi rnam grangs dgu yod pas lam skor dgur yang grags pa bla chen 'brog mi la bka' babs pa'i chos skor la/ dpal ldan tog tse pas sa myu ṭi la brten nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gdams pa mdzad/ de nyams su len pa la bsam mi khyab lnga'am byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rta mchog zhabs/ mda' 'a zer/ bi na pā da/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar 'dug kyang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na bi na pa ti dang thar rtse ba'i der zhin zhes pi waṃ 'dzin pa yin zhes snang ngo /rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti/ 7gle pā da/ mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na zur chag 'di bsto 'dug rdo rje gdan pa'i der la k+ṇi dang thar rtse pa'i der phun tshogs zhabs zhes bsgyur 'dug go /—368

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)yang na 'phags pa nas/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ yang nyan chen pa nas/ gangs pa/ mkhas grub 'phags pa/ bla ma dam pa/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ grub thob yon tan dpal/ la ru bsod nams seng ge /gangs pa/ bla ma dam pa/ de la sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen dang saskya bu ston dbang phyug dar gyis gsan/ yang na brag phug pa la/ brag phug pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan/de la sa skya bu ston pas gsan/ sa bzang pa dang sa skya bu ston gnyis ka la theg chen kun dga' bkra shis/ de nas brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ 'bri khung mkhan chen/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ rje tshe dbang kun mkhyen/ bla chen ye shes dbang po/ gser gling pa shākya bsam grub yongs 'dzin tshul khrims bkra shis/rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o/ /yang na rje tshul khrims bkra shis dang rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gnyis ka la zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud dang brtag pa gnyis pa'i dgongs pa dang rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i gsung la brten nas yan lag /(258na ngo dun pa dang bzhi pa snang bar byed pa la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mdzad pa'i lam nyams su sa he ru ga'i bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'od kyi snying po nyams su len pa'i ched du'ang yin/ len pa la phyag rgya chen po'i yi ge med pa'i gdams pa las byung ba'i byin rlabs dang de'i gsal byed rje btsun chen po grags pas dge slong blo gros brtan pa'i don du mdzad pa nos pa las byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇa grub ngag gi dbang phyug grags ka pa/ de wā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ thar rtse ba'i gsan yig na 'dis gong ma gnyis ka la gsan zer spu 'dug /bla chen 'brog mi nas sa paṇa yan gong ltar la/ de nas 'phags pa/ yid ston khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa/sngags 'chang gzungs dpal/ mnyam med bzang po rgyal mtshan/ sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan dkon cog /mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje dkon cog dpal/ mtshungs med chos dpal 'byor/—370

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rgya bzhi rdzogs kyi lam 'gor lhas byin gyis ni (259na kho byas la zhes pa dang lo rgyus dang bcas pa bstan zin to'i mtha' can rgya gzhung ma'i brgyud pa ni/ dang po dpal sde'i zhal lnga nas/ /de bzhin du yang tshangs pa dang / /bram ze mo ni rdo rje grub/ khyu badz+ra rdo rje rgyal/ /de yi slob dpon de'i phyi ma/ /gos bral zhal snga de bzhin no/ /dpal ldan dz+nyā na bo dhi rgyal/ /de bzhin shrī yo bo dhi dang / /slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra dang / /ḍom+bhi zhal snga de bzhin no/ /yan lag bar pa dpal lha mo/ /bung ba'i pad+ma de bzhin no/ /dur khrod du ni gī lar bzhugs/ /lha lcam lags min de bzhin no/ /bdag kyang dang po grub pa yin/ zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje 'chang / dpal bde ba chen po/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gas yig na 'di ltar 'dug kyang rdo rje gdan pa dang thar rtse pa'i der 'di gsham du in+d+ra bhū ti 'dug pas tshags bcad ltar na dpal bde bar in+d+ra bhū ti che ba gnyis gcig pa 'dra/ bh+ra ma pā da/ gsan yig gzhan gnyis na tshangs pa'i zhabs zhes bsgyur 'dug /bram ze mo sdo/ba pa'i rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa/ slob dpon u pa ma'i zhabs/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig u pa la zer ba 'dug pa dpyad/ ni 5kyi t+ta pā da/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na slob dpon gong bral zhabs zhes 'dug pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig rgya skad ma dang mthun na'ang thar rtse pa'i der gcer bu'i mtshan dang bcas gos bral du bshad 'dug pa dpyad/ rgyal po dz+nyā bhū ti/ shrī yo bhū ti/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ ḍom+bhi hi ru da a na6an+ta lha/ rdo rje gdan pa dang thar rtse pa'i der yan lag bar ma'i zhabs zhes bsgyur/ lha mo bung ba'i pad+ma/ lcam la:/ thar rtse pa'i der legs smin zhes zur chag 'dug go/rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba/ bram zer t+na badz+ra/ kha che shes rab gsang ba'am ā tsarla dmar por grags pa/ 'phrog mi lo tsā ba man (259bskor dra/ nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ lcam legs smin/ paṇa chen shes rab gsang ba man 'dra/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis rdo rje gur la brten nas sgrub thabs mtsho skyes mdzad pa'i don nyams su len pa la zab mo'i tshul dgu'i lam gyi gsal byed sbal ston dar ma 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa'i ngor rje btsun chen po grags pas mdzad pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rje mdzad pa'i dpal kye rdo rje mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i man ngag rgya gzhung gha ya dha ra dang 'brog mi'i 'gyur gnyis thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / grub chen bi lha spya badz+ra/ a na bla badz+ra/ rdo rje gdan pa dang thar rtse ba'i der yan lag med pa'i rdo —372

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rjer bsgyur/ pad+ma badz+ra/ de gnyis na mtsho skyes rdo rjer bsgyur/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam la ā+oṃ ka ra/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ rje gha ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra/ rdo rje gdan pa'i der rgya gar du dpa' bo rdo rjer yang gas zhesasnang / slob dpon ḍom+bhi he ru gas brtag gnyis la brten nas lhan cig skyes grub mdzad/ de nyams su len pa la lhan cig skyes pa gsum gyi lam nyams len dbu na de la ḍom+bhi he ru gas zhes dang zhag gsum de gnyis kyi bar nas gang tsam la sgom/ gzhan yang shes par bya 'o'i mtha' can gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen ḍom+bhi he ru ka /a la la badz+ra/ bā na si pa/ thar rtse pa'i der nags khrod par bsgyur/ gar+bha ri pa/ pe pa/ thar rtse pa'i der bsod snyoms par bsgyur/ du rga tsan+d+ra/ thar rtse pa'i der mi thub zla bar bsgyur/ dge slong prañdza in+d+ra ru tse/ rdo rje gdan pa'i der bī ra badz+ra dang thar rtse pa'i de dpa' bo rdo rje zhes 'dug par dpyad/ 'brog mi man 'dra/ rdo rje gdan pa'i der bod du yang shes rab gsang bar gsan zer ba 'dug /rje btsun sa (260na〉〉 pa yab sras la rnal 'byor bla na med pa dang rjes su 'brel pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu bzhugs pa'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa sa skya'i lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum du grags pa'i nang nas mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhor la 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum las/ ji skad du/ rnal 'byor mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye ba'i lam/ /sdig can thar par bgrod pa'i gsang lam mchog /nā ro ta pa'i chig brgyud snying gi gtam/ /sa skya'i bla chen bsgyur pa'i gser chos 'di/ /snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang / /kun spangs chos rje'i zhal las thos gyur nas/ /zhes pa ltar grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun nā ro ta pa la/ gnyis skyes mchog gnyis sogs slob ma'i gtso bo paṇ+ḍi ta bcu gnyis tsam dang / mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros sogs bod yul gyi slob ma dka' spyad can rnams la ming tsam yang ma gsungs par bal po pham thing pa 'jigs med grags pa dang ngag dbang grags pa mched kho nar gnang ba'i rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod mar grags pa'i gdams pa zab mo/ gang zag rab bde dgyes gang rung gi smin byed sngon du song nas / ra'i byin rlabs nos/ bzlas sgom chag med dang gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pa tsam gyis g.yin la ma —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonaltos par tshegs chung ngus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i gzugs kyis lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'khrid pa/ 'bring la ma ka li ya'i shing la brten nas sis ra'i sgrub pas bud med phal pa'i khrod nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ngos zin te des tshe 'dir dngos su mkha' spyod du 'khrid/ tha ma'ang 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku las bar (260ba)dor langs pa'i dus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mkha' spyod du 'khrid par nges pa'i zab pa las kyang ches zab pa snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi dang ldan pa'i skor la/ tshogs slob gnyis su grags pa'i nang nas ches cher zab pa gsang chen slob bshad pa'i lugs bzhin nos pa la/ si/ ra'i dkyil 'khor du bsgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga tshar chen kyis mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam gyi yi ge'i steng nas sin dhu ra'i byin rlabs dang / rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid kyi chos nyid mngon sum du ston pa de kho na nyid brda rtos)chos kyi byin rlabs kyis smin par byas nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig chen mo mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam la gzhi mdzad/ gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum zhes pa'i dngos bstan dang shugs bstan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes yig chung gis legs par brgyan/ de yang gang zag dbang po rtul ba rnams la sems 'dzin gyi dmigs pa kho nas don 'grub na'ang / blos 'chun pa rnams la bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa bskyed rim rnam bshad dang / bcad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi rim pa gtong lugs sogs kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa ma nor ba ltar sngon 'gro'i 'khrid thun mong ma yin pa bzhi/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi bskyed rim sems 'dzin zhan byung rdzogs rim dang bcas pa/ dngos gzhi'i rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ bde ba dang 'ja' lus sgrub pa/ 'pho ba/ nang gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa sogs cha lag tshang pa'i nyams 'khrid/ thams cad (261na〉pa khyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi zin bris chen mo la brten nas mthun rkyen tshogs gsog dang 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i sngon 'gro/ bskyed rim bsdus pa ngo sprad pa'i sbyang ba/ bdag byin rlabs/ dbu ma kha 'byed pa dang —374

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gsum gyi dmigs rim rje btsun yab dang thun mong ba'i rtsa dbu ma che ba'i nyams (2 ) 'khrid shin tu rgyas pa/ 'di ni gsol 'debs pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston du/ lte ba'i pad mor rlung lnga'i ti la ka /rtse gcig bsgoms pas kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis/ /lus sems rtsa la dri bar+sha ne zhugs pa yi/ /bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par shog /ces sa bon tsam bstan cing rje btsun rin po che'i man ngag rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa'i khyad chos nā ro ta pa'i snyan brgyud slob bshad 'dzin pa rnams kyi thugs kyi nying khu'o/ /'khon ston bsod nams dbang phyug gi gsung (jig de rgyun gyi yi ger brten nas yab dang thun mong ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i rlung sbyang ba'i dmigs rim dang yum rkyang gi spyi bo'i yig 'bru lnga la brten nas rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa'i 'khrid dang bcas pa nyams su legs par bstar nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ rtsa ba rgya gzhung / gdams skor/ sgrub thabs/ rnam bshad/ byin rlabs/ kha skong gi yi ge /'khrid yig dang bdun/ dang po ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs gong ma'i mchan bu dang bcas pa 'di snying po lta bu med du mi rung ba yin no/ /slob dpon nā ro ta pas mdzad pa rgya gar (6)gyi mkhan po su ma ti dang dge slong pra dz+nyā kirtis bsgyur pa/ gnyis pa gdams skor la/ bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ thun mong gi dngos grub (261ba gnod sbyin mo dbang du byed pa/ lam gyi yan lag dang bzhi/ dang po la byin rlabs bsdus don na rjes gnang zer mthug na mkha' spyod sgrub tshul kyang cung zad yod/ kyi yi ge bu (5da)mo gar+shan nu ma la ston mo bya ba dam tshig go'i mtha' can/ don 'grel bskyed rim dngos/( )rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs la don bcu gcig gis nges par bya ba de ltar don bcu gcig go'i mtha' can/spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor las 'phros nas phyi mchod mdor bsdus rtog)byed tshul byang chub sems dpas ba11la ba ce('i mtha' can/ 'di'i zhan byung byin rlabs shig yod kyang phyag len du mi mdzad ces brag phug pa gsung /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i cha bzlas sgom gnyis la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub (pha)pa bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rtong)/ mngor bsdus pa rjes ma —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mngon par bya 'o'i mtha' can/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa (5)yi dam du byed tshul nyes pa thams cad 'dag par gsungs pa'i mtha' can/ rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg rgyas ( )pa bdag nyid la bsdu 'o'i mtha' can/ mar me'i sbyin sreg (5)g.yin la phan pa'i blos yi ger bkod pa'i mtha' can rnams/gnyis pa rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i zhal shes su kha 'phangs/ gsum pa thun mong gi dngos grub gnod sbyin mo dbang du byed pa la gnod sbyin mo'i rtog pa las tshangs pa'i bu mo 'gugs rtog)pa man ngag tu byas pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'di la brgyud kyi dum bu'ang zer/ gnod sbyin mo pad+ma ti'i sgrub thabs ( )yid du 'ong ba pad+ma'i man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i zhal shes (༅)yid du 'ong ba'i gnod sbyin ma sgrub pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'di brag phug pa'i (262na kha rdzas don na mi gsal bgong gi khongasasugs pa'i dbang du bto ba 'dra/ 'khol po pa ta na'i sgrub thabs ( )zhes brjod do'i mtha' can rnams/bzhi pa lam gyi yan lag la/ pra sen dbab (5ka)pa gdams ngag go'i mtha' can/ sman chen po'i bcud len (6)thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag go'i mtha' can rnams bla ma sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ sa chen gyi yi ge de rnams kyi bsdus don brag phug pa'i gsung sgros sa gcad bzhir mdzad pa cung zad kyang snang ngo'i mtha' can rnams/gsum pa sgrub thabs la/ brgyud 'debs rgyas pa bsod nams ye shes (d+ma ri73)ma ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i bsdus pa (d+ma da(3)rdo rje 'chang chen ma/ tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gis stod lung spa ra rdzong du mdzad pa'i brgyud 'der (rdo rje)mchog gi pad+mo bzhad pa'i dga' ston nam rgyal ba rgya mtsho mar grags pa/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' la spyod pa'i sgyub thabs 'phags pa rin po ches sa sprul gdu bu'i zla ba la shangs mdor mdzad pa/ des me byi zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la mdzad pa'i dpal nā ro ta pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbu na bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo yod pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs (e)rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa dam tshig pa rang la bsdu 'o'i —376

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ma/tha' can/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs (rdo rje de rgyun du nyams su blang ba'i ngag 'don gyi tshul tshar chen gyi gsung rgyun nyams len mthar thug 3'a mtha' can/ de dang 'dra min (e)'gor nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i (262ba)sems can zhes yod pa nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o'i mtha' can/ bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang pos mdzad pa'i rgyun gyi nyams (lcags)len mdor bsdus pa bsnyel byang du bkod pa rnams/bzhi pa rnam bshad la/ bde mchog rgyud kyi dgongs pa nā ro ta pa'i man ngag gis bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod du bkral pa'i sgrub thabs kyi don rje sa chen gyis rnal 'byor bcu gcig tu bsdus nas (e)bstan pa'i rnam bshad rje nyi zla seng ges mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam bshad (d+ma da(3)rje btsun byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa/lnga pa byin rlabs la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa blang ba'i cho ga 'phags pa rin po ches lcags rta zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco brgyad la shangs mdor mdzad pa/ 'gor ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lus pa'i zhes yod pa'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge rje sangs rgyas (e/8)dpal bzang gis mdzad pa byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi mtha' can/ byin rlabs (e)gyi cho ga rdo rje 'chang chen po ā nan+da bha dra'i gsung las ji ltar zin pa tsam zhig pradz+nyā bha dras brjed byang du bris pa/ mkhas grub gung sa ༷ ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga (rdo rje/mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma'i de kho na nyid dngos su ston pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ltas)(gi rje/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsung yar klungs pas zin bris su btab pa ltar rje sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa rnams/drug pa kha skong (263na)la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga go go can gyis bskul nas 'phags pas lcags rta gdu bu'i zla ba la shangs mdor mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sbyin sreg gi cho ga go go can gyis bskul nas 'phags pas sa sprul dbyar 'bring shangs mdor mdzad pa/ 'gor rje btsun dam pa mi bskyod rdo rje zhes yod pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga (e)mus chen gyi gsung bzhin chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ rdzong chung pa lugs kyi chos skor sngags 'chang gzungs pas phyogs gcig ( 'i bu rme)tu bsgrigs pa'i man ngag gter mdzod du grags pa la/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len la brten nas bsnyen pas mnyes par bya ba/ zhar byung gtor ma'i cho ga /gzhan don slob ma la phan gdags pa/ tshogs mchod dang bcas pa/ slob ma rjes gzung byin rlabs kyi yi ge /zhan byung si rgyu ra'i sgrub pa/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /mar me'i sbyin sreg /za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg /khrus chog /'khor lo'i man ngag /tshes bcu'i cho ga dang bcas pa rnams/ bdun pa 'khrid yig la/ dngos dang khyad par can rtsa dbu ma che ba'i 'khrid gnyis/ dang po la rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi phyag chen gces bsdus nas 'khor lo sdom pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan gyis (e)bris pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid yig 'gor bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo zab yangs rgyud rgyal gsang mtha'i don zhes yod pa/ rgyud sde drug pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i yang bcud dpal mo mkha' spyod dga' ma'i nye lam rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos kyi nying khu he ru ka dpal tshar pa chos rje'i gsung bzhin (263ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses zin bris su mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig (rdo rje/mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam/ 'di rmi deng sang rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi steng du rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid tsam bsnan nas nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'khrid yin no zhes skad gsangs mthon por sgrog pa rnams dang ye mi 'dra pa'i nā ro pa'i gsang chen slob bshad kyi gnad 'gag thams cad tshang ba yin pas 'khrid kyi mjug tu/ grangs med pho nya'i gtso mo kun 'dar ma/ /zag med bde chen mchog gis mchod byas nas/ /brjod med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i nye lam 'di/ /'khrul med bla ma'i gsung gi nying khu yin/ zhes rang bzo dang 'khrul pa'i dri ma phra mo tsam dang yang bral ba yin la/ 'phral gyi tshig bshad tsam ma yin par lam 'di la brten nas/ grub pa'i rigs 'dzin gyi sa chen po brnyes pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i 378

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rnam thar la brten nas tshar chen gyi rtogs brjod du/ dpal mkha' spyod kyi dga' ma yid 'ongs ma/ /dus ring nas bskyangs pa'i ma ma des/ /da rigs 'dzin gyi grub pa ster ba'i brda/ /yongs ngo mtshar gyi zlos gar ci yang brtsen/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don snying dbus kyi dpal be'ur bcang pa'i 'os so/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa dang nyams len gyi 'khrig rim yongs grags dang cung zad mi mthun par slob bshad pa'i bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa (sgyur dbang5ni rje/go rim 'khrul med du rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis bkod pa yun ring du gnas par gyur cig gi mtha' can/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung rgyun rnal 'byor bcu gcig nang bskyed rim lus dkyil sgom tshul rdzogs (264na'am shin tu zab pa bsam mi khyab kyi zhal shes dang bcas pa mkhas (ga nges rdo rje/grub ngag dbang chos grags kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i dngos grub myur mgyogs kyi pho nya/ 'khrid kyi skabs gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum gyi dang po thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yig ( rdo rje/chung dang gnyis pa bla ma bstim pa'i zhal gdams rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung snying gi dbus su gces par bzung gi mtha' can/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lus dkyil snyan brgyud (rdo rje/tshar chen gyi gsung snying ltar gces pa dam du sba bar mdzod kyi mtha' can/ phyag rgya chen po dbu mar 'jug pa'i yig rnying zhugs pa'o'i mtha' can/ zhal shes gsum pa tshar chen gyi gsung thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i rgyun gyi nyams (rdo rje)len gsang chen bcud kyi thig le snying dbus pad+mo bzhad par gyur cig gi mtha' can/mkha' spyod ma'i zhal shes dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs kyi yig chung gong ma'i man ngag gnyis po 'di bla ma'i gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ yang dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs/ mkha' spyod sgrub pa/ 'pho ba'i skabs sgo dgag pa gsum gyi zhal shes yig chung rgyud las gsal bar 'byung ngo'i mtha' can/ he ru ka yab yum zhal sbyor dang yum rkyang la brten pa'i 'pho ba gser chos lo tsā ba'i man ngag sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ de'i gsal byed yab dang thun mong ba dang yum dang thun mong min pa'i nyams len (rdo rje/tshar ba rdo —379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun dbyings rig bsre bo'i mtha' can/ 'pho ba 'di gnyis dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nyams len gnyis dus gcig la slob ma gcig (264ba tshe pas mi ston zhing zhu ba'i tshe gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas dgos pa deng sang gi bar du phyag len 'chug med du yod pas gser chos tshig brgyud zab chos su ming btags bzhin du khrom chos su 'chad pa rnams dang ye mi 'dra'o/ /thun mong gi rjes 'brang rnams la ming tsam yang ma grags pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i gser chos chig brgyud (rdo rje)ma shin tu zab pa tshar ba rdo rje 'chang gis 'phan yul au ḍi yā ṇa'i gzhis kur mdzad pa/ 'di'i nyams len la brten nas sa skya pa'i sngas 'chang mang po lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon pa'i lo rgyud ngo mtshar ba mtha' klas snang ngo / /tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod zhal bzang lta rdo rje/blta ba'i smon lam rnams/ gnyis pa khyad par can rtsa dbu ma che ba'i 'khrid la/ rje btsun chen pos mdo khams g.yer mo thang gi ston pa gzhen nu'i don du (ke)mdzad pa'i nā ro ta pa'i thugs kyi nying khu rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid kyi gsal byed zhar byung de kho na nyid dngos su ston pa'i byin rlabs kyi lag len bstan pa bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal (༷ga go yordo rje)mtshan gyi gsung sgros rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su gtab pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rje (rgyal)btsun yab dang thun mong ba'i rtsa dbu ma che ba'i 'khrid yig /yab dang thun mong ba'i rlung dbu mar bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang rje btsun yum rkyang gi rlung sems dbu mar bsdu tshul gyi dmigs rim (sad/rdo rje)'jam mgon sa skya pa ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gi gsung rgyun zin bris/ yum bka' la brten pa'i rlung dbu mar (265na tshod pa'i nyams len thun mong ma yin (lcags)pa ngag dbang nyi zla bzang pos lha rigs rgyal mo'i thugs dam du mdzad pa rnams legs par thob pa las yi ge'i rtags med pa'i byin rlabs 'khrid lung rdo rje dang g.yung drung khe rkyang gis mtshan pa dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen rdo rje dril bu pa/—380

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lho gi pa/ ༷ ra pa/ ti slo pa/ grub chen nā ro pa/ pham thing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung ngag dbang grags pa/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ sa skya pa chen po/slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang ston dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog /bdag chen 'jam dbyangs chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rigs kun khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang zhal shes gsum sogs dor pa'i byin rlabs bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams 'khrid/ rdo rje/ gī/rgyal/ 'bum/ lcags te rtags lnga po med pa'i lung yongs rdzogs bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ (265ba)chos rje bla ma dam pa nas/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ 'khor lo sdom pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ ngor chen tshar chen gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs dang / rje mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse nas/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang yab bka' yum bka'i 'pho ba ma gtogs pa'i ༷ ra'i byin rlabs bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams 'khrid lugs gnyis dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan dang / rje mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gnyis ka la/ zha lu mkhan chen khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /si rgyu ra'i byin rlabs dang / de'i yi ge tshar chen gyi mdzad pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig la rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog —381

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang byin rlabs ni/ rje mgon po'i mtshan can nas/ zha lu mkhan chen/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na tshar chen nas/ bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen thar pa rgyal mtshan/ zha lu mkhan chen/ des bdag la'o/ /yang byin rlabs dang bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams 'khrid ngor lugs nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ rje sangs rgyas dpal/ sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na dpal tshul ba nas/ burnya shrī/ ngor chen man 'dra/ yang sis ra'i byin rlabs dang g.yung drung dang sgo'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ brag phug pa la/ bla ma dam pa dang chos rje blo (266na)gros brtan pas gsan/ de gnyis la chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de nas ngor chen/ mus chen/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / kun spangs rje/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na dpal tshul ba nas/ shar chen pa/ ngor chen man 'dra/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i yi ge rnams kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ brag phug pa nas/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge /shar chen/ ngor chen/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mkhan chen rat+na shī la/ sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ngor chen la/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / rje bsod nams dbang phyug /gung ru shes rab bzang po/ mkhyen rab rje bzhis gsan/ bzhi ga la kun spangs rjes gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen la/ mus chen dang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng gis gsan/ gnyis ka la rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ glo bo mkhan po/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mkhan chen rat+na shī la/ sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen nas/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse gnyis ka la bslab gsum rje/ rta ra ba/ byang gling rje gsum gyis gsan/ gsum ga la rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na rin po che bsod nams chos 'phel nas/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po —382

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bsod (266bzhims mchog ldan man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'khon ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug /zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na mkhan ngag dbang chos grags nas/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na mkhan ngag dbang chos grags nas/ rje snying rje bzang po/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na mus chen sems dpa' chen po nas/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge /rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge /brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ lo pa spyan snga man 'dra/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin cen nas/ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra/ yang na mus chen nas/ go ram pa bsod nams seng ge /rje sangs rgyas rin cen man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan po bsod nams lhun grub/ rje lha mchog seng ge man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub nas/ mus chen dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na slo bo mkhan chen nas/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ rje dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na mus chen nas zha lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang /mnga' ris pa dpal ldan rgyal po/ rje bzang po dpal pa/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug /rje chosadabang phyug /mus chen (267na yogangs rgyas rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na slo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub nas/ rje kun dga' grol mchog /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'debs che chung glo bo bar gsan pa yang brgyud pa 'di nyid do/ /yang na mus chen sems dpa' chen po nas/ rje sangs rgyas rin cen/rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mang mkhar ba rab gsal/ zla ba mgon po/ grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na rje grol mchog —383

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonanas/ lcags zam pa bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ drung ngag dbang nyi ma/ lcags zam pa sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug /mkhan chen zha lu ba chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rtse gdong khri chen nas/ lcags zam sprul sku man 'dra/ yang na lo pa spyan snga rin po che nas/ lcags zam sprul sku man 'dra/ yang na mus chen sems dpa' chen po nas/ kun mkhyen sangasargyas 'phel/ rje ra snga rtse pa/ rdzong dkar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na mus chen sems dpa' chen po nas/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ mtshungs med bshes gnyen bkra shis/ grub mchog dge slong ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rje mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na glo bo mkhan po bsod nams lhun grub nas/ rje dkon cog skyabs/ rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa legs ldan rdo rje/ rje mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ dbang gi rtags yod kyi lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab nas/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ (267bdes bdag la'o/ /ngag gi rtags yod pa'i lung ni thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse nas/ rin po che rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya khri chen yab sras gnyis/ khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen/ des bdag la'o/ /'bum gyi rtags yod pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni bla ma dam pa yan gong ltar la/ de nas sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dge legs bzang po/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/sa lung pa shes rab rin cen/ rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/ 'bum chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhas grub byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang / khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na dge legs bzang po nas/ ā nan+da ma ti bha dra/ byams pa chos kyi rin cen/ dran mchog sangs rgyas mgon po/ rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ dge slong nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ 'bum chen man 'dra/ yang na sa lung sher rin nas/ rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/brag gi rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ sa paṇa/ tsho gos sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/yar klungs pa man slob bshad ltar ro/ /brgyud pa 'di la nyan chen par brag phug pas gsan pa'i —384

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po / (ka)lugs la gtso bor mdzad/ gzhan yang sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ paṇ+ḍita rdo rje shes rab/ 'phags rgyal ba/ bla ma bzang po ba/bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyan/gnyis ka (268na tshe pa 'jam skya/ dpal ldan pa/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa/ yar sgom se bo/ do pa ston tshul gsum la rgyal tsha lung mang pos gsan/ de nas mkhas pa yon tan khri/ seng ge bzang po yar klungs pa man 'dra/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ dkar po brag pa/ yar klungs pa man 'dra/ ki'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rin po che rta ra ba yan slob bshad ltar la/ de nas paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngag chos pa nas/ snying rje bzang po lo pa spyan snga/ sa skya khri chen man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/mus chen/ rje sangs rin/ dkon cog lhun grub/ dkon cog rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa skya khri chen man 'dra/ sha'i rtags can gyi 'khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan yan brag gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa nyan chen pa dang zhang dkon cog dpal bzhugs pa ltar la/ de nas khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la nyams 'khrid du stsal to/ /rgyal gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal rtse bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sa'i rtags yod pa'i byin rlabs dang lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse yan/brag gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa nyan chen pa dang zhang dkon cog dpal bzhugs pa ltar la/ de nas rje byams pa rab (268ba tha rtan/ rje snying rje bzang po man sngar ltar/ yang na rje mkhyen brtse nas/ rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra'o/ /lcags kyi rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ rje grol mchog nas bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang por brgyud pa dang gcig go /yang —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonabyin rlabs lung 'khrid thams cad kyi nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen nā ro ta pa man 'dra/ ring brgyud tsog la/ 'di thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gas yig na snang ngo / /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/grub chen dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+ta ra/ spyod pa ba/ gu khya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti slo pa/nā ro ba man 'dra/rgyal po chen po in+d+ra bhū nyis legs par bkral ba'i in+d+ra mkha' spyod dam phag mo zhal gnyis ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma bden gnyis zhal du grags pa'i skor la/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i yi ge la brgyud pa'i phyag len gyis legs par brgyan te sis ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs zab mo smin rgyas su nos/ rgyab rten lung la mi dbang chos gsum gyi dang po dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub (ni/pa o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po mi dbang in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal na lan+da pa dang lo tsā ba pradz+nyā kirtis bsgyur pa/ gnyis pa des mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi rang byin gyis rlob pa'i rim pa (sgo/slob ma ye shes rdo rjes bsgyur ba/ gsum pa 'phags mo'i las bcu (3)zhes pa bsnyen pa'i cho ga /gzhan don slob ma rjes su bzung ba/ tshes bcu dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod/bdag gzhan gnyis ka dang 'brel (269na tha gzhen nu ma'i mchod pa/ gnas skabs thams cad dang 'brel ba gtor ma'i cho ga /dman pa'i dur khrod dang 'brel ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga /bu chung gsar bu la phan 'dogs pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ rtsub las gdug pa tshar gcod pa nga ni'i cho ga /bsgoms pas phyir bzlog pa dang / bris pas phyir bzlog pa rnams bla ma bha len+d+ra ru tses mdzad pa bal po ye shes rdo rje dang bla ma mal lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ mi dbang chos gsum gyi gsal byed rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs lag tu blang pa'i rim pa (3)tseng nge ston pas gsol ba btab pa la brten nas rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ sngags kyi de nyid byin gyis rlob pa lag tu blang ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa (sne khong nge 'dul 'dzin pas gsol ba btab nas rje btsun rin po ches mdzad —386

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa/ phag mo las bcu'i cho ga'i gsal (sna/byed tseng nge ston pa dge slong shes rab grags kyis gsol ba btab par brten nas rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes yod pa'i gong ma'i gsung rgyun gyi zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa ma ti tsi tras brag dkar chos sdings su sbyar ba'i mtha' can/ 'gor phag mo zhal gnyis ma 'di rgyal po in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa 'dra yang zhes yod pa'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge kun mkhyen gung rus mdzad pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'o'i mtha' can/ paṇa chen ngag (269ba)dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs (ngag)byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i cho ga go bde bklags chog tu bkod pa rnams thob pa las ngag gi rtags can ma gtogs pa'i byin rlabs dang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen la ba pa/ rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti/lcam la: ka ra/ zur chag la legs smin zer/ bram ze birlu pa/ grub chen sha wa ri ba/ grub chen mi tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje/ bal po bha ren+d+ra ru tse/ ha du dkar po yang zer/ bal po ye shes rdo rje/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje khu dbon/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa/ chosarje bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kwa ning gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po/ nyi lde ba ngag dbang grags pa/ rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo ring pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang byin rlabs dang sgo'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni grub chen brag phug pa nas/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang / paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan po bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje btsun sgo rus pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na chos rje rdo rje 'chang nas/ mus chen —387

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)'khor lo sdom pa/ rin cen mkhyen rab mchog grub/ rje btsun dkon cog tshul khrims/ grub chen sangs rgyas (270na dpal/ rje sgo rum pa man 'dra/ ngag gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu ba chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rtsa ba'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bram ze birlu pa nas/ a bhi dzuk+ta/ bal po ha du dkar po/bal skad du sngags pa la 'di ltar zer zhes chag lo gsung / lo tsā ba ye shes rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na sha wa ri pa nas/a wa dhū ti pa a khyu ya badz+ra/ grub chen badz+ra pā ṇi/ bal po bha ren+d+ra ru tse man 'dra/ yang na a wa dhu ti pa nas/ ldong dar ba ting nge 'dzin rdo rje/ 'di gnyis ngor pa shar pa'i gsan yig na snang / bsod snyems pa che ba ma ti badz+ra/bsod snyoms pa chung ba sa ma ti bha dra/ 'di yang ngor pa shar pa'i gzha yig na snang / bal po bha ren+d+ra ru tse man 'dra/ nye brgyud ni/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo/ paṇa grub bha ren+d+ra ru tse man 'dra/ bal po thugs rje ོ po yang zer/sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen mo ral pa gyen brjes kyi rgyud la brten nas slob dpon mi tri pas legs par bkral ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'am mi tri mkha' spyod du grags pa'i skor la/spro lung pa kun smon gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge dang brgyud pa'i phyag len la brten nas sis ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par nos/ rgyab rten lung la/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud las phyung pa'i rig pa 'dzin ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub (ske/thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza ya'i zhabs dang sum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen (270bsgo'i sgrub (sgo/thabs slob dpon gnyis med rje gzha sma tri pa/ rdo rjes mdzad pa rje btsun dza ya shī se na dang sum pa lo tsā bas bsgyur pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su snang ba'i cho ga (sgo/mkhas pa chen po rgyal ba'i sdes mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang btsun pa dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje 'dzin pa grags pa gzhen nu sogs kyis bskul nas mkha' spyod sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa spro lung pa kun dga' smon lam gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa —388

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)yon tan mtha' yas ma/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub (ngag)thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga go bde bklags chog tu bkod pa rnams thob pa las ngag gi rtags ma gtogs pa'i byin rlabs dang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ dpa' bo spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin cen/ ri khrod dbang phyug /sha wa ri zer/ grub chen mi tri pa/ gnyis med rdo rje/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje/ ka ma la badz+ra/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ dza ya se na/ sum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ theg chen rin po che/ gu shrī nam bzang / nyi lde ba ngag dbang grags pa/ gcen bdag chen rgya dkar ba/ gcung bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun kun spangs chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za (271na)hor ban+de la'o/ /lung byin rlabs dang sgo'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud gcig ni/ brag phug pa nas/ ri khrod pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen/ mus chen/mkhyen rab chos rje/ ran+ta shrī la/ sangs rgyas dpal/ rje sgo rus pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ ngag gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na spyan ras gzigs nas/ ri khrod dbang phyug /a wa zlo ti pa/ : ti/ ka ma la badz+ra/ lī la ya badz+ra/ lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun grags pa man 'dra/ yang nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nas/ mi tri pa/ nam mkha'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma a/ shākya rak+ṣi ta/ ka na ka shrī/dza ya se na man 'dra/ yang na bla ma a/ dza ya se na man 'dra/ yang na lo ke shwa ra nas/ ri khrod pa dbang phyug man 'dra/ rgyud nas phyung pa'i sgrub thabs kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa nas/ ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen chos rje man 'dra/ yang na theg chen chos rje nas/ bla ma lung rig rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal bzang / brag thog bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ sngags 'chang tshe dbang ba po shis/ rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/ tshar sna mkhan po ngag dbang kun bsod/ bla ma ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'am pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan (271ba tshe pan 'dra/ yang na rje bka' 'gyur ba nas/ rab 'byams chos rje/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /chos rje sher 'byung blo gros ma rgyud kyi phyogs la mkhas grub chen por grags kyang mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bsgrigs par dbang chog tu ming brtags pa dang / la la mkha' spyod phyi ma gnyis kyi byin rlabs la rjes gnang du ngos 'dzin pa sogs snang ba sdom gsum du/ nā ro ta pa dbang bskur dang / /rim gnyis chos kyi gtso bar mdzad/ /nā ro'i brgyud pa 'dzin bzhin du/ /dbang dang rim gnyis mi sgom pa/ /rgyud dang 'gal ba lta ci smos/ /rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs ni/ /mar pa lho brag pa la med/ /mar pa'i brgyud pa 'dzin bzhin du/ /phag mos chos sgo 'byed pa ni/ /rgyud dang 'gal ba lta ci smos/ /rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /zhes rje na ro dang mar pa sogs thog mar bde dgyes gang rung gi dbang bzhis smin par byas nas phag mo sogs kyi byin rlabs mdzad par gsungs pas dbang dang byin rlabs kyi dbye ba ma phyed pa dwags brgyud pa'i rnam thar du song zhing byin rlabs la slob ma grangs nges dgos shing rjes gnang la grangs med kyi chog pas so so'i spu ris ma 'dres par byed dgos so/ /—390

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)sa skya pa'i gdams pa dmar po skor gsum du grags pa'i sgrub thabs gsan pa'i lung brgyud sogs/dkar chag las/ bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /gsang las yang gsang gser gyi chos/ /dmar po skor gsum zhes grags pa/ zhes pa ltar dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan khyad par gyi gdams pa thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhar la 'grub pa dmar po skor gsum du grags pa la/ rjes 'brang gi mkhas pa (272na snams kyi bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang na'ang la la/tsho gos bdag /'dod rgyal/ rdza dmar srog sgrub gsum yin par bzhed/ 'ga' zhig brgyud pa gsum las 'ongs pa'i tshogs bdag la ngos 'dzin/ kha gcig gnyan lo'i dmar chung skor gsum bzhed par snang / 'brul pa'i dri ma tsam gyis kyang ma spangs pa ni bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bzhed pa kha'u brag rdzong pa'i lugs srol ltar rje btsun sgrol ma dmar mo ku ru kul+le/ tshogs bdag bgegs kyi rgyal po dmar chen/ khro bo dag 'chol 'dod pa'i rgyal po gsum las dang po ku ru kul+le 'am rje btsun rig byed ma'i chos skor rnams kye rdor rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang ku ru kulbe'i rtog pa las byung zhing / de la yang sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs su grags pa'i thun mong pa yod pa btang snyoms su bzhag ste/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa zur bka' dpa' bo rdo rje dang gha ya dha ra'i man ngag 'phrog mi las brgyud pa/ lhan skyes rol pa dang ḍom+bhi pa'i man ngag ba ri nas brgyud pa/ gnyan gyi gdams pa sogs bka' babs mang du bzhugs pa'i rim pa rnams rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i dkar chag ltar nos pa la/ tshom bu la brten nas ku ru ku l+le phyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang thun mong ba/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyi yi ge dang zur 'debs dpal ldan bla ma gzungs kyi dpal bas mdzad pa dang brgyud pa'i phyag len 'khrul med la brten nas nang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / su 'jigs med —391

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)grags pa'i yi ge dang dam pa'i phyag bzhes la brten nas ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba rnams legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten (272ba)lung la/ thog mar dpal ldan sa skya pa'i khyad par gyi gser chos dmar po skor gsum zhes grags pa'i chos skor gyi dkar chag dbang sdud pad+ma rā ga'i za ma tog gi kha 'byed gnad kyi lde mig rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ de las byung pa'i ku ru ku lce'i chos skor la/ bla r+ṣa dang ba ri thun mong nas brgyud pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka nas brgyud pa/ bkras rnam pa'i yi ge /dkar chag tu ma bzhugs pa'i skor dang lnga/ dang po brgyud pa'i lo rgyus rjes gnang bcas pa ltas/6 sa/dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa btsun pa ā nan+da sa bris pa rjes byang ngo'i mtha' can/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo sgrub thabs 'di'i lo rgyus ni zhes 'gor yod pa'i lo 'di na mahā rā dza zer ba las lhan skyes rol pa'i gsal kha mi 'dug /rgyus sgrub thabs 'di mahā rā dzas mdzad do sa ha dza pa'i las so'i mtha' can/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i zur 'debs gzungs kyi dpal ba'i gsung las bzhi shis zin bris su bkod pa/ ku ru kulbe'i sgrub thabs las sbyor rtsa rgyud brtags gnyis kyi brtag pa dang po'i le'u bcu gcig pa las phyung ba/ sngags btu ba brtag gnyis sngags kyi le'u las phyung ba/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rim pa las bdag byin gyis rlabs pa'i ku ru ku lce'i sgrub (sge/6 / /thabs kyi rgya gzhung rgyal po lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ slob dpon chen po lhan skyes sgeg pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs (rge)dwa na shi la'i rang 'gyur/ mang du thos pa'i slob dpon ku mā ra bo dhis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rigs ldan ma'am ku ru kul+la'i sgrub (273na)thabs (6)am snya gis mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje las byung ba'i man (glo yo spung ga chen po lnga slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa dwa na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ shākya 'tshos mdzad pa'i man ngag rnam pa lnga dwa na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gdams(5)6 / di pa rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs —392

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)(3)kyi rim pa 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ dkar chag na mi gsal yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses sgo wo par gsan pa'i yi ger bstod pa dang bcas zer ba 'dug pas brtse bas rjes chags ma zhes pa'i sho lo ka gcig bu de'o/ /las sbyor gyi man (7(ling ga paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rjes bla ma ba ri bar gnang ba/ nus pa ma nyams pas khams gsum dbang du byed pa paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ dbu na yi ge yaṃ yongs su gyur ba zhes yod pa'i rdzas sbyor gyi yi ge gla rtsir bcas pa'i du bas mi'i ming rus la bdugs na dbang du 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ gtor ma'i cho ga tshigs bcad (5)6 / )ma nyung ngu yar klungs pas mdzad pa/ las kyi mtha' sdud sbyin sreg (3)tshigs bcad ma rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rje btsun ma'i bris sku'i cho ga (ni/rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gsung rdo rje ma'i lag skul (ni/thams cad yid 'phrog par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ ku ru kul+le g.yin nu ma'i sgrub (sgo/thabs/ rje btsun ma'i bka' sdod pho nya (sgo/gnod sbyin mo sku mdog ser mo'i man ngag /ku ru kul+le sku mdog sngon mo'i char 'bebs kyi yi ge bka' bsgo drag du bya'o'i mtha' can/ sgrub thabs nag po 'gro shes (d+ma kho ni/khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i gnad yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ 'di ni dus gcig la snod ldan gyi slob bu (273ba〉gcig la chig brgyud ma gtogs mang por mi spel ba'i bka' rgya dang phyag len gyi rgyun ma nyams pa yod cing / de'i rgyu mtshan yang dkar chag tu/ blo chung thun mong gdams pas tshim//'byor ldan lung med yig hrul sdud/ shes 'dod grags pa'i rjes su 'brang / /de dag chu 'dod smig rgyur snyeg /ces pa'i ngang tshul dang ye mi 'dra bar slob dpon lhan skyes rol pa nas bzung ste rje btsun kun spangs chen po'i bar du tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi snyan brgyud gdams pa'i ngad ma yal ba'i zab gnad dang ldan pas/ ji skad du/ kho bos dam pa'i zhabs pad ring du bsten/ /snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i zhal 'od snying la shar/ 'khrul med gdams pa'i gnad la nges pa thob/ /grogs dag 'di 'dra'i skal bzang kho bo tsam/ /zhes gsungs pa snying la bcang par bya'o/ /bdag nyid nus ldan du bya ba dang ling ga'i snying gar 'jug pa'i 'khor lo'i zhal shes kyi yig —393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()chung bka' rgya shin tu dam pa rnams/ gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i skor la/bsnyen pa/ lha dbang du byas nas don bsgrub pa/ klu dbang du byas nas char dbab cing nor bsgrub pa/gnod sbyin dbang du byas nas zang zing bsgrub pa/ mi ma yin dbang du byas te srog 'phrog pa/ rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa/ shes rab 'phel ba/ sri'u gso ba rnams ston pa'i khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ko sa lar 'brungs pa'i be+e ro tsa na'i rang 'gyur/ de'i lag len gyi yig sna la lo rgyus/ zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsnyen pa/ rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor du khrol bu/ drag po'i dkyil 'khor du dib ma/ dbang gi (274na bo kyil 'khor du ril bu bsgrub pa/ bye brag lha klu gnod sbyin mi ma yin dbang du bsdus pa/ 'chi glu/ shes rab 'phel ba/ sri'u bsrung ba rnams ston pa ko sa lar 'khrungs pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa rnam par snang mdzad rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa/ brgyud pa sgrub pa char dbab pa ste don gsum gyis bstan pa'i klu'i rgyal po wa ru ṇa'i char 'bebs rgya gar be+e ro tsa na'i rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ char chog gi yig sna rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/'gor yang na rang gi dben khang nas zhes yod pa'i gong gi zhal shes dz+nyā na shrī dharmā 'o'i mtha' can/las sbyor gsum pa zhes pa char dbab pa/ rgyal po skyes pa bud med/ nor/ mi ma yin/ phyag rgya ma/sngags pa rnams dbang du bya ba/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i ku ru ku lce'i sa gcad rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa la na mo byang chub kyi sems kyi phang la zhes yod pa'i sgrub thabs chung gu greng greng sha swā hā'i mtha' can rnams/ gsum pa ḍom+bhi he ru ka nas brgyud pa la/ 'gor bla ma'i gsung las byung ba yi zhes yod pa'i slob ma rjes su gzung pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga tshigs bcad rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'di dkar chag na mdzad pa po'i mi gsal yang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na sa paṇa gyis mdzad zer ba snang /'gor rjes gnang 'di thun mong ba min zhes yod pa'i byin rlabs kyi lag len shin tu gsal ba yang yig tu grags pa bla ma mnyam med pas mdzad pa sngon chad yi ger med pa yi ge bkod pa bzod par gsol lo'i mtha' can/ sgrub (rge)thabs to sdi he ru gas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa ltas/—394

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mi 'gyur ma/ bcom ldan 'das ku ru kul+le la phyag 'tshal lo 'dir rje (274bsgo tsun ma ku ru kul+le mos pa zhes 'gor yod pa'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rdul tshon rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor ro'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo rje btsun ma ku ru kusle'i dbang du bya ba'i man ngag ces yod pa'i rje btsun ma'i sgrub pa'i rim pa dang las sbyor gyi rim pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum chig dril gyi man ngag zab pa sa skya ba chen po shin tu dam par mdzad pa snod ldan gcig brgyud ma gtogs pa shin tu gsang ba/ de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes nyi shu rtsa gcig bar ma chad pa'o'i mtha' can/ zhal shes kyi yig chung snying dang 'dra bas su la yang mi sbyin no'i mtha' can/ yig chung gi yang yig bzlas pa byed zer ba de lags so'i mtha' can/ gsang sgrub kyi skor 'dir thor bu tsam ma gtogs cha tshang ba ye med pas dpes su byung la mi ston pa'i bka' rgya yod tshul dkar chag tu 'dug pa bzhin snying la bcang bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa rje bkra shis rnam rgyal bas mdzad pa'i yi ge ni/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dang bcas pa'i yi ge shin tu rgyas pa shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ lnga pa dkar chag tu ma bzhugs pa'i yi ge la/ rje btsun rig byed ma byon tshul yid 'phrog pad+ma rā ga'i chun po zha a the sirnyis mdzad pa/ chos tshan gcig tu tshang pa'i dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang gi gsal byed rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma ku ru kulbe'i man ngag gi rim pa zhes bskyed rim/ bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba/ sbyin sreg /'khrul 'khor/ las sna tshogs pa ste rim (275na)pa lngar phye nas bstan pa'i bsgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ ku ru ku lce'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bya ba'i ngag 'don gyi sgrub thabs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs srid gsum dbang mdzad ma/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyal ba'i ye shes ma/ sbyin sreg gi yi ge 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ gnad yig nag po 'gro shes kyi zhal 'phangs sbyin sreg gi yi ge brag dmar mkhan chen —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rab brtan dpal bas bskul bar brten nas tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ bsam gtan kho nas las la sbyor ba'i gser chos snying gi yang zhun chig brgyud ma/ gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge rig pa 'dzin pa gu chen gyis bskul ba'i ngor so 'jigs med grags pas mdzad pa/ gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs kyi sgo dbye ba sbyor dngos rjes gsum pa zhal shes zab mo yi ger bkod pa'i mtha' can/ lha lnga'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga gsal ba'i sgron me mkhan chen 'jam dpal dbyangs ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa rnams/ dpe'u ris la/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal sgrub rdzas dang bcas pa/ rang nyid nus ldan du bya ba'i 'khor lo/ ling ga'i snying gar 'jug pa'i 'khor lo/ de dang 'dra min gcig /sbyin sreg gi thab/ klu sgrub kyi rgya gzhung dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi don kun sgrub pa/ lha klu sogs dbang sdud spyir dril gyi 'khor lo/ char dbab pa'i dkyil 'khor/ sprul dang sbal par 'jug pa'i phyed mtha'i tsakra /ril bu 'khor lo can/ rlung
