gnon 'khor lo/ nor sgrub 'khor lo/ sre'u gso ba'i 'khor (275ba)lo dang bcas pa rnams phyag len dmar 'khrid du legs par thob pa las sa gcad lnga pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang tho ra'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga gsum dor ba'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang dang sa gcad dang po dang lnga pa'i lung man ngag tshang ma'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le/ rgyal po lhan skyes rol ba/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo chen rin cen grags/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ rje sa paṇa/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin cen/ 'phags pa rin po che/ rgya tsha chos kyi dbang phyug /mkhas mchog yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog /bdag chen 'jam dbyangs chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /sngags 'chang dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings —396

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na tshar chen nas/ rje btsun bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga rin po che mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ yang na rje mkhyen brtse nas/ rje shega' na nu stobs ldan/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang rjes gnang gnyis tsam gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse/ gnyis ka la rje (276na)dbang rab/ yang na rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs nas/ mkhan chen bslab gsum pa/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab nas/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rje dbang rab kyi mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i lung ni/ de nyid nas/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag go /mkhan chen ngag chos pas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yig brgyud ni/ rtsom pa po nas/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug /mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rjes gnang thun mong ba dang / tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gaṅka'i chu rgyun gyi lung brgyud/rjes gnang thun mong pa dang / tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ga bla'i chu rgyun gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rin po che bod mkhar ba nas/ dga' ldan shar pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rtses dang byang ma khang gsar ba dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang bshad ma thag pa'i lugs srol dang 'brog mi nas brgyud pa'i lugs srol gnyis man ngag phra mo re re tsam ma gtogs rjes gnang chos skor gyi khongs gcig pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ gnyis spangs zhabs/ gha ya dha ra/ bla chen 'brog mi/ se ston kun rig /zhang ston chos 'bar rje —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)btsun sa chen man gong bzhin no/ /brgyud tshul 'di rnams ni kha'u brag rdzong pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs yin la/ rjes gnang dang chos skor thun mong ba tsam gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa nas/ 'u yug pa kun dga' bsod nams/ rdo rje gdan pa'(276bskos na yig na rig pa'i seng ge zer ba 'dug /nyis thog pa kun dga' smon lam/ bla ma yon tan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa'i phyag bris na 'di mi 'dug pa chad dam dpyad/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ grub chen brag phug pa/ rgyal ba'i ri khrod pa/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / bdag chen kun dga' dbang phyug /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na brag phug pa nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na dga' ldan pa kun bsod nas/ bag ston gzhen tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shar pa man 'dra/ yang rjes gnang gnyis dang sgo'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yan gong ltar la/ de nas rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ thun mong ba'i rjes gnang dang gle'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/rje grol mchog /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ bdag chen chu mig pa blo gros dbang phyug legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ glo bo grol mchog man 'dra/sa gcad gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i skor gyi lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob (277na bo pon klu'i byang chub/ dga' rab rdo rje/bla ma rdo rje gdan pa/ bla ma ārla pā la/ bla ma be+e ro tsa na badz+ra/ rje btsun gnas nang pa khams pa dbu rtseyin/ de la gsan yig nges pa zhig med 'dra pas bla ma bdun tsam chad/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ 'di ku rab pa'i zhal ngo paṇa chen bkras rnam pa'i dbon po sa skya pa'i dge bshes yin kyang / rjes su po khra pa brgyad pa'i bla mar gyur cing —398

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gnyug la legs bshad gling gi 'chad nyan du bskos pa sogs nas kurma 'phrin las zhes grags pas/ brgyud 'debs su thams cad mkhyen pa rje gas phren las khas tshes snang ngo / /rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man rje mkhyen brtse dang bod mkhar ba nas spyan snga la 'ongs pa so so nas brgyud pa gong dang 'dra/ ḍom+bhi ba lugs kyi lha lnga'i si rgyu ra'i byin rlabs dang de'i chos skor sa gcad gsum yongs rdzogs dang lnga pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga le tshan gnyis kyi lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje lang / rdo rje snying po/ ḍā ki ni su bha gi /ḍom+bhi he ru ka /tsa ṇa ba/ ti slo pa/ nā ro paṇa chen/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa sa paṇa/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma mnyam med chen po/ mkhas grub gzungs kyi dpal ba/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dbon rgyal ba mchog /brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ bla ma blo gros rnam rgyal/ rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ tshar chen man 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse nas brgyud pa bzhin no/ /rje grol mchog gi gsan yig na gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud par rgyal po lhan skyes rol ba bgrangs 'dug pa ni phan tshun 'dres (277ba)pa'i dpyad mi bzod par mngon no/ /sa gcad bzhi pa rje bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i lung brgyud ni/ rje bkra shis rnam rgyal/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ char chen/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/rje dbang rab man 'dra/dkar chag tu ku ru kulbe'i sde tshan du gsungs shing 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig sogs phal cher du zur du phyung nas gser chos bcu gsum gyi grangs su 'dren pa bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba'i dbang gi lha gsum du grags pa'i skor la/ so so'i yig rnying la gzhi byas brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes kyis brgyan te rjes gnang spyi 'gro dang mi 'dra ba'i dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang khyad par can/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo'i sku sgoms dang bzlas lung gi rjes gnang /lha mo ti nu'i bdud rtsi sis ra'i dril bu la brten pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang rnams legs —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 7)par nos nas/ lung la dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can gyi skor ni/ gnyan los paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa dbang du bsdus pa'i lo rgyus/ bsnyen pa srog gi 'khor lo zhes par bsnyen sgrub las gsum du yod pa'i bsnyen pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/ sgrub pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ las sbyor dbang du bsdu ba/ bsgral ba/ las la gzhol ba gsum gyis bstan pa/ longs spyod rdzas gyi 'khor lo zhes pa/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis bstan pa/ dbang sdud yid bzhin 'khor los phyag rgya mtshan ldan 'gugs pa sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyis bstan pa/ lung blang ba'i yi ge dkar chag tu mi gsal ba/(278na)gnyan los gnyan lha khang gi khro bo sme brtsegs kyi zhabs 'og tu gter du sbas tshul gyi lo rgyus rnams/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo'i chos skor la/ na mo ba su dha ra ya gnas yid dang mthun pa zhes pa 'gor yod pa'i sgrub thabs kha zas la sogs pa med par bya'o'i mtha' can/ ā tsarla'i zhal las rag lus pas zhal shes/ rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams 'a rna kyig na a na ya sogs kyi sngags byang yod pa/lha mo ti nu'i chos skor la/ dang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo 'gor yod pa'i sgrub thabs gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa'o'i mtha' can/ lung blang ba'i yi ge sa skyar yar sgom gyis zhus pa/ rjes gnang gi phyag len/ rje mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i bstod pa pad+ma ra ga'i lcags klu rnams dang bcas pa rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnas kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje khu dbon/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ bla ma 'phags pa/ bla ma dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin cen dpal/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs srasakun dga' rgyal po/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rdo rje rje gdan pa (278bzhis/ bla ma blo gros rnam rgyal/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/—400

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)tshar chen man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun grags pa nas/ bla chen yar sgom/ rgya tsha chos kyi dbang phyug /mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal mchog /brag thog pa man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/dka' bcu pa gar+sha ne nu seng ge /gung pa bkra shis bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na bar 'dir lung mang po zer ba zhig 'dug kyang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pa brtag /mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ brag thog pa man 'dra/ zhar byung sa la tshogs bdag a ba ra tsit+ta gsum la brten pa'i gnyan lo'i gser chos ra la gsum bsgril gyi gdams pa las sbyor kho nas lag tu lon pa'i man ngag zab mo'i sgom lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan yan gong du bshad ma thag pa'i rgyud pa le tshan ltar la/ de nas mkhan chen khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /dkar chag tu/ dwa na shi la las brgyud pa la gtso bor mi mdzad gsung ba gtso mi che ba ma gtogs don dkar chag gi tshig gis zin pa yin pas glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs pad+ma'i snying po dang / dkyil 'khor gyi tsha ga rin cen pad+ma rā ga'i gter la brten nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs sgrub dkyil gnyis kyi lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ (279na)kha che paṇa chen/ paṇa chen dwa na shī la/ rje sa paṇa/ 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge /dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ nyis thog pa kun smon/ rje yon tan dpal/ kun dga' rdo rje/ kun dga' bsod nams/ brag phug pa/ ri khrod ba/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇ+ḍita/ slo bo mkhan po bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ zha lu pa 'jam dbyangs/ byang gling chos rje/kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don —401—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)grub/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na badz+ra pā ṇi/ dze tā ri/ a shā ka /a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng / mkhan chen chos rin/chos rje dge sdings pa/ bla ma sgom pa/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen man gong bzhin no/ /bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro brgyud nas bshad pa'i dpal lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po khams gsum dbang du mdzad pa'i gdams skor sa skya'i rje btsun chen po la bka' babs par brten/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas hor dang rgya gar gyi rgyal po sogs 'gro ba mang po dbang du bsdus pa ni rgyud sde rin po che'i dgongs pa ltar 'phags yul gyi grub chen du mas bstan pa la mi dad pa'i rgyal po dregs pa can dbang du bsdus nas bstan pa la bcug pa'i tshul dang (279bsgo tshungs shing / zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis tshogs bdag gzir ba'i mthus/ des bskul nas sa ston ri pa bsam bzhin 'phags pa rin po cher skye ba bzhes nas hor rgyal po'i ti shrī ra gyur te bod chol kha gsum gyi bdag mdzad pa/ khams su dge 11nga bzhi sde zhig gis lha chen 'di bsgrubs pas gser sdo/ga gi mchin pa tsam rnyed pa sogs thun mong gi dngos grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i gser chos zab mo'i skor la/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi yi ge dang dam pa'i phyag len la brten nas lha chen tshogs bdag dmar po phyag bcu gnyis pa'i thun mong gi rjes gnang / paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i phyag len khrigs chags 'dod dgu'i dpag bsam gyi steng nas dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / des mdzad pa'i ma nor don tshang gsal ba'i sgron me'i steng nas dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i khyad par gyi rjes gnang / rjo bo rje lugs kyi tshogs bdag chags pa rdo rje'i yig rnying dang mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar tshogs bdag dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba legs par nos nas/ rgyab brten lung la/ rtsa ba'i yi ge /gsal byed kyi lhan thabs/ gsang sgrub kyi yi ge /zhar byung jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i dkar po/ gser chos kyi gsang sgrub dmar po phyag bzhi pa'i yi —402

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ge dkar chag tu ma bzhugs pa'i skor dang drug /dang po la/ 'gor 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag (sa/'tshal lo tshogs kyi bdag po'i lo rgyus ni zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos las dbang phyug gi chung ma phag mo'i bur tshogs bdag (280na tshe skyes pa'i gtam rgyud/ 'gor dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo bgegs kyi rgyal po'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni zhes yod pa'i rjes (sa/gnang gi yig rnying mal los mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi lag len rgyas bsdus yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa/ 'gor dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo bgegs kyi rgyal po'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i khyad par gyi rjes gnang gi yi ge dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa khyad par gyi gdams pa brjed thor bkod pa'o'i mtha' can/ yar klungs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi gsal byed bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa bla ma gong ma'i yi ge dang mi mthun pas spang par bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo dpal tshogs kyi bdag po zhes yod pa'i thun mong gi rjes (rge)gnang ngor chen gyis mdzad pa tshogs bdag gi rjes gnang bya tshul nywa'i mtha' can/tshogs bdag gi rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u bcu dgu pa las phyung ba'i 'phags pa bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po'i gzungs (klo/lo tsā ba dge slong puṣ+yo shrī bha dras dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ grub chen nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs zhes pa 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgom bzlas paṇa chen gha ya dha ra dang bla chen 'brog mis bsgyur ba/ yang des mdzad pa'i bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs(7)gha ya dha ra dang gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis (280༷ ba/ des mdzad pa'i 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i bstod pa 'jig rten mgon mdzad ma/ 'di'i gsham du bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ma dang de nas mus 'thud pa'i bzlas pa bya tshul sogs yar klungs pa'i mdzad byang yod pa zhig chos tshan gcig gi tshul du 'dug pa dkar chag na mi gsal yig rgyun ma dag pa 'byams pa las —403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)'og gi yar klungs pa'i gtor chog na mdzad byang sogs mi 'dug pas de'i zhabs yin nam snyam pa slar yang dpe rnyed na dpyad dgos 'dug go /des mdzad pa'i bgegs kyi rgyal po'i bris sku'i man ngag gha ya dha ra dang gyi jo'i 'gyur/ des mdzad pa'i 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'gyur bshad ma dag pa dang 'dra ba/ des mdzad pa'i bgegs bdag gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'gyur gong 'dra/ dkar chag dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar 'dug sbyin sreg gi yi ger 'byog mi'i 'gyur zer pa 'dug pas dpyad/ shin tu myur ba'i lha bgegs chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon di paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i las bzhi'i 'khor lo'i gsal byed grub chen ḍom+bhi he ru gas mdzad pa/slob dpon nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad (7)pa rje btsun rin po che grags pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mjug na zhar byung gi zhal gdams mang po yod kyang ma bris so'i mtha' can/ 'gor rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo ga ṇa pa ti sgrub pa byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i gsang sgrub lha dgu'i sgrub (7)(281na thag rnying pa dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho brdol nas 'ong ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo ga ṇa pa ti sgrub par 'dod pas zhes pa'i gsang sgrub lha dgu'i sgrub thabs sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ zhan byung dam tshig dang 'phags pa rin po che sum cu rtsa gsum du khyer ba'i lo rgyus zur tsam dang bcas pa/ de dang 'dra min 'gor dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo yod pa gsang sgrub drag po'i lag len sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ zhar byung sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro dang sngags byang bstan pa/ tshogs bdag gi mngon rtogs/gtor 'bul/ bstod pa/ rmi ltas/ sku'i dbang sdus/ 'khor lo'i las sbyor/ 'dre mthong bcas pa rnams zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ dpal ga ṇa pa ti'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum spogs chog dang bcas pa gsal bar ston pa'i sgrub yig chen mo g.yin las ches khyad par 'phags pa stong gsum nor bus bkang ba las kyang dga' ba chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/—404

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'di dus gcig la slob ma gcig las mi ston pa'i gser chos bka' rgya can yin no/ /des mdzad pa'i sgrub khrigs kyi sdom tshig shin tu gsal ba/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo yod pa'i tshogs bdag gi gtor chog (rge)rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pas mdzad pa/'di'i mjug rgyal ba'i sku gsung ma zer ba'i bstod pa slob dpon nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad zer ba zhig gi rdzogs pa las yar klungs pa'i mdzad byang (281ba〉ba byung bas gong du dogs slong bris pa'i nag po pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'jig rten mgon mdzad ma'i gsham du drung chos rje pas mdzad zer pa'i bstod pa dang gtor chog sogs kyi mthar yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis dam pa mang po'i bzhugs gnas bsam gling bde chen du sbyar zer ba 'dug pa/ dpe gong 'og gnyis po'i mjug yig mkhan gyis nor nas bris sam snyam pa slar yang ma dpe rnying pa rnyed na zhu gtugs dgos par snang ngo / /gnyis pa gsal byed lhan thabs la/ bris sku bri zhing sgrub pa'i yi ge de phyir sngags la nan tan bya sa ma pa tha mi'i mtha' can/ bris sku bri ba'i man ngag rab tu gnas pa dang bcas pa bris sku'i cho ga rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gnod sbyin chen po bse gdong gzugs mnan pa'i yig rnying tshigs bcad ma/ gnod sbyin bse gdong can gnod sbyin lag len chos rje bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis bsam yas su zin bris mdzad pa/ sku rten bri ba/ dngos grub kyi rten gtor bca' ba/ gsang rten lus la bcad pa/ rgyun gtor gter du sba ba thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad dbab rnams kyi yig chung bka' rgya can gser chos chig brgyud ma/ sgrub pa'i sgab 'dre gnon pa/ gsang rten bca' ba/ bla rdo 'chang ba/ dngos grub blang thabs rnams ston pa'i gsang ba gnad kyi yig chung sgrub yig chen mo'i lhan thabs bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i gser chos tshig brgyud ma/ gsang ba snying gi 'khor 31'i las bzhi bsgrub tshul/ spogs chog /gsang ba thugs kyi man ngag nor bu bsam gtan/ (282na ton gas bdag dang tsartsi zhal sbyor gyi thab gter/ bang mdzod kyi —403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 7)cho ga rnams ston pa'i yi ge rin cen ljon shing gser chos chig brgyud gras/ 'gor dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing yod pa'i sbyin sreg gi lag len me ma shi bar la gzhan reg tu mi 'jug ge'i mtha' can/ bi na ya ga'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i phyag mtshan bcu gnyis kyi las tshogs (7)zhes pa dgra stas dgra bo gzhom pa/ gtun shing gis bgegs tshar gcod pa/ mda' gzhus dgra bo dbang du byed pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gas 'byung po dga' bar byed pa/ lcags kyus 'gro ba dbang du bsdu ba/ thod pas gdul bya 'gugs pa/ rdo rjes gdon bgegs tshar gcod pa/ ral gyis gza' bsrung ba/ thod pa sha chen gyis nor sgab pa/ phub kyis bsrung ba/ ba dan gyis grags pa spel ba/ mdung gis bsam pa sgrub pa rnams ston pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i (7)bstod pa tshig rkang bcu bdun ma/ des mdzad pa'i spyan 'dren mchod 'phreng sha lta pra titsā hūṃ gi mtha' can/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa paṃ pad raṃ nyi ma/ des mdzad pa'i rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ma/ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa (klo/gdug pa kun 'dul ma rnams/ gsum pa gsang sgrub kyi yi ge la/ tshogs bdag dmar po gsang sgrub zhal gcig phyag drug pa'i sgrub (7)ba dpal nā ro pas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ de'i lag len tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsang sgrub kyi lag len rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka nas brgyud pa'i tshogs bdag (282ba)dmar chung zhal gcig phyag gnyis nor rgyun ma dang yab yum du sgrub pa'i yi ge mchod pa'i las so'i mtha' can/ rgyal blon btsun mo 'bangs sogs dbang du bsdu ba'i yi ge /rten phyi nang gsang gsum bca' ba'i yi ge rdzogs so'i mtha' can zhar byung dbang du ma 'dus na dmigs pa bya tshul dang bcas pa rnams/ bzhi pa zhan byung jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i dkar po'i skor la/ tshogs bdag rigs lnga ston pa'i rgyud rin cen gter mdzod le'u dgu pa paṇ+ḍi ta di paṃ ka ra dang nag tsho lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po 'jur gegs sel ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta di paṃ ka ra dang lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng shes yam bu mkhar du bsgyur ba/ de'i lag len 'phags —406

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa tshogs kyi bdag po bgegs sel gyi sgrub thabs jo bo a ti shas mdzad pa gu gul gyis bdug cing gtor ma gtang ngo'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa phyag 'tshal dpal ldan ma/ tshogs bdag gi sku la rab gnas bya ba mchod thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gnad la dbab pa rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i man ngag shin tu zab pa/ gnad la bor ba/ bzlas pa'i zhal gdams/ sbyin sreg gi las med thabs med pa'i mtha' can/ gsad pa'i las rta phru ma/ spogs pa'i yig chung / rjes gnang lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i yi ge /yang jo bo rje'i gdams pa tshogs bdag dkar po phyag bzhi pa slob dpon a mo gha nas brgyud pa'i skor la/ tshogs bdag sgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis zhes 'gor yod pa'i tshogs bdag dkar po glang gdong phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs ma mthong bar du'o'i (282ba)mtha' can/ paṇ+ḍi ta a dkar dri la dur khrod phung lung nag por skye ba sngon ma'i yon bdag dang phrad pa'i lung bstan byung tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus/ dkar chag na bar 'dir tshogs bdag dkar po sha ba'i gdong can gyi sgrub thabs zer ba zhig 'dug kyang dpe ma 'byor bas lung ma thob/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsang sgrub a mo gha badz+ra kyis mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/ tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub pa'i man ngag nges par dbang du 'gyur ro li mtha' can/ sku la rab gnas bya thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ mnyes par bya ba'i phyir gtor ma 'bul ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ bstod pa sum cu rtsa gsum ma a mo gha badz+ra gyis mdzad pa rnams/lnga pa gsang sgrub phyag bzhi pa'i yig rnying la/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo tshe 'di la bsod nams che ba zhes 'gor yod pa'i gsang sgrub dmar po phyag bzhi pa'i yig rnying gdong grogs gyis shig gi mtha' can/ de'i rten bca' ba sogs kyi zhal gdams dam pa kun dga' grags kyis yi ger bkod pa/ bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa nor gyi rgyud 'gyur ma 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag yang gsang drag po btsan thabs su sgrub pa'i nying khu zab mo phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg spogs chog dang bcas pa bla ma sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag glang po'i —407

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gzugs sgrub kyi sgo nas nor sbyin pa'i zhal gdams zhes pa glang po che'i gzugs la brten nas sgrub pa dkar chag tu thab 'khor mdzod 'khor dge (283bsko rin 'du ba'i 'khor lo gsum gyi gnad yig 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/ rje bsam gtan gling pa'i phyag dpe dngos las bshus pa rnams/ sa gcad lnga pa 'di thams cad mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na gsum pa'i mjug na 'thud pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa'i khyad par gyi gdams pa gser chos thun mong ma yin pa'i zhes yar bcad nas sa gcad bzhi pa 'di logs su mdzad pa don la gnas na'ang / 'dir dkar chag chen mo'i bzhugs tshul ltar bkod pa chos sde'i brgyud babs gyi dbye ba ma 'dres par byed dgos shing / dpa' bo rdo rje/ gha ya dha ra/ ha du dkar po/paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dpal dbyangs te brgyud pa bzhi'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gyi dbye ba'ang kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan 'dzin zhig gi zhal lung las len dgos kyi shes rlom kun gyis spyod yul ma yin no/ /drug pa dkar chag tu ma bzhugs pa'i skor la/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len khrigs chags 'dod dgu'i dpag ( pe go)bsam paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po'i khyad par gyi rjes gnang (ngag)ma nor don tshang gsal ba'i sgron me/ tshogs bdag dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ spogs pa/ sbyin sreg dang bcas pa tshigs bcad ma bla ma gnyan phu byung pas mdzad pa /chin)sba zhing gsang la sgrub pa'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa dpal (tshin)chen spyan snga ma/ dbang du byed na zla (3na)gam dmar po zhes sogs (284na)kyi zhal shes/gdams pa 'di la don gsum ste zhes 'go dang (6na)ā ka ro bdun gyis dbul lo'i mtha' can/gnod sbyin bse gdong mnan pa'i gdams /chin)pa sems can kho na'i don du dam tshig go'i mtha' can/ yang 'gor bzlog pa rem du bya zhes yod pa'i bse gdong mnan pa (ji)lus nag sna dmar gzugs su 'bri'i mtha' can/ dang po tshogs bdag gi phyi nas 'brang zhes 'gor yod pa'i bse —408

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gdong mnan /chin)pa smon lam 'debs su 'jug go'i mtha' can/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rin cen spungs (khro ji/pa zhes pa snyan ngag mkhan dpal ldan bsam yas pa'am klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa (klonge/sdeb sbyor rgya mtsho'i sprin/ mgon bo tshogasakyi bdag po mchod cing sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub kyi 'byung (me)gnas paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ mchod gtor 'bul zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba lta'i ni)tshar chen gyis mdzad pa phun tshogs dngos grub ma/ tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub thabs (|)slob dpon na ro pas mdzad pa gsang ba'i man ngag /chags pa rdo rje'i skor nas rgyud kyi bsdus don rnam par bshad pa'o'i mtha' can/tshogs bdag khro bo spre'u ltar sgrub pa bla ma gser gling pas mdzad pa/ spre'u ltar sgrub pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsang sgrub dpal a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i zab pa/ tshogs bdag gi gtor ma sa mtha'i mtha' can/ gsol gdab mi 'gyur bkod pa zhan byung spyan 'dren ri rab ma dang bcas pa/ chags pa rdo rje'i (284bshal gdams tshig gnyis ma/ sngags 'bum gyi gdams pa/ gaṇa pa ti spre'u'i sgrub thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ tshogs bdag gsang sgrub ces pa bsnyen pa bla rdo gnad dbab dang bcas pa ga lnga mar grags pa bla ma'i zhal las rnyed pa'i gdams pa/ 'gor sngags gzhan gnyis po 'di gong ma gtsigs che zhes yod pa'i spre'u'i zhal gdams bsam gtan gling pas mdzad pa thugs dam mnyam pa 'o'i mtha' can/ a mo ghas mdzad pa'i skor la/ la du 'chos thabs rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di'i 'og tu thun sngags zer ba logs su ma rnyed/ gzan nam chan la gtore ma bre gang yan chad bzang bar byas te zhes pa 'gor yod pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ tshogs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo de la 'di sgrub par 'dod pas zhes 'gor yod pa'i sgrub thabs dbu shar du bltas pa yin gsung ba'i mtha' can/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po'i gzungs la phyag 'tshal lo 'gor yod pa'i bstod pa bzhes su gsol gyi mtha' can/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo rnal 'byor longs spyod brtag dka' ba zhes 'gor yod pa'i sgrub thabs —409

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yonathob par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig 'di'i 'og tu bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabasani zhes sogs kyi sgrub thabs yod gsung ba dpe ma rnyed/ mig mthong gi gdams pa rnams/ dpe ris skor la/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ dmar chen dang dmar chung gi gtor dpe/ bse gdong can gyi ling ga /ga brgyad 'khor mtho/ 'di la (285na 'phags pa'i sku bsrung dang gong ma'i yig rnying gi lugs srol gnyis tsam yod/ gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo las bzhi sgrub pa'i gnam sa bar gsum gyi 'khor lo bcu gnyis/ tshar chen gyi sku gsung la rgyas pa'i steng 'khor gyi yi ge ma log pa dang 'jam dbyangs chen po'i sku bsrung la drag po'i steng 'khor yi ge log pa sogs gong ma'i gsung rgyun sku bsrung sogs kyi ba gnad mang bar snang ngo / rgyas pa'i bar 'khor gyi steng bar 'dri rgyu'i nor bu mig gsum/ thab gter gyi dngos grub myur du blang 'khor / tshogs bdag dang tsa ri tsaka zhal sbyor gyi thab dang mdzod kyi 'khor lo rnams kyi dbang lung phyag len man ngag legs par nos pa las thun mong gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ dpal rdo rje 'chang rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ grub chen sha wa ri pa/ bal po ha du dkar po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na hūṃ ka ra zer ba 'dug /bal po blo gros grags/rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje skyob pa dpal/ rdo rje gdan pa dang thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na 'di dang sa paṇa gyi bar na 'pha ga pa mi 'dug /rong pa shes rab seng ge /bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge gar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / nyi lde ba ngag dbang grags pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ de gnyis la rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ de gnyis ka la rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /yab sras (285ba)gnyis ka la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na tshar chen yab sras la/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang rta ra ba bsod nams —410

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)chos 'phel gnyis gas gsan/ gnyis ka nas rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na bla ma tshul rgyal ba nas/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan byang chub seng ge man 'dra/ yang ngor chen nas/ rje bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo ring pa chen po man 'dra/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ grub chen birlu pa/ shar phyog nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ gha ya dha ra/ bla chen 'byog mi/ 'khon dkon cog rgyal po/ brtse chen snying po'i zhabs/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na'ang 'di nyid la grags pas dngos su gsan 'dug /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangasabasod nams rgyal mchog /bdag chen 'jam dbyangs chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo ring pa/ rdo rje la'i tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ rje gzhon nu stobs ldan/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /khyad par ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan yan gong ltar la/ de nas khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag (286na tshe pa'o/ /yang na sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ khams sgom byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags pa'i gsan yig 'di'i tshab 'phags pa 'dug pa dpyad/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ ti shrī kun dga' blo gros/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ de gnyis la bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de nas yar klungs pa man 'dra/ yang na dga' ldan pa kun bsod nas/ gan pa rin rgyal/ 'bri phyug pa rin cen 'bum/ yar klungs pa man 'dra/ sa gcad dang po dang gnyis pa yongs rdzogs dang / lnga pa'i chen gyi rtags yod pa bcas pa'i lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yan thun mong yin pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa rigs bzhi po ltar la/ de nas dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur bka' drin mnyam med chos dbyings rang —411

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1)grol/ des bdag la'o/ /ngag gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de srasang ga dbang bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ klong gi rtags can ni/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa/pha rgod rtogs ldan rgyal po/ drin can thugs sras chos rje/ sprul sku rdo rje seng ge /dka' bcu pa pu ṣ+yosidha/ rje blo gros seng ge /rje rdo ring pa man 'dra/ me gi rtags yod pa ni/ kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po (286bto: ri ba dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po man 'dra/ rjes gnang dang gle'i rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ ngor chen yan thun mong gi rjes gnang ltar nas/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug /mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/rje grol mchog /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ bdag chen chu mig pa blo gros dbang phyug /paṇa chen shāka mchog /brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ mkhan chen bkras rnam pa/rje grol mchog man 'dra/ nā ro pa'i gsang sgrub dang / sa gcad drug pa'i na'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ nā ro pa nas pham thing pa brgyud de mal las 'ongs sam snyam yang gsan yig tshor mi gsal bas slar yang gsan yig ga 'a na 'dra las dpyad do/ /sa gcad gsum pa'i ḍom+bhi pa'i lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ ḍo sbyi he ru ka /dz+nyā na pas kriṣ+ṭha pa/ bhi na su ka /dharma sidha/ su kha ba ti/ rdo rje gdan pa/khro phu lo chen/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma 'ban ston/ bla ma rdo rje seng ge /dka' brgya pa bsod namasaseng ge /bla ma blo gros seng ge /rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po man 'dra/ 'di ni zhal gzigs kho nar bzhed pa yin no/ /chags pa rdo rje'i rjes gnang dang / sa gcad bzhi pa dang drug pa'i chos skor gyi lung brgyud ni/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ rgyal po grags pa/ bo dhi a ka ra/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na byang chub nga gnas su gzhur/ rin cen 'od zer/ yang dag sbyin pa/ rat+na ka ra shan+ti/ rin cen 'byung gnas zhi bar bsgyur/ jo bo a ti sha /rgya brtson 'grus seng gi grub thob shol po ba/ sangs rgyas dbon ston/ sangs—412

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rgyas(287na〉ston tshul/ khyung tshang pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ snar thang mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/dbu ma pa grub pa brtson 'grus/ chos rje dka' bcu pa gzhen nu seng ge /gung chen pa bkra shis bzang po/ gnyan phu pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na tshal min chos rje zer/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ chos rje klu dbang gling pa/ rigs 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ sa gcad bzhi pa tshogs bdag dkar po phyag bzhi pa dang / sa gcad drug pa'i a mo gha nas brgyud pa'i skor ni/ a mo gha badz+ra/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ dī paṃ ka ra/ lam yig sogs su jo bos nā ro par phyag mi mdzad pas chos 'grel med pa 'dra zer ba 'dug kyang bka' gdams glegs bam rin po cher brgyud pa'i khrod du bgrangs yod pa 'di dang mthun/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ po to pa rin chen gsal/ shar pa yon tan grags/ bya 'chad ka pa/ khro phu ba/ khyi lo/ yo ga /rdo rje gdan pa'i der yo pa zer ba snang / shī la pra bha wa/ dos ku mā ra/ lcan ban+de/ gsal ba sgang pa/ slob dpon dpal mgon/ slob dpon bde ba/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gas yig na slob dpon 'od ma zhes snang /tshal min chos rje man gong ltar/ yang na a mo gha badz+ra/rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ gragasapa/ sa paṇa/ khar ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma byang chen pa/ dka' bcu pa gzhen seng man 'dra/ sa gcad lnga pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa khu dbon nas/ bla ma dge sangs pa/drung gzims khang (287na bo bon po/ rje dkon cog bzang po/ tshar ba rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ /kye rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa sogs kye rdor gyi chos skor gyi lung brgyud sogs/kye rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud/ pad+ma he ru ga'i dbang du bsdu ba'i le'u sogs nas bstan pa'i khro bo dag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i chos skor ni/ dkar chag —413—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)las/ gsang ba'i snying po ā li kā li'i bcud/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa gzhan la ma grags pa/ /gsang chen chos kyi bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /gsang ba'i gdams pa zab mo 'di ltar snang / /zhes dang /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ gdams pa 'di dag grub pa'i bstan pa dang / /khyad par sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa'i ched/ nyams su blangs na yid ches 'phral du 'byung / zhes bsngags par mdzad pa don dang mthun pas bla ma ba ri bas mnga' bdag rtse lde sogs rgya bod mang po dbang du bsdus/ bal por bod thang zhes bya ba'i sa gzhi chen po gser dpag med kyi rin gyis nyos/ brtse ba chen por phrang brag dmar ba'i sde dgon gyis sku dgra byas pa 'di'i sgo nas dbang du bsdus/ gshen rdor gseng gis dpal phag mo grub pa dbang du mdzad/ do pa ston tshul ngam shod rje btsad kun gyi bla mar gyur/ rgyal tsha lung mang po hor rgyal po'i ti shrī ra bskur ba sogs ngo mtshar lo rgyus nges shes can gyi man ngag skor la/ sa paṇa gyi yi ge dang gong ma'i phyag bzhes la brten nas thun mong ba 'dod pa lha'i rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs mgon po'i yi ge dang phyag len ltar thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la thun slong ba/ thun mong ma yin pa/dkar chag tu ma bzhugs (288na)pa'i skor dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo gdams ngag 'di'i brgyud pa na zhes pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus rong pa dge ring gis zhus pa'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor pad+ma dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa'i dbang sdus las kyi 'khor lo yang sdud thugs kyi 'khor lo byung tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus cung zad rgyas par phye ba thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa chos kyi rjes gsung pa'o'i mtha' can/ dbang sdud dag chol ma'i lung gi rja gnang gi cho ga (rge)dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rgyas par bkod pa/ byin rlabs kyi lung blang pa'i zhal shes sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i man ngag zab mo/ bla ma sa skya pa'i gdams pa (klo/nam mkha' mdzod kyi rjes gnang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gro ge ma'i sgrub thabs ka kha ma'i sgrub thabs kyang zer/ kyi rjes gnang bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin —414

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)sngags 'chang rgyal ba dpal gyis sa skya'i sku 'bum gyi gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ sngags kyi rgyal po'i dam tshig gi dngos grub mchog sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub (:)thabs slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po de bzhin gshegs pa bsrung ba'i dpal gyi zhal snga nas dang bod kyi lo tsā ba rin cen grags kyis bsgyur ba/ gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor lo snod bcud dbang du bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta tha bi ra'i zhal snga nas dang / ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs (5)dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag ba ri pas bsgyur ba (288bsgo ba mas gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i man ngag bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ 'phrin las bzhi'i sgrub thabs kyi don yang dag par bsdus pa rgya sgom tshul khrims grags kyis mdzad pa/ slob dpon rin cen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gsal bar byed pa'i 'grel pa (mi/rin po che'i myu gu rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ 'gor zhi ba la kha dog dkar po zhes pa yod pa'i 'phrin las bzhi'i dbye ba'i man ngag zhi rgyas dbang drag thams cad de dang 'dra ba go bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'di 'khor lo rab tu gnas pa byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i las bzhi 'khor lo'i rab gnas so so'i skabs dang sbyar bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ bsnyen pa/ 'khor lo/ dngos gzhi/ tsakra sgrub pa/ rjes/ spogs pa/ gnad kyi man ngag /dngos grub dam tshig ste spyi don rnam pa dgus bstan pa'i spyi'i man ngag mdor bstan zhes bya ba dbang gi 'phrin las kyi lag len mngon rtogs dmar 'khrid du dge slong shī la kirtis bkod pa/ rgya sgom tshur khrims grags/ 'gor khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo a wa she ku ru ho yod pa'i dbang sdud dag chol gyi sgrub thabs rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa 'dzam gling gser gyis bkang ba bas kyang 'di mi dga' ri shi'i mtha' can/bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge ba ri lo tsā pa'i gser chos rje sa skya pa'i zhal gdams thun mong ma yin pa 'gor rnal 'byor pa sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i dus su zhes pa'i bzlas pa'i zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i gsung mi spel gsang ba'i rgyas btab pa'i mtha' can/ 'gor gsang sngags kyi rtsa bar —413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dbyangs yig dang zhes pa'i dbang gi gtor ma'i man ngag (7)dpal (289na kho ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i phyag bzhes so'i mtha' can/ dbang gi 'khor lo'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa bla rme ba ri lo tsā ba'i gdams pa/ 'gor thun bzhi la nyer spyod kyi mchod pa byed na yod pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba'i rim pa'o'i mtha' can/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bstod par rab dga' zla rgyas ma/ 'gor sangs rgyas don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo 'khor lo dpe chung ltar bris la zhes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa dang 'khor lo'i nang tshan bstan pa bla ma ba ri ba'i gdams ngag gnad khyad par du 'phags pa/ sgom pa'i dus kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i gdams ngag shin tu zab pa g.yin la gsang bar zhu'i mtha' can/ sngags byang 'byin 'jug dang bzlas thabs bla ma'i zhal las shes so'i mtha' can/ gnad kyi sgrub thabs snying dang 'dra ba/ 'gor oṃ shan+ti ka ra ṇi : yod pa'i sngags dang 'khor lo'i gnad lung 'bogs pa rā dza la sogs pa dbang du bya ba'i yig chung gzhan rnams gong dang mthun no'i mtha' can/ bri gzhi sogs lnga/ maṇ+ḍa sogs lnga/snod sogs brgyad de man ngag gi bsdus don nyung ngu mchan bu dang bcas par/ 'gor bsnyen pa 'dod rgyal la 'bum phrag nyer bzhi pa bskyal la zhes yod pa'i ka kha 'khor lo brtsegs rin cen 'phreng ba zhes pa la mi phyed pa/ dbang du gyur ba/ 'ong ba/ bcings pa bzhin 'gyur ba/ 'gugs pa/ nor rgyas pa/ gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa/ rig byed mas 'gugs pa/ bu mo dbang du byed pa/ gnod sbyin mo'i nor 'gugs pa/ thams cad dbang du byed pa/ bran du 'gyur ba/ 'bru 'phel ba/ (289ba thang mdzod mi zad pa/ sngar ma mthong ba'i bud med dang / rgyal po'i btsun mo 'gugs pa/ bltas pa/ byin pa/ brgyab pa/ reg pas dbang du 'gyur ba/ mi 'bral ba/ rgyal po dbang du bya ba/ ḍā ki thams cad 'ong ba sogs las phran tshegs bstan pa'i skor/ dbang gi sbyin sreg gi lag len snga ma chen po sa skya pa'i phyag bzhes sku gsung thugs kyi rab gnas kyi zhal gdams zin bris/ tsakra'i rab gnas bya thabs ba ri lo tsā ba'i gdams ngag /bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge bsdus pa bar gcod mi 'byung zhing las myur ba —416

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)yin gsung ba'i mtha' can/ ḍā ki ma'i 'gro ba dbang sdud kyi gdams pa zhes pa dbang drag gi man ngag zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo bu d+dha a mo gha sid+dhi zhes yod pa'i 'khor los bsgrub bya 'gugs pa sogs ba ri lo tsā ba'i gdams pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhal gdams bod du thon pa'i man ngag la 'di las zab pa med do'i mtha' can/ 'khor lo'i yi ge la gtor ma 'bul ba'i zhal gdams bla (sa/ma sa skya pa chen po'i phyag bzhes/ gnod sbyin rin cen sgrub pa'i u pa de sha /'gor wa she ku ru ho gro ga mdzub gang pa gcig la zhes pa'i 'khor lo'i man ngag gsung tshad ma gru bzhir bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor gro ga mdzub gang la nang du sor bdun tsam zhes pa'i 'khor lo'i bri thabs sba ba'i man ngag bzla tshe sbrel nas bzla zhes pa'i mtha' can/ dbang gi tsakra'i zhal gdams nam mkha' mdzod kyis gdams pa nyung la 'dus pa khyad du 'phags so'i mtha' can/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gnad bod du 'gyur ba'i gdams pa zab pa nus pa chung (290na)du mi 'gro ba'i gnad yin no'i mtha' can/ 'gor yar tshes brgyad la rjes gnang zhu'o yod pa'i zhal gdams zin bris ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub bo rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ ḍā ki ma'i gdams pa rdzun mi smra'o'i mtha' can/ ḍā ki ma'i srog snying khong nad phyung pa ba ri lo cwa ba'i gdams pa chig brgyud/ bla ma ba ri pas sag thang pa dang dol po bsod nams 'phel la gnang ba'i ḍā ki ma sgrub pa'i lag len zhes pa 'khor lo/ bzlas sgom mchod gtor lag len ga'u gzhung dang mthun zhes pa rnams bstan pa/rtags kyi yi ge ltas/ba ri lo tsā ba bod du 'byon khar bla ma rdo rje gdan pas gnang ba/ gzhan dbang du byed pa'i gdams pa rin po che'i zhal gdams mthar thug /tshe bsring ba'i thabs/ de'i zhal shes pad+ma kha sbyor gyi ting 'dzin/ rgyas pa'i gtor ma'i phyag bzhes dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍita'i khyad par gyi man ngag /drag po'i 'phrin las bsgrub par 'dod pasahrūb nas dben par sba'o'i mtha' can/ bla ma la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas lung 'bogs pa'i gdams pa/ chu dang phyag rgya'i nyin bsrung mtshan bsrung gi man ngag de'i yi ge mchan bu dang bcas pa bar du gcod pa rnams srung shig gi mtha' can —417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rnams/ man ngag 'di'i mjug tu bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen bos/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sa skya pa'i dbang sdud man ngag khyad par can/ snyan brgyud zhal gdams ma gtogs pa/ /thun mong chos skor tshang bar bzhugs/ /snod ldan slob ma 'ga' tsam las/ /g.yin la rgya cher spel mi bya/ /rdo rje lta bur rtogs dka' zhing / /rtogs na yid bzhin nor (290ba'i dra'i chos/ des na 'di lta'i zab don la/ /mkhas pas gces spras bya bar rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shin tu zab cing dkon pa'i chos 'di snying gi thig ler 'chang ba'i 'os so/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la/ khams gsum 'gro ba dbang byad dag chol gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus (mi)mkhas pa yon tan khris mdzad pa/ dbang sdud dag chol ma'i ā li kā li'i sngags ring 'dri bzlas kyi man (7)ngag sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas dag cing gsal bar mdzad pa/ dag chol chen mo'i rtsa ba'i tho yig brjed byang tsam du shrī ā nan+da gar+bhas rje byu/ mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i de 'grel khyi ka sbas pa mig 'byed gser gyi thur ma/ 'khor lo'i rab gnas bya ba'i man (7)ngag zhal gdams dang bcas pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rgyas par bkod pa/ des bkod pa'i bde ba rgyas byed ma'i sku ltas/la brten pa'i dbang gi nang sgrub zab mo/ gsang sgrub tha chen gyi tsakra'i man ltas/ngag rje btsun rin po che grags pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i gnad 'bebs (rge/nyi zla'i 'khor lo'i gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i spogs chog gis gnad la dbab (5)pa'i man ngag sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rgyas par bkod pa/des mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i man ngag (mi)bla ma'i zhal las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ yul bdag dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal gdams ba ri'i man ngag rje sa skya pa'i gdams pa/ 'gor bzlas pa'i sngags kyi man ngag ni zhes yod pa'i sngags kyi 'byin la jug gi yi ge las de gzhan du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro'i mtha' can/ gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor lo'i bsdus don rang bsrung ngo'i mtha' can/ ma 'grub spogs pa'i cho ga mnyam par bzhad (291na to'i mtha' can/ 'khor lo blta ba tshigs kyi zhal gdams smin mtshams su reg pa'o'i mtha' can/ ma 'grub gnad 'bebs kyi 'khor lo gces par —418

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)zung gi mtha' can/ 'gor kho bo'i bla ma 'di skad gsung zhes pa yod pa'i pho mo gnad 'bebs kyi 'khor lo/ 'gor phyi sgrub 'khor lo chen mo zhes yod pa'i gnad 'bebs nyi zla'i gdams pa/ 'gor bla ma'i zhal gdams 'dri bar bya zhes pa yod pa'i pho mo gnad 'bebs kyi 'khor lo'i zhal gdams sa skya pa chen po'i zhal gyi gdams pa ma bu 'di rnams bris pa lags kyi mtha' can/ 'gor dngos grub kyi mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo zhes yod pa'i mtha' can 'khor lo'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs the tshom med do'i mtha' can/ de'i zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i gdams ngag nor bu rin po che phag mo grub pa la gnang ba/ tha chen 'khor lo'i yi ge dbang bsdus dam pa/ 'gor bla ma bde chen lhag pa'i lha zhes yod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i rjes sgrub gshen bde ba'i rdo rjes bla ma sa skya pa chen por zhus pa khyad par gnad kyi gdams pa'o'i mtha' can/ de'i gsal byed 'gor mkha' 'gro bde ba rgyas byed kyi sku zhes yod pa'i zhad btsun sag thang pa'i zhal gdams/ 'phrin las myur du sgrub pa dbang gi rlung 'khor zab mo dang (rge)rlung lha las la gzhug pa sogs gab pa'i man ngag sa skya pa'i zhal gdams/ 'gor dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang zhes yod pa'i a'i gdams pa zur gcig 'dri ba ā li gnad kyi gdams pa rin cen yid bzhin nor bu bla ma'i bka' rgya can/ de'i (291bstol shes 'gor spyir ni khams gsum sems can thams cad la zhes yod pa dbang gi gdams pa'i mtha' can/ ā li'i sbyin sreg gshen gyi lugs/ rje sa chen dang 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa gnyis kyi zhu ba (rgyad nu lan ā li kā li las sna tshogs la 'jug pa zhes pa'i gdams pa le'u nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/'dod rgyal yab yum sbrags te sgrub pa'i man ngag lag len du dril ba'i nag po 'gro shes bshes gnyen gra bo rin cen phan gyi don du sngags 'chang rgyal po dpal gyis mdzad pa/ de'i zhal shes de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sa skya pa'i gdams pa khyad par 'phags pa 'dzam gling gser gyis bkang ba las ches cher dga' ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi zur 'debs 'jam dbyangs mgon pos mdzad pa/ dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel (2)pa 'gro ba'i srog snying 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ khyad par gyi sgrub thabs nor bu gsal 'bar snying gi thig le'i dang ma drung nam mkha' bzang pos bskul nas rin po che bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi gsung las skyed pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa ri khrod dbang pos bsam gtan gling du mdzad pa/ mkha ngag chog pa'i ga yig na bsam gto gling pa dpal ldan bzang pos mdzad ces snang / 'di gser chos shin tu zab pa'i tshigs brgyud dusagacig la slob ma gcig las mi ston pa'i bka' rgya can yin te/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las/ snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams pa 'di/ /snod ldan slob ma gcig la ni/ /bstan par bya yi g.yin du min/ /gsang ste nyams su blang bar rigs/ /(292na tshe tshes pa ltar sa gcad gnyis pa 'di bka' dog par mdzad pa'i rgyun ma nyams par yid kyi dran gsor bsten par rigs so/ /gsum pa dkar chag tu ma bzhugs pa la/ dbang bsdus 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud 'debs pad+ma rā ga'i chun po tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ 'gor rtsa ba'i 'khor lo 'di la zhes pa'i 'khor lo'i bri yig zin bris gsang ba ni gcig la yin no'i mtha' can/'gor 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas zhes pa'i 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa gtor ma bya khyi dang mi gzhan la mi sbyin no'i mtha' can/ byin rlabs kyi lung blang pa'i gsal byed tsha rong ba rin cen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ 'dod rgyal yab yum gyi rjes gnang gces spras su mdzad pa (ngag)rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung las mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis zin thor btab pa/ des mdzad pa'i gsang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang bklags chog tu bkod pa (ngag)zhar byung thun mong gi rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ nyi zla 'khor lo'i rig pa ban+de bsam gtan gling pas gak+ṣ-i na la phan pa'i sems kyis mdzad pa rnams/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na bsam gtan gling pa phyi ma zhes snang ba nor bu gsal 'bar mdzad mkhan dang gcig gam snyam/ dpe ris skor la/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal mi 'dra ba gsum/ rab gnas kyi maṇ+ḍal 'dra min gsum/ gtor ma'i maṇ+ḍal zhi rgyas dbang drag phyi sgrub kyi 'khor lo bzhi/ drag po'i 'khor lo 'dra min gnyis/ yang sa chen gyi ba ched pa dang mthun (292ba)pa 420

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gcig /las bzhi sgrub pa'i 'khor lo kha sbyor bzhi/ sbas pa mig 'byed nas gsungs pa'i rgyas pa'i 'khor lo/ pho mo gnad kyi 'bor lo bzhi yod pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i gsung dang mthun pa dang po/phag gru'i bzhed pa dang mthun pa gnyis pa/ dpe ris rnying pa kho na la thugs gtsigs su mdzad pa gsum pa/ gsum pa'i mu khyud kyi sngags dum bu gsum du byas pa bzhi pa/ gnad 'bebs nyi zla'i 'khor lo rigs mi gcig pa gsum/ dril sgrub la dgos pa'i tha chen 'khor lo/ gsang sgrub tha chen 'khor lo/ nang sgrub yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi 'khor lo re/ rlung 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang lung man ngag phyag len dmar 'khrid du thob pa las thun mong ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ dpal mchog rdo rje chos/ yum bde ba rgyas byed ma/ grub chen dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ grub chen la lī ta badz+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ rdo rje gdan pa chung ba s+tha bi ra/ba ri lo chen/ rje bzhi brtseb wo po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje bas rin po che/ rje sa paṇa/ 'phagasapa rin po che/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung gi dbang phyug /mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ mkhas grub chen po yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dbon bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ yab 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo ring pa/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /yab sras gnyis ka la rdo rje 'chang dbang rab kyis gsan/ de nas khyab bdag mgon po (293na tha sod nams mchog ldan/ rigs kun bdag po chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /yang na rdo ring rin po che nas/ rje sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ tshar chen man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen yab sras gnyis nas/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na rje mkhyen brtse nas/ drang srong dka' bzhi pa'i sras gzhen nu stobs ldan/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje mkhyen brtse nas/ mkhas grub gzhen nu stobs ldan 'od zer/ rje dbang rab/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /—421 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)ngag gi rtags can ma gtogs pa'i rtags yod med la ma bstos pa'i lung phyag len dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse nas/ mkhas grub bsod nams chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang rab man zur chos dbyings rang grol bzhugs pa ltar ro/ /ba ri bas sag thang par gnang ba'i chos skor ni/ jo btsun sag thang pa/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na lcags thang zhes pa snang / rje se chung pa/ sa chen man gong bzhin no/ /ngag gi rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ rin po che rta ra ba dang rje dbang rab gnyis nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ 'khon ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang thun mong ba'i rjes gnang dang rgya'i rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ kun spangs rje nas/ rje kun dga' grol mchog /(293ba'i jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ bla ma gzhon nu 'bum/ bag ston ga thon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ bdag chen bzhi thog pa kun dga' dbang phyug /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ khang ston bsod nams 'bum/ bag ston gzhon tshul man 'dra/yang na sa paṇa nas/ shar pa sher 'byung / de'i gcung rdo rje 'od zer/ 'dul 'dzin bsod nams ye shes/ bla ma bsod nams dar/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / glo bo mkhan chen/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ bdag chen chu mig pa blo gros dbang phyug /paṇa chen shāka mchog /brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ mkhan chen bkras rnam pa/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos dzam dmar srog sgrub kyi skor la/ yig rnying rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa'i mchan ma dang thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i lhan thabs ltar si/ ra'i dkyil 'khor du gnod sbyin dmar po yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bzlas pa dam bca'i lung dang gtor dbang dod kyi chu sbyin bcas nod nas/ lung la gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i —422

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)yi ge la nang gses kyi rten bca' ba/ bsnyen sgrub/ las la bskul ba dang bcas pa bla ma chen pos ma sbas par dbal kha gdangs su yi ger bkod pa sa mtha'i mtha' can/ lung blang ba'i man ngag bla ma'i gsung bzhin dpal (294na tshe ldan sa skyar sbyar ba/ 'di yan gyi mchan rnams rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pas mdzad la/ dam lha'i mas bu rdo rje gdan pas mdzad do/ /kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi gsal byed/ gra pa dang gser chos kyi dzam dmar gnyis kyi rjes gnang lhan cig pa'i phyag len gzhan rnams dkyus kyi yi ge bzhin no'i mtha' can dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa/ slob dpon shar phyogs nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ gha ya dha ra/ bla chen 'byog mi/ bla ma mnga' ris ba gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon skye chu ba/ rje btsun brtse chen/ slob dpon rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/bla ma yar sgom se bo/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung gi dbang phyug /mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog /mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / brag thog pa dpal 'dzin bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ rje blo gros rnam rgyal/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /yab sras gnyis ka la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na tshar chen nas/ rje bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ gur rdzong pa chos 'byor dpal bzang / sngags 'chang gzhon nu don grub/ zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /lung gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen (294ba)brtse nas/ 'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang / rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/ 423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i skor gyi lung brgyud/dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i skor la/ tshom bu la brten pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bzlas lung dang bcas pa legs par nod nas/ lung la 'jam dpal nag po'i gnad bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i gdams pa nyams su len tshul zhar byung shin tu rtsub cing rnam rtog ches za ba'i tshe bya tshul phan yon dang bcas pa nyams su myong bas kyang grub bo'i mtha' can/'gor bla ma dang 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo 'jam dpal nag po bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rjes bsngo ba sogs bya'o'i mtha' can/ gu ge paṇa chen gyis bdag chen ma dkon cog rgyal mo'i don du mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang bcas pa thob pa'i rgyu 'gul bas mdzad pa ma gtogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun brtse chen/ slob dpon rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ shad dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma ye shes dpal/ blo bzang dkar mo/ dkon cog thugs rje/ gling smad paṇ+ḍita shes rab dpal ldan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ slob dpon rin cen chos mchog /mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ mtshungs med rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na khyab bdag (295na dbang rab nas/ rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /rgyu 'gul paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa nas/ 'ad mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma mnyam med pa/ bla ma shākya pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun bzang po rgyu —424

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'gul paṇa chen/ gu ge paṇa wo grags pa rgyal ma' gyi mas gyi rnam grangs yin/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor wo dkon cog lhun grub/ de dbon dkon cog dpal ldan/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /sgom lung gi brgyud pa ni/ slo bo mkhan chen nas/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rin po che bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ spang khang pa grags pa seng ge /bla ma mang mkhar ba/ bla ma byang seng ba/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ gnas rnying chos rje kun dga' bde legs/ se ra rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ pha bong kha pa bde legs nyi ma/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i lcags ri mi bda' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan 'chi med rdo rje'i lha mo zhes dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bshad rgyud a bhi dha na las gsung pa'i rdo rje che'i lha mo'i rjes su gnang (295ba tha rgyu 'gul paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi yi ge la brten nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen lha hi pa/ grub chen dha ri ka pa/ an+tat+pa/ ti slo pa/nā ro pā da/ pham thing pa sku mched gnyis/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo blo gros grags/ rje btsun brtseb chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje paṇ+ḍita/ zhad mdo sdod pa la/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /bla ma dam pa bsod namasargyal mtshan/ bla ma byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ de dbon sangs rgyas rin cen/ de dbon dkon cog rgya mtsho/ bla ma dge 'dun dbang phyug /mus chen sangs rgyas rab brtan/ bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams grags pa/mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'jam dpal rdo rje sa skya pa ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu ba/ des bdag la bka' drin du stsal to/ /—423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi skor la/ pad+ma rak+ta 'am rdo ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas seng gdong nag mo'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang khyad par can nos nas/ lung la ngor nas brgyud pa dang gong dkar ba nas brgyud pa ste gnyis/ dang po la/ 'gor rgya gar skad du tsakra saṃ bha ra ma hā ya na su tra zhes yod pa'i ba ri bas gter brtan nas mu stegs skal ldan rgyal po btul ba'i lo rgyus/ mu stegs gsad pas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar rdo rje gdan pas lo tsā ba mjal khar ma bto zer ba bog /(296na stond du byon nas sa chen kun snying la gnang ngo'i mtha' can/'gor sgrub thabs ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra zhes yod pa'i mngon rtogs gnyis su med par gyur nas sngags bzla ba'i mtha' can/ zlog pa'i dmigs pa dang dus gnad/ gsod pa'i dmigs gnad/ zhar byung sku smad phur bas 'gegs bsgral zhing ngag gnon thabs/ mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi bsrung ba mo'i g.yas la btags so de ni bsrung ba bo'i mtha' can/ seng gdong dkar mo'i tshe sgrub tshe nyi zla dang mnyam mo'i mtha' can/ nor sgrub 'bum tsho gcig bzlas nas 'grub bo'i mtha' can/seng gdong dmar mo'i dbang sdud gser srang do'i bka' rgya yod do'i mtha' can/ sre'u gso ba gser 'bul dgos so'i mtha' can/ char 'bebs mtha' ma lnga la mi 'bab mi srid do'i mtha' can/ mtshan med kyi char gcod ri mgo thams cad me ris khengs par bsgom char gcod pa'i man ngag go'i mtha' can/ bye ma la brten pa'i 'bu bsrung / chu la brten pa'i sad bsrung ba/ mtshan med kyi ser bsrung rnam gzhag gzhan las shes so'i mtha' can/ mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi thog thub ngas so'i mtha' can/khar gong la brten nas lus gnad gcod pa/ bal skud la brten nas g.yag nad gcod pa/ chu la brten nas lhog pa bsrung ba/ rdzas gnyis kyis dud pas rims bsrung ba/ sran mas 'brum bu bsrung ba/ khyi bal gyis 'khru ba gcod pa/ me rtsas mgo yor bsrung ba/ 'dogs pa'i mtshon bsrung man ngag zhal las shes so'i mtha' can/ gu gul gyis bza' nad 'chos thabs/ (296ba tshe dmigs pas jag pa 'ching pa ste las tshogs nyi shu rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro'i gdams pa rgya mtsho'i nang nas zab mo chu 426

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)thigs tsam zhig bkod pa/ 'gor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la zhes yod pa'i khyad par gyi zlog pa bsams pa'i don rnams 'di yis/ 'grub bo'i mtha' can/ mkha' 'gro ma shin tu drag mor byed pa'i ma can rtogs yi ge bcu bzhi pa sham bu can/ rtags/ gtor 'bul/ mtheb mdzub kyi dmigs pa/kha phyogs/ mtheb skyu la brten nas jag pa chom rkun bsrung ba dang bcas pa bla ma sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i man nga gnywa'i mtha' can/ mngon rtogs rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang gis chos lung bla ma'i gdan sar sbyar ba rnams/ gnyis pa gong dkar ba nas brgyud pa la/ 'gor mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can la phyag 'tshal lo 'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i yi ge mi dag las mang ba la sbyin pa med do zhes dam bcas nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pas ba ri lo tsā bar gdams pa'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdams pa 'di'i lo rgyus bla ma pa ri lo tsā ba dang mu stegs skal ldan rgyal po zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus dang sdig sbyongs su gser gyi gsung rab bris gsungs pa'i mtha' can/ mtshan bcas kyi bsrung bas byad kha mkhan po kho rang la zlog pa/thal rdab kyis dgra 'chi ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyis ngag gnon pa/ sngags kyis phyogs ngan bdud gcod bsrung pa/ bzlas pa'i mchil mas mtshon bsrung ba/ rkang 'og gi sa sa g.yul gyi rang phyogs kun bsrung ba/ sngags kyis jag pa 'ching ba/ mkha' 'gro ma (297na dmar mo'i nor dang tshe sgrub cing bsod nams spel ba/ rmi lam ngan pa zlog par kha gtod pa'i gnad/ dri chus rims nad bsrung ba/bsnyen tshad dang sham bu'i zhal shes/ seng gdong dmar mo la brten pa'i khyad par gyi zlog pa bsam pa'i don rnams thams cad 'grub pa'i mtha' can/ phyir zlog man ngag tshigs bcad ma zhal gdams bla ma'i man ngag las byung ngo'i mtha' can/ rdo rje phag mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs dang bzlas pas thun mong gi dngos grub mi rtogs pa/ sgrib pa sreg pa/ drod bskyed pa/ g.yin gyi bgegs zlog pa bcas bstan pa mkha' 'gro ma bdag gis dbang du sdud do'i mtha' can/ gtor ma gtong ba dang bskul ma mo mkha' 'gro ma zhar byung me mchod dang bcas pa badz+ra ḍā kai ni ye 'grub bo'i mtha' —427

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nas/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ go shrī nam mkha' bzang po/ bdag chen rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen (298na tor bum phrag gsum pa/ sngags 'chang yon tan rgya mtsho/gong dkar zur 'chad pa o rgyan rgyal bo/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal po/ nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ de gnyis la rab 'byams chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho de nas khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag la'o/ /ngor nas brgyud pa'i lung brgyud/ngor nas brgyud pa'i lung ni/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod nas bla ma dam par brgyud pa'i slo bo mkhan chen nas/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhyen rab rje/ zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po sa lo man gcig /gong dkar ba nas brgyud pa'i lung ni/ brag phug pa nas bla ma dam par brgyud de gong dkar zur 'chad pa rnams las 'ongs pa bshad ma thag pa de'o/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi steng du gcig bsnan pa'i klu pa'i gser chos bcu bzhir gser chos brgya bzhi'i gras la rdo ring rin po tshe'i gsan yig na birnya pa bdud rtsi 'dul ba'i man ngag rtses dang bsam gtan gling pa'i chos rje zhal bu dbon po la gsan tshul 'dug kyang deng sang rgyun med pa 'dra'o/ /grags pa'i ya rgyal 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i ngag bsrung 'grol gyi man ngag shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug myong bas thon pa'i lung man ngag nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa seng ge'i sgra/ slob dpon dze (298ba)tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun chen po grags pa/ yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/—429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog /'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mchod dpon dkon cog pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /de'i cha lag tu gtogs pa seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang bshad ma thag pa'i mngon rtogs dang lung gsum gyi chings la brten nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ seng ge sgra/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi/de'i slob ma gcig /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang yang / lo pa spyan snga dang rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams kyi gsan yig na bram ze dpal 'dzin du ngos bsgrung / paṇa grub nā ro pa chen po/ pham thing pa sku mched/ a thu la dha sa badz+ra/ me lha gling pa/ lo pa spyan snga dang shar pa'i gsan yig na bha ro phyag rdum zer ba 'dug pa 'di gnyis 'jigs byed kyi chos 'byung tshor gcig mi gcig sna tshogs yod 'dug pas 'khrul gzhi byung ba 'dra yang 'di ni bal po thugs rje chen po yin pas bha ro dang mi gcig par snang ngo / /mal lo blo gros grags/ shar pa'i gsan yig na 'dis gong ma gnyis ka la gsan gsungs/rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ gnyan phul byung ba gtsug tor rgyal po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje sa paṇa/ (299na gar pa sher 'byung / shar pa ye shes rin cen/ dus 'khor ba yang zer/ kun dga' byang chub/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge /rje btsun go rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ zha lu mkhan chen khyab bdag rin cen bsod na mas mchoge grub/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / 'dren mchog dkon cog 'phel/ ngor chen dkon cog —430

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lhun grub/ byang gling rje/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo po mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang dkon cog lhun grub kyi yi ge ltar nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dkon cog lhun grub yan gong ltar la/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgo nas gdon 'grol ba'i cho ga rin cen 'phreng mdzes kyi lung phyag bzhes bcas thob pa'i brgyud (299ba)pa ni/ slob dpon shā d+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo blo gros grags/ brtse chen/ gnyan gtsug tor rgyal po/ rje btsun chen po/ sa paṇa/shar pa ye 'byung / shar pa dus 'khor ba/ kun dga' byang chub/ mkhan po rgyal bzang ba/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang / rgyal tshab kun dbang /dkon cog 'phel/ dkon cog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ thar rtse nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ glo bo mkhan chen/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis go na ba chos rje'i don du mdzad pa'i seng ge sgra'i bsnyen thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ mkhas pa dpal ldan don grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' sangasang rgyas/ drin can zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /'khon rigs 'jam dpal rdo rje rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bstan pa bsrung pa'i chos skyong grags med pa zhig bka' babs ba'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa ma ga dha rdo rje gdan gyi sgo skyong 'phags yul paṇa grub rnams kyi srung ma'i gtso bo rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po ni/ mkha' —431—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos nag po chen po 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo zhes pa ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i sprul par bstan pas phyogs re'i (300na rdzal pa'i srung ma rnams ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo ste/ tshul de la dgongs nas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis/ bgrang yas bstan srung kun gyi sde dpon che/ /dran pas snying gi mun sel rdo rje gur/ /zhes ched du brjod pa'ang rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho na yin la/ 'di nyid kyi khungs kyang mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba dang khrag mtsho khol ma sogs bod kyi mkhas pa thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston gyis the tshom gyi gzhir mdzad pa'i rgyud tsam la lhos mi dgos par rtsod bral gyi rgyud mgon po mngon par 'byung ba/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur lha mo'i khungs 'phags yul na bzhugs pa'i gdan bzhi'i rgyud pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bod kyi mkhas pa dag the tshom gyi gzhir mdzad na'ang / rang lugs rgyud de dag tshad mar bzhed cing / gal ce rgyad dngos min kyang grub thob tshad ldan gyi gsung yin pas rgyud dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i khungs su 'os pa/ mgon po khros rgyud dngos grub 'byung ba/ gsang ba dur khrod nag po/ dur khrod chen po gri gug brtsegs pa/ me lce 'bar ma/ bshan pa nag mo/ ma mo srog gi 'khor lo sogs las gas pa bar bstan pa'i gdams skor la/ma hā kā la'i chos skor gyi brjed byang bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng ba las/ khyab bdag gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor ni/ 'phags pa'i yul du paṇa grub rnams kyis phye/ /rgyud rgyal ma dros chu gter las byung ba'i/ /bka' babs rnam bzhi'i gdams pa'i chu rgyun ni/ /lo tsā rnam bzhi'i gsung gi 'bab stegs las/ /legs 'ongs sa skya'i bla chen thugs (300ba〉pa tshor 'khyil/ gang de'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i gzigs ma ni/ /phyogs brgyar 'phros pas kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /zab ston lbu 'phreng bye bas phyug pa yin/ /rjes 'brangs chu klung rnam bzhi ring du 'babs/ /zhes pa ltar rgyud rgyal rnams gyi gdams pa'i snying po 'phags yul paṇa grub rnams kyis srol rgyas bsdus sna tshogs su btod pa'i nang —432

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (kananas rnal 'byor dbang phyug birnya pa las brgyud pa'i lam/ 'bras pa'i gur mgon lo chen 'brog mis bsgyur ba/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa las brgyud pa sgrub thabs kun las btus pa lugs kyi mgon po ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po paṇa chen shākya shrī las brgyud pa'i mgon po sa lo tsā ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred kyi gdams pa lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur ba mal lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa ste lo paṇa bzhi las brgyud pa'i bka' ma chad pa'i chu bo chen po bzhi'i rgyun ltar babs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gis/ deng nas dus kun rgyud rgyal kai la sha/ /snyan brgyud tsha zer gyis sbran gdams pa'i rgyun/ /ma dres chu klung las 'ongs bka' babs bzhi'i/ /zab don bdud rtsis bdag rgyud tshim par shog /ces gsung pa yin zhing / gyi ljang lugs ni lo chen rin bzang nas mal lor rgyud nga/ min na'ang / sdod lugs smad lugs gnyis su byung ba'i stod lugs rnams mal lo nas brgyud pa yi na pas bka' babs phyi ma'i khongs su don gyis 'du zhing / lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang lo chen nas brgyud pa dang gyi ljang smad lugs kyi gdams skor rnams rje btsun gong ma rnams las ma brgyud (301na jo'ang / bzhi thog pa sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba nas sa lugs su bka' babs pas deng sang ma/na ngag rnams phyogs gcig tā mdzad pa yin no/ /de la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa zab rgyas kyi dbang gis gdung brgyud kho na'i snan nas snyan du brgyud pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa khu dbon nas brgyud pa/ sbas pa'i rngal 'byor rdo rje rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa/ ngor rdzong gong dkar ba gsum so sor brgyud pa gsum las/ yar klungs pa dang bar sdings pa gnyis snyan brgyud kyi khongs su bsdus te gcig tu byas nas zhal ngo brgyud pa dang / ngor rdzong gong gsum la slob brgyud du byas te gdams ngag gi bka' srol 'dzin pa'i rjes 'brang bzhir mdzad pa'i/ dang po ni/ deng sang kha'u brag rdzong pa mtshar lugs su grags pa 'di nyid la bka' babs shing / 'on kyang thun mong ba'i gdams pa rnams kyang yongs su rdzogs par mnga' —433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)bas kha skong dkar chag zab don gsal sgron las/ kho bos rgyal khams yangs pa'i phyogs kun myul/ /mkhas grub bla ma mang po'i zhabs pad bsten/ /rang g.yin gdams pa zab mo'i gnas kun shes/ /dag dang ma dag 'byed pa'i spobs pa thob/ /khyad par nag po chen po'i man ngag ni/ /brgyud ldan bla ma bcu phrag gcig la zhus/ /'gran zla kun bral drin can rdo ring pa'i/ /snyan brgyud zab mo bum pa gang byor thob/ /e waṃ pa ni bsdus la spros pa chung / /mus sras ba ni dkar chag khrigs chags can/ /rdo rje gdan pa 'chams dang nus pa'i bdag /kho bos thob pa'i thun mong brgyud pa gsum/ /zhes gsungs pas thun mong ba'i brgyud pa (301ba)gsum las 'ongs pa'i dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag dang / gtso bor bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i me 'bar dkar chag las/ bdag ni chos skyong man ngag la/ /mkhas grags cung zad yod pa'i phyir/ /khams gtsang dbus pa'i grwa pa sogs/ /sngon chad slob ma mang byung yang / /nges par snod dang ldan pa dang / /snying nas dad ldan ma gyur phyir/ /snying po gyur pa'i man ngag rnams/ /yang mdzod dmar po thugs dkyil las/ /gzhan nas rnyed par mi 'gyur bas/ /dad ldan yod na blang bar gyis/ /zhes dang / bsam 'phel nor 'phreng las/ khyad par sa skya'i bla chen thugs kyi bcud/ /mkhas grub gzhan gyis ma thob gsang chen mchog /gdung brgyud gong ma'i snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor/ /zhal shes phyag 'khrid ma lus legs par snang / zhes pa ltar 'khon gyi gdung brgyud tshang dang slob ma sa skya tshang kyi rna bar ma grags pa'i rin cen sgang pa sgos kyi zhal ngo nang brgyud snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi byin rlabs rjes gnang nyams khrid man ngag phyag len dmar 'khrid dang / thun mong ba nos pa'i skor rnams las/ bka' babs dang po grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba birnya pa nas brgyud pa'i nag po chen po dpa' bo gcig pa'i tshom bu dang gtor ma la brten pa'i rjes gnang / bka' babs gnyis pa bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i lugs kyi mgon po dpa' bo gcig pa'i tshom bu'i rjes su gnang ba/ bka' babs gsum pa la rjes gnang med pas 'dir ma smos/ bka' babs bzhi pa slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyi gdams —434

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa snying po'i man ngag zab cing rtogs bka' ba mkhas (302na)rlom phal gyi mig dang rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa gsang chen gdams pa'i skor la/ tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar na khog 'bubs lo rgyus rnams kyi bla ma tshad ma/ nyams 'khrid dang mngon spyod drag po'i las sbyor sogs phyag len dmar 'khrid du bstar ba nyams myong tshad ma/ rgyab rten gyi man ngag be bum rnams kyi bstan bcos tshad ma/bshad khungs kyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung rnams kyi lung tshad ma 'gyur/ gtso bor snyan brgyud bzhi dang sbyor dgos pa/ de yang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung sgros sogs brgyud ldan gyi yi ge mang por byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra ba'i bka' ma nub pa/ gdams ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i sa rga ma log pa/ mos gus gzhen nu'i dga' ba lta bu'i bsam pa tshim pa/ longs spyod lha 'dod yon la rtse ba lta bu'i dpal 'byor gyi rgyun ma nyams pa'am/ lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dgongs 'grel paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa sogs bla ma snga phyi mang po'i gsung sgros su gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis go ldog pa dang / yang na bsam 'phel nor 'phreng las/ phyi nang gsang ba'i man ngag zhu ba'i tshe/ /tshogs dang gtor mas mkha' 'gro mnyes par byas/ /rin chen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul/ /gsang chen grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i dam bca' byas/ /zhes pa ltar rdo rje'i slob dpon thugs gting nas mnyes par 'gyur ba'i snyan brgyud dang snyan brgyud kyi rgyu la ming btanas/ po'i rten 'brel bsgrigs rjes/snyan brgyud gnyis/ rdo rje slob dpon la ltos pa'i sngon 'gro'i snyan brgyud/ pa dbang rjes gnang byin rlabs
