kyi bka' chu bo'i rgyun ma nub pa/ snyan brgyud gsum/ rdo rje slob (302ba)dpon la bltas pa'i dngos gzha'i snyan brgyud/ pa man ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang 'dra ba gdams pa'i sa rga ma log pa thob par brten nas snyan brgyud ci bzhi/ snyan brgyud kyi 'bras bu la ming btags/ pa mos gus ga cho zhe nu'i bde ba lta bu shugs la 'byung ba'i go rim mi 'dra ba gnyis snang na'ang don kyi cha la khyad par med cing 'dir snyan brgyud ha la nag po'i sbyar byang gi rjes su 'brangs pa yin la/ de ltar snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi snyan brgyud gnyis pa la dbang dang rjes gnang gnyis/ dang po dbang gi bka' ma nub pa la/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa'am —433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par rtogs pa bdud las rnam rgyal dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mgon po rnam rol gnyis la brten nas bla ma'i phyag len bzhin rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khar du bram ze chen po nas nye bar brgyud pa'i mgon po gri gug lha lnga'i rig pa'i dbang lnga/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang / brtan byed du chu'i dbang / sngags kyi bzlas lung dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs grags pas mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil bshad ma thag pa'i steng nas bla ma mal lo'i bzhed pa'i lha brgyad ma'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i dbang lnga rjes gnang bzlas lung dang bcas pa/ mngon dkyil de nyid la brten nas bla ma brag steng pa'i bzhed pa lta bcu gnyis ma'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i dbang lnga/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang bzlas lung dang bcas pa/ yig cha de khar brten nas dur khrod nab/ po'i rgyud gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i gyi ljang lugs kyi (303nasgo gon po lha bcu bdun ma'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du chu/ cod pan/ rdor dril ming dbang bzlas lung dang bcas pa rnams dkyil chog tu lugs gnyis gsungs pa'i rgya gzhung lugs sor nas/ yang mngon dkyil gong ma la brten nas si rgyu ra'i dkyil 'khor du gri gug lha lnga'i dbang snyan brgyud lugs ltar bzlas lung yan rgya gzhung bzhin la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang / gsang dbang sher dbang bzhi pa dang bcas pa rnams/ gnyis pa rjes gnang gi bka' ma nub pa la/ brgyud pa'i bka' srol yig chung gi tho bcos bslad med pa ltar lo chen gyi bzhed pa gtso bor gyur pa'i thun mong ba lcam dral lha gsum sbags te bsgrub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i phyag len la gzhi byas rgyal tsha lung mang po dang bla ma zhang ston khu dbon gyi phyag bzhes zin bris kyis brgyan te yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge dang bshom sogs mthong brgyud kyi bka' srol ltar lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbrags sgrub thun mong ba'i rjes gnang / yar klungs pa'i yi ge dang mgon po rnam rol gyi mngon rtogs ltar mgon po lha bcu gnyis kyi thun mong ba'i rjes gnang / gtor chog pho nya myur —436

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po / (ka)mgyogs dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i tho yig bzhin dus gcig la chig brgyud las mi gnang ba'i lha brgyad gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / mgon po rnam rol gyi mngon rtogs dang kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi tho yig ltar dus gcig la tshig brgyud kho nar gnang ba'i mgon po lha bcu gnyis ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i tho yig ltar (303ba)mgon po khro bo bcu'i rjes gnang bka' rgya dam pa/ yar klungs pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ger nang gi las mkhan gyi mngon rtogs bsnan pa'i gsar 'khrid kyi smin byed mgon po lha dgu'i rjes gnang bka' rgya dam pa/ yig rnying ltar dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i phyi sgrub thun mong gi rjes gnang /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na thun mong ma yin pa zhig 'dug pa ma thob/ rngog ston bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba can gyi gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang bka' rgya dam pa/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi zin to dang brgyud pa'i gsung sgros ltar nang gi las mkhan ber nag zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang chig brgyud ma/ yang bshad ma thag pa'i yi ge gnyis dang zangs gri skor gsum gyi rjes gnang gi zin bris/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad par brten nas gcer bu zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa'i yi ge dang gsung rgyun phyag bzhes ltar gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra ming sring gi rjes gnang chig brgyud ma/ pu tra'i rjes gnang gi chings la gzhi mdzad cung zad mi mthun pa brgyud pa'i gsung sgros kyis brgyan te ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i thun mong gi rjes gnang / tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar bran bdud kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang chig brgyud ma rnams legs par nos nas/ snyan brgyud gsum pa gdams pa'i dngos gzhi lag len dmar 'khrid la/ dngos dang rgyab rten lung dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs gcod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ (344na)rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos mdzad pa'i phyi 'khrid rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i yi ge dang de'i lhan thabs kyi tshul du thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i yi ge gnyis la gzhi byas yig chung zur 'debs —437

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)chos kyis rgyal khams 'gengs ta re/ /zhes gsung ba thugs shin tu med par snang zhid la la dag man ngag 'di 'dra gong ma'i dus med snyam pa'i log lta byed pa ni sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i tshogs bdag ltar bsgrub pa/ sga ā nan dam pas mdzad pa'i shog hril drug pa'i nang gi gnyis pa dang rbod gtong bzlog pa'i zhal shes su pho nya'i spro bsdu zur tsam lags/ rgyas pa bla ma'i zhal las dris zhes sogasas bon tsam yi ger bris nas dngos gzhi thugs la gab pa'i rnam rtog tsam yang ma shar ba'i cal col smra ba ni chu shing lta bu'o/ /chos la bshad sgrub tshul bzhin du byed na/ ji skad du/ skye ba gsum gyi (30ldan)gong nas gsol btab cing / /tshe 'dir longs spyod sgrub pas mnyes par byas/ /dad dang snying rje shes rab mi dman la/ kun spangs chos rje'i bstan la lhag par dad / /ston dang bstan pa gzhan nas mi 'tshol bar/ /ci mdzad khyed shes mos gus lde mig gis/ /gsang chen thugs kyi bang mdzod sgo phye nas/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu kho bos rnyed/ /bco brgyad lo yi mtha' ru ma son bar/ /dad dang skal ldan g.yin dang g.yin dag la/ /snyan brgyud 'di 'dra'i ming yang ma bshad na/ /yongs rdzogs gdams pa sbyin par ngas ma phod/ ces gsungs pa las tshar chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs par 'khrungs pa'i dus/ rje mkhyen brtse rang nyid nas yar bgrangs pa'i skyes rabs bzhi pa 'jam dbyangs dgag par 'khrungs dus zab chos rnams gnang bar gsol ba btab pa lta bu'i las sad pa ni rang cag mtha' dag la dka' na yang de phyin gyi don rnams gong 'og gi gdams pa mtha' dag gi skabs su dran par byas te snying gi dpal ber 'chang ba'i 'os so/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i nang 'khrid dam gsang 'khrid du grags pa ni nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten nas bsgrubs pas nang sgrub/ gsang ba sems kyi gnad la brten nas gsang sgrubs pas gsang sgrub du grags shing / 'di la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis yod pa las gnyis ga'i rtsa bar gyur pa gong mas mdzad pa'i man ngag mdor bsdus/ de nyid cung zad rgyas su btang ba dam pas mdzad pa dang / gsang rten lus la sba ba'i yig chung rnams dang zhal shes la brten nas nang 'khrid thun mong ba (305bsnal 'byor —439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dbang phyug chen po yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag 'di yi ge nag 'gros lta bur bkod pa'i thog ma yin 'dug pas/ gsung las/ gzhan gyis bskul phyir g.yin phan bsam pas bris/ /snyigs dus nub par dogs pas 'dir brjod bya/ /zhes dang / dpe 'khyud med par ma bris na snyigs dus su song bas brjed pa dang nub kyi dogs nas/ yi ger gsal por 'dri bar srung ma rnams la lo gsum gyi bar gsol ba btab/ ces sogs ltar/ de yan chad du yi ger gsal po med par shes nus/ mal lo'i rjes gnang gi thor/ man ngag phyi sgrub dang nang lus la brten pa rnams sbyin zhes dang / sa chen gyi 'byung lugs gtor mar rang nang gi rnal 'byor pa yin na bdag nyid kyi lte ba chos 'byung gru gsum nang du bsdus la bzhag ces gsang rten lus sba'i gnad zab mo zur cam bstan pa sogs cung zad ma dgongs pa 'khrid brgya'i nang du/ skyed cing gsed nas phyag bzhi'i srog thig phyung / /gur la'ang 'dra cog yar klungs pa yis sbyar/ /zhes zur za mdzad pa ni rje btsun grol mchog mkhas grub chen po yin kyang phyogs 'di la gzigs pa'i dkyus thung bas thugs su ma shong pa'i gsung tsam mo/ /de yang nang 'khrid kyi 'khrid tshul la phyi'i brag rdzong gis bskyed rim dang nang gsang gi brag rdzong gis rdzogs rim byas pa/ yang bskyed rim gong ltar la rdzogs rim yar klungs pa lugs kyi nang 'khrid thun mong bas byas pa/ yang rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa gsang 'khrid kyis byas pa sogs lugs gsum cam las/ /(306na bong po ni gong du song zin pa dang / gsum pa song na gnyis pa'ang zhar la 'byung bas rje btsun rdo ring pas mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi 'khrid yig yid bzhin nor bu la gzhi byas yig chung zhal shes sogs kyis kha bskangs te/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems/ yig brgya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa 'khrid gzhung du'ang bshad kyang brag rdzong mar rgyas par song bas yang skyor ma dgos/ brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa rdo rje'i lus kyi gnad shes pa la brten nas rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi mgon po mngon du bya ba'i nye lam rtsa gsum 'khor 440

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lo lnga la brten nas bsnyen pa'i dmigs rim/ 'khor lo lnga ldan dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa'am rbad pa/ las sbyor thun mong ba bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang rnal 'byor sgos dgra bsgral ba/thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor lo lnga ldan gyi 'khrid dang bcas pa nyams myong yid ches su legs par nos/ de yang zab lam 'di la brten nas gnas skabs kyi dngos grub tu ma zad mchog gi dngos grub kyang bde blag tu bsgrub nus pas/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ zab las ches zab gsang chen snying po'i bcud/ /dkon las chos dkon yid bzhin rin cen dbang / /mchog las ches mchog snyan brgyud gdams pa 'di/ /sa skya'i rje btsun thugs kyi nying khu yin/ /'di 'dra rtse gcig bsgoms na lta ci smos//thos pa tsam gyis snang srid 'khor 'das chos/ /kun gyi rang mtshang rjen par ston pa'i phyir/ /zab par rlom pa gzhan gyis (306bsho zla min/ /zhes gsungs pa don la gnas shing / dpe 'di rang gi bstan pa 'dzin nges las/ /gzhan gyi rna bar ming tsam mi bsgrag cing / /snying nas dad kyang bstan pa mi zin na/ /chos rgyun shod la dpe rgyun sba bar byos/ /zhes pa shin tu mang bar snang bas bla ma dang chos la ci yang ma bsam par chos skyong gnyan pa dang gdams pa zab pa'i grags pa tsam la brten nas chos ci thob tu byed par 'ong bar 'dug pas de 'dra'i rigs la mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'chang ba snying la bcang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyab rten lung dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs gcod pa la/ rtsa ba'i yi ge bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos dkar chag bsgregs par mdzad pa'i mgon pod me 'bar ma'i skor/ der ma 'dus pa'i yan lag gi yi ge'i skor dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis lcam dral gyi chos skor gsan pa'i yi ge phal cher glegs bam du bsgrigs par mdzad pa dus re zhig na nyang stod rgyal mkhar rtse nas sa skyar spyan drangs tshe chom pos khyer bar glo bur du me 'bar zhing sgra chen po sgrog pa dang 'phar ba la sogs byung bas de nas bzung ste bu yig rnams la'ang me 'bar mar grags pa'i chos sde 'di la/ phyi nang gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i skor dang gsum/dang po la/ yid ches bskyed pa lo rgyus/ snod ldan du bsgrub pa rjes gnang gang las byung ba'i gzhi'i —441 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonargyud/ rtsa ba'i sgrub yig /de dag la mkho ba'i las tshogs lhan thabs dang lnga/ dang po la/ rdo rje gdan gyi ka ba nas rgyal rigs pad+ma badz+ra zhes bya bas spyan lta me chod rteni/lo shi(6dbyings pa'i mgon po 'di nyid gter nas 'byung (307na tha'i lo rgyus/ 'di las mgon kho na'i lo rgyus su ngor rdzong sogs rjes 'brang phal cher bzhed kyang mgon po rang la rgya gar du bka' gter gnyis byung ba'i bka' mar ma zad gter ma slob dpon chen po pad+mas shar phyogasapa dharma pā la la gnang ba lo chen gyis gsan cing o rgyan chen pos bsam yas su gter du sbas pa lha btsun gyis bton pa rgya gar nasagadan drangs pa'i gter ma dang zhus dag pher ba las mgon ma gtogs mgon chen gyi skor ma byung / rgya pad+ma dbang phyug gi gter ma rnams ni rgyal tsha lung mang po nas brgyud pa ma gtogs sa chen yab sras gsum yan la 'ong don med la/ brgyud pa'i skabs gur mgon rang la bka' gter gnyis 'dren dang / me 'bar dkar chag na mgon po 'di nyid gter nas byung ba'i lo rgyus zhes gsungs pas lasamagon kho na'i min par shes nus la/ gser pod na bzhugs pa dang tshig rigs cung zad mi mthun par snang ba der lhad zhugs par ma' zhing rdzong sa pa dam pas mdzad par sgo tshe do/ /bka' ma'i lo rgyus zhes pa cho so skyong gi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus (mchod rten)tho tsam bla ma'i gsung bzhin rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug gis sa skya dang yar klungs phyogs su bris pa/ gnyis pa snod ldan du bsgrub pa rjes gnang la/ 'gor dpal nag po chen po bsten pa'i gang zag des zhes yod pa'i lcam dral gyi rjes gnang ( mchod rten)gi tho bla ma mal gyis mdzad pa las mkhan gyi khyad par ni gud na mchis so sa ma pa tha'i mtha' can/ lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi cho lta me chod rtend(e mu/ga nyi mas bskul nas 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis me yos smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin bya 'dam gyi sa'i char mdzad pa/ ngor rdzong gnyis kyi be bum du 'di dang dzig mi 'dra ba 'ga' (307ba)re 'dug pa zhus dag ma song ba zhig nas mched dam snyam/ nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang (mchod rten)bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung zhang dkon cog dpal gyis zin bris su byas pa 'di rnams mi la mi spel ba'i bka' rgya can/ gser pod kyi de ltar brgyad dang sbyar ba'i 'di dang zhus dag ye mi pher zhing brjed tho lta bu'i 'dra min gnyis 'dug pa zur pa zhig yin par snang ngo / /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi zur 'debs kyi man ( me chod rten)ngag snyan —442

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nas snyan du brgyud pa zur khang pa slob dpon dkon cog 'od kyis yi ger bkod pa/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi chings lta me chod rten)bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis phyag len dus dang mthun par rgyas bsdus ci rigs mdzad kyang lan mang du mdzad par bltas shing drung gi gsung las zin bris su yar klungs pa sdong ston seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub par sug bris mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo dpal ma hā kā la'i rjes gnang gi zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang lta me chod rterne/gi yi ge 'cham sku mi g.yo bar ga da'o'i mtha' can/ dngos gzhi lcam dral gyi rjes gnang yin 'dus/ cing deng sang lha brgyad thun mong ma yin par mdzad pa'i phyag len dang phyogs tsam mthun par tshogs sgom pa nas brgyud pa'ang bris 'dug go /lcam bral gyi rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa bla ma lta me chod rten)rnams kyis phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin du dpon shes rab bzang pos bskul nas dam pa kun dga' grags kyis tre stod 'bom dgon par yi ger bkod pa/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos gragasalha brgyad ma'i rjes gnang gi yi ger ngos 'dzin mdzad pa mdun du bka' sdod rnams sam zhes pa la (308na bo gongs pa 'dra/'gor khyed rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas zhes yod pa'i dpal mgon lcam dral gyi rjes (mchod rteni/(e)gnang gi brjed byang gser pod na lo rgyus 'dra min dang go rim cung zad mi mthun pa snang ba yig skyon du mngon/ btsun pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba/ thun mong ma yin pa lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang bya (mchod rteni/thabs rgyas pa bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi phyag len mang du mthong ba la gzhi byas zhad dang brag phug pa'i zin bris dang / rgyal tsha lung mang po'i phyag len gyis cung zad brgyan nas bdag cag gi bla ma'i gsung gis rjes su gnang zhing bkas bskul ba dang /bshes gnyen grogs mched dam pas nan gyis bskul nas yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis klu'i dgon pa bde chen du sug bris su mdzad pa rnams/ gsum pa gang las byung ba'i gzhi'i rgyud ni/'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i dkyil 'khor bsdus (mchod rten shi97e)pa'i rtog pa'i le'u glegs bam du 'di tsam las mgon po mngon byung nas rigs drug gi rnam ga ldan —443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonabastan pa yig tshegs dang khos rgyud kyi le'u bcu par bshad pa sogs rgyud gzhan rnams dpyad gzhir dgongs nas ma bkod dam snyam /bco lnga pa las khol du phyung ba 'di gyi ljang po ti na yang yod/ paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang lo tsā ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur las bris pa/ bzhi pa rtsa ba'i ji/ba yig la/ 'phags yul gyi paṇa ji/ba kyis sbyo/da la brten pa'i rjo/ba skor/ gangs khrod kyi skyes chen rnams kyi mdzad pa'i sgrub skor te gnyis/ dang po la/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang / (308ba)bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /tshul khrims stsogs ldan bsdu dngob/bzhis/ /zhes yod pa'i sgrub (mchod rtend/rdo rje)thabs rgyas/ sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa mi gcig tsam ma gtogs gyi ljang po ti na yang yod cing birnya pa'i slob ma nag po par bka' sdod/ tshogs bdag /gshin rje/ gnod sbyin tar gyi pho rkyang gi sgrub lugs bzhi bram ze chen pos gsan pa yin/ pa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po shā d+dha ka ra warma dang lo tsā ba rin cen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ yang mjad pa ngo dang sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong ma ltar gyi sgrub thabs (mchod rtend(e)bsdus pa 'gor skad shan sbyar dang rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas zhes yod pa/ dkar chag na chung ngu zer ba 'dug cing gser pod kyi de yig skyon yin nam dbu nas cung zad ma mthun/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar sngon gsungs pa'i rim pas stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa'i rjes la zhes ( mchod rten)yod pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa lo tsā ba ga rod kyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tho rengs mal nas langs nas zhes yod pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub (mchod rten)thabs byin gyis brlab pa dang bcas pa slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kyi sti dang lo tsā ba dge slong pra dz+nya kirtis bsgyur ba/ 'gong skad shan sbyar dang dpal mgon po nag po la phyag 'tshal lo de kho na bzhin du sngon du bstan pa'i cho gas zhes yod pa'i sgrub ( mchod rtend(rten thabs bram ze mchog srid kyis mdzad pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ 'di dang lo chen gyis bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs chung ba dang klu sgrub kyi mdzad (309na ngo'i sgrub thabs gsum 'gyur khyad tsam ma gtogs don gcig ces bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gsung kha stong po ti na'ang bzhugs so/ /'a skra/ra skad —444

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (kanashan sbyar yod pa'i dpal mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs dregs pa zil ( me chod rtend(rgya/gnon zhes pa slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bsam yas mchims phur mdzad pa/ 'di rgya pad+ma dbang phyug gis gter nas spyan drangs pa rgyal tsha lung mang po nas brgyud pa ma gtogs rje btsun gong ma nas ma brgyud pas bka' gter gnyis med do/ /bram ze chen pos mdzad pa'i mgon po lha lnga'i dkyil (mchod rtend(rji rjed/khri)cho ga paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang 'gos lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang slob dpon sku la sdo byed dang zhes yod pa'i dpal nag po chen po srog gi spu gri'i sgrub ( me chod rteni/thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa mal gyi lo tsā ba blo gros grags kyis bsgyur ba rnams/ 'gyur byang tsam ma gtog gyi ljang na'ang yod/ gnyis pa gangs khrod kyi skyes chen rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub skor la/ rkyang sgrub dang sbrags sgrub gnyis/ ma hā kwa las bram ze chen por gnang ba'i sgrub thabs gsum zhes pa rang lugs la pho rkyang mo rkyang sbrags sgrub gsum du bzhed/ dang po la pho rkyang du bsgrub pa/ bka' sdod tshogs bdag gshin rje/gnod sbyin ltar sgrub pa bzhi yod pa lha'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba bzhi dang bdag mdun sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba rang lugs su bzhed cing /rdzong chung pa gshin rje dang gnod sbyin ltar sgrub pa'i yi ge logs su ma mthong gsung ba brag steng pa'i sgrub lugs bzhi dang bla chen bsod blo'i man ngag tshigs bcad ma dam pa'i gshin rje ltar sgrub pa sogs ma gzigs pa'i skyon no/ /mo rkyang du bsgrub pa/'khor rkyang du bsgrub pa dang gsum/ dang po la 'gor bla ma (309bdam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo spyir bram ze mchog sred kyi mgo'u po lcam bral sgrub lugs 'di la zhes yod pa'i pho rkyang lta me chod rten)(yi59tshu)gi sgrub thabs bod yig mar grags pa/ rdzong chung pas dgra dang bgegs la bya ba zhes pa las mdzad pa po ngos ma:na par snang jo / /mal lo chen pos mdzad pa phyis sa chen gyis zhus dag ma dam tshig bsrung ba dang 'bad pa shin tu gal che'o pho rkyang du bsgrub pa 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo brgyud pa bzang ldan mal gyi bu thu bo zhes yod pa'i pho rkyang gi bsnyen sgrub sbrags (mchod rten)(yi47tshu)te bsgrub pa/ 'de'i sbyar byang na bum badz+ra gyis sbyar zer ba 'dug cing mkhan chen ngag chos pa'i gsan yig na'ang de ltar snang la/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ lo pa spyan snga/ khyab bdag bka' gyur ba gsum gyi gsan yig na dkar chag sor gnas—445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)bzhin mdzad 'dug pa don la gcig /ser pod na kha skong nang gi pho rkyang gi sgrub thabs shog sngon can gnyan phul byung bas mdzad par ngos bzung nas 'di la rkyang sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub sgrogs ma zhes pa las gnyan phul byung pas mdzad pa'i 'phros mi 'dug la/ rdzong chung pa'i der bgegs la bya ba man chad ma tshang zhing slob dpon rtse mos mdzad ces snang ngo / /sa chen gyi slob ma gnyan phul byung bas mdzad pa/ 'gor oṃ su sti bla ma dang nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo ka la'i man ngag yig ṣi snga ma'i 'phros zhes pa dkar chag dang dpe'i zhal byang gnyis kar snang / la zhes dang mjug (rmi chod rteni)tu sa skya jo sras kyi yi ge man ngag rnying pa snga ma'i 'phros sa ma pa tha'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ su sti dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo rten gyi gang zag dbang bzhis snod du rung ba zhes yod pa'i nag po chen po'i 'byung lugs bstan ( mchod rterno3ng gtor ma dang po'i 'phros kyi yi ge (310na lhang pa'i cha lag gong mas mdzad pa rje btsun gyi bla dpe las bris pa/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo bhe dan gyi yul na bram ze mchog sred ces yod pa'i tshogs kyi bdag (mchod rte278)po'i tshul du sgrub pa'i u pa de sha sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ mgon po khro bcu tshogs bdag ltar sgrub par ngos 'dzin yang / de'i rjes gnang gis mal lo'i lugs kyi pho rkyang la rjes gnang med par bzhed pa la mi gnod pa 'dra ste/ de ni gtso rkyang la dgongs kyi 'di ni pho rkyang gtso 'khor sbrags sgrub yin pas so snyam zhing / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan du sbrags sgrub yin pas so rje tshar ba gsung pa'i ngag rgyun de legs po snang zhes pa 'dug kyang / sa gcad du rkyang sgrub sbrags sgrub ces so sor dbye ba'i dbang du song na 'di lugs gnyis gang du'ang ngos 'dzin dka' ba'i dogs gnad che ba zhig 'dug pa 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin du khur gyis lci ba rnams ljags kyi dbang po rkyong bar rigs so/ /'gor bla ma dang dpal kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo tshogs kyi bdag po'i tshul du sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub gnyis sngon du song nas las (mchod rten pe yo ni/(ni rje/la sbyar zhes yod pa'i man ngag gi yig rnying / rdzong wo pa ser ba dbab pa gas gi yig sna'i zhabs na yod ces logs su ngos bzung ba de 'di'i nang gi de'o/ /—446

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ser ba bcad pa'i las rnams sgrub thabs nyid la/ btsal // ྅༷ ba /sal zhes gad dang tsos gsung /lo'i mtha' can/de'i gsang las 'gor dpal mchod rten rda rjen nag po chen po sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i slob dpon bram ze ma/ga sred kyi // //༷bsdog gsad pa'i las sbyor ro'i mtha' can/'gor ma hā kā la'i bsnyen pa mchod rten mu rda rjen yang dang po lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i bsnyen pa sngon du 'gro bar bya ste zhes yod pa'i bka' bsgo'i tshul du sgrub pa bla ma gong mas mdzad pa sgra snyan gyi rdzas rdzogs so'i mtha' can/rdzong wo pa 'di'i nang gi sreg rdzas la ba la ta waṃ rdzasadang bcas bsad smyo dbye gsum so sor kha bsgyur chog pa bsgrub thabs nyid nas gsal zhes zhal 'phang pa 'dir ngos bzung 'dug/yang des /dzad pa'i do// waX ༷/ bdag nyid kyis bsnyen sngags dang sngags ring gnyis ka la bsnyen pa mchod rten mu rda rje / thabaskyal ces yod pa'i ling ga bsregs pa'i dum bu lam rgya gram du mnan no'i mtha' can/rdzong chung bas chos 'a sngon ma dang sbrel bog/gong dkar ba 'di la ging ga sreg lugs su ho/ma'i gdung 'chod rtend(rji spund kyis gsad pa/gtor ma 'chod rtend(rdo spul brten nas 17 ri/nya chi/gsad pa/ting nge 'dzin gyis mchod rten rda rdzogs da pa ste drag po'i las sbyor gi man ngag bla ma gong mas mdzad pa/'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tsha/ lo nag / /nad /'i/ ba thabs ni dang por rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i zhes yod pa'i pho rkyang gi las mchod rten ma mu byang rje btsun gyis mdzad pa gser pod na lo chen gyis mdzad ces snang zhing rdzong chung bas pho rkyang gi gtor chog tu 'bod cing las byang mi zer bar las spangs de zhes pa dang tshogs bdag gi yag rnying du sgrub thabs gsum gsungs pa'i 'bring por ngos bzung 'dug kyang bdag byu rdo rje lang tshong po zhes pa yig nor yin gsung ngo //las byang de rgyun du yi dam bya ba man ngag go'i mtha' can rnams/gnyis pa mo rkyang du bsgrub pa la/zhi drag gnyis las zhi ba nang pa ltar sgrub pa 311na'agor bla ma dam pa'i sa la ( la spyi rtsend /ga /tshal lo//mo rkyang du sgrub pa la gsum ste zhes yod pa'i mo rkyang du sgrub pa'i gsal mchod rten 'byed shākya'i dge slong bum badz+ra gyis mdzad/྅wo na rteshe ba yin/'gor mkha' 'gro ma dbang du bya bar 'a/sdu na zhes yod pa'i mo rkyang gi bsnyen mchod rten

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()(ed(/ ces ldo rjed sgrub mkha' 'gro dbang du bya ba gong mas mdzad pa kho'i rkyen bzlog tu 'gro bas mi bul gsung pa'i mtha' can/rdo rje gdan pa'i phyag dper rang rdzi phyogs su mi bstod zer ba yin pas mi 'dug cing 'di'i r+sāmajug na yod pa'i me'i gdung ba zhes pa ser pod na chos 'a logs su ngos bzung yod do//'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal ldan lha mon ga po la phyag mar ( lo dpal zhwan lha mo na gadzo spu mo sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i lha mo drag mo phyi pa mu stegs pa ltar mchod rtege kho e da(| rjen bsgrub pa/'di la dkar ga tu phyi pa mu stegs pa ltar sgrub pa zhes gsung pa rdzong chung pas phyi sgrub dang nang sgrub kyi khyad par yin zhes zur za dang gi ljang ma gtogs lugs 'di la med gsungs kyang dam pa kun dga' dpal gyi sgrub yig dang bla ma gzungs kyi dpal bas yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan la gnang ba'i dri lan gyi brjod don me 'bar dkar chag dang mthun zhing lha mo la yang bka' stod tshogs bdag/phyi pa/nang pa ltar sgrub pa ste lugs bzhi dang phyi ma gnyis la so sor 'jam rtsub kyi sgrub pa dang /yang nang pa la/'jam pa cung zad 'jam pa/shin tu 'jam pa'i rnam gzhag kyang yod cing lha mo bdag skyed du byed pa lo ka shrī'i yi ge 'di ma gtogs med pas tshogs bdag ltar sgrub pa zhal gyis bzhed phyin rang tshag dang yang 'gal bar mngon/gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na mu stegs pa ltar sgrub pa 'di la lha mo'i sgrub thabs zer ba tsam las mi snang ngo //rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po bram ze 311bsgo cho go sred kyi mdzad pa slob dpon lo ka shis bsgyur ba rnams/gsum pa 'khor rkyang du sgrub pa ni dkar chag tu gtso 'khor ci khyad nas 'og tu 'chad gsung ba'i rjes su 'brangs te/gnyis pa sbrags sgrub pa la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis dang po la thun //nga ba lcaX /mos ltar /༷sa / rje gdan pa'i gas yig na lhagasum ma'i bsnyen sgrubalas gsum zhes pa snang /te sgrub pa mchod rten rlud(65rna rjen bla ma'i gsung las ji ltar gyur ba bzhin gzhan gyis gsal ba btab pa'i ngor dge tshul rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/'phags pa rin po che/dpal da' pos chu lnga bye do'i lo gdu bu'i zla ba la byang ngos su sbyar ba/des rgyal bu ji gin gyi don du mdzad mchod rtend/ni / pa'i lcam dral gyi gtor chog/gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la/lha brgyad kyi bsnyen pa byed thabs lta mchode rten/(5da/༷)thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba'i man ngag ma lo pas mdzad pa/rdzong chung ba lha brgyad ma'am bcu gnyis ma'i mngon rtogasaX'adam khar bzhed cing /'ga' zhig bu lung kun rdor gyis mdzad

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gsung yang rang lugs la mi bzhed/ de la nye bar mkho ba 'gor bla ma dam pa'i 'bas la phyag 'tshal lo mkha' 'gro ma rnam pa gnyis las mkhan dang bcas pa bka' sdod du sgrub pa'i dus su zhes yod pa'i sgrub pa dang (mchod rtend/klu)las sbyor ston pa'i bka' sdod kyi yi ge dgos shing gces nas btab pa yin sa ma pa tha mi'i mtha' can/ 'di lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan mal dpon gyis mdzad ces snang zhing rdzong chung pa'i dkar chag na sbrags sgrub kyi zin bris zer ba 'dug cing mjug na bod rbad bsad gsum dril ba zhes pa'i yig chung zhig btags 'dug /dkyil 'khor la brten nas rtsub (312na shā yugs lta me cho de rtend/rdo rje/su sgrub/ 'di la rdo rje gdan pa'i gas yig tu bod rbad gsang gsum/ thun/ phur pa/ ba dan/ dam shing / zor/ sbyin sreg dang ga gis gsad pa drug 'phral nas mdzad 'dug /pa 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo mkha' 'gro sbrags te sgrub pa'i man ngag brjod par bya'o zhes yod pa shākya'i dge slong theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa blo gros seng ges mdzad pa mal lo'i dbon po yin/ 'di mal dang 'phags pa'i dus gang du byung dpyad dgos la dun go/'gor na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn mo mahā kā lā ya spyir bram ze mchog sred kyi mgon po lcam dral bsgrub (mchod rteni/de li(rdo rje)lugs la zhes yod pa'i lugs brgyad kyi bsgrub tshul/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na rdzas dang longs spyod bsrung ba/ dngos grub sgrub pa/ 'khu ldog spang ba zhes brjod don gsal bar snang zhing gtso 'khor sbrags sgrub tu'ang bzhed/ rdzong pa rnams 'ad bzhi dril bar yig sna 'a mo zhes dpe 'a tsog tu sa tshe pa don la gnas so/ khyur bar 'dod pa'i las la rtsub dang bsdos te las la sbyar bas zla ba phyed kyis rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i man ngag rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad (mchod rteni/(5ri lo ldo rje)pa'i 'gor 'jam can/ gyi ljang pu tir yang yod/ 'di la rgyas pa zer/ 'gor dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo nag po chen po'i gzhud nas 'di gnyis kyi g.yin gyi —457

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)ngag gnon par 'dod zhes yod pa'i gdams ngag 'chod rten)( li(6da(rji rje)dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa gzhung bzhin bya 'o'i mtha' can/ mgon po'o bstod pa sngon tshe bde gshegs ma/gyi ljang po ti dang tshar lugs bstod 'bum na'ang yod/ dang srin gzugs ma/ 'di ga'i bstod 'bum dang tshar lugs bstod 'bum na'ang yod/ bskul 'das dang ma 'ongs pa gsum sbrel ba'i mjug rdo lta me chod rten)rje re ma ti e ka ṭi yak+ṣa be ta li/ paṇa sha ba ri ste gsang ba'i yum bzhir bcas pa'i bskul rnams chos sde gcig tu bzhugs pa slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa/ dkar chag na 'di ltar 'dug pa yum bzhi'i bskul la dgongs sam snyam bka' gter gang yin ma nges/ rje grol mchog gis bstor ba'i mgon po'i rjes gnang mdzad kyi yod 'dug pa thugs kyis gsar du dpyad pa zhig yin pa 'dra'o/ /'gor bla ma dang ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo/ nag po lcam dral mchod dang rto me chod rten)(ni rje)bsten zhes yod pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs pa'i cho ga'i yig rnying yar klungs pas zhus dag mdzad pa gtor ma gdab par bya 'o'i mtha' can/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na rten gsum ru ma' 'dzugs zhes snang zhing gyi ljang po ṣi yang bzhugs/ 'gor bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo dpal ldan nag po chen po'i (318ba)drag sgrub spyi'i las la zhes yod pa'i ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i sgrub (mchod rteni/(rdo rjed(tshi)thabs las tshogs ru tshon gyi man ngag dang bcas pa dpal brtse ba chen po chos kyi rje'i zhal snga nas kyi rjes su bzung ste rgyal khams pa do dkar chag na gong mas gnang zer ba 'dug /pa ston tshul la gtsigs su mdzad de snang ba/ gyi ljang na yang yod/ bran bdud kyi lung sbyin tshul tshig brgyud ( me cho ne rten)(rno rje/do tshon ma yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis bla ma'i gsung la dag par gtugs te yang dgon shug ra bde chen du bris pa/ rgya pad+ma dbang phyug gis gangs bar phug mo che nas gdan (mchod rteni/(rje khrings pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i bar chad sel pa'i cho ga /mgon po'i gtor wo gyi man ngag /de nyid rgyas su btang ba gtor chen gyi gsol kha (mchod rten)bya tshul mal lo shud bu gnyis kyi yi ge sa skya dang rgyal tsha lung mang po phyag len gcig kha bskangs te mkhas pa yon tan khris grub thob birla tsan+t+ra'i gnas su mdzad pa/ 'gor dpal ldan ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po zhes yod pa'i dmod —438

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bcol sa paṇa (mi chod rteni/gyis mdzad pa/kha skong na yod pa' 'phags pas mdzad pa de 'di las rgyas su bto 'dug/gzungs gsar pa'am rnying pa ( mchod rten ri7rdzo4)'dzugs sam gso ba'i man ngag dam pas mdzad pa/kha skong po ti na'ang yod me 'bar glegs bam la lar bstod pa bde dga' rgya mtsho sogs bsnan pa'i mang tsam 'dug pa lhad yin min brtag/zor lam dbye ba bdag lus rdo rje 'chang ( mar rtend(mud/rdo spu dpal ma dang de'i 'phros las zor 'phang thabs lta me chod rteni/nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang 319na tha cas pa zhes sogs kyi tshig lhug 'phags pas mdzad pa/dkar chag dang gsan yig rnams na 'di ltar snang yang ya ge na gnyan los mdzad ces dmar chos rgyal gsung zer ba bog cing rdzong chung pa'i glegs bam du ni med/dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bskang mdos 'chod rtend/sdo rje)bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa shin tu zab pa'i mdos re zhig rdzogs so'i mtha' can/de'i gsal byed cung zad rgyas su btang ba lta mchod rten)lta rdo rje dgar pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis sa skyar mdzad pa/dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bla ma spyan chen po (mchod rteni/6 ) lo rdo rje/yi dam bde dgyes dang chos skyong zhal gzigs pa'i tshe mgon po nyid kyis rjes su gnang ste bskang bzlog bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa/'di rgya bod su yin la dpyad gzhi mdzad mag mang yang rang lugs rgya gar bar 4kho/bskang ba rnam dag tshogs(mchod rteni/gtor ma mal gyi mdzad pa/des mdzad pa'i dam rdzas kyi bskang ba (mchod rten/sku dang gsung thugs ma/nag po r+ṣa po'i bstod pa srin lta me chod rteni/6)gzugs ma bram ze chen pos mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/dam tshag can la bdag bstod do yan tshar lugs bstod 'bum na yod/bstod pa bcom ldan dpal chen ma (mchod rteni/slob dpon a wa sgru tis mdzad pa/bstod pa sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'cho de rten ma bla ma sa chen gyis mdzad pa/bstod pa chos dbyings stang nyid ma (mchod rten)slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i rgyud 'grel gyi bstod mang nas yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis phyung ba/bstod rnying dmigs (mchod rten)med thugs rje ma /lha mo'i bstod pa 319ba(mchod rteni/'jig rten gsum bdag ma/lha mo la lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags bzang ris kyis don dam pa'i sgo nas bstod ༷/lta mchod rteni/spros bral 'od gsal ma 'jim

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/lha mo la dge bcu rnam dag gi sgo nas bstod lta me chod rteni/pa 'jig rten 'khor ba ma lo tsā ba ga rod kyis bsgyur ba(/tshig zur cu/ /da mi 'dra ba ma gtogs dud sol po ti na'ang yod/lha mo la nam mkha'i lha bran rnams kyis bstod pa mchod rten bang pe skal pa med par ma 'jim lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/spyosabatsos mar yang yod/rdzong pod ḍi bram ze mchog/ da kyis mdzad ces pa'i tshig zur ca zad mi mthun tsam zhig drug/lha mo'i bstod pa ye shes dbyings las mcho/ rten nam sdo/sa/ rin po ches sa skyar mdzad pa/'phags pas mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi'i lnga mchod dam mchod rten mugasang ba'i /chod gto/ / /ma pa dgra bgeṭa rnams ni ma/zhabs //gas mar ya/ //)/des mdzad pa'i bshags pa mchod rten the yo tshig lhug/des mdzad pa'i bstod pa mchode rtene mugang thu/sa ma/zha//bkros ma dang tshar lugs bstod 'bum na'ang yod/spre lung kun smon gyis mdzad pa'i bshags pa mchod rten ra / bya spyogs bcad bla ma mchog dkyil ma/(dibs bas/ mar yang yod/nag po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i bshags mchod gtor sgrub zhag/di mchod rtenadu bya tshul/'di'i nang du mgon /'ang se gags pa mal gyi mngon rtogs nas phyung ba'i yon to lhun rdzogs sum dang mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i lha mo' bshags pa mu / / 'gro ba'i don sku ma gnyis yod/rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa sbyar byang med pa las can zhig dang phrad shog gi 320nasgo tha' can rnams/rtsa ba'i gnyis pa zab pa'i yang tig nang gi man ngag la/'gor ḍi mo gu ru /(na/ / /'o po/ gdams pa la rang gi kye rdo rje zhes pa'i rtsa gsum la brten pa'i mchod rten 'a mu rda rje(zha)man ngag mdor bsdus pa gong mas mdzad pa gnad kyi gdams pa srog gi yang tig dam pa yin no'i mtha' can/rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na rtsa gsum mgon po lcam dral du bsgoms nas gsang ba'i man ngag zer bar snang /de nyid cung zad rgyas su btang ba 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo nag po 'khru med mi 'gyur ba'i srog 'dzin rim pa'i (mchod rten)(e)((lo| rje)'a)man ngag shad ces yod pa'i dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad/ bsgrub / shā do/ // ༷di /༷ / zhes kyang grags so'i mtha' can/ gsang ba'i rten lus la mchod rte/6khrim mu rda rje phyanang pe cad pa'i man ngag gong

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mas mdzad pa/gsan yig dang dkar chag na 'di ltar snang yang yi ge na dam pas mdzad zer ba 'dug cing rdzong chung pa'i glegasabam du gong du las pa las zur du med/ bla ma dam pa'i dbon po bsod nams legs grub la rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis lag 'khrid du bstan pa'i dus yi ge gsal por bris zhes bskul ba la brten nas rdzogs rim zhal shes dang bcas pa (mchod rtend/rdo rje)snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i bsnyen sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag chu pho khyi lo hor zla dang por dpal sne'u gdong rtse'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa rnams/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa zab pa'i gnad kyi man ngag gi skor gyi zin tho tsam dkar chag tu (320ba)gsungs pa rnams ni bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yan chad la phal cher gsung ngag tu bzhugs shing la lar reg zig thor bu tsam yod par 'dug pas dkar chag las/ 'di rnams ni snying nang gi khrag lta bu'i gdams ngag ste 'dir man ngag nub kyi dogs pas bsdus don zhib par bkod pa yin gsungs pas dkar chag dang sgo bstun rgyu'i glegs bam nag 'gros su 'dug pa/ snying po gnad sgron las/ gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /yi ge gser gyi ri bo'i grangs/ zhes yig sna brgya dang lnga bcu'i grangs su 'dren rgyu'i bdun gyi gtor ma'i zhal gdams gnyis gcig tu brtsis shing de min drug las dkar lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dris lan du ngos 'dzin 'di ltar mdzad kyang / gnad sgron du yig sna brgya dang bzhi bcu dgu zhes lar bcad pa'i nang du gsang ba'i yi ge bdun po bgrangs pa nas mthar dkar chag nyid dang lnga bcu po zhes pa'i brjod byar dpags na dkar chag min pa'i chos tshan zhig dgos rgyur 'dug kyang da ltar gtor ma'i yi ge gnyis so sor 'phral na ma gtogs ngos 'dzin rgyu ma rnyed pas lugs gnyis po de gang yin slar yang gsang chen slob bshad phyogs la phu thag chod pa zhig dang 'phrad na 'dri dgos par 'dug go /chag yongs grags ltar dang gzhan lnga kun la ma grags pa'i snying nang gi khrag lta bu yin pas snyan brgyud glegs bam gyi gras su 'os par dgongs nas thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig tu yang mi gsal/ lo pa spyan snga dang thar rtse pa rnams kyi gsan yig na dkar chag nang 'ded 'dug pa ni dkar chag gis zin pas rnam pa gcig tu mi 'thad pa ma yin mod/ 'on kyang thun mong dang thun slong ma yin pa so sor (321na phra khyed pa'i —461 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dbang du byas na legs par ma mngon/ 'di skor gyi man ngag phal cher 'thor ba bsdebs nas rdo ring rin po ches mdzad pa snyan brgyud po tir bzhugs nas/ bdag chen rin po ches mdzad pa rnams kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse khu dpon gyi gsan yig gi dkyus su 'dug kyang dkar chag na mi gsal bas/'dir dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi sdebs su byas yod do/ /glegs bam gyi dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i bang mdzod kyi sgo 'byed gsal ba'i yid 'phrog bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad/ 'di thog mar bzhugs rigs pa 'dra zhig 'dug na'ang / tshar chen gyis/ dril bas mgon por me 'bar mar/ /grags pa'i dkar chag nang bzhugs pa'i/ /yig sna brgya dang bzhi bcu dgu /dkar chag nyid dang lnga bcu mā /nges so skal ldan snying la chongs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang bstun pa yin no/ /dkar chag tu/ da ni zhan las 'ongs pa 'khor lo'i dpe ris rnams zhes gsungs pa la rags rim tsam las mi gsal zhing / rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes gdung brgyud kho na las chig brgyud du byon pa/ yang klungs pa/ bar sdings pa ste brgyud pa gsum gyi dpe ris tshang zhing lhad ma zhugs pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi phyag bris dngos la 'bru len mdzad pa dang / der ma tshang ba rnams yab 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i phyag bris ngos las bshu bar mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrig pa gnang ba ltar bkod pa la/ /mgon po dang lha mo'i srog 'khor 'dra min bzhi/ nag po chen po srog gi spu gri'i sgrub thabs mchog (321ba〉thud kyi gzhung las gsungs pa'i sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi/ chings chen drug dang 'khor lo'i bri yig nas gsungs pa'i byad ma rang gshed dbab pa'i 'khor lo'am bsrung bzlog sbrags ma'i 'khor lo/ pho rkyang du sgrub pa'i shom/ pho rkyang mu stegs pa ltar sgrub pa'i shom/ pho rkyang gi skabs zan ling gi snying gar 'jug pa'i 'khor lo/las mgon gyi bla rdo'i 'khor lo/ pho rkyang tshogs bdag ltar sgrub pa'i shom/ gnyan phul byung pas mdzad pa'i pho rkyang gi sgrub pa'i las khung dang thab khung / gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu'i mgon khang sogs la dgos pa lha brgyad bskyed pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor/ gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu'i gsad —462

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa'i las khung / drung chos rje'i bzhed pa'i las khung rtsang dang bcas pa/ mgon po phur bu ltar sgrub pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus so so'i shom/ pu tra ming sring gsum gyi tsaka li/ dam shing dang ba dan gyi dpe/ spra tshil gyi ling ga gsal shing la bskyon pa/ gtor zor/ rdo zor/ khrag zor/ mda' zor/ rwa zor/ kong zor/ phur zor/ lha brgyad 'jam lugs su sgrub pa'i gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'bor lo ru mtshon rtse lnga'i shom/ lha brgyad rtsub lugs kyi gnod sbyin yab yum gyi 'khor lo/ sbrags sgrub dus thun gyis gsang rgyu'i ling ga sngags can dang / me'i gdung bas gsad pa'i 'khor lo/ mkha' 'gro 'khu ldog spang ba'i 'khor lo/ pho rkyang gi sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyi gzhung ltar zan ling gi khog par 'jug rgyu'i 'khor lo/ dam pas mdzad pa'i ngag gnon ling ga /rang bsrung 'khor lo chen (322na glo rnams gyi steng nas phyag len ngo sprod mdzub btsugs su legs par nos/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa der ma 'dus pa'i yan lag gi yi ge skor ni/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i me 'bar dkar chag snying po gnad sgron las/ 'di na ma bsgrigs zab gnad kyi/ /yi ge thor bu sbas pa rnams//kho bos dkar chag gzhan du bris/ /snod ldan dad pa'i mig ldan dag /ngo mtshar ltad mo byos shig kye/ /zhes pa ltar me 'bar glegs bam du ma bkod par zab cing gsang ba'i gab sbas kyi yig sna 'ga' zhig dang rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos mgon po 'di'i chos skor bla ma bcu gcig tsam la gsan pa dang gzhan yang rdzong pa shes rab rin chen dang gong dkar ba tshe dbang bkra shis kyis mtshon pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i brgyud 'dzin gyi bla ma bcu phrag gcig dang rngog chen po bsod nams bstan 'dzin sogs dam pa mang por tshar chen rang nyid kyis gsan pa rnams zur du bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam la thun mong ba man ngag kha skong po ti'i skor/ mkhas grub phal cher gyis rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i snying khrag gi gzungs lta bu snyan brgyud po ti'i skor/ bla ma gyi ljang lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i gyi ljang po ti'i skor/ 'dod khams dbang phyug khrag 'thung dud pa'i sol ba can gyi skor dang bzhi/ de yang gdung brgyud du rloms pa 'gas rang bzo'i lag len la 'di nas brgyud med par zab zab byed pa —463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dang mi 'dra bar khungs btsun pa'i rgyu mtshan lhag bsam rab dkar las/ kho bos rje btsun kun dga' bzang po las/ /brgyud pa'i ser (322ba)pod la sogs kun kyang thos/ /rgyud gsum smra ba pradz+nyā rat+na la: /rdzong chung pa las brgyud pa zhib tu zhus/ /khyad par grub mchog dbang po kun spangs zhabs/ ring du bsten zhing gdung brgyud rim pa las/ /brgyud pa'i ma ti dh+wa dza'i snyan brgyud kyi/ /gdams pa ma lus bum pa gang byor thob/ /mdor na dam pa'i yongs 'dzin bdun la gtugs/ zhes dri ba 'di gnang skabs gong dkar ba tshe dbang bkra shis sogs dang ma mjal ba'i skabs yin 'dug /de rjes dam pa'i yongs 'dzin bcu phrag la dpyad pa rdzogs nas thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis gsan pas bsam 'phel nor 'phreng las/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dbang gis/ /bsgrigs pa'i mgon pod me 'bar ma/ /zhal shes kha skong zin bris bcas/ rgyal bas lung bstan e waṃ pas/ /bsgrigs pa'i ser pod ces grags dang / /mthu stobs dbang phyug gong dkar ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i mgon pod dang / /sa skya'i rdzong chung pa rnams kyi/ /thugs dam man ngag po ti sogs/ /zab cing mchog tu gnyan pa yi/ /man ngag be bum de dag thob/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ dang po rjes 'jug mkhas grub rnams kyi yi ge thun mong ba me 'bar mar ma 'khod pa'i kha skong po ti la/ thog mar rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i man ngag zab bsdus gsal byed kha skong dkar chag zab don gsal ba'i sgron me/ de las byung ba'i chos skor la/ paṇa chen gha ya dha ra nas bla chen 'brog mir brgyud pa/ ba ri lo tsā bar rje btsun brtse ba chen pos gsan pa/ kha che paṇa chen gyi chos (323na)rje paṇ+ḍita la gnang ba/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ 'gor bla ma dang nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo rje btsun gha ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul ni zhes yod pa'i rjes ( mchod rtend(theg twa)gnang gi zin bris yig chung dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i tshe sa bon las bskyed pa ni gang byas kyang 'dra 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje nag po'i sgrub thabs de nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo zhes yod —464

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa'i sgrub thabs 'chod rtege yo tshe)(sa)chung ngu mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi le'u bco lnga pa las phyung ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/'gor dpal nag po r+ṣa po la phyag na 'a lo rdo she / / shā/ zlo ba/da pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni zhes yod pa'i las sbyor man ngag mchod rten e kusatwa gur rgyan las phyung ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams/gnyis pa ba ri / /mu cho lo) rje btsun brtse ba chen pos gsan pa la/sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i lta me chod rteni/6 ) khre mi bud/lugs kyi rjes gnang gi zin bris/'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal mgon / skye ga/ sna / /〉 〉la shā de khon bzhin sngon du bstan pa'i cho gas zhes yod pa'i sgrub thabs mchod na mu sna rgyad rgya gzhung bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa ba ri'i lngar 'di me 'bar mar yang yod/gsum pa kha che paṇa chen gyis chos rje paṇ+ḍi tar gnang ba la/'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba'i rdo rje /di zlo chen po ༷/shāg tshal lo sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas zhes yod pa'i sgrub thabs kyi 323bakhamachod rten e na rgya gzhung zhes bya ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa rtogs par bya'o'i mtha' can ser pod na bram ze mar sred kyis mdzad ce/zlo ba yid par sgos/de'i 'phros las de nas bsgom par bya ba'i cho ga brjod par da nyamachod rten e)bya ste zhes pa paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i man ngag go'i mtha' can/bsnyen pa la brten nas phyi pho lha ltar bsgrubs pas mthu thon la 'byung ba/sgrub pa zhun chen gyi mar me la brten nas gnag pa kro bdun la zlo// ba/las // rdo /di po'i tsit+ta snying la brten nas dgra bo kha 'phung du gsad pa/de gsum la kha mchod rten na the yugasang sgrub spu gri skor gsum du bshas pa'i chos 'a r+sāg tu bzhugs pa yin/rje sa paṇa gyis lkod/rmir rteni/des)(mkha che paṇa chen la gser zho brgyad dang sa tsā sa brgyad ri ba gcig jal /sa 0 pa'i lo rgyus/bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi zhal gdams las khad(mchod rtend(( li(6'phreng ba'i man ngag sogs yod pa'i bsnyen pa'i zhal gdams/ma hā kā la dang dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang bsgom pa sogs yod pa'i phrod(ma rdzo rtege yos)(mdzeb pa'i lko gdams/mnan lugs6)'a rdzo rteshe46

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()(ed/ni drug bstan pa'i las sbyor gyi zhal gdams/ me tog nag pos sogs rdzas rnams (kha)(mchod rtend(e)bstan pa'i gtor ma'i yig chung kyang brgyud pa gcig pas mu'i rtag pa bkod pa yin/ nag po chen po'i chos skor gyi dkar chag (6)rdzong chung pa byams pa rdo rje rgyal —473

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mtshan gyis chu sprul rgyal zla'i tshes bcu gnyis pa la sa skya'i zhe dgon du bris pa/ de stag tshang lo tsā ba ma ñdzu shrī'i gsung bzhin sa skyar bris (tshu)pa'i gyi ljang lugs kyi chos skor gyi dkar chag /des mdzad pa'i rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i gsal byed las le'u gnyis pa bskang gso rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum (mu)gyi thems yig khol du phyung ba/ bskang gso nag po mchod rten gyi sa bcad (ni/sngags 'chang gzungs pa'i slob ma bo dong dge legs bzang pos mdzad pa rnams/bcu pa gong dkar ba'i lugs la/ rong pa rgya lo'i dpon brgyud bla ma dpal ldan grags pa la bla dgas su chos rje bla ma dam pas ngag dbang grags par 'bod cing phyis gsang phu brag nag tu bzhugs pas brag nag pa ngag dbang grags par 'bod pa des mdzad pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos skyong gur zhal rnam gnyis kyi mngon rtogs mchod bstod bzlas pa rjes gnang bskul sogs tshang ba'i sgrub thabs chen mo'i mjug tu/ ji skad du/ /ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa gzhir bzhag la/ /brgyud pa'i phyag len rim dang lung yod pa'i/ /rigs rnams (330na po khas su btags pa'i bstod 'bum 'di/ /rdo rje gdan du bkod nas rnal 'byor la/ /brtson rnams dga' phyir par du'ang bgyis te spel/ /zhes pa ltar bstod pa rnams mjug tu btags pas gnyis ka sbrel bar bstod 'bum zhabs btags mar grags pa la/ brag nag pa rang gis mdzad pa'i mchod (༷ga rdo rje/gtor sgrub bstod phyag len rgyun chags gcig tu bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i dpal 'byung 'di'i nang gi dur khrod nag po 'i rgyud las byung ba'i mgon po'i bstod pa (6)'das dang ma 'ongs ma/ bram ze 'a pos mdzad pa'i bstod pa (6)ma skyes mkha' klong ma/ rgyud las byung bar grags pa'i dpal ldan 17mu)mgon po ma'i dam tshig can gyi dgra lha nag po che yin/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan snga ma (༷/spyo rnams rdzong lugs bstod la bu pa na'ang yod/ bstod 'bum la/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa'i (ni rje/bshags pa tshig bcad bla ma rnams dang ma/ mal los mdzad pa'i (rno rje/bskang gso mtha' yas tshogs rdzogs ma/ bla chen bsod blos mdzad pa'i (rdo rje)bskang gso he ru ka dpal nag po ma/ 'di la byin rlabs che ba'i gtam rgyud yod par snang / bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i —474

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bstod pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor (rdo rje)1)dbus gnas ma/ gong gi stsod tsom na'ang yod/ dge slong burnya dh+wa dzas lcags mo glang gi lo bre'i (rji rje/zla bar sbyar pa'i bstod pa rnam dag gi 'phreng ba/ theg chen chos rjes mdzad pa'i bstod pa (rdo rje/nag po rngam pa ma/ gong gi bstod 'bum na'ang yod/ bdud re lde 'gong yag gis mdzad (330ba)pa'i lha mo'i (rdo rje)spyan 'dren thod pa dgu brtsegs ma gong gi bstod la bum na'ang yod/ 'di la spyan 'dren ma gtogs lha la dbang sgyur ma ni mi 'dug /bstod pa sems nyid 'phrin las (ni rje/ma/ lha mo nam mkha'i lha phran rnams kyis bstod pa bskal pa lta rdo rje)(mu)me 'bar ma me 'bar ma na'ang yod/ gnyan los mdzad pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i lta rdo rje/spyan 'dren lha mchog ma chosaskyong che chung 'dres pa 'dra zhig 'dug kyang yig cha'i dkyus bzhin gsan yig gong ma tshor yang snang ngo / /kha'u pas mdzad pa'i mchod 'bul (ni rje/dur khrod gnas brgyad ma/ gnyan gyis mdzad pa'i phyag 'tshal (rno rje/bskang gso stobs chen shugs drag ma/ mchod 'bul (rdo rje/'jig rten khams kyi dgra bgegs ma/ kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gzigs dus mdzad pa'i bstod pa (rji rje/rdo rje 'chang dbang ma/ tshar lugs bstod 'bum na'ang yod/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa (rdo rje/sangs rgyas thams cad ma/ bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa /rdo rje/srid gsum dbang bsgyur ma/ brag thog pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa (rno rje/'jigs byed rngams nag ma/ gnyan los mdzad pa'i zhal gyi bskul (ni rje/dpal ldan mgon po ma/ des mdzad pa'i bskul (rdo rje/legs ldan nag po ma/thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i (gi rjed('o/gur gyi mgon po 'khor bcas gyi mdos chog rab 'jigs rdo rje'i me char/ shar phyogs (tshu)lha srin ma 'di'i nang na yod/des mdzad pa'i mgon po'i bskang gso rgyas pa rnams kyi lta ni rje)skabs su gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring sgo (331nasgo bzhi ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i 'cham yig lag len la 'dris par bya'o'i rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i zor 'cham ni ma thob/ mtha' can rnams/bcu gcig pa ngor lugs la sa bcad 'di skor ser pod na med kyang brgyud pa gcig pas e'i rtags bkod pa'o/ /—475

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dngul chu chos rdzong gi bla ma 'phags pa'i don du rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos (e)mdzad pa'i dkar chag /des mdzad pa'i gur mgon lha brgyad kyi (e)rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/ des mdzad pa'i mgon po che chung gi gtor ma'i cho ga dgra las rnam rgyal/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa bdud las (e)rnam rgyal le'u lnga pa/ des mdzad pa'i gtor ma la brten nas (d+ma da sgrub pa'i gdams pa g.yul las rnam rgyal/ des mdzad pa'i gur mgon gyi bskang ba'i cho ga (e)he ru ka dpal zhes pa'i slo ka gcig 'gor yod pa'i dpal ldan mgon po ma/ bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i (e)lag len rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug gis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa dge bar gyur cig gi mtha' can/des rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung bzhin brjed thor btab pa'i (e)mgon po gdong bzhi pa'i thugs dam bskang ba'i lag len/ 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhi dpal nag po chen po phyag 'tshal lo nag po chen po'i bsrung 'khor bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i mgon po khro bcu'i (e)bsrung 'khor mkhas grub gung ru'i zin bris kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang 'thob par shog gi mtha' can/'gor bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer ma mchis pa kye rdo rje'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang zhes yod pa'i (e)/331ba)gtor sgrub ngor lugs kyi zin bris gsal ba'i sgron me na t+na kirtis sbyar ba de'i zhor las bstod pa dang dbyangs kyi khungs bstan pa/ stobs srog gzhom pa'i man ngag ces pa g.yul las (e)rnam rgyal 'di dkar chag na mi gsal yang zin bris gyi khrod du don gyis tshang ba'i yin nam snyam/ gyi zhal shes zab mo rnams/bcu gnyis pa drung btsun pa nas brgyud pa las/ mkha' 'gro sbrags sgrub la 'jam pa dang rtsub par sgrub pa gnyis las dang po 'jam par sgrub pa'i nang sgrub zhi ba'i 'khrid yig brag rdzong ma nas cung zad (mchod rtend(yar/bsnan pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas rin cen gyis dben gnas dpal ldan rtser bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gsol ba btab nas snyan brgyud zab mo yi ger bris pa/ des dbus stod lo dgon par rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa'i ye ger gzhi —476

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)byas nas 'cho de rtend(ya ge bris pa'i rtsub par sgrub pa'i nang sgrub drag po'i yi ge /nang wed 'di gnyis thun mong ba yar klungs pa'i 'khrid yig dang thun mong ma yin pa gsang 'khrid gnyis nas man ngag thor bu tsam bsres shing gnyis ka dang mi 'dra ba zhig snang zhes rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje gsung ngo / /gtor ma la brten nas dgra gsad pa 'chod rteni/r+ṣa re lo8)til 'bru tsam yang med par byas par bsam mo'i mtha' can/ btsan po'i mkhar du gzhug 'chod rtend/rmi re kyi6)pa zhes pa'i mgon po'i gzi brjid bskyed pa thon pa kha sprod kyi man ngag /nang gi bsrung 'khor rdo rje 'chod rteshe(ya re lo3)brag rdzong ma'i zhal shes dge slong sangs rgyas rin cen gyis zin bris su bkod pa'i mtha' can/ rmi lam ngan pa lta me chod rtend/yi re lo3)mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog pa/ 'khon nag zas su za ba'i 'chod rtend/ya ge man (332na)ngag rnams dus kyi tho rengs su bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'khor rkyang gi rjes gnang bya tshul ni sngon 'gro mchod gtor (mchod rteni/6 she58)bsham pa zhes yod pa'i pu tra ming sring gi rjes gnang brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol bsrung ba rnams bya'o'i mtha' can/ bcu gsum pa thor bu'i skor la/ bo dong paṇa ོ gyis mdzad pa'i bskang gso rin cen 'bar ba yang des mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang bka' stod dang tshogs bdag ltar sgrub pa gsum gye dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/ des mdzad pa'i mgon po mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i mgon po phyag bcu drug pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ brgyad pa/ drug pa/ bzhi pa/ gnyis pa ste mgon po rigs drug gi mngon rtogs/ mgon po rigs drug gi rjes gnang dpal ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gsung gi rim pa'o'i mtha' can/ stag tshang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i chos skyong spyi la bstod cing bskang bshags su gsol ba rdo rje 'cha dbang ma/ des mdzad pa'i gur gyi mgon pa'i bstod pa bdud kyi stobs 'joms/ des mdzad pa'i zhal kyi bstod pa dpal ldan mgon po ma/ des mdzad pa'i las mgon gyi bstod pa dpal chen bka' sdod ma rnams legs par thob/ dkar chag na mi gsal ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i (go pu ḍā mdos chog gi lung yang nod do/ /—477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mkhas grub phal cher gyi rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur ba'i snying khrag gi gzungs lta bu snyan rgyud po ti'i skor/rtsa ba'i gnyis pa mkhas grub phal cher gyi rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i snying khrag gi gzungs lta bu snyan brgyud po ti'i skor ni/ dkar chag las/ kha ba can ljongs rdor 'dzin mang yang mkhas dang grub pa rgyun chad med pa de ni dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /sa skya par grags (332ba tshe sngags 'chang mang yang gsang chen snyan brgyud smra ba de ni kho bo'i bla ma kha'u pa/ kha'u pa yi rjes 'brang mang yang dgongs pa ji bzhin dad dang gus pas 'dzin pa de ni blo gsal dbang / /blo gsal dbang pos nag po chen po'i snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dkar chag bri yi bla ma lha yis gnang du gsol/ /zhes rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin mang yang snyan brgyud mtha' dag 'dzin pa ni rje rdo ring pa tsam dang / de'i rjes 'brang gi slob ma mtha' klas pa'i nang nas mgon po che chung sogs zab don gyi bka' babs ni rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje gcig pu yin pas gong du smros pa'i me 'bar ma'i rtsa ba'i sa bcad dang po gnyis dang kha skong bcas pa thun mong du mdzad nas brgyud pa bzhi 'dus yin na'ang / shin tu gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i snyan rgyud kyi skor rnams las thor bu 'ga' re ma gtogs kha'u brag rdzong pa'i brgyud tshul las rnam grangs mang po bgrang du med pas snyan brgyud glegs bam zhes 'e1gas su bsgrig par mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig las/ snyan brgyud ma dres chu bo nyams dga' ba/ /rnam bzhi brgyud pa'i gsung gi 'bab stegs las/ /nye bar 'ongs pa'i smin grol bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /sa skya'i bla chen thugs mtshor gcig tu 'khyil/ /de las phyogs brgyar gdams pa'i chu thig ni/ /thun mongs lha bas phyug pa 'phros na yang / /snyan brgyud nor bus gtams —478

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa'i rlabs 'phreng can/ /'khon ston ma ti gcig pa'i 'dzin mar babs/ /ngan rtog ba tsha spangs ba'i gaṅgā klung / /the tshom dri ma 'khrud pa'i bcud bzang ni/ /kun spangs drang srong kho na'i spyod yul las/(333na〉khas grub gzhan gyis nam yang thob ma gyur/ /ma lus gdams pa'i chu klung brgya phrag ni//dngos grub nor bus gtams pa du ma zhig /nam yang ngoms pa med par 'thung byed pa/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho'i rdzing las g.yin su zhig /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa ni tshar chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs par sku 'khrungs pa'i dus/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen rtse 'jam dbyangs dgag par 'khrungs te snyan brgyud kyi chos gnang ba'i gsol ba btab pas da lam res mi yong slar byed gsung ba sku tshe rjes ma la rten 'brel 'grig par dgongs pa sogs skye ba du mar dpon slob tu 'brel zhing / sku tshe 'dir yang / ji skad du/ bdag chen chos rje'i sku yi dbon skyes shing / (1)grub mchog rdo ring chos rje'i bstan la dad/ /(2sko rum chos rje'i thugs kyi sras su gyur/ /(3thasarab snying rje rnam dpyod phun tshogs shing / /(4)(5bod dang sgrub 4ngos bla ma mnyes pa ste/ /rgyu drug 'dzom pas zab mo'i gdams pa rnyed/ /grogs dag 'di 'dra'i skal bzang kho bo tsam/ /zhes rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pa drug tshang bas gdams pa rnams rdzogs par gsan pa/ brgyud pa de las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa nod pa la/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po'i snyan brgyud yi ger bkod pa'i dkar chag snying gi bdud rtsi'i zil dngar/ de las byung ba la gong ma'i gsung sgros kyi yi ge /sga ā nan+da pas mdzad pa'i yi ge /bar skabs kyi snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i gsung sgros/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung / rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yi ge /rdo rje 'chang tshar (333ba/pa chos rjes mdzad pa yi ge /dkar chag tu ma 'khod pa'i yi ge /de dag kun la thun mong du nye bar mkho ba'i skor dang brgyad/ dang po la/ 'gor oṃ su sti dha ma sang kri ma tang bi ra zhes yod pa'i nag po chen po'i lo rgyus lha bkod las sbyor gsum dang bcas pa las sbyor bde ba'i rnam dag bzhugs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor nag po chen po'i lo rgyus ni ma rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur nas zhes yod pa'i —479

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mgon po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus zhes bya ba'i yig chung deng sang gi bar na kun la gsal te lo rgyus so'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo 'khor lo mu khyud lnga skor lte ba la gri gug gi zhes yod pa'i rang bsrung 'khor lo rab gnas dang bcas pa ā tsarla spos pā da'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa badz+ra kha tham gyi mtha' can/ 'gor 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed la na mo gshin rje pra khong nag gi rgyud las zhes yod pa'i dam can la/ (rgya/ru mtshon 'dzugs pa'i yi ge phyon chen pos gud du bkol ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ de'i zhar byung du srog mdung ru mtshon 'dzugs pa'i tshigs bcad dkar chag mi gsal ba gong gi khongs su gtogs sam snyam/ bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ 'gor lha mo chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo de'i sgrub pa la bzhi ste zhes yod pa'i lha mo phyi pa mu stegs pa ltar bsgrub pa'i rgya gzhung gsal byed kyi yig chung yid bzhin nor bu rngog pa'i lha mo phyi sgrub gyi rgya gzhung gi 'grel pa lag len ma dang zhus dag pher zhes tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po gsung ches bya ba 31 tsā ba rin cen bzang po la gdams pa/ 'gor dpal mgon po zhes bya ba'i sgrub (334na)thabs dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan zhes yod pa'i ye shes kyi mgon po dang las kyi mgon po ber nag zangs gri can sbrags ma'i gsang sgrub kyi yig rnying rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ las mgon gyi yum 'jigs byed khrag 'thung ma rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi la brten nas sgrub pa dang / las kyi mgon po gsod byed gdug pa'i gri gug can tsan dan gyi beng dang mtshon cha gri gug 'bar ba la brten nas bsgrub pa 'khor lo dang las sbyor la brten nas dgra bo myur du sgrol ba'i thabs bal po pham mthing pa nas mal lo la brgyud pa'i yi ge 'bum phrag gsum bzlas na 'di thams cad 'grub pa yin gsung ba'i mtha' can 'di'i rjes su 0 seng ge /bha tri stag /sring mo dre'u la zhan pa'i drag sgrub kho bos ma thob/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis ma gsan gsung / sa skya khri chen gyi gsan 'dug pa rin po che bod mkhar ba nas lo pa spyan snga la brgyud pa yin nam snyam/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i mu stegs kyi ngan sngags rkyal 'bud ces pa mon chung pu tra'i rkyal 'bud kyi rtsa ba'i yi ge mnyal ba rong ling lo tsā bas bal yul du bram ze ha ra ri ma la —480

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gser srang ga sdo/ma phul nas sdos sa pa 'di gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra dang tha dad yin pas bsre bar mi bya zhes snyan brgyud rol mtsho dang lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan sogs su snang ngo / /'gor mon chung pu tra'i rkyal 'bud thun mong ma yin pa nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo thebs bzlog brtsi mi dgos zhes yod pa'i de'i lag len gyi yi ge rnal 'byor smyon pa'i mtshon char gnang ba'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ su sti mon chung (334ba)rkyal 'bud la gsum ste zhes yod pa'i rkyal 'bud kyi zhal gdams yi ge gnas dben par mis mi mthong ba bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo ma hā kā la mu stegs shrī ral pa can gyi rkyal 'bud 'di byung tshul ji ltar brgyud pa'i rim pa ni zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus (zhin dang bcas pa'i yi ge bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig gi mtha' can nor phyir gtang ba'i mon bu pu tra nag po rnam gsum gyi yi ge mal lo'i lugs slob dpon snye ston gyis jo sras rgyal mtshan la gnang ba/ bdud pu tra'i sgrub thabs gtsang rong gi rā nag lo tsā ba'i gdams pa khyad par can rgya ston gyis gsal bar bris pa/ phyi pa'i lha bshan pa ro khur 'di la yang bdud pu trar lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan du ngos 'dzin no/ /gyi man ngag bshan pa'i cho 'phrul mgo brnyan mar grags pa yar klungs pas klu'i dgon pa shug ra bde chen du dag par bgyis pa/ sbrags sgrub kyi skabs su ma hā kā la'i sgrub thabs kyi rigs bsdus pa zhes pa dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la la mgon po chen po bcu gnyis kyis bskor zhes sogs brgyad brgyad drug cu rtsa bzhi ston pa'i yig chung tshigs 'di dang kha skong po tir yo da pa 'dra min snang / bcad ma dgra bgegs ma lus thal ba'i rdul du rlog gi mtha' can/ las sbyor gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i slob dpon chen po pad+mas mdzad pa'i srung ma spyi'i dmod bcol snga ma la me 'bar mar yang bzhugs/ (rgya/mi brjed gzungs thob jo mo mkhar chen bza'i bla dpe/ yang des mdzad pa'i chos skyong spyi'i snying chu (rje/bsre ba yon tan rab rgyas ma/ des mdzad pa'i chos skyong gi srog 'phrog pa/ bcing pa khyi bzhin 'khrid pa/ phyi (335na)ma mi 'breng ba/ rtsal 'gran pa ste zab pa'i gnad (rje/'o rdo rje/lnga'i man ngag /'khon nag zas su za ba'i gdams pa slob dpon klu sgrub nas ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma dang gnyan lo nas brgyud pa/ bya rog gi —481 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dbang po lnga sogs la brten pa'i nag (mu)(8)po chen po'i cho 'phrul ston pa'i man ngag rnams/gnyis pa sga ā nan+da dam pas mdzad pa'i yig cha la/ nag po chen po sgrub thabs 'di la mang du gsung yang don gsum du 'du tshul sogs spyi'i khog bsgrigs ā nan+da ki rta'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi 'o'i mtha' can/ sngon 'gro rten dang mchod gtor gyi skabs nye bar mkho ba'i shog dril bcu par grags pa'i nang tshan 'gor rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dam rnams zhes yod pa'i sngon 'gro shom gyi shog dril dam pa kun dga' grags kyis 'phags pa rin po cher lus 61ngas spyod thams cad phul nas sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i bka' 'bangs dang 'khas tog mdzad par brten pha phogs kyi tshul du gnang ba 'khon dharma rak+ṣi ta dang zhang dkon cog dpal sogs kyi ched du mdzad pa'i rin cen nor 'dra'i man ngag zab mo 'di su zhig rnyed nas srog ltar gces par bzung gi mtha' can/ sku gzugs bzheng tshul yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa dgos 'dod thams cad kyi 'byung khungs bris sku sgrub pa'i shog dril/ phyag mtshan gri gug gis gsod pa'i las sgrub pa'i shog dril/ phyag mtshan thod pa la brten nas dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub pa'i shog dril/ dgra bgegs tshar gcod gaṇ+ḍi sgrub pa'i shog dril/ dmag thog ser rlung gnon pa ral gri sgrub pa'i shog dril/ dgra bgegs zil gyis gnon cing cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa thug (335ba bla na sgrub pa'i shog dril/ khro tshogs pho nya sdud cing dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i rnga chen sgrub pa'i shog dril/ nyams chag thams cad skong zhing bar gcod kyis mi tshugs pa kha ṭ+wāṃ sgrub pa'i shog dril/ gtum drag mi bzad pho nya'i las rim sgrub pa'i shog dril te bcu/ gzungs 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad lus kyi mun nag zil gnon ma/ 'gor de nas rta nag po sogs rten rnams la chen dmar po bskus zhes yod pa'i gzungs bskyed chog rgyas pa dang bsdus pa hūṃ las byung ba'i rta mchog ma dang bcas pa bla ma la gus pas zhu bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo ma hā kā lwa ya dang mgon po'i man ngag tsit+ta brtag pa'i rim pa ni zhes yod pa'i gsang rten gyi skabs su gri snying brtag pa'i yi ge nag po'i rgyud las gsungs pa'o'i mtha' can/ dus gcig la chig brgyud kyi gras/ 'gor bla ma dang —482

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo bca' ba rten gyi skabs su gri snying 'khor lo zhes yod pa'i gri snying 'khor lo thun mong ma yin pa'i bca' tshul rab gnas zhag bdun ma dang bcas pa'i yig chung yid bzhin nor bu ci bsam 'grub par 'gyur ba dus gcig la chig brgyud ma/ sbrags sgrub kyi skabs su 'khor lo dang ling ga'i bri yig (tshu/ces pa mgon po'i 'khor lo pad 'dab bzhi pa/ lha mo'i brgyad pa/ gnon sbyin pho mo'i lto 'bor/ 'jam lugs kyi pho mo'i 'khor lo/ rtsub lugs kyi pho mo'i 'bor lo/ bzlog 'khor/ dgra bo'i snying gar 'jug pa'i 'khor lo rdzong chung pa rnams 'di lid+ma'i bri yig tu bzhed/ ming sring gsum gyi gzungs 'dri lugs/ ling ga 'khor lo can 'di rdzong wo par med/ gyi bri yig rnams ston pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum (336na)gyi zhal gdams (khri)yig brgya nyams chags kha skong ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor bsnyen sgrub las gsum la bsnyen pa'i dus su mgon po'i sngags thung zhes yod pa'i sngags kyi bzla (khri)thabs de nas brgya pa bzla'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor hūm̐ las sngags kyis bskor ba la zhes yod pa'i las bzhi'i dmigs (6da/khri)pa tshar gcad pas bsam mo gu spo sa ma ya'i mtha' can/ srog gta' mar 'dzin pa/ snying rten du 'dzin pa/ 'khor lo dbye ba/ rang ka gshed dbab pa/yi dam gyi bsnyen sgrub/ gtor ma'i gnad de chings chen drug gi zhal gdams snod min dam tshig med pa la sbyin na nag po chen pos snying khrag 'thung zhig gi mtha' can/ bsgom pa lha'i gnad kyi man ngag sbyor dngos rjes rnam pa gsum sgrub pa'i man ngag dam pa yin no zhes bla ma gsung ngo sa ma pa tha ma'i mtha' can/ zhar byung bsnyen sgrub las gsum gtor ma dang bris sku tsam la brten pa/ glo bur las bcol gsum gyi tho tsam bstan pa dkar chag na migs la/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi gtor ma/ nyams chag skong ba/ 'chi ltas dang rmi lam dang ngan pa bzlog pa/ lo zla dus tshone dang rdzas gnad/ rjes gnang gi khyad bcos 'di dkar chag tu mi gsal/ gtor ma phul bas rtags ma byung na nyes pa bsgrag pa gsang 'dus lugs bzhin bya ba'i zhal 'phang bya sha lpags pa dang bcas pa rnams gcig tu dril bar gtor ma'i man ngag /pha rol gyi rbod gtong drag po rlung sbyor gyi sgo nas bzlog pa/ 'di las 'phros pa'i man —483

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)chen po'i sras po drag po chen po'i bsnyen sgrub las la 'jug pa don gsum ma zhes pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge chig brgyud ma'i gras/ des mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi dus su rmi lam gtan la dbab pa'i man ngag rtags yig du grags pa/ pu tra'i gtor chog theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos dpal nyan po'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ gur zhal rnam gnyis kyi bla brgyud bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yan gyi mtshan byang skad gnyis sbyar ba/ nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan 'dren sngags byang dang bcas pa dad pa dam tshig ma 'byug rdzas kyi ngos 'dzin dang bcas pa rje btsun gyi phyag bris dngos las zhal bshus pa/ shā sa na'i sngags don (e)ser bod na 'a rda dz+nya ya na rdo rje lang kun dga' bzang pos 'grol bar mdzad de man zhabs tog tu bris zer ba 'dug /dkyus su bkral ba ci /dkar chag na gur zhal las mkhan dang bcas pa'i sngags byang zer ba las ngor pa dang sa bzang pa sogs nang gses kyi dbye gsal mi 'dug /yang sa bzang ma tis rgya dpe bdun la gtugs nas mchan bus (337ba/(ed/ni/bkral ba gcig /lha mo'i sngags kyang bkral 'dug /des shwa sa (d+ma mi lo tho/na bod 'di glegs bam du bzhuṭa kyang dkar chag tu mi gsal/ skad kyi tshigs bcad du sdebs pa gcig /gur zhal las mgon dang bcas pa'i sngags byang rgyas pa mchan bus bkrol ba/ gong gsal kyi sngags byang gsum po dpe phywa gcig tu yod/ mgon chen las mgon dang bcas pa'i grol med pa'i sngags byang / (6)bsdus par grags pa bla ma dam pa ngag dbang grags pa'i dpal gyis gong ma'i phyag dpe la gtugs te mdzad pa/ yang sngags byang mjug na kun la ngag 'dzin byed pa phyag len yin zhes yod pa'i chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis zhus dag mdzad pa ltar yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal gyi klu'i dgon par bris pa'i phyag bris dngos las bshus pa/ gtsang rigs kyi dpal mgon bdun cu dang bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi srog sngags dang bum rdzas lnga tshan lnga'i ngos 'dzin phan yon dang bcas pa rnams/ bzhi pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung la/ de nyid kyis mdzad pa dngos dang de'i gsung sgros zin bris su byas pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'gor bla ma dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo 'dir rdo rje nag po chen po'i man ngag gi tho bla —485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonama'i zhal las byung ba cung zad brjod na zhes yod pa'i sgrub skor gyi khog phub kyi yi ge phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig gi mtha' can/ me 'bar ma'i dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu'i bang mdzod/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu/ deng sang gsang ba'i mgon khang la gsang ba yid bzhin nor (338na)bu'i mgon khang zhes pa'ang sgrub yig 'di la brten nas thogs shing / thog mar slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal bar zin bris tsam zhig gnang ba khong gi grogs dam pa zhig nas 'phel ba'i phyag tu 'byor pas man ngag shes par 'dod na med kha med cig byung 'dug par dgongs nas chos kyi bu dang rigs gyi tsha bo rnams kyi don du zhus dag dang mjug gi tshigs bcad sogs gnang ba yin la/ de yang gangs kyi chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa de//ngang pa rgyal pos 'byed shes gzhan min ltar/ /ma nor gnad kyi bcud rnams len shes pa/ /da lta'i dus na bdag las gzhan su zhig /de lta'i blo gros gang gis mthus byung ba/ /mkhyen brtse nus mthu mchog gi 'byor ba can/ /dpal ldan bla ma nam mkha'i mtshan can zhabs/ /'dren mchog de yi drin las rnyed par gyur/ /zhes zab pa las kyang ches zab pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu snyan nas zhal nas snyan zhal du brgyud pa'i gdams pa rnams ni yab 'jam dbyangs chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan kho na lags na zhing / de yan du gdams pa kha 'thor nas shes rlom phal cher gyis zing zing por gyur nas rtogs dka' ba dag bstan pa rin po che'i lcags rir nag po 'gro shes kyi tshul du bkod pa gnang ba yin pas/ spyir snyan brgyud kyi glegs bam yongs rdzogs bka' dam par ma zad/ gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu'i yi ge 'di dus gcig la snod ldan gyi slob ma gcig la rig brgyud du spel ba'i phyag len nyams pa med cing / de'i rgyu mtshan yang ji skad du/ mthu chen dregs pa'i dbang phyug gdong bzhi la/ /gnyer du gtad do dam (338bsnyams stod min la/ / spel na de yi snying khrag gsol bar mdzod/ /bla ma la gus dam tshig snying rjer ldan/ bstan la sems pa'i stod ldan byung gyur na/ /thog mar dam btags gcig brgyud tshul du sbyin/ /de mthar bka' rgyas gdab pa shen tu gces/ /zhes 486

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gsung pa brgyud 'dzin mtha' dag gis snying gi dpal be'ur bcangs shing 'chang bar 'gyur ba sha stag go /'gor na mo gu ra we 'di ltar phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i de ltar gyi 'char sgo rtog rigs bag chags dang bcas pa 'di dag ces yod pa'i nang sgrub dang gsang sgrub kyi gnad kyi zin bris skye ba'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung ba mtshon pa'o'i mtha' can/ nang gsang gi 'khrid ma thob par lung mi mdzad pa phyag len no/ /mgon po khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor la nye bar mkho ba'i khro bcu'i man ngag zhal rton rmenagadams dang bcas pa bya 'gyur rdo rje'i pho brang du kun dgas yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas mdzad pa rnams/ gnyis pa gsung sgros zin bris kyi skor la/ bka' babs bzhi'i rnam gzhag /sku gsung thugs phyi nang gsang ba'i rten bsham tshul/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor/ gtor ma dang mchod pa'i rim pa/dam pa'i shog dril drug lag len rnams gsal bar ston pa'i zin bris mchan/ (zha)mor grags pa/mjug na ji skad du/ 'di las phun tshogs dge ba gang thob des/ /blo gros khang bzang snyan brgyud nor gyis gtams/ /rgyal mtshan 'phyar bas gzi brjid khams gsum 'gengs/ /dpal 'byor bzang pos dbul phongs zhi bar shog ces pa'i mtha' can/ 'di yang dus gcig la tshig brgyud las mi gnang / yang dgon mkhan chen dpal (339na dzin bkra shis pas zin bris su btab pa'i skor la/'gor oṃ su sti ༷ bla ma dang dam can srung ma'i tshogs snyel gus pas phyag 'tshal lo sems can thams cad kyi don du sku bzhi'i dbang phyug ces yod pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i dbye ba/ brgyud nas chos skyong bsten tshul/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ rkyang sgrub sbrags sgrub/ phyi rten phyi ru bca' ba/ nang rten nang du bca' ba bsnyen sgrub las sbyor/ gsang rten gsang bar bca' ba 'khu ldog spong ba/ phyi sgrub 3|ga dril drug gi lag len sogs ston pa'i zin bris rgyas pa gzhan gyi rkyen bzlog tu song ba'i nyen yod sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag go'i mtha' can/ dus gcig la chig brgyud ma'i gras/ 'gor sa skya pa'i mgon po'i ru mtshon bca' thabs la zhes yod pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i ru mtshon gyi zin bris bstod pa byed tshul rnams gzhan dang 'dra 'o'i mtha' can/ mgon po'i gtor chen byed tshul la rnal 'byor pa 487

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)kha lho la bltas pa'i mdun du zhes yod pa'i gtor chen gyi zin bris rkang rjes rnams rdo rje rgya gram du bsam mo'i mtha' can 'gor mdos la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa la dang po ni zhes gnyis sogs yod pa'i mdos kyi zin bris mkha' 'gro rnams kyi 'khru ldog mi 'byung zhing bzod par gsol gyi mtha' can/ de'i cha lag mdos byin gyis brlab 'di dkar chag na mi gsal yang gong gi 'phros yin nam snyam/pa bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni zhes sogs brjod do'i mtha' can/ yang dgon mkhan chen pa'i zin bris 'di rnams ngo mtshar ba'i legs bshad dang nor 'brul cung zad kyang yod ces rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes gsung pas/ (339ba)slad mar yang yi ge man ngag gzhan dag dang bstun pa'i dpyad dgos par snang ngo / /lnga pa rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yi ge la/ nag po chen po'i khu ldog spang ba/ bzlas pa'i spyi'i sngon du 'gro ba brgyad dang so so'i khyad par gsum bstan pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa/ srog phur gyi man ngag rnams bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis yig ris so sor bkod pa slob ma'i don du mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma phul nas mi dgag pa'i mtshan ma byung bar brten bcos bslad med par gcig tu bsdoms nas kha'u skyed lhas nas 'go brtsams dpal e waṃ chos ldan du rdzogs par grub pa'i yi ge mjug tu 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/badz+ra shrī me ga la sirnyi/ bar sdings pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje rnams las rim par brgyud pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis bka' rgyas btab nas gnas tshul bcas yod pa dus gcig la tshig brgyud las mi gnang ba/ mnga' ris pa dge slong chos skyong grags dang dmar khams pa grags pa dkon cog seng ges lo drug bdun gyi bar du bskul ba la brten nas chos skyong la gsol ba btab pas mi dgag pa'i gnang (6)(bra)ba byung bar brten lcags bya snon zla ba'i nyer lnga la dpal e wam chos ldan du mdzad pa'i kha sbyor dbye ba brgyad kyi man ngag gi yi ge dus gcig la chig brgyud ma'i gras/ de'i mjug tu lha dbye'i ngag 'don gyi rim pa/ 'di dkar chag na mi gsal ba gong gi 'phros su gtogs sam snyam/ nag po chen po'i nang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang sgrub kyi 'khrid yig lta')rab 'byams pa blo gros rab —488

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gsal gyis bskul ba la brten dpal mgon (340na)por gsol ba btab pas gnang ba'i skabs thob nas kha'u brag rdzong du mdzad pa/ bsrung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong gi nyams len gyi yi ge rgyas pa tshar chen gyis yun ring nas bskul zhing yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas nag po chen pos gnang ba'i skabs thob ste kha'u brag rdzong gi gnas mchog tu sbyar ba/ 'gor na mo gu ra we dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsrung 'khor brag rdzong gi nang gi nyams len zhes yod pa'i drag po sngags rgod kyi man ngag gsung gi bdud :nywa'i mtha' can/ 'gong bla ma nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo bsgom pa'i man ngag la gsum gyi dang po zhes yod pa'i nang dam tshig gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba gsang ba'i brag rdzong ma'i yi ge snod dang ldan pa la sbyin gyi gzhan la ni ma yin no'i mtha' can/ phyi nang gi 'khrid yig 'di rnams nyams 'khrid ma thob par gnang srol mi 'dug go /ser ba bsrung ba'i yi ge mjug tu/ /'di 'dra'i man ngag gdams pas ni/ /ser ba thub pa the tshom med/ /rang gi slob mas bskul nas ni/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa bris pa la/ /bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod/ ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad yod pa/ sngags pa nang rgyas kyi man ngag shin tu gsang zhing sba bar bya zhes pa'i mtha' can dus gcig tu tshig brgyud kyi gras/ 'di'i rjes su rdo ring rin po che'i gsung rje bas sgo rum pas zin bris mdzad pa'i brag rdzong ma ni dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/ las mgon bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i gtor chog tshar chen gyis bskul ba la brten nas kha'u brag rdzong du mdzad pa rnams/ drug pa rdo rje'i 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i yi ge la/ me 'bar ma'i dkar chag snying po gnad kyi sgron me (340ba)tshigs bcad ma/ 'di'i mjug na de lta bu'i man ngag glegs bam 'di zhes sogs kyi sho lo ka drug tsam zhig sa skya'i phyag dper bris 'dug kyang gnas gsar dang bod mkhar ba gnyis da'i phyag dper mi 'dug cing lung yang ma thob/ mgon po'i man ngag zab bsdus kha skong rnams kyi dkar chag zab don gsal ba'i sgron me/ snyan brgyud zhal shes yi ger bkod pa'i dkar chag gsang chen gnad kyi za ma tog /gyi ljang lugs kyi khog phub dkar chag zab don gnad kyi lde mig /'dod khams dbang phyug dud sol ma'i dkar chag snyan brgyud gsal ba'i me long / dpal rdo rje nag po chen —489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonapo gur gyi mgon po'i lha dang chos skor byung tshul gyi lo rgyus man mal lo tsā ba'i lo rgyu kyi ma sgos nas lor lus pas ma
