tshang kyang lung byung la/ 'di'i rjes su nag po chen po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa 'i:na bris dang btsoganyisama'i zin bris dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/ ngag gi khog phub snyan brgyud rin po che'i lde mig /'gor na maḥ shrī gu ru badz+ra ma hā kā wā ya gur gyi mgon po khro bcu'i zhes yod (zha)pa'i mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang gi yi ge bkra shis seng ge des bdag blo gsal la 'o'i mtha' can/ las mgon zangs gri can rnam gnyis kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge chos rje tshul khrims pa des bdag la 'o'i mtha' can/ dpal sa skya pa'i bstan srung dbang po rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga snyan brgyud zab mo'i man ngag gis rnam par brgyan pa'i phrin las myur mgyogs kyi pho nya/ 'gor bla ma mchog dang dpal he ru ka dbyer med pa la phyag 'tshal lo dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhes yod pa'i mgon po lcam dral gyi gtor chog ngag dbang gzhon nu'i gsung gis (341na tha skul ba'i ngor gtsang stod zha lu'i chos grwar sbyar ba/ 'gor bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhes yod pa'i lcam dral gyi gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru sogs brjod kyi mtha' can/ 'gor na maḥ shrī ma hā kā lu ya dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgo nas tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa zhes yod pa'i gur mgon dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi yi ge dgyes pas bskyang du gsol gyi mtha' can/mgon po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga (zha)dngos grub rin cen bang mdzod/brgyud 'debs rnam kun mchog ldan ma/ bsrung 'khor ( 'i ga/gsang 'khrid ljag lung dngos gzhi'i skabs gsang 'drid man gyi dpe ma 'byor dang bcas pa rgyun du nyams su len tshul kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa ma nor pa'i snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu rdo rje'i mched zla ar+sha sirnyi shrī gyi nyams len du zho lung mtsho kha'i ri khrod du mdzad pa/ dpal gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad sbrags te bsgrub pa'i bsrung 'khor mdun khang 'phags pa'i yi ge'i gsal (zhir/byed rje bla ma ma hā kwa la'i gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs te tho tsam bkod pa/ 'di'i nyams len yod na nad yams sogs yul phyogs tsam du yang mi 'byung zhes sga ā 490

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nan dam pas che ba dpag tu med pa mdzad pas zab gnad ma'o/ /'gor gu ru badz+ra dha ra na mo gsang sgrub kyi skabs su rje bla ma'i gsung nas zhes yod pa'i gsang sgrub kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i gsung sgros snying gi dkyil las gzhan du ma yin no'i mtha' can tshig brgyud kyi gras/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi le'u bco lnga pa dkyil 'khor chen po bsdus pa'i (341ba)rtog pa las nang sgrub dang gsang sgrub bstan tshul pha rgod rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin de ma thag tu zin bris bgyis pa/ gsang rten bla rdo bcang thabs/ 'di'i sbyar byang du/ dam can 'khu ldog spong ba'i gdams pa'i bcud/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas cung zad yig ris su/ /mdzad kyang nam mkha'i mdzub ris ji bzhin du/ /snyan brgyud zhal shes bral bas rtogs mi nus/ /'dir ni ma sbas lag len lhug par bris/ /bka' drin dran no rje btsun kha'u pa/ /gsang chen bstan pa gtad do snying gi bu/ zhes mdo khams rdo rje bkra shis la gnang ba yin pas bka' rgya shin tu dam par 'dug cing chig brgyud kyi gras kyang yin/ nang sgrub kyi 'khor lo lnga'i las sbyor thun mong ma yin pa spu gri so 'debs kyi gdams pa rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i phyag bris dngos zin bris thor bu 'khrugs can du bzhugs pa las bka'i gnang ba zhus te dkyus su bris pa tshig brgyud ma'i gras/ 'gor na mo badz+ra ā tsarla dam can rgya mtsho'i yum chen ma zhes yod pa'i e ka dza ṭi la brten nas rims nad bsrung ba'i gdams pa rje btsun rdo ring pa'i gsung gi nying khu sa ma pa tha mi'i mtha' can/ nag po chen po la klu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sgo nas char 'bebs pa'i yi ge zhag gsum tshun la 'babs bar 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo gu ru bla ma dang ma hā kā la'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo 'dir mgon po dbyer med du bsre ba zhes yod pa'i chos skyong gi snying chu bsre ba'i zhal shes kyi yi ge mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung brjed byang du bkod pa'i mtha' can/ bsrung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i zab gnad kyi bsdus don nam thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi sa bcad mthong (342na8na dge legs kun 'byung du grags pa/ brag rdzong ma'i lde kha gdags pa'i man ngag phyi rol rdzas kyi sbyor ba'i man ngag zhal shes mal phur gyi yi ge —491

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonadapon chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas mdzad pa bka' brgya dam pa'i gras/ 'gor su sti dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa'i bsrung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i yig chung las zhes yod pa'i gtor ma la brten nas dgra bgegs rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i man ngag gi yi ge lta bu'i ngang du bzhag rjes spyi ltar bya'o'i mtha' can/ ser ba bsrung 'bebs kyi man ngag dug gi rlung chen nag po zhar byung thog bsrung shwa bzlog dang bcas pa dpal brag mig chos rdzong gi yang dben du mdzad pa/dam can srung ma rnams la phyi rten 'dzugs pa'i lag len gyi yi ge nag po 'gro shes kyi tshul du gtsang rong mtsho la'i mgul gyi ri khrod bsam gtan rtser sbyar ba/ gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i dam can srung ma rnams kyi thun mong gi ru mtshon 'dzugs pa'i yi ge /zab gnad 'di dag la brten nas chos srungs rnams mtsho la ngang pa dang sha rul la sbrang ma ltar 'dus pas kha'u skyed lhas/ rtses dang bsam gtan gling / phan yul dpal ldan rtse sogs srung ma rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas yin zhes pa'ang gnad 'gag zab mo la brten pa yin gyis/ snang shes dbang gi khang pa'i yang thog rtser/ /rnga thug 'dzugs pa'i skye bo mang na yang / /brgyud pa'i man ngag lag len dang ldan pa/ /'di 'dra shes pa'i sngags 'chang nyin skar tsam/ zhes gsungs pa don la gnas pas zab gnad mi shes pa'i lder bzo gog po tsam la yid gtod par mi bya'o/ /nag po chen po'i dmar chen gtor bzlog (342ba8 cho ga dgra bgegs kyi stobs 'phrog rol pa/ 'di ni mgon po la brten pa'i gtor zlog gi cho ga 'khrul pa med pa yin la/ deng sang dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi tshab la mgon po dang las gshin gyi tshab tu pu tras byas pa'i mgon po drug cu par grags pa sogs ni zhwa dpe lham la bkab pa kho na las/ ji skad du/ rtsang zlog mu stegs byed la yod ces thos/ /dgra chos zhes bya g.yung drung bon gyi yin/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi gshin rje pa la grags/ /'di ni drag po gtor ma'i zlog par brjod/ ces gsungs pa yid la ri mor 'dri bar bya'o/ /bstod bskul 'og min bde chen ma/ dam can pu tra'i bskang gso phrin las lhun grub/ de'i bskang rdzas byin rlabs rlung ltar tshub ste byon par gyur badz+ra sa mā dze'i mtha' can/ chos skyong —492

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gi dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar rnams/ bdun pa dkar chag du mi bzhugs pa'i yig cha'i skor la/mthu chen ā nan dam pas mdzad pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos mdzad pa/ rje btsun sgo rum pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa dang gsung rgyun zin bris/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa/ khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pas mdzad pa/ kha'u brag rdzong pa'i phyag len du mdzad pa'i bstod 'bum dang bcu gnyis/ dang po ni/ nang sgrub la brten pa'i bsnyen pa/ mi 'khru mi ldog srog tig blang ba'i gnad (343na 'jam gar bsgrub pa/ las sbyor/ myur ba'i gnad gtor ma'i man ngag dang bcas pa ma hā kā la'i spu gri so 'debs kyi man ngag shin tu rno myur du bsgrub par grags pa/ dus gcig tu chig brgyud kyi gras/ gnyis pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro 'khru ldog spong bar (zha)(khrin rgyu rtags nyes dmigs/ mi ldog pa'i man ngag gi phyi rol lha sogs gnad drug 'di gnyis gas du zhal 'pha ngas nang sngags sogs gnad drug gi man ngag /gsang ba yang tig sems kyi gnad lnga la brten nas bran bzhin bkol ba'i zab pa'i gnad kyi man ngag spogs chog 'di gzhan du kha 'phangs/ dang bcas pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu gzhan la phan pa'i blos mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gsol ba btab ste mdo smad gnyan tshe'i sa'i char sbyar ba/ mjug na/ bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /bstan la sems pa'i bu yi mchog /snying dang 'dra ba gcig la sbyin/ /g.yin yang mang du spel gyur na/ las mkhan pu tra 'khor bcas kyis/ /mgo chod snying khrag zhal du gsol/ zhes bka' rgya dam par snang ngo //'khu ldog spong ba'i sa bcad bzhi pa'i zhal 'phangs pa spogs chog gi gsal byed srog phur gyis gnad du sdigs pas las myur du 'grub pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu'i yi ge rang gi dran pa gso phyir bris pa/ rje bas rdo ring pas mdzad pa'i yin cha 'di rnams lha drugs sdebs su gong du'ang bsas/ 'gor na mo gu ru mgon —493—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)po'i gtor chen bya bar 'dod pas rnal 'byor pa kha lhor bltas zhes yod pa'i mgon po lha brgyad rtond/khri)kyi gtor zlog gi phyag len dben gnas kha'u brag rdzong du sbyar ba rnams/ (343ba bzlas pa spyi'i sngon 'gro brgyad/ so so'i khyad par bstan pa gsum gyi zhal shes skal bar (zhad/khri)ldan pa rnams kyi don du legs par sbyar ba/ mjug na/ snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag dam pa 'di/ /kun la mi sbyin gsang ba'i bka' rgya yod/ /snod ldan dag la chig brgyud tshul du sbyin/ /gzhan la rgya cher mang du spel gyur na/ /las kyi mgon pos zangs gri rnon po yi/ /de yi mgo chod yan lag rgyan du gyis/ /man ngag rin chen snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /zhes snang ngo / /chos tshan bzhi po dus gcig la chig brgyud du gnang ba'i bka' rgya can yin cing / las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro zhes pa kha sbyor dbye ba brgyad kyi man ngag lung yang snang ngo'i mtha' can rigs sngags go ldog yi ge g.yin nas thon pa las 'di kha'i gras kyi yig chung ma rnyed pas slar btsal lo/ /nag po chen po'i sgo nas phrin las gang sgrub kyang gtor ma bca' shes dgos sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag gi gtor ma'i rnam (zhi)gzhag bzod par gsol ba'i mtha' can/ lcam dral gyi gtor ma (ne)bsham thabs don gsum pa dam pa kun dga' grags las brgyud pa man ngag8gyi'i mtha' can/ gsum pa rje btsun rdo ring pas mdzad pa ni/ spyi don gsum pa dgra bo rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i zhal shes gtor ma (ni lo6)'phangs na de ni rang gshed rang gis byed nges so'i mtha' can/ bzhi pa rje btsun sgo rum pas mdzad pa la/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsar gsungs (she(khra)pa'i mgon po'i rjes gnang gi tho/ 'gor rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i spyi bo'i nang du zhes yod pa'i tshe sgrub (zhad/khri)pa bdag mo tshe brtan bu 'dren la gnang ba/ 'gor na mo gu ra we rno (344na)gsum mtshon du brdung ba'i dmigs pa tshar (she(/ na nas zhes med pa'i brag rdzong ma'i khyad par gyi zhal shes rig stong thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur gyi mtha' can/ 'gor na maḥshrī ma hā kā lwa ya dbang sdud bsrung 'khor raṃ zhes yod pa'i dbang gi dngos grub (ni lo6)bsgrub pa'i thabs zab mo mi dbang bsod nams rab brtan la gnang ba/ nag po chen po'i dbang gi sbyin sreg gi —494

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)cho ga mi dbang rtond(khra)bsod nams rab brtan gyis bskul nas tshul zang rab brtan du sbyar ba/de'i zhal shes 'gor su sti thab khung du me sbar te me lha me dpung du gyur ba'i dbus su (zhad/khri)zhes yod pa gsung gi bdud rtsi'i mtha' can/ khon gcugs (zhe)1bra)sbyang ba'i dmigs pa nyes lhung thams cad dag par mos pa 'o'i mtha' can/ bsnyen pa'i dmigs (zhad/khri)pa byin gyi brlabs pa'i mos pa nyid lags kyi mtha' can/ shā sa na'i rims bsrung (zhad/khri)ba mi dbang gsod nams rab brtan la gnang ba bo'i mtha' can/ las bzhi'i bskul rgyal kun mthu stobs(zhad/khri)ma mi dbang bsod nams rab brtan la gnang ba rnams/ lnga pa rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa dang gsung rgyun zin bris la/ nag po chen po'i chos skor gyi khog phub man ngag gi rnam par bshad(zhe)pa zab don snyan brgyud kyi rol mtsho legs bshad kyi rba rlabs rnam par g.yo ba mchod pa bsham pa man 'phror lus pa/ khro bcu'i rjes gnang gi skabs nye bar mkho ba'i sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur ba'i man ngag rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ/ phaṭa swā hā'i mtha' can/ ru mtshon las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i rjes gnang bka' gtad kyi (344bge ge snyan brgyud sbas don gsal ba nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa/ 'gor na mo badz+ra dha rā ya bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa la zhes yod pa'i mgon po lha (ma/brgyad kyi bsrung 'khor gyi yi ge snyan brgyud rdo rje'i go khrab sa ma pa tha mi'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i zhal shes ni zhes yod pa'i brag rdzong ma'i bsrung 'khor thun mongs ma yin pa'i zhal shes zin bris rdo rje'i go khrab khyad par gyi man ngag lde kha gdags pa dang bcas pa bkra shis bde bas khyab pa deng 'dir stsol gyi mtha' can chig brgyud ma'i gras/ nang sgrub kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i las sbyor gyi nang tshan snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i las sbyor rnal 'byor sgos dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon cha mdo khams pa rdo rje bkra shis la gnang ba/ 'di'i mjug tu/ snyan brgyud nying khu yin gyi bslus pa med/ /snying dkyil spos la bsnyen sgrub tshad du skyol/ /khas 'an skyabs dang bral ba'i dus byung na/ /mtshon 'di 'phyung la sdig can chos dbyings—495—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 7)skyol/ /de min nyes chung tsam la mi rtsom zhing / /zhes gsungs pas bag dang ldan pa gnad du che zhing chig brgyud ma'i gras so/ /rdo rje'i chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams mnyes byed gtor sgrub bskang gso'i phyag len gyi gsal byed lhan thabs dngos grub rol mtsho bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi phyag len 'khrul med du bkod pa/ dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor ma gsum gyi rnam bshad kyi zhas shes thun mong ma yin pa snying gi khrag lta bu'i gdams pa zor 'phen pa man cung zad mdzad (345na)'phror lus pa chig brgyud ma'i gras/ gur mgon pho brgyud mo brgyud zhal stag zhen dang bcas pa'i dmod bcol gyi yi ge 'gor so so'i sngags dang gur bzhin 'dri 'o'i mtha' can/ mang mkhar thub stan dge 'phel (zhi)gur mgon la bcol ba'i dam bsgrags/ gsung sgros zin bris la/ 'gor oṃ su sni dpal ldan sa skya ba'i bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan zhes yod pa'i mgon chen gyi dam tshig gso ba'i bskang gso'i zin bris rjes cho ga rnams dkyus bzhin mdzad do'i mtha' can/ gur zhal sbrel ma'i gtor chen gyi zin bris zor lam dbye ba sogs lhan thabs ji lta ba bzhin mdzad do'i mtha' can/ sku rten bris 'bur bzheng tshul/ rab gnas zhag bdun ma/ gsung rten glegs bam/ thod rnga/ rnga chen/ rkang gling bzheng ba/ thugs rten rdo rje gri gug /thod pa/ gaṇ+ḍi/ rtse gsum bzheng ba/ phyi rten rta g.yag sogs phyi ru bcas te nor rdzas bsrung ba/ nang rten nang du bcas te bang mdzod bsrung ba zhar phyung thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ru mtshon/ byang chen mchod rten/ 'phan nag /ba dan/ zhwa nag /lham nag /gos nag /gsang mdos/ pho mo'i gsang rten/ gsang rten gsang bar bcas te mkha' 'gro 'khu ldog spong ba/ gzhan yang pu tra'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rten/ nor bsrung gnod sbyin pho mo'i tshul du bsgrub pa'i rten dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal shes thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung rgyun mdo khams pa rdo rje bkra shis kyis zin bris su bkod pa snod dang ldan nges la chig brgyud ma/ 'di lung rgyun lta ci dpe rgyun yang dkon (345bstanang 'di nas rab gnas zhag bdun ma khol du phyung ste zur du bris pa'i yi ge yang mthong ngo / /drug pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i —496

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dbang phyug gis mdzad pa la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsrung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khrid yig sa skya tshang gi rna bar ma grags pa'i snying nang gi zungs khrag lta bu lcags byi snron gyi zla ba'i nyer lnga la tshong 'dus 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i lte ba rgyal po'i pho brang chen po'i gzims chung chos rgyal pho brang du mdzad pa/ de'i sbyar byang du/ rang bzo'i 'jigs 'jigs bsgrigs pa'i rdo phal mdog /'brel med mgal dum spel ba'i rnyog ma can/ /nyams len 'od dkar spros tshe skal ldan gyi/ /snying gi pad+mo zum dang 'di mi 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa rdo ring kun rgyan pa sogs kyis man ngag ma tshang pa'i ras rul bsdus nas 'chad pa rnams la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten nas sgrub pa nang sgrub dang gsang ba yang gsang sems kyi gnad la brten nas sgrub pa'i gsang 'khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ 'khrid ma thob par lung mi gnang ba dkyus gcig cing sbyar byang du//rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /snyan brgyud kho nar byon pa'i gsang chen 'di/ /snying dbusachongs la nyams len rgyun du skyongs/ /kun la ma spel snod ldan gcig la byin/ /zhes pa ltar rje btsun kha'u pa yab sras yan la tshag brgyud kho nar bzhugs pas kun la ma grags shing / dpyod ldan gyis dpyad na rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab kyi tshig zur la zab gnad 'di 'dra thugs la gab nas yod par shes nus kyang / rje btsun grol mchog (346na khogs rjes 'brang mang po'i thugs su mi chud pa tsu ta'i yul gyis rkang gnyis pa ltar ro/ /'gor oṃ su sti bdag gi bla ma tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas zhes yod pa'i lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang (khri)(cha)thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge pha bla ma'i bka' gnang thob nas brjed thor bkod pa shu lha gyi mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ su sti bdag cag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po zhes yod pa'i lha (khrid cu gnyis ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris su bgyis so'i mtha' can/ 'gor bran bdud kyi rjes gnang thun mong ba'i phyag len ni zhes yod pa'i zin bris rjes gnang bka' rgya can no'i mtha' can/ 'di gsum rjes gnang ma thob par mi gnang ba'i bka' rgya can 'gor na mdzo gu ru ma hā kā lu —497

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonaya de la rdo rje nag po'i bsnyen pa la gsum (ge yo khri)ste zhes yod pa'i bsnyen pa'i man ngag dpe 'di mi la mi ston pa'i bka' rgyas btab yod lags kyi mtha' can chig brgyud ma'i gras/ lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbrags grub kyi mchod pa'i cho ga dam can 'du ba'i mchod (ge sprin mi dbang ma ṇi bha dra'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas bde gsal rab brtan du bkod pa/ bka' srung zangs gri skor gsum gyi gtor 'bul (zhe)sde snod rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i drung pa bslab gsum pas bskul bar brten nas 'brug lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyer gsum la mdzad pa/ ma hā kā la'i chos skor thob pa'i brjed (zha)byang bsam 'phel nor bu'i 'phreng ba rnams/ bdun pa rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis (346ba)mdzad pa la/ 'gor nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa la thog mar gzhi skye med dngos po'i gnas tshul zhes yod pa'i yar klungs pa'i gur mgon (zha)nang 'khrid kyi zhal shes mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung rgyun zin bris su mdzad pa hūṃ la sems gtad nas bsgom pa sogs sngar bzhin no'i mtha' can tshig brgyud gras/ gsang 'khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge (sa)glang bu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug gis bskul ba la brten nas bla ma mgon po dang bcas pa la gsol ba btab nas mdzad pa 'di'i rjes gnang dang lung ma thob pa la rna ba'i lam tsam du yang mi bsgrag pa'i bka' rgya can/ dri chu la brten pa'i rims bsrung (dza/mi 'dra ba rnams kyi nang nas pha bla ma bslab gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis thugs gcigs su gnang ba zin bris su bkod pa/ mgon po khro bcu'i brgyud 'debs bdud las rnam par rgyal (zhe)pa rigs brgya'i mkhyen brtse ma mi dbang tshe dbang don grub kyis bskul nas zha lu ri sbug tu mdzad pa/ yang rje bslab gsum pa'i gsung la zin bris su mdzad pa'i rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i bsdus (zha)don gyi yi ge rje nyid kyi spyan sngar zhus dag pa nyams 'khrid 'di nyid mkhan chen bslab gsum pa kho na'i bka' drin las byung bas/ sbyar byang du/ /blo 'das gdod ma'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /gang 'dul dag pa'i zlos gar drin can rje/ /bka' drin dran no pha rgod —498

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bslab gsum zhabs/ /snying nas 'du 'bral med do thugs rje skyong / /zhes drin bzo'i tshul (347na)du bstod pa ni brgyud pa dang bla ma la ci yang mi sems pa'i chos 'dod mkhan po rnams la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /brag rdzong ma'i gtor ma la brten nas rang gshed 'bebs pa'i man ngag sga ā nan dam pa sogs gong ma mang po'i yi ger tho tsam las mi gsal ba'i gsal byed nag 'gros su mgon po khro bcu'i gtor bzlog gi chos (ne)bdud las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba skyed tshal mkhan po thar pa bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas chos sde de kha'i mgon khang du mdzad pa rnams/ brgyad pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma (rngog)yin pa bla ma gong ma'i rjes gnang yi ge rnying pa las tshig sna bsrings te rgyas su btang ba/zangs gri can skor gsum gyi rjes gnang gi zur (ngag)'debs rjes bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan phyag bzhes rang gi yid la gang zin tsam zhig phyag len zin bris su bkod pa/ 'di gnyis rjes gnang ma thob par mi gnang pa'i bka' rgya can/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung rgyun/ phyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la brten nas sgrub pa'i brag rdzong gi 'khrid kyi yi ge 'dod (ngaganadagu'i dpal ster tsha lung dgon par shing rta'i lo zin bris su mdzad pa rin po che rta ra bas nang gi brag rdzong ma'i 'khrid rgya (ngag)'dre tshar bcad pa'i lo rgyus kyang snang bas shin tu zab gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ gsang ba'i brag rdzong sems nyid ye shes kyi rtsa 'dod gyi 'khrid (ngag)rigs sngags 'chang gtsug rgyan bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung la (347bzo lung dgon par zin bris su mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i gsang 'khrid kyi yi ge rin po che rta ra ba'i gsung sgros yid bzhin nor bu (ngag)de bla ma'i bzhugs gnas tsha lung dgon par zin bris su zla ba dgu pa'i nyer gsum gyi nyin rdzogs par grub pa rnams nyams 'khrid ma thob par mi gnang ba phyag len gyi rgyun bzhin no/ /dgu pa lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub kyi mdzad pa la/ nang gi brag rdzong drag po sngags rgod kyi ('od—499

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonanyams len rje bla ma mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gsung bzhin dpal ldan sa skya'i lha chen gsang ba'i mgon khang du sbyar ba/ brag rdzong ma'i sngags pa nang rgyas kyis man ngag gi zhal shes lus dbral ba/stobs gzhom pa/ rnam shes spor ba gsum gyi gdams pa ('od khyad par can spyan lnga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gsung bzhin 'jam dbyangs gdung brgyud la yab chos phul ba'i tshe lha chen gsang ba'i mgon khang du sbyar ba/ 'di dang dbyibs 'dra ba zhig tshar 'a dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa deng sang lung rgyun ho bog pas 'di wo mkho bar snang ngo / /yi ge gnyis ka tshig brgyud kyi gras/ bcu pa rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis ('a)mdzad pa ni/ rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sku rten bzheng tshul dang khyad par gyi rab gnas bya tshul gsal ba'i me long chig brgyud ma bcu gcig pa khyab bdag zha lu (zha)bas mdzad pa ni/ brag rdzong ma'i rdzas zlog las kyi mtshon cha/ tshad med bzhi/ lce byin brlab/bzlas pa/ skyabs yul/ dgra bgegs kyi sa bon/ thal rdeb/ 'khor lo 'khor lug /thun bsdu ba/(348na tha zlog pa'i sku'i tshad rnams kyi zhal shes rnams kyang chig brgyud ma'o/ /bcu gnyis pa kha'u brag rdzong pa'i phyag len du mdzad pa'i bstod 'bum la/ srin gzugs ma'i sh+lau ka gsum/ 'di yan me 'bar mar yang yod/ 'gor yod pa'i dpal ldan mgon po ma ()'phags pas mdzad pa/ rdzong kha bas rgyud nas phyung gsung yang lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan du pod mar 4kho pas dpyad do/ /e ka dza zhi'i bstod pa kun bzang ma/ lha mo'i bstod pa (6)til mar ma/ de bstod pa rgya (6)mtsho'i klong gnas ma/ zhal gyi bstod pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i dpal ldan ma/ mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i gur gyi bstod pa (ni/sngon tshe bde gshegs ma/ me 'bar ma dang gyi ljang po snya yang yod/ mal los lha mor bstod pa (ni/gang gi sku gsung ma/ rdzong chung pa 'phags pa rin po ches mi lhag tu mdzad par bso/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i 'phrin bcol khyod kyi phrin las ma/ gnam kha'u pas mgon po gdong bzhi pa zhal gzigs dus bstod pa'i rdo rje 'chang dbang ma/ spyos pa shas mar yang bod/ 'phags pas mgon por bstod pa gang (ni/thugs ma/ 'di me 'bar mar yang yod/ (5)paṇ+ḍi ta lo ka shrī'i sgrub thabs las byung ba'i mchog sred kyis lha (ni/mo la —500

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bstod pa mi pham srid gsum ma/ dud sol phyi sgrub kyi rgya gzhung na'ang yod/ gnyan los zhal la bstod pa paṃ pad raṃ nyi ma/ las mgon rnams kyi bstod pa mgon po'i bka' nyan ma/ bstod pa nag po rngams pa ma/dpal ldan dbang ldan ma'i blo ka gcig bcug 'dug pa ma gtogs kha skong bstod 'bum dang zhabs btags mar (348ba〉pang yod/ bskul mgon po ma hā kā la ma rnams/ g.yin yang khro bcu'i phrin las bskul ba mkha' dbyings dag slong ma sa rta rgyal zla la pho brang du 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ khro bo bcu gcig gi gtor 'bul dang bstod pa ser sna rnams dag ma mkhan chen gnas drug pas rgyud las phyung ba/ yang des rgyud las phyung ba'i bskul byang chub sems bskyed ma/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa me stag thim 'gyur ma rnams kyang thob/ brgyad pa de dag kun la thun mong du nye bar mkho ba'i skor la/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi spyi don gsal bar ston pa dregs pa spyi'i gnad bco lnga pa slob dpon shrī sirnyis yi ger bkod pa spa gor lo tsā ba be+e ro tsa na nas bsgyur ba/ de'i zhal gdams kyi nying khu khyad par gnad brgyad kyi man ngag 'di dang gong gi spyi don bco lnga pa bsdoms par/ slob dpon chen po shrī sidha yi/ /spyi don gnad kyi man ngag nyi shu gsum/ /phyi rabs rnal 'byor don du yi ger bkod/ ces snang la yig cha'i kha yig tu slob dpon pad+mas mdzad zer ba 'dug pa brtag /las sbyor gyi zab gnad dril ba drag sngags kyi mig 'byed zhu lan gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba'am sgrib pa thams cad bsal bar byed pa'i me long zhes bya ba dpal o rgyan chen pos mnga' bdag chen po la gdams pa/ yang des mnga' bdag la gdams pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi drod tshad gsal bar ston pa rmi lam brtag pa rin po che'i shel gyi sgron me/ chos skyong bran bzhin bkol ba zab pa'i gnad lnga ma/ 'khu ldog rtse log spong ba chos skyong snying chu gcig tu bsre ba/ yang (349na〉pang 'a bdag la gdams pa'i bzlog thabs brgyad kyi man ngag /sgrub pa spyi la gces pa'i gtor ma'i bkra brtag pa gu ru pad+ma'i yig cha 'phags pa dang rga los nyams su blangs pa/ rgya gsum 'grol pa'i gdams pa slob dpon chen pos mdzad pa rnams/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa bla ma gyi ljang lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i gyi ljang po ti'i skor ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal —301 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)pos mdzad pa'i khog phub yi ge'i dkar chag zab don gnad kyi lde mig /de las byung ba'i chos skor la/ sngon du 'gro ba lo rgyus kyi yi ge /snod rung du bya ba dbang dang rjes gnang gi yi ge /rtsa bar gyur ba rgyud kyi yi ge /nyams su len pa sgrub thabs kyi yi ge /dkar chag tu ma 'khod pa'i yi ge dang lnga/dang po la/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo rdo rje nag po chen po'i skye rgyud ni zhes yod pa'i yig rnying (mchod rteni/gur mgon gyi skye rgyud rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo de la sngon gyi dus na rgyal bu gcig dang blon po'i bu gcig gis zhes yod pa'i ( rdo rje)lha dngos kyi lo rgyus dang bram ze mchog sred sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams ston pa'i yi ge dge slong dharmā gzi brjid la gnang ba lags so'i mtha' can/ rdzong chung pa dam pas mdzad pa'i lcam dral gnyis ga'i lo rgyus 'dren pas mtshon te rgyud sgrub thabs bstod pa thams cad du lha mo'i rnam gzhag mdzad kyang lugs 'di la lha mo'i sgros med pa sa 'thad par ma mngon zhing kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa dang rdo rje la4 tshar pa chos rje gnyis kyang mi bzhed do/ /'di dharmā gzi brjid kyis mdzad ces dkar chag na 'dug go /(349ba yi nyis pa snod du bya ba dbang dang rjes gnang gi yi ge la/ dpal nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bram ( rdo rje kyi lha/ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po la lī ta badz+ra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba/rjo rje gdan pa gcig lha lnga dang gcig bcu bdun pa'i dbang chog yin par bzhed pa gsan yig dang phyag dpe gnyis kar 'dug pa brjod don lhag po mi 2ga pas dpyad dgos par snang ngo / /'di dang tshig sna ring thung cung zad yod pa'i mchan bu dang bcas pa nag po ro 'dzin dang gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba dang dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog gnyis dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/ la snyi ta badz+ra 'di phal cher dur khrod rnams su bzhugs pas mtshan dur khrod nag po ro 'dzin du grags zhes khog phub dang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu snang na'ang 'dir dbang chog 'dra min gnyis byung ba'i sngon mar la lī ta dang phyi ma la nag po ro 'dzin zhes so sor byung ba dang 'byung khungs bsdus don na mi gcig par bshad cing 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i gsan yig na'ang so sor snang ba brtag dgos 'dug go /'gor dpal nag po chen po'i —302

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di la spyi don gsum ste zhes yod pa'i dbang chog rgya gzhung gi sa (rdo rje)bcad dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba'o rdzogs so'i mtha' can dharma gzi brjid kyi mdzad pa/'di'i rjes su des mdzad pa'i dbang gi lag len dang gcer bu zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang zur 'debs yod 'dug pa ma thob/'gor ye shes mgon po'i dbang bskur ba'i rjes la zhes yod (350na)pa'i bran bdud rjes gnang gi zur (༷/'debs gyi yi ge las mgon gyi rjes gnang rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams/ yig cha dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig rjes gnang gi yi ge rnying pa zhes snang ngo / /gsum pa rtsa bar gyur pa rgyud kyi yi ge la/'gor bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'dzo dzil phyag 'tshal lo 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes yod pa'i gtso rkyang ston ( me chod rteni/pa'i rgyud rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga pa las phyung ba/ 'di me 'bar mar yang btsos/ lha bcu bdun dngos ston pa dur khrod nag po'i rgyud brtag pa bcu gnyis lta sdo ji53)pa bla ma nag po ro 'dzin dang / gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis zhus te gtan la phabs pa/ 'di'i sngags gas le'u'i 'gyur khyad tshigs bcad ma lo paṇa gnyis kyi g.yar dam brgyud pa zhes dkar chag tu gsungs pa le'u bcu gcig pa 'di kha lasalogs su ma rnyed cing rje mkhyen brtse'i gtso yig na'ang mi snang ngo / /nag po chen po 'di'i rgyud la dur khrod chen po sku'i rgyud/ dur khrod nag po gsung gi rgyud/ gri gug brtsegs pa thugs kyi rgyud ces gsum yod pa las glegs bam du yang dur khrod nag po'i rgyud las mi bzhugs shing nyams len man ngag rnams kyang 'di kho na la brten pa'o/ /rdzong chung pa'i dkar chag na lha mo srog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud drangs shing gter ma yin pas gyi ljang du 'thad mi 'thad the tshom mdzad 'dug kyang rang lugs la dogs pa tsam yang ma dgos so/ /rgyud gyi don 'grel bzhi sdom bcu (6)pa slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa dkar chag dang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsang yig na 'di ltar snang yang (350ba)yig cha na la snyi tas mdzad zer ba 'gyur byang dang nor chas cag /dur khrod nag po'i 'byung khungs stong thun (ni/gyi khog don bsdus pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ rdzong sa pa'i dkar chag na phyis kyi bla ma dag gis mdzad ces snang ngo / khyud dur khrod nag po'i bsdus (ni rje/don sa bcad dge slong dharma gzi brjid kyi sbyar ba/ des mdzad pa'i dur khrod nag po'i rgyud kyi rnam —503

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nas yig 'phreng gnyis tsam mi gcig pa'i de phyin me 'bar ma'i de dang zhus dag pher ba snyi 'dug /'gor bla rma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo nag po chen po'i phur bu'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa gza' skar drag po la zhes yod (mchod rteni lo8)pa'i mgon po phur bu'i sgrub thabs kyi gsal byed me 'bar mar yang btsos/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa bla ma'i gsung bzhin bris pa sa ma pa tha mi'i mtha' can/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ slob dpon sku la sdo (351ba)byed dang / dkon cog gsum la gnod byed dang / zhes yod 'chod rten lo8)'i nag po wo po srog gi spu gri'i sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis me 'bar mar yod kyang sgrub thabs dngos gzhi rgya gzhung gi sdebs su sku smad phur bu'i gsal kha yang mi 'dug pas de dang ming gcig pa'i sgrub thabs zur pa zhig yod med dpyad/ 'gor bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo dpal nag po chen po srog gi spu gri sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i gong gi gsal (mchod rtend(6)byed brtse ba chen pos mdzad pa'i nag po chen po phur bu'i sgrub thabs sa ma ya pa tha mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'di la rdzong chung ba dge slong shrībha dras mdzad pa la sa r+ṣa gyis mdzad byang sbyar gsung yang shrī bha dra zhes pa'i gang zag su yin 'chad rgyu rang gzhan gnyis dang ngos 'dzin rgyu ma byung zhes rdo rje 'chang tshar pa gsung ngo / /'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal he ru ka phyag 'tshal lo nam mkha' lta bus 'jigs byed 'phros zhes yod pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa la gang zag dbang po 'bring gi khog phub dang brjod bya la dpags na 'di tshong du tshon rigs na'ang dkar ga 7sa bkod pa'o/ /dbang du byas nas las kyi gshin rje pho mo bcu drug lus la bkod de bsgoms pa'i sgrub thabs (mu)gsang ba zhes bya ba gsang sgrub bam 'phrin las gsang ba'i sgrub thabs su grags pa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa ā tsarla rā hu la dmar po'i gdams ngag bla ma gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo bla ma la gus sdom pa bsrung zhes yod pa'i dbang po tha ma spros pa la dga' ba'i ched du (352na sto bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bsgoms pa dur khrod nag po dngos bstan gyi sgrub (ni rje/6)thabs rgyas pa 'di la bsnyen pa'i tshul du sgrub pa/ bod pa'i man ngag sgrub pa'i tshul du khos su blang ba/—503

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rbad pa'i man ngag las sbyor gyi tshul du nyams su blang ba yod ces dkar chag tu gsungs pa ltar don la tshang zhing gsal ba'og gi bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyis gdams par 'dug go /nang sgrub tu grags pa nag po chen po'i khyad par gyi cho ga bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa la lī ta badz+ra dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i dpal mgon po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo drag byed kyi tshul du zhes yod (rdo rje)pa'i gong gi bsdus don dharmā gzi brjid kyis mdzad pa las gzhan bya bar bstan pa'o'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor oṃ swā sti dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang bsgyur dam tshig sdom la gnas/ zhes yod pa'i dpal (ni rje)(sku/nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyi gdams pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ 'gor bla ma dang ni yi dam lha/ /chos skyong mgon la gus btud de/ /zhes yod pa'i dpal nag po chen po lha bcu bdun ma'i bsnyen sgrub las (tshu/gsum gyi yi ge mi bslu ba'i gsang tshig dpal chen skye med jo gdan dang lce rin po che mnyam med mkhyen chen gyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi gru ston gyis mdzad pa/ 'gor bla ma khrag 'thung phug mor bcas/ mchod 'os kun la btud byas te zhes yod pa'i mgon po lha bcu bdun ma'i bod rbad gsad gsum gyi mngon rtogs rgyas (tshun pa (352bskor sgrub thabs lag tu blang ba'i rim pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che zhes bya ba gyi ljang lo tsā ba chen po'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin mdo smad kyi slob ma'i gtso bo tshar dgu ston pa dang gru gu ston pa gnyis kyis dka' bgros nas yi ger bkod pa mngon par rtogs pa nye bar mkho ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ lugs srol 'di'i nyams len la sgrub thabs 'di ka med snying ltar gces pa'i gdams pa yin pas chol par mi ston pa'i bka' rgya dam po dkar chag tu gsal bar 'dug go /lugs srol 'di nyid kyi snying por gyur pa nag po chen po gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung (mchod rtend('khor le ) ba'i gter zhes bya ba mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug sga ā nan dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa/ de dag la nye bar mkho ba'i cha lag 'gor bla ma rnams la na mo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstan pa bsrung zhing —306

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mnga' mdzad pa zhes yod pa'i nag po chen po lha bcu bdun ma'i mngon par rtogs pa rtags byung nas rtags gtor kyang btang ngo'i mtha' can/ mgon po'i phrin las bka' gsang med (tshu/byung ma thams cad byang chub tu bsngo'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'thung zhig 'thung zhig rdo rje'i chu/ zhes yod pa'i nag (6)po chen po'i mchod 'phreng las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i nag po chen po'i gtor ma'i cho ga (2 rje)slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor gtor ma'i cho ga 'di la gsum ste zhes yod (353na)pa'i gong gi bsdus (rdo rje)don dharma gzi brjid kyis mdzad pa/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bram ze (mu)mchog sred kyis mdzad pa zhar byung me lha'i bstod pa gsang gsum ma dang bcas pa/ 'gor sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di la gsum ste zhes yod pa'i gong gi bsdus(rdo rje/don dharma gzi brjid gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i dpal nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa'i 'phreng ba ( me chod rtend/rdo rjed(tshu/bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa la lī ta dang /mtho tsā ba gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba/ kha stong bstod 'bum dang zhabs btags mar yang yod 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na zhal gzigs ma'i bstod pa rnams gsung 'dug pa paṇ+ḍi ta snying 'phreng can dang gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba'i mgon po'i bstod pa rnams la dgongs 'dra ba brgyud pa so sor bgrangs phyin sgyur byed kyi stabs nas bgrangs kyang mi 'gal lo/ /yang mdu paṇa de gnyis kyis bsgyur ba'i dpal nag po chen po la bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba/ lta me chod rtend/sdo rje)sngon tshe bde gshegs ma bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ me 'bar po ti dang tshar lugs bstod 'bum na'ang yod/ 'di'i rjes su nag po chen po'i bsnyen sgrub rbad gsang gyi yi ge snying po zhes pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na'ang mi 'dug cing rgyun chad ma ho ji ltar yang ma thob/bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga'am bkra shis gyi cho gar grags pa sna tshogs rdo rje ma gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba rnams/ gnyis pa las mgon gyi sgrub thabs la/ 'gor rgya skad (353ba)yod pa'i mgon po gcer bu'i ngan sngags sam dur khrod kyi —507

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mgon po gcer bu'i sgrub thabs ( rdo ji58)bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa gyi ljang dbu dkar gyi bsgyur ba/ 'di la nang gses sgrub pa las sbyor ser 'bebs dang bcas pa yod cing rang 'dra'i 'khor bzhis bskor ba'i lha lnga dang k+ṣe tra pā la dang pi tā pā la gnyis bsnan pa'i gtso 'khor bdun du 'gyur pas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i gsan yig na lha bdun zhes yod/ kha cig gur mgon dpa' gcig dang rdzong chung pa gur mgon nyid du bzhed pa ni sgrub yig rnying par mdun du mgon po'i bka' nyan gyi tshul du bskyed rnga/ra bshad pa dang sgrub lugs dang sngags sogs gang la'ang the tshom ma zhugs pa'i skyon yin zhing / gnod sbyin klu bdag nag po zhes bya ba las mkhan shin tu gnyan pa zhig yin tshul bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras gsung ba sogs dkar chag tu gsal bar yod pa zhib mor dpyod pa gnad du che ba'o/ /'gor bla ma dam pa rnams dang dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo dur khrod na gnas pa'i mgon po gcer bu zangs gri can zhes yod pa'i ( me chod rten)sgrub thabs gong ma'i yi ge lhag chad dang bral bar bris pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ me 'bar mar yang bzhugs/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal mgon po chen po la / phyag 'tshal lo gtso bo'i nga rgyal sngon song bas zhes yod pa'i bran bdud (mud/rdo spug shin rje nag po'i sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa g.yin la mi spel bar bka' rgyas btab pa gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba/ 'gor 'di'i (354na)lung sbyin pa'i tshul 'dri ste zhes yod pa'i rje sa chen gyis do pa ston tshul gnang ba'i (mchod rten)(rdo rjed(nir byu/bran bdud gyi lung sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i rjes gnang gi yi ge ngag 'dzin yi ge zin bris byas pa po'i mtha' can/ me 'bar du yang btsos/ /'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo dpal nag po'i chen po'i drag sgrub spyi'i las la zhes yod pa'i 'chod rten shi(rdo sna lo ni ra 'bran bdud kyi sgrub thabs dpal brtse ba chen po chos kyi rje'i zhal snga nas kyi rjes su bzung ste rgyal khams pa do pa ston tshul la gtsigs su mdzad de gnang ba/ 'gor bla ma dang dpal ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo nag po lcam dral mar dang bsten zhes yod pa'i ru mar bca' 'chod rtend/rdo spu thabs kyi yig —508

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rnying yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis zhus dag mdzad pa/ me 'bar mar yang yod/ la la dag bran bdud 'di lugs gzhan zhig du ngos 'dzin pa dang 'phags pa rin po ches gzigs snang gi mgon po rta nag mar 'dod pa sogs rnam par ma brtags pa kho na ste 'di'i sgrub skor bla ma mal la brtse ba chen pos gser srang gang gis blus pa'i gtsigs chen yin tshul sogs yig rnying du yod pas kyang shes nus so/ /bran bdud 'di shin tu bka' gnyan pas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas chig brgyud du gnang ba yang phyag len ma'o/ /las sbyor thor bu'i skor las sgrub thabs sna tshogs kyi brgyud lugs/gsum pa las sbyor thor bu'i yi ge la/ dpal nag po chen po dang las byed rdo rje mong spu can gyi sgo nas ser ba dbab pa'i yi ge mgon po'i ser ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'gor gzhan yang ser ba dbab pa dang zhes pa ni (354ba bo kyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom zer ba yod pa'i gong gi gsal byed kyi yi ge gzhan rnams gzhung na gsal lo'i mtha' can/ 'gor gzhan yang man ngag 'di lta ste zhes yod pa'i rbod gtong bzlog pa'i man ngag mthar ni byang shar mtshams su mnan zhes pa'i mtha' can/ nag po chen po'i rgyud las rdo rje tshig tu sbas nas gsungs pa'i man ngag (rdo rdzi yo8)brgyad ces pa drag byed thams cad gnon par byed pa/ bgegs thams cad rlag par byed pa/ char dbab pa/ char gcad pa/ yi dwags bskrad pa/ phyag rgya ma 'gugs pa/ rgyal po la sogs dbang du bya ba/ rig sngags rbod gtong gcod pa rnams/ lnga pa dkar chag tu ma 'khod pa'i yi ge la/ rdzong chung pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i (6)dkar chag /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses dpal bde gsal gyi mgon khang du (zhad/khri)mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs khyab bdag sku bzhi ma/ 'gor bla ma la na mo —509

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)nag po chen po'i dbang bskur ba la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang zhes yod pa'i mgon po lha bcu bdun lta me chod rten)ma'i dbang gi tho yig rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin bris so'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor dpal rdo rje 'chang dbang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo dpal nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor du zhes yod pa'i gyi ljang (mchod rten)lugs kyi dbang gi lag len nyi shu dgu'i dgongs mo bka' gnang ba shin tu gal che gsung pa'i mtha' can rnams legs par thob/ de yang phal cher gyis (355na〉na dmas pa 'di nyid rtsa khungs ma chod pas bzang ngan gyi rtog dpyod med la/ phyogs 'dir sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa dag gis sa lugs dang gyi ljang lugs zhes srol mi gcig pa gnyis su bzhed nas/ rdzong lugs mgon pod gnyis kyi dkar chag tu/ chos tshan phan tshun ye ma 'dres par mdzad pa ni deng sang man ngag gi snying po dang phur bu dang srog gi spu gri'i skor las mgon gnyis tsam ma gtogs dbang lung gi brgyud par sa chen mi bzhugs pas 'a(gral gzhi byas pa 'dra ste/ mdo smad g.yig ra lha rtser grags pa'i lha gnyan gnas pa'i yul ljongs su 'brungs pa'i bla ma gyi ljang lo tsā ba bla chen 'brog mi'i gzhung rdzogs pa'i slob ma gcig yin/ rgya gar du byon nas la lī ta badz+ra/ ā tsarla dmar po sogs paṇa grub mang po la zab khyad kyi chos gsan pa'i nang nas mgon po'i skor 'di rnams dbus gtsang sa'i cha stod du mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags sogs la gnang bar phrin las gsang ba dang las mgon zangs gri can gnyis sogs gtso che ba la stod lugs/ mdo smad du byon nas ldang 'chang ston pa thogs med mthu rgyas kyis bsgral zhing slob ma tshar dgu ston pa dang gru gu ston pa sogs la sgrub thabs che chung phur bu'i lugs sogs gnang bas smad lugs su grags/ gyi ljang gi skor mal la gsan nas sa skya ba chen po thugs gtsigs che bas gsang ba'i tshul gyi nyams len mdzad tshul sogs tshar chen gyi dkar chag chen mor shin tu gsal/ sa skya tshang la med pa'i snyan brgyud gser chos kyi (355ba'i dag po rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa yas sras la 'di'i bka' babs shing dbang rjes gnang yang nyi shu dgu'i mtshan ma —310

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gtogs mi mdzad pas dam dog che/ snyan brgyud rol mtshor/ srol 'dzin phyi ma 'gas 'di pa'i man ngag dang / sa lugs bsres pa ni dag dug bsres pa'i gos dang mtshungs gsungs pa brag steng pa nas mal la brgyud pa'i skor la sgos ming spyi la btags sam yang na gsung rgyun dngos gzhi dang mi mthun pa'i yig skyon shor ba yin/ gang ltar phan tshun me bsre gsung pa'i dgongs gzhi gyi ljang lugs 'di gzhan la ltos mi dgos par dbang brgyud man ngag thams cad rkang tshugs pas lha dang man ngag mgon pod dngos gzhi dang mi mthun pa mtha' dag bsre bslad mi byed pa'i don yin gyi 'di sa lugs su mi gtogs pa'i mi bzhed la/ rna thos tsam las man ngag gi gnad ma rtogs pa la la dag gyi ljang skor rgya gar du med pa'i bod mar 'dod pa sogs kyi ngan smras byed pa ni/ mgon po gshin rje ltar sgrub pa lha bcu bdun ma 'di jo bo chen po di paṃ ka ra/ paṇ+ḍita 'jam dpal dbyangs/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa sogs mang po la yang yod pas rang nyid kyis mi shes pa rgyu mtshan du byas te phal cher la ngan smras byed pa'i mus pa dkon grags pa lta bu rnams bag yod pa'i gnas la 'god par 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa 'dod khams dbang phyug khrag 'thung dud pa'i sol ba can gyi skor la/ de yang dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma la rje khol gnyis su grags pa'i dud pa'i sol ba can 'di rje mo re (356na)ma tī yin zhing gur mgon kyi skabs mgon po lcam dral gnyis su grags na'ang sa skya pa'i lugs la rjes gnang zur pa med cing sgrub thabs la tshogs bdag /bka' sdod/ phyi pa/ nang pa ltar sgrub tshul yod kyang man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa med par brten rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes yum bka'i skor gyi rjes gnang man ngag tshang ba zhig thugs la bzhed nas/ tshul de sa sdo/gas dwags brgyud pa sogs gang du'ang ma rnyed par rim gyis rtsad gcod gnang bas chu 'go gangs dkar gyi dpe bzhin/ rje mar pas/ dud sol lha mo ma gtogs pa'i/ bstan srung brgya dang rtsa brgyad zhus/ zhes gsungs pa ltar shin tu gces spras su mdzad pa'i lha mo'i skor 'di spyir dpal nā ro pa la bstan srung brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa'i khrod nas gtor ma dngos su len pa'i chos skyong gsum yod pa'i nang nas gdams pa 'di la —5//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonamadzad pas rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig /lo gsum bal po'i mthil du bsdad/ rje byin rlabs can gyi bal po la/ rgyud gnyan por grags pa'i gdan bzhi zhus/ chos skyong dud sol lha mo zhus/ /zhes bal po pham thing pa spyi ther ba la yang gsan cing rje mar pa la slob ma'i gtso bo ka chen bzhi'i nang gi rngog chos kyi rdo rjes lo tsā ba'i chos skyong gi gtso bor dud sol ma/ kai ka rtsal/ thod phreng can gsum zhus pas gsum ga mi yong 'dam btang bar kye rdor dang gdan bzhi sogs rgyud mang po'i bka' srung du 'dug pa dang bla ma yang thugs gtsigs che bar 'dug pa sogs nas 'dod khams ma 'dams te rdzogs par gsan/ de nas rngog tshang 'og mar grags pa'i (356ba)rngog ston chen pos bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyi bar du rigs dang chos kyi brgyud pa zam ma chad pa'i nges shes kyi gnas chen por gyur te rjes gnang sgrub skor dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ phyogs der bla ma'i sku srog la sdo ba'i bsgral bya'i zhing zhig 'dug pa chos bka' rnams rdzogs par gnang ba'i bka' drin gsab ched du chos skyong 'di'i sgo nas gtor ma la brten pa'i las sbyor mdzad pas ring por ma lon par rjes med du gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar yid ches dang ldan pa'i chos skor la/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma 'jigs byed dud pa'i sol ba can gyi chos skor gyi dkar chag snyan brgyud gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ de las bstan pa'i gdams pa la/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo dpal ldan lha mo'i sgo nas gtor ma'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i lha mo phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge rngog zhe sdang rdo rje mdzad pa/'di nyid kyi lag len gsal byed rngog bsod nams don grub kyis gzhung ri bo khyung lding gi chos gyur mdzad pa ni dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/ lha mo chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo dang po rten rdzas thams cad tshogs par byas la zhes yod pa'i lha mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa nan chags mar grags pa'i rtsa ba'i yi ge rngog zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de'i gsal byed mar rngog gi phyag len zhes pa'i gsang sgrub rjes gnang gi yi ge mkhas pa'i dbang po blo gsal rgya mtshos bskul ba la brten nas rngog bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyis —312

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)stod (357na)lung mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ ma mo spyi'i rgyud dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ma'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa o rgyan gyi gnas chen por mkha' 'gro ma ḍom+bhi ka ma la'i zhal snga nas dang sgyur byed kyi lo tsā ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dud sol ma'i sgo nas rgyud dpal lha mo nag mo dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa rgya gar gyis mkhan po nā ro pa dang bod kyi lo tsā ba brje lo ka shrīs bsgyur ba/ yang lo paṇa de gnyis kyis bsgyur ba'i 'dod khams dbang phyug ma phyi sgrub kyi rgya gzhung zhes pa bsnyen pa/ spyo zhing gsad pa/bsam gtan gyi gsod pa rnams ston pa'i mkha' 'gro dud sol ma'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ 'di dang me 'bar ma'i phyi pa ltar sgrub pa gnyis khyad par med ces dkar chag tu gsung pa ltar zhus dag kyang pher ba 'dug go/de'i bsdus don sa gcad 'gor dpal ldan lha mo nag mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo 'di sgrub pa la don bzhi ste zhes yod pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ bsnyen pa la don bco lnga/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor/ smyo zhing gsad pa la don lnga/ don lnga zer yang rdzas bsags pa nas sbyin sreg gi bar brgyad bdug go/bskyar ba'i cho ga dang bcas pa'i lag len shin tu zab cing gsang ba rgya gzhung gi 'grel pa zhal gdams mar grags pa zhag bdun du ci yang mi za bar byed do des nges par 'grub po'i mtha' can/ snan brgyud po tir bzhugs pa 'i yig chung yid bzhin nor bu dang zhu dag pher zhes dkar chag na snang ngo / /'gor dpa' bo chu skyes sngon po'i (357ba7dog ces yod pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rje mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi gsung las byung ba bla ma'i zhal nas gsung ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/'gor dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo dam tshig ldan pa'i sngags pa yis zhes yod pa'i sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi zhal gdams shin tu zab pas gsang bar bya zhes pa'i mtha' can/ mar pas nā ro pa la chos skyong zhus pa'i lo rgyus yod pa'i lha bskyed/ bzlas pa/ rmi ltas/ srog thun sum cu'i rno tshad/ bzlas pa'i skyon yon/ sgrub pa las sbyor/ sbyin sreg gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la brten tshul/ bod rbad gsad gsum gyi sngags byang / gtor ma dang ling ga bstab tshul rnams chos sde gcig tu bzhugs pa'i 'dod —513

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khams dbang phyug ma'i zhal gdams rjog gzhud pa yab sras la gnang ba/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i zhal gdams bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge zhes pa 'dug /'be/ra ma hā de li na 31/g.yin yang bdag gi rmi ltas su zhes yod pa'i sgrub pa las sbyor gyi yi ge zhal gdams rmi ltas mar grags pa dpal ldan lha mo'i rmi ltas rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'dod khams dbang phyug dud sol ma'i gsang sgrub kyi rgya gzhung rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po nā ro pas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ yig cha'i kha yig na birnya pas mdzad zer ba 'dug pa 'brul gzhi byung bste 'di dur khrod dga' ba'i tshal du rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa la lha mo dngos su gnang nas shar phyogs nag po las bsgyur pa yin gyi yig cha 'di mdzad pa ni min no/ /de'i (358na)'grel pa'i lag len ma 'dod khams dbang phyug drag mo rkang thang ma rno ba'i mde'u ha la reg chod ces bya ba zhe sdang rdo rjes yi ger bris/ 'gor dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo sgrub pa'i thabs la gru gsum steng du zhes yod pa'i drag mo rkang thang gi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ drag mo rkang thang yang snying bkol ba'i sgrub thabs dud sol ma mngon sum du bkol ba'i man ngag tu grags pa rngog zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'gor dpal khrag 'thung gi rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal lo dur khrod sol ba can gyi sgrub thabs ni zhes yod pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug yang gsang rkang thang du bsgrub pa'i yi ge rngog zhe sdang rdo rje'i zhal gdams ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa'i mtha' can/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byed pa'i las sbyor kyi yi ge longs spyod thams cad lha'i dbang po dang mnyam mo'i mtha' can/ la cha'i sdig par brten nas ma mo rang gi lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs pa'i rten gyi yi ge /dpal ldan lha mo'i sgo nas dgra la ltas ngan dbab pa'i thabs bstan pa'i yi ge rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dpal ldan lha mo'i mngon par shes pa sgrub pa'i lag len gnad dbab dang bcas slob dpon chen po zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gong ma 'di la pra rten gyi khye'u sogs 'dun pa dang 'og ma 'dir khye'u med pa'i me long sogs la brten pa'i mo yig pa'i brjod bya 'dug pa nas gong 'og gi ming nor ba yin min som nyir snang ngo / /dpal ldan lha mo'i sgo nas pra dbab pa —314

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)spyan 'dren ma gcig lha slo ma dang bcas pa/ gri snying (358bstas gas la brten nas mngon shes bsgrub pa/ dkar chag na 'di logs su med la zhal gdams dang bcas zer ba'i zhal gdams yin nam snyam/ 'di'i rjes su rngog zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dud sol ma'i ga sto snyo lag len du tsogs pa zhin yod 2ga pa ni ma thob/ spyan 'dren thod pa dgu brtsegasa'aphrul gzhal ma rgyal tsha rdo rje sems dpas mdzad pa/ mchod 'bul khyed la gtsang dme'i rtog pa mi mnga' ma/ gzhan yang mchod 'bul ma/ gtor bskang bas lcang lo ma/ thugs dam bskang zhing 'phrin las bskul ba bdag ni rigs 'dzin ma rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gtor gshegs dpal ldan ma/gtor gshegs zlog bsgyur dang bcas pa rdo rje gar dbang ma/ bstan ma stong ba bka' yi tshogs bcas ma rnams dud sol gtor chog gi lhan thabs skabs nye bar mkho ba/ bstod rnying sems nyid 'phrin las ma/ zhabs bas mar yang yod/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dge ba bcu'i sgo nas bstod pa sngon 'das bskal pa ma/ tshig zur tsam ma gtogos ra gas rim zhus dag pher ba me 'bar mar yang bzhugs/ phyogs bcu'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bskul ba ma mo'i gtso bo ma/ 'di'i 'og ྅zor dang gtor won gyi yi ge zhig yod 'dug pa ni ma thob/ 'dod khams dbang phyug khrag 'thung dud sol ma'i 'phrin las kyi las byang rgyas pa ḍā ki ma'i thugs gyi ze'u 'bru dge bar byed pa'i man ngag rgya mtsho gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba sngags 'chang ā nan+da dh+wa dza dang btsun pa kye rdo rje shrī badz+ra gnyis kyis ngan rtogs spangs nas rgyud sgrub thabs rnams dang mthun par bsgrigs pa dang bcas pa (359na snams kyi smin grol rjes gnang nyams 'khrid lung man ngag phyag bzhes dang bcas legs par thob pa'i dang po rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa nas brgyud pa'i nag po chen po dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ paṇa grub birlu pa/ shar phyogs nag po pa/ grub chen ḍā ma ru pa/gnyis spangs zhabs/ gha ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ se ston kun rig /zhang dgon pa ba/ rje btsun yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dpon/ zhang dbon zhang / chos rje bla ma dam pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen burnya shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun kun spangs chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ de bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun rdo ring pa nas/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ mchod rten dang satwa lhan cig gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'amang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims nas (359ba〉sbos rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / grub chen sangs rgyas rin cen ldan/ sgo rus pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa man 'dra/ bka' babs gnyis pa ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i mgon po dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ grub wo dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa a shwa ka shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/ rje btsun yab sras gsum/rje sa paṇa/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ mthu stobs dbang phyug gzungs kyi dpal ba/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /rje dkon cog 'phel/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon cog dpal ldan/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rab 'byams pa chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za hor brje la'o/ /yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ dkon cog 'phel man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge /dkon cog 'phel man 'dra/ yang na mus chen nas/ rwa ston yon tan dpal/ glo bo mkhan chen legs 516

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)'byung / 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ dkon cog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na dkon cog 'phel nas/ rje lha mchog seng ge /(360na〉5tshungs med sangs rgyas seng ge /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ mkhan dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /mchod rten dang bu d+dha 'i rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ ngor chen yan gong ltar la/ de nas mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge /sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/bka' babs gsum pa kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i spu gri skor gsum ga dang lhan cig pa'i mchod rten gyi rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred nas rim par/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍita shākya shrī/ sa paṇ+ḍita kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dge slong zla ba kye rdor kyi zhal lan gsum gzigs par grags/ rgyal mtshan/ bla ma khams pa/ ri pa dge tshul dar ma dpal/ 'di gsum gyis chos skyong zhal lan lnga re gzigs skad/ rim bzhin yab chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar ro/ /e'i rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ dar ma dpal nas rim bzhin/ khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po man ngor lugs bzhin no/ /mu'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dar ma dpal nas/ ral lam ston pa shwa kya dh+wa dza nas rim par/sngags 'chang gzungs pa man rje'ong lugs bzhin no/ /bka' babs bzhi pa'i gri gug lha lnga/ lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis ma rnams kyi rgya gzhung lugs kyi dbang rdo (360ba)rje dang g.yung drung lhan cig pa'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze chen po/ nor bu gling pa/ slob dpon grwa d+dha rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na dha dang ka gnyis ring por mdzad nas dad pa'i 'byung gnas go cha zhes bsgyur bar dag gsung rang lugs gsol 'debs su dad byed go cha zhes dha dang ka gnyis ka snyeng ngu 'di na'o/ /ka ra warma/ mtho chen rin bzang / brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba/ rje brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje paṇa chen/ chos gyi rgyal po 'phags pa/ bkras lung pa nam mkha' —517

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bsod nams/ dge sdings pa chen po/ rje sangs rgyas dpal/ rin chen gling pa/ dkar gshongs pa rin cen rdo rje/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rdzong chung pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan 'jam dbyangs grags pa 'ang zer dbang lnga po'i cho ga mdzad mkhan de yin/ chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / jo stan khrom yon yang zer/ brag thog pa dpal 'dzin bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ de la klung dbang:nga pa gnas kyi ming yin snyo yongs grags thugs sras zer/ kun dga' rgyal po dang lcang lo can pa bsod na mas mchogo ldan gnyis gas gsan/ de gnyis la rigs 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis de nas tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rigs kun bdag po zur chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na nam mkha' lhun bzang nas/ mus srad pa byams pa rdo rje (361na)rgyal mtshan/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ klu dbang gling pa kun dga' rgyal po man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ 'di ngor chen gyi bla ma de dang mi gcig /bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen dol po ba/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ theg chen chos rje man 'dra/khyad par lha brgyad rgya gzhung lugs kyi dbang brgyud gcig ni/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa nas/ yangs pa can byang chub dbang rgyal/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis man gong ltar ro/ /yang gri gug lha lnga'i gsan yig phal cher dang dkar chag tshor brgyud pa gong ma rnams gcig pa'i rtsis las gsal kha mi 'dug na'ang 'di rje rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig ltar na sa chen yan ji ra'i dbang dang 'dra ba'i phyogs 'dug pa gri gug lha lnga'i rgya gzhung lugs 'di la 'brog mi dang mal nas brgyud pa ste gnyis yod pa 'dra zhing gyi ljang lugs kyi lha bcu bdun ma'i cho ga yang 'di bsdus par bzhed do/ /—318

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rgya gzhung lugs sogs dbang brgyud lugs khag gi skor/rgya gzhung lugs kho na'i dbang brgyud gcig ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ bag ston 'ong gan tshul/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan snyan brgyud lugs ni brag thog pa'i dbon po las pha chos rjer ma gsan kyang gsan yig la lar 'dres 'dug pa 'brul gzhi byung 'dra'o/ /pa man 'dra/ yang gri gug lha lnga dang lha bcu gnyis ma gnyis kyi dbang brgyud lugs gcig ni/ dga' ldan (361ba)pa kun bsod nas/ gan pa rin rgyan/ bla ma dam pa/ bla brang pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug ye shes dpal bzang po/ rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/ chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug /rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa nas/ dpal kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo man 'dra/ gri gug lha lnga snyan brgyud / ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ a rna ga badz+ra/ gong dkar pa'i gsan yig tu yan lag med pa'i rdo rjer bsgyur/ pad+ma badz+ra/ mtsho skyes rdo rjer bsgyur/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ phun tshogs bde ba/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ paṇa chen gha ya dha ra/ bla chen 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ se mkhar chung pa/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu zhe sdong rdo rje zhes gsang ma' bris 'dug /rol pa'i rdo rje/ gsan yig gnyis na 'di lta bris 'dug kyang dkar chag na zhang ston chos 'bar ra/ rje btsun sa chen/ mi bskyod rdo rje ra/ slob dpon rtse mo rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ 'phags pa rin po che/ mthu chen ā nan dam pa/ rong mi ye shes/ tre bo rdo rje grags/ bag ston gzhen tshul/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge /theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen nam 519

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mkha' lhun bzang / mnyam med dpal 'dzin bzang po/ mthu chen 'jigs med dpa' bo/ klu dbang gling pa (362na)kun dga' rgyal po/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mthu chen bsod nams chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang nam mkha' lhun bzang nas/ gab chag pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ klu dbang gling pa man 'dra/ gyi ljang po ti'i rdo rje dang dung lhan cig yod pa ma gtogs pa'i rdo rje'i rtags yod pa rnams kyi lung dang gshin rje ltar sgrub pa'i nag po chen po lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ grub chen nag po ro 'dzin/ lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar/tshar dgu ston pa/ mon mig dmar ston pa/ bla chen ra la ma pa/ bla ma zhang ston pa/ lang 'gro byang chub dar/ lce ston mdo sde/ dpal chen skye med/ gru ston shākya 'bum/ dge bshes dbu/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gas yig na dbugs zer ba 'dug pa dbya da/ sa skya pa dharmā gzi brjid/ nyis thog pa sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba/'dar yar 'dren mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal bzang / brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ sngags 'chang bsod nams mchog ldan/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis nas 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan yan gong ltar la/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol (362bdes bdag la'o/ /rdo rje dung dang lhan cig gi rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ gyi ljang lo tsā ba nas/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ zhang mnga' risapa/ dge bsnyen sras mchog mgon po/ dol po 'byung gnas/ rgya sgom tshul khrims grags/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ seng ge bzang po/ yang klungs seng ge rgyal mtshan/rigs 'dzin dpal ldan blo gros/ dmar ston chos kyi rgya mtsho/ thu btsun bsod nams rnam rgyal/ thu btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal man gong bzhin no/ /yang dbang rkyang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po nas/ de dbon dpal 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa man 'dra/ yang —520

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)dbang dang gyi ljang po ti kha skong gi mu g.yung drung can gyis brgyud pa'ang 'di nyid do/ /mu'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred badz+ra pā ṇi/ ku ku ri pa/ la lī ta badz+ra/ gyi ljang dbu dkar/ khams pa gru bu ston pa/ mon mig dmar ston pa/ ra lam mang ston/ mgon po jo zhang / lang 'gro byang chub dar/lce ston mdo sde seng ge /gru ston shākya 'bum/ dkar gshongs pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ stag tshang lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī/ rtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ klu dbang gling pa thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po man 'dra/ yang na gru ston shāka 'bum nas/bdag po bsod nams yon tan/ mnga' ris bla chen man 'dra/ yang dbang rkyang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dad byed go cha/ jo bo (363na)'a po a ti sha /lo chen rin cen bzang po/ dge tshul puṇi/ rgya lcags ri gong pa ba/ rdzing bu kha pa shākya grags/spen phug pa dar ma shākya/ zhang ye shes rgyal mtshan/ gzi pa don grub ye shes/ khams pa shākya rje/ 'di gnyis la bar thang pa yab sras zer ba dkar chag dang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na 'dug /bar thang pa chos grags/ slob dpon dar ma shākya/ spur ston bsod nams dbang phyug /bla ma mchog ldan pa/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin cen rdo rje/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge /mkhan chen nam mkha' ye shes/ de gsum ga la theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos gsan/ rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / mus srad pa man si rgyu ra'i dbang dang 'dra yang na skyi ston grags rgyal nas/ kun mkhyen dol po shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge /theg chen pa man 'dra/ yang na slob dpon bsod nams dbang phyug nas/ gan pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ ta dben chen po/lo tsā ba tshul khrims brtan pa/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa man sngar bzhin no/ /'khor lo dang lhan cig pa ma gtogs pa'i mchod rten gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ gyi ljang nas/ mal lo tsā ba/ yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po man me 'bar ma ltar/ yang na sa chen yab sras gsum/ do pa/ rgyal tsha man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun nas/ sa321

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()paṇa man kyang gong bzhin no/ mchod (363brten 'bor lo lhan cig pa'i rtags yod pa'i lung ni/sa chen yan gong ltar la/ de nas slob dpon rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ sga ā nan dam pa/ phing phag bla ma rdo rje dpal/ mdo khams pa bkra shis seng ge /bar sdings pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ yab 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man me 'bar ma bzhin no/ /rjes gnang skor la/lcam dral lha gsum sbrags sgrub dang thun mong ma yin pa lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbrags sgrub dang lha bcu gnyis ma gnyis la yang nang gses kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin par dbye ba'i rjes gnang bzhi dang bcas pa sga ā nan dam pa tsam ma gtogs gdung brgyud rim par chig brgyud du byon pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ grub chen bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ paṇa grub dad byed go cha/ lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ chos rje khu dpon gnyis pas mdo khams kyi khrom gseb tu mgon por gzigs pas sprul par yang grags so/ /bla ma bdag nyid chen 21/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/yab 'jam dbyangs chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ gdugs gnyis la brtag gnyis thugs su chud pas de ltar grags/ rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ (364na)rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje blo gsal grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rje gnang 'ga' zhig tshar — rang la'ang gsan 'dug go/khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na tshar chen yang yab sras gnyis ka la/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyis gsan/ de gnyis la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gsan pa man 'dra/ phyi 'khrid nang 'khrid nyams 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen 322

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)brtse'i dbang phyug nas/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje rin po che nas/ sgo rum pa kun legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse man 'dra/lha/ rgya/ sdings/ yar/ 'a/ zha rkyang / pra/ khra rkyang / kha'i rtags yod pa ma gtogs pa'i me 'bar ma pho rkyang gi thogs ma'i brgyud rim du rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ ārla de wa/ birnya pa/ nag po pa/ mchog sred ces sgo rus dpe khang gi sa chen gyi phyag bris ngo ma bdag chen rdo rje long gis rnyed pa las byung bar snang ngo / /dang kha skong gnyis kyi mchod rten gyi rtags can rnams dang / rgya/ 'a/ zha rkyang / pra/ khra rkyang / ngag /pha/ sa/ lo'i rtags rnams ma gtogs pa'i snyan brgyud po ti'i rtags yod med yongs rdzogs kyi lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nas/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug (364bsgo sod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/ yang lha brgyad bcu gnyis ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang dang / phyi 'khrid gsang 'khrid gnyis/ de las 'phros pa'i yi ge /me 'bar dkar chag gi sa gcad gsum pa'i gsang ba thun yong ma yin pa'i yi ge dang / de'i gsal byed rjes 'brang gis mdzad pa dang / sdings kyi rtags yod pa rnams ma gtogs pa'i mchod rten gyi rtags yod pa'i lung rnams dang rjes gnang gsum nang 'khrid dang bcas pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan nas/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug /mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog /'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man gong ltar/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ yar klungs pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ yid dkon cog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ bran bdud kyi chos tshan gsum po'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sa chen nas/ zhad mnga' ris la/ dge bsnyen sras mchog mgon po/ dol po 'byung gnas pa/ bla ma dgon pa rgya/ do pa ston tshul man gong bzhin no/ /me 'bar kha skong snyan brgyud gsum gyi chos skor gter mkhan chen dpal ldan bkra shis pa'i zin bris na pu tra rkyang pa yin pa 'dra zhig 'dug pa gsung sgros ma zin par ma'/ byon gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ 'dis rdo —323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonarje gdan gyi ka ba la gter du sbas/ de nas dpal o rgyan chen po pad+ma badz+ra gyis spyan drangs nas rgya gar/ (364ba yan ra phyogs pa dharma pā la gnang / des te se dang mtsho ma dros pa gzigs pa'i ched du byon pa dang lo tsā ba chen po mjal bar gdams pa rnams gnang / de man gong bzhin no/ me 'bar po ti'i phyi sgrub yig sna brgya nyi shu'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ yab 'jam dbyangs chen po nas/ gcen rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ yab sras gnyis ka la gcung bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / de la rdo ring rin po che dang mkhan chen rat+na shrī las gsan/ gsum ga la rje btsun sgo rum pa/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen nas/ rin po che bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan/spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rab 'byams chos rje kun dga' lhun grub chos sku rdo rje yang zer/khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba man 'dra/ rgya'i rtags yod gter ma 'di phyis gyi bla ma rnams kyis gsan pa lo tsā ba chen po byung ba 'ag kho mar ngos mi 'dzin/ pa'i lung ni/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ o rgyan chen po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston rgya pad+ma dbang phyug /lho pa ston nyi/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug man 'dra/ yar gyi rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ rje sa chen nas/ bla chen yang sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ seng ge bzang po/ yar klungs pa/ mkhan chen bsod rgyal/ yab 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / slob dpon dpal ldan rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen dpal bzang po/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang tshar ba man mchod rten gyi rtags yod pa dang 'dra/ sdings gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dam pa kun dga' grags nas (365na)bla ma rdo rje dpal/ mtshungs med bkra shis dngos grub/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa sdings pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba'i man ngag khyad par can yang 'di nas brgyud pa'o/ /yab chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man zhal ngo nang brgyud bzhin no/ lcam dral lha gsum gyi thun mong ba'i rjes gnang rjes 'brang gi slob ma nas 'ongs pa'i thor bu'i brgyud pa ni/rgyal ba brag phug pa nas/ de dbon dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ bu ston dbang phyug dar/ theg chen chos —524

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)kyi rgyal po/ tā'i gu shrī yon tan rgya mtsho/ sgo rum pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa man gong ltar/ yang na na bza' pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/dbon po nam mkha' dpal bzang / grub chen sangs rgyas rin cen/ sgo rum pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ gnyags chen bsod nams 'od zer/ mkhas grub bsod nams bzang po/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan mtshungs med shes rab zla ba'i dbang po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang na tshogs sgom pa nas la ru ba/ nyan chen pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ shar pa kun dga' seng ge /shar pa kun dga' bsod nams dpal bzang po/ bla ma rdo rje seng ge /dka' bcu pa chen po/ gung thang pa seng ge dpal ldan 'od mdzes bzang po/ rtses dang dge 'phel ba rigs 'dzin bsod nams blo gros/ rje btsun rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma (366na skor phags rgyal ba/ bla ma bzang po ba/ bla ma dam pa man gong bzhin no/ /yang na 'phags pa nas/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /chos rje bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang ngor lugs kyi kha dang lha'i rtags yod pa ma gtogs pa'i e'i rtags can gyi lung dang lha gsum ma'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba brag phug pa la chos rje bla ma dam pa dang brag phug pa blo gros brtan pas zhus/ de gnyis la chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de nas shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ drin can bsod nams dbang phyug /rje btsun rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nas/ mkhas grub gung ru sher bzang / rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug /mkhas grub don yod dpal pa/ rje rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang kha dang lha dang mu g.yung drung can ma gtogs pa'i mu'i rtags yod pa'i lung dang lha gsum ma'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje bla ma dam pa nas/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal pa/ chos rje dge legs bzang po/ chos rje ā nan+da ma ti/ rdzong lugs pa rnams rjes gnang gi chings 'di'i yig cha sor bzhag mdzad/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgyud —523

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yonagasum smra ba shes rab ren cen/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man sngar ltar ro/ /yang rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'phags pa nas/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal/ mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang gzungs pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ bla ma cha ga na pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/bla ma mnyam med pa man 'dra/ yang gong dkar (366ba)lugs kyi rjes gnang dang rdo rje nor bu lhan cig yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ bla ma dam pa yan gong ltar la/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ rje btsun chos sgo ba chen po/ brag thog bsod nams bzang po/ mthu chen 'jigs med dpa' bo/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rigs 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ yang rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ cho me rje sa paṇa nas/ bla ma khang gsar ba/ blo chen seng ge dpal/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ 'di gnyis kyi bar du bla ma gcig gnyis shig dgos tshod du 'dug na'ang kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i phyag bris dngos la 'di ltar snang ngo / /ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen chos rje/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po man gong ltar/ lha brgyad dang bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang rjes 'brang nas 'ongs pa'i thor bu'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ 'jam skya ba/dge sdings pa chen po/ bla ma bkras lung pa/ bla ma bsod nams dpal/ theg chen chos rje/ nyi lde ba gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa man 'dra/ lha brgyad kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ 'phags pa nas/ bla ma 'phags rgyal ba/ sgro mon cen pa rin cen dpal bzang / bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ shar pa kun dga' seng ge man lha gsum ma ltar ro/ /lha bcu gnyis ma'i brgyud pa lugs ga ṇi ga ni/ dam pa kun dga' grags nas/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ drung chos rje pa (367na tshe bzhi thog pa/ bdag chen kun dga' rin cen/ bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug /drung btsun rin cen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje btsun sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal nas/ drung chos rje pa —326

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)man gong ltar ro/ /ngor lugs lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang dang gong gi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims yan lcam dral lha gsum ltar nas grub chen bzhi shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ drin can bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo ring rin po che man 'dra/ rdzong lugs lha brgyad gyi rjes gnang dang gong gi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ chos rje dge legs bzang po yan lha bcu gsum ma ltar la/ de nas rin po che zur shākya dpal ba/ mus sras pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan man kyang 'dra/yang rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan yan thun mong ma yin pa ltar nas/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ khrom yon pa mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / mus srad pa man 'dra/ /yang na 'phags pa nas/ khams chen byang chub dpal/ 'dzims chen rgyal mtshan dpal/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ 'jam skya pa/ mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gzungs kyi dpal pa/ theg chen chos rje man 'dra/ yang na na bza' pa nas/ brag phug pa dkon rgyan/ bu ston dbang phyug dar/ theg chen man 'dra/ yang na gzungs pa nas/ mkhas grub (367ba)kun bzang pa/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ gong dkar lugs kyi lha brgyad dang lha bcu gnyis ma'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa nas/ bla ma bsod nams 'od zer/ bla ma dpal ldan legs dbang / brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po man lha gsum ma bzhin no/ /rdo rje dang brag lhan cig yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ bla ma dam pa nas/ brag nag pa ngag dbang grags pa/ gong dkar ba rnams rjes gnang gi chings 'di'i yig cha sor bzhug mdzad/ dpal ldan legs dbang man 'dra/ rgya nor bu brag dpal be'u bzhi dang lhan cig yod pa ma gtogs pa'i rdo rje'i rtags can yongs rdzogs kyi lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal ba mchog dbyangs nas/ brag thog pa bsod namasabazang po man 'dra/ rdo rje dpal be'u lhan cig yod pa'i lung ni yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan blo gros/ dmar chos kyi rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa/ mthu chen 'jigs med —527—
