rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dpa' bo man gong bzhin no/ /yar gyi rtags can dang tshe sgrub ma gtogs pa'i sgo'i rtags can yongs rdzogs kyi lung ni/ rje btsun rdo ring pa nas/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ tshe sgrub kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje bla ma dam pa nas/ cho so rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang / grub mchog bsod nams dbang phyug /rje btsun kun spangs chos rje man 'dra/ yar dang lhan gcig pa'i sgo'i rtags can gyi lung ni/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen nas/rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ /ru'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ (368na rdo rje 'chang / grub chen bram ze mchog sred/ la lī ta badz+ra/ nag bo ro zan/ lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar/ gshen do rje seng ge /'brom rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sgom rin cen seng ge /seng ge dpal/ snang/kyi rin cen/ dmar bsod nams 'phel/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ kun dga' bsod nams/ bag ston/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ rin cen 'phel/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ rgya ston tsan+d+ra de wa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bsod nams seng ge /'gos ston rdo rje seng ge /mnga' ris ru thog pa nam mkha' gzi brjid/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /drung kun dga' legs pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/glegs bam so so'i 'a'i rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/des bdag la'o/ /zha dang zha g.yung drung can gyi lung ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab nas/ khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /pra'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan nas/ rab 'byams chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /khra dang khra g.yung drung ris kyi brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan nas/bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ drin chen blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /pha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen nas/ rin po che bod mkhar pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams (368ba)rgya —528

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mtsho/ rje drung rin po che dge 'dun bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sa'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /ngag gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug /mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /lo'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rin po che bod mkhar ba nas/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ sa skya khri chen man 'dra/ mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa yan zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar nas/ sngags 'chang ba'i rgyangs kyi dpal ba/ thugs sras bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rwa chen gnyis pa dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas mchog /chos rje skyes mchog rgyal mtshan/ grub dbang bkra shis seng ge /rdo rje 'chang tshar ba chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ grub mchog bsod nams chos 'phel/yab sras bzhi ga la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gsan/ de nas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ mkhas grub chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /mgon po gsang sgrub lha dgu sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig gi bzlaḥd sdo/gas/mgon po gsang sgrub lha dgu'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse yan khro bcu ltar la/ de nas mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan (369na)man gong ltar ro/ /lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan du 'di'i brgyud pa 'khrid kyi brgyud pa dang gcig —529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)pa'i phyogs mdzad 'dug kyang cung zad thugs snang la ma nges pa zhig byung bar sems so/ /dud sol ma'i phyi sgrub thun mong ba'i rjes gnang gyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ lus med ye shes mkha' 'gro/ grub chen tai lo pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ mdo sde yang zer/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje/ rngog thogasamed grags/ rgyal tsha ra mo/ rngog kun dga' rdo rje/ rngog gzi brjid grags/ rngog rin cen bzang po/rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rngog don grub dpal/ tog byang chub dpal/ rngog khra tshang pa bsod nams don grub/ rngog shākya don grub/ rngog thar gling pa bsod nams lhun po/ de sras rngog ston bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /grub pa mchog gi ded dpon bsod nams chos 'phel/ rigs kun bdag po dbang phyug rab brtan/mkhan chen zha lu pa khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rin cen bzang po nas/ rin cen dpal/ dpal gyi rdo rje/ slob dpon bzang po dpal/ rngog byang chub dpal man 'dra/ yang na rin cen bzang po nas/ sangs rgyas seng ge /btsun pa dpal gyi rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na rgyal tsha ra mo nas/ slob dpon lcam me/ slob dpon nam mkha' dbang phyug /kun dga' dbang phyug (369ba tsā ngen cen dpal/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' bzang po/ rngog bsod nams don grub man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang / bram ze chen po sar ha pa/ mgon po klu sgrub/ ḍā gi ma skal pa bzang mo/ slob dpon pa la pa/ bzhi ga la tai lo pas gsan pa man sngar bzhin no/ /gsung sgrub rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa nan chags mar grags pa dang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ kun mkhyen mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /'di la gsang sgrub lha mo nyi shu'i rjes gnang zhes pa zhig tshar chen gyis gsan 'dug kyang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gsan yig na mi 'dug pa rgyun chad pa yin nam snyam/ slar yang khungs —530

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam dang po/ (ka)btsun pa zhig rnyed na zhu bar rigs shing la la dag rdog dkyil bdun gyi nang tshan 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi tshab tu lha mo 'di la dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs dang dbang bzhi sogs blos byas kyi cho ga 'dug pa lta bu'i rigs ni ma thob pa rang gan gtsang bar snang ngo / /phyi'i las mkhan gcer bu zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang ni/ 'phags pa rin po che yan zhal ngo nang brgyud la/ de nas do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha chos kyi dbang phyug /mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/gcen rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'bum rab 'byams pa chos kyi don grub/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'ang zer/ mkhas(370na)pa'i dbang bo rat+na shrī la/ chos rje tso li pa'ang zer/ rje sgo rum pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ yab sras gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ de la rje bslab gsum pa dang rta ra ba gnyis gas gsan/ yab sras bzhi ga la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na rje sa chen nas/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun sa chen nas/ 'gos ston tshar sgang pa/ dge bshes mi g.yo ba/ gshen sgom bla ma dpal/ slob dpon shes rab bla ma/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na rje sa paṇa nas/ mdo khams kyi rta rge bla ma dpal/ slob dpon shes rab bla ma man 'dra/ lugs gcig la rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ ku ku ri pa/ nag po ro 'dzin/ gyi ljang lo tsā ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen man 'dra/ nang gi las mkhan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses tshar chen la gsan pa'i brgyud par las mkhan phyi nang gnyis brgyud pa gcig tu bgrangs shing / sgo dras par gsan pa der mi gcig par bgrangs 'dug pa 'dir gnyis ga'i don la dpyad nas gsal bar bgyi yod do/ /ber nag zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'gos ston tshar sgang pa dang rta rge bla ma yod pa sor gnas kyi/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings 331

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gong dkar lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa sogs lung brgyud 'ga' zhig /gong (371na bo kar lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa nas/ bla ma bsod nams 'od zer/ bla ma dpal ldan legs dbang / brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ yangs pa can pa shākya kun dga'/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /bod kyi gter ma'i brgyud pa ltar na/ o rgyan chen po nas/ jo mo 'tsho rgyal mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po man sngar bzhin no/ /ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i thun mong ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar la/ de nas do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug /mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ tshem bu ba dpal ldan blo gros/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ dpal ldan kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ te'u ra pa chag lo rin cen chos rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ de la bslab gsum rje dang rta ra ba gnyis kyis gsan gnyis ka la rje dbang rab/ de nas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /bran bdud kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa ni/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan nas/'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog /'jam dbyangs (371bshom mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'bum phrag gsum pa byams pa chos kyi don grub/ chos rje tshul khrims pa/ rdo —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rje 'chang tshar pa man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ badz+ra pa ṇi/ ku ku ri pa/ dur khrod nag po ro 'dzin/ gyi ljang lo tsā ba dbu dkar/ mal lo blo gros grags/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/bla chen yar sgom se bo/ do pa ston tshul man 'dra/ yang na sa chen nas/ zhang mnga' ris pa/ dge bsnyen sras mchog mgon/ dol po 'byung gnas pa/ rgya sgom tshul khrims grags/ bla ma do pa ston tshul man 'dra/ de yang gong gi rtsa ba'i rtags bzhi rgyag pa'i dgos pa ni/ ji skad du/ de dag las 'ongs so so'i ngos 'dzin ni/ ngor lugs yi ge e yi rtags kyis mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa las byung rdo rje'i rgya/ /mus srad pa ni yi ge mu yi rgya/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dbang las brgyud pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i yi ger mchod rten rgya yis mdzes/ thor bu gzhan dag mchan bu btab pas shes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gong du ngos ma zin pa'i me 'bar kha skong / gyi ljang gsum la rtags med pa 'ga' zhig byung ba rnams mchan bu 'grol rgyu yi ge ngo ma ma mthong bas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag la/ ser pod nas/ shā sa na mchan bus bkral ba dbang lo'i zhus dag ma/ nya ga gsum la zor gyi gsad pa zhes yod pa'i zor las pu pra'i bstod pa dpal ldan ma hā kā la ma/ 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang zhes pa 'ad ge zin bris su grags pa'i 'dra min mjug na kha ru mi dbyung bya ba dang thun mong ma yin pa zhes yod pa'i le tshan gnyis dang bcas pa/ rdzong chung pa'i (372na)thugs dam man ngag po ti nas/ rdzas dgram bzlas gsad gsum gyi tho/ gong dang gcig pa'i zor las/ 'khor gyi ltas ngan dbab pa las byed mon bu'i man ngag /rdzong pod dkar chag na/ 'di la byed mon bu'i man ngag skabs su gsal gsung pa don khyi ku gi nang na yod par gsung kyang der mi gsal la/ snyan brgyud kyi phyir gtong ba dang bshan pa ro 'khur gnyis ni mi 'dug /gtor ma gsum gyi man ngag ces pa gsham na dgra nag dang bde mchog nas gsungs pa'i shes byed yod pa gcig rnams rang lugs be'u bum rnams dang ngo ye ma 'phrod pa slar yang dpyad par bya'o/ /de yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa las/ drag po mi sdug khros pa ni/ /ut+pal sngon po'i kha dog 'dra//phyag bzhi pa ni cho ga yi/ phyag na thod pa bsnams par sgom/ zhes dngos su bstan cing / dpal 'khor —534

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lo sdom pa'i bshad rgyud las kyang gsal bar bstan pa'i stobs 'phrog nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'am drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug tu grags pa 'di nyid/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i dri med rgyud sde las/ /gsung pa'i bstan srung kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /drag shul mthu ldan stobs 'phrog nag po zhes/ /rgya bod mkhas grub kun la rlung ltar grags/ /zhes pa ltar 'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub zhabs/ bsod snyoms pa chen po ta tha ga ta ra snye tra/ paṇ+ḍita 'bum phrag gsum pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma ku swā li chen mo sogs paṇa grub du ma'i chos skyong gi gtso bo mdzad cing / bod yul 'dir gnyan lo tsā ba dar (372bsgo grags kyis gdan drangs srung ma brgya rtsa tsam gyi nang nas gtso bor bzung / bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs bstan srungs mgon po che chung gnyis su dbye ba'i chung bar grags shing shin tu rtsub 'gyur che zhing gnyan cha che bas bka' ches dam par mdzad/ khyad par sbas pa'i mgon po la rigs mang du yod pa'i nang nas sbas pa'i mgon po'am dam tshig gi mgon po yin pas zhal bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi sku gzugs bris 'bur sogs kyang mi bzhed zhing re gnyis byung ba dag kyang khyab gdal deng sang 'di'i sku 'dri ba dang ston pa sogs bag med du byed pa rnams ni 'di dag rna bas ma thos shing tshub 'gyur mi 'byung ba sogs kyang chos skyong ye ma 'khor ba'i rtag so/ /du ye mi ston pa sogs dam tshig che phra kun la gces par mdzad pa smin grol gdams pa'i gnad mtha' dag ma nyams pa snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i kha rlang thul le ba thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs par snyan brgyud dang po byin rlabs rjes gnang / gnyis pa gdams pa dngos gzhi/ gsum pa bla ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong longs spyod kyi mnyes par bya ba la brten nas snyan brgyud bzhi pa'i rten 'brel shugs la 'gris/ pa sogs khungs btsun gyi yig cha mang po las 'byung ba ltar ram/ yang na tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gis/ de yang thog mar tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / /rin cen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa/ /snyan brgyud dang po'i rten 'brel kun bsgrigs nas/ /snyan brgyud gnyis pa byin rlabs rjes gnang sbyin/ /snyan brgyud gsum pa gdams pa'i dngos gzhi 'di/ /bklag lung min par lag len —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dmar 'khrid du/ /byin pas snyan brgyud bzhi pa (373na)shugs la 'byung / /zhes pa ltar rdo rje slob dpon mnyes pa dngos grub rtsa ba dang shin tu bka' gnyan pa'i zab chos rnams la dpon slob gnyis gas tshogs dang bskang bshags sogs kyi sgo nas mkha' 'gro srung ma rnams kyi nyams chags skong zhing bka' rgya bkrol te gnang ba zhu ba ma byas na 'phral 'tshub mthar mi shes pa sogs 'byung bas lha 'dod yon la longs spyod pa lta bu snyan brgyud dang por byas te/ gnyis pa chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun lta bu/ gsum pa gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu/ bzhi pa chos la yid ches kyi mos gus rnyed pa gzhon nu'i dga' ba lta bu'i go rim ste/ de yang bshad tshul gnyis po gang byas kyang go rim tsam las don la khyad med na'ang phyi ma'i rjes su 'brangs te snyan brgyud dang po'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa sngon du 'gro ba'i snyan brgyud gnyis pa rjes gnang dang gsum pa gdams pa'i dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ gnyan lo'i gnad yig dang dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyi yi ge dang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dngos grub rgya mtsho dang brgyud pa'i phyag len la brten nas bsnyen dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang / pho nya myur mgyog dang rjes gnang gi yi ge gong ma rnams la brten nas sgrub dus thun mong pa'i rjes gnang / yi ge de gnyis dang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i bka' rgya ma la brten nas sgrub dus kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge /gong ma dang mthong brgyud kyi phyag len dbri snon ltar las sbyor gyi mgon po'am paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa lugs kyi dpal mgon gdong brnyan can du grags pa'i rjes gnang (373ba)dngos grub rgya mtsho dang gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang phyag len gsung rgyun ltar gsang 'khrid kyi rjes gnang /las bzhi'i rjes gnang la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i yi ge la brten nas dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang dkar chag na bzhugs pa'i las bzhi'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang yig chung dngos grub rgya mtsho/ gsung rgyun phyag len ltar g.yas zhal dkar po las byung ba'i dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ba'i rjes gnang / steng zhal dud kha las byung ba'i ser po rgyas byed lha —536

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nas rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i gnad kyis gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa mdud rnams grol nas cir snang bde chen du shar te tshe 'dir zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed nus pa'i gsang 'khrid kyi nyams 'khrid (374ba)zab mo zhag nyi shu skor gyi bar dang zhing skyong dbang po 'khor bcas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rang gi snying dbus su 'bral med du bzhugs nas mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba'i dmar 'khrid dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gdung brgyud kho na la chig brgyud du bzhugs pa'i nyams 'khrid zab mo smin rgyas su legs par nos/ /gnyis pa phyag bzhes man ngag rgyab brten lung dang bcas pa la/ dkar chag gis zin pa'i skor dang / ma zin pa'i skor te gnyis/dang po ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i chos skor gyi dkar chag gsung rgyun pad+ma'i srad bur brgyus pa'i zab don nor bu'i do shal/ de las gsungs pa'i chos sde'i rnam grangs paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa nas brgyud pa/ /shrī parnyi ta ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa/ khar su pā ṇi'i ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma ku swa li chen mo nas brgyud pa dang gsum/dang po la/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal mgon po nag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams 'jigs byed pa'i/ /nag po de la phyag 'tshal nas/ zhes yod pa'i mgon po gdong brnyan can nam las sbyor gyi mgon por grags pa glang gdong phyag drug pa'i sgrub (rge)9 she/nya )thabs kyi rtsa ba'i rgya gzhung slob dpon klu sgrub snying pos mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang lo tsā ba gnyan dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ rgya gzhung gi 'grel pa dri med don gsal (375na tshe dge bshes dge ba rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas mdo stod pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis nyang brag dga' ldan dgon du mdzad pa/ 'gor tā ra na mo dpal gdong bzhi pa'i ma lnga rna rtogs kyi man ngag (rgya)paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa'i zhal gdams mthar thug pa ni zhes yod pa'i gtso 'khor lnga'i mngon rtogs gong dkar ba'i glegs bam na don gcig pa tshig 'dra min rgyas bsdus (nyi5ga)cung rad yod pa zhig 'dug /chung ngu bla ma gong mas mdzad pa der rtogs par bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor dkon cog gsum la phyag 'tshal —338

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lo rang skad cig gis hūm̐ mthing nag tu gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes yod pa'i gtor chog gi yi ge gong mas mdzad pa de wi sirnyi zhes nyer gcig gam gsum la sogs pas dbul lo'i mtha' can/'gor tshangs pa ser po ngang pa bzhon zhes yod pa'i 'khor mang gi mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma gong mas mdzad pa bka' nyan gsung gtod las byed tshul du bsam gyi mtha' can/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos zhal bkod gnang nas sman thang blo bzang pas bris pa'i 'khor mang gi zhal thang de yang gzhi 'di la brten nasargyas su bto bar mdzo/ las sbyor gyi gsal byed las kyi sham bu brgyad (5)'a5de)pa zhes pa gsad pa'i las/ mdze gtong ba/ rabs gcod pa zhing la lo mi skye ba/ rims nad gtang ba/ grong khyer dkrugasapa/ grong bshig pa/ bskrad pa/ smyo bar byed pa/ 'di gnyis lhag pa 'dra zhig byung yang gong gi khongs su bsdus sam snyam/ dbang du byed pa rnams gnyan los mdzad pa/ 'di yan gyi glang gdong (375ba)ma'i skor rdzogs nas zhar byung 'gor dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i/ /gser gyi spu gri'i lag len 'dri/ /zhes yod pa'i dpal mgon khyung zhal can nam dmag dpon mgon po'i sgrub thabs lag len gzhung nas dril nas btus/ sngags 'chang bstan pa bsrung bar shog gi mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa shrī paṇ+ḍita ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa la/ 'gor rgya skad dang zhal bzhi pa'i dam tshig dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa'i rtsa ba'i sgrub (e ska rgyad(nyig)thab rdzong po dan 'ang yod/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i bdag mdun mgon po zhal khra can nam sgrub dus kyi mgon por grags shing / deng sang yongs grags sgrub dus kyi mgon po zhal g.yas g.yon mthing nag tu byed pa'i yi ge 'ga' zhig 'dug kyang tshar lugs la sgrub dus kyang zhal khra can du mdzad pa gzhung 'di'i gnad 'gag gtso bor ston par snang / rgya gzhung rtsom pa po rang nyid dang gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ gzhud chung 'di la 'phrin las rnam bzhi bye brag tu sgrub tshul gyi gnad 'gag kyang zur tsam bstan 'dug cing / rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes gsang sgrub gsal byed snying thig gi skabs rgya gzhung las bshad tshul gyi rtsa ba'ang gzhung 'di la brten pa yin no/ /'gor rgya gar gyi yul du chu bo gaṅgā dang —539

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nyi ma phyed dang gnyis tsam yod pa'i grong chung ngu'i 'gram zhig na zhes yod pa'i gnyan los mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mjal tshul gyi lo rgyus nyung ngu dang sbrel ba'i (mi ) sgrub thabs rdzong pod na'ang yod/ kyi rim pa bsnyen pa dang (376na〉pas sbyor ston pa zla ba gcig gis las rnams 'grub bo ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas gnyan la 'o'i mtha' can rnams/ phal cher snyan brgyud kyi zhal bzhes la rag las zhes dkar chag na snang bas yi ge 'di las mang ba zhig thog ma nas med tshod du 'dug /gsum pa khar+sā pā ṇi'i ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma ku su li chen mo las brgyud pa la/ zab cing rgya che ba phyi'i sgrub bskor/ rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa gsang ba'am nang gi man ngag /snying nang gi khrag lta bu khyad par gyi man ngag dang gsum/ dang po la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun pa lo rgyus kyi yi ge /nus ldan du bya ba rjes gnang gi yi ge /rtsa bar gyur pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge /gsal byed du gyur pa lhan thabs sam yan lag gi yi ge /'phral du nye bar mkho ba gtor chog dang bskang ba bstod bskul gyi yi ge dang lnga/ dang po la/ 'gor na mo gu ru man ngag 'di'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge sa chen gyis mdzad pa bon po pho mo 'dres pa lnga bcu tsam chos skyong gi nus pas bsad zer ro'i mtha' can/ 'di'i nang du kha'u par rje gas sa skya pas zhus zer bltar na tshig gcig gnyis slar bsnan pa 'dra'o/ /'gor brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo bka' srung 'di'i lo rgyus ni bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus (nyi)kyi yi ge rgyas pa 'phags pas mdzad pa mnga' bdag kyang de'u grong blon po la la yang shi skad kyi mtha' can zhar byung bla brgyud dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa nus ldan du bya ba rjes gnang gi (376bar+sā ge la/ 'gor oṃ swa sdi sid+dhi nag po chen po'i lung sbyin pa ni 'byor na tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rting la bya (sgo/zhes yod pa'i nag po chen po'i rjes gnang gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa gdams pa 'o'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor bla ma dang tā ra la na mo nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang la gsum ste zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge kha'u pas mdzad pa smon lam gdab po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo gu ru dbang thob cing dam tshig ma —540

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)nyams pas 'di'i rjes gnang dang bka' lung thob cing zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge sa chen gyis mdzad pa smon lam gdab bkra shis bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra la na mo 'di'i rjes gnang la don gsum ste sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes so zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang (ed(sgo lo gro༅)gsal ba rdzong pod na mas mi 'dug /don de gnyer ba 'gas yang yang gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa/ 'gor oṃ su sti srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan nag po che zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang shin tu rgyas pa nag po 'gro shes (nyi)zhes pa dpang por nag po chen po bzhugs pa 'di rang gi bla mas rjes su gnang nas bkas bskul zhing grogs mched dam pa'i gsung gi ngor rje btsun pa'i yi ge'i steng du 'phags pa'i phyag len dang zhang khu dbon las brgyud de bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bzhes ltar yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis klu'i dgon par mdzad pa/ des slob mas bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i 'gor dpal zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa la (377na)zhes yod pa'i gri snying bla rdo srog 'khor phyag mtshan rnams kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams/ gsum pa rtsa bar gyur pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge la/ kun gyi rtsa ba ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas mdzad pa'i sgrub (rga7gli4los༅)thabs byu bshad du grags pa'i yi ge /rdzong chung pa'i der 'gro ba'i lam du an dha mu shar bcug la sba'o yan las mi 'dug cing gong dkar ba'i glegs bam na de'i mjug tu grong khyer bskyod pa dang sngags thung bris pa gcig dang yang dngos dkyus dang mthun pa la ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta'i lugs kyi lo rgyus sgrub thabs gnyan gyi lo rgyus sgrub thabs gnyan gyis mdzad pa de'i lo rgyus chu bo gaṅgā zhes sogs yod pa 'jug na btags bas bsres pa zhig kyang snang ngo / /gzhud de la brten nas bsnyen sgrub zhar byung mnan pa dang bcas pa 'gor ma hā kā (rga lo li la'i man ngag la bsnyen sgrub gnyis las zhes yod pa gnyan lo'i u pa de sha 'o'i mtha' can/ gnyan los mdzad pa'i chos skyong gi gnas kyi yig chung (8)(mi/zhes pa bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ gsad pa/ las sbyor dang bcas pa zhal gyi gdams rdzong pod na'ang yod/ pa 'di mi la ma spel rnam smin che'o gsung ba'i mtha' can/ mgon —541 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)po sgrub dus kyi las khrigs rdzong pod na'ang yod/ (5)bla ma kha'u pa chen pos mdzad pa snying phyung rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod ces brjod do'i mtha' can/ 'gor ma hā kā la tsa tu rmu kha u pa de sha zhes yod pa'i mgon po sgrub (ed(3tsu)6 / )dus kyi las khrigs gsal rdzong pod na'ang yod/ byed sa chen gyis mdzad pa de'i snying ga bsnun par bya 'o'i mtha' can/ kha'u pas mdzad pa'i las khrigs kyi gsal (rlud(sdi)dza7)byed 'gor bla ma mgon (377ba)po nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo mgon po sgrub dus kyi las khrigs la gsum zhes yod pa'i yi rdzong pod na las khrigs chen po zhes pa las mdzad pa mi gsal/ ge sngags 'chang gzungs pas mdzad pa dgra na ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pa'i las nges par 'grub bo sa ma pa tha mi'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo dpal ldan nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa bsnyen cing sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i bsnyen sgrub (ed/nyi༅)las gsum gyi sgrub thabs nag po 'gro shes dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi yig chung mi spel gsang bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na 'di gzungs pa'i nag 'gros su ngos bzung / rnam gsum lag len gsal byed zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i lag len dmar 'khrid mthong chog bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsung bzhin bsod nams grags pa dpal bzang pos yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba'i blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bskal ba la brten nas zin bris su bkod pa/ bsnyen pa'i go rim gnad don snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i skyes 'phreng rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pas dad ldan slob ma'i zhal ngor sbyar ba/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor tā ra na ma dpal mgon tsa tu rmu kha'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i bzlas pa dang gegs sel gyi man ngag snyan brgyud gser chos mthar thug /des mdzad pa'i 'gor bla ma mchog dang chos skyong la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus btud nas zhes yod pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum spogs chog shi sa bstan pa dang bcas pa'i mngon rtogs gsal byed gnad kyi zhal (378na tshe ka dmas mthar thug snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gser chos mchog tu gyur ba'i mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag /des mdzad pa'i dpal gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma bca' thabs kyi —542

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)snyan brgyud snying gi khrag thig lta bu/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor bla ma yi dam bstan skyong la/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas zhes yod pa'i las rab 'byams dang gsad bskrad kyi 'khor lo'i zhal gdams chig brgyud ma snying nang gi khrag lta bu/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma dang zhes yod pa'i bye brag tu gsad las kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can du grags pa rno myur spu gri reg chong dang 'dra ba'i man ngag snyan brgyud mthar thug /des mdzad pa'i 'gor bla ma mchog dang lha mchog la zhes yod pa'i 'khrul 'khor bltab cing sba ba sogs mnan pa'i man ngag mthar 'don thabs dang bcas pa snyan brgyud sbas don gsal ba/ yar klungs pa'i gsung 'di rnams phyi sgrub la ltos pa'i bka' rgya dam pas mang ba la me ston pa'i gras/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub thabs rta bdun rgyal po zhes bya ba mdo stod pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ de skor gyi yig chung bzhi zhes pa pra sko pha la'i gsung bzhin bris pa'i sa chen kun dga' snying po'i man ngag gnad brgyad pa'i ngos 'dzin dang / chos wo bzhi'i skabs 'di gnyis so sor 'dren/ ma chag pa'i gnad gnyis ston pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i srog snying gnad gyi man ngag snying dang 'dra ba mdo stod pa 'jam dbyangs kyis dwags lha sgam por sbyar ba/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i mnan pa dang srog (378ba)gi zhal ga dmasa'i mtha' can/ 'gor chos skyong gi rten gyi 'khor lo ni dbang po dar ma grir shi ba zhes yod pa grub pa dpal gyis yi ger bkod pa rnams/ bzhi pa gsal byed du gyur pa lhan thabs sam yan lag gi yi ge la/ spyi'i lhan thabs bye brag gi lhan thabs/ las phran bu'i man ngag dang gsum/ dang po la/ srog 'phrog pa/ bcing ba/ khyi ltar 'khrid pa/ snga phyi gnyis mi 'bren pa rtsal 'gran pa ste zhal gyi gdams (6)zho)6 / /(pha)pa don lnga rdzong pod na yod pa der mi spel ba'i bas rgya yod do yan las med/ ma shākya'i dge slong gnyan gyi u pa de sha /lta ba/ dam tshig /mthun rdzas sngags/ 'khu ldog mi 'byung ba/ shi sa bstan pa ste zab pa'i gnad drug gi gdams pa mchan bu dang bcas pa ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag gnyan gyi gsung / de'i gsal byed gdams 'di la don drug ste zhes—343

rgyal dbas lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rdzong pod na yod pa der skad ༅ tse re 'ong ngo yan las mi sig/yod pa'i bla ma (ed/sgo lo lha)na6)gnyan gyi nye gnas dar ma seng ge la gnang ba srod thun la gtor ma med du mi rung ngo'i mtha' can/mgon po la pha ltar bkur zhing lha mo la sring ltar dungs pa'i man rdzong pod na'ang yod/(e)(sgo/lha ) nga ga blos khel ba ni 'go ba'i gnad yin no'i mtha' can/khyad par gyi dam tshig ltas/gi yi ge shin tu ga bye bar bya ba rnams yin no'i mtha' can rdzong pod na'ang yod/'khon nag zas su za ba'i gdams ngag ( de )slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/'di rdzong pod na yod ngor pa'i der klu sgrub nas brgyud pa zhig 'dug pa 'ad dang ma mthun/gong dkar ba'i glegs bam du/379na7ba dpon pad+mas mdzad pa' kha gas mi bog/'gor dpal ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo nyams chags sam 'chi ltas sringad ba 'a// chags che ba'i dus su gtor skyong byed par 'dod na maṇ+ḍal zhes yod pa'i nyams chags (ed/snyi(rgya)bkang ba'i yi ge bsdus rdzong pod na'ang yod/pa bskang bshags cho ga 'o'i mtha' can gnyan gyis mdzad pa/des mdzad pa'i dpal ma hākā la la phya/ 'tshal lo rnal 'byor pa la nyams chags sam 'chi ltas byung ba'am chags che ba'i dus su 6 gtor skyong byed par 'dod na nang du gtor ma zhes yod pa'i nyams chags bkang ba'i yi ge rgyas pa gdams nga gnywa'i mtha' can/'gor 'di'i dam tshig gso ba ni zhes yod pa'i kha'u pas mdzad pa'i dam tshig gso ba'i pad+ma (ed/sna/spu'i ba sbyor gyi yi ge bsdas rdzong pod na'ang yod/pa bla ma gnam kha'u pa gsung nywa'i mtha' can//des /dzad pa'i 'gor bla ma dam pa dang nag po gdong bzhi pa la na mo chos skyong 'di bsten pa na 9 zhes yod pa'i pad+ma kha sbyor gyi yi ge rgyas pa gnam kha'u pa'i gdams pa sa ma ba tha'i mtha' kau//'gor nag di chen po la phyag 'tshal lo mgon po'i gsang ba byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa (d+ma da(sgo/(glo 'a )gsang ba'i cho ga 'di dkar chag na mi gsal rdzong mod na yod//'o'i mtha' can rnams/gnyisapa bye brag gi lhan thabs la/sngon 'gro rten sdi skabs/sku 'gor rta ra na mo ma hā kā la'i rten bca' ba ni phyi rten du g.yag nag ces yod pa'i phyi nang (rlud(sgaX(3)gsang ba de kho na nyid dang 378ba tha cas

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa'i rten bca' ba'i yi rdzong pod na'ang yod/ ge shākya'i dge slong gnyan gyis mdzad pa'i u pa de sha su thod thod la bstan par mi bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor ma hā kā la'i rten bca' ba ni rdo nag po smrag po'am zhes yod pa'i nang rten bla rdo bca' ba'i yi ge bsdus rdzong pod na'ang yod/ pa gnyan lo'i gsung bcu bzhi la ma chag pa gyi man gong dkar ba'i glegs bam na tshang ba gcig dang bskal me ma man med pa zhig dang bcas 'dug/ngag yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa su la yang mi sbyin no zhes brgyud pa rnams gsung ngo'i mtha' can/'di' gsham na seng ge rgyal ma' rgyas klu' dgon par zhus dag brgyas zer ba las mdzad byang ma 'dug/de'i phyag len gtor zlog lhan thabs bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug gi bkas bskul ba la brten nas rje btsun rdo ring pa chen /sad /0 // rdzong da / //da pa rnams/gnyis pa bkang ba la/dam rdzas kyi bkang ba khyed mthun ma le sga sgro nya spyan 'dren lha mchog ma dang bcas gong dkar thabs e ga glo nya dang 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad stobs chen shugs drag ma/kha'u pas mdzad pa'i gtor (ed/gli4los)bkang /dur khred gnad brgyad (zu)smyo da/'a)ma/stobs 'phrog nag po'i gsang sga blo nye / mdos mgon po nyid kyis bla ma kha'u pa la dngos su gnang ba rnams/rdzong pod na'ang yod/gsum pa bstod bskul la/slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa srin gzuṭa ma/sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs wa// byi// pa'i bstod pa srin po'i gzugs can ma/bram ze rin cen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bstod pa nyang pa la ldan mgon po sho 'o // / shu pa gnyan lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas mdzad ྅ do// /nye /86na sgo / : sgo rtog dbyings las ma/bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i bstod pa paṃ le ga nya pad raṃ nyi ma/deng sang 'di dang yum gyi bstod pa g.yas phyogs ma gnyis sor sor bris pa mang yang 'di kha'i mur 'thud nas mdzad byang bris 'dug

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()go/kha'u pas mgon po zhal dngos su gzigs (ed/snyi4lo3)dus bstod pa rdo rje 'chang dbang ma/bkang bstod la lar 'di dang khyad bzhugs ma gnyis kha phral nas bris pa yod 'dug kyang don du 'di kha'i 'phros yin/mal lo tsā bas rmi lam du mgon po zhal gzigs dus bstod pa zhi rgyas dbang drag ma/sa chen gyis bstod pa (rga73)'jigs byed dpa' bo ma/sa paṇa gyis sa skyar mdzad pa'i bstod pa (sgo lo lha)dpal ldan () lo snya)dbang ldan ma/rdzong pod na'ang yod/'phags pa rin po ches shing kun tu mdzad pa'i bstod pa nyasangs rgyas gcig bsdud ma/'di'i rjes su dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa zhig yod 'dug pa ma thob/chos rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 9)stong nyid snying rje ma/des mdzad pa'i bstod pa srid gsum (8)(nyi)dbang sgyur ma/gtor chog bstod ༅la dang 4sa pa yi mdzad byang na bog/'jam dbyangs grags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa bde chen dur khrod ma/dmar chos kyi rgyal pos bstod pa dpal ldan ma hā kā la ma/'jam dbyangs 'khon ston gyis chu bzang dben gnas su mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyal ba kun gyi ma/bkra shis don grub kyis bstod pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas ma/dharmā shrī bha dras sgon lung bsam gtan rdzong du sbyar ) rto klo ///| khyod thugs zhi ba ma/mkhan chen gnas drug pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa mthu chen 386ba tshon / sdang dgra ma/khyo wan yon tan blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa sngags kyi don bstod dus mtshan chen po ma/sngags 'chang gzungs pas sa skyar mdzad pa'i bstod pa sku (5)(nyi)gsum mngon gyur ma/rdzong pod na'ang yod/des mdzad pa'i thun (ni/gsum bsten cing ma/chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan par chos skyong gis rmi lam du bskul nas kha'u skyes lhas su mdzad pa'i bstod pa ha ha dgod pa ma/shrī mā na bha dras rtsa sngags dang mthun par rin chen sgang mgon khang du bstod pa chos dbyings mthing nag ma/bzang po'i mtha' can gyis rin chen snang bla brang du bstod pa'i lha chen thugs kyi ma/zhal bzhi pas bskul nas sbas pa'i rnal 'byor zur shākya dpal gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa rab 'jigs dur khrod ma/rdzong pod na'ang yod/gnyan los mdzad pa'i rtsa sngags kyi drag lta'i)bskul nag po chen po ma/des mdzad pa'i bstod bskul (5)do//macan spyod rol pa lo rgyus dang bcas pa/des

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mdzad pa'i bstod bskul ( lha/las kyi rgyal po tshigs bcad dpal ldan mgon po ma lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ des mdzad pa'i bskul (nyi)legs ldan nag po ma/ 'di dkar chag na mi gsal ba gong gi bstod bskul gyi sdebs su 'gro rgyu yin nam brtag /des mdzad pa'i dmod bskul las kyi rgyal po zhes pa tshig lhug dpal ldan nag po ma/ kha'u pas mdzad pa'i dmod bskul lo ston thig le la gnang ba tshig lhug dpal ldan ma hā kā la ma rnams/ dkar chag tu/ snyan brgyud khrag mtsho'i ljongs nas 'ong / /mngon spyod sgrul gdug kha rlangs can/ /srog gi mthar byed (387na 'di mthong tshe/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin la 'khub ba'i/ /mi dang mi min gang ci'ang rung / /bag yod dus la bab min nam/ zhes gsungs par dpags na phyi sgrub yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas snod ma brtags par bab col du 'chad pa'ang mi rung bar mngon no/ /gnyis pa nang rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa gsang ba'i man ngag la/ rtsa ba'i yi ge tshigs bcad ma (2)bla ma'i man ngag bzhin gab dkrugs med par dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa/ yig rnying 'di lta bu yod pa mig dang rna ba'i yul du ma gyur par rtag brtan sprul sku kun dga' snying pos tshar chen gyi gur mgon gyi 'khrid la dpe blangs pa'i rang bzo yin zhes ngan smras kyi than skad phyogs brgyar sgrog pa ni rang gi nang cha gsal bar ston pa'o/ gsang sgrub kyi 'khrid gzhung ngam man ngag thun mong ma yin pa snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa ka zha dka' bcu dang rong po dka' bcu sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas bskul ba la brten nas mtshungs med skyes mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ gsang ba'i 'khrid yig zung 'jug rnam par rol pa bdud sde 'joms pa'i bshan pa chen po zhes bya ba mdo khams lho phyogs pa dbon chen chos rgyal mtshan dang bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs kyis bskul nas rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/des kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i du 'dren gyi pho brang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bsam gtan khang bur mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa rgyal ba kun dngos ma rnams (387ba'i ni skor ni gtso bor mchog gi dngos grub zung 'jug gi go 'phang sgrub pa'i gsang lam zab mo yin pas/ dkar chag tu/—555

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonalhan skyes rdo rje lus kyi zhing skyong che/ /bde chen 'od stong 'bar ba'i 'dzum zhal la/ /rnal 'byor yid kyi dga' ma ji bzhen du/ /'bral med rtse dgas rol 'di ngo mtshar med/ /e ma tshe 'di'i chos brgyad kun dor nas/ /gcig pu dben pa'i nags kyi sman ljongs su/ /rgyal ba'i thugs bcud rim gnyis bdud rtsi'i ro/ myang ba'i spyod tshul de la snying nas spro/ zhes pa rdo rje'i gsung bla na med pa yin la/zhar byung du las bzhi ga dang khyad par mngon spyod kyi las spros pa la ma bltos par 'bad med du 'grub pas/ e dbyings sde brgyad dbus su bsgrub bya'i gzugs/ /lus la zhing skyong bkod pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /rtsa 'bral khams gsol rnam shes 'phrog pa yi/ /zhes dgra bo rnams ring por mi thogs par mi bskyod ba'i zhing du skyes pa'i zab gnad kyang shin tu che'o/ /gsum pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu khyad par gye man ngag la/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas bla ma gnyan la gdams pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i shog dril nyer gcig /de las zab pa'i yig chung dang gnyis/ dang po la/ 'gor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang dang zhes yod pa'i bsrung bzlog gsad mnan tshe sgrub dang bcas (zhi nge/pa'i shog dril gtor mdos man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang zhes yod pa'i rten gsum/ gnad 'bebs/ bsnyen pa/ las sbyor/ rtags/sreg mnan (sa732)rnams ston pa sbas te 'dzam gling du ma grags pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu'i lha ga dril/ 'gor chos skyong zhi bar zhes yod pa'i bsnyen dus kyi mgon po la brten pa'i chos skyong zhi ba nor du sgrub pa'i shog dril sgrub lugs yin no rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor bu d+dha ya shrī pa she ku ru zhes yod pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma hre gdan la bzhugs pa nang tsit+ta la brten nas zhal dngos su blta ba'i shog dril rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor dpal mgon po gdong bzhi pa bsgrub pa la zhes yod pa'i phyi'i sgab 'dre bdud mo shi rnye ro zan ma gnon pa 'brug mgo can gyi shog dril/'gor byad ma'i ngag mnan pa ni zhes yod pa'i nang gi mal 'og bsrung ba byad ma'i ngag gnon pa'i shog dril/ 'gor man ngag 'di'i zhal gdams na zhes yod pa'i gsang ba rang srog rten gyi 'khor lo —556

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()la chongs kyi mtha' can/'di la dpal mgon gdong pha pa'i pha pa ka ces pa gong gogs la byed bag min na 65235naganyis pa bgyis so zhes dang a ma ra zhes pa yod pa gcig dang bcas pa'i nang gses chos tshan bzhir dbye ba 'dra zhig 'dug kyang dkar chag tu sdoms par snang ngo //rdzong pod na'ang bzhugs/gong dkar ba'i glegs bam nang gses bzhi'i gnyis pa 'gor tā ra na mo dpal (nyi)mgon gdong phre pa zhes dang mjug tu chos rje rin po che bsod nams la brgyud zer ba de snang /'gor dpal mgon nag po chen po ma 'chun na/zhes yod pa'i ma 'chun 'khru ldog byed na mnan pa'i shog dril sa ma pa tha mi'i mtha' can/'gor dpal nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa dgra bo la 'gro ma nyan cing zhes yod pa'i las byed (klo/du mi 'dod na ar gto kyi shog dril shin tu sbas pa'o mtha' can rnams dus gcig la mang por mi spel ba'i chig brgyud gras/shog dril dang po' gsal byed 'gor bla ma dang dpal ldan mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo rje btsun ku sa li zhes yod pa rje btsun (dbang46)rdo ring pa chen pos mdzad pa zlog pa sogs gas du shes so'i mtha' can/shog dril dang po'i rgyun gyi nyams len ngag 'don gsal bar bkod pa rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa rnams/gnyis pa de las zab pa'i yig chung la/tsa tu rmu kha dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgrub (ni nge lo rdo rje )thabs yin byung rjes gnang gi yig chung dang bcas pa snyan brgyud yi ger bkod pa bka' rgyanywa'i mtha' can 'gor gnyis pa rnal 'byor pa nor spel (ldo pe' rje )na zhes yod pa'i ser po rgyas pa'i yi ge/'gor gsum pa dgra bgegs sgrol na zhes yod pa'i nag po dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i yi ge zhal du (zhi rngolo| rje )gsol bar bsam mo'i mtha' 389ba lon/'gor bzhi pa dmigs bya dbang du bsdu (〈 pe5rdo rje rke zhes yod pa'i dmar po dbang sdud kyi yi ge/'gor tā ra la na mo mgon po dkar ser dmar nag ces yod pa'i las (ldo/yo rdo rje )bzhi mgon po'i mngon rtogs kyi gsal byed u pa de sha gsang bar bya'o mtha' can/mgon po ser po'i byin mas kyi yig 〈ldo nge5ni rje )chung tsit+ta'i dkyil du sbas so sa ma pa tha mi'i mtha' can/las bzhi mgon po'i sgrub thabs tā ming rgyal po chen po'i bkas bskul ba ltar theg chen choX kyi rgyal pos pho brang twa'i tu'i ho'i sde chen por

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)sbyar ba/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa dkar po'i tshe sgrub zla ba'i chu rgyun (ldo nge/rdo rje tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje 'chang dbang ma/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma ku swā li chen mos g.yi lo bod du 'byon khar 'gro chos su gnang ba'i bram (rdo rje )ze dmod pa'i srog mthu 'di phyi bram ltar sgrub pa'i man ngag yin nam snyam/ dgra bo'i srog gi bshan pa dmar po snying khrag thang la 'pho zhing sa mā ya na ra skan gyi mtha' can/ sngags dgra srog gi spu srid mar po yang zer/ lam bar gyi chom rkun brtag pa'i phyir du gdong bzhi pa'i bka' sdod drang srong nag po'i bra se na dbab pa'i man ngag mkhar nag dge bshes nas brgyud pa shin tu gsang ba gal che 'o'i mtha' can/ de'i zhal shes snying gi dkyil du chongs kyi mtha' can/ bla ma gnyan bod du byon khar mgon pos lung bstan pa la brten nas zhus pa'i tsa tu rmu kha'i cho 'phrul (dzi rje )than 'gyed gnyan gyi mgul khug mar grags pa chig brgyud snying gi dum bu dka' rgya dang bcas pa3ni'i mtha' can/ 'gor ḍā gi ma bzhi zhes yod pa'i (390na/ yum chen bzhi'i than ( rdo rje )'gyed gnyan gyi mgul khug bka' rgya ma sa ma pa tha mi thi'i mtha' can/'gor twa ra na mo rnal 'byor pa mtshan ma thob nas zhes yod pa'i gnyan (rdo rje/dga' 'khyil)mgon gyi par bu'i cho ga'i man ngag zhal gdams bka' rgya mi:'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na ma mgon po'i nor sgrub ni zhes yod pa'i gnyan mgon lha dgu'i sgrub (rdo rje )thabs thun mong ma yin pa snyan brgyud kun la ma grags pa'i snying nang gi khrag lta bu shin tu gsang rgya'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo rdzas kyi sbyor ba zhes yod pa'i rdzas kyi sgo nas dgra gsod pa'i las sbyor bla ma'i zhal las shes so sa ma pa tha'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo gtad bya ba ni zhes yod pa'i rdo nag (rdo rje ) yig dmar gyi sgrub mthu gser zho re'i bka' rgya yod pa sa ma pa tha mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor khang sel zhing sel la zhes yod pa'i khang sel nag po zla phyed tshun la 'jig pa su hā sngags so3ni'i mtha' can/ 'gor zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag la dgra glo bur zhes yod pa'i dgra bo zla ba gcig la gsod pa ltas/mdze bo nag po'i man ngag 'di ka la gsod3ni'i mtha' can/ dgra bo klu la gtod pa reg pas chog pa drag —559

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā)po'i btsan dug gtad khram gyi yang snying gnyan gyi nā ga stobs 'phrog tu grags pa/ 'gor na mo gu ru mon pa zhes yod pa'i mon pa nag po nor bsher gyi 'di bugs lha pa gyi las tshogs/ man ngag rgya gar nas bod du byon pa la 'di las zab pa med do rtags thon thon pa yid ches par gyis shig gi mtha' can/dar lung gi brag spre'u dmar 'dzing 'dra ba'i rmang du bla ma gnyan gyis sbas pa kha'u pas brtan pa'i zangs (390bsgo ba ba dmar po'i gsad las khar lce myug ge bya'o mtha' can/ gdong brnyan can la brten pa/ 'gor dpal rje btsun stobs 'phrog nag po la phyag 'tshal lo bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba zhes yod pa'i sreg byed me'i sbyor ba bla ma kha'u chen po'i gsung bzhin yi ger bkod pa la/ nag po chen pos bzod par mdzod cig sa ma pa tha mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gong oṃ su sdi sid+dhi dpal mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa bstan pa ni zhes yod pa'i btsun pa'i mthar thug sdig pa nag po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi las tshogs gtso 'khor gsum bsgom mo'i mtha' can rnams/ g.yin yang gdong bzhi pa'i sgo nas sri'u gso ba rgyud rin can spungs rgyan gyi gdams pa mngal bsrung ba'i cho ga 'o'i mtha' can/ bu 'tshol ba'i man ngag (zhi nge lo snyarme)ltas kyi le'u 'o'i mtha' can/ mngal bsrung ba'i gdams(wo nge kyi lha6)pa dbang phyug dang pad+ma la brten pa gnyan gyi u pa de sha'i mtha' can/ ma hā kā la'i sku gzugs (nyi༅)la brten nas sri'u gso ba/ 'gor tā ra na mo zhal bzhi pa'i sgo nas srid med pa srid dang phrad pa 'di la gsum ste zhes yod pa'i srid med pa 'tshol ba lung skam chu 'bebs/ klung log bu mor 'ong bas srid pa lte ba bsgyur ba/ yod pa gso ba'i gdams pa rnams kyi yi ge bla ma gnyan gyis mdzad pa bka' rgya ma/ 'gor tā ra na mo nag po chen po'i sgo nas chung sri zhes yod pa'i chung sri 'dul (nyi༅)ba gnyan lo'i man ngag lha'i mtha' can/ dkar chag na 'di gong ma'i khongs su bsdus pa las zur du med/ zhal gdams snying gi dum bur grags pa'i nang (391na)tshan la 'gor twa ra na mo tsa tu rmu kha'i zhal gdams snying gi dum bu zhes yod pa'i spu gri so 'debs kyi gdams (ldo nge/pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa'i zab chos gzhan la mi ston pa'i bka' rgya dam po yod do'i —560

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()na/ rang bsrung 'khor lo che chung gsum gsungs pa'i chung ba shog dril nyer gcig gi khu ldog bsrung ba'i rang bsrung 'khor lo gri thod ma'am sku gsung thugs 'khor du grags pa/ zhal bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i rang bsrung yang zer/ gtum po'i sgo nas mi ma yin drag po bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ 'khor bsrung ba'i gri gug can/ shog dril nyer gcig gi gsang ba rang srog rten gyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug kha sbyor lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs pa/ yi ge rnying pa las byung ba'i gsad pa'i 'khor lo ling tshe nyi shu pa dang / bco lnga pa/ dmar gyi ba ched pa gcig /ling tshe rkyang pa bco lnga pa dang / nyi shu pa/ ling ga 'khor lo can/ ling ga ling tshe can 'khor lo yod med gnyis/ chos rdzes paṇa la mgon po nyid kyis gdams pa'i ling tshe nyi shu pa dang bco lnga (392na)pa/ de'i ba 'ad pa'i rang bsrung 'khor lo ling tshe nyi shu pa dang bco lnga pa/de'i bzhed pa'i ling ga 'khor lo can gnyis/ de'i bzhed pa'i ling tshe rkyang pa gnyis/ de'i bzhed pa'i ling ga ling tshe can gnyis/ gzhan yang gong dang cung zad mi 'dra ba'i ling tshe nyi shu pa gtor ma la 'dzugs rgyu'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa/ ling ga sngags bkod lugs mi 'dra ba gnyis dang sngags med gcig /rdo nag maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor dang bcas pa'i shom/ phyag mtshan/ las khung / rdo zor/ rwa zor mda' zor/ thun khungs/ rlon thun/ sbyin sreg gi thab khung mi 'dra ba gnyis/ rdza'i an dha mu sha / la cha'i a nā dh+wa mu sha /'bru nag gi sdig pa/ sgab 'dre 'brug mgo can gyi mnan 'khor/ mal 'og bsrung ba'i ngag mnan 'khor lo/ ma hā ba la/ de'i rgyab yig /ling ga /rgya gram/ glang dmar gyi rwa/ tshe sgrub kyi bca' gzhi'i mchod rten/ nor sgrub kyi bum pa/ dbang sdud gri lag /lam bsrung gi rde'u dang rdo rje rgya gram rtse mor phyag mtshan dang bcas pa/ shwa zlog phur thod/ bya rog bskrad 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i ling ga dang / bya rog gi gzugs/ ma chun spre'u'i 'khor lo/ lha mo nag mo'i dpe/ mngal bsrung pad+ma'i pho 'khor mo 'khor dbang phyug gi gzugs/ nā ga stobs 'phrog gi ling ga /su tho bum pa/ rgya gram/yang ling ga 'khor lo can lugs gcig /klu sgrub rgya gzhung gi sham bu brgyad pa'i dkyil 'khor ling ga /thun snod dang bcas pa/ nam mkha'/ rgyang bu/ mda' 'phang / pho gdong mo gdong / ri rab gling —562

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)bzhi/ gdugs sogs mdos kyi cha lag rnams/ gzhan yang dpe ris rnying pa na med pa'i mgon po che chung gi dam rdzas rgyan (392ba)gyi gtor ma/ dpal gyi zhal zas/ dzasbu ti ba/ bshos bu dmar nag/gur gyi bsnyen sgrub rjes gnang gi gtor dpe/ dud sol ma'i gtor ma/ zhal gyi dam tshig bkang so dang rtag gtor/ pu tre'i gtor ma/ beg rtse'i gtor ma/ gzhi bdag gtor ma/ dmar chen gtor ma/mgon po che chung gi gtor ma'i dar gur/ zangs gri can gyi zor gtor/ zhal gyi gtor chen gyi dpe rnams rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi zhal bkod ma/ gnyis pa dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i skor la/ phyi sgrub dang khyad par gyi man ngag la mkho ba'i skor/ gsang sgrub kyi skor/ phyi sgrub kyi snying por gyur pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i snying thig ha la nag po'i skor dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'gor gdong brnyan can la gtor ma 'bul na paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzas pa bsgyel zhes yod pa'i glang ('bum)gdong phyag drug pa'i gtor 'bul e ka dza ṭi hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'o3|'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ su sti bla ma dang ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa zhes sogs kyi mchod brjod blo ka gnyis mdo stod pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dri med don gsal ji lta ba la de nas slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung la dpang po byas zhes yod pa'i gdong lta'i bu rme)brnyan can gyi bsnyen pa'i yi ge 'phags pa klu sgrub snying po'i rgya gzhud ltar bsnyen pa'i cho ga 'o'i mtha' can/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos bskul nas tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i zhing skyong stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa las sbyor gyi mgon po gdong brnyan can 'khor (393na sgong dang bcas pa la bstod cing (dbang/'phrin las gsol ba bdud dgra'i srog 'phrog dam nyams kyi tsit+ta dmar 'byin/ 'gor bla ma dam can srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ shes bya kun la blo gros rab rgyas shing zhes yod pa'i gdong bzhi pa'i lo rgyus dkar chag bskyed chog mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mkha' 'gro 'khu ldog spong ba dang bcas ston pa'i yi ge bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa mngon sum nyid du grub pa'i —363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()las mdzod cig gi mtha' can/ 'di 'go'i mchod brjod la bdag chen rje'i mtshan spel yod pa de rdo ring rin po che'i gsung yin pa 'dra zhes yig sa snang ngo / /'gor rdo rje 'chang dbang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang zhes yod pa'i rgyud 'debs (glang/(khra)kyi lo rgyus zung ldan gyi rgyan dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i 'od can zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang tshar pa blo gsal rgya mtshos kha'u brag rdzong nag por mdzad pa/ des mdo khams pa dbon po dpal grub dang bsod nams mchog grub gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar na lan+dar (wing )mdzad pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang dngos grub rgya mtsho/ bskul ba po dang mdzad po gong ltar gyi dpal stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa sgrub (ta)dus kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang chig brgyud gser chos kyi yig chung / sgrub dus kyi mgon po zhal khra can gyi rjes gnang gi khog phub bsnyen dus sgrub dus thun mong ma yin pa/ dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ma yin pa/ dmar po dbang sdud/ ser po rgyas byed lha dgu /sngon po bgegs 'joms dang bcas pa rnams kyi tho yig (ngag)mun sel sgron me zhes (393ba)bya ba thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ des rtse gdong phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwar mdzad pa'i dpal mgon gdong brnyan (/ da 'bum(ngags na gyi rjes gnang go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa/ 'gor tā ra na mo 'di chig brgyud ma gtogs ye mi byed do zhes yod pa'i gnad dbab (5)kyi mgon po nang gshin rje ltar sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi yi ge dkyus dang 'dra'o'i mtha' can tshar chen gyi gsung /de'i gsung 'gor tā ra na ma bram ze mngags pa'am bran du gtad pa zhes yod pa'i bram ze nag po mngags gtad kyi rjes (༷)gnang 'chol par spyad na dam tshig nyes pa chen por 'gyur de bas gsang zhing sba bar bya 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor glud su sti rdo nag po mi gcig gis theg mi theg cig ces yod pa'i sgrub dus kyi las khrigs gsal byed kyi yi ge rnying pa zhes spel ba ni man ngag dam pa'o'i mtha' can/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma zhi ba dam tshig bskang ba'i gtor stong dang gtor ma'i las tsam gyis dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i tshe bya ba drag po gtor chen gyi tshul lhan cig tu gsal bar —564

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ston pa'i cho ga gnam lcags (rdo rje)'bar ba zhes bya ba mthu stobs gyi dbang phyug dpal rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ 'gor oṃ su sti dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan zhes yod pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i dam tshig bskang gso rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung (sku/rgyun phyag len ltar mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros kyis zin bris su mdzad pa nag po chen po mche ba can sogs kyi bskul bya'i mtha' can/ 'gor a mri tas bsangs su bhā was sbyangs (394na tshe zhes yod pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gtor ma drag po'i chog 9 spu bsgrigs tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa gnod byed tshar bcad par bsam mo'i mtha' can/dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gtor chen gyi lta rdo rje/'cham yig thu btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i gtor chen gyi rnga brdung bstan pa ni zhes yod pa'i gtor chen 'cham (rdo rje)yig gi zhal shes mthar dgu brdung 'ba' zhig gis sdud do'i mtha' can/dpal mgon khyung zhal can gyi rjes gnang lta'i)gi yi ge las sbyor gyi mgon por btags gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ dpal mgon seng ge nag po'i gtor chog (brje/las dang po ba 'ga' dang rang gi rgyun gtor gyi phyir phun tshogs gling du bris pa/ de'i rjes gnang 'gor (bsgro/mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer stong 'phros pas zhes yod pa ga ga na dharma shrīs bris pa/ 'gor dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i bsrung (dbang/(sa)(rdo yi nge lo6)'khor tshe sgrub ces yod pa'i yi ge rin po che rta ra pa'i gsung la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis reg zig mdzad pa de ma gtogs rgyun khyer ji lta bas 'khrid mdzad kyi 'dug go'i mtha' can/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i bsrung (mus)'khor tshe sgrub kyi yi ge bdud rtsi 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ gnyis pa gsung gi mgon po dmar po'i nyams len snyan brgyud zab mo'i bdud rtsi rnal 'byor (ldo nge5dbang)tos)(glan(khra)dbang phyug yar klungs pas mdzad pa chos bdag zhing skyong mkha' 'gror gtad pa'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i rgyas pa gtso 'khor dgu'i (394ba po khrid gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos bla ma dam pa'i bka' (woji/—565

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'bange yo li/glang46)dang bshes gnyen dam pa 'ga'i ngor bkod pa chos bdag zhing skyong mkha' 'gror gtad pa'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i gsum pa rgyas pa'i las sgrub na yon tan gyi mgon po ser po lha lnga'i nyams len brgyud pa bzang ldan (sdo nge lo rdo ba pe yo3lo gla nge5rte)sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo'i gdams pa chos bdag zhing skyong mkha' 'gror gtad pa'i mtha' can/ sku skye rin po che bsod nams ye shes dbang pos bskul ba la brten nas thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos byang phyogs theg chen chos 'khor gling du mdzad 9)pa'i zhal bzhi pa dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi yi ge zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi snying po bsdus pa/ rdo rje 44 tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i bla rdo bca' ba'i thabs/ (ljong )man ngag gis rnam par brgyan pa des mdzad pa'i chu bo gaṅgā yang gyen la nges par ldog nus pa'i shwa zlog gi man ngag rje btsun kun spangs (〈 pe yos)(ying46)chen po'i gsung gi nying khu 'gro don dpag yas sa steng khyab par shog gi mtha' can/ bla ma gser gling pa'i man ngag rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po la zhus pa srog me khab rtos)ma gser srang bdun ma'i yon tan yar klungs pa'i phyag dpe las bshus pa/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i thabs bzlog brtsi ba'i man ngag (sa)rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa/ 'gor na ma tsa tu rmu kha 'gab ho dang ga the gos drud dang zhes yod pa'i dpal 'bar gyi me bkra brtag pa kha'u pas gnang ba'i mtha' can/ 'gor skyabs med skyob pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo sgrub pa'i khang pa dben pa ru zhes yod pa'i me bkra dang du ba brtag pa zhal las shes par bya'o'i (395na) mtha' can/ 'gor twa ra na mo me bkra 'di la bzang po'i rtags bzhi zhes yod pa'i me bkra brtag pa mngon shes su 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ dpal 'bar (dbang/bkra rtags/ ba ling bkra (dbang/rtags rnams/ gnyis pa gsang sgrub kyi skor la/ dpal ma hā kā la zhal bzhi pa'i gsang sgrub kyi rnam gzhag gsal bar byed pa snying gi yang thig ces (3)shwe/lo )bya ba rdo rje lang tshar r+ṣa blo gsal rgya mtshos kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i ru 'dren gyi pho brang sum cu rtsa gsum du mdzad pa/ des mdo khams pa lcags sgom chos rje'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin (glang/—366

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mdzad pa'i 'gor bla ma mchog dang yi dam lha zhes yod pa'i gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi tho/ des mdzad pa'i zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa'i gsang 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro rnam pa bzhi'i 'khrid nyams len gyi snying po dril ba yin no'i mtha' can/ lcags sgom chos rje'i gsung bzhin des dam pa'i gsung ngor bris (glang/pa'i zhing skyong dbang po'i gsang 'khrid kyi skabs su 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i las sbyor gyi gdams pa snyan brgyud ma/ gong gi 'phros 'gor gsum pa tsit+ta dharma tsakra zhes yod pa'i ches zab (glang)lo she/khri)yang gsang snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i las sbyor gyi yi ge rtags myur du 'byung ba ni nges pa'o'i mtha' can/ 'di gnyis cung zad 'dra min 'du/lung ni gnyi ga mnos la phyi ma legs par ma'/ 'gor gsum pa las sbyor la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa zhes yod pa'i snying ga (glang/(sad/khri)chos kyi 'khor lo'i las sbyor snyan brgyud zhal shes kho na yin gyi mtha' can/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum (glang/gyi phyi ma'i yang yig /'gor lha mo nag mo'i gdams pa ni rang nyid sgrub pa'i (395bcus kyi mgon po zhes yod pa'i las sbyor spogs chog gi dus su nye bar mkho ba'i lha mo nag mo'i gnad 'bebs shog dril gyi gnad 'bebs las khyad par du gyur ba'i zab khyad can tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rgyun gzhan du ma 'khyar ba mdzod ces bka' bsgo yod do'i mtha' can/ chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan sa pa ba so sprul sku lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba la brten nas thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya ma tshos rdza ngom chab mdo'i sgar thog tu mdzad pa'i gsang 'khrid dngos (6)grub kyi snye ma zhes bya ba zung 'jug rnam rol las nye bar bsdus pa/ zab chos 'di nyid 'chad pa la med du mi rung ba'i snying nang gi khrag lta bu'i 'khrid yig (glang/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa/ 'di nyid mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel gyi bka' drin la brten pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ mjug tu/ rgyal ba kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /rigs brgya'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i zlos gar gyis/ /deng 'dir skye rgu'i don slad bshes gnyen sku/ /pha rgod sku drin dbang po dgon gsar ba/ /mgon de'i gsung gi gsang ba mi zad —567

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonapa/ /zab rgyas snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho las/ /dad gus snyim pa'i bcud kyis bsdus pa 'di/ /skal bzang snying la grub pa'i dga' ston spel/ zhes pa'ang snang ngo / /'gor bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes yod pa'i gsang 'khrid kyi zin bris (zhe)mkhan chen zha lu pa rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa yig chung ltar gsung gin 'dug go'i mtha' can rnams/gsum pa phyi sgrub kun gyi snying por gyur pa zab pa las kyang ches zab (396na)pa'i snying thig ha la nag po'i skor ni/ phyi bram ze ltar sgrub pa/ nang zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug gi sgrub pa/ gsang ba stobs 'phrog nag por sgrub pa gsum las phyi ma ste/ gong gi phyi sgrub dang khyad par gyi man ngag rnams su gab sbas thor bu bzhugs pas shes rlom can dag man ngag gi khog sgrig mi shes pas dpe mthong bas phyogs tsam yang mi rtogs pa'i phyir snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi gsung rgyun zhal shes phyag 'khri kho na la bltos dgos pas/ rje btsun kun spangs rdo ring pa chen po yan chad du yi ger gsal bar bkod pa med 'dug na'ang / snyigs ma lnga ches cher bdo zhing bdud rigs snying la zhugs pa'i skye bo mi bsrun pa dag gi rnam par 'tshe ba bsrung ba la ji skad du/'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i ljongs 'di na/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i chos skyong bgrang yas kyang / /khro zhing 'khrug la gnyan zhing myur ba ni/ / yongs su grags pa stobs 'phrog dbang po yin/ /zhes ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i gdams skor rnams med du mi rung ba lta bu yin na'ang / kwa ye da ni lang tsho mthon por song / kha ba'i khrod na 'di 'dra shes pa med/ /ga le spel kyang nub par gyur dogs nas/ /nga yis 'di ni yi ger gsal bar bris/ /che'i/bstan pa rin po che'i btsas su 'khrugs bsdebs su mdzad pa shin tu rno ba reg thabs med pa lta bu nas/ de ltar 'di ni srog 'phrog ha la'i dug /bstan dgra'i klad 'gems gshin rje'i dbyug pa ste/ /rnal 'byor sgos dgra'i (396ba)snying 'byin bshan pa che/ /gang la'ang thogs med gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mtshon/ /sa skya'i rje btsun thugs kyi gces pa'i nor/ /kun spangs chos rje'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i —568

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mtshon cha'i mchog /rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo'i chos/ /zhes dga' rab dbang phyug sde dang bcas pa las rnam par rgyal ba'i go mtshon yin la/ de yang dgos pa'i gtso bo/ gang 'di thub bstan 'jig la thug pa'am/ /rnal 'byor kha zhan skyabs dang bral gyur nas/ kha drag dpung gis bsdigs shing gnod pa'i tshe/ /mtshon 'di phyung la sdig can chos dbyings skyol/ /zhes bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa'i sgos dgra bsgral ba la dgongs nas mdzad pa yin pas/ de la ma yig dang bu yig gnyis/dang po ni dpal mgon zhing skyong nag po chen po dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba snying thig ha la nag po'i be bum zhes bya ba/ 'di nyid kyi lung gnang ba'i dus mgon po'i bris 'bur gyi sku byin rlabs can gyi drung du mchod gtor dang bcas te spyir las 'bras la 'dzem zhing bstan pa rin po che gces spras dang / khyad pa na dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa spyi dang / yang sgos gsang chen slob bshad pa'i ring lugs la gces par 'dzin zhing / snod ldan la tshig brgyud las mang por mi spel ba sogs mgon po dpang du btsugs pa'i dam sgrag cing / 'chol par sbyor pa rnams gnod sbyin beg tse (397na phom dral gyis snying khrag 'thung ba'i bka' rgya shin tu dam pa/ dus der chos kyi yon la gser srang gang ngam yang na de ri ba'i dngos po 'bul ba sogs kyi phyag len deng sang gi bar du'ang ma nub par yod pas dpe tsam mthong bas nyams su len pa/ rku thabs su byed pa/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa spyi sger la ga rjes par 'dzin pa lta zhog gnod pa lhur len bzhin du tshul 'di don du gnyer ba rnams ni sa bon mes tshig pa la so nam 'bad pa lhur len pa dang / btsan dug la rjen zas byed pa dang mtshungs pas bag yod par bya ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ /gnyis pa bu yig ni/ gong gi ma yig gi be'u bum mi'i lus kyi phyi'i dbyibs lta bu la stod smad bar gsum gyi zab gnad don snod dang dbang po lta bu rnams logs su gab pa yin la/ de'i rgyu —569

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mas ni/tshe 'di'i 'dod pa phra mo tsam gyi phyir//drag po'i las sbyor byung rgyal rtsom byed cing //chosal brten nas sdig chen gsog pa yi//blun po zhe sdang can de'ang 'di'i snod min//sdig can mi dpon stobs ldan khyim nang du//las sbyor drag pos lto gos 'tshol byed cing //las sa rgyab bsgyur mthu stobs r+ṣa por lhu/dmyal ba'i bud shing chos 'di'i snod ma yin//spyo pa'i gang zag gi lag tu son tshe spre'u la sgron me bskur ba bzhin thams cad phung la skyor ba'i dgag bya dang dgos pa la dgongs pa yin pas bu yig gi skor la/mā ri'i lag len de 'khor gsal 2byed dang /mal 397bsgo srung zlog 3zab tsa kra'i bri 4yig bcas//gta' rnga sro 5bzung kha sbyor de'i gsal 6byed//yid bzhin 7la 'khor lo ༅ sgros rnying gi/tsakra 8(gli ge mkha' 9mig (gla ge mnga' zugs 0(gro ge ling tshe rnying //'khor 1(gro pe3n ling can 2sngags (gro nge3n 3kyang 6gegazugs 4(glanabazhi/ /paṇ+ḍa ra yi mkhas pa'i ba ched tshul 15gcig (glang///tsaṇ+ḍa'i tsakra 6de yi lag 17len bcas//rdo rje gri gug 8dngos sku'i bsrung 19ba dang //mi min 0rak+ṣi ta dang ba 21li gzungs//spu gri so 'debs 22man+ta lugs 23ldog dang //ral gri rtags can las bshus rnam dag 24sngags//nyi zla can 25dang de khyi kā 26li ma//mnan 27pa dur rdo man+t+ra'i 28ri mo can//bri yig lag 29len (glang/(sad/khri)gsal byed zhal 30shes (glinge lo6da/khri)dang //drag 3gto (gro ge(sa)'a)gzugs 32bsnun 〈 pe yos)khro)rten 33brab(gro gi(sa)6 tu lu 34(glang)i lo 6 )dang //gas 356gi(sa)khye)lor ka 3(pā ye nge yos)khro)la dang /(da/— 7rdzo)gnad 'khor 37 glang sa khram//gnad dbab shi sa'i tshad 38'dzin mtshams sbyor 39klong lo da/khri)dang //'jam mgon sa skya'i chos kyi khrir bzhugs pa'i/ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa yis//khyab bdag dar+shaX /ga rab brtan zhabs bsten nas//yab chos gsan tshe 'di dang gsang sgrub zung //dkar 40sa rnga zhing skyong dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas kyis//mtha' rten kho bo' snying dbus bum par bltams//zhes grangs/༷ 'god pa las gsal bar mi 'dra ba ni/'di ni

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lho bal gser gyis gnongs pa ltar/ /yod ces mi smra shin tu gsang zhing sba/ /sbas kyang shes na khyi dang slo ba ni/ /phrad ltar mi bya rim (395) gyis brtags byas te/ /skal bzang snod dang ldan pa'i bu mchog la/ /chig brgyud kho nar byin la rgyas gdab bya/ zhes pa'i don snying gi dpal be'ur bcang dgos pas zhib cha mtha' dag yid la ri mor 'dri ba dang / gal te brjed ngas kyis 'jigs na tho gsal po bris nas gud du bcang pa las tho yig yongs grags su'ang rgyas par mi 'dri ba phyag len no/ /da ltar chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs par nos pa las bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang / ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma nas brgyud pa'i sa bcad dang po phyi sgrub skor dang sa bcad gsum pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu khyad par gyi man ngag rnams las shog dril dang po'i gsal byed rje btsun rdo ring pas mdzad pa ma gtogs pa yongs rdzogs/ dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad dang po'i ldong g.yung drung lhan cig pa'i rtags can dang rtags gang yang med pa rnams dang bcas pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang / 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs/ grub chen ba liṅka pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba'i zhabrus/ bi mā la gup+ta/ rat+na kirti/ rat+na badz+ra/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rjes sa skya paṇ+ḍita/'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ (398ba〉thab 'jam dbyangs chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun spangs rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rigs kun bdag po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor ban+de la phyag len zhal shes dmar khrid dang bcas pa legs par stsal/ phyi sgrub kyi —371

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rjes gnang / dkar chag gi sa gcad dang po yongs rdzogs/ gsum pa'i nang gi ldong gi rtags yod pa/dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad dang po'i ldong g.yu drung can dang bcas pa'i lung gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ bdag chen 'jam dbyangs chos rje man gong bzhin no/ /yang rjes gnang dang sa bcad dang po'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan nas/ bdag po zha lu pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje bas grol mchog gi gsan yig na bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi rjes la bdag po zha lu pa 'dug pa ni khu dpon lugs ldog tu song ba'i 'brul gzhi can no/ /paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa man gong ltar/ e'i rtags yod pa thams cad kyi lung brgyud ni/bla ma dam pa nas/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ bzhi thog pa bdag chen kun dga' dbang phyug /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man gong ltar/ (399na〉nga rjes gnang dang sgo'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rje btsun rdo ring pa yan gong ltar nas/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang sgo'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims/ rje btsun sgo rum pa man 'dra/ rdo rje rkyang pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ bla chen rong pa/ bla ma shes rab seng ge /bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug /bla ma dpal ldan legs dbang / brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ mthu chen tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar ba chos rje man gong ltar ro/ /rdo rje g.yu drung can gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ gnyan lo nas/ gshong ma'i sngags ban ge rad/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar ba/ 'dis dgung lo phyed nyis brgya tsam bzhugs pas sku tshe'i stod la sngags ban dang mjal/ sku tshe'i smad la spyan snga dang mjal zer ba rdo rje gdan pa dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'dug cing / rje grol —572

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mchog gis sngags ban tshe ring po zhes sngags pa ge rang sku tshe ring po byung bar bzhed pa ni cung zad 'khrul gzhi byung bar snang /thel spyan snga bsod nams grags pa/ rin po che tshal min pa/ rin po che seng ge dpal ba/ brag thog chos rje man 'dra/ 'di skor la brgyud tshul zur pa 'di 'dra zhig yod na'ang de rgyu mtshan du byas nas rje btsun gong ma nas ma brgyud par 'dod pa ni log rtog go /(399ba)rdo rje dga' 'khyil can gyi lung brgyud gcig ni/ kha'u pa nas/ slob dpon go cha/ dam pa de skyes/ gru rdo rje seng ge /bcom ldan ral gri /skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen jo mo nang pa chen po/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ rje lung rig pa mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ brag thog pa chen po'i man 'dra/ rgya'i rtags g.yung drung yod med thams cad kyi lung brgyud ni/ rdo ring rin po che nas/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man sngar bzhin no/ /glo g.yung drung can gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ lcang lung pa gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchog man 'dra/ ku'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen nas/ gnyan ston sprul pa'i zlos gar gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur pa/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag go /dbang gi rtagasayod ba'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen nas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/ desabadag la'o/ ngag gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje dbang rab nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams/ des sras bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha sdo/ pa/des bdag la'o/ /mus kyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/'jam dbyangs dkon cog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams man gong ltar ro/ /nyi g.yung drung can gyi lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs bsod (400na loms rgyal ba mchog nas/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ 'jam dbyangs byang chub dbang rgyal/ yongs 'dzin shākya kun dga'/ bla ma ye shes dbang po/ bla ma badz+ra ma ti/ nyi ma —573

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonagling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ de gnyis ka la paṇa chen kun bzang rtse pas gsan/ de la zha lu pa mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /nyi dga' 'khyil yod pa dang / mgon po gdong bzhi chos tshan bzhi po 'di tshar pod rdzong pod gnyis na tshig zhus dag pher ba ma byung yang yig rnying zhig yin nam snyam/pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsad gsum gyi las khrigs gos brdab dmod mo brjod do'i mtha' can/ 'gor de nas sngags ring brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa'i gtor ma gtong ba/ sngags bzla ba/ gtad dang 'khor lo bris thabs thor bu yod pa rdzogs par bri po'i mtha' can/ gsang ba'i las sbyor 'di yis 'grub a mi kyi zer ba'i gdams pa/ 'gor tā ra na mo bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo dpal nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa bsnyen cing sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rten bca' lugs dang mngon rtogs gtso bor ston pa mjug tu brgyud pa'i dam bsgrags dang phrin las bcol lo'i mtha' can rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje gdan pa yan mtha' ma chod/ de man gong dang 'dra/ 'gor shrī ma hā kwa la na mo bstan la sdang ba'i dam nyams rnams zhes yod pa'i ro skyed gsum gyi steng du sla nga btsugs pa'i than 'gyed kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje g.yung drung can gyi lung brgyud zur pa dang mthun/ nyi rkyang (400ba)pa'i rtags yod rnams dang shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyal kun thugs sprul ma'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje gdan pa yan rdo rje rkyang pa'i lung brgyud ltar la/ de nas 'jam dbyangs byang chub dbang rgyal man nyid g.yung drung dang gcig go /dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad gsum pa ha la nag po ma yig bu yig rtags med rnams kyi lung man ngag phyag 'khrid dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po nas/ drung yig byams pa don grub/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /de yang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos ched gnyer du 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la gnang / mkhyen brtse'i zhabs las 'phro gling pa'i lung bstan du/ lang 'gro'i sprul pa bka' gter bdag po ni: mkhyen brtse'i ming can rig gnas lngar —574

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mkhas pa: gtsang phyogs 'di nas 'khon gyi thog ma 'byung : de la gdams pa gtad na bstan pa 'phel zhes pa'i lung bstan ltar gter ston dang chos bdag rten 'brel 'grig na sku tshe mthar phyin rgyu la dbus gtsang sa thag rings pas gter ston gis lung bstan yul gyi gang zag ngo ma 'phrod par 'gyangs pa'i skyon gyis gzhan la ma gnang ba'i ngang du/ gsung las/ 'di nas 'phos nas byang phyogs lcang lo can/ zhing der phan na drung du nges par 'gro/ de nas o rgyan zangs mdog dpal gyi rir/ /skye ba'i rten 'brel sgrig la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes zhal gyis 'ches pa ltar dgung lo zhe drug par lcang lo can gyi zhing khams (401na)su gshegs pas ches rgyun chad par thug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis spyan lnga rin po che mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho bzhugs su re nas dbus phyogs su rtsad gcod la phebs tshe spyan lnga'i gsungs rin po che bod mkhar ba rang gis kyang gsan ma thub tshul byung ba nas/'di skor thugs rtsom gyi ljags dpod gnang ba'i drung yig byams pa don grub kyis tshig gcig kyang ma lus pa gus pa chen po'i sgo nas gsan 'dug par brten/ stobs 'phrog dbang por brtag pa phul ba de yang legs pa'i mtshan ma gsal po byung bas drung yig par gsan pa yin pas 'di skor la rje byams pa don grub brgyud par ma bzhugs pa'i lung byed pa mtha' dag mo gsham gyi bu lngar gzhan 'drid pa'i phyir du tshul 'chos pa kho na'o/ /ha la nag po'i ma yig tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i ngos ma mgo thog tu bzhag pa'i bka' bsgo rgyas pa dang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor 'khor lo'i phyag len shin tu zhib cing mtha' chod pa rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi drung du'ang nos so/ /yang rjes gnang khe rkyang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje sa paṇa nas/ nub pa rigs 'dzin grags/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ gu ru dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/ bla ma rdo rje seng ge /mkhan chen bcu pa/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ rtses dang dge 'phel ba bsod nams blo gros/ rje rdo ring pa/ de la rje btsun sgo rum pa dang tshar chen gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses gsan pa man sngar ltar ro/ (401ba〉thang na —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhang dkon mchog dpal nas/ dgon pa bsod nams 'bum/ bag ston gzhen tshul man 'dra/ yang na chos rje bla ma dam pa nas/ bdag chen kun dga' rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag po bla ma/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ gung thang pa seng ge dpal ldan 'od mdzes bzang po/ bla ma paṇ+ḍita man 'dra/ yang na bzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen nas/ bzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ gra thang pa shes rab zla ba'i dbang po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na bdag chen zha lu pa nas/ chos rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge /rje rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang na chos rje bla ma nas/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ de gnyis ka la chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rim bzhin shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje bya gyur pa bsod nams seng ge man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen chos rje bsod nams dbang phyug /rgyal tshab kun dbang / slob dpon bsod nams sangs rgyas/ mkhas grub gung ru sher bzang bzhi gas gsan/ bzhi ga la kun spangs chen pos gsan pa man 'dra/ yang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /gnyis ka la mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang rta ra ba gnyis kyis gsan/ yab sras bzhi ka la rdo rje 'chang dbang rab kyis gsan no/ /sgrub dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang / ta thā ga ta rak+shi ta nas brgyud pa'i sgrub (402na tshe skor dang dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad dang po'i ta'i rtags can dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ bā ling ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad/ dpal bde ba/ bi mā la gup+ta/ rin chen rnam gnyis/ shrī paṇ+ḍita ta thā ga tak+ṣi ta/ gnyan lo man gdung brgyud brgyud pa dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa nas brgyud pa gnyis rta ra ba bzhugs pa dang 'dra/ sgrub dus kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ brgyud lugs 'di lo pa spyan snga'i gsan yig na snang / bla ma bdag nyid —576

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)chen po/ chos rje bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ bdag chen kun dga' rin cen/gzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ gra thang pa shes rab zla ba/ rje rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang sgrub dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang thun mong ba'i brgyud pa gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag go /yang na tshang chen nas/ rin po che bod mkhar ba mai tre don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan lnga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ skyed tshal mkhan po thar pa bzang po/ mkhan chen zha lu pa man 'dra/ gong dkar lugs kyi sgrub dus mgon po gtso 'khor lnga pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams bstan pa/ rje brag phug pa/ drung chos rje ba/ bzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen/bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal (402bstab/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ mthu chen 'jigs med dpa' bo/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ yangs can shākya kun dga'/kun bzang dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/des bdag la'o/ /sgrub dus dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar la/ de nas kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag
