la'o/ /las sbyor gyi mgon po gdong brnyan can gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / na gā rdzu na/ gtor ma pa/ dz+nyā na pā da/ dī paṃ kwa ra bha dra/ shrī su ra pā da/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rat+na rnam gnyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lo nas tshar chen yan gdung brgyud brgyud pa dang yar klungs pa brgyud pa gnyis rta ra ba bzhugs pa ltar la/ de nas bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan lnga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams/ rje chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'phags pa yan gong ltar nas/lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge /chos rje dharmā kirti/ chos rje blo bzang pa/ nya dbon kun —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dpa' dpal/ bla ma lung rig rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ brag thog bsod nams bzang po/mthu chen 'jigs med dpa' bo/ mus chen rnam rgyal dpal bzang / thugs sras kun dga' rgyal bo/'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa nas/ 'jam dbyangs (403na〉khyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'khor zhal gyi rjes gnang zhes logs su bgrangs 'dug pa gdong bas can pas zur pa med kyang lo mchog pa yod pa'i brgyud pa'i skabs gdong bas can dang las bzhi lhan du grangs pa'i dbang gis so sor phye bar snang ngo / /mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen po/ na bza' ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen/ gcung grags pa blo gros/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal man 'dra/ yang na bdag po kun rin pa nas/ bdag chen blo gros pa/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje zla ba shes rab/rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang rje rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba man 'dra/ 'di nye brgyud yin pa 'dra zhing 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig gi tshar lugs nas brgyud pa'i skabs ring brgyud dang gong dkar ba lugs kyi gsan yig skabs gsan yig rgya mtsho sor bzhag bgrangs 'dug pa rgyas bsdus su mngon/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa nas brgyud pa'i chos skor dang dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i 'bum gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/tshar chen yan zhal ngo nang brgyud dang yar klungs pa nas brgyud pa rta ra ba bzhugs pa nas/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ rta ra ba/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ nang zhing skyong ltar sgrub pa'am gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang ni/ 'phags pa rin po che yan bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang ltar la/ de nas dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bla ma dam pa (403bsgo sod nams rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dge ba rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sangs rgyas mchog /mtshungs med skyes mchog rgyal mtshan/ mdo khams pa lcags mo bkra shis seng ge /'disagadan thog gcig tu sngags thung 'bum phrag brgya song zhing zhal dngos su gzigs pa yin ro/ /rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ kun 578

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /phyi nang gi bsrung 'khor 'chi med sgrub pa zhar byung zlog pa dang bcas pa'i phyi'i nyams 'khrid/ gsang 'khrid kyi nyams khrid zab mo/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma nas brgyud pa'i sa bcad gnyis pa'i skor/ dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad gnyis pa'i rtags gang yang med pa rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rje bka' 'gyur ba yan gong ltar nas/zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /gsang 'khrid yig rnying gi brgyud pa lugs gcig la bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ g.yag phyug bstan pa'i nyi ma/rong ston shes bya kun rig /rje dge ba rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang bsrung 'khor tshe sgrub kyi 'khrid ni/lcags bkra shis seng ge nas/ khams ston bsod nams don grub/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa man 'dra/glang gi rtags yod do cog gi lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ glang bu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rtags sna tshogs las sa'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud skor/sa'i rtags yod do (404na chog gi lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ sa skya pa 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug /mkhan chen zha lu pa man 'dra/ zha'i rtags kyi lung ni mkhan chen nyid la kho bos nos khra'i rtags yod do cog gi lung ni/ mkhan chen zha lu pa nas/ mkhas grub blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /pha'i rtags thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i lung ni/ tshar chen nas/ rin po che bod mkhar ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ gsang bdag gnyis pa rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun —579

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()grub/ des bdag la'o/ /byang chub ma thob kyi bar du chos skyong snying dbus su mi 'bral ba'i nyams 'khrid zab mo nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab/ glang bu chos rje/ khyab bdag zha lu pa/des bdag la'o/ /dkar po tshe 'phel gyi tshe dbang thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan yan bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar la/ de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal ba mchog /'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / kun spangs rje/ tshar chen/ rje bod mkhar ba/ spyan lnga mi pham pa/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rje mgon bsod nams/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ desabadag la'o/ /yang na rje dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/des bdag la'o/ yang na rje dbang rab nas/ glang bu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong (404ba bo bang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /dkar po tshe sgrub thun mong ba/ ser po bsod nams sgrub pa lha lnga ma/ dmar po dbang sdud/sngon po bgegs 'joms rnams kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa yan bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang ltar/ de nas lo tsā ba mchog ldan mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags dang lo pa spyan lnga'i gsan yig dang mthun/man gdong brnyan can bzhin no/ /yang na ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta'i gzhung las kyang 'phrin las bzhi'i skor sogs bstan pas brgyud pa de ga ltar bgrangs na 'thad par sems mod 'on kyang gsan yig tshang mar gsal kha ma byung bas phyogs 'di la ljags kyi dbang po ring du rkyong ba mchis na dogs pa'i mdud pa 'grol bar gsol lo/ /yang na gong dkar lugs kyi gdong rnyan can gyi brgyud pa mchog ldan pa yod pa ji lta ba'o/ rdo rje gdan pa dang gsan yig rgya mtsho nas mo pa'i rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig dang mthun/dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ba dang ser po rgyas byed lha lnga'i rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas glang bu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa nas/ rje rin chen rnam rgyal/ rgya —580

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ bla ma shākya kun dga'/ rje dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ kun bzang rtse pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/ mkhan chen zha lu pa/ des bdag la'o/ /nor sgrub ser po gtso 'khor dgu pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ma hā de wā/ paṇ+ḍita shrī sidha/ ā tsarla gnyan chen dpal dbyangs/rgya gar (40ldan ga ma rū pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ glang ban ga rod/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar ba/ spyan lnga bsod nams grags pa/ rje bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ mtshungs med shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ grub mchog sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rin po che bod mkhar ba nas/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyi bar sngar bzhin/ de la bdag gis zhus/ yang na tshar chen nas/ sngags 'chang tshe dbang bkra shis/ bla ma rnam rgyal bkra shis/dpal 'byor gling pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ kun bzang rtse pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rje btsun grol mchog gis zhi rgyas dbang drag gi mgon po'i rjes gnang yangs pa can pa rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal la gsan cing gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa brgyud par 'dren bzhin du paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa nas dbus phrug phur pa dar dang / gshongs ma'i sngags pa las brgyud nas gnyan lo med khul mdzad 'dug pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig phyag bris ma gong dkar gyi phyag dpe khang na yod pa der 'phags pa yan lngar ltar la/ de nas lo tsā ba mchog ldan zhes yod pas mkhas pa chen po la'ang 'khrul gzhi byung bar mngon no/ /brtsegs zhal lam shi sa bstan pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ bsnyen dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar nas khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la bdag gis zhus so/ /yang na bdag chen kun dga' rin chen nas/ bdag chen blo gros pa/ rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ (405bsgo tshungs med shes rab zla ba/ rdo ring rin po che man gong dang 'dra/ yang na rdo ring rin po che nas/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na chos rje sa paṇa nas/ rong pa rgya lo/ sras shes —581 —

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)chen shol po ba/ rin po che sangs rgyas dbon/ zhig po rin po che ston tshul/ zur dben pa/ spyan snga chos kyi gzhon nu/ bla ma dbang phyug seng ge /rje byang chub rgyal mtshan/ rin po che shes rab grags/ bla ma rin chen rgya mtsho/ bla ma dpal rin skyabs rje nam mkha' chos bzang / brag thog pa dpal 'dzin bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ paṇa chen 'bum rab 'byams pa/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal po/ rje tshe dbang bkra shis/ sngags 'chang rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o/ /bram ze nag po mngags gtad kyi rjes gnang dang bram gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ 'phags pa rin po che yan bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang (406btom ra la/ de nas dam pa kun dga' grags/ brgyud lugs 'di lo pa spyan lnga'i gsan yig na 'dug /bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bdag chen kun rin pa/ bzhi thog blo gros pa/ rje dge rgyal ba/ rje shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos rje/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ rje bsod nams chos 'phel/ mtshungs med dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na bla ma dam pa yan bsnyen dus ltar la/ de nas bdag chen kun rin pa man kyang gong bzhin no/ /deng sang sa lugs nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang yin khul la zhal rnam 'gyur bcu gsum zhes rnam 'gyur gyi tha snyad 'dogs pa'ang lugs 'di la ye ma grags shing sha ba ri pa nas brgyud pa'i rnam 'gyur bzhi zhes pa dang 'khrul gzhi byung bar 'dug /sgrub dus kyi mgon po g.yas g.yon mthing nag tu byed pa yig cha khungs ma nas bshad pas mi 'thad pa ma yin na'ang gtso bor ta thā ga ta rak+shi ta'i bzhed pa ltar zhal khra can dang / de la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang yod pa sogs kyi rnam dbye tsam yang ma dod pa/ gdong brnyan can phyag bzhi par deng sang rjes gnang gi rgyud chad kyang yod khul/ yang gdong brnyan can zhabs bzhi yod pa'i blos byas/ gnad dbab dang spogs chog —583

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gcig pa so sor kha phral nas gnad dbab kyi mgon po brtsegs zhal ma dang / spogs chog la ma lha'i zhal can zhes dbye ba 'byed pa/ dmag dpon mgon po'i khyung 'kho zhas bzhi por mi the yang steng 'kha khyung zhal yin khul dang rtsa zhal khyung du 'dod pa/ gter mgon g.yas (407na tshe yon zhal bram ze dang steng zhal bram zer byed pa/ phyag mtshan dar khra can sogs lugs 'di la sgros tsam yang med pa grangs 'dren pa/ gtor ma la bram ze shugs ldan dang nag po bskyed pa'i rjes gnang / khams phyogs nas de mo lha dbang par byung zer ba'i bram ze dkar ser dmar smug sogs grangs nyer gcig tsam gyi rjes gnang byed pa sogs rnam par ma dag pa'i lugs de rnams blo dang ldan pa kun gyis ngan skyugs kyi phung po bzhin du dor bar bya ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ /khungs dang brgyud tshul phyag len 'di yin med pa'i rjes gnang re gnyis nos/ bskang gso tsam blor chud pa la mgon po'i grub thob kyi snyan pa dang ldan pa mang mod/ kho bo ni grub pa thob pa lta ci rmi lam bzang po tsam byung ba'i gdeng dang mi ldan na'ang khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dren las zab mo'i chos tshul rnams khong du chud pa'i gdeng cung zad ldan pa ni gong du smos pa de lags so/ /tshar lugs rdzong pod kyi lung sogs legs par nos pa'i lung brgyud skor/tshar lugs la rdzong pod kyi lung logs su mdzad pa'i srol 'dug pa ltar nos pa la/ dpal mgon tsa tu rmu kha bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ rdzong chung pa byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag gi yi ge'i tho/ de las byung ba'i gdams skor la/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma nas brgyud pa gnyis/ dang po la/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i dam tshig dngos —584

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)grub bsgrub pa'i thabs paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba gnyan gyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor rgya gar gyi yul du chu bo (407ba〉na ṅgā dang zhes sogs lo rgyus yod pa'i gong gi lag len bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge bla ma gnyan gyis mdzad pa zla ba gcig gis las rnams 'grub bo'i mtha' can/ gnyis pa ri sul gyi rnal 'byor nas brgyud pa la/ rtsa ba'i gzhung de la brten pa'i man ngag ste gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub thabs mchan bshad/ tshar lugs be'u bum gyi yang ngo'i brgyad dang zhes pa man mi 'dug /ma hā kā la'i sngags kyi gnad ces pa sa tshar lugs be'u bum na med/ gcod kyi yi ge las la bskul ba'i sngags yin no sa ma pa tha mi thi'i mtha' can zhan byung ma rgyu ma nu sogs kyi sngags yod pa/ rdo rje nag po cen po'i sngags kyi thems yig bstan pa/ mchod pa'i de kho na nyid bstan pa nir ya phu lan btsan mchod pa'i man ngag 'a lcags glegasabasan me rta ge bzhi stor gyi sked par 'dug pa zur du phyung ba yin 'dug /gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ sngags kyi kha skong chad 'jug bstan tshar lugs be'u bum na med/ pa bris pa med do'i mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa de la brten pa'i man ngag la/ lo rgyus/ mchod chog /rjes gnang / bsnyen sgrub las gsum man ngag phran tshegs dang lnga/ dang po ni/ 'gor oṃ su sti sid+dhi dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la phyag 'tshal lo gdams ngag 'di'i lo rgyus ni bla ma ben ta pa zhes yod pa'i bla ma gnyan gyis chos skyong btsal ba'i lo rgyus gdong bzhi pa'i nus pa yin gsung ba'i mtha' can zhar byung gnyan la phur pa dar gyis zhus tshul dang bcas pa/gnyis pa mchod chog la/ rgyun du mchod pa gtor ma'i cho ga khyad par du mchod pa skong gi cho ga dang gnyis/ dang po la/ 'gor na mo tā ra dpal mgon po gdong bzhi ba'i mgon po mchod pa ni zhes yod pa'i mchod gtor gnyan (408na)gyis nye gnas dar ma seng ge la byin pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/de'i kha skong 'gor 'di sgrub pa'i gang zag des zhes yod pa'i rdo rang byung gru gsum sogs 'god tshul dge slong gnyan gyi gdams ngag go'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo gu ru yi dam gang byed du bsam la zhes yod pa'i gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub (ma)thabs gnyan gyi man ngag dharma pā la u pa de sham+bhi'i su rung rung la mi ston no'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ su sti sid+dhi bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo —585

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dpal mgon po gdong bzhi pa yab yum gyi mchod gtor zhes yod pa'i gnam kha'u pas mdzad pa'i sgrub pa'i las khrigs zhal gzigs nas bstod pa 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo 'di sgrub par 'dod pas byang chub kyi sems zhes yod pa'i sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'phrin las bcol gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa dpal ldan dbang ldan ma/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i bstod pa sangs rgyas gcig bsdus ma/sngags 'chang gzungs pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa sku gsum mngon gyur ma/ dmod bskul yon tan rdzogs ma/ ngor lugs dang mthun tshar lugs la dbu'i mchod brjod blo ka gsum dang tshig gcig po de med/ gzungs pas bstod pa'i thun gsum ma/ zur shākya dpal gyis bstod pa'i rab 'jigs dur khrod ma rnams/ gnyis pa khyad par du mchod pa skong gi cho ga la/ ma hā kā la'i rten gzugs pa'i man ngag ces pa spyan 'dren lha mchog ma/ tshar lugs dang gong dkar lugs gnyis ka las nyung ba 'dug pa yig rnying sor sgom tu ma pho/ bskang gso (408bsko byed mthun ma/ stobs chen shugs drag ma dang bcas pa/ mgon pos zhal gzigs nas gnam kha'u par gnang ba'i mdos chog /'gor bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo ri rab bang rim bzhi byed pa'i lugs la zhes yod pa'i mdos shom rgyas cha lugs be'u bum na med/ pa chos rje ā nan+ta ma nyis mdzad pa shin tu gsang ba gal che 'o'i mtha' can/ gsum pa rjes gnang la/ 'gor oṃ su sti nag po chen po'i lung sbyin pa ni 'byor na tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge gnyan gyis mdzad pa/ gdams pa 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo 'di'i rjes gnang la don gsum ste zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi yi tshar lugs be'u bum la mas yod pa 'dir 'dug /ge rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa sbyar ba yin no'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ su sti sirnyi sku gsum mngon gyur rdo rje 'chang dbang dang zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi yi tshar lugs be'u bum na med/ ge slob dpon dpal ldan chos skyong gis bskul ba la brten nas a nan+ta ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dras dpal ngam ring rtser bris pa rnams/ rtsa ba'i bzhi pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum la/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag dngos/ de'i gsal byed —586

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)kyi yi ge phra mo dang gnyis/ dang po la/ yab yum sbrags ma'i bsnyen bsgrub las gsum dang / yum gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum ste gnyis/ dang po la/ 'gor ma hā kā la'i man ngag la bsnyen sgrub gnyis zhes yod pa'i gtso 'khor gsum la brten pa'i bsnyen bsgrub mnan gsum gyi man ngag gnyan gyis mdzad pa gsod na klu gnas sar sba'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor ma hā la tsa tu rmu kha u pa de sha zhes yod pa'i gtso 'khor gsum lnga gnyis ga'i bsnyen bsgrub las (409na tshe na sum tshar lug la sa chen gyis mdzad par bas/ gyi yi ge de'i snying gar bsnun par bya'o'i mtha' can/ de'i gsal byed 'gor oṃ su sti sirnyi rdo ba nag po mi gcig gi theg mi theg gcig ces yod pa'i yi ge ( 5 rnying pa tshar lugs be'u bum na med/man ngag dam pa'o'i mtha' ca ska mgon po sgrub dus kyi las khrigs rtsad nas chod ces brjod do'i mtha' can/ de gnyis ga'i gsal byed 'gor bla ma dang mgon po nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo mgon po sgrub dus kyi las khrigs la gsum zhes yod pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi las khrigs chen mo tshar lugs la 'di gzungs pas mdzad par bskyo/ shi ba la sogs pa'i las nges par 'grub po sa ma pa tha mi'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo dpal ldan mgon po gdong bzhi pa bsnyen cing sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi las khrigs nag po 'gro shes su grags tshar lugs dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad par bzhed/ pa sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas mdzad pa sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi yig chung ma spel gsang bar bya'o'i mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa yum gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum ni/ 'gor na mo gu ru bla ma gnyan gyi man ngag chig brgyud ma zhes yod pa'i yum srin mo las mkhan gyi sgrub thabs (ma)dam tshig med pa la gsang bar bya'o mtha' can/gnyis pa de'i gsal byed kyi yi ge phra mo la/ thun mong du gsal byed dang / so sor gsal byed gnyis/ dang po la/ 'gor oṃ su sti zhal gyi gdams pa 'di la zhes yod pa'i gnyan gyi gdams pa don drug pa skad ngan tser gyis 'ong ngo'i mtha' can/ (409ba'i gor dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo sgrub pa po la zhal bzhi pa'i mgon po 'go bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i zhal —587—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonagadams don lnga ma bzhi las mang ba la mi spel ba'i bka' rgya yod do'i mtha' can/ 'di'i khyad par gyi dam tshig yi ge gsang bar bya ba rnams yin no'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo mgon po la pha ltar bkur zhes yod pa'i chos skyong bsten thabs gnad yin no'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma gnyan lo'i zhal gdams zhes yod pa'i gtor ma bca' thabs rgyun gyi thun 'tshams sa'i mtha' can/ 'gor yar ngo'i brgyad dang zhes yod pa'i gtor ma gtong thabs nang par gtang ngo'i mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa so sor gsal byed la/ 'gor tā ra na mo ma hā kā la'i rten bca' ba ni phyi rten du g.yag nag ces yod pa'i rten gyi man ngag ces bya ba phyi nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid kyi rten bca' tshul gnyan gyis mdzad pa su thod thod la bstan par mi bya'o mtha' can/ 'gor ma hā kā la'i rten bca' thabs rdo nag po zhes yod pa'i nang rten gyi gsal byed bcu bzhi la ma chag pa gong bzhin no'i mtha' can/ 'gor gtum po rang bsrung gi 'khor lo dang zhes yod pa'i gsang rten gyi gsal byed gser srang bzhi phul ces grags so'i mtha' can/ 'gor rten bca' thabs la gri snying 'khor lo zhes yod pa'i yi ge 'gor 'di'i gnad la bla ma chos rje zhes yod pa'i rten bca' thabs kyi gnad kyi gsal byed mthol lo bshags kyi mtha' can/ 'gor bsrung 'khor la mu khyud ces yod pa'i sngags 'dri lugs u pa de sha 'o'i mtha' can/ sngags ring gi bar bar du 'dri lugs yod pa'i (410na tha srung 'khor gyi sngags byang g.yas bskor du 'dri'i mtha' can/ 'gor chos skyong gi gnad kyi yig chung zhes yod pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi zhal phyag gi khyad par ston pa rnam smin che gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor rten gyi mdun du zhes pa'i 'bul rdzas sha tshil la sogs pa 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo lung rjes su nod pa'i shri zhes yod pa'i me tog bzhi sbyor rnying pa'i pur+sha 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor bzlas lung gi me tog ces yod pa'i me tog bzhi sbyor gyi man nga gnywa'i mtha' can/ 'gor mchod pa'i spos sbyor gyi cho ga zhes yod pa'i yi ge lus sbrid pa la sogs 'byung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo dpal mgon gdong bzhi ba'i bsnyen sgrub ces yod pa'i thun mong gi bsnyen sgrub tshar —588

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)lugs 'phags pas mdzad par sa tshe/ gur las gsungs so'i mtha' can/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa rig pa 'dzin pa 'phags pas gsang sgrub tu mdzad pa/ 'gor sngags kyi gnad ni bsnyen sngags zhes yod pa'i yi ge dag par bzlas so'i mtha' can/ 'gor rje btsun gyi zhal nas zhes yod pa'i sgrub pa'i man ngag mi btub gsung ngo sam pa tha mi'i mtha' can/ tshar lugs la 'di gnyis chos tshan gcig tu mdzad/'gor dus rtag tu bsnyen pa bya zhes yod pa'i glo bur las bcol gyi man ngag mi 'grub mi srid do'i mtha' can/ 'gor las sbyor ling ga la thun rnams zhe sdang zhes yod pa'i bsnyen bsgrub las gsum gyi rtags mtshan dmod mo brjod do'i mtha' can/ gtor ma'i bkra brtag bya rog mi 'khor zhes yod pa'i tshig rkang drug pa/ 'gor rtsa ba'i 'khor lo ni rtsibs drug ces yod pa'i 'khor lo'i bri thabs (410ba)sdig pa'i sa bon byed pas gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor man ngag 'di'i bsrung 'khor 'dri bar 'dod na zhes yod pa'i yi 'di dkar chag na mi gsal pa gong gi 'phros yin nam snyam/ ge nges par 'grub gsung pa'i mtha' can/ sa yi yaṃ sogs 'khor lo'i sngags bri gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'khor lo'i skabs su rtsibs drug ces yod pa'i 'khor lo'i man ngag rdzogs par 'bri gsung ngo'i mtha' can/'gor thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams thun brdeg go'i mtha' can/'gor ling ga ni 'khor lo can zhes yod pa'i 'khor lo dang ling ga'i zhal gdams mi spel gsang bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na cho/ bsnyen bsgrub gnyis la ma ra ya'i mtha' med ces yod pa'i yang gsang thugs kyi nying khu ling ga la 'o'i mtha' can/ kha sbyor dbye ba'i man ngag 'di ni rab tu gsang ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor las sbyor gyi tshe zhes yod pa'i dmod pa las sbyor bcug la bya 'o'i mtha' can/ mngon spyod gsang las sgrub pa'i yi ge gsang sngags rnam pa gcig pas zab bo'i mtha' can/ nag po chen po'i sgong zor gyi yi ge las kyi mthar thug bla ma gnyan gyi man nga gnywa'i mtha' can/'phang ba khyu mchog zor gyi las 'bring yin no gnyan gyi u pa de sha'i ma po' can/ 'gor las mtha'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas 'brub khung khru gang pa brtsigs zhes yod pa'i yi ge sbyin sreg gi cho ga —589

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lha'i mtha' can/ 'gor las mi byed na zhes yod pa'i shi sa bstan pa gar thod thod du mi rung ngo gsang ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor ma hā kā la la na mo dang por chos thams cad ces yod pa'i bdag bskyed kyi yi ge a nā bh+yas dbu brgyan no'i (411na7tha' can/ 'gor bdag nyid ye shes kyi mgon po zhes pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag rtsub pas tshod blang gin bya'o gar thod thod bu mi bya gdams ngag yin no'i mtha' can/ 'gor rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas zhes yod pa'i lha mo nag mo'i zhal gdams re|ga (mi)dril bka' rgya ma'i man ngag go'i mtha' can rnams/ lnga ba man ngag phran tshegs la/ 'gor sri'u gso na khams phor zhes yod pa'i yi ge chung ba man ngag go'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i zhes yod pa'i sri'u gso ba'i gdams pa che ba bram ze kha spu can gyi man ngag /'gor tā ra na mo nag po chen po zhes yod pa'i las rgyas pa yid bzhin nor bu'i man ngag kun la kha lo sgyur ba yong gi mtha' can/ 'gor khams gsum dbang du sdud pa zhes yod pa'i gri lag dbang gi las shin tu zab pa'i mtha' can/ nag po chen pos bsgrub bya dbang du bya thabs rdzas skad shan sbyar ba nges par 'ong ngo'i mtha' can/ 'khon nag zas su za ba'i gdams pa slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ 'gor shrī ma hā kā la tsa tu rmu kha ye zhing skyong 'di'i sgo nas zhes yod pa'i ltas ngan gtong ba chig brgyud ma gtogs bka' rgya ma'o shin tu gnyan no'i mtha' can/ bya 'ug rta nag gi snying dang phag thod la brten nas ltas ngan gtong ba/ 'gor twa ra na mo grong khyer bskyod pa'i sngags la zhes yod pa'i bskrad pa'i las mthar thug go'i mtha' can/ de'i zhal shes dmigs pa'i 'khor lo dri mar bcas sogs tshig rkang drug ma/ de'i 'phros las zha kha shes 'khor du mi gzhug go'i mtha' can/ ngag mnan pa'i las mthar thug pa gnyan gyi gdams ngag3ni'i mtha' can/ ma hā ba la la brten (411ba)nas 'dre gnon pa btsan thabs su mnan pa'i man ngag3ni'i mtha' can/ gtum po'i shwa zlog lnga'i bar gyis bzlog go'i mtha' can/ mgon po la rang dang slob ma dang rdzas dang yo byad sogs gtod pa gsol ba gdab bo'i mtha' can/ gtsug lag khang gtad pa rgyas par bya 'o'i mtha' can/ de'i lag —590

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)len gsal byed gtsug lag khang gi rten zhes yod pa'i yi ge cho ga 'o'i mtha' can/ gnas dang mal cha nor rdzas bsrung ba cho ga 'o'i mtha' can/ mgon po'i gsang ba byed pa 'di dkar ga na mi gsal/mtshan ma ma byung gi bar du bya 'o gsang ba'i cho ga 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'di'i dam tshig gso ba ni rang lhag pa'i lha'i zhes yod pa'i yi ge bla ma gnam kha'u ba gsung gi mtha' can/ 'gor dpal ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo nyams chags sam 'chi ltas byung ba'am zhes yod pa'i gtor skyong gi yi ge bskang bshags cho ga 'o'i mtha' can/ spyod lam dbang du bya ba'i cho ga rdzogs so'i mtha' can dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs/ ba kla ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ bla chen gnyan/ gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sa chen/ slob dpon rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje paṇa chen/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'ad ston dkon mchog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal pa/ chos rje dge legs bzang po/ chos rje ā nan+ta ma ti/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgyud gsum smra ba shes rab rin chen/ tshar (412na)chen rdo rje 'chang / kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /yab sras gnyis ka la mkhan chen bslab gsum dang rin po che rta ra ba gnyis gas gsan/ yab sras bzhi ga la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ de nas khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse nas/ mthu chen bsod nams chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ sa skya khri chen kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'khon bsod nams dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /ma'i rtags yod pa rnams ma ga rta gos pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug brtan 391

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)nas/ lo pa spyan lnga kun dga' don grub/ lcags zam sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug /khyab bdag zha lu pa man 'dra/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis rgya gar nas bstan srungs brgya rtsa tsam gdan drangs pa'i nang nas/ gtso bor gyur pa stobs 'phrog nag po gdong bzhi pa'i bka' sdod bshan pa dmar nag gnyis su grags pa'i shin tu myur ba shu kra nag po'i skor ni tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos rong sham+bha ra chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gsan pa'i snyan gsan phul tshul sogs lam glu chen mor gsal ba ltar yin na'ang deng sang rgyun bzhugs par mi mngon zhing / mthu rtsal mchog tu che ba las mkhan dmar po gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral gyi skor la tshar ba rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rjes su gnang ba smin rgyas lan gnyis legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ (412ba)bka' ma'i skor dang gter ma'i skor te gnyis/ dang po la spyi bye brag gnyis/ dang po yongs grags spyi'i chos skor la/ yid ches pa lo rgyus/ nus ldan du bya ba rjes gnang / khungs btsun pa rgyud/ nyams su blang ba sgrub skor/ gong 'og tu nye bar mkho ba gtor mdos bskang ba/ gzungs dang thug chen bzugs pa/ bstod bskul/ las tsho gos dang brgyad/ dang po la/ gnod sbyin bshan pa lcam sring gi chos skor byung tshul bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros ltar gnyag gi bzhes yi ger bkod pa/ 'gor bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srog gi bshan pa mi reng dmar po zhes yod pa'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus (rin)man ngag la yi ge gcig kyang khyad mi 'dug go'i mtha' can/ 'gor bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo bshan pa sgrol byed srog bdag dmar po lo rgyus ni zhes yod pa'i bshan lta rirge)pa lcam dral gyi skye rgyus rgya bod du dar tshul gdams ngag gnyan gyi lugs che bar gda' 'o'i mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa nus ldan du bya ba rjes gnang la/ 'gor na mo gu ru pad+ma rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir zhes yod pa'i ( ri ni)rjes gnang gi yi ge kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge'i gsung sgros mjug tu bla ma brgyud pa bkod pa/ 'gor ha ya gi wa la na mo beg tse lcam dral gyi gtor dbang ni zhes yod pa'i (rin)sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi yig rnying —592

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gtor dbang yig chung lha'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam bral gyi rjes gnang gi yi ger kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge'i tho yig las cung zad gsal bar rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa 'phrin las thams cad myur du sgrub par mdzad du gsol gyi mtha' can rnams/ gsum pa khungs (413nasgo tsun pa brgyud la/ dmar po khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i ngan sngags bshan pa dmar mo'i rgyud (pha)le'u drug pa dmar mo 'jig rten za byed ma'i rgyud rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī dha ra kra shu dang bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pas bod yul dbus kyi gra thang gi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ 'di gnyis pha bong kha pa'i phyag dper mtshan zhib par 'dug pa'i lung yang byung / srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags bshan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud (6)le'u lnga pa shrī dha ra kra shu dang mar pas gra thang du bsgyur ba'o/ /bzhi pa nyams su blang ba bsgrub skor la/ mo'i sgrub pa dmar mo khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i ngan sngags (6)bshan pa dmar mo'i sgrub thabs ā tsarla nyi ma grags kyis mdzad pa shrī dha ra kra shus bsgyur ba/'di gnyis pha bong kha ba'i phyag dper mtshan 'dug pa'ang nos/ pho'i sgrub nga srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags bshan pa sgrol byed kyi sgrub thabs ('in ā tsarla nyi ma grags pas mdzad pa shrīdha kra shu dang mar pas bsgyur ba/'gor gnod sbyin 'di ni skyes bu dbang gi mdog can zhes kyang bya zhes yod pa'i bshan pa dmar po'i sgrub thabs (pha)dgra bo dngos su sgrol bar 'gyur gyi mtha' can ā tsarla nyi ma grags kyis mdzad pa shrī dh+wa ra kra shus bsgyur ba/ 'di'i mjug tu rgya gar bam so dmar po nas nyi 'od grags pas bton tshul dang dgra la mig bltas pa tsam gyis shi ba byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod do/ /dmar po khrag gi mda' 'phen ma dang bshan pa dmar mo'i ngan sngags yab yum sbrags te (ma/grub pa gnas gsar gyi phyag dper nga yi nor gyi rting la rgyug man 'bri 'phro lus 'dug /ā tsarla nyi ma grags gyis mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can shrī dhar kra shu dang mar pas gra thang du bsgyur ba/ srog bdag dmar po bshan pa gri thogs kyi sgrub thabs (6)(413ba〉yu stegs slob dpon rdo rje grags pas mang yul byams sprin mgon po'i thugs dar sbas nas bstan pa'i don du smon lam btab pa gnam lcags thog dmar/ pho rkyang sgrub pa gnod —593

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sbyin ra zhen yam shud dmar po'i sger sgrub (6)gnyan los mdzad pa bdag gis bran bzhin khol bar shog yam shud srog gi sgrub pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo srog bdag dmar po bshan pa gri thogs sgrub par 'dod pas gnas ni ri gsum 'dus pa'am zhes yod pa'i sgrub thabs mjug tu bcol ba'i las rnams ma lus sgrub par mdzod ces yod la mang du thos pa'i btsun pa seng ge 'bum gyis dpal brag ram gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba gsang bar bya 'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor rgya gar skad du dang dur khrod dam brag dmar po'i rtsar bsgrub ste zhes yod pa'i gnod sbyin lcam sring gi sgrub thabs drag po gnad bskul dang bcas pa kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng gis mdzad pa dgra bgegs ma lus tshar gcod par 3|ga gi mtha' can rnams/ lnga pa gong 'og tu nye bar mkho ba gtor mdos bkang ba la/ 'gor chos skyong beg tse can gyi gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas lha mo dang de'i smin mtshams nas beg rtse spro ba'i gtor chog yig rnying bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ 'dar phya ru ba rin chen dpal bzang gis brag ram chos grwar mdzad pa'i bkang ba ra dmar khrag chang ma/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bkang ba lha mchog sgrol ging ma/a mo ghas mdzad pa'i (414na tha kang ba dus gsum rgyal ba ma/ gtor chog bsdus pa tshar chen gyi gsung rgyun mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs kyi mtha' can/ de'i gsung rgyun gyi bkang rdzas byin rlabs/lcang spe ba seng ge 'bum gyis mdzad pa'i bkang ba byang shar dbang ldan ma/ bshags pa bde chen chos sku ma/ bu d+dha bha dras bstod pa'i gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse ma/ burnya wa rnas mdzad pa'i bstab pa dbang ldan ma ru ma rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i bkang bshags rgyun khyer rol mo drag tu bya 'o'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi thugs dam bkang pa'i cho ga rgyas pa byang shar mya ngam ma shar mdo khams pa rdo rje bkra shis kyi ngor rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ des ā tsarla nyi 'od grags dang gnyan lo sogs gong ma rnams kyi yi ge 'thor pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te mdzad pa'i 394

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)gnod byin lcam dral gyi las byang 'phrin las lhun grub ma/ gtor mdos la brten nas srog bdag dmar po bshan pa sgrol byed bcos pa'i (phad(sgyur dar/thabs phyogs phyogs ma gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa srog bdag dmar po'i bkang mdos rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin bshan pa lcam dral gyi gtor zlog (su/bos so chos skyong ma dpal ldan 'dar phya ru ba rin chen bzang pos dpal brag ram gyi gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa rnams/ drug pa gzungs dang thug chen gzugs pa la/ gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor bcas kyi phyi rten gzugs pa'i lag len gyi rim pa gnyag gi ban+de bi dza bha dras dpal nyan po'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ srung ma'i dbang po beg gdong lcam dral (414ba)gyi thug gso ba'i cho ga (6)sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa byang shar dbang ldan mar grags pa 'dar gyi ban+de rig 'dzin rdo rjes sbyar ba dang bcas pa'o/ /bdun pa bstod bskul la/ lcang spe ba seng ge 'bum gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa rig pa'i lha mo ma/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge mus srad dgon par sbyar ba'i bstod pa gang gi thugs rje ma/ rigs 'dzin rtogs ldan blo gros bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor rtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mus srad gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa'i bstod bskul gnas mchog rgya gar ma/ gnyag gi ban+de rnam rgyal bzang pos bstod pa'i ha ha dgod pa ma/rgyud las byung ba'i bskul gnod sbyin zangs gyi beg tse (6)ma dang rig pa'i (6)lha mo ma/ rgya gar dam sri ma/ 'jam dpal thugs kyi pho nya ma/ e ka dza ḍi ma/ las mkhan srog bdag ma/ gri thogasabargyad/ bshan pa nyer gcig /bka' 'khor spyi/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/rgyu skar nyer brgyad dang bcas pa rnams kyi bskul (6)gnyan los bsgrigs pa/ gnad nas bskul ba ma hā de wa ma rnams/ brgyad pa las tshogs la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po la/dam tshig pa bskyed bstim/ bsnyen pa/ rtags/ las sbyor/ shi sa/ spyo 'bog /ltas ngan/ bcun thabs rnams kyi snying po'i man ngag (4na)ā tsarla nyi ma grags kyis mdzad pa shrīdha ra ku shus bsgyur ba dam nyams lag tu ma gtang zhig gi mtha' can/ dmar po khrag gi mda' (415na tsher phen ma'i 'khor le'i —593

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)man ngag (pha)'byung ba rlung la brten nas bskor ba smyo 'bog lceb par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ 'di lag tu blangs nas dregs ldan cham la phab pa'i nyams myong yang cung zad bdog /'gor bstan pa bsrung ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo sngags dang rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin dang zhes yod pa'i (che/gsad pa'i las sbyor dha ra kra shu'i ngan sngags zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' rgya ma/ ling ga ming byang 'dri ba'i (rin)rdzas dang smyu gu'i ngos 'dzin/ 'gor dgra bo lha dang dbye ba la spyir dgra la lha lnga zhes yod pa'i lha dbye'i man ngag lhun bzang bdag la gnang ba lags so'i mtha' can/ 'gor ā+oṃ āḥlha yod pa'i sngags bsnal dkrug zlog (6)pa sogs kyi zab gnad gsad pa'i sngags8ni'i mtha' can rnams/gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bla rdo'i (su/man ngag gnyan lo'i tshig brgyud ma/bshan pa dmar po'i gsang rten (tshu/bca' thabs ra ban chos dpal gyi brjed byang / 'gor rang yi dam du gsal ba zhes yod pa'i (su/bzlas pa'i gnad mtho bar byas nas yab rbad do'i mtha' can/gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi bsnyen grub las gsum lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ha la nag po dug gi spu gri zhes bya ba dbang lung thob pa'i snod ldan re gnyis la chig brgyud ma gtogs mang por spel na bshan pa dmar po la zas su gtad pa'i bzhes sgra dang bka' rgya shin tu dam pa rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i nang gi rnal 'byor la brten nas bsnyen bsgrub las gsum myur (415ba)du 'grub pa'i zab gnad can rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu dang srog bral lto ba'i gser bzhin sba ba'i chig brgyud ma ming tsam yang brjod par dka' ba'i gdams pa/ yab yum srog 'khor/ sgrub pa'i 'khor lo kha sbyor/ rlung 'khor gyi dpe ris dang bcas pa rnams phyag len dmar 'khrid nyams su myong bar nos/ gnyis pa bye brag gis skor la/ gnod sbyin dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug par brten pa'i gsang sgrub bka' rgya ma snying khrag thang la pho zhig gi mtha' can/ gnod sbyin gdug pa'i las sbyor la brten nas dgra la khyi dmag drang ba be ro tsa nas paṇ+ḍi ta dha tsaṇ+ḍal gser srang gang phul nas zhus pa/dgra la bya dmag gtong ba sa la sba'o'i mtha' can/ wa thod las kyi rlung dmar la brten nas sngags —596

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)pa nag po bsgral pa'i gdams pa man+t+ra3ni'i mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa gter ma'i skor la/ nub lugs dang nyang lugs gnyis/ dang po la/ bshan pa dgu skor gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po pad+mas bsam yas dbu rtse'i ke'u tshang du gter du sbas pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis spyan drangs pa la/rgyal po gser gyi shugs can dang btsun mo ut+pa la'i rgyan gnyis kyi sras su gcen grags ldan dang gcung grags skyes gnyis 'khrungs pa'i lo rgyus/ 'gor khrag gis dmar rdzib gtang zhes yod pa'i srog bdag yam shud dmar po spu gri reg chod ces bya ba yum shud btsan gyi cog brdung bshan pa dgu skor gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa/ slob dpon pad+mas dur khrod phung lung nag por srog (416na thad ga yam shud dmar po'i srog phrogs nas mdzad pa'i bshan pa dgu skor gyi sgrub thabs sngags kyi rgya bsdebs zhes bya ba/ gsad pa srog las kyi rkyal bu nas phyung ba ngan sngags kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ wa thod kyi thun snod la brten pa'i srog bdag yam shud dmar po'i thun gyi sgrub pa/ bya 'ug khra srin bzhi'i sgro sgron pa'i srog bdag yam shud kyi mda' zor/ rdzas la brten nas spyo ba/ mdze/ skrangs 'bur/ bsrung ba/ mtshon bsrung / las mi byed par 'khru na srog bdag dmar po gzir zhing bcun pa/ mde kha rnam drug ces pa gri srog la brten nas smyo ba/ nal thod la brten nas gsad pa/ rims thod la brten nas nad rims/ spyo 'bog gi thod par brten nas 'od/ mon thod la brten nas ltas ngan/ phur par brten nas cho 'phrul rnams gtong ba/ 'gor srog bdag bshan pa zhes yod pa'i dmod kha brgyad pa3|'i mtha' can/ 'gor srog bdag chen po'i dus la babs zhes yod pa'i bla 'gugs pho nya'i skabs gtso 'khor rnams kyi bskul byang bskul zhing rbad do rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa nyang lugs skor ni/ drag po btsan gyi rgyal 'bud slob dpon chen pos mnga' bdag la gdams pa sba gro skyer chu dang ru lag grum pa rgyang gnyis su rgod dang /g.yung mang yul du sbas shing rgod gcig mchims phur sbas pa mnga' bdag nyang gis spyan drangs pa la/bshan pa srog gcod dmar po'i srog mthu (416ba bog po btsan gyi rkyal 'bud bsnyen sgrub rbad —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bskul la ma bltos pa'i ngan sngags chig chod ma yid la yang dran du mi rung ngo'i mtha' can/ gsang bskul dur khrod chen po ma 'phrin las gong ma rnams las thos pa yi ger bkod pa 'o'i mtha' can/bshan pa srog gcod dmar po'i srog mthu'i zhal shes gsad thabs rnam pa lngas bstan pa las 'phro can dang 'phrad shog gi mtha' can/ drag po btsan gyi rkyal 'bud kyi zhal shes yig chung sgrub pa'i zhag grangs spog pa kha bsgyur rnams bstan pa gsang pa'i zhal shes snying ltar chongs las can la 'phrad shog gi mtha' can/ drag po btsan gyi rkyal 'bud kyi yang yig rgya gar gyi ngan sngags gsad pa'i spu gri sdang ba dgra'i gshed ma bla srog rku ba'i man ngag ma gter nas phyung banywa'i mtha' can dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob pa'i rin dang su'i rtags yod pa ma gtogs pa'i rjes gnang dang bka' ma sa bcad gnyis po'i lung yongs rdzogs man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ma hā de ba/ā tsarla nyi 'od grags pa/ sras zla ba nag po/ paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/ shrī dhar kra shu'ang zer 'di lam 'bras pa'i gha ya dha ra ni min par 'dug /gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa dar ma seng ge /rje btsun sa skya pa chen bo/ ra sa'i shod bu bkra shis 'od zer/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug grub thob 'dar phya ru pa rin chen bzang po/ chos rgyal bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje/ jo sras sangs rgyas rin chen/ slob dpon shes rab mtsho/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug /lcang spe ba seng ge 'bum/ (417na sko/na mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge bzang po/ chos rje rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla ma gzhon nu dpal ba/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgyud gsum smra ba shes rab rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rin po che rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ grub pa mchog gi ded dpon dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /nye brgyud ni slob dpon chen po pad+mas grub thob 'dar phyar la dbang dang gdams pa gnang ba yin no/ / 598

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam dang po/ (ka)rjes gnang dang lung gdams skor rags rim gyi brgyud lugs khag /rjes gnang dang lung gdams skor rags rim gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po nas/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mus chen rnam rgyal dpal bzang / zhabrul zhig dkon mchog bzang po/ tshar chen man 'dra yang rjes gnang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje nas/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang / mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ge man 'dra/ yang na mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ge nas/ tshal min bsod nams bzang po/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge nas/ dpal ldan rat+na kirti/ gu ru dug gsum nad sel/ mtshungs med rin chen bkra shis (417bsgon 'dra/ yang na rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po nas/ ston pa chos dpal ba/dam pa seng ge /grub chen be phug pa bde legs rgyal mtshan/ slo bo dzar pa sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bsod nams 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/gnubs lugs gter ma'i lung brgyud ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku pad+ma dbang chen/sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ nubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs pa tshur ston pa/ gnubs ston phug pa 'bar/ de nas rim par sngags 'chang sangs rgyas 'phel/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po brgyud par bzhugs pa bzhin no/ /nyang gter gyi lung brgyud ni/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma nas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ lha sras mu tig btsan po/ nyang nyi ma 'od zer nas rim par brgyud de/ tshar ba rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang / rin/ pha/ 'dar gsum gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge nas/ mkhas grub rin chen dpal —599

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yonabazang / grus ston kun dga' bzang po/ dran mchog don yod rgyal mtshan/ de sras rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de sras thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ se ra rje btsun pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bde legs nyi ma/ shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rin chen bshes gnyen/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag za hor ban+de la stsal to/ /yang na rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po (418na khos/ des sras kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen seng ge /gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ se ra rje btsun pa man 'dra/ rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa nas/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rjes gnang 'dar dang su'i rtags yod pa'i lung 'khor lo'i phyag bzhes bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'khrul zhig dkon mchog bzang po nas/ de sras sngags 'chang gzhen nu stobs ldan/rin chen rdo rje yang zer / sngags 'chang phyag na rdo rje/ pha rgan gu ru rin chen/ snying ri ba rgyal sras bde ba bzang po/ yi dam gyi lhas brtags pa la rig pa'i ye shes zer/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na gab chag pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan nas/ mnyam med dkon mchog dpal bzang / nub dgon pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/ nub dgon sprul sku shākya rgyal mtshan/ rgyal sras bde ba bzang po man 'dra/ yang na grub thob 'dar phyar nas/'dar dgon pa chos kyi 'byung gnas/ sngags 'dzin tshe 'chang chos skyong mgon yi/ yar 'dren nam mkha'i mtshan can/ rigs 'dzin tshe dbang rgyal po/ rigs 'dzin grags pa rdo rje/ pha rgan gu ru rin chen man 'dra// //—600
